tei:div.tei:p: ji rirtso ) khuXtre lā rmigi jir+ṣa9 ri — — — nga pa ( 'i ni7 zhu snye hwa cigi khu sbyi t+t+waṃ 1snye tshodzā—wa/sto—3 kā ③ 'u ḍāgyid+ku dzi/ snye ’ — rmenya ri / /rti ram̐ — dhe —duḥ sto kai —skeblo— lhod+ngha ne dhe rto ram̐ k+ṣi/ — zugle gi 5 tsho ‘trī ( /:gatre —nga ṣ+yom+bi ོ༵ rngo rde wa sprung bod kyi rig dpe spun khang /
— tsho snyi ci rdo2 ri 7du ci rdosheri3tsho rtsom pa po'i 'dra par/

dpe srun gsal bshad/mkhas pa'i dbang po dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las mchog ni/1927lor bod ljongs kong po nying khri'i khongs jo mo shang du sku 'khrungs shing / 1934lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas dung dkar sprul skur ngos 'dzin gnang / khong gis se ra dgon par nang bstan mdo lugs gzhung chen po lnga la sbyangs pa gnang ba dang / 1947lor dbe bshes lha rams pa ang bzhi pa'i gzigs bzos bya dga' thob/ rjes su nang chos gsang— sngags kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa gnang zhing / 1951'o/ra dge bshes sngags rams pa ang gnyis pa'i bya dga' gzigs bzos thob/de bzhin bod kyi rig gnas gzhan dag la'ang sbyangs pa dpyis phyin par mdzad/ 1956lor krung gung nying khri kron chus kyi u yon dang nang bstan chos tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon par bsko bzhag thog gsar brje'i las don la zhugs shing / de nas mi ring bar pe cing du krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig dge rgan gyi phyag las gnang / ‘6rig/ gnas gsar rje'i ’’nang lha sa grong khyer grong mi u yon lhan khang gnyis pa'i khongs sungal rtsol bsgyur bkod la zhugs/ 1974lo nas bzung snga rjes su bod rang skyong ljongs rig dngos do dam u yon lhan khang dang /bod ljongs yig tshags bdag gnyer khang / bod ljongs gsar brje 'grem ston khang / bod rang skyong ljongs chab srid gros tshogs bcas la dkar

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chag dang lo rgyus rtsom sgrigs kyi phyag las gnang zhing / 1978lo nas bzung slar yang krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig dge rgan gyi phyag las gnang / dge rgan chen mo gzhon pa dang / dge rgan chen mo ba'i go ming thob pa'i thog krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i phul byung dge rgan gyi gzengs bstod lag 'khyer dang / bod rang skyong ljongs slob gso tshan rtsal u yon lhan khang nas bod ljongs slob gso'i phul byung byas rjes can gyi gzengs bstod lag 'khyer thob/ 1993lo nas da bar rgyal yongs chab srid gros tshogs skabs bdun pa dang skabs brgyad pa'i u yon du 'dems bskos byung ba dang / gzhan yang krung go rgyal yongs lo rgyus zhib 'jug tshogs pa dang krung go 'dzam gling chos lugs zhib 'jug tshogs pa/ krung go grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rtsom rig zhib 'jug tshogs pa/ krung go rgyal yongs nang bstan chos tshogs bcas kyi u yon dang 'thab jus 'dri yul/ krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi spyi khyab dbu 'dzin gzhon pa dang / rgyal spyi'i bod rig pa'i zhib dpyad lhan tshogs kyi las 'dzin bcas kyi 'gan bzhes gnang la/ snga rjes su 'jar man dang /nor wi/ dbyi tā li/ o ti li/ h+pha ran si/ dbyin ji bcas su rgyal spyi'i bod rig pa'i zhib dpyad gros tshogs su phebs myong ba bcas mdor na khong nyid ni rgyal khab phyi nang du mkhas pa'i grags pa rab tu 'bar bar mngon/gsung rtsom gyi thad la bod kyi dus deb phal che ba'i steng du ched rtsom khag mang po zhig spel gnang myong yod la/ dpe deb 〈 tshig rgyan rig pa'i 2

dpe sgrun gsal bshad/ sgo 'byed 〉dang / 〈 bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa 〉〈 deb ther dmar po'i mchan 'grel 〉(rgya yig dang dbyin yig gnyis su bsgyur nas phyi rgyal du yang 'grems spel byas)bcas mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas dpe skrun 'grems spel byas yod la/ de bzhin da lta gnang mus kyi〈 gna' rabs bod kyi lo rgyus rgyun spyod tshig mdzod 〉ces pa ming tshig khri tsho lnga yas mas zin pa'i deb chen zhig kyang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gi dpe skrun 'char gzhir bkod zin pa bcas so//〈 gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 〉'di ru khong gis dus deb mang por gnang ba'i ched rtsom khag nyi shu lhag dang / da thengs rtsom pa pos slar yang dag zhus gnang ba'i 〈 bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa 〉ces pa'i dpe deb bcas phyogs bsdus byas yod la/ nang don gyi cha nas bod kyi lo rgyus dang / chos lugs/ skad yig slob gso/ bod yig dpe rnying par skrun/ bod kyi dkar chag rig pa bcas nang don dang rnam grangs kyi cha nas phun sum tshogs par 'khod stabs bod kyi rig gnas bang mdzod 'di nyid nyams pa sor chud dang gnas pa rgyun 'dzin/ stong pa gsar 'dren bcas byed pa'i sgo nas rim gyis phun sum tshogs par 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i lde mig lta bu zhig tu 'gyur nges pas/ rgya che'i klog pa po dag gi spyan lam du par du bskrun pa lags/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe srun khang nas/ 3

dkar chagasrong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa dbyar dus thog ma'i 'brug sgra/ (/)bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi 'phel 'gyur skor gleng ba/ (40)bod kyi dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byor gnas tshul la dpyad pa/ (67)gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldog byung tshul skor gleng ba/ (79)gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i byung ba rags bsdus/ (99)mkhan slob gnyis kyi mdzad rjes mdor bsdus/ (107)bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog gi gnad don 'ga' zhig gleng ba/ (/25)sems gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i nang dngos gtso smra ba 'dres nas yod pa/ (153)bod gna' rabs kyi rig gnas dang /chos lugs/ mi rigs bcas kyi 'byung khungs skor gleng ba/ (/62)bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug cung zad byas pa'i myong tshor/ (182)bod ljongs su tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las don thog la thob pa'i grub 'bras rags tsam gleng ba/ (200)bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltar byung ba'i gtam gleng / (207)

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skor gyi thog ma'i bsam tshul/ (293)bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/ (327)bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhig skor gleng ba/ (406)tun hung nas thon pa'i bod yig gi lo rgyus yig cha dpe skrun byas pa'i gleng gastun/ (452)bod kyi rdo ring yi ge dang dril bu'i kha byang gces bsdus dpe skrun byas pa'i gleng gzhi/ (455)〈 deb ther sngon po'i 〉mdzad pa po'i lo rgyus dang nang don ngo sprod gnad bsdus/ (462)〈 deb ther dmar po gsar ma 〉mdzad pa po'i lo rgyus dang nang don ngo sprod gnad bsdus/ (473)〈 sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad mkhas pa'i legs bshad gces bsdus 〉kyi rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus gnad bsdus/ (477)bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/ (481)2

spong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa dbyar dus thog ma'i 'drug sgra/lugs gnyis khrims srol drang por legs srong gser skud zung gcig 'brel ba'i thig sne/gzhom med rdo rje'i mkhar rdzong rab btsan gangs ljongs nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir/ sgo /ring por brkyang ba'i mkhyen dpyod yongs sgam mtha' yas chu gter che la 'gran/ / sgos chen skyong mkhas mi yi bdag po deng yang mtshan snyan dpal gyis brjid/ /rnam mang mi rigs rig gzhung nor bu'i mdzod/ /bod ljongs gser ldan yangs pa'i snod gcig tu/ /bsdu bar mdzad la rlabs chen dgongs pa'i rtsal /zla med mi yi dpa' bo khyed 'dra dkon/ /gang gi mdzad rjes nor bu'i phreng ba yis/ /sa chen dam por 'ching ba'i sde bzhi'i dpal/ /ngo mtshar bsngags brjod dbyangs kyi cha shas tsam/gzur gnas thos 'dzin mdzes pa'i rgyan du blangs/ /

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rang rigs mchog 'dzin dregs ldan ri bo'i spor/ /gnas lnga'i shes rig rdzing bu bskyil byas kyang / /mi chags blo gros gshong gya rab yangs par/ /phul byung yon tan chu mtsho kun nas 'khyil/ /rigs mtshungs gzhan gyi sngon byung drang po'i gtam/ /smra la mgrin pa'i mdud rgya ma grol yang / /blo gsal rig can kun gyi mes po ru/ /rlom pa'i rang mthong can rnams mchid 'di gson/ /ces ched du brjod pa'i snyan tshig gi me tog 'phreng ba cung zad spel ba dang chabs cig gang gleng bar bya ba ni/ dwangs gsal shel dkar gzhon nu'i khu bas lan brgyar byugs pa lta bu'i sa 'dzin gyi mu khyud yongs su mdzes pas khor yug tu bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir/ rmongs pa'i mun pa sel ba'i lugs gnyis khrims srol bzang po'i nyi gzhon gyis 'phral yun phan bde'i pad tshal thog mar bzhad par mdzad pa'i btsan po srong btsan sgam po zhes grags pa don ldan gyi mtshan snyan gser gyi skud pas yangs pa'i nor 'dzin mtha' dag 'ching bar mdzad pa de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus cha shas tsam zhig rang rigs phyi rabs kyi skye bo blo gros dang ldan pa rnams la thog ma'i dpyad gzhi'i tshul du gleng bar spro'o/ /2

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa/dang po/ pur rgyal bod kyi rus rgyud tsho pa khag rnams gcig gyur byas te mi rigs kyi rnam pa ldan pa'i srid dbang thog mar btsugs pa/da yod kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha gzhir bzung na/ de sngon bod kyi btsan po srong btsan sgam po ma byon gong gi lo bdun brgya sum cu so gcig gi sngon la btsan po gnya' khri btsan po byung zhing / de'ang rang rgyal gyi han nub ma'i rgyal rabs kyi gong ma han u rdi dang phal cher dus mtshungs par snang / (spyi lo'i gong gi lo 140—spyi lo 87bar)de nas rgyal rabs sum cu pa 'bro gnyan lde'u'i bar bod kyi sa gnas khag rnams rus rgyud tsho pa khag mang pos bcad bzung byas te kha 'thor du gnas pa las sus kyang gcig gyur byed ma thub/ rgyal po stag ri gnyan gzigs kyis srid dbang bzung rjes/ ban pa rje dang / 'a zha rje/ brang gar rje sogs rus rgyud tsho pa'i rgyal phran 'ga' zhig mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa'i 'go tshugs shing /de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan gyi dus su 'phan yul gyi zing po rje dang /gtsang gi rgyal po mar mun/ dwags po sa khus bcas mnga' 'og tu bsdus te/ bod sa gnas kyi rus rgyud tsho pa rnams gcig gyur byed pa'i rmang gzhi bting yod/de rjes btsan po srong btsan sgam pos srid dbang bzung rjes/ sngar 3

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ yod btsan po gong ma'i dus kyi mnga' khongs sra brtan du btang thog da dung nub phyogs kyi zhang zhung dang / byang phyogs kyi 'a zha dang / gru gu/sum pa bcas dang / lho phyogs kyi 'jang bcas mnga' 'og tu bsdus nas mnga' khongs sngar las rgya che ru song ba ma zad/ rus rgyud tsho pa khag gcig gyur byas te bod mi rigs kyi rnam pa ldan pa'i srid dbang thog mar btsugs thub pa byung ngo / /de skor 'dir zhib phra gleng rgyu min/gnyis pa/ cung zad cha tshang zhing go rim ldan pa'i sgo nas chab srid dang / dmag don/dpal byor bcas kyi khrims srol gtan la phab pa/khrims lugs ni srid dbang gsar du 'dzugs pa'am sngar yod srid dbang sra brtan du gtong ba dang / mnga' khongs bde 'jags su gnas pa/ phyi nang gi dgra bo'i gtor bshig gi spyod ngan bkag 'gog dang tshod 'dzin byed pa bcas kyi thad la ha cang gal che ba'i bya ba chen po zhig red/der brten rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod sa gnas kyi rus rgyud tsho pa khag gcig gyur byas te mi rigs kyi rnam pa ldan pa'i srid dbang gsar du btsugs rjes chab srid dang / dmag don / dpal 'byor bcas kyi khrims srol cung zad cha tshang zhing go rim yod pa zhig gtan 'be+ebs mdzad yod pa red/ 4

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa/skabs der thog mar gtan 'bebs byas pa'i khrims srol spyi'i ming la khod sum cu so drug zer/ bka' yi khrims yig chen po drug bka' gros chen po drug yig tshangs drug bka' yi phyag rgya drug rkyen drug dpa' mtshan drug bcas yin/bka' yi khrims yig chen po drug ni/ 1 khri rtse 'bum bzher gyi khrims/ 2 'bum gser thog sha ba can gyi khrims/ 3 rgyal khams dper blangs kyi khrims/ 4 mdo lon zhu bcad kyi khrims/ 5 dbang chen bcad kyi khrims/ 6 khab so nang pa'i khrims bcas yin/bka' yi khrims yig drug gi dang po/ khri rtse 'bum bzher gyi khrims ni/srid 'dzin sa khul khag gi dbye mtshams dang / de'i srid 'dzin dang dmag don gyi sgrig gzhi/ dpon rigs khag gi go gnas dang las 'gan bcas gtan 'bebs byas pa'i khrims srol la zer zhing / de yang nang gses phye na bdun yod de/ (dang po/)ru sde po lnga ste srid 'dzin spyi khyab sa khul chen po lngar phye ba/ (gnyis pa/) yul gyi dbang ris zhes rgyal blon dang rus rgyud tsho pa khag gis sger bzung byas pa'i sa khul rnam pa bco brgyad du phye ba/ (gsum pa/) rgod kyi stong sde zhes dmag dpung gi sde tshan drug cu rtsa gcig tu phye ba/ (bzhi pa/) blon po che dgu zhes srid 'dzin spyi khyab rim pa'i blon chen dgur phye ba/ (lnga pa/) dpon bdun sogs srid 'dzin las tshan dma' ba'i rim pa'i dpon rigs che chung khag bcu gnyis su phye ba/ (drug pa/) g.yung gi mi sde zhes 'bangs mi'i khongs su gtogs pa'i rje bran rim pa lngar phye ba/ (bdun pa/) sa zhing dbang 5

— dungadakarablo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i lam lugs rim pa drug tu phye ba bcas yin/(1)bod sa gnas kyi mnga' khongs rnams skye khyab srid 'dzin sa khul ru sde chen po lngar dbye ba ni/ dbu ru/ g.yo ru/ g.yas ru/ ru lagasum pa'i ru bcas yin zhing / 'di rnams 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉nang gsal ba ltar las 'dir bskyar ldab ma byas shing /'on kyang 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉las skabs 'dir ru chen lngar phye ba'i nang zhang zhung gi ru sde 'dus min gsal bar ma bshad cing / stong sde drug cu re gcig tu phye ba'i skabs zhang zhung stod smad gnyis ru sde gcig tu brtsis par bshad 'dug pa de ni dbus la dbu ru dang g.yo ru gnyis/ gtsang la g.yas ru dang ru lag gnyis/ sum pa'i ru yi nang zhang zhung gi ru sde 'dus pa'i dbang du byas nas ru sde chen po lngar phye ba yin nam brtagagong gsal ru sde chen po lngar phye ba ni spyi khyab rim pa'i srid 'dzin sa khul yin zhing / de rnams la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i dpon rigs go gnas mtho shos ni blon chen yin/ de'i 'og tu dmag dpon rgan gzhon bzhi dang / ru dpon/ sde dpon/ stong dpon/ stong bu chung gi rje/ lnga brgya chen po sogs dpon rigs rim pa mang po yod tshul 'og gi dpon bdun gyi skabs su bshad par 'dod pas 'dir ma bris la/ spyi khyab rim pa'i srid 'dzin sa khul lnga po de ni dmag srid gcig gyur gyis do dam byed pa'i sa khul yin/ de ni gsar du btsugs ma thag pa'i srid dbang la mtshon na dmag srid gnyis ka gcig gyur gyis do dam byed bde ba dang /6

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyibyungabacungazadabarjodapa/ —da lhag par du sa rgya che zhing mi grangs nyung ba'i sa khul la ched las dmas dpung gi stobs shugs gcig pus khyab ma thub pa'i dbang gis mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i 'bangs mi yongs rdzogs rjes grabs dmag mi sha stag tu ma gyur thabs med yin par snang /(2)yul gyi dbang ris rnam pa bco brgyad du phye tshul ni rgyal blon dang rus rgyud mi 'dra ba'i dpon rigs rnying pa rnams la sger bdag sa zhing dang bran g.yog nor phyugs sogs dz+wabang chog par byas pa zhig ste/de ni rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod sa gnas gcig gyur ma byas gong du rus rgyud tsho pa khag gi dpon rigs mang pos sa khul dum bur bgos nas dbang sgyur byas te/ phan tshun gcig 'og gcig la mi 'dus pa'i nang 'khrugs rgyun mi chad par byung bar brten/ rus rgyud tsho pa khag gcig gyur byas ma thag kho tshor sngar nas dbang ba'i sa zhing nor phyugs sogs sger bzung gi dbang cha 'os 'tshams zhig rgyun 'dzin ma byas na/ slar yang kho tshos 'khrugs rkyen bslang srid pa de rigs sngon 'gog byed ched/kho tshos srid gzhung gis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i khrims lugs brtsi srung dang / dpya khral mi nyung tsam 'bul rgyu khas len byed pa'i cha rkyen 'og sa zhing dang / nor phyugs/ bran g.yog bcas sger bzung gi dbang cha 'os 'tshams zhig sprad pa ma zad/ gal te kho tshos btsan por gyen log byed pa dang / dpon gzhan 'tshol byed pa/ lkog g.yo bshams pa sogs byas pa byung na sa zhing dang nor phyugs bran g.yog bcas btsan pos gzhung bzhes btang ba'i dbang cha yod pa red/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉las yul gyi dbang ris rnam pa bco brgyad bshad skabs rgyal blon rnams kyis dbang ris gnyis phud/sa khul bcu drug ni khu dang gnyags la sogs pa'i rus rgyud tsho pa nyi shu rtsa lngas sger bzung byed pa'i yul yin par bshad cing / li yul nas rnyed pa'i shog dril yi ge 'ga' zhigarī gi nang blon po dang rus rgyud tsho pa'i dpon rigs rnams kyis sger bzung byed pa'i sa khul rnams kho tshor byas nyes ma byung na pha tsha bu rgyud la 'jags chog pa dang / gal te nyes khrims phog pa'am mi rgyud chad na sa zhing dang nor phyugs bran g.yog rgyu dngos bcas btsan pos phyir len byed pa'i dbang cha yod pa'i dpe mtshon lo rgyus mang por 'khod 'dug(3)rgod kyi stong sde zhes dmag dpung gi sde tshan drug cu rtsa gcig tu phye ba ni/ gong gsal gyi ru sde lnga po de'i nang nas dbu ru/ g.yo ru/g.yas ru/ ru lag zhang zhung gi ru bcas la stong sde bcu re dang / sum pa'i ru la stong sde bcu gcig bcas stong sde drug cu re gcig yod pa ste/dbu ru stod dang / g.yo ru stod/ g.yas ru stod/ ru lag stod bcas la stong bu chung bzhi dang / zhang zhung stod smad gnyis la stong bu chung re/sum pa'i ru la stong bu chung gcig bcas stong bu chung bdun/ dbu ru smad dang / g.yo ru smad/ g.yas ru smad/ ru lag smad bcas la sku srung gi stong sde re re bcas sku srung gi stong sde bzhi yod tshul zhib par 〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉du gsal ba ltar yin zhing / 〈 blon po bka' thang 〉las rgyal po'i 'phrin las sku mkhar stong sde gsum/ g.yon 8

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyibyungabacungazadabarjodapa/ da —ru'i bka' btags stong sde gnyis/ chab 'og bka' btags dbu ru'i stong sde lnga/ g.yas ru g.yon ru'i bka' btags stong sde bdun/ bod khams gzhi ma'i sa la stong sde bco brgyad/ stod kyi zhang zhung stong sde bcu gsum dang / smad kyi sum pa stong sde bcu gsum bcas yod par bshad pa stong sde drug cu re gcig gi kha grangs tsam mthun yang de tsho'i sa ming mi gsal ba ma zad/ stong sde so so'i bsdoms grangs kyang gong dang bshad tshul mi mthun pa yod pa ni/ rgyal po khro srong lde btsan skabs stong sder bcos sgrig byas pa'i bsdoms grangs yin nam snyam/ gzhan yang li yul nas thon pa'i byang khram khag gi nang stong sde'i ru khag lnga bcu tsam gyi sa ming 'khod pa ltar na/ dbu ru stod kyi khongs nas dor sde dang / sde mtshams/ yel rab/ dbu ru smad kyi khongs nas skyid stod/ g.yo ru stod kyi khongs nas nyag tshe dang / gnyi mo pag dwags po/ g.yo ru smad kyi khongs nas lho brag dang / gnyal pa/ g.yas ru stod kyi khongs nas lang mi dang / phod dkar/ g.yas ru smad kyi khongs nas nyen kar dang 'brang mtshams/ ru lag stod kyi khongs nas grom pa dang / khri khoms/ lang kar/ru lag smad kyi khongs nas gad sram/ zhang zhung smad kyi khongs nas spyi gtsang dang yar gtsang / sum pa'i khongs nas byan po nags shod/ kha ro/'jam stod/ 'jam smad/ rgod tshang stod/ rgod tshang smad bcas ru sde nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sa ming gsal ba rnams 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉du bshad pa'i stong sde khag gi sa ming dang yongs su mthun pa ma zad/ sa ming 'ga' zhig deng sang yang ngos 'dzin rgyu yod pa red/ g.yo ru'i nub 9

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phyogs kyi sa mtshams kha rag ni/ deng sang sna dkar rtse shan dpal di chus khongs kha rag sa khul la zer zhing / de dang 'dra bar g.yo ru'i shar phyogs kyi kong yul spre sna ni deng sang kong po stod smad dang / g.yo ru'i lho phyogs sha 'ugs ltag sgo ni deng sang gi mtsho sna shan legs po chus khul sha 'ug grong tsho dang / g.yo ru'i dkyil khra 'brug ni deng sang sne gdong shan khongs khra 'brug chus dang / g.yas ru'i nub phyogs bye ma la dgu ni deng sang gi ngam ring shan khongs kyi bye ma la zer ba'i ri dang / g.yas ru'i lho phyogs gnya' nam g.yag po'i sna ni deng sang gi gnya' lam shan gyi sa khul dang / g.yas ru'i byang phyogs smi ti gtsang po ni sngar shangs kyi byang phyogs nas byang lha ri shan smi ti kha chus kyi bar dang / g.yas ru'i dkyil shangs kyi gzhongs pa tshal ni shangs rnam gling shan khongs gzhong gzhong sa khul dang / ru lag gi lho phyogs bal po glang sna ni deng sang gi bal bod mtha' mtshams yin pa sogs dang / gzhan yang ru khag so so'i khongs gtogs kyi sa ming dbu ru'i 'bri mtshams dang / phyugs mtshams/ skyid smad/skyid stod/ g.yo ru'i khongs kyi yar lung dang / 'phying lung / dwags po/gnyal/ lho brag ru lag khongs kyi mang kar dang / grom pa/ lha rtse/myang ro/ zhang zhung khongs kyi gu ge dang / cog la/ sum pa'i ru khongs kyi rgod tshang stod smad gnyis dang / nags shod bcas deng sang gi sa bkra'i ming thog tu 'khod yod cing / sa bkra'i ming thog tu ma 'khod kyang sa ming da lta bed spyod byed bzhin pa yang mi nyung ba zhig yod pa rnams la dpyad gzhi chen po yod/ stong sde de dag gi dmag dpon dang / dmag mi 10

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyibyungabacungazadabarjodapa/ da warnams ni 'bangs kyi nang nas rim pa mtho shos yin cing / rgyun du zhing las byed pa dang chabs cig rang rang gi yul sde srung ba'i 'gan 'khur gyi yod/ dmag sar rang srog shor ba'i byas rjes can dang / dmag dpon byas rjes can rnams la sa zhing dang / nor phyugs/ bran g.yog bcas 'os 'tshams kyis bya dga' sprod pa'i khar/ dpa' bo rnams la gong ras dmar po dang / stag pags kyi stod gos gzengs bstod dpa' rtags su sprod cing / dpa' bo'i nang mi'i khyim tshang gi sgo'i steng du lcags kyi byang bu re 'dogs pa sogs dpon dmag rnams spyi tshogs kyi thog go gnas dang mthong chen po yod/ g.yul sa nas bros pa'i mi rnams kyi mgo la wa'i rnga ma'i zhwa bskon nas khrom bskor du khrid pa dang / dpung sde dang / mang tshogs kyi dkyil du rkang lag bzhi ka sa la btsugs nas khyi'i skad sgrog tu 'jug pa sogs dmag khrims dam po yod stabs dmag dpung gi stobs shugs che/ dmag dpon ni dmag dpung gi nang nas blo stobs che zhing /dmag rtsal la mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis dang blangs byas te thon pa dang /kho tshos byas rjes bzhag rjes dmag dpon du bskos/ btsan pos dmag dpung gi dpon dmag byas rjes can la mthong chen dang bya dga' sprod pa dang / dmag sa nas bros pa rnams mang tshogs dang / dmag dpung gi dkyil du dma' 'bebs byas pa sogs kyi thabs jus bzang po bton par brten dmag dpung nang dang blangs byas pa'i dmag dpon dang dpa' bo mang po thon no/(tsāblon po che dgu zhes srid 'dzin spyi khyab rim pa'i blon chen dgur /1

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phye ba/ btsan po srong btsan sgam pho'i dus srid kyi dbang cha chen po btsan po'i lag tu gcig sdud byed pa dang dus mtshungs srid 'dzin gyi zhib phra'i las 'gan rnams blon po so sor bgos te lag len bstar du 'jug cing /gros 'go blon po rnams kyis bton te rgyal blon gros tshogs thog thag gcod byed kyi yod pa red/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs kyi blon po che dgu so sor las 'gan mi 'dra ba yod kyang srid 'dzin gyi thad spyi khyab rim pa'i dbang cha dang go gnas bzung yod cing / blon po che dgu ni dgung blon che 'bring chung gsum dang / nang blon che 'bring chung gsum/bka' yo gal 'chos pa (bka' blon )che 'bring chung gsum bcas yin/dgung blon ni/ rgyal po'i 'og gi blon chen go gnas mtho shos yin la zhi drag gnyis kar dbang cha yod pa'i spyi khyab blon chen zhig kyang yin/de'i las 'gan ni gal che'i tshogs 'du skong 'tshogs byed pa dang /tshogs 'du'i dbu bzhugs kyi 'gan khur ba/ gsham 'og gi blon po gsar pa bsko ba dang / gnas dbyung gtong ba/ do dam btson 'jug byed pa/ dmag gi bka' brda bsgrags pa/ sa khul gyi dbye mtshams dang dmag dpung bcos sgrig byed pa/ bka' khrims gsar pa khyab bsgrags byed pa sogs kyi 'gan khur yod/ dgung blon che 'bring chung gsum gyi mi grangs thad btsan po so so'i skabs 'gyur ldog mang bas mtha' gcig tu nges pa med pa ni/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam ngo 'i skabs dgung blon chen po bzhi dang / khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs su/ da gung blon dgu/ khri lde srong btsan sad na legs kyi skabs su dgung blon chen po drug byung ba lta bu'o/ /12

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyibyungabacungazadabarjodapa/ ———rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs kyi dgung blon chen po bzhi ni/blon chen mgar ba stong bstong btsan dang / thon mi sam sgo ṭa/ 'bri se ru gung ston/ nyang khri bzang yang ston bcas yin/ de'i nang nas mgar dang / thon mi/ nyang khri bzang bcas ni srong btsan sgam por bsam pa dkar ba dang chab srid thog byas rjes che ba'i blon yin pa dang /'bri se ru gung ston ni rang nyid la byas rjes gang yang med kyang / blon chen gzhan rnams rang gi gong du shor dogs nas rgyal blon bar dkrugs shing dbyen sbyor byed mkhan zhig yin/nang blon ni/ srid gzhung gi nang khul gal che'i las don khag la bdag gnyer byed mkhan zhig ste/ de la nang gses che 'bring chung gsum yod/ de dag gi go gnas ni nang blon che ba dang dgung blon 'bring ba'i go gnas mnyam pa dang / nang blon 'bring ba dang dgung blon chung ba'i go gnas mnyam pa/ nang blon chung ba dang bka' blon 'bring ba'i go gnas mnyam pa yin/ mi grangs mang nyung nges pa med de/ dper na rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus nang blonabān po drug yod pa ni 'phul gyi sna chen rigs bzang dang / zhang po rgyal gyi khrom bzang / cog ro rig pa'i skad bzang / lha gzigs shog po brtan bzang / ska yi gnyags ston 'phel bzang / sbas lcang dpal gyi legs bzang bcas dang / khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su nang blon bcu/ khri lde srong btsan sad na legs kyi dus su nang blon bco brgyad byung ba lta bu'o/ /bka' blon (bka' yo gal 'chos pa)ni/ rgyal blon gyi bka' la yo 13

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsrang byed mkhan zhig ste/ de la nang gses che 'bring chung gsum yod cing / de'i las 'gan ni rgyal po dang blon chen tshos bka' phab pa rnams khrims dang mthun min dang / lag len du bstar 'os dang mi 'os bcas legs par brtags nas gal srid khrims dang mi mthun pa'am lag len du bstar mi 'os pa zhig yin tshe rgyal blon gyi tshogs 'du po'i thog rgyal po dang blon chen su la yang thad kar skyon brjod byed dgos pa dang byed chog pa'i dbang cha yod/ de'i go gnas ni bka' blon che ba dang / dgung blon chung ba/ nang blon 'bring ba bcas go gnas mnyam zhing / bka' blon 'bring ba'i go gnas ni nang blon chung ba dang mnyam la/ bka' blon chung ba'i go gnas ni blon po che dgu'i nang gi go gnas dma' shos yin/phyi blon ni/ srid gzhung gi phyi phyogs kyi las don gal che'i rigs bdag gnyer byed mkhan zhig ste/ de'i las 'gan ni/ dgung blon che 'bri nga chung gsum la rogs ram byas te sa mtshams kyi yul sde dang dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byed pa dang / khrims lugs lag len bstar mkhan yin/ kho tshos rang nyid la ming grags dang bya dga' yong ba'i ched du sa mtshams su dmag 'khrug yang yang bslangs pa'i gnas tshul gtsug lag khang mdun ngos su yod pa'i rgya bod mthun 'brel rdo ring thog 'khod pa ltar yin/ phyi blon gyi mi grangs mang nyung nges pa med pa dper na/rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus phyi blon btsan po rnam drug zer ba yod de/khyung po spungs sad zu rtse dang / lam khri bangeblag khri btsan/ mu khri rdo rje gnam btsan/ mthing gi byang chub mchog btsan/ thar pa klu yi dpal 14

— srongabatsanasgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa/ —btsan/ rong po 'phrul gyi lde btsan bcas byung zhing / yang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su phyi blon bcu gsum yod par bshad pa lta bu yin/(5)dpon bdun sogs srid 'dzin las tshan dma' ba'i dpon rigs rim pa khag bcu gnyis su phye ba/dang po/ yul dpon (rtse rje)ni/ spyi khyab srid 'dzin sa khul lnga so so'i mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i yul sde khag gi rdzong dpon lta bu zhig ste/li yul nas thon pa'i shog dril nang rtse rje zhes 'khod pa de yin/ 〈 lde'u chos 'byung 〉las bod dbus gtsang ru bzhir phye ba'i ru re re la yul dpon tshan pa bcu drug re yod tshul bshad pa ltar yin/gnyis pa/ dmag dpon ni/ spyi khyab blon chen gyi bkod 'doms 'og ru chen lnga'i dmag dpung la bdag gnyer byed mkhan zhig ste/ de'i las 'gan ni rang gi sa mtshams su bde 'jags srung skyob dang / gzhan gyi btsan 'dzul 'gog pa/ rgyun du zhing las thon skyed la bkod 'doms byed pa/ dmag mi bsdu len bya rgyu bcas yin/ de'i go gnas kyi rim pa la ru dpon dang / stong dpon/ stong bu chung gi rje/ lnga brgya chen po bcas bzhi yod/ ru dpon ni/ ru chen gcig gi dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byed mkhan zhig ste/ ru sde rer ru dpon rgan pa gnyis dang las rogs gzhon pa gnyis/ ru sde gcig la dmag mi'i 'bor grangs stong sde bcu/ stong sde rer dmag mi stong phrag bcu dang / ru sde gcig la dmag mi khri bcu yod pas ru dpon ni dmag mi 'bum gcig gi dmag dpon yin/ de'i rgyu /5

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtshan dang khungs gang nas bshad yod dam zhe na/ de ni thang rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus 〈 thang hru'u gsar ma 〉las/ thang rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thang the tsung gi drin kon khri lo brgyad pa spyi lo 634lor rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos mi sna mngags te rgya bza' 'un khren kong jo btsun mor slong yang ma sbyin par brten/ rgyal po khros nas dmag khri nyi shu tham pa btang ste rgya yi zhing chen zung ju bcom pa dang / yang thang zhon tsung gi khri lo gnyis pa spyi lo 714lor bod kyi blon po 'ben tā yan gyis bod dmag khri bcu khrid de lin tha'o nas lan kre'o dang we kre'o bcom pa/ thang zhon tsung gi khri lo nyer bdun pa spyi lo 739lor bod kyis khris h+phin po la dmag drangs skabs dmag mi khri tsho bzhi bcu yod par bshad pas/ stong sde re la dmag mi stong phrag re las med tshe stong sde drug cu re gcig la dmag mi khri drug dang chig stong las med pas/ bod sa gnas nas thang gi mnga' khongs sa khul la dmag drangs skabs dmag mi khri bzhi bcu lta zhog khri bcu yang ma longs pas so/ /des na gong du bshad pa ltar ru sde gcig la dmag mi khri bcu yod nges red/stong dpon ni/ ru dpon gyi 'og tu yod cing stong sde gcig gi dmag dpon yin/ de'i khongs su dmag mi stong phrag bcu yod pas don du dmag mi khri gcig gi dmag dpon yin/stong bu chung gi rje ni/ stong dpon gyi 'og tu yod cing dmag mi stong phrag 'ga' zhig gi dmag dpon yin/ stong bu chung zer ba'i go don ni dmag dpung stong sde'i tshad gzhi ma longs shing / stong phrag 'ga' zhig 16

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyibyungabacungazadabarjodapa/da wa —— —las med pas ming de ltar btags/lnga brgya chen po ni/ dmag mi'i 'bor grangs lnga brgya yas mas kyi dmag dpon zhig ste/ li yul nas thon pa'i shog dril nang bshad pa ltar na/ skabs re lnga brgya chen po bskos pa dang / skabs re lnga brgya chenaca de stong bu rjer bcos zhes 'khod 'dugadamag mi'i 'bor grangs las 'phros te rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod kyi mi 'bor ji tsam yod skor dpyad gzhir gleng na/ khyim tshang rer mi grangs gsum re dang / khyim tshang gsum rer dmag mi re 'khri ba'i dbang du byas na/ dmag mir song ba'i mi grangs khri drug cu re gcig po phud pa'i lhag ma mi grangs khri bzhi brgya brgyad cu gya brgyad yod dgos pa red/ skabs der dmag mi las gzhan pa'i 'bangs mi ldab gnyis tsam yod srid pa ma zad/ 'bangs mi de'i nang tshong pa dang / lag shes bzo las pa/ zhing pa/ bran g.yog 'brog pa sogs mang po zhig yod pas de rnams ched las dmag mi'i khongs su gtogs pa zhig yin mi srid snyam pas mkhas dbang rnams kyis zhib dpyad gnang 'os che snyam/gsum pa/ mngan dpon (rngan dpon )ni/ srid gzhung gi 'bru rigs dang gser dngul sogs nor srid kyi do dam byed mkhan dpon rigs shig ste/ nor srid bdag gnyer byed mkhan rnams la rgyun du phyi nang gnyis ka nas mi 'dod pa'i 'khang ra dang skyon 'dzugs sna tshogs byed mkhan mang ba'i dbang gis ming de ltar thogs pa yin zhing / srid 'dzin sa khul khag la yang nor srid kyi bdag gnyer byed mkhan mngan dpon yod/ de dag /7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshang ma'i bkod 'doms spyi khyab par mngan dpon khab so 'o cog gi bla zhes zer/bzhi pa/ khru dpon ni/ srid gzhung gi khongs su gtogs pa'i 'brog khul gyi nor phyugs dang thon skyed dpya khral sogs la do dam byed mkhan gyi dpon rigs shig yin/zhing dpon ni/ zhing las sa khul gyi sa zhing gi grangs 'bor dang /de'i thon 'bab legs nyes/ dpya khral sogs la do dam byed mkhan gyi dpon rigs shig yin/rtsis pa chen po ni/ srid gzhung gi mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i nor srid kyi 'gro song dang / dmag don gyi gtong yong / dpya khral gyi bsdu 'bab bcas la zhib 'jug dang rtsis bsher byed mkhan gyi dpon rigs shig ste/ ming gzhan rtsis dpon zer ba dang 'dra/lnga pa/ sde dpon ni/ dpa' sde gsum gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i yul khams stod smad bar gsum gyi sde chen po'i dpon la zer/drug pa/ chibs dpon ni/ rgyal blon rnams kyi chibs rta dang dmag rta bsdu gtong bya rgyu dang / 'grim 'grul gyi bde 'jags la lta rtog nyen zon byed mkhan gyi dpon rigs shig yin/khral dpon ni/ srid gzhung gis sa gnas so sor ched du mngags nas dpya khral bsdu bar btang ba'i dpon rigs shig ste/ ming gzhan bkar rgya yong sdud pa zer ba dang 'dra/gzims dpon ni/ btsan po sger gyi pho brang dang / rgyun mkho'i 18

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byungabacungazadabarjodapa/ ——'tsho ba/ khor yug gi bde 'jags bcas la do dam byed mkhan gyi dpon rigs shig yin/rnam phyi pa ni/ btsan po'i rjes su 'bral med 'brangs te sku srung gi las 'gan sgrub mkhan dpon rigs shig ste/ ming gzhan sku srung nyen rtog pa zer ba dang 'dra/bdun pa/ drang dpon ni/ nyes can dang zhu gtugs mkhan rnams la nyes pa yod med dang / nyes pa che chung la gzhigs nas khrims lugs ltar khrims thag gcod mkhan gyi dpon rigs shig ste/ ming gzhan zhal lce pa yang zer/ 'di la yang spyi khyab zhal lce pa dang / sa gnas so so'i zhal lce pa bcas rim pa gnyis yod/khrims dpon ni/ zhal lce pa'am drang dpon gyis khrims thag bcad pa ltar nyes can la khrims lugs dngos su lag bstar byed mkhan gyi dpon rigs shig ste/ 'di la gong rim nas thag bcad pa'i khrims lugs lag bstar byed pa'i dbang cha yod pa las khrims thag gcod pa'i dbang cha med/ thang rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus 〈 thang hru'u gsar ma 〉las/bod kyi khrims ni nyes pa chung ngu la yang mig 'don pa dang / rkang lag 'breg pa/ sna gcod pa/ lcag gzhu ba sogs khrims dpon gyi 'dod mos ltar byed pa ma gtogs khrims lugs nges gtan med ces bshad pa ni/rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i gong gi rgyal rabs kha shas kyi sngon la de 'dra yin srid rung / srong btsan sgam po'i dus su de 'dra gtan nas min te/khrims dpon gyis khrims lugs lag bstar byed par gzhi 'dzin sa'i 19

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/khrims srol med na/ srid gzhung med pa'i ring lugs gang sar khyab ste spyi tshogs bde 'jags su gnas mi thub pa'i thog srid dbang yang 'thor zhig tu 'gro rgyur 'gog thabs med pa ni/ sngon dang deng rabs kyi dngos yod lo rgyus thog nas ra sprod byung ba ma zad/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos srid dbang gsar pa btsugs pa nas glang dar ma'i bar lo grangs brgya dang go drug gi ring srid dbang gong 'phel dang brtan por gnas thub pa byung ba de ni mnga' khongs su gcig gyur gyis lag len bstar ba'i khrims lugs yod par brten nas byung ba zhig red/(6)g.yung gi mi sde zhes 'bangs mi'i khongs su gtogs pa'i rje bran rim pa lngar phye ba/ g.yung ngam kheng zhes pa ni btsan po dang srid gzhung gi khongs su gtogs pa'i 'bangs mi'i ming yin zhing / de la snubs rje srid pa la sogs pa'i rje phran dgu/ lo ngam rta rdzi la sogs pa'i rdzi bo bdun/ mkhan drug tshong pa lnga/ 'dzin gsum sogs ni las rigs sna tshogs can gyi 'bangs dang / gzhan yang nam pa lde rgyal/(zhang zhung )bal po li rgyal/(ner+ya pā la) sum pa lcags rgyal/(mtsho sngon dang bar khams sa khul) mon rtse rgyal (mon pa rus rgyud tsho pa )bcas ni lo dus su dpya khral nges can re 'bul dgos pa'i rgyal phran bzhi yod pa 〈 mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉sogs lo rgyus khag 'ga' zhig tu gsal mod/ rdzi bdun dang /mkhan drug 'dzin gsum sogs gang dang gang la ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i skor zur tsam 〈 mkhas pa lde'u'i chos 'byung 〉las gsal ba ltar yin/(7)zhing las dang 'brog las kyi dpal 'byor thad gcig sdud dang 20

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa/ —sger dbang zung 'brel gyi lam lugs lag len bstar ba/bca' khrims dang dmag don gyi lam lugs gtan 'bebs byas pa'i rjes su gal che ba zhig ni dpal 'byor gyi lam lugs yin/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su zhing 'brog dpal 'byor gyi lam lugs ji 'dra yin pa'i skor gsham gsal gyi gnas tshul thog nas bden dpang byed thub pa ste/ li yul nas thon pa'i shog dril dang byang khram khag gzhir bzung na/skabs de'i sa zhing dbang ba'i lam lugs rigs drug ste/ rgyal po la dbang ba rigs gnyis/ blon po la dbang ba rigs gnyis/ rus rgyud tsho pa tshor dbang ba rigs gnyis bcas yin/rgyal po la dbang ba rigs dang po ni/ rje zhing ste sa zhing sprod len gyi dbang cha btsan por yod kyang / de'i thon 'bab dpya khral rnams srid gzhung la dbang zhing / srid gzhung gi yong 'bab kyi khongs su gtogs/sa zhing de dag ru sde lnga'i zhing pa rnams la bgos nas tshad gzhi ltar dus thog tu 'debs dgos pa dang / ma btab par bzhag mi chog pa/ tshad las brgal nas gsar sbol byed mi chog pa/ dpya khral dus thog tu 'bul dgos pa/ rang gis sa zhing gsar du sbol nas btab pa rnams sa zhing gi tho yig tu bkod dgos pa/ de'i thon 'bab kyi dpya khral 'jal dgos pa bcas yin/zhing pa khyim mi rer sa zhing bgos pa'i tshad gzhi ni/ khyim mi rer sa zhing dor gcig yin/ dor gcig gi go don ni/ rmon mdzo cha gcig gis nyin gcig ring rmo thub pa'i sa zhing gi rgya khyon la zer zhing / sa zhing dor 2

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gcig la rgya rigs sa khul gyi rtsis gzhi ltar na mu'u bcu tham pa yin pa dang / dor phyed la mu'u lnga yin pa'i skor li yul nas thon pa'i 〈 sha ju'i khyim mi'i grangs dang sa zhing bgos pa'i tho yig 〉gi nang khyim dud nyi shu lhag tsam gyi mi grangs dang kho tshor bgos pa'i sa zhing gi tho 'god skabs bod kyi sa zhing bgos pa'i tshad gzhi dang / rgya rigs sa khul gyi sa zhing bgos pa'i tshad gzhi gnyis ka zung 'brel byas nas bkod yod pa de'i thog nas ra sprod gsal po byed thub/zhing pa rnams la bgos zin pa'i sa zhing de tsho'i thon 'bab kyi thog nas dpya khral ji tsam 'jal dgos pa'i skor/ da yod kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rnams su gsal bar 'khod pa zhig sngon chad ma mthong yang / tshod dpag byas na phal cher sa zhing dor gcig gi sa nas thon pa'i thon 'bab spyi'i bsdoms grangs kyi drug cha gcig ni dpya khral gyi tshad gzhi yin nam snyam zhing / des ma zad li yul nas thon pa'i sa zhing gi tho yig nang sa zhing thob pa'i zhing pa rnams la son 'bru sa zhing gi bdag pos sprod dgos lugs gsal ba der brtags na yang sa zhing gi thon 'bab spyi'i bsdoms grangs kyi drug cha gcig gi dpya khral phud/ da dung son 'bru'i 'bab sprod dgos kyi yod 'dra snyam/'brog las sa khul du 'brog pas srid gzhung la dpya khral 'jal dgos pa'i tshad gzhi gang yin skor/ li yul nas thon pa'i lo rgyus shog dril gyi nang blon chen mgar stong btsan gyis 'brog khul nas sha khral bsdus pa'i gnas tshul gsal por 'khod kyang / nor phyugs rnams srid 22

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa/gzhung dang / btsan po/ blon po/ rus rgyud tsho pa/ 'brog pa bcas so sor dbang ba'i tshad mi 'dra ba gsal por ma bshad pa'i thog sha khral phud/ khral gzhan dag gi skor gang yang mi gsal zhing / da dung shog dril gzhan dag 'ga' zhig nang nor phyugs brje tshong byed pa'i rin thang dang /nor phyugs dang 'bru rigs brje tshong byed pa'i 'dzin yig 'ga' zhig kyang 'dug pa der bltas na/ 'brog khulo du yod pa'i 'brog pa tshor sger la dbang ba'i nor phyugs yod pa gsal por bstan pa des bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi 'brog las dpal 'byor mtshon pa yin/'brog khul du gtan 'bebs byas pa'i thul ka zer ba de dpya khral dang tshong las gnyis kyi nang nas gang gi tshad gzhi yin pa'i skor 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉nang 'khod don du/ sngar rgyal po pu de gung rgyal gyi bu e sho legs kyi dus su blon po lha bu mgo dkar gyisas zhing la dor kha dang / 'brog la thul ka brtsi ba'i srol thog mar btod par bshad/ 'on kyang de dgos pa gang gi ched du gtan 'bebs byas pa yin min mi gsal zhing / li yul nas thon pa'i da yod dpyad gzhi'i yig cha tshor zhing la dor ka brtsis pa ni sa zhing bgos pa'i tshad gzhi yin pa dang /de'i dgos pa ni dpya khral gyi tshad gzhi gtan 'bebs byed pa'i ched du yin pa gsal por bstan yod kyang /ri 'brog khul du brtsi ba'i thul ka zer ba de tshad gzhi ga 'dra zhig yin pa dang5 / de'i dgos pa gang yin skor bshad pa'i dpyad gzhi rtsa ba nas malhad cing / 'on kyang kho bos rmongs tshod kyis dpyad skabs 'di 'dra zhigamin nam snyam ste/ 'brog khul du 23

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brtsi ba'i thul ka zer ba ni/ deng sang 'brog khul 'ga' zhig tu lug gi pags pa drug gam bdun dang phyed ke yas mas la thul gcig ste pags tshags gos ldeng gcig zer zhing / de'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i nor phyugs kyi pags par thul gcig zer ba dang / tshad de gzhir bzung nas bzos pa'i phyu pa gcig la thul ka gcig zer ba de rang yin srid de/ sems can nor phyugs che chung gi thon 'bab grangs ka brtsis pa'i tshe nor phyugs so so'i pags pa cha tshang ba re'i tshad gzhi bzung nas brtsi ba ma gtogs/rwa dang / rmig pa/ sha sogs tshad gzhir bzung nas brtsis na gdeng tshod yod pa'i tshad gzhi zhig yong mi thub pa'i dbang gis pags pa cha tshang ba grangs ji tsam gyis gos gcig ldeng ba de la thul gcig zer/ tshad gzhi de dngos po brje tshong gi skabs rin thang gi tshad gzhi dang / dpya khral gyi skabs su nor phyugs so so'i thon 'bab kyi tshad gzhir bzung ba min nam snyam pa bcas mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyis dpyad par zhu/gsum pa/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad dang mthun pa'i yi ge gsar gtod gnang ba/yi ge ni mi rnams kyi bsam blo phan tshun brje res byed rgyu dang / de'i sgra gdangs mtshon byed kyi brda rtags shig yin pa ma zad/ yi ge yod pa'i mi rigs rnams rang nyid kyi dpal 'byor dang / chab srid/ rig gzhung bcas kyi 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i myur tshad mgyogs pa dang / yi ge med pa'i 24

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa/ —mi rigs rnams de las ldog ste rjes lus thebs kyi yod/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i gong du bod gna' rabs kyi yi ge zhig yod med skor rgyal khab phyi nang gi lo rgyus mkhas pa tshos gsung tshul 'dra min sna tshogs yod cing / de'i nang nas bon gyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug gnang mkhan mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis gsungs don du/ srong btsan sgam po'i gong du bod gna' rabs kyi yi ge zhig yod pa de ni zhang zhung gi yi ge yin pa dang /de yang cung zad stabs bde ba dang nang don rgya che ba ston rgyur tshod 'dzin yod pa zhig yin par brten rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs thon mi sam bho ṭas sngar yod kyi bod yig rnying pa gzhir bzung nas da lta'i bod yig gsar pa 'di bzo gnang mdzad pa yin zhes gsung ba 'dir kho bos bsams na rgyu mtshan mang po zhig yod pa red snyam/ da yod bod kyi lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i yig cha mang po zhig gi nang rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas srong btsan sgam po'i bar gyi lo rgyus mi nyung ba zhig 'chad rgyu yod pa dang / de bzhin 〈 rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉gi rtsom pa po dang /〈 deb ther dmar po 〉yi rtsom pa po gnyis kas gzigs myong ba'i 〈 lo rgyus log gnon chen mo 〉dang 〈 rgyal rabs dpag bsam ljon shing 〉dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas gzigs myong ba'i bon gyi lo rgyus 〈 yang gsang the'u rang lugs 〉zer ba sogs nas cha shas 'ga' zhig drangs pa de tsho'i nang rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas stag ri gnyan gzigs bar gyi lo rgyus dang / li yul nas thon pa'i lo rgyus shog byang gi nang gsal ba'i gnya' khri btsan po dang / gri gum btsan po/ stag ri gnyan gzigs 25

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sogs kyi lo rgyus mi nyung ba yod pa de rnams srong btsan sgam po'i gong gi mi rabs sngon ma tshos gcig gis gcig la brgyud bshad byas pa'i ngag rgyun tsam zhig ma yin par yig thog tu 'khod yod pa zhig yin nges red/gal te yig thog tu 'khod med pa'i ngag rgyun tsam zhig yin na mi rabs sum cu lhag brgyud thub pa lta zhog mi rabs kha shas song mtshams su ngag rgyun tsam yang lus mi srid de/ dper na rang re'i mi rabs gong ma kha shas kyi lo rgyus rnams yig thog tu 'khod med tshe/ mi rabs nas mi rabs bar blo thog tu bzung nas gcig gis gcig la brgyud bshad byed thub thabs med pa mngon sum myong grub yin pa lta bu red/ de bzhin du gnya' khri btsan po nas stag ri gnyan gzigs bar gyi rgyal rabs sum cu lhag gi lo rgyus rnams mi rabs mang po'i mis blo thog tu bzung nas gcig gis gcig la brgyud bshad byed thub pa de bas kyang dka' ba yin/ gzhan yang bod kyi lo rgyus mang po'i nang gnya' khri btsan po'i gong nas lho kha yar klungs su bon gyi mkhas pa mi bcu gnyis byung zin pa dang / de dag gi nang nas tshe mi gshen gyi rmu rgyal gyis bon gzhung bod skad du bsgyur ba sogs bshad pa rnams lo rgyus khungs ldan du khas len byed bzhin pa la/bod skad du bsgyur ba'i bon gzhung mang po de tsam zhig yig thog tu 'khod pa gcig kyang med par gcig gis gcig la brgyud bshad byas pa'i ngag rgyun tsam zhig yin zhes bshad na tshan rig dang mthun/ pa zhig e yin snyam/ der brten deng skabs bon gyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug po / nang mkhan rang rigs kyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis gsungs don du/ gna' rabs zhang 26

srong btsan sgam po'ilegasamadzadakyibyungabacudazadatshodang// ——————— —zhung gi skad du la don gyi phrad gu/ cu/ da/ du/ tu/ u/ su/ tur/sur bcas dgu po rnams tren mi sam bho ṭas su ra ru du tu bcas lngar bsdus par mdzad pa dang / de bzhin zhang zhung gi skad du na la lu le bzhi yod pa rnams thon mis na la gnyis su bsdus par mdzad cing / 'ang zhung gi skad du 'brel sgra la gi/ kyi gyi/ 'i/ yi/ ci/ ti/ ni pe// cir/si bcas bcu yod pa rnams thon mis 'brel sgra gi kyi gyi 'i yi lngar bsdus par mdzad pa yin zhes gsungs pa der nga tshos nges par du mthong chen dang brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byed 'os pa zhig red snyam/deng skabs nga tshos bed spyod byed mus yin pa'i bod yig 'di bzo ba gnang ba'i lo rgyus dang / dbyangs gsal ming gzhi sngon rjes tshig phrad sogs kyi rnam grangs/ de dag gi brda sprod rigs pa'i gzhung lubs ji ltar gtan la phab pa bcas kyi skor sngon dang deng rabs kyi mkhas pa mang pos rgyas bshad mdzad pa las lhag pa zhig 'dir brjod par bya ba gang yang ma mchis shing / skabs don slob dpon thon mi sam sgo ṭas thog mar gsar gtod mdzad cing de nas da lta bar bed spyod byed mus yin nga/'i bod yig 'dir dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos gang yod pa'i skor cung zad gleng na/ 1 deng skabs nga tshos bed spyod byed mus yin pa'i bod yeg 'di thog mar gsar gtod mdzad skabs dus skabs de'i bod sa gnas/ spyi'i thun mong gi skad gzhir bzung ba yin pas khyab che ba/ 2 dbyanganu/ dang gsal byed ming gzhi sngon 'jug rjes 'jug tshig phrad so gas rnamyo grangs nyung bas slob sbyong byed bde ba/ tshon dus skabs dang myog thun pasnyerwa 27

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ming dang tshig gsar snon byed dgos pa ('di yi ge yod pa'i mi rigs kyi skad yig thams cad dang 'dra )phud/ de min bod mi rang gi skad kyi thog nas gtam gleng ji 'dra byed dgos kyang yi ges ma ldeng ba med pa/ 4 lo ngo stong phrag lhag song yang rig gnas kyi chu tshad yod pa'i mis klog thub par ma zad go ba yang lon thub pa/ 5 go rim ldan pa dang ma lag cung zad cha tshang ba'ibarda sprod rig pa khungs btsan zhig yod pa/ 6 rgya che zhing rnam grangs mang la gting zab pa'i nang don ji 'dra zhig ston dgos kyang dbyangs gsal so bzhi dang ming gzhi sngon rjes tshig phrad bcas kyi sdeb sbyor la brten nas ston thub pa ma zad rang nyid kyi skad du bsgyur thub pa bcas kyi khyad chos yod/ der brten thon mi sam bho ṭa rang nyid 'tsho bzhugs mdzad skabs kyi rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang mkhas pa mang pos khong la sam bho ṭa ste bod bzang po zhes pa'i bsngags da tshad med mdzad pa dang / rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos kyang blon po gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar khong la gus bkur chen po gnang ba red/ gong gsal bod yig 'dir khya/ da chos de dag yod pa'i bden dpang dngos po gang dang gang yod zer na/ skabs der thon mi rang nyid kyis bsgyur ba gnang ba'i spyan ras gzigs kyi 〈 mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig 〉yod pa'i nang nas 〈 'od zer rnam par bkod pa'i mdo 〉dang / 〈 chu klung sna tshogs pa'i mdo〉〈 snang ba rol pa'i mdo 〉 〈 mtshan rab yongs su bstan pa'i mdo 〉bcas bzhi tsam ma gtogs de byings tshang ma deng skabs yod pa'i bka' 'gyur gyi nang du bzhugs shing / gzhan yang thon mi nyid kyis bsgyur bar 28

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyibyungabacungazadabarjodapa—/————— —mdzad pa'i 〈 'dus pa rin po che'i tog gi gzungs 〉dang / 〈 zla ba sgron me'i mdo〉 〈 mdo sde dkon mchog sprin 〉 〈 dpang skong phyag rgya pa 〉〈 mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa 〉bcas da lta'ang bka' 'gyur gyi nang du yod la/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan dang / sad na legs/ khri ral pa can sogs bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su lo tsā ba mkhas pa chen po ska cog zhang gsum sogs lo tsā ba lnga bcu lhag tsam dang / bod sil bu'i dus skabs su lo tsā ba brgya dang lnga bcu lhag tsam byon pa de dag gis rgya nag dang / rgya gar/ bal yul/ kha che/ zhang zhung / li yul bcas nas sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung chen po lnga dang / gsang sngags/ gso rig skar rtsis/ gtam rgyud/ rtsom yig snyan ngag sogs nang don ha cang rgya che zhing rnam grangs mang la gting zab pa bcas kyi gsung rab 'bor chen de lta bu zhig bod skad du bsgyur ba— rnams da lta 〈 bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈 bstan 'gyur 〉zhes rgyal khab phyi nang du mngon sum mig gis mthong rgyu yod pa ma zad/ yig bsgyur gyi chu tshad kyang ha cang mthon po yod pa de dag tshang ma'i nang don dang ming tshig rnams da yod bod yig 'di'i dbyangs gsal so bzhi dang / ming gzhi sngon rjes tshig phrad bcas kyi sdeb sbyor la brten nas bsgyur ba sha stag yin pa las ming dang tshig gsar pa mang du song ba ltar bod yig gi yig 'bru mang du song ba med/gong du bshad pa'i khyad chos de rnams kyi thog nas slan phyin da yod bod yig 'dis rang re'i ljongs 'di mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa zhig tu 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu'i thad la nus pa ha cang chen ngo 2 9

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thon thub pa ma zad/ 'phel rgyas kyi mdun lam yangs shing rgya che ba zhig yod par mthong thub pa ste/ de ni da yod kyi dbyangs gsal so bzhi dang /ming gzhi sngon 'jug rjes 'jug tshig phrad bcas kyi sdeb sbyor la brten nas deng rabs kyi rtsis rig deng / gso ba rig pa/ gnam dpyad rig pa/skye dngos rig pa/ rdzas 'gyur rig pa/ srog chags rig pa/ mtshan nyid rig pa sogs cha tshang bar ston thub pa dang bod skad du bsgyur thub pa de red/ de la go bde ba'i dpe zhig bshad na/ 'dzam gling thog bzo las rgyal khab thengs dang po 'dzugs mkhan ni dbyin ji rgyal khab yin zhing /skabs der (spyi lo 1765)dbyin ji'i yi ger dbyangs gsal bsdoms pa'i nyi shu rtsa drug las med pa dang / deng skabs 'dzam gling thog khyab che shos kyi skad yig ni dbyin ji'i skad yig yin cing / de la deng rabs dang mthun pa'i ming dang tshig gsar pa mang po kha snon byung yod kyang / skad yig sga/ sdeb sbyor dang yig 'bru mang nyung sngar bzhin gnas pa ma gtogs mang du song med/ de bzhin du rgyal po srong btsan sga ma pos srid dbang bzung ba nas smin grol gling lo chen dharma shri sku ma gshegs bar du lo grangs chig stong brgya med bdun cu don bdun ring snga rjes su byon pa'i lo tsā ba mkhas pa bdun brgya lhag tsam byung ba rnams kyis spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang / khor yug gi cha rkyen ha cang zhan pa'i gnas tshul 'og rang rigs kyi skad yig dang rig gzhung gong 'phel gtong rgyur mig dper 'os pa'i byas rjes rgya chen po 'jog gnang mdzad yod pas na/ da cha krung go gung khran tang gi srid jus yang dag pa'i 'og mi rigs khag gi rig gzhung 30

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzadakyibyungabacungazanabasnodapū/——— —— —— —'phel rgyas dang gong mthor gtong ba'i cha rkyen bzang po yod pa'i gro skabs dam 'dzin byas te/ da yod bod yig gi sdeb sbyor 'di rang la brten nas nang don gsar pa dang ldan pa'i rig gnas phun sum tshoganu/ su gtong thub pa ni smros ma dgos pa red/ der brten skad yig sna mang la byang chub pa'i lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis dgongs pa btang snyoms su ma bzhugs par snying stobs che bskyed kyis khur du bzhes 'os pa'i las 'gan gzi brjid can 'di phrag par bsnams te 'od stong 'phro ba'i bod kyi rig gnas phul byung gi srol rgyun bzang po nam yang mi nub par mdzad dbos rgyu ni ha cang gi gal chen po zhig red snyam mo/ /bzhi pa/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi sngar yod rig gzhung rgyun 'dzin dang gong 'phel btang ba/sngon dang deng rabs kyi dngos yod lo rgyus mang po'i thog nas gsal bshad byung don du/ mi rigs gang 'dra zhis/ yin rung rang nyid kyi dpa' 'byor gong 'phel byung ba des rigs gzhung sngar las lhag par yar rgyas 'gro rgyur skul ma thebs thub pa dang / rmang gzhi de'i thog mi rigs gzhan dag gi rig gzhung la slob sbyong byas te rang nyid kyi rig gzhung phun sum tshogs su 'gro bar skul 'ded yong gi yod pa de red/mi rigs rang nyid kyi sngar yod rig gzhung rgyun 'dzin dang gong 'phel gtong rgyu de ni mi rigs gzhan gyi dge mtshan ldan pa'i rig gzhung 3/ ga

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la slob sbyong byed rgyur gal che ba'i thog ma'i rmang gzhi yin cing / rmang gzhi de med na rang gi mi rigs kyi rig gnas la yod pa'i dge mtshan dang skyon cha gsal por ngos 'dzin mi thub pa'i dbang gis mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gzhung la yod pa'i dge mtshan mthong mi thub pa ma zad/ rang gi mi rigs kyi rig gzhung chu tshad gang 'tshams yod pa zhig gis mi rigs gzhan dag gi rig gnas la slob sbyong byas pa dang / gang yang med pa zhig gis mi rigs gzhan dag gi rig gzhung la slob sbyong byas pa gnyis kyi grub 'bras che chung dang yar rgyas 'gro ba'i mgyogs tshad rtsa ba nas mi 'dra zhing / de bzhin du rang gi rig gnas chu tshad mtho tsam yod pa'i mi rigs dang rgyal khab cig gis mi rigs gzhan dag la slob sbyong byas pa de dang / rang nyid kyi rig gnas chu tshad dma' po yin pa'i mi rigs dang rgyal khab cig gis mi rigs gzhan dag dang rgyal khab gzhan dag la slob sbyong byas pa gnyis kyi grub 'bras che chung dang yar rgyas 'gro ba'i myur tshad kyang gtan nas mi 'dra ba mngon sum du mthong rgyu yod pa ltar red/ der brten rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos phyogs gcig nas rang gi mi rigs kyi sngar yod rig gzhung rgyun 'dzin dang gong 'phel gtong ba'i mig dpe bzang po zhig btsugs pa ma zad/ rmang gzhi de'i thog nas mi rigs gzhan dag dang rgyal khab gzhan dag la slob sbyong byed pa'i mig dpe bzang po zhig kyang btsugs pa red/ 'o na rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos rang gi mi rigs kyi rig gzhung sngar yod rgyun 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas btang yod na/ srong btsan sgam po'i gong du bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi lo 32

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byungabacungazadabarjodapa/ ————rgyus dang rig gzhung yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i gong du bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gzhung rma/nga gzhi legs po yod pa ni/ dper na rgyal po pu de gung rgyal gyi dus (spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo brgya lhag tsam gyi gong )lho kha yar klungs khul du byung ba'i 〈 sga mo bal ma'i gab rtsis 〉 zer ba zla ba dang skar ma'i 'khor 'gros la brten nas dus bzhi dang tshes grangs brtsi ba dang / gzhan yang rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi 'khor 'gros la brten nas zla ba so sor ming btags pa dang / dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog mtshon pa'i 〈 gna' rabs rgan po'i myong byang 〉 zer ba'i skar rtsis rig pa dang/ yul thabs kyi gso ba rig pa/ dmangs khrod kyi sgrung dang gab tshig sna tshogs/ snyan ngag gi nyams dang ldan pa'i glu gzhas/ zlos gar/ rol mo/ lus rtsal/ mdzes rig 'dzugs skrun/bon chos sogs sna mang zhing de dag tshang mar mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos ldan pa ma zad/ 'ga' zhig la tshan rig gi chu tshad cung zad mtho tsam yod pa bcas 'dir re re nas brjod kyis mi langs shing / gal te dma' rim nas mtho rim du yar rgyas 'gro ba'i shes rig gi rmang gzhi de 'dra zhig med na/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus dang lhag par du rgya bza' 'un khren kong jo bod du phebs nas glo bur du gong 'phel chen po 'gro rgyu ni gtan nas yong mi srid pa zhig red/rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos mi rigs rang nyid kyi sngar yod rig gzhung la mthong chen gyis rgyun 'dzin dang gong 'phel btang ba'i gnas tshul mtshon tsam ni/ lha sa gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs skabs su 33

—da dungadakarablobazanga3sdin+t+ra lasakyis/sung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ldebs bris dang gdung ma'i ldebs su sngar gyi bon po'i lo rgyus su gsal ba'i sgrung gtam gyi bkod pa sna tshogs ri mor bris pa dang 'bur brkos byas yo da pa dang / gzhan yang we'u (deng sang gi gab tshig )zhes pa'i rig rtsal gyi dri ba dang dris lan 'ga' zhig ri mor bris pa dper na/ them gnyer mang la lba ba che/ ci yin zhes dri ba bkod pa'i lan du/ 'degs byed srang zhig nyag ka'i grangs dang / srang rdo/ srang snyer dang bcas pa zhig ri mor bris pa dang / por mgo mgo can skyed cing rgyags/ ci yin zhes dri ba bkod pa'i lan du/ mchod rten gyi gzugs ri mor bris pa dang /dmar po spu med bcug cing phyung / nag po kha gdangs gdangs mig tshums/ ci yin zhes dri ba bkod pa'i lan du/ mgar ba zhig gis lcags dmar po skam pas bzung nas thab kyi nang du bcug cing phyir 'don pa zhig ri mor bris pas mtshon/ sngar yod rig rtsal gyi nang nas mi rnams kyi blo sgo 'byed par phan thogs yod pa rnams yi ge dang gzugs snang can gyi ri mo zung 'brel byas te bkod pa des gna' rabs kyi gab tshig dang 'brel ba'i snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur mtshon par byas yod pa ma zad/gtsug lag khang gi 'og khang gi rtsig pa da nga ka ba'i rgyan la sogs pa'i shing brkos kyi gzugs 'gros mi nyung ba 'i/ga/ 'as bod gna' rabs kyi 'dzugs skrun lag rtsal mtshon gang thub byas yod cing / de bzhin du po ta la'i pho brang dmar po thog rtseg ri ma pa mang 'a/ rgya khyon chung zhing / gyang rtsig star pa so gnyis yod pa'i lcags ri can/ gyis bskor ba'i bko da pa des bod gna' rabs kyi mkhar btsan po'i rtsig bzo'i lag rtsal rgyun 'dzin byas pa 34

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa/ —sogs yin/bod mi rigs kyi rig gzhung sngar yod rgyun 'dzin thog gong 'phe' / gtong ba'i mtshon byed gtso bo ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar mi rigs/ rang nyid kyi skad dang mthun pa'i yi ge gsar gtod dang / yi be/ nge'i thob nas mi rigs gzhan gyi ska ra rtsis dang / gso rig chos lugs bcas rang bi/ skad du bsgyur ba bcas byas pa des mi rig/sa rang nyid kyi ris/ gzhung gong 'phe' du btang ba'i mig dpe bzang po zhig thog mar gtod pa'o / lnga pa/ thang rgyal rabs dang / bal po/ rgya gar sogs dang mdza' mthun 'brel ba btsugs te mi rigs gzhan dag gi rig gzhung slob sbyong byas pa/mi rigs gzhan dag gi rig gams slob sbyong byed pa ni rang gi mi rigs kyi rig gzhung gong 'phel gtong ba'i bya thabs ang gnyis pa red/de'i rgyu mtshan ni mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gzhung slob sbyong byed pa la thog mar de'i dge mtshan shes dgos shing / de shes rtogs byed pa la rang bi mi rigs kyi rig gnas la yod pa'i dge mtshan dang skyon cha mthong ba byed dgos/ de mthong tshul yang rang gi mi rigs kyi rig gnas chu tshad yong rngari zhig gis mthong ba dang / rang nyid la rig gnas chu tshad ga/nga yang med 25

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa zhig gis gzhan zer rjes 'brangs tsam la brten nas rang gi rig gnas la mthong chung byas pa gnyis rtsa ba nas mi 'dra zhing / sngon ma des slob sbyong byas pa'i grub 'bras dang / rjes ma des slob sbyong byas pa'i grub 'bras kyang gtan nas mi 'dra/ der brten rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos mi rigs gzhan dag dang rgyal khab gzhan dag la slob sbyong byas pa des bod mi rigs rang gi rig gnas gong 'phel 'gro bar skul 'ded gtong thub pa byung ba las/ de las ldog ste nyams rgud du gtong mi thub pa de ni rang gi rig gnas dang / mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas gnyis la lta stangs yang dag pa zhig bzung ba la brten nas byung ba red/'o na rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos mi rigs gzhan dag gi rig gnas slob sbyong byas pa'i mtshon rtags gang yod dam/ skabs der bod dang mi rigs gzhan dag bar la 'brel ba gang 'dra yod dam zer na/rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos mi rigs gzhan dag dang rgyal khab gzhan dag bar phan tshun 'brel ba btsugs pa de'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni rang gi mi rigs kyi rig gnas gong 'phel gtong ba'i ched du yin pa ma zad/ 'brel ba de 'dra btsugs pa la brten nas phan tshun shes rtogs gting zab tsam byung nas mthun sgril dam zab yong ba dang / sa mtshams bde 'jags su gnas pa/ dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas brtan po yong ba/srid dbang sra brtan du srung ba bcas kyi ched du'ang red/rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos srid dbang bzung rjes btsun mo 'ga' zhig blangs yod (〈 bka' chems ka khol mar 〉srong btsan gyi btsun mo dang po 36

srong btsan sgam po'i legs mdzad kyi byung ba cung zad brjod pa/ —mong bza'/ gnyis pa mi nyag bza'/ gsum pa zhang zhung bza'/ bzhi pa 'a 'a bza'/ lnga pa bal bza'/ drug pa rgya bza' bcas yin par bshad/)pa'i nang nas bal bza' khri btsun dang / rgya bza' 'un khren kong jo gnyis btsun mor blangs pa'i dmigs yul ni/ skabs der bod dad thag nye ba'i bal po dang / thang rgyal rabs gnyis sa 'brel yin pa ma zad/ shes rig dang /sangs rgyas chos lugs/ chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ dmag don bcas kyi thad 'dzam gling thog snyan grags che ba'i gras yin pas go skabs de dang bstun nas gnyen 'brel gyi 'brel ba btsugs te rang nyid kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ sangs rgyas chos lugs bcas sngar las lhag par gong 'phel gtong ba'i ched du red/ der brten thog mar bal po'i rgyal po so ma 'bri sho ste 'od zer go cha'i sras mo bal bza' khri btsun btsun mor blangs pa dang dus mtshungs jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje sogs sku rten mang po dang / bal po'i bzo bo mkhas pa mang du brdzangs pa la brten nas po ta la'i pho brang dang / lha sa gtsug lag khang gi steng khang dang bar khang / sku rten dang ldebs bris rnams bzhengs te bal po dang rgya gar gyi 'dzugs skrun dang mdzes ris lag rtsal bod du dar bar mdzad/bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lha sku bzhengs pa'i lag rtsal rnams thog mar bal po'i bzo bo mkhas pa'i drung nas slob sbyong byas pa red/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar spel byung ba'i gnas gzhi ni rgya gar yin pa dang / bal yul du skabs der sangs rgyas chos lugs dar rgyas che ba'i dbang gis chos lugs kyi mdzes rtsal la mkhas pa'i bzo ni7

————— dungadakarablobazanga'aphrinalapakyisangartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa —pa mang zhing / ṇa/bong rnams bod dang sa thag nye ba'i thog gnam gshis kyang mi 'phrod pa med stabs lha bzo mang che ba bal yul nas 'bod 'gugs byas pa red/phyogs mtshungs thang rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thang tha'i tsung gi tsha mo 'un khren kong jo btsun mor len ched drag po'i dmag 'thab dang zhi ba'i re zhu/sna mang gi rtsal 'gran bcas bya thabs mang po brgyud de ma/thar rgya bza' 'un khren kong jo srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor thob pa ma zad/ skal rdzongs su jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku brnyan dang / 〈 bzo rig pa'i bstan bcos 〉dpe sna drug cu tham pa/ lo rgyus kyi yig tshangs chen mo/ skor 'go sum brgya drug cu'i skar rtsis kyi bstan bcos/ gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos brtag thabs brgyad pa/ sman dpyad brgya pa/ gso rig gzhung bzhi sogs bskur ba de dag rnams rgya yi hwa shang mkhas pa ma hā de ba tshe dang /thon mi sam bho ṭa/ dharma ko ṣa sogs kyis bod skad du bsgyur ba des bod kyi sngar yod gso rig dang skar rtsis bcas la 'phel rgyas gsar pa byung /gzhan yang rgya rigs kyi bzo bo mkhas pa mang po bod du gdan drangs te rgya stag rwa mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing / de bzhin du gong ma thang tha'i tsung la re 'dun zhus pa ltar rgya rigs kyi lag rtsal mkhas pa mang po gdan drangs te dar 'bu gso ba dang / 'bras chang bsnyal ba/ shel bzo ba sogs kyi lag rtsal khyab spel btang / phyogs mtshungs bu phrug shes rig gsal ba khag gcig thang gi rgyal sa khrang an du mngags nas rgya yi skad yig dang deb bzhi gzhung lnga sogs kyi rig gnas slob sbyong byed par 38

srong btsanasgamapo'ilegs/mdzadakyibhang cung nab dpa/———————btang bas/ rgya bod mi rigs bar phan tshun shes rtogs byed rgyu dang mdza' mthun 'gro 'ong gi 'brel lam sngar las lhag par gong 'phel du gyur cing / de nas bzung bod sil bur ma gyur bar lo grangs nyis brgya nyi shu lhag tsam ring thang bod sa mtshams su dmag 'khrug yang yang byung rung / thang bod dbon zhang gi 'brel ba nam yang chad ma myong ba sogs lha sa gtsug lag khang gi mdun ngos su yod pa'i thang bod mthun 'brel rdo ring thog gsal bar 'khod pa ltar yin no/ /

bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi 'phel 'gyur skor gleng ba/bod sa gnas su lo ngo brgya phrag mang po'i ring rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi gnya' bar gnon pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs de krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og rtsa gtor btang ste bod kyi mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams mthar phyin pa'i bcings 'grol thob pa dang / rang nyid kyi tshab byed pa'i mi dmangs dmangs gtso'i srid dbang btsugs pa/ rjes lus kyi yo byad la brten nas thon skyed byed pa'i kher rkyang gi rang byung dpal 'byor gyi rnam par 'gyur ba btang ste tshan rig can dang deng rabs can gyi phyogs su mdun skyod kyis thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas su phyin pa bcas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi dus mjug tu gnas pa'i shul rnying thog nas thad dkar spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs su 'phur mchong byas pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'phel rgyas gsar pa zhig yin/der brten kho bos thengs 'dir bod kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dus rim gzhan dag skor ma gleng bar bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs thog mar chags pa dang / bar du 'phel rgyas ji ltar byung ba /mthar rgyu rkyen gang zhig la brten nas rtsa 'thor song ba bcas kyi brgyud rim dang / da lta'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bod ljongs gsar pa'i rnam pa 40

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglengab/—da wa—gnyis phan tshun blta sdur byas thog slad phyin rang re'i ljongs dang bod mi rigs kyi mdun lam gang 'dra zhig yin pa'i skor bcas gleng rgyu yin/dang po/ bod ljongs ni dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs su 'pho 'gyur byung ba'i skor/rang re'i ljongs 'dir mes rgyal nang khul du byung ba'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs dang mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs yin pa dang / bran g.yog lam lugs nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs su bar brgal byed pa'i dus rim ni dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos srid dbang bzung ba nas 'gro mgon 'phags pas bod sa gnas kyi chos srid gnyis ga'i dbang 'dzin ma gnang bar gyi dus skabs der zer/ de la bar brgal dus rabs zhes zer pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyi tshogs gsar rnying gi 'pho 'gyur zer ba de kha sang phan chad spyi tshogs rnying pa yin la/ de ring tshun chad spyi tshogs gsar pa yin pa'i gris bcad pa lta bu ma yin par/ lam lugs rnying pa nas gsar par 'gyur ldog 'gro skabs spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lhag 'phro yod la spyi tshogs gsar pa'i 'gyur ldog kyang yod pa'i bar brgal dus rim zhig brgyud de gzhi nas spyi tshogs 4/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsar pa'i lam lugs cha tshang ba zhig chags dgos pa der zer/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i srid dbang gsar nga dang / khrims lugs gsar pa/ dpal 'byor gyi sgris/ srol gsar pa bcas btsugs te lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi dus mtshams gsar pa zhig tu slebs pa red/ srong btsan sgam po nas 'go btsugs te btsan ngo rim byung gis rim bzhin 'thus sgo tshang du btang ba'i khrims lugs kyi nang bran g.yog lam lugs kyi lhag 'phro dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs gnyis ka'i rnam pa ldan pa'i nang don mang po yod pa'i nang nas gtso che ba ni bran g.yog dang zhing pa'i bar la dpal 'byor thog gi khyad par chen po yod pa'i thog blon po dang zhing dpon dmag dpon sogs kyis 'bangs dkyus ma dang / bran g.yog tsam ma zad btson pa zhig bsad kyang srog stong 'jal dgos pa gsal por bkod yod stabs/bran g.yog lam lugs kyi dus skabs dang mi 'dra ba gsal por mthong thub/de dang phyogs mtshungs dpal 'byor lam lugs thad la tun hong nas thon pa'i yig cha'i nang rgyal po dang / blon po/ dmag dpon so gas kyis zhing par khyim dud kyi mi grangs la gzhigs pa'i sa zhing bgos te lo legs byung dus sa zhing dor gcig la dpya khral 'bru khal drug sprod dgos pa dang /lo nyes byung dunu/ 'bru khal lnga las sprod mi dgos pa/ dpya khral lo dus su ma 'jal na lo rjes mar ldab gcig sprod dgos pa sogs zhing sa/sa/'a/ 'khod nga/ des/ zhing pa rnam/sa rang rang la bgos pa'i sa zhing gi dpya khra lnga 'jal ba phud pa'i lhag ma rang nyid la dbang bar khas len byas/ pa'i 42

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglengab/ ———dpang rtags gsal por mthong thub/skabs der bran g.yog lam lugs kyi shul lhag ni bran g.yog rnams la sger dbang dang dpal 'byor dang sdod khang med pa/ bran g.yog bdag por rang gi bran g.yog gzhan la 'tshong ba dang / bzung ba/ phud pa / btson du 'jug pa bcas kyi dbang cha yod pa de tsam zhig red/btsan po rim byung 'das skabs/ rgyal po'i blon po dang btsun mo/ bran g.yog bcas khag gcig btsan po'i pur dang mnyam du 'jog gi yod ces bod kyi lo rgyus nang 'khod pa ni/ btsan po 'das rjes btsun mo dang blon po'i gtso bo 'ga' zhig rang nyid ma shi bar du btsan po'i bang so srung mkhan du bzhag pa'i don yin pa las/ mi gson po dur gyi nang du sbas pa'i don ma yin par 〈 rgyal po bka' thang 〉dang 〈deb ther dkar ngo 〉sogs las gsal por bshad pa ltar yin/gong du bshad pa'i dpe mtshon de dag gi thog nas dus rabs bdun nga/'i 'gor slebs dus bod kyi spyi tshogs de sngon dus kyi bran g.yog lam lugs dang mi 'dra bar yar rgyas kyi 'gyur ba ha cang po byung yod par brten/ de nas dus rabs dgu pa'i dkyil bar lo ngo nyis brgya dang nyi shu tsam gyi ring bod kyi btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyi srid dbang mu mthud du gnas thub pa byung yod/ 'on kyang btsan po khri srong lde btsan sku 'das rjes/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dge 'dun pa rnams spyi tshogs thog gi go gnas mthon por slebs te/ myang ting 'dzin bzang po dang / bran ka dpal gyi yon tan sogs dge slong 'ga' zhig gis kyang btsan po'i 'oyi 43

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gi srid 'dzin blon chen gyi go gnas dang dbang cha bzung ba dang / btsan po khri ral pa can gyi skabs grwa pa rer 'bangs mi khyim bdun re dang/ sa zhing / nor phyugs bcas dbang chog pa dang / spyi tshogs thog gi mi su 'dra zhig gis kyang grwa par brnyas bcos byas na btsan pos bka' phab ste de'i mig 'don pa dang / mdzub mo gcod pa sogs kyi khrims chad drag po gtong gi yod par brten/ chos byed dge 'dun pa tshor spyi 'bangs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal dbang cha chen po bzung thub pa byung zhing / de la brten nas sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa med pa'i blon 'bangs mang po mi dga' bar gyur te thog mar btsan po ral pa can dang / btsun mo cog ro bza'/ blon po bran ka dpal yon gsum gyi bar du dbyen sbyor dkrugs shing byas te blon po dmar gsod btang zhing /btsun mo rang shi rgyag dgos byung ba dang / btsan po rang nyid kyang blon po sbas dang / legs sdugs btsan gnyis kyis mgul gcus/ cog ro lha lod (btsun mo cog ro bza'i gcung po )kyis sku la mtshon bsnun te bkrongs/de rjes btsan po glang dar mas srid dbang bzung ste sangs rgyas chos lugs bsnubs shing / lo ngo phyed dang gnyis kyi ring sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grwa pa gtso che ba rnams dmar gsod dang / de byings 'ga' zhig khyim par phab/ babs su ma 'dod pa rnams rngon pa byed du bcug sku rten 'ga' zhig chu la bskyur/ 'ga' zhig sa dong dang bye ma'i nang du sbas/gsung rab mang po me la bsregs shing chu la bskyur/ gtsug lag khang rnams kyi sgo la 'dag zhal byas/ lha khang /nga du bshas ra byas pa sogs 44

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi 'phel 'gyur skor gleng ba/bod sa gnas su sangs rgyas chos lugs byung ba'i ming tsam ma gtogs ma lus pa bzos/ dge 'dun mkhas pa 'ga' zhig brdzus chas spras te stod mnga' ris brgyud mtsho sngon du bros dgos byung zhing / btsan po glang dar ma rang nyid kyang lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bkrongs/ glang dar ma grongs skabs btsun mo gzhon pa'i lus la bu skye rgyu yod stabs/ btsun mo che bas kyang rang lus la btsan po'i bu yod khul byas te btsun mo gzhon par phru gu skyes ma thag btsun mo rgan pas kyang kha nang du so skyes tshar ba'i sprang phrug cig nyos pa yin kyang zer (kho rang gi bu yin kyang zer ba yod )pa'i skabs der/ btsan po'i bu che ba su yin skor la ma 'cham par btsun mo rgan gzhon gyi phyogs khag gnyis su gyes te lo nyi shu lhag tsam ring nang 'khrug byas nas mthar btsun mo gzhon pa'i phyogs khag la pham nyes byung / nang 'khrug gi go skabs de dang bstun nas kheng log ('bangs gyen log )byung ste thog mar khams khul dang / de rjes rim bzhin dbus khul gyi lha sa dang /lho kha/ gtsang / dwags po/ kong po bcas phyogs thams cad nas 'bangs gyen log byung / gyen log der bod gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus thog kheng log ces 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyi skabs spyi 'bangs kyi nang nas dmag don gyi las ka byed mkhan rnams la rgod zer zhing / de min gyi spyi 'bangs gzhan dag la kheng zer ba yin la/kheng gi nang du blon po dang / lag shes bzo las pa/ zhing pa/ 'brog pa/tshong pa/ bran g.yog bcas tshang ma de'i khongs su gtogs pa yin pas/skabs der byung ba'i gyen log ni bran g.yog gcig pu'i gyen log tsam ma 46

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yin par spyi 'bangs yod tshad 'dus pa'i gzhi rgya chen po'i gyen log cig yin par brten/ dus yun lo dgu lhag tsam rgyun 'khyodas byas mthar rgyal po dpal 'khor btsan bgrongs shing / khong gi sras gsum stod mnga' ris su bros dgos byung ste bod rje gnya' khri btsan po'i gdung rgyud kyis bzung ba'i srid dbang de sa gas ri nyil ltar rtsa 'thor song ba dang /de nas bzung dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i 'gor yon rgyal rabs kyis bod 'di mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur gyi mnga' khongs su bsdus pa'i bar lo grangs sum brgya sum cu so drug gi ring der/ dbus gtsang khul du rje dpon tshan pa bcu gcig dang / stod mnga' ris su rje dpon tshan pa gsum/ mdo smad du khag gcig bcas kyis dum bur bcad nas dbang bsgyur ba'i bcad bzung sa khul chags te bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang kha 'thor mang po yod pa der lo rgyus thog bod sil bu'i dus rabs zhes 'bod pa de byung ba red/ gnyis pa/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs 'phel rgyas byung ste chos srid zung 'brel gyi 'go tshugs pa/1 bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs de chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs su 'gyur ba'i dus mtshams skor/ de'i thad la mkhas dbang rnam pa tshor dgongs chul mi 'dra ba yod cing / 'on kyang rang nyid kyi lta tshul la/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs zer ba 46

da wa bkasabakod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lamalug5kyi'aphela'agyuraskodas+t+ringab/ — — ——— de chab srid thog chos byed dge 'dun pa dang / bon po tsho srid dbang bzwang mkhan gras su slebs yod med tsam la go rgyu ma yin par/ srid dbang bzung mkhan gyi gtso bo yin pa'i rgyal po de chos srid gnyis ka'i dbang cha bzung mkhan yin min dang / de'i dpal 'byor thog gi dmigs bsal dbang cha gang 'dra yod med bcas/ phyogs gnyis zung du ‘rabre' nas dbye zhib byed dgos pa 'dug bsam/chos byed dge 'dun pa dang / bon po tsho srid gzhung gi nang du da bang cha bzung mkhan gras su slebs pa tsam gyis chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs byung bar ngos 'dzin byas na/ srong btsan sgam pos srid dbang ma bzung gong gi btsan po rim byung mang po zhig la yod pa'i mchod gnas sku gshen du 'bod pa'i bon po de tshos srid gzhung gi nang du dbang cha chen po bzung yod pa dang / rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs rba gsal snang / khri lde srong btsan skabs kyi myang ting 'dzin bzang po khri ral pa can skabs kyi bran ka dpal gyi yon tan bcas rab byung yin pa ma zad/ srid gzhung gi nang du blon po'i go gnas kyang bzung yod pas/skabs de dus nas bod du chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs byung zin par khas len dgos pa lta bu chags yod/ 'on kyang skabs der chos byed dge 'dun pa 'ga' zhig srid gzhung gi nang du blon po chen po'i bo gnas bzung ba ni rjes su chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs 'byung rgyu'i thog ma'i rnam pa tsam zhig yin pa ma gtogs/ chos lugs kyi dbang cha ni blon po de tsho phar zhog btsan po rang nyid la yang med par bcom ldan 'das /7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyi ring lugs pa ste mkhan po dang slob dpon rnam pa tsho'i phyag tu bzung yod pas chos srid gnyis ka'i dbang cha mi gcig gi lag tu bzung pa de 'dra min pa skabs de'i bka' gcigs yi ge dang / rdo ring gi yi ge khag tu gsal por 'khod yod/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs chags rgyu'i dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi ni/ dus rabs dgu pa'i 'gor rgyal po khri ral pa can gyis srid dbang bzung skabs grwa pa tshor 'bangs mi khyim bdun re dang / stod lung lcang phu sogs dgon pa 'ga' zhig la sa zhing dang /nor phyugs/ 'brog thang bcas phul ba de ni dgon pa'i nang gi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dang / chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs chags rgyu'i dpal 'byor rmang gzhi thog mar byung 'go tshugs pa red/ 'on kyang skabs der srid kyi dbang cha ni srid gzhung gi rgyal blon tsho'i lag tu bzung yod cing / dgon pa dang lha khang tshor dbang ba'i 'bangs dang bran g.yog rnams kyis khrims dang 'gal ba'i gnas tshul byung na yul sde so so'i blon po dang dpon rigs tshos thag gcod byed pa ma gtogs/ dgon pa lha khang gi bdag po tshor khrims thag gcod pa'i dbang cha gtan nas med/bod sa gnas su yod pa'i chos lugs grub mtha' khag la mchod gzhis mi ser dang / khrims thag rang gcod kyi dbang cha byung ba'i dus tshod ni/ yon rgyal rabs kyi skabs yon rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po tha'i tsung o go tas srid dbang bzung skabs bod sa gnas kyi chos lugs grub mtha' che ba khag drug (sa skya/ phag gru/ g.ya' bzang / 'bri gung / stag lung / tshal 48

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglengab/———— —pa bcas )gis yon rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po dang rgyal sras khag so sor mgo btags zhus rjes kho tshor bod kyi sa gnas khag nas rgya khyon ha lam 'dra ba'i mchod gzhis mi ser dang / khrisnyas 'go rang btsan gyi dbang cha sprad pa nas chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs 'go tshugs pa red/der brten bod sa gnas su chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs tshugs pa dang / bod sa gnas 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs su gcig gyur byung ba gnyis phan tshun 'brel ba dam po yod pas gsham du de'i brgyud rim skor gnad bsdus shig gleng rgyu yin/ byu2 rgyu rkyen gang zhig la brten nas yon rgyal rabs kyi skabs bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs chen po'i nang du gcig gyur byung ba'i skor/gnad don 'di bod sa gnas su chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs chags pa'i nang rkyen dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ chos srid gnyis phan tshun gcig la gcig brten gyi 'brel ba dam zab yod pa der thug yod/ de yang gong du bshad zin pa ltar bod sil bu'i dus skabs su dbus gtsang mnga' ris mdo smad dang bcas par rje dpon tshan pa khag bco lngas dbang sgyur byas pa'i ring phan tshun gcig 'og gcig la ma 'dus pa'i nang 'khrug rgyun mi chad par byung ba dang chabs cig rang byung gi gnod 'tshe dang mu ge bcas gcig mjug gnyis mthud du byung bar brten zhing 'brog thon skyed la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa'i dbang bis bod dbus gtsang khul gyi mi mang po zhig mdo smad dang khams yul sogs yul lung bde 'jags dang zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi cha rkyen cung bzang 49

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i sa khul du bros byol 'gro dgos pa byung yod/ spyi tshogs hril po bde 'jags me da pa'i gnas tshul 'og da dung dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug tsam nas sangs rgyas chos lugs phyi dar gyi 'go tshugs te smad 'dul gyi brgyud 'dzin tsho pa che ba bzhi dang de re re la yang nang gses tsho khag mi 'dra ba bcu phrag kha shas su gyes shing gzhan yang bka' gdams pa dang / sa skya ba//tshal pa/ bka' brgyud/ phag gru bka' brgyud/ karma bka' brgyud/'bri gung bka' brgyud/ stag lung bka' brgyud/ g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud sogs bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad bcas byung ba dang / de tshos kyang rang rang so sos gnas gzhi bzung yod par brten sa gnas de rang gi mang tshogs dang dpon rigs khag rnams kyis sa gnas de gar dar khyab che ba'i chos lugs der dad pa byed kyi yod pa'i dbang gis sa gnas khag so sor chos lugs grub mtha'i stobs shugs khyab khongs mi 'dra ba re chags te/ phan tshun bar mchod gzhis mi ser 'phrog res kyi nang 'khrug che chung sna tshogs rgyun du yong gi yod/ de ni btsan po'i sadung rgyud kyis bzung ba'i bod sa gnas kyi gcig gyur srid dbang 'thor rje sa lo grangs sum brgya sum cu so drug gi ring bod nang khul gyi chos lugs stobs shugs dang / srid 'dzin stobs shugs sus kyang bod sa gnas yongs rdzogs gcig gyur byed ma thub pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig yin pa ma zad/chos lug/sa grub mtha' khag gi bar dang dpal 'byor yong khungs dang sde 'bangs/ mi ser 'phrog res byas pa'i 'khrug rtsod de mthar srid dbang 'phrog res kyi 'thab rtsod du 'gyur ldog yong rgyu dang / rim bzhin chos 50

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugasakyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglen+d+ra ṣa/— — — —srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs chags rgyu'i nang rkyen gtso bo zhig yin /gzhan yang chos dang srid gnyis phan tshun gcig la gcig brten gyi 'brel ba dam po yod pa ste/ de gnyis sus kyang gzhan ngos kyi stobs shugs dang kha bral na rang tshugs mi thub pa de red/ de yang gsal por bshad na/ chos lugs grub mtha' khag la rang rang gi stobs shugs che chung sna tshogs yod kyang / de nyid srung 'dzin dang gong 'phel gtong rgyur thabs shes gnyis las med pa ste/ gcig ni rang nyid kyi lag tu srid dbang bzung thub pa bya rgyu de yin pa dang / gcig ni rang rang so so'i rgyab rten bcol sa'i sbyin bdag de chab srid dang / dmag dpung /dpal 'byor bcas kyi thad nas dus skabs der stobs shugs che shos yin pa zhig la brten dgos rgyu de yin/ bya thabs dang po de ni skabs de'i bod kyi chos lugs grub mtha' khag rnams chab srid dang / dmag don/dpal 'byor stobs shugs gang gi thad nas bshad na yang rang nyid kyi lag tu sred dbang bzung thub pa'i stobs shugs med par brten bya thabs gnyis pa de lag bstar mi byed ka med kyi gnas su gyar yod/ 'on kyang skabs der bod sa gnas nang khul du de 'dra'i stobs shugs che ba zhig med pa ma zad/ dus skabs der 'dzam gling thar phyogs su/ chab srid dang /dmag don/ dpal 'byor sogs gang ci'i thad nas stobs shugs che cos ni yon rgyal rabs yin pa'i dbang gis ya gling dkyil ma dang / nub ma/o gling shar rgyud bcas la'ang rgyang skyod dmag 'khrug byas te phyi nas yong ba'i btsan 'dzul stobs shugs/ bkag 'gog byas nas mes rgyal nang khul 5/
