dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gyi shis zha dang / sung lho ma/ cin rgyal rabs gsum tsam ma gtogs sa khul mang che ba mnga' 'og tu bsdus te sus kyang 'gran zla byed mi nus pa lta bu chags yod par brten/ bod kyi chos lugs grub mtha' khag gis kyang yon rgyal rabs la rgyab rten bcol rgyu de kha tsha dgos gtug yin par bsam ste/ spyi lo 1239lor sa skya dang / phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung pa/tshal pa/ stag lung pa/ g.ya' bzang pa bcas grub mtha' khag drug gis rang rang so so'i 'thus mi mngags nas/ sa skya bas sog po'i rgyal po o go ta'i ngo mar mgo btags zhus shing / de bzhin 'bri gung pa dang /phag mo gru pa/ g.ya' bzang pa gsum gyis rgyal sras hu la'i hu/ stag lung pas rgyal sras a ri bo ga tshal pas rgyal sras hu pi li la mgo btags zhus pa bcas byas yod/lo de'i rjes mar sog po go dan rgyal pos dmag dpon dor dha nag pos sne 'khrid pa'i sog dmag stong phrag mang po bod du btang nas de sngon mgo btags ma zhus par rang srung rgol lan slog mkhan gyi bod mi'i yul sde tshang ma sreg gsod 'phrog gsum gyi drag shugs la brten nas dbang du bsdus/ mgo btags zhus pa'i chos lugs grub mtha' khag la rgyal po dang rgyal sras che chung so sos rang nyid kyi mnga' khongs bod kyi sa gnas khag nas rgya khyon ha lam gcig mtshungs yin pa'i mchod gzhis dang sde 'bangs mi ser bcas sprad pa red/yon rgyal rabs skabs bod sa gnas kyi chos lugs grub mtha' khag la mchod gzhis dang mi ser sprad pa'i thog nas bshad na/ thog mar go 52

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglengab/ ——dan rgyal pos sa skya ba la mnga' ris skor gsum phud pa'i la stod lho byang gnyis dang / gur mo/ chu mig shangs/ zhwa lung / yar 'brog bcas khri skor bdun gyi sa cha dang mi ser them dud chig khri stong med brgyad brgya/phag mo gru par rgyal sras hu la'i hus sprad pa'i mchod gzhis dang mi ser them grangs nyis stong bzhi brgya sum cu so brgyad/ 'bri gung par rgyal sras mong gol han gyis sprad pa'i mchod gzhis dang mi ser them grangs sum stong drug brgya sum cu/ tshal pa la rgyal sras hu pi lis sprad pa'i mchod gzhis dang mi ser them grangs sum stong bdun brgya/ g.ya' bzang par rgyal sras hu la'i hus sprad pa'i mchod gzhis dang mi ser them grangs sum stong / stag lung par rgyal sras a ri bo gas sprad pa'i mchod gzhis dang mi ser them grangs lnga brgya bcas sger 'dzin byed chog pa'i dbang cha byung yod/srid kyi thog nas bshad na/ srid don gyi dbang cha bzung mkhan gyi rgyal blon dang srid gzhung gang yin yang dpal 'byor dang / khrims lugs/dmag don bcas kyi dbang cha chen po bzung yod kyang / de nyid rgyun 'dzin dang srung skyob byed dgos na/ dus skabs de'i rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi nang du dad mos che ba'i chos lugs stobs shugs dang chos lugs kyi gtso 'dzin go gnas bzung ba'i grags can mi snar brten nas rang nyid kyis dbang sgyur bya yul sa gnas der rkang pa brtan por 'dzugs thabs bya dgos pa las/ dus skabs de dang sa gnas der mang tshogs kyis dad mos bya sa'i chos lugs stobs shugs dang kha bral ba'am 'gal zlar langs 53

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na/ rgyal khab der dmag don dang dpal 'byor thog stobs shugs ji tsam chen po yod kyang mang tshogs dang kha bral nas srid dbang brtan por gnas thub thabs med/ der brten bod sa gnas su rim gzhin dbang sgyur byas pa'i yon rgyal rabs kyis sa skya ba dang / karma pa/ 'bri gung pa/tshal pa bcas kyi chos lugs stobs shugs bed spyod byas pa dang / de bzhin ming rgyal rabs kyis sa skya dang / karma pa/ phag gru/ dge lugs rtsopa bcas la brten pa/ ching rgyal rabs kyis dge lugs pa'i stobs shugs la brten pa red/gong du bshad pa ltar gyi nang rkyen dang phyi rkyen de 'dra zhig la brten nas bod kyi lo rgyus kyi 'phel rgyas gsar pa ste/ yon rgyal rabs nas bzung bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs rtsod pa med pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po ches bod sa gnas kyi chos srid gnyis ka'i bdag po dang / yon rgyal rabs kyis/ bod sa gnas su btsugs pa'i bod kyi shon wu'i si tu'u yon hra'o h+phu'i gtso 'dzin gnang ba nas bzung bod du chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs dngos su 'go tshugs pa yin/de yang zhib phra shod par yig tshogs che stabs gnad bsdus shig brjod na/ spyi lo 1260lor yon rgyal rabs dngos su ma btsugs pa'i sog po'i rgyal rabs kyi skabs/ rgyal sras hu pi lis thog mar sog yul du rgyal po'i go sar 'khod cing / rjes su rgyal yongs khyon la dbang bsgyur ba'i gong ma'i go gnas su slebs rjes/ rgyal sa pe cin du spos thog rgyal 57/

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglengab/ da rabs kyi ming la hā yon rgyal rabs zhes ming sgyur byas shing / 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che rgyal po'i mchod gnas su gdan drangs te dbang thengs dang po zhus pa'i yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum phul/(dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum) dbang thengs gnyis pa zhu skabs dbang yon du stod mnga' ris nas rgya mchod rten dkar po yan chad kyi bod chol kha gsum phul/ skabs der gong ma hu pi lis 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che la dbang thengs gnyis zhus pa'i dbang yon du thog mar bod khri skor bcu gsu ma dang / rjes su bod chol kha gsum yongs rdzogs phul ba yin zhes bod dang sog po'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus su gsal ba de dbye zhib byas na/skabs de nas bzung yon rgyal rabs kyi gong mas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang la the jus med pa dang / dbang cha med pa de 'dra gtan nas min pa ni/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po cher bod khri skor bcu gsum dang bod chol kha gsum phul zin pa'i rjes su spyi lo 1272lor yon rgyal rabs kyis bod sa gnas su thu po shon wu'i si tu'u yon hra'o h+phu zer ba'i srid 'dzin las khungs btsugs pa de ni zhing chen rim pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs mtho shos yin cing / 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che ni las khungs de'i dbu 'dzin gtso bo yin pa dang / gsham 'og tu dpon chen dang / khri dpon/ stong dpon/ brgya dpon sogs srid 'dzin dpon rigs mang po yod pa ma zad/ de sngon bod kyi khrims lugs rnying pa rnams mi dgos pa bzos te/ yon rgyal rabs kyi khrims lugs lag bstar byed du bcug thog khral 'jal sa tshigs dang / dmag don do dam babs 55

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshugs btsugs nas lo re bzhin bod sa gnas nas dpya khral nges can zhig bsdu gi yod pa red/de rjes ming rgyal rabs kyi dus sde srid phag mo grub pas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung skabs sa gnas khag la rdzong dpon dang /gzhis sdod bsko bzhag dang / lo gsum re nas gsar pa brje len sogs srid 'dzin gyi lam lugs bcos sgrig mi nyung ba zhig byas yod kyang / sde srid rim byung gi nang nas mang che bas ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma rim pa'i sar rang nyid ngo 'gro'am ngo tshab btang ba gang rigs kyi thog nas bod sa gnas su dbang sgyur byed chog pa'i 'ja' sa dang bka' yig go gnas bcas zhus yod pa phag gru sde srid rim pa'i lo rgyus nang gsal por 'khod 'dug gsum pa/ chos srid zung 'brel dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs 'phel rgyas kyi rtse mor son pa/ man ching rgyal rabs 'go tshugs ma thag pa'i thog ma'i dus skabs su de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung ste tā la'i bla mas gtso bo gnang ba'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs btsugs pa dus mtshungs shing / skabs der de sngon pham nyes byung ba'i dgra phyogs nas slar yang tshur rgol gyi dus zing bslangs te srid dbang thor zhig 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha chen po yod par brten/ thog mar tā la'i bla ma lnga pa chen po dang paṇa chen rin po che blo 56

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglengab/ ge—bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis kyis se chen chos rje brgyud man ching srid gzhung gsar pa btsugs par rten 'brel zhu gnang mdzad cing /man ching gong mas kyang rang nyid kyi dbang gyur sra brtan yong ba dang /sog po sogs grangs nyung mi rigs gzhan dag dbang du bsdu dgos na/dus skabs der snyan grags dang stobs shugs che ba'i chos lugs bed spyod byed dgos pa dang / de yang tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis gal chen po yin par mthong nas 'tshams 'dri'i 'brel ba byas pa ma zad/ gong ma hrun kris tā la'i bla ma lnga pa chen po pe cin du gdan drangs nas gus bkur sne len gzab rgyas zhus te/ skad rigs bzhi shan sbyar gyi 'ja' sa gser tham chen mo phul ba de nas bzung tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon rnams kyis gal che'i bka' shog khag la gser tham chen mo de phab pa gnang gi yod/ tā la'i bla mas gtso bo gnang ba'i bod sa gnas kyi srid gzhung gsar pa der sa skya dang / phag gru sogs kyi srid rabs rim pa'i lugs srol nang nas 'ga' zhig legs bcos dang /legs cha rgyun 'dzin/ cha ma tshang ba kha snon bcas mdzad de/ bka' blon shag sogs las khungs khag bcu gsar 'dzugs dang / bka' blon dang mda' dpon sogs dpon rigs rim pa bco lnga gsar bskos/ sa gnas khag gi sgo phra them gzhung gsar 'god/ rdzong gzhis khag gi sa ming / thon khungs legs nyes/ de la gzhigs pa'i khral 'bab ji thob bcas kyi 'bab deb khag lnga bcu nga drug gsar bzo bcas byung yod/ gzhan yang dgon sde khag gcig la mchod gzhis mi ser 'phar snon thog khrims 'gro 57

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rang btsan gyi dbang cha gnang ba dang / khag gcig la mchod gzhis mi ser ma dgos par srid gzhung nas lo ltar grwa pa mang nyung la gzhigs pa'i 'bru phogs gtan 'jags sprod rgyu/ dgon sde khag la grwa grangs gtan 'khel/ sde srid rim byung tshang mas srid dbang bzung ring sger gyi rgyu nor gsog mi chog pa dang / sde srid dgongs zhu byas rjes rgyu nor dang / pha gzhis/ mi ser/ sems can bcas kyi skal ba srid gzhung nas sprod rgyu bcas kyi gtan 'bebs gnang yod/ dus skabs de nas bzung dgon sde che ba khag gcig la mchod gzhis mi ser rgya che yod pa'i thog khrims 'go rang btsan gyi dbang cha yang bzung yod par brten/ rang khongs zhing bran rnams la dpal 'byor thog nas khralatshurigs sna tshogs bsdus chog pa dang / chab srid thog nas srid 'dzin las khungs khag dang khyad med pa'i khrims lugs lag bstar byed kyi yod pa ma zad/ dgon pa'i nang gi dge 'dun pa chos khrims dang 'gal ba byung rigs la yang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung nas gsungs pa'i chos khrims ltar ma byas par/ srid gzhung gi khrims khang nang gi lugs srol ltar btson 'jug dang / nyes rdung / rkang lcags lag lcags rgyag pa/ ske sgo g.yogs pa sogs byed 'go btsugs pa red/ de ni chos srid zung 'brel dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi dus rim mtho shos su slebs pa'i mtshon rtags shig yin/ 58

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglengab/da —— —bzhi pa/ chos srid zung 'brel dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs nyams rgud du song ba'i 'go tshugs pa/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa sku na phra mo'i skabs bod sa gnas kyi bka' blon nang khul srid dbang 'phrog res byas te dbus gtsang gnyis bar mi mthun pa'i nang 'khrug langs pa dang / pho lha tha'i ji dang kho pa'i bu 'gyur med rnam rgyal gnyis kyis srid dbang bzung skabs tā la'i bla ma rin po cher gus bkur med pa'i bsnyad 'dogs skyon 'tshol yang yang byas pa/ dbus gtsang du sdod pa'i man ching srid gzhung gi dmag mi phyir 'then byed du 'jug pa/ lha sar bzhag pa'i am ban gnyis bsad pa sogs byas par brten/ man ching srid gzhung gis phyin chad bod sa gnas kyi sde srid lam lugs mi dgos pa byas thog tā la'i bla mas gtso bo dang / de'i 'og bka' shag dang / yig tshang bcas las grub pa'i lam lugs gsar pa zhig btsugs nas chos srid zung 'brel lam lugs der shugs snon brgyab ste 'thor la nye ba'i nyen kha'i gnas de re zhig skyob thub tsam byung yod/ de nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas srid dbang ma/ bzhes bar du bod gnas kyi srid dbang de gong 'phel 'gro rgyu lta ci/snum zad mar me lta bur gyur te sger pa khag dang dgon sde khag gi dpal 'byor stobs shugs je rgyas su song zhing / srid gzhung gi bang mdzod ni stongs la nye ba dang / rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs ni lto skyo la gos hrul 59

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba/ lus po ni rus gong pags pas g.yogs pa lta bu/ khral gyi sna kha mang ba rta mog ro'i spu lta bu zad mtha' med pa bcas ni srid dbang de 'thor zhig tu 'gro nye ba'i mtshon rtags red/de nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas srid dbang bzhes skabs phyi nas dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas btsan 'dzul byas pa dang /nang nas man ching srid gzhung gis rgya bod mi rigs mthun sgril la gtor bshig gtong ba'i bya ngan rgyun mi chad par spel ba'i mthar man ching srid gzhung 'thor zhig tu song zhing / skabs der bod sa gnas kyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas 'ugro thabs la dgongs pa bzhes te sger pa dang dgon sde khag gi gzhis ka srid gzhung gis gzhung 'dzin gnang rgyu dang / zhing 'brog gi khral rigs chag yang gtong rgyu/ srid gzhung gi 'bru mdzod 'dzugs rgyu/ gzhon nu blo rig gsal ba khag gcig phyi rgyal du slob sbyong gtong gnang sogs dus bab la gzhigs pa'i bod kyi nor srid dpal 'byor yar rgyas 'gro thabs gang thub ci thub gnang yang sger chos gnyis kas bkag 'gog gang thub byas par brten don thog tu ma 'khyol ba'i ngang nas dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang / de nas srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po ches gnang ring lo shas ring bod kyi dpal 'byor phran bu yar rgyas byung yang stabs ma legs par srid skyong stag brag rin po che dang ma mthun pa'i 'gal zla cher song ste/ bod ljongs ser skya yongs kyis gus bkur chen po zhu ba'i srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che yang mun nag gi btson khang nang du sku bgrongs ba'i blo pham yid mug gi bya ba tshabs chen de 'dra byung / 60

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglengang /———— —de nas srid skyong stag brag rin po ches gnang ring zhabs 'bring pa mi ngan 'ga' zhig dang / dpon ngan nyung shas kyi gzhan dbang du song ste srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che sku bkrongs pa dang / se ra dgon par dmag dpung btang ste drag gnon byas pa sogs dus thung lo shas ring la yang lhing 'jags ma byung ba'i dbang gis 'bru rigs dang / bza' bca'i rin thang de sngon las ldab kha shas kyi bar du 'phar ba bcas bod sa gnas kyi dpal 'byor gnas tshul je zhan je sdug tu song yod/lnga pa/ bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs rtsa med du song ste 'od stong ldan pa'i mdun lam thog bskyod pa/spyi lo 1949lor krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og tha'e wan dang bod sa gnas tsam ma gtogs rgyal yongs bcings 'grol btang zhing /lo de'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig nyin krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal/ khab dngos su btsugs pa'i khyab bsgrags byas rjes/ krung go mi dmangs bcings bgrol dmag bod du bskyod pa dang chabs cig krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung la zhi ba'i sgo nas bcings 'grol gtong rgyur gros mol bya dgos pa'i skul slong gnang yang / me dbyin btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis dkrog gtam bzos pa dang bkag 'gog byas pa sogs phyi nang gi rkyen mang po zhig dang 'phrad kyang mthar krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang gros mol bya rgyu'i khas len 6/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mi byed ka med byung zhing / tā la'i sku phreng bcu bzhi pas dngos su srid dbang bzhes rjes/ 1951lor skabs de'i bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis gtsos pa'i dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi lnga pe cin du btang nas yongs su grags pa'i gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags dngos su bkod pa ma zad/ de nas yun ring ma song bar krung go mi dmangs bcings bgrol dmag lha sar 'byor zhing / tā la'i bla ma yang gro mo nas lha sar phyir phebs gnang ba bcas tshang mar bod kyi rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs tshos spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu zhus pa ma zad/ de nas bzung rgya bod mi rigs bar gyi mthun sgril dang / bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril bcas sngar las lhag par dam zab byung ste/ bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i mdun lam gsar pa zhig phye thub pa byung yod/krung go mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag bod du 'byor rjes/ krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang dang / bod bskyod rgya rigs las byed pa/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dpon dmag bcas tshang mas tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus lag len mthar phyin bstar bar brten/ rgya che'i mi dmangs tshang mas krung go gung khran tang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i byams brtse'i thugs khur la snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu ba dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la yid ches dang dga' zhen byed pa ma zad/ mtho 'bring mi sna khag gcig kyang go rtogs sad nas krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og bod kyi mi rigs khag gi 62

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglengab/ —da mi dmangs dang mnyam du dmangs gtso'i gsar brje brgyud spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam thog bskyod rgyu ni 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam yin pa dang / de las gzhan pa'i 'gro lam med pa gsal por shes te bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam lugs de yongs su bcos sgyur byed rgyur brtsi bkur zhus pa red/ 'on kyang mtho rim mi sna nyung shas zhig gis phyi tshul thog brtsi bkur zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan kyang / don dngos su ngo rgol byed pa'i mgo gnyis ma'i spyod tshul bzung ste 1959lor phyogs yongs nas ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs pa red/ 'on kyang mtha' mjug bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs de lo rgyus thog byung ba'i ming tsam ma gtogs ma lus pa'i rtsa med song ba dang / rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs rnams mi rabs nas mi rabs bar rta zog dud 'gro lta bu'i 'tsho ba skyel ba'i nyi ma mjug 'gril te rang lus rang dbang thob nas rgyal khab kyi bdag por gyur pa dang / bod kyi thon skyed dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung / mi 'bor bcas lo re las lo re gong 'phel du phyin nas ha cang rjes lus yin pa'i bod rnying pa de dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i bod ljongs gsar pa zhig tu 'gyur ba'i 'go tshugs pa red/ 6ni

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/drug pa/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pas gtan 'khelatshoganang ba'i lam phyogs dang / bod kyi las don la gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i mdzad phyogs srid jus la rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi gting zab yod pa/rgyal khab gang zhig dang srid dbang 'dzin pa'i tang gang 'dra zhig yin yang rang nyid kyis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i byed phyogs de la rgyal kha thob thub dang mi thub ni rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi brtan po yod med la rag las pa ma gtogs/ tshogs pa 'ga' zhig dang / phyogs khag re zung gi rgyab skyor thob dang mi thob la rag las pa zhig min cing / gal te stobs shugs che ba'i phyogs khag gcig la gnas skabs ring rgyal kha thob kyang de la mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi med na mgyogs myur pham nyes dang 'thor zhig tu 'gro rgyu nges can red/ rgyal phung dmangs sa/nod byed mkhan mi bzhi shog khag gis kyang dus skabs gcig ring mang tshogs khag gcig la ma/go skor bslu brid byas te tang srid dmag gsum gyi dbang cha yongs rdzogs 'phrog thub pa byung yang / kho pa tsho'i byed phyogs der mang tshogs kyis rgyab skyor thob thub pa'i rmang gzhi med stabs mthar pham nyes dang khrims gcod phog pa de ni de'i dpe mtshon zhig red/ phyogs gzhan 64

bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi'aphela'agyuraskoraglengabad/ da wazhig nas bshad na krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du 'byor ba nas bod du ngo log zingaho'akhrug ma langs bar gyi dus skabs de'i ring krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang dang bod bskyod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis dus dang rnam pa kun tu tang gi yang dag pa'i mdzad phyogs dang srid jus khag lag len nan po bstar ba des rgya bod mi rigs bar dang bod mi rigs nang khul/ mi rigs gzhan dag bar bcas kyi mthun sgril la shugs snon thebs pa dang bod kyi chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung slob gso/ sman bcos 'phrod bsten/ zhing 'brog thon skyed bcas la yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro bar skul ma thebs par brten/ rgya che'i bzo zhing mang tshogs dang / rim gras khag rgyal gces mtho rim mi sna bcas kyi yid ches dang brtsi bkur thob ste gsar brjer ngo log pa nyung shas kyis bslangs pa'i ngo log zing 'khrug de bzhin dus yun thung ngu zhig gi nang gtor pham btang thub pa byung ba de yang krung go gung khran tang gis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i bya gzhag de la gzhi rgya rnge ba'i bod kyi mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor thob thub pa'i rmang gzhi bzang po yod par brten nas byung ba dang / de rjes dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur byas pa nas rig gnas gsar brje chen po ma byas bar du bod kyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun gyi bya gzhag gong 'phel 'gro mgyogs po byung ba de yang krung go gung khran tang gis bod kyi rgya che'i mang tshogs dang / rim gras khag gi 'dod pa khengs pa'i mdzad phyogs dang srid jus lag len bstar rgyu mtha' 'khyongs byas pa la brten nas byung ba 65

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/red/ grub 'bras dang rgyal kha chen po sngar las lhag pa zhig thob grabs yod pa'i skabs su slebs dus ha cang blo pham dbos pa zhig la/ rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi nang tang gi snyan grags chen po yod pa de mi bzhi shog khag gis bed spyod byas te tang srid dmag gsum gyi dbang cha g.yo 'phrog thog mang tshogs la mgo skor btang nas kho pa jo'i g.yon thal lam phyogs spel ba dang / tang dang mang tshogs kha bral du gtong ba/ phyogs ris ring lugs dang srid gzhung med pa'i ring lugs spel ba/ mi rigs khag gi dmigs bsal thon rdzas dang / rig gzhung gtor brlag gtong ba bcas byas yod/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po zer ba'i nor 'khrul can gyi las 'gul de'i nang rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor dang / mi rigs khag gi rig gzhung slob gsor tshabs che ba'i gyong gun bsam yul las 'das pa phog yod/ gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og tu tang krung dbyang gis rgyal yongs mi dmangs la dbu khrid gnang nas ngan rgu tshang ba'i mi bzhi'i shog khag rtsa gtor btang zhing / bsam blo'i thog zing bcos yo bsrang byas te rang re'i tang gi phul byung srol bzang skyar gso byung ba red/ lhag par tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzom gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs nas rang rgyal yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong ba'i lam phyogs gtan 'khel gnang ba dang / krung dbyang nas bod kyi las don la mthong chen gnang ste yang dag pa'i mdzad phyogs srid jus rab dang rim pa gtan 'bebs gnang stabs bod ljongs 'di bzhin 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i dus skabs gsar pa zhig tu ba4skyod pa red/ 66

— — da —bod kyi dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byor gnas tshul la dpyad pa/bod kyi dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byor grub tshul ni/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgon pa'i dpal 'byor gnas tshul dang 'dra ba'i phyogs mang po yod pa'i thog bod sa gnas rang gi dmigs bsal khyad chos kyang yod par brten/ dgon pa'i dpal 'byor gyi grub tshul de bod sa gan/sa kyi dpal 'byor rten gzhi'i sum cha gcig tsam ni mchod gzhis dang / mi ser yod pa'i dgon pa khag gi lag tu bzung yod/ der brten nga tshos dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byor gnas tshul la brtag dpyad byed skabs sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgon pa spyi'i dpal 'byor grub tshul dang /bod du yod pa'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byor gnas tshul gnyis bsdur nas zhib 'jug byed dgos pa ma zad/ mchod gzhis mi ser med pa'i dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byor yong khungs dang /'tsho ba'i rten gzhi bcas la yang zhib 'jug dang dpyad bsdur byed dgos shing / zhib 'jug de 'dra byas pa brgyud nas skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor gnas stangs gal chen po zhig mthong thub pa yin/(1)rgya gar gyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byor gnas tshul/de sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs/67 rgyal

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsungartsomaphyogs bsgrigs /po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal dang / mnyan yod rgyal byed kyi tshal/ yangs pa can/ 'khrungs yul du na gro d+ma'i skyed tshal/ ko'u sham bi'i gdang can gyi kun dga' ra ba bcas lnga tsam yod/ dgon pa khag so sor ha cang thag mi ring zhing phan tshun gyi sgra mi thos pa'i sar lha 'bangs kyi mi ser sdod pa'i dud khyim yod pa dang / rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal gyi khongs gtogs lha 'bangs khyim dud lnga brgya yod tshul 〈 'dul ba lung gzhi'i 〉〉gnas mal gyi gzhi'i skabs su gsal zhing / 'tsho ba ni nyin re grong khyer gyi nang du bsod snyoms slong ba la brten dgos pa dang / dgon pa spyi'i dpal 'byor nang khag bzhi yod pa ste/ 1 sku gsung thugs rten gyi mchod pa dang / lha khang nyams gso sogs la gtong rgyu'i gras/ 2 chos gsung mkhan la chos lon 'bul rgyu'i khongs gtogs/ 3 dge 'dun spyi'i rdzas su bzhag nas bgo bsha' rgyag mi chog pa'i rigs/ 4 mang nyung gang 'dra yod kyang tshang mar cha mnyam du bgo dgos pa'i bgod rdzas kyi rigs bcas yin pa dang / de bzhi po phar bsgyur tshur bsgyur byed mi chog pa ma zad/ spyi rdzas tshong bsgyur dang / bu lon gtong ba/ skyed kha len pa/ gta' ma len pa sogs dge 'dun spyi'i don du byed chog pa las/sger gyi don du byed mi chog spyi rdzas do dam byed mkhan yang dge tshul dang /dge bsnyen ma gtogs dge slong gis gtan nas byed mi chog pa'i dpal 'byor lam lugs nan po yod pa dang / dus skabs der dgon pa khag la lha 'bangs yod kyang mchod gzhis sa zhing dang 'brog sde sogs med/nyin re dge slong dang dge tshul rnams nyin gung la grong khyer nang bsod 68

bod kyi dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byoraganasatshulaladapyadapa/ da wasnyoms la phebs pa ma gtogs gnas khang nang rgyu dngos dang / 'dzin chas sogs gang yang med/ mal chas dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad sna bcu gsum cha tshang ba re yod dgos pa phud/ de min lhag po yod na dge 'dun gyi don du yin pa'i bsam tshul bcang nas nyar chog pa las/ rang don du nyar ba dang bed spyod mi chog pa bcas yin/ skabs der rgya gar gyi rgyal khab chen po gnyis dang / grong khyer drug gi sa khul du gnas pa'i spyi tshogs lam lugs ni/ 'byor ldan khag gi khyim tshang gi bdag po shi rjes mi rgyud rjes ma'i bu yod na de tshor dbang ba dang / bu med na rgyu nor gang yod rgyal pos bsdus 'gro ba dang / zhing pa rnams nas rgyal por lo re'i ston 'bab thog nas drug cha'i khral bsdu ba'i lam lugs yod tshul sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi 'dul khrims gleng gzhi'i nang gsal por 'khod 'dugaskabs der rgya gar du thog mar dge slong chig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu las med pa nas sangs rgyas sku mya ngan las 'da' khar dge slong khri kha shas yod pa tshang ma'i 'tsho ba rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pas bsod snyoms 'bul bar brten nas 'tsho thub kyi yod pa red/ de rjes nas dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor dbyi si lan chos lugs ma dar bar du gzhi rtsa'i cha nas lugs srol der gnas/ dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor 622lor hra rti a rab rgyal khab kyi nub byang me carazer ba'i sa gnas su/ dbyi si lan chos lugs kyi ston pa mo han mo ti'am bod yig ma dha ma ti ri zer ba byung zhing /des dbyi si lan chos lugs gsar gtod byas pa nas 'dzam gling thog dbyi si lan chos srid zung 'brel gyi ngo bo ldan pa'i chos lugs shig chags 69

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/shing / de sngon nang pa'i chos lugs dang / mu stegs pa'i chos lugs dar ba'i sa gnas khag la btsan 'dzul byas te/ mthar rgya gar nub dang byang /dbus bcas kyi sa cha btsan bzung thog sa khul de dag tu yod pa'i chos lugs gzhan dag gi lha khang dang / chos gzhis phrogs pa'i gnas tshul nu byung yod/ rgya gar dang 'brel yod shis la rgyal khab kyi lo rgyus thog 'khod pa ltar na/ dus rabs bdun pa'i yas mas nas/ rgya gar du yod pa'i chos lugs tshang mar gzhi khyon nges can gyi lha 'bangs dang / mchod gzhis byung yod pa dang / 'bar ma dang / sing ga la sogs rgya gar shar phyogs dang / lho mtha'i nang dgon pa rnams sangs rgyas sku bzhugs dus dang 'dra bar bsod snyoms la brten nas 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod tshod red/grwa pa'i grangs 'bor thad nas bshad na/ sbyi lo'i dus rabs gsum pa'i yas mas nas dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i mjug bar rgya gar gyi dbus dang nub/ byang bcas kyi sa khul du grwa pa nyung du phyin yod kyang /rgya gar shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs rgyud du grwa grangs sngar las mang du song ba bcas cha snyoms byas na dus rabs lnga pa dang drug pa'i skabs rgya gar du grwa ba mang shos kyi skabs yin cing / de skabs dge slong pa ma dang /dge tshul pha ma bcas bsdoms na grwa pa'i 'bor grangs sa ya gnyis lhag tsam lon yod cing / de tsho'i 'tsho ba yang bsod snyoms la brten nas 'tsho ba spyod pa ma gtogs mchod gzhis dang / sems can 'brog thang bcas bdag bzung byed dgos pa'i dka' ngal thug med pa red/dus rabs bdun pa'i 'go nas dbyi si lan chos srid zung 'brel gyi 70

bod kyi dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byoraganasatshulaladapyadapa/da wa——— gestobs shugs a rab hril po dang / rgya gar nub byang brgyud nas rim bzhin rgya gar gyi sa khul phyed ka tsam la rgya bskyed byung stabs sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grwa pa rnams bsod snyoms la brten nas 'tsho ba skyel sa'i sa khul yong rdzogs dbyi si lan chos lugs kyis dbang sgyur byas stabs 'tsho ba'i thad la 'gan srung med par gyur te/ rgya gar shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs brgyud du gnas spos bya dgos byung ba ma zad/ sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa yod pa'i rgyal blon dang / 'byor ldan rnams kyis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dgon pa khag la mchod gzhis sa zhing dang / phyugs rigs 'brog thang lha 'bangs bcas zur du phul nas/ de sngon bsod snyoms la brten nas 'tsho ba skyel ba'i gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog ma gtang ka med byung yod/ dper na rgyal khab phyi nang du mtshan snyan grags che ba'i thang san bla ma rgya gar du phebs skabs/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gdan sa chen po na len+d+ra dgon pa spyi la lha 'bangs mi ser grong dud brgya tsam dang / sa zhing / nor phyugs 'brog thang bcas yod par ma zad/ paṇ+ḍi ta rim pa dang por lha 'bangs grong bcu yod pa nas rim pa bcu par lha 'bangs grong gsum yod pa'i bar gyi go gnas rim pa bcu yod tshul khong gis mdzad pa'i lam yig las gsungs par ma zad/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i rnam thar nang du'ang khong nalen+d+rar slob gnyer thog mar gnang dus na len+d+ra dgon pa'i phyugs rigs kyi gnyer pa lo shas gnang myong tshul gsal ba bcas la brtags na/ dgon par sa zhing dang / phyugs rigs/'brog thang bcas byung ba'i lo rgyus de bod tsam min par rgya gar du byung 7/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/myong ba dang / de yang sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo 1170lhag tsam song ba'i rjes su gzhi nas byung ba zhig yin cing / rgya gar shar phyogs kyi 'bar ma dang / lho phyogs kyi sing ga la bcas su da lta sangs rgyas bzhugs dus dang 'dra bar grong khyer du bsod snyoms slong bar brten nas 'tsho ba skyel ba'i srol rgyun ma nyams par gnas yod ces mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gsungs 'dug(2)bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byor gnas tshul skor/de las nang gses kyi dus rabs bzhi ru phye chog pa ste/1 bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rab byung thog mar byung ba nas rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku tshe'i mjug bar gyi dus rabs/2 btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis dgon pa lha khang dang / rab byung grwa btsun rnams la 'bangs mi ser khyim dud gsum re gnang ba nas/khri ral pa can gyis dgon pa lha khang dang / rab byung grwa btsun rnams la sa zhing dang / phyugs rigs/ 'brog thang bcas gnang rjes mthar btsan po'i srid dbang 'thor zhig tu song ba'i dus skabs/3 dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug tu bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs phyi dar mgo tshugs nas chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs ma byung bar gyi bar brgal dus skabs/sna4 yon rgyal rabs skabs bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs su gcig gyur byung zhing chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs 'go tshugs pa 72

bod kyi dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byor gnas tshul la dpyad pa/ —nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung rtsa med du song ba'i bar gyi dus skabs bcas yin/dus skabs dang po ni spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil du btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis srid dbang bskyangs skabs bod sa gnas su sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgon pa dang po bsam yas bzhengs pa nas/dus rabs brgyadartsopa'i dkyil du btsan po khri ral pa can gyis dgon pa 'ga' zhig la sa zhing / 'brog thang phyugs rigs bcas mchod rgyun du sprad pa'i bar gyi lo brgya ma zin tsam gyi dus skabs de yinari cing / de'i ring la dgon pa la mtshon na/ nang chos slob grwa khag bcu gnyis/ lha khang gsar rnying bsdoms pa'i bco brgyad/ sgom grwa che chung bsdoms pa'i bcu drug yod pa bcas bsdoms na dgon pa dang lha khang grangs bzhi bcu zhe drug de thog srong btsan skabs srong btsan rang gis bzhengs pa gtsug lag khang bco lnga/ khri lde gtsug brtan gyis bzhengs pa lnga dang / btsun mo rim byung gis bzhengs pa brgyad/ mchod gnas slob dpon rim byung gis bzhengs pa dgu btsan po'i gnyen mtshan rnams kyis bzhengs pa bco lnga/blon po rim byung gis bzhengs pa sum cu so lnga bcas bsdoms pa'i gtsug lag khang dang dgon pa grangs brgya dang sum cu so gsum yod (glang dar ma yan chad)pa dang / bsam yas dang mching phu/ yer dzi/ chu bo ri bcas dgon khag bzhi la grwa pa bsdoms na sum brgya dang lnga yod cing / de 'phros rnamasartsol cha snyoms kyi grwa pa brgya re yod par cha bzhag na grwa pa 'bor grangs chig stong brgya med sum bcu so gnyis yod par/ gong 73

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsal dgon khag bzhi'i grwa grangs thog tu bsnan na grwa pa chig stong sum rgya sum cu so bdun yod cing / de las mang ba yod mi srid/ dus skabs ཿde'i ring grwa pa dang / slob dpon/ slob ma bcas la lo rer rgyal po'i mdzod nas phogs thob sprod pa ma gtogs mchod gzhis sa zhing dang /phyug rigs/ 'brog thang sogs gang yang med cing / phogaso thob kyang rim pa mi 'dra bar gzhigs pa'i thob bya mang nyung gi tshad gzhi gtan 'bebs yod tshul 〈 sba bzhed 〉nang gsal ba ltar gong gsal grwa pa rnams la lo re cha snyoms kyi phogs thob nas /khal nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / mar khal bcu gcig dang srang sum cu tham pa re sprad pa'i dbang du byas na 'bru khal sum khri sum stong bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga dang /(deng sang gi rgya mar phab na rgya ma dgu 'bum sum khri lnga stong dgu brgya) mar khal bcu gcig dang srang sum cu tham pa/(deng sang gi rgya ma brgyad cu tham pa)grwa pa'i grangs kyis bsgyur ba'i thob grangs rgya ma chig 'bum khri med drug stong dgu brgya drug cu tham pa yin pas grwa pa'i grangs/ 'bor nyung nyung las med kyang / khong rnam par srid gzhung nas sprad dgos pa'i phogs kyi grangs 'bor tshad mthon po yin pas skabs de'i zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi chu tshad deng skabs dang bsdur na ha cang dma' po las med cing / btsan po'i srid gzhung dang zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyis dpal 'byor thog 'khur thub pa'i tshad las brgal yod/gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og bod la gsar du byung nas yun ring ma song ba'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grwa pa rnams dus rabs drug pa'i gong gi rgya gar dang 'dra bar grong khyer dang grong gseb du bsod snyoms slong bar brten 74

bod kyi dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byoraganasatshulaladapyadapa/ da wanas 'tsho ba skyel dgos sam/ yang na dus rabs bdun pa nas rgya gar du dar srol yod pa ltar sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgon pa dang grwa pa rnams la srid gzhung nas mchod gzhis sa zhing dang / nor phyugs/ 'brog thang bcas sprad nas 'gan gtsang byed du bcug dgos pa bcas kyi gnad don de lhag yod/'on kyang bod sa gnas su rgya gar dang 'dra bar sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grwa pa rnams bsod snyoms slong bar brten nas 'tsho ba skyes sa'i sa khul rgya po med/ gang yin zer na/ bod sa gnas su rang byung gi cha rkyen thad rgya gar dang mi 'dra bar ha cang zhan po yin pa dang / 'brog las thon skyed kyi rten gzhi rgya po med pa'i thog dngos zog nyo tshong gi brten sa gtso bo ni 'bru rigs la brten nas brje tshong byed dgos kyi yod pa dang / 'bru rigs thon skyed bya yul khyab che zhing zhing khul gyi dpal 'byor gnas tshul 'brog khul las legs pa yod pa dang / brjes tshong byed skabs 'bru rigs las mar gyi rin gong ldab gcig gis mtho ba yod pa ni da yod dpyad gzhi'i yig cha mang po zhig ṣ+kathog nas ra sprod byung yod/bod du yod pa'i grwa pa rnams bsod snyoms slong bar 'gro sa'i sa khul ni 'brog khul las zhing khul legs pa yod pas/ zhing khul du bsod snyoms la song na yang zla ba gsum lhag gi 'tsho ba'i 'gan srung byed mi thub pa ma zad/ dus rabs riyobyung gi srid gzhung dang / sger pa stobs 'byor can gang zhig yin kyang rgya gar dang 'dra bar lo mang po'i bar grwa pa 'bum phrag longs par 'tsho ba nar gtong byed thub pa'i stobs shugs yod mkhan 75

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gtan nas med stabs/ dgon pa dang grwa par srid gzhung gis mchod gzhis sa zhing dang / 'brog ra/ nor phyugs/ lha 'bangs mi ser bcas bdag bzung dbang cha sprad nas 'gan gtsang byed du bcug rgyu ma gtogs thabs shes gzhan med stabs/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi tshe smad nas bzung bya thabs de lag len bstar dgos byung yod/ de ni bod sa gnas kyi dgon pa dang / grwa pa khag gcig dpal 'byor thog nas zhing bdag gral rim du slebs rgyu'i cha rkyen gtso bo zhig tu gyur yod cing / 'on kyang de skabs chos srid bzung 'brel gyi lam lugs slebs rgyu'i cha rkyen yongs su 'dzoms med pa dang / bod sil bu'i dus rabs kyi mjug tu yon rgyal rabs kyis bod sa gnas sogs rgyal nang yongs rdzogs gcig gyur byed pa dang dus mtshungs chos srid gnyis ka'i dbang cha 'gro mgon 'phags pas bzung gnang mdzad pa nas bzung chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs byung ba bcas kyi skor nga rang gis bris pa'i ched rtsom gzhan dag nang bkod zin pas 'dir skyar du gleng rgyu min/(3)bod sa gnas su chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs dar nas rtsa med ma song bar gyi lo bdun brgya lnga bcu lhag tsam ring gi gnas tshul/dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i 'go nas bzung yon rgyal rabs dang /tā ming rgyal rabs/ man ching rgyal rabs bcas kyi ring bod sa gnas su/sa skya dang / phag gru/ rin spungs/ gtsang pa rgyal po/ dga' ldan pho brang bcas kyis lo grangs bdun brgya lnga bcu lhag tsam srid dbang bzung ba ma zad/ bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang 'pho 'gyur mang po byung yang / 76

bod kyi dgon pa khag gi dpal 'byoraganasatshulaladapyadapa/ da wachos srid gnyis ka'i dbang cha chos lugs kyi gtso 'dzin zhig gis bzung ba'i srid dbang zhig yin cing dgon pa mi nyung ba zhig la srid gzhung nas sprad pa'i chos srid gnyis ka'i khrims 'go rang btsan gyi dbang cha yod pa dang / dpal 'byor gyi rten gzhi yang / mchod gzhis sa zhing dang /'brog rwa/ nor phyugs/ mi ser bcas rgya chen po yod stabs bod sa gnas kyi dpal 'byor stobs shugs sum cha gcig tsam dgon pa stobs chen tsho'i lag tu bzung yod cing / de byings dgon pa mang che ba ni srid gzhung rim byung gis lo re bzhin sprod pa'i gtan 'jags chos phogs la brten nas 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod pa dang / dgon pa nyung shas zhig dbyar dus 'brog khul dang / ston dus zhing khul du bsod snyoms slong bar brten nas 'tsho ba skyel dgos kyi yod/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sku 'das rjes chos lugs ris med kyi dgon pa chig stong brgyad brgya bcu med bdun yod khongs su mchod gzhis mi ser yod pa'i dgon pa sum bcu so bdun las med cing / dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi grwa pa'i grangs 'bor nyis 'bum nyis khri chig stong bdun brgya bzhi bcu zhe gnyis tsam yod/(rnam thar du gsal)skabs der mchod gzhis mi ser yod pa'i dgon pa sum bcu so bdun la/ mi ser them grangs sum stong nyis brgya lnga bcu nga gcig yod// them grangs rer mi bzhi re yod par cha bzhag na mi grangs chig khri sum stong brgya med bcu med bzhi yin/ bod du dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur btang ba'i lo sngon ma bar mchod gzhis yod pa'i dgon pa'i grangs ldab gcig 'phar yod par 77gyi

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/cha gzhag na dgon pa bdun cu don bzhi las zin med pa dang / bod ljongs yongs kyi grwa pa'i bsdoms 'bor gong dus las ldab gcig 'phar yod par cha bzhag na grwa grangs bzhi 'bum bzhi khri sum stong bzhi brgya brgyad cu gya bzhi tsam zin dgos pa red/ 'on kyang / twa la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sku gshegs pa nas spyi lo 1958bar gyi dus skabs de'i ring mchod gzhis mi ser dang / phogs mthon po yod pa'i dgon pa stobs chen nyung shas zhig gis grwa grangs lo re las lo re 'phar yod pa las/dgon pa mang che ba'i grwa grangs ldab kha shas bar chag yod pa dang /dgon pa mang po zhig 'thor nas grong khyim du gyur yod/ der brten dgon pa mi 'thor ba'i ched grwa grangs gtan 'khel dang / bu gsum bar pa'i grwa khral gtan 'bebs bcas bzo dgos byung yod cing / 'on kyang grwa grangs nyung du 'gro ba ma gtogs tshad lon pa yong gi med pa red/gong gsal de dag gi thog nas bdag dbang mchod gzhis dang khongs gtogs mi ser bcas yod pa'i dgon pa'i dpal 'byor de khe gyong rang khur gyi 'gan gtsang dpal 'byor yin stabs grwa pa'i kha grangs mang du 'gro ba las nyung du 'gro gi med cing / phogs dang bsod snyoms tsam la brten dgos pa'i dgon pa rnams thabs shes ji ltar byas kyang grwa pa nyung du 'gro ba ma zad/ yod pa rnams kyang chos khrims gtsang ma srung mkhan zhig yong thub kyi med pa de red/ de ni da yod dgon pa khag la dus skabs dang mthun zhing / chos lugs kyi dgongs pa dang yang mthun thub pa'i bsgyur bcos bya dgos pa'i 'gag rtsa'i gnad don zhig tu gyur yod/ 78

—gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ljog byung tshul skor gleng ba/rang cag 'gro ba mi'i rigs rnams 'jig rten 'dir thog mar 'tsho gnas byung ba nas dus yun ring po'i 'phel 'gyur gyi lo rgyus nang spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed 'brel ba dma' rim nas mtho rim bar rim bzhin gong 'phel phyin pa dang chabs cig yul lung dang sa gnas phan tshun bar thon rdzas brje 'tshong byed pa'i bya gzhag dar rgyas byung ba brgyud/khyab khongs de las brgal te mi rigs phan tshun dang rgyal khab phan tshun bar dngos zog brje res kyi tshong don 'brel ba rgya cher phyin te/ dngos zog gi rin thang dang mnyam pa'i brje len gyi tshad gzhi 'jal ba'i 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi nges tshad dang / tshab byed dngul sgor/ dngos zog skyel 'dren gyi lam thag ring thung 'jal ba'i 'dom tshad/ dngos po'i mtho dman dang ring thung 'jal ba'i sor tshad/ 'grim 'grul gyi kha phyogs ston pa'i phyogs ston brda rtags sogs kyi tshad gzhi nges can byung zhing / tshad gzhi de dag kyang thog mar rags pa tsam dang stabs bde can yin pa nas rim bzhin zhib tshags je che dang / rnam grangs je mang /spus tshad je mthor song ba sha stag yin/ tshad gzhi de dag gi nang nas yul thon dngos zog brje 'tshong la nges par du gal che ba'i 'jadhi py-ishor

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'degs gsum ni thog mar sa gnas dang sa khul gyi khyad chos ldan pa zhig yin stabs tshad gzhi 'dra min sna tshogs zhig las khyab che ba'i gcig gyur zhig yong thub kyi med cing / de yi tshad gzhi gcig gyur bya rgyu ni srid 'dzin gyi khyab khongs rgya che tsam yod pa'i srid gzhung zhig gi khrims srol gcig gyur bzo rgyu dang thad kar 'brel ba yod pa ma zad/ mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi dngos po'i khe phan dang yang 'brel ba dam po yod/ der brten sa gnas dang mnga' khongs phan tshun bar 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi gcig gyur med pa des thon rdzas brje res thad stabs bde med pa'i thog dngos zog gi tshab byed dngul sgor gyi rin thang mtho ba'i sa khul dang / mi rigs/ rgyal khab bcas la khe bzang chen po thob kyi yod pa dang / dngul sgor gyi rin thang dma' ba'i mi rigs dang / rgyal khab bcas la tshong don dang dpal 'byor thog gyong gun chen po phog gi yod/ de'i 'byung rtsa ngo ma ni 'dzam gling thog gi lcags rigaṭa kyi dngos po'i nang nas gser ni dus yun ji tsam ring po song yang spus tshad dang ngo bo mi 'gyur ba'i gtan 'jags rin po che zhig yin par brten dngos zog gi tshab byed dngul sgor gyi ma rtsa blos 'khel shos shig yin cing / rgyal khab dang mi rigs su zhig yin kyang rang nyid kyi mdzod khang nang gser gsog 'jog gi tshad mthon po yod na so so'i srid gzhung gis bton pa'i dngul sgor gyi rin thang mtho zhing / dpal 'byor thog stobs shugs che ba'i go gnas rgyun 'khyongs byed thub kyi yod pa dang / gal te so so'i mdzod khang nang gser gsog 'jog gi tshad 80

gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degasagasumaskoraglengabad/ wad —dma' po yin pa'i gnas tshul 'og dngul sgor mang po bton drags na khrom ra'i zog gong ldab gcig nas ldab kha shas bar 'phar te/ dngos po'i khe phan longs su spyod mkharno dang dngos zog nyo mkhan la dpal 'byor thog gi gyong gun chen po phog rgyu ma zad/ dngos zog gi rin sgong ji tsam mtho ru phyin pa de tsam gyis srid gzhung gis/ gton pa'i dngul sgor gyi rin thang dma' ru phyin te dngul bun (zug )po'i tshad gzhi mtho ru 'gro gi red/ dper na bod sil bu'i dus skabs su bod kyi sa gnas 'ga' zhig nas gser gyi gter kha mang po thon yod kyang / skabs der gsar du dar ba'i chos lugs grub mtha' khag gi dgon pa dang / srid gzhung /tshogs pa bcas khag gis bod kyi sa gnas gang sar gser bed spyod byed pa'i tshad gzhi mtho ba ma zad/ bod nas rgya gar dang / bal yul/ kha che bcas la slob sbyong du phebs mkhan gyi lo tsā ba snga rjes bsdoms brgya dang lnga bcu lhag tsam byung ba rnams phyi rgyal du slob sbyong gnang nas bzhugs yun cha snyoms kyis lo dgu dang / lo re'i slob yon dang gron dngul cha snyoms kyis gser srang brgyad cu btang bar cha bzhag na/ mi res lo re gser srang bdun brgya nyi shu tham pa gtong dgos shing / de nyid lo tsā ba'i mi grangs kyis bsgyur ba'i thob nor gser srang chig 'bum khri med brgyad stong tham pa thob kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang de 'gro gron gyi tshad gzhi dma' shos zhig gi dbang du byas pa'i grangs kha tsam zhig yin pa las/ don dngos su grangs 'bor de las mang ba yod pa ni/ skabs de'i lo tsā ba mang po'i rnam thar nas tshod dpag byed thub pa lta bu red/ der brten 8/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dus skabs so so'i nang rgya gar dang / bod sa gnas kyi 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhir 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ba gang byung skor bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang rnams la rang nyid kyi lta tshul dpyad gzhi'i tshul du gleng rgyur don tshan gsum ste/1 gna' rabs bod sa gnas su 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad la 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ba gang byung skor/ 2 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi ngo sprod dang gsal bshad/ 3 bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degs gsum dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad don 'ga' zhig gi gsal bshad bcas yin/dang po/ gna' rabs bod sa gnas su 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad la 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ba gang byung skor/rang rgyal gyi lo rgyus thog skad grags yod pa'i gong ma chin hri hong gis spyi lo'i sngon gyi 221lor krung go yongs rdzogs gcig gyur byas pa'i srid dbang btsugs rjes/ dngul sgor dang / shing rta 'khor lo'i lam gyi zheng tshad/ 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi (rgya ma dang tan phud )bcas gcig gyur bzos yod cing / rang re'i bod ljongs su ni da yod bod yig gi lo rgyus yig cha yongs grags rnams kyi nang / dus rabs drug pa'i 'gor btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i mes po stag ri gnyan gzigs kyis srid dbang bzung skabs bre phul srang sogs kyi 'jal tshad gsar 82

gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degasagasumaskoraglengab/ da da gtod byas par bshad yod cing / de ni btsan po stag ri gnyan gzigs kyis srid dbang khyab khongs su gtogs pa'i lho kha sa khul gcig pur 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi nges can zhig gsar gtod byas pa'i don yin pa dang / bod sa gnas yongs khyab kyi 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi gcig gyur ni/ btsan po srong btsan sgam pos dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ sum pa'i ru dang bcas pa'i mnga' khongs gcig gyur gyi srid dbang stobs ldan zhig btsugs rjes/ 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi gcig gyur gyi khrims srol thog mar bzos pa de la 'bum gser thog sha ba can gyi khrims zhes thogs pa yin tshul 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉nang gsal ba ma zad/ 〈 tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus rgyal rabs 〉dum bu kha pa'i nang du yang 'di ltar/bod kyi gtsug lag bka' khrims chen po dang / blon po'i rim pa dang /che chung gnyis kyi dbang thang dang / legs pa'i bya dga'/ nyes pa'i chad pa/ zhing 'brog gi thul ka dang dor ka bre phul dang srang la sogs pa bod kyi chos kyi gzhung bzang po kun/ btsan po khri srong btsan gyi ring la byung ngo / /zhes 'khod yod/ de nas btsan po khri ral pa can gyi skabs bod sa gnas su sngar yod 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi la bsgyur bcos mdzad tshul skor 〈 sba bzhed 〉kyi rjes su byung ba'i bod kyi lo rgyus snga shos kyi gras yin pa'i 〈 mnga' bdag nyang gyichos 'byung 〉zhes dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i dus dkyil du mnga'abadag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis mdzad pa de yi bod yig lcags dpar ma'i grangs 453 5las btsan po 83

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/khri ral pa can gyi lo rgyus thad 'di ltar/ tha na bre dang / srang dang / zho la sogs pa rgya dkar po ma gha dha dang bstun nas 'on cang rdo dang skyid shod kyi sho ma rar (mdo khul )gtan la phab ces gsal ba des skabs der chos lugs thog nas 'brel ba che shos rgya gar yin stabs de'i dgos mkho dang bstun na phan tshun gnyis kar stabs bde yong rgyur dgongs nas gtan 'bebs de 'dra gnang ba red/ rgya gar ma gha dha'i 'jal gshor 'degs gsum dang bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degs gsum bar khyad par ji yod gsham gsal don tshan gnyis pa'i nang gleng rgyu/de nas bod sil bu'i dus skabs su zhing 'brog thon skyed dang /lag shes bzo las/ tshong las bcas gong 'phel chen po byung yod kyang /bod sa gnas gtso bor byas pa'i sa khul khag badhu gsum la srid dbang stobs shugs mi 'dra ba re kha thor du gnas pa'i dbang gis sa gnas so sor 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi sna tshogs chags te/ 'bru rigs phul drug la bre gang du rtsis pa'i drug phul ma dang / phul bdun la bre gang du rtsi ba'i bdun phul ma zhes mi 'dra ba gnyis dang / gser gyi srang tshad kyang gser se ba nyi shu la gser zho gang du rtsi ba'i dbus zho dang /gser se ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi la gser zho gang du rtsi ba'i tshong 'dus mgur mo'i mgur zho/ gser se ba nyi shu rtsa lnga la gser zho gang du rtsi ba'i gzhung zho/ gser se ba sum cu so gnyis la gser zho gang du rtsi ba'i gser zho/gser se ba sum cu so drug la gser zho gang du rtsi ba'i lha sa'i byes zho bcas mi 'dra ba lnga tsam byung zhing / de'i nang nas tshong dus mgur mo'i 84

gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degasagasumaskoraglengab /de —— da zho tshad de bod sil bu'i dus skabs su dbus gtsang mnga' ris bcas kyi sa gnas mang che bar gcig gyur gyis lag bstar byas pa'i tshad ldan 'o tshad yin/ de nas dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i mjug tu yon rgyal rabs kyis bod sa gnas su dbang bsgyur byed skabs/ de sngon btsan po khri ral pa can gyis gtan 'khel gnang ba'i 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi mu mthud lag bstar byas yod pa ni/1361lor phag gru sde srid mi rabs dang po tā si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈 bka' chems 〉lcags dpar ma'i grangs 146 12par 'di ltar/ rta rab la dngul bre re/ dngul bre rer gser srang brgyad yin/ zhes gsal ba de yin/ de yang dngul bre gang la gser srang brgyad dang / de ni gser bre phyed kyi tshad yin cing /gser bre gang la gser srang bcu drug gi ljid tshad yod pa dang / de la dngul bre do ste dngul srang sum cu so gnyis yin pa'i srang tshan de la/gser se ba drug cu re bzhir gser zho gang du rtsi ba'i zho tshad de ma gtogs/zho tshad gzhan dag ltar byas nas rtsi na gser bre dang dngul bre'i lngid tshad la chad lhag yong ba mngon sum gyis grub pa de yi thog nas ra sprod byed thub/'bru rigs kyi gshor tshad ni ma gha dha'i bre chung gang la bod kyi phul drug ma'i dbang du byas na bre do dang / phul bdun ma'i dbang du byas na bre do dang khyor ba gang yod pa red/ de nas spyi lo 1632lor gtsang pa sde srid ka rma bstan skyong gis srid dbang bzung skabs bod sa gnas kyi bre tshad la phul drug ma dang / phul bdun ma sna tshogs zhig dang / 85

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mkhar khal gyi 'bo'i tshad kyang che chung mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa des zhing 'brog gnyis kyi thon rdzas brje 'tshong dang / gzhung gis dpya khral bsdu len skabs mang tshogs la stabs bde med pa'i rtsod gleng yang yang yong gi yod pa thag gcod byed ched/ phyin chad bod sa gnas su bre tshad phul drug ma dang / bre nyi shu tham pa la mkhar khal gang du rtsi ba'i tshad ldan gyi mkhar bre dang / mkhar 'bo gzhung tham 'byar ma zhig gtan 'bebs byas pa de la gtan tshigs mkhar tu zer zhing / de nas bzung bod du dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma byas bar du dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sa gnas phal che bar lag bstar rgyun 'khyodas byas yod pa red/ de nas man ching rgyal rabs skabs ching gong ma'i srid gzhung gis tā la'i bla mas gtso bo gnang ba'i bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang stobs shugs do dam byed ched bka' shag srid gzhung dngos su btsugs pa ma zad/bod sa gnas kyi nor srid la rogs skyor gyi dngul rta rmig ma phon chen lo ltar sprod kyi yod pa gnas skabs su phan thogs che tsam byung yang / sa gnas kyi tshong zog brje res kyi thad la ha cang stabs bde med pa'i khar/dbus gtsang khul du 'gro rgyugs byed mus kyi bal ṭam la yang gsar rnying gnyis yod pa de nas rnying pa'i spus tshad cung legs tsam yod rung /bal ṭam gsar par lhad bsres mang ba'i thog gsar rnying gnyis ka'i rin thang 'dra mtshungs 'gro rgyugs dgos rgyu'i skabs de'i bal po'i srid gzhung nas re ba shugs che bton pa des bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs la gyong gun 86

gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degasagasumaskoraglengab/ da da chen po btang ba ma zad/ de la ngo rgol byed par bsnyad btags nas bod sa gnas su btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrugs kyang bslangs pa 'i 9jags btang rjes/ gob ma chen lung gis bod sa gnas su dngul sgor lugs bzo byed dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar/ 1792lor rim bzhin bong dngul zho gang skar lnga dang / zho gang / zho phyed sogs kyi dngul sgor snga rjes su bton pa ma zad/ sngar gser dngul zho brgyad la srang gang du rtsi ba'i srol der bsgyur bcos byas te/ zho bcu la srang gang du rtsi ba'i bcu srang gi lam lugs bzos te/ mes rgyal nang sa dang bod sa gnas kyi dngul sgor lam lugs gcig gyur yong ba byas pa ni gser dngul sgor mo'i rin thang thog gi bcos bsgyur chen po zhig red/ gong gsal rnams gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degs gsum thad la yar rgyas dang 'gyur ldog byung ba'i lo rgyus rags bsdus tsam yin cing / da dung 'di skor las 'phros pa'i gleng bya mang du mchis kyang skabs su ma babs pas re zhig de tsam gyis 'thus par byas so/ /gnyis pa/ 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi ngo sprod dang gsal bshad/ 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi nang tshan 'jal tshad de la/ 'grim 'grul gyi lam thag ring thung dang / 'bur thon dngos po'i dkyus zheng ring tshad dang mtho dman gyi tshad/ srid du ring ba'i snam bu dang thag pa sogs kyi ring tshad bcas 'jal skabs/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung 87

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/〈 mngon pa mdzod 〉nas bshad pa ltar rtsi dgos shing / de la tshad gzhi dma' rim nas mtho rim bar rnam grangs bcu drug yod pa ste/ 1 rdul phra rab/ 2 rdul phran/ 3 lcags rdul/ 4 chu rdul/ 5 ri bong rdul/ 6 lug rdul/ 7 glang rdul/ 8 nyi zer gyi rdul/ 9 sro ma/10 shig 11 nas/ 12 sor/ 13 khru/ 14 'dom/15 rgyang grags/ 16 dpag tshad bcas yod/ de yang rdul phra rab bdun la rdul phran gcig rdul phran bdun la lcags rdul gcig lcags rdul bdun la chu rdul gcig chu rdul bdun la ri bong gi rdul gcig (ri bong gi spu'i rtse mor chags pa'i rdul) ri bong gi rdul bdun la lug rdul gcig (lug gi spu'i rtse mor chags pa'i rdul) lug rdul bdun la glang rdul gcig (glang gi spu'i rtse mor chags pa'i rdul) glang rdul bdun la nyi zer gyi rdul gcig(khang pa'i nang gi skar khung nas nyi 'od phog pa dang du ba srab mos khyab nas yod skabs nyi zer nang rdul phran khri phrag mang po steng 'og phyogs bzhir 'khor bskyod byed pa rang re'i mig gis mthong rgyu yod pa de yin) de 'dra'i nyi zer gyi rdul gcig gi nang rdul phra rab brgyad 'bum nyis khri sum stong lnga brgya bzhi bcu zhe gsum yod ces/ bstan 'gyur pod nya pa'i nang gi 〈 lhag mthong bskyed pa'i thabs cung zad bris pa 〉zhes kha byang du 'khod pa las 'grel bshad re'u mig dang bcas pa bkod 'dug dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug tu deng sang lta bu'i phra mthong che shel med pa'i gnas tshul 'og nyi zer gyi rdul gcig gi nang rdul phra rab kyi grangs 'bor ji tsam yod pa'i gsal bshad byed thub pa ni ha cang ngo mtshar che ba zhig red/ nyi zer gyi 88

gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degasagasumaskoraglengab/ da da rdul bdun la sro ma gcig sro ma bdun la shig gcig shig bdun la nas 'bru gcig nas 'bru che chung snyoms pa bdun 'phred du bsgrigs pa'i ring tshad la sor gang / sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi la khru gang / khru bzhi la 'dom gang / 'dom lnga brgya la rgyang grags gcig rgyang grags brgyad la dpag tshad gcig bcas su rtsi ba yin/ gong gsal gyi khru dang 'dom la sogs pa'i tshad gzhi de rnams deng sang gi le dbar dang spyi le bcas phan tshun bsdur na 'di lta ste/ dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor byon pa'i thang rgyal rabs kyi slob dpon paṇ+ḍi ta thang san tsang gis mdzad pa'i 〈 rang rnam rgya gar zhing gi bkod pa'i dkar chag 〉rgya yig nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba las 'dir bkod pa'i rgyang grags ni rgya yi le dbar yin zhes mchan 'god gnang 'dug pa de ltar na/ skabs de'i le dbar dang deng sang gi spyi le gnyis tshad gzhi mnyam pa yin 'dug pa ma zad/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i 〈 gtam rgyud gser gyi thang ma 〉las/slob dpon thang san tsang gis rgya gar gnas yig nang bkod pa'i rgya gar gyi gnas chen khag dang / grong khyer che khag phan tshun bar gyi lam thag ring thung rgyang grags dang / dpag tshad sogs kyi thog nas zhib phra gsungs pa rnams ha cang tho gtugs thub pa 'dug ces gsungs pa nas ra sprod byung yod/ gong gsal rgyang grags 'jal byed tshad gzhi'i 'dom gang zhes pa ni lus gzugs tshad ldan gyi mi'i 'dom gang ste/ de la deng sang gi spyi khre gnyis yod cing / 'dom lnga brgya la spyi khre chig stong ste spyi le gcig dang mnyam mo/ /'on kyang deng skabs dpar bskrun byas pa'i 〈 8 9

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo 〉stod cha grangs 542rgyang grags zhes pa'i rgya yig gi 'grel bshad thad/ de hri khre nyis brgya lnga bcu'i tshad dang mnyam zhes gsal ba yig nor yin te/ de ltar byas na hri khre gcig la 'dom gnyis yod dgos pa dang / hri khri gsum la spyi khre gcig tu rtsi dgos pa yongs grags yin pas/ spyi khri gcig la 'dom drug yod dgos par 'gyur zhing / spyi khre gang la 'dom drug lta ci 'dom gang yang longs med pa mngon sum gyis grub pas gong gsal gyi bshad tshul der yo bsrang bya dgos pa lags/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi 'dul ba'i gzhung 'ga' zhig las/ 'dom lnga la srog shing gcig srog shing nyi shu la ngal gso gcigangal gso brgyad cu la rgyang grags gcig ces bshad pa ltar na/ rgyang grags gcig la 'dom brgyad stong yod pa dang / 〈 dus 'khor 〉las gzhu 'dom nyis stong la rgyang grags gcig tu rtsi ba sogs sna tshogs yod kyang / bod kyi lo rgyus dang rgyun srol thog rgya khyab tu lag len bstar ba ni 〈 mngon pa mdzod 〉kyi lugs de yin cing / deng skabs bod kyi rgyun srol tshad gzhi dang / deng sang gi 'dzam gling spyi srol gnyis ka lag bstar byed kyi yod/ 'bru rigs sogs sil bur spungs pa'i dngos po rnams shong tshad 'jal ba'i bre dang phul sogs la brten nas 'jal dgos pa ste/ nas 'bru skam po che ba gnyis dang / 'bring ba gnyis/ chung ba gnyis bcas drug shong ba'i kham tshog gang la kham phusmyopa gang / kham phul drug la star kha'i phyi pags phyed bcad ma gang ste star phul gang/ star phul drug ste khyim 90

gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degs gsum skor gleng ba/ —bya'i sgong pags phyed bcad ma gang gi shong tshad la sgong phul gang sgong phul drug ste lag pa ya gcig gi khyor ba'i nang du shong tshad la ya khyor gang ngam mkhar phul gang /(ya khyor nyi shu rtsa gcig la phul gang du rtsi ba ni phul bdun la bre gang du rtsi ba'i lugs yin ) mkhar phul drug la mkhar bre gang/ mkhar bre nyi shu la mkhar khal gang du rtsi ba yin/ khams khul sde dge dang / brag g.yab sogs sa gnas 'ga' zhig la mkhar khal gcig gi tshad gzhi dbus gtsang khul dang gcig mtshungs yin kyang / khal gcig gi gzhi 'dzin sa'i cha shas chung ba rnams kyi ming dang tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa ni/ phul gang yan chad gong dang 'dra ba la phul gsum la nas 'dong gang zer zhing / nas 'dong bcu la zho gang / zho bzhi la khal gcig tu rtsi srol yod pa ma gtogs bre zhes pa'i tha snyad 'bod kyi med/ mtha' mtshams sa khul gyi mon pa dang / lho pa sogs so so'i 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi ji 'dra yin min da phan dpyad gzhi ma mthong bas 'dir bris med lags/gong gsal bod kyi bre khal tshad gzhi dang rgya gar ma gha dha'i bre tshad bar gyi khyad par ni/ 'bras bzang shos phul gang la rgyal nang gi rgya thur gyis gzhal skabs/ thur srang gsum dang zho drug skar lnga tsam thob pa gzhir bzung na 'bras phul bdun la srang nyi shu rtsa lnga dang zho drug byung zhing /de ni rgya gar ma gha dha'i bre chung ba gang gi tshad yin/ de cha bcu drug tu bgos pa'i cha gcig la srang gang dang zho drug byung ba de rgya gar ma gha dha'i srang gi tshad yin pa rigs pas grub pas/ ma gha dha'i srang gang la bod kyi 9/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/srang gang zho drug yod pa ra sprod byed thub/('di yang rgyal nang gi thur srang dang ma gha dha'i srang tshad gnyis bsdur nas bshad pa ma gtogs/ 'bru rigs sogs thur srang la brten nas 'jal gshor byed kyi yod ces bshad pa min) ja dang rtsam pa phyur ba sogs yang ba'i rigs mang po zhig ni nas 'bru drug gi ljid tshad la se ba gang dang/ se ba nyi shu la zho gang / zho bcu la bre gang ste spor gang ngam srang gang yang zer/ srang bzhi la nyag gang /srang brgyad bcu tham pa la khal gcig tu rtsi srol yod pa ni gser dngul sogs kyi ljid 'degs srang tshad dag mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yin/srang la 'degs dgos pa'i dngos po lci ba'i rigs ni/ gser/dngul/ zangs/ lcags/ rag khro sogs ste/ de rnams srang la 'degs pa'i ljid tshad rnamasagaser srang gi ljid 'degs tshad gzhi ltar rtsi dgos pa ste/ de yang mgron bu nyi shu tham pa'i ljid tshad la ka ka ni gcig(ka ka ni zhes pa bal sran nam yongs grags su dmar tu mgo nag zer )dmar tu gnyis kyi ljid tshad la gser se ba gang / gser se ba gnyis dang ka ka ni bzhi yi ljid tshad mnyam pa de la gser skar ma gang ste/ de la rgya gar skad du ma sha ka zer zhing / bod kyi brda rnying pa 'ga' zhig gi nang nam gcig zer ba de yin/ gser skar ma lnga 'am/ nam lnga/ ma sha lnga smu kar sha pa ṇa'i bzhi cha gcig de la gser se ba bcu yod/(gser skar ma nyi shu tham pa ste gser zho bcu la gser srang gang du rtsi ba ni/ bod dngul ṭam dkar thon pa'i rjes kyi srang tshad yin pas 'dir de ma bris lags ) gser skar ma bcu drug ste se ba sum cu so gnyis la kar sha pa ṇa ste gser zho brgyad kyi ljid tshad yod pa'i gser ṭam gcig ste/ de la gser srang gang zer/ gser srang brgyad la 92

gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degasagasumaskoraglengab/ da gser bre phyed yin cing / de la dngul srang bcu drug yod/ gser srang bcu drug la gser bre gang zer zhing / de la dngul srang sum cu so gnyis te/ dngul bre do yod/ dngul srang bcu yod pa'i dngul lugs ma la bcu khog gcig dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa'i dngul lugs ma rta mig gi gathugs la de la rta rmig ma gcig dngul srang lnga bcu yod pa'i dngul lugs maklerta rmig gzugs la dngul bre chen gcig zer ba ni yon rgyal rabs skabs kyi dngul bre'i ljid 'degs kyi tshad gzhi yin/gser dngul sogs kyi lcags rigs phud pa'i sha dang / mar/ bal/rnga ma sogs kyisrang 'degs tshad gzhi ni/ nas 'bru che ba gnyis/ 'bring ba gnyis/ chung ba gnyis bcas drug bsdoms pa'i ljid tshad la se ba gang /se ba nyi shu tham pa la 'degs zho gang / 'degs zho bcu la srang gang ste spor gang yang zer/ srang bzhi 'am spor bzhi la nyag gang / nyag nyi shu tham pa ste srang brgyad cu tham par khal gcig tu rtsi srol yod cing / 'di rigs la se ba nyi shu ma'i zho tshad dang / srang brgyad cu ma'i khal ma gtogs gzhan dag rtsi srol mi 'dugayang khrims khang gi nyes khrims srang 'degs kyi gzhi ni/ tshong 'dus mgur mo'i gser zho brgyad la srang gang du brtsi ba'i srang tshad dang /se ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi ma'i zho tshad ma gtogs zho tshad gzhan dag rtsi srol mi 'dug pa bcas kyi zhib cha yod/gsum pa/ bod kyi 'jal gshor7degs gsum dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad don 'ga' zhig gi gsal bshad/ 93

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gong gsal gser dngul gyi ljid 'degs tshad gzhi'i nang gses kar sha pa ṇa zhes pa'i skor/ lo shas sngon du bod kyi rig rtsal dang / lo rgyus ched rtsom 'ga' zhig nang / rgya gar skad kyi kar sha pa ṇa zhes pa bod skad du mgron bu zhes 'bod pa yin tshul dang / thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs skabs rgya gar du mgron bu la dngul gyi tshab byed pa ma gtogs/ de dus gser dngul sogs lcags rigs kyi sgor mo thon med ces bris 'dug pa don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i shod tshul ma dag rgyun 'byams byung ba zhig yin te/ 〈'dul ba lung gzhi 〉las dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu gtan 'bebs gnang skabs/ dge slong zhig gis gser dngul las byas pa'i dngul sgor nyar tshags byas pa'i gleng gzhi la brten nas/ mngon mtshan can gyi gser dngul sgor mo nyar mi chog pa'i bca' khrims mdzad tshul gsal por 'khod yod pas skabs de dus nas gser dngul las bzos pa'i kar sha pa ṇa byung zin par gsal bshad byas par ma zad/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i mgor byon pa'i rgya gar gyi slob dpon dge legs bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 〈 'dul ba lung gzhi'i 'grel pa 〉dang / 〈lung zhu ba'i 'grel pa 〉bod skad du bsgyur ba las/ kar sha pa ṇa ni/ zong gi khyad par ste dngul las byas pa gzugs dod pa btsong tu rung ba yin no/ /zhes gsal ba ltar/ rgyu cha dngul se ba so gnyis las bzos pa'i dngul ṭam dang dngul zho gang las bzos pa'i dngul ṭam sogs sna tshogs yod thog dngul ṭam gyi steng du yul gyi rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan dang / rgyal 94

gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degasagasumaskoraglengab/ da khab mtshon pa'i rtags mtshan sogs zong brkos byas pa zhig la mngon mtshan can zhes 'bod pa yin tshul 'dul ba'i 'grel pa mang po'i nang 'khod pa ma zad/ rgya yi slob dpon chen po thang san tsang rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar nang / skabs der rgya gar byang phyogs kyi ne pa la rgyal khab dang / rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rdo 'jog thur cis/ bcom brlag sogs mang po zhig la gser dngul gyi ṭam kha dang zangs ṭam bcas yod tshul dang / thang san tsang rang nyid rgya gar nas rgyal nang du phyir phebs gnang skabs rgya gar gyi rgyal po shi har ṣa (shri har+ṣa )ste mtshan gzhan tshul khrims nyi mar 'bod pa des phebs rdzongs rgya chen po phul ba'i nang /gser ṭam khri/ dngul ṭam sum khri sogs yod par gsungs 'dug pas mgron bus dngul gyi tshab byed pa'i dus tshod yol nas lo chig stong lhag song zin par gsal bshad byung yod/yang de sngon bod sa gnas su phag gru dang / gtsang pa sde srid/dga' ldan pho brang pa bcas kyis srid dbang bzung skabs/ nyes khrims gcod pa'i nyes 'gal gser srang zhes pa'i tha snyad 'dug pa de ni/ dus skabs so so'i khrims yig ngo ma'i nang / tshong 'dus mgur mo'i mgur zho zhes gser se ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi la gser zho gang du rtsi ba'i 'degs zho de la zer ba dang / de yang dngos po gang yin gyi yul srol rin thang gi cha bzhir phye ba'i bzhi cha gcig bcag nas lenaspol yod pa 'bras ljongs rgyal po bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyis sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshor khrims srol skor la dri ba zhus pa'i lan gyi nang gsolapor 'khod 'dug kyang / 95

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/deng skabs kyi ched rtsom 'ga' zhig nang / nyes pa gser srang gang la bod dngul srang dgu dang zho drug yin zhes gsal ba ltar na/ nyes pa gser srang grangs la dngul gyi srang grangs ldab dgu dang zho drug thob kyi 'dug pa de ni sngon dus phag gru sde srid dang / gtsang pa/ dga' ldan pho brang bcas kyi thog ma'i dus skabs dang mi 'dra bar bod sa gnas su gser dkon du song ba dang / gser gyi rin thang ldab kha shas 'phar bar brten/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mjo'i khrims yig nang gsal ba'i nyes 'gal gser srang gi tshad gzhi de bod sa gnas su dngul sgor lugs bzo byas rjes go mi chod pa chags pa zhig yin nam snyam/phyogs mtshungs dngul sgor gsar rnying brje len byas nas rnying pa bsdus te gsar pa 'grems spel bya thabs skor/ sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈 rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar 〉las/ phal che ba la grags pa ni/ bsod nor 'dod pa gang dag gis mnga' ris su gtogs so cog gi bu lon rgyal pos sbyangs nas/sngar zong du spyod pa rnams bor te/ zong gsar pa la rang gis ming du btags nas spyod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs 'dug pa/ 'di'i nang gsal ba'i sngar zong du spyod pa rnams bor te/ zhes pa dngul sgor rnying pa mi dgos pa bzos pa'i don dang / zong gsar pa zhes pa gsar du bton pa'i dngul sgor la zer ba yin zhing / dngul sgor rnying pa mi dgos pa byas nas gsar pa 'grems spel bya thabs ni gsar rnying brje len bya rgyu de yin pa dang / brje len byed skabs dngul sgor rnying pa'i bu lon len rgyu yod 96

gna' rabs bod kyi 'jal gshor 'degasagasumaskoraglengab/ da pa rnams gsar pa dang rin thang mnyam pa'i brje len byas na dngul sgor gsar pa 'grems spel byas kyang de la rin thang gi stobs shugs che ba bzung mi thub pa'i rkyen gyis dngul sgor rnying pa'i rin thang shugs che tsam bcag nas de'i thad nas spyi 'bangs la gyong gun phog pa dang bun bdag la gyong gun phog pa rnams yul gyi rgyal pos gun gsab ldang nges sprad pa'i don yin/ dngul sgor sngar yod kyi nus pa shor ba'i cha rkyen gnyis yod pa ste/gcig ni khrom ra'i thog zog gong ldab kha shas 'phar ba dang / dngul sgor gsar pa 'don spel gyi ma rtsa ldeng nges med par dngul sgor mang po bton par brten srid gzhung dang / spyi 'bangs la bu lon gyi khur po chen po yod pa sel ma thub pa bcas ni da yod dngul sgor gyi rin thang nus pa shor ba de yin cing / de min gyi rgyu rkyen gzhan gcig ni srid gzhung snga ma'i dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs nyams pa dang chabs cig srid dbang sngar bzhin gnas thabs med par gyur pa ni srid gzhung gis bton pa'i dngul sgor la nus pa med pa chags nges yin cing / de skabs srid gzhung gsar pa btsugs te dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs bskyar gso dang /dngul sgor gsar pa 'don thabs byas na dngul sgor rnying pa'i nus pa rang shugs su rtsa med 'gro ba de red/ de skabs dngul sgor gsar rnying brje ba'i 'gag gnad gtso bo ni/ dngul sgor gsar rnying brje ba'i bar du spyi 'bangs dang / bun bdag rnams la gyong gun phog pa der srid gzhung gsar pas kha gsab rogs skyor ldeng nges zhig sprod pa'i dpal 97

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'byor stobs shugs yod med la thug yod pa de red/ der brten khrom ra'i zog gong 'phar bar tshod 'dzin nan po ma byas par rgya yan du btang na mtha' mjug tu rgyal khab dang spyi 'bangs tshang mar dpal 'byor thog gi gyong gun tshad las 'das pa phog rgyu yin pas/ deng rabs 'dzam gling thog gi dpal 'byor 'gran bsdur nang gnas pa'i nyen kha che shos zhig gi dus skabs 'dir khrom ra'i dngos zog dang / zog gong la 'os shing 'tshams pa'i do dam lam lugs nan po zhig 'dzugs rgyu ni ha cang gal chen po red snyam/ gong zhus rnams kho bor lo mang ring slob gso'i las don gyi zhar la dpal 'byor gnad don dang 'brel ba yod pa'i 'jal gshor 'degs gsam gyi tshad gzhir zhib 'jug cud zad byas pa'i lta tshul ༄rags bsdus shig yin/ rgya che'i mkhas dbang rnam pas legs bcos yo bsrang gi bka' slob kyang zhu rgyu yin/ 98

da gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i byung ba rags bsdus/'dzam gling sa mtho'i sa 'dzin dkar po'i ngos//rin chen sa zla sa la bkram pa lta'i//yangs pa'i sa skyong sa skya'i chos srid kyi//ngo mtshar sa steng sa mchog ljon pa bzhin//rab dkar ke la sha yi ri bo'i bskor ba'i bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya zhes gnas kyi ming las mtshan du thogs pa 'di ni/gangs ri'i ljongs su sangs rgyas chos lugs phyi dar gyi 'go tshugs pa nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i thog ma'i 'byung khungs lta bur gyur pa zhig yin thog bod kyi rab byung dang po'i chu glang /(sung byang ma'i rgyal rabs kyi gong ma sung hron tsung / kra'o hu'i shis nying khri lo drug pa/) spyi lo 1073lor/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po zhes gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis ka la mkhas shing grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa des dgung lo bzhi bcu la phebs skabs thog mar 'debs par mdzad pa nas bzung da bar lo dgu brgya lnga bcu nga bdun song yod/ khong gis gdan sa 'di 'debs pa'i gnas gang bzarnga partag ched nye 'dabs kyi sa gnas mang por phebs skabs/ dbon po ri'i sa dbyibs glang po che bres la nyal ba lta bu'i mkhal khung g.yas pa'i steng na sa dkar zhing snum pa yotwe 9pa ni

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ bkra shis pa'i sa dang / mdun ngos su chu bo g.yas su 'babs pa sogs sa dbyibs phun sum tshogs par gzigs nas gnas der dgon pa 'debs par dgongs te/ sa gnas spyi'i bdag po jo bo gdong nag pa zer ba la sa slong bar mdzad pas des kyang sa cha phul/ sgos kyi sa bdag 'a/nga zhung gu ra ba dang / ban de grong bzhi/ lha mi grong bdun sogs la sa cha de dgon 'debs pa'i gnas bzang por 'dug pas nged la ster dgos/sa rin gyong gun med pa gnang rgyu yin zhes gsungs pas/ kho tshos bla ma khyed dgon pa 'debs bzhed yod na sa cha dgongs bzhed ltar phul chog cing sa rin gtan nas mi dgos zhes zhus kyang / bla mas khyed rnams kyis nga la dgon pa 'debs pa'i sa cha rin med par phul ba de thugs rje che yang / phugs su rtsod gleng mi 'byung ba dang brtan po yong ba'i ched du sa rin nges par du phul rgyu yin pas bzhes par zhu gsungs nas/ rta rgod ma dkar mo gcig dang nor bu'i phreng ba gcig mo gos gcig la sogs pa gnang nas mon grog man chad nas 'bal grog yan chad bla ma rang la bdag rgyu byas nas dgon pa 'di thog mar 'debs pa mdzad cing / sa dkar gyi ri'i ngos su dgon pa chags yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis dgon pa chags pa'i gnas kyi ming chos brgyud la thogs te dpal ldan sa skya ba zhes grags pa yin la/ gdan sa 'di'i che ba'i dbang du byas na/ gdung brgyud kyi che ba dang / chos brgyud kyi che ba dang / gdan sa'i gnas kyi che ba/ chab srid mnga' thang gi che ba bcas bzhi'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin/ 100

gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i byung ba rags bsdus/1 gdung brgyud kyi che ba ni/ rus brgyud kyi dbang du byas na/sngon gyi bshad srol la/ gnam lha mched gsum gyi 'bring po g.yu ring gi brgyud las ma sangs spun bdun sogs brgyud pa 'ga' zhig song mtshams su g.ya' spang skyes zer ba'i sras zhig byung ba de srin po skya rengs khrag med dang 'thabs nas srin po bsad/ srin po'i chung ma g.ya' grum bsil ma zer ba mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig tsha/da pa de khab tu blangs pa'i bu zhig byung ba de srin po dang 'khon pa'i bar du skyes pas ming la 'khon bar skyes zhes btags pa nas 'khon gyi gdung brgyud thog mar byung zhes grags la/'khon bar skyes des btsan mo bza' lce dman zer ba chung mar blangs pas sras gcig byung ba de la 'khon dpal po che zer/ de nyid cher longs pa dang yab kyis yul gang bzang ltar btang bas yul yar lung gi sa cha bzang yang bod kyi btsan pos dbang du bzung tshar bas/ la stod gnyan rtse thar gyi yul ya tshang zer ba phun sum tshogs par mthong nas yul de bzung / rjes su rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi blon por gyur/ rlangs khams pa lo tsā ba'i sring mo rlangs bza' ne chung khab tu blangs pas sras gcig byung ba de la 'khod klu'i dbang po srung zer zhing / de ni rgyal po khri srong lde btsan skabs kyi lo tsā ba skad grags can dgu (rgan gsum/ bar gsum/gzhon gsum )yod pa'i nang nas gzhon gsum gyi gras gcig dang / sad mi bdun nang gi gcig yin/ de nas rim bzhin 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i bar byung zhing / de rjes bdag bzang po dpal gyi bar gdung brgyud rim par byung ba las/ bzang po dpal la sras mang po yod 101

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i nang nas mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa nas bzung gzhi thog bla brang gi gdung brgyud 'ga' zhig dang / 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched nas bzung rin chen sgang bla brang gi gdung brgyud 'ga' zhig ti shri kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas nas bzung lha khang bla brangaci gi gdung brgyud mang tsam/ dbang kun dga' legs pa nas bzung dus mchod bla brang gi gdung brgyud mang po byung ba dang / dus mchod bla brang phud pa'i bla brang gzhan gsum gyi gdung brgyud ni dus rabs bco lnga pa'i mjug tsam la slebs dus bdag chen kun dga' blo gros legs pa'i 'byung gnas sku 'das pa nas gdung brgyud chad zin kyang / dus mchod bla brang gi gdung brgyud ni da lta'ang ma nyams par bzhugs yod pa yin/2 chos brgyud kyi che ba ni/ dpal ldan sa skya ba'i chos brgyud 'di la/slob dpon chen po pad ma 'byung gnas nas brgyud pa'i gsang sngags snga 'gyur spyi dang / lhag par yang dag dang / rdo rje phur pa gnyis kyi chos brgyud dbang dang / bshad pa/ myong khrid bcas yab mes gong ma'i dus nas phyag bzhes su yod pas yang phur gnyis ni sa skya ba'i yab chos su grags shing / gzhan yang 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes dang / grub chen bir wa pa gnyis nas brgyud pa'i lam 'bras kyi chos skor dang / partsi ta gsang ba shes rab nas brgyud pa'i gsang sngags thig le'i skor/ grub chen bir wa pa las brgyud pa'i sa skya'i lcags ri'i mi 'da' ba'i zab khyad gser chos bcu gsum/ gnam kha'u pa nas brgyud pa'i mgon po gur zhal gnyis sogs chos skyong gi skor/ phu hrang lo tsā ba las brgyud pa'i bde 102

gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i byung ba rags bsdus/ —mchog 'gos lo tsā ba dang mal lo tsā ba/ rma lo tsā ba sogs las brgyud pa'i gsang sngags gsar ma'i gsang 'dus dang bde mchog rngog lo tsā ba yab sras nas brgyud pa'i dbu ma dang tshad ma/ ska cog zhang gsum las brgyud pa'i mngon pa gong 'og 'dzims lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i 'dul ba/snar thang lo tsā ba saṅga dzinas brgyud pa'i rig gnas che ba lnga dang / chung ba lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i dbang lung khrid gsum gyi brgyud pa ma tshang ba med pa bzhugs pas sa rnying bka' brgyud dge lugs sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma ha cang mang po zhig gis sa skya ba'i gdung brgyud dang / slob brgyud rim byon rnams las chos ma gsan pa med pa lta bu yin/3 gdan sa'i gnas kyi che ba ni/ gdan sa 'dir yon rgyal rabs dang ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma rim pas phul ba'i gna' rabs kyi dngos rigs rin thang bral ba ha cang mang po yod pa'i thog dus rabs rim byung nang bod kyi ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi shes rig bzo rtsal las bskrun pa'i lha khang dang / sku rten/ gsung rten/ mchod rten/ thang ka ldebs bris sogs bgrangs kyis mi langs pa yod cing / da dung mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ shong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/ lo tsā ba dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ge/ lo tsā ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yar lung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyalda mtshan/ lha btsun chos kyi rin chen/('di sung rgyal rabs lho ma'ilhal bo tha ma hra'o ri ci'u zhan rgyal sa shor nas sa skyar btang ste grwa pa byas pa de yin) lo tsā ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 103

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ ldan ma lo tsā ba tshul khrims seng ge bcas kyis kye rdor dus 'khor sogs gsang sngags dang / tshad ma rnam 'grel sogs tshad ma/ snyan ngag me long / skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs snyan ngag sgra mdo ka lā pa sogs sgra rig bcas kyis mtshon rgya gar gyi gzhung mang po bod skad du bsgyur bar mdzad pa'i gnas yin pa ma zad/de dag gi ma dpe tā la'i lo mar bris pa'i rgya dpe mang che ba de sngon 'di gar bzhugs shing / da lta'ang tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rgya dpe sogs 'ga' zhig ma nyams par bzhugs yod/gzhan yang gdan sa 'di nas sa skya'i gdung brgyud rtsod med yin pa'i mkhas grub chen po sa chen gong ma lnga dang / bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ bdag chen a mes zhabs la sogs pa mang du byon zhing /chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes chen dam pa yang 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge/ kun mkhyen g.yag phrug pa sangs rgyas dpal/rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun red mda' ba/ rje tsong kha pa yab sras gsum/ go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge/ chen po shākya mchog ldan/ ngor pa kun dga' bzang po/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/thon mi kun dga' rnam rgyal/ rjong chung pa gzungs kyi dpal ba/ byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa/'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang / mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags sogs bgrang gis mi langs pa byung bas 104

gdan sa po dpal ldan sa skya'i byung ba rags bsdus/ gematshon gangs can ljongs 'di'i mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i chu bo chen po gcig tu 'du ba'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur yod/4 chab srid mnga' thang gi che ba ni/ yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yon shan tsung mong gol han gyis bod sa gnas 'di bzhin mes rgyal mnga' khongs chen po'i nang gcig gyur byas pa'i rjes su sa skya paṇa chen gong ma'i mchod gnas su gdan drangs pa dang / gong ma hu pi li se chen han gyis 'gro mgon 'phags par bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi bdag dbang phul ba nas yon krung dbyang srid gzhung gi thad ka'i bkod 'doms 'og sa skya bas bod dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi srid dbang bzung zhing /dpon chen shākya bzang po nas bskyar ldabs dang bcas pa'i dpon rabs nyi shu tham pa'i bar san glu'i gun min dbang hu'i dang tu'u yon hre'e sogs yon rgyal rabs kyi go gnas yod pa'i dpon chen grags pa can yang mang du byung / phyogs mtshungs yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma rim pa'i dus su gong ma'i ti shri gnang mkhan gcig pur mtshon na yang / 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas gong ma hu pi li se chen han gyi ti thi gnang ba nas/ bdag chen kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan rjes mas yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma tha ma zhon rdi tho bkan the'i mur gyi ti shri gnang ba'i bar ti shri'i go gnas yod pa bcu bzhi dang / ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan nas bdag chen bsod nams blo gros kyi bar ti shri'i go gnas yod pa lnga byung bas mtshon chos srid gnyis ka'i thog nas bod dang mes rgyal bar gyi 'brel ba'i thad gal che'i gnas babs bzung 105

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod par brten/ sa skya'i gdan sa 'di bzhin rgyal yongs rig dngos srung skyob sde tshan nang gtso bo'i gras su gyur yod pa dang / lo bcu'i god chag chen po byung ring gdan sa 'di'i byang rgyud le lag rnams la gtor bshig tshabs chen song yang / lho rgyud du yod pa'i lha khang mo 'dir srung skyob byed thub tsam byung ba lags shing / phami bzhi shog khag 7gtor pham btang rjes tang krung dbyang gi byams brtse'i thugs khur 'og rgyal khab nas lo ltar mi shugs dang / dngos shugs 'bor btang ste nyams gso bdag gces gnang dang gnang mus yin pa bcas dran gso'i lo rgyus nyung bsdus tsam zhig rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams la ngo sprod zhu'o/
