mkhan slob gnyis kyi mdzad rjes mdor bsdus da/ rnam dag sdom gsum nor bus yongs gtams zhi dul btsun pa'i 'o mtsho las rdzilegs 'khrungs brtse yal 'dab rab rgyas byang chub thugs kyi pad+ma dkar/ /gzhan phan thugs rje'i dri bsung yongs 'phro 'phrin las bzang pos 'gro ba 'dul/ /ma nor lam ston sa rmekhan zla med bdag nyid po zhi ba 'tsho/ /zab lam rirme gnyirla then rmochog rtsi yis tha mal sgo gsum lcags kyi khams/ /yongs dag rgyal ba'i sku gsum rin gser sbyangs gshis su sgyur ba yis /tshe gcig zung 'jug go 'phang mchog brnyes ma rungs 'dre srin 'dul ba la/ /mtshungs zla med pa'i gangs can skyabs gcig grub dbang pad+ma kā rar gus/ / rdzo rdziphul byung gzhan r+shan lirgos mdzad bzang po khri gdugs nyi ma'i dpal la 'gran/ / rdzi107

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lugs gnyis khrims srol drang por legs srong 'gro kun dga' bde'i dpal la sbyor/ /ma 'dres blang dor gzugs brnyan kun gsal rin chen nor bu'i lde mig gis/ /mdo sngags chos kyi sgo 'ophar btsan po bde blag 'byed mkhas khri srong rje/ /zhes snyan tshig dang 'brel ba'i rbesngags brjod cung zad dang bcas te 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni/ gangs can ljongs 'dir lugs gnyis kyi bka' khrims bzang pos khyab par mdzad cing / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi srol bzang dar rgyas su mdzad pa la gzhan mi mnyam pa'i thugs rje dang bka' drin mtshungs zla med pa mkhan slob chos gsum zhes grags pa don ldan gyi mtsham/ snyan sa gsum na khyab pa'i mdzad bzang rags bsdus su bkod pa la/mkhan chen bo rnyi sa twa/mtshan dngos zhi ba 'tsho ste/ rgya gar skad du sharnyi ra k+ṣi ta zhes zer/bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha mang por dgung lo dgu brgya lhag tsam gyi bar du bzhugs pa/ rgyal po lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi skabs lo tsā ba li the si la mdo sde spang skong phyag rgya sogs bskur gnang mdzad/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su bod du gdan drangs te byon pa dang / mkhan chen de sku tshe ha cang ring po bzhugs pa'i dbang gis sku tshe stod dang / bar/ smad gsum gyi slob ma mang po yod ces bshad rnyo rāri 'dug jo nang tā ra nā thas 108

mkhan slob gnyis kyimadzadarjesamadorabasdus/ da wamadzad pa'i 〈 rgya gar chos 'byung 〉le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'i nang bod kyi yul du byon pa'i ā tsār+ya bo rnyi sa twa ni/ rgyal po go pā la nas rgyal po dharma pā la'i bar du nges par bzhugs par mngon la/ bod kyi lo rgyus khungs che bar byas pa mang po zhig gi nang bod kyi rgyal po dgu mkhan po 'di'i sku tshe'i ring la 'das zer bar snang bas de lta na slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med sku mched gnyis kyi zhabs zin pa tsam du byed dgos te ji bzhin yin par dka' 'o/ /zhes gsal ba de rang gzhir bzung na/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po gau pā las srid dbang bzung ba'i dus ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i 685—720bar yin cing / de nas rtsis pa'i rgyal rabs bzhi pa rgyal po dharma pā las srid dbang bzung ba'i dus ni spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug 790—853bar yin cing / de'i bar lo brgya dang lnga yod pas sku tshe ring po bzhugs nges can red/ gang ltar bod du mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' zhes yongs su grags pa'i bdag nyid chen po de ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs bhartse la grags pa der/ yab rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin la sras lcam sring gsum yod (che ba rnyarma rā rga'abring po mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ chung ba lha lcam marnya ra ba/)ste/ (slob dpon po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rig mar bzhes )mkhan 'dis sku che'i stod dang bar gyi ring rgya gar du bzhugs nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad/ rgyal po chen po khri srong lde btsa na gyis bod du nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa cha tshang ba zhig 'dzugs par dgongs te blon po sba gsal snang rgya gar du btang nas/ gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig 109

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'tshol du btang bas stod mang yul gyi so kha srung ba'i blon por bskos pa ltar mdzad de mngags bcol gnang / sba gsal snang gis rgya gar rdo rje gdan du song nas mchod 'bul byas/ bod du tshur phyir log byas pa'i lam zhor bal yul du song nas bal rgyal gyi drung du btsan pos bskur ba'i 'tshams rten rnams phul skabs bal po'i rgyal po'i mchod gnas su mkhan chen sku dngos bzhugs pa dang mjal te chos 'brel dang sems bskyed zhus nas rang lus la yod pa'i gser dang gyon pa/ ske rags zhwa dang bcas pa tshang ma chos 'brel dang sems bskyed kyi yon du phul bas bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas gong 'phel yong ba'i rten 'brel bzang po 'grigs/ gsal snang gis mkhan nyid bod kyi btsan po'i mchod gnas su phebs par zhu ba phul skabs/ mkhan gyi zhal nas bod kyi yul la phan thogs bya rgyu ni nga'i las skal yin/ bod kyi btsan po dang khyod gnyis kyi skye ba dgu'i bar du ngas mang yul dang za hor gyi yul gnyis bar phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas nas bsgugs bsdad pa yin/ da bod kyi btsan po dang khyod gnyis nar son nas dus la babs 'dug pas ngas bod kyi btsan po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas te yul byan dkar du chu bo lo hi ta'i 'gram ri has po yi drung du brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs par byed do/ /zhes gsungs te zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas gsal snang bod du log nas rgyal po'i sku mdun du mi gzhan dag med pa'i skabs dang bstun nas mkhan chen mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan khyad du 'phags pa rnams rgyal 110

mkhan slob gnyis kyi mdzad rjes mdor bsdus/ —por zhib par zhus thog bod du phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes bzang po thob pa rnams rim bzhin zhus par rgyal po thugs shin tu mnyes te gsungs don/nged rang gnyis kyis paṇ+ḍi ta de bod du gdan drangs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srol bzang po zhig 'dzugs thub pa bya rgyur gsang dam po dgos/gal te chos la mi dga' ba'i blon po 'di tshos shes na khyod rang srog dang bral ba'i nyen kha yod pas gnas skabs ring rang gi yul du song la gab nas sdod cig ngas thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas don 'grub pa bya gsungs nas thabs 'phrul sna tshogs kyi sgo nas chos la mi dga' ba'i blon po gtso bo rnams brtul te srid dbang rang nyid kyi phyag tu bzhes rjes rgyal blon rnams chos byed par gros mthun nas chos byed pa la mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta zhig slob dpon du bsten pas chos la mkhas pa su yod ces gleng ba na gsal snang mang yul nas phyir log pa bsdad yod pas khong bos na zhus pa ltar rgyal pos gsal snang sku mdun du bka' 'gugs gnang ste gsung don/khyod rang rgya gar du 'gro myong stabs chos la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta su yod pa smros shig ces gsungs/ gsal snang gis rgyal blon kun 'dzoms pa'i sar sngon dus rgyal por gsang ba'i sgo nas zhus pa'e don rnams zhib phra bshad/skabs der rgyal pos khyod rang da res rang yul du log skabs paṇ+ḍi ta de spyan drangs pa'i ched du bal yul la song / bal rje la nga'i bka' yi sgrom bu 'di phul nas paṇ+ḍi ta de nges par du can drangs thub pa gyis shig ces mngags nas gsal snang slar yang bal yul du brdzangs/ gsal snang bal yul du 'byor nas bal rje la rgyal po'i bka' yig phul te mkhan chen bod 111

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/du gdan drangs/ rim gyis stod mnga' ris mang yul du phebs pa na bod nas rgyal po'i gnyer pa stag btsan ldong gzigs dang / lang 'gro snang ra/sbrang rgya ra legs gzigs bcas phebs bsur btang ba 'byor/ de nas rim gyis rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs pa'i tshe/ gsal snang gis sngon la rgyal po'i drung du song nas phyag 'tshal zhus te/ paṇ+ḍi ta phebs kyi yod pa'i lo rgyus rnams zhus pas rgyal po dgyes tshor chen po byung nas phebs bsu zab rgyas gnang rgyu'i dgongs pa 'khrungs pa na zhang blon chos la dad pa che ba 'ga' zhig gis zer don/ rgya gar dang bal yul nas 'ongs pa'i mi la ngan sngags mkhan mang po yong bas sngon la brtag dpyad legs par mdzad na bzang zhes zhus/ blon po lo tsā ba sang shi (rgya rigs )sogs kyis brtag dpyad byas kyang rgya gar skad ma go ba'i stabs kyis bzang ngan ma shes/ kha che a nan+ta la lo tsā ba bcol nas bka' 'dri 'ga' zhig zhus skabs zhal nas lha dkon mchog gsum la mchod/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas/gtso bor sems can la gang phan 'ba' zhig byed gsung / blon po de tsho yid ches nas rgyal po la zhus pa ā tsar+ya 'di lta ba dang spyod pa bzang po zhig 'dug pas thugs dogs gtan nas gnang dgos pa mi 'dug ces zhus nas rgyal blon rnams kyis sne len bsu ba phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te pho brang du gdan drangs/ pho brang gi sgo 'gram du byon pa na/rgyal pos gser phye bre gang phyag rten du phul nas phyag 'tshal nas zhabs la gtugs te byin rlabs zhus/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srol dar rgyas yong ba'i zhu ba phul ba ltar/ pho brang rlung 'tshubs su zla ba bzhi'i ring 112

mkhan slob gnyis kyi mdzad rjes mdor bsdus/dge ba bcu dang / khams bco brgyad rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas chos gsungs/ skabs der chu log byung ste pho brang 'phang thang chus khyer ba dang / lha sa'i dmar po ri'i pho brang la thog rgyab pa/ mi rgyugs la nad yams phog pa bcas byung bas bod 'bangs tshang ma sems log nas chos byas pa'i rkyen gyis lan pa yin/ mtha' mi ā tsar+ya phyir bskrad dgos zer ba na/ rgyal po thugs pham chen po'i ngang nas mkhan po'i drung du phebs te zhabs la dbu gtugs nas bshum bzhin du bod 'bangs kyi mi la bsod nams med pa dang nag phyogs kyi lha 'dres bar chad byas pa'i dbang gis bod 'bangs rnams kyis 'di 'dra zer 'dug pas mkhan po gnas skabs ring bal yul du phyir phebs ma gnang ka med byung song yang rjes su dus la babs skabs slar yang gdan 'dren gtong rgyu yin pas nges par du phebs gnang yod pa zhes zhus nas re zhig bal yul du phyir phebs mdzad dgos byung / skabs der mkhan por rgyal pos phyag rten du/ gser phye ha cang mang po phul ba nas khyor ba gang tsam zhig bal po'i rgyal por 'bul rgyu'i rten du/ bsnams nas de 'phros tshang ma rgyal po rang la phyir slog gnang ste gsung don/ sngar yab mes kyi sku ring la bod kyi lha srin gdug pa can mang po dam la ma btags pa'i dbang gis nag phyogs kyi lha 'dre chos la shin tu mi dga' ba de tshos bar chad byas te chos gnang skabs ltas ngan sna tshogs btang ba/ rgyal po sku tshe thung ba sogs byung ba yin pas/ rjes su chos gnang na thog mar nag phyogs kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams dam la gdag dgos/ de la ni 'dzam gling 'di na nus pa che ba'i rig sngags /3

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las migasung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mkhan slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha’zhes zhu ba zhig yod pa de ngas bod du gdan drangs te lha 'dre 'dul dgos/ bod la mu stegs pas 'gran rgol byed mkhan mi yong / nang pa sangs rgyas pa nang phan tshun dang de min chos lugs gzhan zhig gis 'gran rgol byed pa byung na/ lung dang rig pa'i sgo nas nga dang rtsod zla byed chog mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas pad+ma sam bha wa dang 'gran pas 'dul thub gsungs nas bal yul du phyir phebs/ de nas btsan pos thabs mkhas pa 'i sgo nas chos mdzad rgyu'i bka' gros gnang ste/ gsal snang slar yang mkhan chen gdan drangs par bal yul du btang / 〈 sba bzhed 〉las skabs der mkhan chen gyis kyang slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha ba dang lha khang rtsig pa'i sa dpyad brtag mkhan bcas gra sgrig gnang ste mnga' ris mang yul bar phebs grub pa dang mjal/ slob dpon po dang / mkhan chen sku 'khor bcas mnga' ris mang yul nas snye thod dkar gyi bar du chu thog la gru rdzings bcas te phebs shing / slob dpon pos lha 'dre 'dul ba dang dam la 'dogs pa'i mdzad pa rnams rim gyis bskyangs/ de nas bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa cha gang du bzang min gyi brtag dpyad mdzad pa'i ched du mkhan po dang / slob dpon/ btsan po/ gnyer stag btsan ldong gzigs bcas has po ri'i rtser phebs nas gzigs pa na/skabs der bsam yas kyi sa gzhi de 'jag ma skya tho re ba dang shing rtsi sdong phung chung ba dang / lcang ma sdong po thar thor re yod pa rnams la gzigs nas shar phyogs ri ni rgyal po khri'i steng du bzhugs pa 'dra ba dang / me 114

mkhan slob gnyis kyimadzadarjesamadorabasdus/ da ——yar gyi ri drel rta chu 'thung ba 'dra ba/ dol thang dar dkar gyi yol ba bres pa 'dra ba/ sa gzhi 'di mkhar gzhong me tog gur kum gyis bkang ba 'dra ba bcas lha khang bzhengs pa'i sa gnas 'di rang bzang zhes gsungs nas phyag mkhar gyis phyag bris mdzad/ bod 'bangs rnams la gsang ba bya ba'i phyir sa cha 'dir chibs rta 'dogs pa'i bres chen po zhig brtsegs rgyu yin khul gyis rtswa 'jag ma rnams kyi rtse mo phan tshun bsdus nas mdud pa brgyab ste mtho yor btsugs pa bzhin du bskor nas phyi'i rwa ba sngon du brtsegs nas sa chog gi rim pa rnams mdzad/ de nas lha khang dngos gzhi rtsig skabs/ mkhan chen gyis gsung don/ btsan po'i thugs dam lha khang 'di 'dzam bu'i gling 'di na ngo mtshar che ba gcig byed dgos/ de yang 'dul ba dang / mdo sde/ mngon pa bcas mdo phyogs kyi sde snod thams cad dang / gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi thams cad dang mthun pa zhig byed dgos gsungs nas sngon dus rabs bdun pa'i mjug dang brgyad pa'i 'gor bzhengs pa'i o tan+ta pū ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe byas te bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i ljags bkod zhib par gnang / bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i rjes su slob dpon chen po dang lhan tu rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas par gnang / rgya gar nas thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs nas/ sba gsal snang sogs sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po mdzad pas mkhan chen zhes mtshan thogs/ de nas bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs dar rgyas gong 'phel 'byung ba la bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rnams bod 115

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mi rigs rang gi skad du bsgyur rgyu gal che bar dgongs te bsam yas su sgra bsgyur gyi chos don khang dang / slob grwa btsugs pa gnang ba de ni bod du yig bsgyur gyi slob grwa dang yig bsgyur khang btsugs pa'i thog ma de yin/mkhan po 'dis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom gras ṭ+wāṃ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa 〉dang / 〈 dbu ma rgyan 〉de'i 'grel pa bcas yod pa bod skad du bsgyur ba bstan 'gyur sde dge dpar ma'i nang du yod pa gsung rab spyi'i dgongs pa gnad bsdus nas ston pa yin par rgya bod mkhas pa kun gyis bstod bsngags chen po zhu ba zhig yin/ sku che'i mdzad pa tha ma ston par nye ba na/ 'phral snang la bsam yas kyi pho brang 'og khang zhig la phebs skabs chibs ltas dbu la 'phra rgyab pa'i rkyen byas te sku gshegs shing sku gdung bzhu ba'i spur khang has po ri'i rgyab ngos su brtsigs pa der mchod rten kyang bzhengs/ mkhan po bdag nyid chen po 'di'i lo rgyus rnam thar rgyas pa zhig sngon chad ma mthong zhing / 'dir bkod pa ni 〈 sba bzhed 〉dang / 〈 rgya gar chos 'byung 〉 〈 lam rim bla brgyud kyi rnam thar 〉bcas su gsal ba rnams phyogs sdud byas te bkod pa yin/slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha ba/slob dpon 'di ni bod la bka' drin che ba'i a tsar+ya gsum gyi nang tshan dang po yin/ 'di yi rnam thar dang lo rgyus thog bshad srol mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'dug cing / gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi lo rgyus la yang slob dpon chen po 'di rgya gar gyi nub phyogs au ḍi ā na ste bod skad du o rgyan 116

mkhan slob gnyis kyi mdzad rjes mdor bsdus/ gemakha' 'gro'i gling gi dha na ko sha zer ba'i mtsho yi nang du me tog pad+ma'i nang brdzus te 'khrungs pa dang / yab dang yum mi dgos par brdzus nas rang byung du 'khrungs pa'i sangs rgyas yin zhes gsungs/ jo nang tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i 〈 slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar yid ches gsum ldan 〉gyi nang 'di ltar gsungs te/ rgya gar yul dbus ma gha rnyar rgyal po de wa pā las rgyal srid skyong ba'i tshe (spyi lo 730—777bar)o rgyanalhagyi yul du rgyal po ha ya li las srid dbang bzung zhing / de'i tshe rgyal rigs rig pa smra ba sra do 'am srig rnya ra ste me tog phreng ba 'dzin pa zer ba zhig yod/ de la sras mtshan bzang dang ldan pa ngo mtshar 'gran zla med pa zhig 'khrungs pa las/ khye'u'i mtshan ltas blta ba la mkhas pa mang po zhig la bstan pa na/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig gis sras 'dis rgyal srid mi bzung zhing gsang sngags kyi lam la brten nas grub pa thob pa'i slob dpon chen po zhig 'byung ba dang / ma la pad+ma a ba bha si ste mtshams sbyar bas pad+ma ba gha si zhes btags/ sku na chung dus nas rig gnas che chung dang / brtag pa brgyad la sogs pa gang la yang dka' tshegs chen po mi dgos par mkhas par mkhyen/ gsang sngags kyi slob dpon sharnyi rū pa dang grub chen su kha de ba/ mkha' 'gro ma su kha rda ri bcas kyi drung nas gsang sngags kyi chos mang po gsan cing sgom sgrub yun ring mdzad de bzhugs pa'i skabs rgyal po ha ya li la 'das/ de'i bu a k+ṣa mi la zer bas srid dbang bzung/ sras pad+ma a ba bha yis rang gi yab dang 'dra bar rgyal po'i pho brang gi srid kyi las don dang / skar rtsis la 117

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brten nas ltas bzang ngan rmung ston pa bcas mdzad cing skyed tshal zhig gi nang du lha khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde bzhengs shing mtha' bskor du mchod rten dang lcags ri rim pa mang pos bskor ba zhig 'dzugs skrun gnang bas/ slob dpon rang nyid kyi bran g.yog gcig rgyal po'i yig mkhan dang / gnyis blon po'i khongs su gtogs pa de gsum ngan sems skyes nas rgyal por dbyen sbyor dkrug shing byas te slob dpon med par bzos te/ yul 'di'i dbang cha bzung thabs bya rgyur gros mthun ste rgyal por thabs shes sna tshogs kyi sgo nas dbyen sbyor byas par rgyal po kho tsho'i gtam la yid ches te dmag dpung btang nas skyed tshal gyi mtha' bskor/slob dpon dge 'dun bcas pa yul gzhan du gnas dbyung btang /blon po rnams kyis slob dpon 'di ma bsad na rjes su rang cag la gnod pa byed srid zer nas gshed ma mngags te slob dpon bzung / mtshon cha bsnun pa dang / mer bsregs pa/ chu la bskyur ba/ g.yang la bskyur ba/gson por sa sbas btang ba bcas byas kyang slob dpon gsod ma thub cing / rdzu 'phrul bstan nas sku lus la ci yang ma gnod par mdzad/ de nas bzung brag phug dang / dur khrod sogs su bzhugs nas lha 'dre gdug pa can thams cad dbang du bsgyur/ grub pa thob pa'i slob dpon rda bu gri ta sogs slob dpon brgyad las/ ral gri dang / ril bu/ mig sman/ rkang mgyogs/ sman/ bcud len/ gter gyi bum pa/ gser 'gyur rtsi bcas thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad thob/ da dung des thugs ma tshim par rgya gar yul dbus ma gha dhar byon/ skabs der rgyal po rnyarma 118

mkhan slob gnyis kyi mdzad rjes mdor bsdus/pā las srid dbang bzung ba'i dus (spyi lo 790—853)dang / (slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes grub pa thob nas slob ma gso skyong gnang ba'i skabs yin/)chos kyi myu gu'i dgon par slob dpon de'i drung nas rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi'i rgyud dang man ngag ha cang mang po gsan/ de nas slob dpon gyis bka' gnang ba ltar rgya gar bhat+ta la'i yul gyi grong khyer paṇ+ḍa pa'i byang phyogs kyi nags tshal sar shi zhes bya bar bzhugs/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa mdzad de mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mngon du mdzad/ de nas rgya gar byang phyogs kyi yul ti ra hu ti dang / bal yul/ shar phyogs kā ma rā/ lho phyogs tri ma la sogs mu stegs pa mang po yod pa'i sa gnas phal che bar byon nas rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas mu stegs pa brtul zhing / rig sngags kyi sgo nas mu stegs pa'i lha 'dre rnams btul nas dam la 'dogs par mdzad pa sogs gsal/ slob dpon po 'di nyid bod du gdan drangs tshul la 〈 rba bzhed 〉dang bka' thang gnyis bshad tshul mi mthun pa yod cing /bka' thang du 'khod pa ltar na/ rgyal po khri༄nga lde btsan gyis rba gsal snang dang / sna nam rdo rje bdud 'jomag mtshims shākya pra bha/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge bcas bzhi la gser phye bre gang re dang / gser gyi pa tra re bskur nas rgya gar du brdzangs/ slob dpon po dang mjal te rgyal po'i phyag rten rnams phul nas bod du phebasapar zhus pas zhal gyis bzhes/khyed pho nya ba tsho sngon la song / ngas rjes su 'ongs te nag phyogs kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams btul nas dam la 'dogs kyin ma byas na bar chad 119

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/che gsungs nas pho nya ba rnams sngon la btang / slob dpon gyis bal yul du zla ba gsum tsam bzhugs te mi ma yin mang po dam la 'dogs pa dang gter sba ba sogs mdzad/ (de nas rba bzhed du gsal ba ltar na mnga' ris mang yul nas snye mo thod kar gyi bar du chu thog gru rdzings la byon par bshad)de nas slar yang rgyal pos/ gnubs nam kha'i snying po/ dbas mang rje gsal snang /seng mgo lta lung gzigs dbas mi gru gzings/ tsag ro dpal gzungs mgon sha li pu tra shrī/ gnyer stag btsan ldong gzigs sogs mang yul gyi mtha' srung blon por brdzangs pa'i khul mdzad de slar yang ska ba dpal brtsegs dang / sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms dang / cog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan bcas gdan 'dren du btang / mang yul nas rim bzhin gnam thang mkhar nag 'o yug byang khul 'dam gzhung / 'phan po/ mal dro sogs su byon nas/ lha mo gangs dkar sha med sogs bstan ma bcu gnyis/ dam can rdo rje legs pa/ gnyan chen thang lha/ gnyan mkhar nag mal dro gzi can/ yar lha sham po sogs lha 'dre mang po dam la btags te nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa skyong ba'i srung mar bskos/rim gyis yar lung gtsang po'i 'gram zung mkhar mdar phebs pa na/rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis/ blon po/ bod 'bangs skye bo pho mo yongs kyis rnga bro dang glu bro sogs kyi bsu ba'i bkod pa gzab rgyas dang bcas te pho brang brag dmar du gdan drangs/ bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus/—de nas rgyal po'i gzims mal ba lha 'dung 'tsho ga'ir snyan legs sogs la pra rten mdzad de rgyal po chen po bzhi yi pra phab (mi'i lus rten la lha babs 120

mkhan slob gnyis kyi mdzad rjes mdor bsdus/su bcug pa )nas/ sngar bod sa gnas su chos dar spel gtong rgyur bar chad dang gnod 'tshe byed mkhan lha 'dre su dang su yin gyi lung bstan rgyag tu bcug pa de ni bod du gsang sngags kyi gzhung nas bshad pa ltar gyi lha phabs pa'i lugs srol thog ma de yin/ de nas slar yang bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul dang / rmang 'ding bar mdzad/'di ni bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi sa 'dul dang rtsig rmang 'ding thengs gsum pa yin par 〈pad+ma bka' thang 〉las bshad/ de nas bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs 'go tshugs nas stag lo nas rta'i lo'i bar lo bzhi'i ring bzhengs grub ste/ rab gnas slob dpon dang mkhan chen gnyis lhan rgyas su mdzad cing ngo mtshar can gyi ltas bzang po ha cang mang po byung zhing / slob dpon gyis rdzu 'phrul la brten nas ngam shod kyi bye thang dang 'gram thang rnams nags tshal dang / spang thang du bsgyur/zung mkhar sogs chu dkon pa'i sar chu thon par mdzad/ lha sus mu khri btsanaci po dmag dpon du bskos nas bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa bcom nas der yod pa'i nor rdzas rin thang che ba rnams bod du drangs pas/ nor bdag rgyal po pe har yang ka ca'i rjes su 'brangs nas bod du 'ongs pa de la bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi srung mar bskos/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis/ sad mi mi bdun sogs gsang sngags kyi skal ldan slob ma nyi shu rtsa lnga la bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas dbang bskur mdzad cing / rgyal po sogs 'khor nyung shas shig la tshe dpag med kyi dbang bskur gnang / rje 'bangs nyer lnga zhes bod kyi grub 121

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thob nyi shu rtsa lnga thog mar byung / slob dpon po 'di bod du yun ji tsam bzhugs pa dang / rgyal po gang gi dus su bod nas rgya gar du phyir log phebs pa'i skor la bod kyi lo rgyus thog bshad srol mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod/ 〈 rba bzhed 〉las/ slob dpon chen po bod du phebs nas bsam yas kyi rab gnas ma mdzad gong du chu med sar chu 'don pa dang bye thang dang / gram thang rnams spang thang dang nags tshal du bsgyur ba sogs kyi rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan pa mdzad par blon po sangs rgyas chos lugs la mi dga' ba rnams kyis rgyal por zhus don/ rgya gar gyi a tsar+ya 'di mthu dang nus pa che lugs la bltas na 'dis nam zhig bod kyi rgyal po'i srid dbang 'phrog rgyu'i nyen kha shin tu che bas kho rang gi yul du bskyal na legs zhes yang yang nan tan gyis zhus pas rgyal po bya thabs ma rnyed nas slob dpon rgya gar du phyir phebs skyel zhu dgos byung ba dang / blon po rnams kyis lkog tu gros byas te slob dpon rgya gar du phyir phebs gnang ba'i lam bar du lkog gsod bya ma thub na rjes su bod la gnod 'tshe byed nyen yod ces gros mthun nas slob dpon gyi rjes su gshed ma rta pa mi bco brgyad btang nas mnga' ris mang yul gung thang la khar sgugs ra sprad de slob dpon der phebs pa dang gshed ma tshos glo bur du gnod 'tshe byed par 'ongs skabs slob dpon gyis bye ma la sngags btab pa gtor bas gshed ma rnams lus rengs te sgul bskyod ma thub par lus/ de nas slob dpon nam mkha' la 'phur nas srin yul du phebs par bshad/ 〈 bka' thang 〉'ga' zhig las slob dpon bod du lo drug bcu gnyis/ bco brgyad/122

mkhan slob gnyis kyimadzadarjesamadorabasdus/ —da —lnga bcu sogs su bzhugs par bshad pa sogs mi 'dra ba yod/ bsam yas kyi 'khor sa chen mo'i ldebs bris dang 〈 bka' thang sde lnga〉〈 pad+ma bka' thang 〉bcas la zhib tu brtags na/ slob dpon chen po bod du phebs skabs bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi sa 'dul dang / rtsig rmang 'ding thengs gnyis byas zin pa dang / bod du phebs rjes slar yang rtsig rmang bting ste bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas kyi skabs su bzhugs yod par gsal zhing lhag par du bka' thang khagacigi nang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku che'i ring dang / de nas mu ne btsan pos srid dbang skyong skabs dang mu ne btsan po 'das nas mu tig btsan pos srid dbang bzung skabs lo shas bcas kyi bar bod du bzhugs par gsal ba ltar na bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i chu stag spyi lo 762—rgyal po khri lde srong btsan nam sad na legs kyis srid dbang bzung ba'i lo ste spyi lo 80'bar lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum yod pas rgyal po mu tig btsan po sad na legs kyis srid dbang bzung rjes kyang lo shas bzhugs pa bsdoms na bod du lo lnga bcu ma zin tsam zhig bzhugs yod nges snyam/ 'on kyang bka' thang nang du 'khod pa'i slob dpon gyi rnam thar las nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs spyi'i lta tshul dang mi mthun pa'i tshig mang po zhig 'dres nas yod stabs des rkyen byas te bod ljongs skye bo yongs la mtshungs zla med pa'i bka' drin can gyi slob dpon chen po dang / gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas par ma dad log rtog skye ba'i gzhi chen po zhig tu gyur 'dug pa phyi rabs rang rigs kyi /23
mkhyen ldan mkhas pa rnams kyis phyogs lhung spangs te thugs dgongs gzu bor gnas ba'i sgo nas zhib 'jug brtag dpyad nan tan mdzad par zhu zhes gsol ba 'debs rgyu yin lags/

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog gi gnad don —'ga' zhig gleng ba/gcig lo rgyus zhib 'jug byed rgyu'i gal che'i khyad chos/spyir 'gro ba mi'i rigs so so'i lo rgyus 'phel rgyas la phyogs gnyis kyi khyad chos ldan yod pa ste thun mong gi khyad chos dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gnyis yod pa/ gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi dus skabs nas rim bzhin rus rgyud spyi tshogs dang / bran g.yog spyi tshogs/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin/ ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs bcas 'phel rgyas kyi dus rim mi 'dra ba mang po zhig brgyud pa dang / de yang thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas kyi chu tshad mtho dman la brten nas thon skyed 'brel ba mi 'dra ba re chags pa de la spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus zer ba dang / de yang dpal 'byor rmang gzhi 'phel rgyas kyi chu tshad mtho dman la ltos nas bshad pa zhig red/rig gnas dang de'i khongs su gtogs pa'i chos lugs 'phel rgyas ni dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang 'brel ba yod pa/ thon skyen nus shugs gong 'phel phyin te dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi chu tshad nges can zhig la slebs rjes mi'i rigs kyi shes rig gi chu tshad kyang de dang bstun nas mtho /25

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ru song ste phyi rol yul dang rang byung khams la ngos 'dzin byed pa'i lta tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang / de mtshon byed kyi ri mo dang brkos ris/'bur bzo/ rgyan cha/ 'dzugs skrun gyi bkod pa/ snyan ngag rtsom rigazlos gar/ glu gzhas/ sgrung la sogs pa'i rig gnas khag rim bzhin byung zhing / de yang dma' rim nas mtho rim du 'phel rgyas byung ste mthar thon skyed nus shugs kyi tshad mthon por slebs skabs deng rabs tshan rig gi shes yon khag rnams byung ba yin pas/ mi rigs gang 'dra zhig gi rig gnas 'phel rgyas kyi tshad gzhi de'i thog nas/ mi rigs de'i thon skyed nus shugs dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi chu tshad mtho dman mtshon thub kyi yod pa red/ der brten 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas phan tshun bar 'brel ba dam po yod pa dang /'brel ba de'i thog nas mi rigs khag so so'i lo rgyus 'phel rgyas la zhib 'jug bya rgyu de ni lo rgyus dngos gtso smra ba'i zhib 'jug byed thabs yin pas nga tshos phyogs gsum po de zung 'brel byas nas lo rgyus zhib 'jug bya dgos/chab srid lo rgyus la zhib 'jug bya rgyu ni ha cang rnyog 'dzings che ba zhig yin/ de ni da lta'i mi tshos 'das zin pa'i lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byas nas rgyal kha dang legs cha rgyun 'dzin byed rgyu dang pham nyes dang nor 'khrul gyi nang nas bslab bya len rgyu yin pas gnad don mang po zhig gi brten sa gtso bo ni da yod dpyad gzhi'i yig cha de tsho red/ de nas khag gcig ni yig thog tu 'khod med pa'i dbang gis rgan rabs rgyus mnga' 126

bodarigapa'izhibaXjugathogagiganadadona'aga'aglengab/ da ——ge—yod pa tshor bka' 'dri zhus nas yig thog tu phab thub pa byed rgyu de yin/de nas khag gcig ni dus skabs de'i 'brel yod mi snar brten dgos rgyu bcas red/ da yod dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs khag la mtshon na/ bod yig dang / rgya yig phyi rgyal yi ge bcas yin pas mang po zhig phan tshun kha gsab dang zhib bsdur bya 'os pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rin thang ldan pa zhig yin/ mi nyung ba zhig ni dus skabs de'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyi khe phan dang bstun nas lo rgyus ngo ma 'khyog bshad byas nas mi mang po mgo bo 'khrul du bcug pa yin stabs lo rgyus ngo ma yig thog tu bkod thabs med pa chags yod/ bod yig thog lo rgyus bshad tshul mi mthun pa yod pa rnams da lta 'tsho bzhugs gnang ba'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis phan tshun bsam 'char brje res thog nas yo bsrang gnang bzhin pa de ni dga' ba skye 'os pa'i bya ba bzang po zhig red/ 'dis rjes su bod yig gi lo rgyus lta tshul gcig gyur yong sar phan thogs yod/ 'dir bod dang mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams skor gleng bar bya ste/bod 'di yon rgyal rabs kyi skabs nas 'go tshugs te mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs su gcig gyur byung ba yin/ de ni bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun pa ma zad/ khungs skyel ra sprod byed thub pa'i dpang rtags btsan po yod pa zhig dang / rgyu mtshan mang po bshad rgyu yod pa zhig yin/ thengs 'dir dus tshod mang po med pas rgyu mtshan gtso che ba tsam tshang mar dpyad gzhi'i tshul du zhu rgyu yin/yon rgyal rabs nas bzung bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs su / 27

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gcig gyur yong dgos pa'i phyi rkyen dang nang rkyen skor/mi rigs khag so so'i lo rgyus 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldog 'gro skabs bya dngos 'phel rgyas gzhan dag dngazu'adra bar phyi rkyen dang nang rkyen gnyis la brten nas yong gi yod cing / phyi rkyen gyi nus pa de nang rkyen la brten nas nus pa thon gyi yod pa dang / nang rkyen med na phyi rkyen gyi stobs shugs ji tsam che rung nus pa thon mi thub/ bod 'di btsan po'i dus rabs su nang khul gcig gyur du gnas pa'i mtha' mjug chos lugs bar gyi 'gal ba dang chab srid stobs shugs phyogs khag bar dbang cha 'phrog res kyi 'gal ba gnas pa des nang rkyen byas te mthar 'bangs gyen log byung nas kha 'thor zhing / de nas lo nyis brgya bco lnga tsam bar bod sa gnas su chab srid stobs shugs tshang ma gcig 'og tu gcig ma 'dus pa'i kha bral sil bur gnas pa zhig byung / dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i 'go tsam nas rim bzhin bka' gdams/ sa skya/ bka' brgyud bcas chos lugs dar 'go tshugs te bka' brgyud pa yang nang gses che bzhi chung brgyad du gyes pa dang chos lugs phyogs khag mi 'dra ba de tsho yang rang rang so sos rten gzhi gnad che ba re bzung yod pas sa gnas khag la chos lugs stobs shugs mi 'dra ba re chags pa dang / dus mtshungs chos lugs phyogs khag so sos rang rang gi rgyab rten bcol sa'i bod nang khul gyi chab srid stobs shugs re btsal bar brten chos srid gnyis ka'i thog nas kha bral gyi gnas tshul gsar pa zhig byung ste slar yang lo nyis brgya tsam ring bsdad pa bcas khyon bsdoms lo bzhi brgya lhag tsam bod sil bur 128

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog gi gnadadona'aga'aglengab/ —da —gyur te bod sa gnas su yod pa'i chab srid stobs shugs sus kyang gcig gyur byed ma thub/ spyi lo 1239lor sa skya ba dang 'bri gung pa/ phag grutshal pa/ g.ya' bzang stag lung pa bcas kyis yon rgyal rabs kyi rgyal bo go dan dang rgyal sras a ri bo ga o go ta sogs khag so sor mgo btags shing / de byings bod kyi chos lugs gzhan dag dang / sa gnas mang che ba sngar rgyun rang 'jags su bsdad pa las mgo btags med/de'i phyi lor hor go tan gyis mngags pa'i dmag dpung bod du yong nas mdo khams dang dbus khul du gtsang pa gsum gyi dmag jus lag len bstar nas bod yongs rdzogs yon rgyal rabs kyi mnga' 'og tu bsdus te gcig sgyur byas pa dang / chabs cig yon rgyal rabs kyi khrims lugs lag bstar byas pa dang sa gnas so sor yon rgyal rabs kyis bskos pa'i dpon rigs 'jog pa/ khral bsdu bra bcas kyi lo rgyus yig cha gsal po yod/'gro mgon 'phags pa ni chab srid dang bod kyi lo rgyus/ rig gnas bcas mkhyen rgya che ba ma zad/ chos lugs thad la yang grub mtha' ris med kyi chos lugs tshang mar nye ring med par gzigs skyong gnang bar mkhas pa zhig yin pas/ hu pe li se chen rgyal pos bod la sa skya'i chos lugs ma gtogs chos lugs byed mi chog pa'i bka' phab rgyu'i gros mol zhus skabs/ chos lugs grub mtha' tshang ma sngar bzhin rang mos su gnas chog pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po gsungs te bod kyi chos lugs khag la bsgyur bcos med par rang 'jags su gnas thub pa byung yod par ma zad/ /29

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril la yang phan thogs chen po byung yod par/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sogs bod kyi mkhas pa mang pos 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i chos srid gnyis ka'i thad nas gzigs rgyang ring ba'i dgongs pa rlabs chen der bstod bsngags gnang ba dang chabs cig bod kyi srid 'dzin dpon rigs dang / chos lugs khag gi bstan pa'i thugs khur bzhes pa'i bla chen tsho la gnang ba'i bslab bya mang po zhig gi nang 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i mdzad bzang rgyun 'dzin byed dgos par gsungs/bslab bya de tsho dus skabs der gnad la khel ba'i byed phyogs bzang po zhig yin pa smos ma dgos pa'i thog deng skabs bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril dang / rig gnas yar rgyas/ dpal 'byor gong 'phel gtong ba bcas kyi don snying chen po yod pa zhig red/ gang yin zer na/ bod mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril dang mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur phan tshun gnyis phan yin pa las 'gal zlar gnas pa zhig min/gnyis/ chos lugs zhib 'jug gi skor/deng sang 'dzam gling thog chos lugs 'dra min kha shas yod/ rgya gar la mtshon na/ 1 mu stegs gcer bu ba'i chos lugs/ 2 hin rdu'i chos lugs/ 3 dbyi si lan gyi chos lugs/ 4 ye shu'i chos lugs/5 sig gi chos lugs/ 6 nang pa'i chos lugs sogs yod/ rgyal nang la mtshon na/ 1 nang pa'i chos lugs 2 ta'o ca'o chos lugs/3 khung ci'i chos lugs bcas gsum yod/ bod la mtshon na/ 1 130

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog giganadadona'aga'aglengab/ da bon gyi chos lugs/ 2 nang pa'i chos lugs bcas gnyis yod/deng sang dar che zhing mi grangs mang ba'i chos lugs ni/ 1 nang pa'i chos lugs 2 dbyi si lan gyi chos lugs/ 3 ye shu'i chos lugs bcas gsum yin/ de gsum la 'dzam gling chos lugs chen ngo/ gsum zer/ chos lugs de tshor rang rang gi lo rgyus dang 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul/ 'jig rten lta tshul// mtshan nyid rig pa bcas mi 'dra ba yod pas deng sang chos lugs zhib 'jug bya rgyu de zhib 'jug gi nang don gnad che ba'i gras zhig tu gyur yod stabs rgyal khab phyi nang du chos lugs zhib 'jug gnang mkhan tshan pa dang mi sger bcas grangs las 'das pa yod cing / rang rang so sos zhib 'jug gnang ba'i mjug bsdoms gsung tshul yang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod/ zhib 'jug gi nang don thad nas bshad na gtso che ba'i gras bcu drug yod/1 chos lugs kyi lo rgyus/ 2 chos lugs kyi khyad chos/ 3 chos lugs kyi nus pa/ 4 chos lugs kyi nang don/ 5 chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa/ 6 chos lugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul/ 7 chos lugs khag gi rten gzhi/ 8 chos lugs kyi khrims srol/ 9 chos lugs kyi slob gso/ 10 chos lugs kyi byed sgo 11 chos lugs kyi rig gnas dang sgyu rtsal/ 12 chos lugs dang mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba/ 13 chos lugs dang spyi tshogs bar gyi 'brel ba/ 14 chos lugs dang chab srid bar gyi 'brel ba/ 15 chos lugs phan tshun bar gyi 'gal ba bcas yin/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang po/ chos lugs kyi lo rgyus/ de la chos lugs thog mar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen dang bar du 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i gnas tshul/ mthar chos lugs nyams rgud du 'gro tshul bcas kyi gnad don gsum po de'i thad chos lugs rang rang so so'i yig cha nas bshad tshul dang / deng rabs mar le ring lugs kyi lo rgyus dngos gtso smra ba'i thog nas bshad tshul bcas gnyis yod cing / bshad tshul de gnyis kyi bar la phan tshun 'dra ba'i phyogs kyang yod la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyang yod pas bshad tshul gnyis po bsdur nas zhib 'jug bya dgos/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung nang chos lugs thog mar byung ba'i rgyu rkyen ni/ bskal pa ya thog gi spyi tshogs nang mi rnams thun mong bde skyid mnyam myong gi 'tsho ba spyod skabs sger la dbang ba'i dpal 'byor med stabs phan tshun 'thab rtsod dang dmag 'khrugs/ khrims khang sogs med cing / skabs der mi rnams la zhe log pa dang sems skyo dgos pa'i gnas tshul gang yang med/ rjes su dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas phyin nas mi rnams kyi sger sems che ru song ste sger la dbang ba'i dpal 'byor byung ba dang / dpal 'byor de'i don du lung pa phan tshun dang rus rgyud phan tshun/ 'tsho pa phan tshun bcas kyi bar 'phrog rtsod dang / rkun ma/ jag pa/ 'thab rtsod/ dmag 'khrugakhrims khang bcas byung ste spyi tshogs bde 'jags med par brten/ mi mang po zhig 'jig rten 'di la zhe log pa dang / sems skyo dgos pa'i bsam tshul shugs chen po byung ste/ de'i nang gi mi khag gcig gis gnas tshul de la zhib 'jug brtag dpyad byas pa'i mjug bsdoms 'jig 132

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog gi gnadadona'aga'aglengab/ da da rten 'di'i sdug bsngal la bzod sgom byas nas 'jig rten phyi ma'i bange skyid thob 'dod kyi bsam blo bskyed de de'i thabs shes la bsam blo btang ste rim bzhin bskal pa ya thog gi chos lugs dang rgya gar gyi mu stegs pa'i chos sogs byung ba yin zhes bshad yod pa de la zhib 'jug byas na/deng sang nga tsho'i lo rgyus dngos gtso smra ba'i lta ba dang ha cang mthun po yod/ gnyis pa/ chos lugs kyi khyad chos/ de ni chos lugs khag so sor khyad chos bdun yod pa zer ba ste khyad chos bdun ni/ (1)lo rgyus ring ba/(2)rig pa'i gzhung lugs yod pa/ (3)mang tshogs kyi rang bzhin/(4)sa gnas kyi khyad chos/ (5)rgyal spyi'i thog khyab che ba/ (6)mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod pa/ (7)yun ring gnas thub pa'i khyad chos yod pa bcas yin/ de tsho re re nas 'grel bshad zhu rgyu min/gsum pa/ chos lugs kyi nus pa/ de ni chos lugs khag so sos spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang rig gnas slob gso/ mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur bcas kyi thog la phan thog yod pa'i nus pa thon dang / yang na gtor bshig gi nus pa thon pa gnyis kyi skor la zhib 'jug bya rgyu ste/deng sang rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi mang pos gnad don de'i thog lta stangs mi 'dra ba gsum bshad yod/(1)chos lugs ni mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi sems rmongs su 'jug pa'i nyal tha lta bu yin pa dang / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas mdun du bskyod par bkag 'gog byed mkhan/ mi rigs khag gi drang bden 'thab rtsoja 33

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la sems shugs med par bzo mkhan/ mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur dang mi rigs khag gi mthun sgril med par bzo rgyu'i bsam blo'i rmang gzhi bcas red zer/(2)khag gcig gis de las ldog ste/ spyi tshogs thog rgyas spros chud zos kyi 'tsho ba sngon 'gog byed rgyu dang / thon skyen gong 'phe la gtong rgyu/spyi tshogs kyi sgrig lam legs su gtong rgyu/ mi rnams bsam blo gcig la sgril nas phan tshun bar gyi 'gal ba sel rgyu/ rig gnas gong 'phel gtong rgyu bcas kyi thad la phan yod kyi nus pa thon thub pa yin stabs da phan gyi chos lugs dar ba'i lo rgyus yun ring yod pa ma zad/ phyis 'byung lo brgya phrag mang po'i nang mang tshogs kyi sems nang brtan por gnas thub rgyu red zer/(3)chos lugs kyi nus par gcig nas gnyis su gyes te lta dgos zer/ de yang chos lugs kyis spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang / rig gnas slob gso/ mi rigs mthun sgril bcas kyi thad la phan pa yod pa'i phyogs dang phan pa med pa'i phyogs gnyis ka yod pas phan pa med pa'i phyogs rnams tshod 'dzin byas te rim bzhin sel thabs dang phan pa yod pa'i phyogs rnams kyi nus pa 'don spel legs par byed thub pa zhig byung na/nga tshos chos lugs mi sna dang chos dad yod pa'i mi dmangs mang tshogs la mthun sgril byas te/ mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur sngar las lhag par sra brtan gtong thub zer ba bcas yin/bzhi ba/ chos lugs kyi nang don/ chos lugs khag so so'i nang 134

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog giganadadona'aga'aglengab/ da wa da —don ha cang mang po yod kyang / gtso bo ni 'jig rten lta tshul bshad pa'i lta ba dang sems rgyud 'dul thabs kyi sgom pa/ de gnyis kyi grogs kun spyod skor bcas gsum du 'dus pa yin/ de rnams kyi thad la chos lugs rang rang so sos bshad tshul 'dra ba dang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa ma zad/nang gses kyi rnam grangs mi 'dra mang po yod pas/ chos lugs kyi shes yon rgya che tsam med na chos lugs kyi nang don thad la zhib 'jug tshan rig dang mthun pa zhig yong mi thub/ dper na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pas bshad pa'i stong pa nyid la go ba len khul byas te/ snod spyad nang du gang yang med pa'i stong pa stong rkyang zhig la 'grel bshad byas pa dang / phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad sems kyi bdagachanyid tsam yin zer ba la go ba log sgrub byas te nang pa sangs rgyas pas dngos po thams cad sems la brten nas byung ba/ sems dang por byung nas/ phyi rol yul rjes su byung bar bshad kyi yod pa red/lnga pa/ chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa/ de la mang po yod kyang gtso chertsob kha shas bshad na/(1)'jig rten chags tshul gyi mtshan nyid rig pa/ (2)gzugs khams chags tshul gyi mtshan nyid rig pa/ (3)sems khams chags tshul gyi mtshan nyid rig pa/ (4)phyi rol yul dang yul can sems bar gyi 'brel ba'i skor/ (5)spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid skor/ (6)kun spyod bzang ba dang bsam blo yar rgyas kyi 'brel ba'i skor/ (7)'phel rgyas dang nyams rgud bar gyi rtsod sgrub 'brel ba'i skor sogs yod/ rgya /parte5

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gar du mu stegs pa dang nang pa'i bar/ bod du bon po dang nang pa'i bar bcas phan tshun rtsod pa byung ba'i 'gal ba thug sa gtso bo ni gong gsal gyi gnad don de tsho'i thad la byung ba zhig yin cing / de tshor zhib 'jug byas pa dang chabs cig deng sang mar khe si le nyin ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang phan tshun zhib bsdur byas na blo sgo chen po phye thub rgyu red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni gong gsal mtshan nyid rig pa de tsho'i nang deng sang gi tshan rig dang yongs su mthun pa ha cang mang po yod/ 'dir dpe zhig drangs nas bshad na/ rang cag 'tsho gnas byed pa'i 'jig rten go la 'di thog mar chags skabs rlung khams chen po'i bar snang du 'byung pa'i chu dang / me dang sa bcas kyi rang bzhin rdul phran shin tu phra ba mang po phan tshun 'phel bskyod byas te mthar gcig la gcig 'dus— te gong bu gcig tu gyur ba'i sa yi go la chags pa dang / skam sa chen po'i mthar rgya mtsho chen po dang / rlung khams chen po'i bang rim le dbar khri phrag mang po yod pa bcas kyi bshad tshul dang / de bzhin du mi'i lus khams chags tshul dang / lus khams nang gnas skye ldan gyi 'bu phra brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pa dang / 'bu phra re re'i ngo bo dang phan gnod kyi nus pa bcas zhib cing phra bar bshad pa ma zad/ bshad tshul mang po zhig deng sang gi tshan rig dang ha cang mthun po yod pa lta bu red/drug pa/ chos lugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul/ de ni tshe 'di'i bde skyid ji tsam che yang mthar snying po med pa dang yid brtan med pa yin pas tshe phyi ma phan chad kyi bde skyid thob pa'i phyir du chos byed dgos pa de red/ 136

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thogagiganadadona'aga'aglengab/ ——lta tshul de ni deng sang gi mi rnams phyug po dang / bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa zhig yong ched 'bad brtson byed rgyu'i bsam blo de dang rgyab 'gal yin pa'i gnad 'gag thug sa ni chos dang 'jig rten gnyis kyi dmigs yul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis red/ chos lugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul des tshad med pa'i phyug po dang tshad med pa'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba sngon 'gog byed par phan thogs yod/ phyug po dang bde skyid de tshad yod pa zhig byung na rgyas spros chud zos kyi 'tsho ba skyel stangs sngon 'gog byed thub cing / gal te bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la tshad gzhi med na 'jig rten 'di'i thoge gi mi rnamatsu sger sems shugs che ru song te chog shes gtan nas med pa'i rgyas spros chud zos rul sungs kyi 'tsho ba'i spyod tshul chu log rgyas pa ltar gang sar khyab nas rgyal khab kyi khrims lugs thog nas kyang bkag 'gog byed thub thabs med pa zhig yong rgyu red/ chos lugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul spyi tshogs thog khyab ji tsam che yang / da lta'i mi grangs ches mang che ba'i bsam blo'i 'khor phyogs dang kha gtad langs thub pa zhig gtan nas yong mi srid/ gang yin zer na/ 'dzam gling thog mi mang che ba'i bsam blo'i 'khor phyogs ni/ tshad med pa'i phyug po dang bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa zhig yong rgyu'i re ba dang 'bad brtson byed kyi yod pa ma zad/ bsam tshul de lo re bzhin shugs che ru 'gro rgyu nges can yin stabs/chos lugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul de dus yun ji tsam ring yang lo brgya phrag kha shas tsam las gnas mi thub/bdun pa/ chos lugs khag gi thog ma'i rten gzhi/ de ni chos /37

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lugs khag so so'i thog ma'i ston pa dang slob dpon gyis rang nyid kyis gsar gtod byas pa'i chos lugs de 'chad spel dang dar khyab gtong sa'i gnas gzhi bzung ba de la zer zhing gnas gzhi der slob ma mang po byung ba rnams rjes su rang rang gi skye yul dang sa gnas gzhan dag tu khyab ste chos lugs 'phel rgyas byung ba yin 'dzam gling chos lugs chen po gsum so sor rang rang gi thog ma'i gnas gzhi yod/ dbyi si lan chos lugs kyi ma kha'i yul te/ deng sang me kyar zer ba de yin pa dang / ye shu'i chos lugs kyi gnas gzhi ni deng sang pa le si than yin pa lta bu red/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gnas gzhi/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan sogs gnas chen brgyad/ de bzhin bod la mtshon na chos lugs grub mtha' khag tshang mar thog ma'i gnas gzhi yod/ rta zig bol mo lung ring lha sa gtsug lagakhang gnyis dang / po tā la/ bsam yas/ lho brag rwa sgreng / sa skya/ mtshur phu/ stag lung / 'bri gung / tshal gung thang / phag mo gru g.ya' bzang /shug gseb/ 'bab rom/ 'brug ra lung / dwags lha sgam po/ dga' ldan / rgyal nang gi ho nan zhing chen gyi be ma zi dang hran shis kyi ri bo rtse lnga lta bu yod/ gzhan yang lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i gnas gzhi grags can ni ha cang mang po yod pas zhib phra zhu rgyu min/ gong gsal thog ma'i gnas gzhi dang grags can gnas gzhi/ de tsho chos lugs khag so so'i gnas gzhi yin pa tsam du ma zad/ de tshor bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang mi rigs gzhan dag gi khyad chos ldan pa'i gna' rabs kyi 'dzugs skrun dngos po dang ldebs bris dang thang ka brkos dkrol/ gser dngul /38

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thogagiganadadona'aspyoglengab/ da zangs lcags/ li ma/ mnyam bsres lcags rigs bcas las bzos pa'i lha skra dang mchod rten/ mchod pa'i yo byad/ gser bris dang dngul bris/rin sna lnga dang sna bdun las bris pa'i gsung rab/ shing la dpar bskrun byas pa'i dpar shing / lo chig stong lhag gi lo rgyus yig cha/ dus rabs so so'i srid gzhung gi yig rigs bcas grangs las 'das pa yod sa zhig yin pas rig gnas sne mang 'dzoms pa'i bang mdzod yin/brgyad pa/ chos lugs kyi khrims srol/ de ni chos lugs kyi bca' khrims dang sgrigs 'dzugs srol yig gnyis kyi bsdus ming yin/ chos lugs kyi bca' khrims ni/ chos lugs tshogs pa khag tshang mar yod cing /de yang rang rang so so'i thog ma'i ston pa'am slob dpon des spang blang gi byed sgo gang yod gzhi 'dzin sa'i bca' khrims thog mar bzos pa de la zer zhing / de ni chos lugs de'i tshogs pa tshang mas gcig gyur gyis srung brtsi zhu dgos pa'i rtsa 'dzin zhig yin/ sgrigs 'dzugs srol yig ni gong gsal rtsa 'dzin de gzhir bzung thog tshogs pa rang rang so so gnas sdod byed sa'i yul gyi rgyal khrims/ skabs de'i gnas tshul 'gyur ldog gi babs dang bstun nas tshogs pa so so'i dbu 'dzin slob dpon dang tshogs 'du'i dbang cha 'dzin pa'i 'thus mi/ tshogs pa'i nang gi mi sna bsam shes can bcas phyogs gsum gros bsdur mos mthun byung rjes gtan 'bebs byas pa'i srol yig la zer/ dper na bod kyi dge lugs dgon pa khag gi khrims yig ni rtsa ba'i gzhi 'dzin sa ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i bca' khrims dang / rje tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i /39

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dga' ldan dgon pa'i bca' khrims kyi dgongs don de dang mi 'gal ba'i thog zhing khul gyi dgon pa dang / 'brog khul gyi dgon pa'i bar mi 'dra ba yod pa/ gnam gshis dro ba'i sa khul dang gnam gshis grang ba'i sa khul mi 'dra ba/ dpal 'byor cha rkyen zhan pa'i sa khul dang dpal 'byor cha rkyen legs pa'i sa khul bar mi 'dra ba lta bu yod/ gnes tshul mi 'dra ba gang zhig yod kyang rang rang gi thog ma'i slob dpon gyis gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i bca' khrims dang / dus skabs de'i srid gzhung gi gtan 'bebs khrims srol de gnyis dang mi 'gal ba bya dgos pa ma zad/gal srid chos khrims dang yul gyi rgyal khrims bar mi mthun pa'i 'gal ba byung na chos khrims kyis rgyal khrims la bstun dgos pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyis 'dul ba'i gzhung du gsal thag chod gsungs yod/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gong gsal gsung tshul de las ldog nas chos khrims dang rgyal khrims bar 'gal ba byung na chos khrims la rtsi dgos pa ma gtogs rgyal khrims la rtsi mi dgos zhes gsungs pa yin na/chos pa mang che ba rgyal khrims la rtsi med byed mkhan zhig yong rgyu yin pa dang / sangs rgyas chos lugs de deng sang 'dzam gling thog gnas rgyu lta zhog sangs rgyas dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das nas yun ring ma song bar rtsa med du 'gro rgyu thag gis chod/ der brten chos khrims kyis yul khrims la bstun dgos pa de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyis gsungs pa'i rtsa don yin pas chos pa tshos rgyal khab kyi khrims rtsi 'jog nan po byas na srid gzhung la 'gyur ba gang 'dra byung yang chos dad rang 140

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog giganadadona'aga'aglengab/da wad ——mos kyi rang dbang yong gi red/phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ chos khrims kyis rgyal khrims la bstun dgos pa de chos pa'i rtsa don yin par khag bzhag nas srid gzhung gis nang bstan chos byed grwa ba tshor gnyen bsgrig byed dgos pa dang / mi dang sems can rang gis gsod dgos pa/ dmag la 'gro dgos pa sogs kyi bka' phab pa yin na de ni chos byed grwa pa tshos nam yang bsgrub mi thub pa'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ gnad don de yi rkyen gyis nyes khrims phog rgyu yin pa dang / chos byed grwa pa dang srid gzhung bar 'gal ba tshabs che ru song ste mthar chos dad yod pa'i rgya che'i mi dmangs dang kha bral ba zhig yong rgyu red/ dgu pa/ chos lugs kyi slob gso/ chos lugs ni rang rang gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs yod pa'i bsam blo'i ma lag cig dang / mi'i rigs kyi dus skabs so so'i 'tsho ba'i nang gi gson nyams ldan pa'i skad cha mang po 'dus pa'i rig gnas shig yin par brten/ slob sbyong gi nang don dang go rim/ 'char gzhi/ slob deb/ sgrigs 'dzugs bcas cha tshang ba'i slob gso yod/ slob gso'i lam lugs yod pa'i sgrigs 'dzugs kyi rnam pa ni dgon pa khag yin/ de'i skor la nga rang gis bris pa'i 〈 bod kyi slob gso rig pa'i 'phel rgyas skor bshad pa 〉zer ba'i nang zhib par bshad yod pas skabs 'dir zhu rgyu min/bcu pa/ chos lugs kyi byed sgo/ chos lugs khag tshang mar rang rang so so'i byed sgo 'dra mi 'dra sna tshogs yod/ dper na/ rang rang so /4/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/so'i thog ma'i slob dpon sku 'khrungs pa dang chos kyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs thog mar gsungs pa/ slob dpon de'i sku tshe gcig gi mdzad rjes gtso che gras/ sku gshegs pa bcas kyi nyin mo'i rjes dran du phyag dang mchod pa 'bul ba/ bsang gtong ba/ chos 'chad nyan/ gling bskor 'gro ba/ lha sku dang mchod rten bzhengs pa/ dus bzang gal chen la sha mi za ba dang gzhan la gtam mi smra ba/ srog gcod mi byed pa/ du ba dang chang spangs pa sogs yod cing / 'ga' shas ni chos dad yod pa'i mang tshogs dang grwa pa mnyam du 'dzoms pa'i gzhi rgya chen po yod pas mi ngan 'ga' zhig gis go skabs de dang bstun nas zing cha slong pa/ spyod ngan spel pa bcas kyi gnas tshul yong gi yod stabs/ de la brten nas mang tshogs kyi chos dad byed sgor gtor bshig dang 'gog rkyen rang shugs su mi yong ka med red/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og rgya che'i chos dad mang tshogs kyis zing cha bzo mkhan de tsho phyogs gang 'dra zhig nas yong ba yin min gsal po shes pa byas te mgo bskor ma thebs pa bya rgyu gal chen po red/bcu gcig pa/ chos lugs kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal/ de ni ngo bo mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal yin pa la/ de mtshon byed chos lugs kyi rnam pa'i thog nas mtshon par byed pa de la chos lugs kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal zhes ming btags pa red/ gang yin zer na/ ldebs bris/ thang kabarkos ris/ 'bur bzo 'dzugs skrun/ gar 'chams rol mo glu dbyangs/ snyan ngag sgrung gtam sogs rig rtsal gyi byed sgo mang po yod 142

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog giganadadona'aga'aglengab/da wad ——pa de tsho'i nang nas sgyu rtsal gyi tshad gzhi mthon po yod pa mang po zhig dgon pa dang lha khang nang du yod pa dang / dgon pa dang lha khang nang du yod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rigs la chos lugs med pa zhig yong dka' ba yin pas nga tshosatregana' rabs kyi dgon pa lha khang nang gi bzo bkod rgyan ris sogs la lta skabs chos lugs kyi nang don yod pa'i phyogs rkyang par lta rgyu med par/ gtso bor mi rigs khag so so'i blo gros dang lag rtsal thog nas byung ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad dang de'i rin thang thog nas lta dgos rgyu gal chen po red/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rnying pa bzhi rtsa gtor gtong dgos zer ba'i 'bod tshig bton nas rin thang bral ba'i mi rigs khag gi shul bzhag rig dngos tshang mar bsam yul las 'das pa'i gtor bshig phog pa de yang gna' rabs kyi rig gnas dngos por chos lugs kyi nang don yod pa'i phyogs gcig po kho nar bltas pa ma sa/togs/ nge tsho'i sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad dang rin thang thog nas lta ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis byung ba red/ nga tshos gna' rabs kyi rig dngos la mthong chen byed pa de gna' rabs la rnying zhen byas pa dang / deng rabs kyi rig dngos la mthong chung dang ngo rgol byas pa de 'dra ma yin par/ deng rabs kyi rig dngos de gna' rabs rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi'i thog nas byung ba yin pa dang dus skabs so so'i rig dngos de duso rabs de'i mi rnams kyi cha rkyen ha cang zhan pa'i gnas tshul 'og rang nyid kyi skyes stobs 'bar ba'i blo gros dang bde lcag 'khyug pa'i lag pa gnyis la brten nas bzo skrun byas pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad de mthong thub kyi yod par brten/ dus snga ba de /4 3

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tsam gyis rin thang che ba'i tshor snang zhig shar gyi yod cing / deng rabs tshan rig gi lag rtsal gsar pa la brten nas bzo skrun byas pa'i rig dngos rnams mig gis lta snang du dpe med pa'i ngo mtshar chen po yod kyang de'i rin thang de gna' rabs kyi rig dngos las lhag pa'i khyad chos gang yang med/ dper na/ bod kyi gna' rabs 'dzugs skrun snga shos lha sa gtsug lag khang dang dus rabs bcu gcig patshimagor bzhengs pa'i mnga' ris mtho lding lha khang / dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i mgor bzhengs pa'i rgyal rtse mchod rten chen mo/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i mjug tu bzhengs pa'i po tā la pho brang dmar po bcas kyi bzo skrun lag rtsal dang de rnams kyi rin thang che chung 'dra mtshungs su shod thabs med pa lta bu red//bcu gnyis pa/rdzo chos lugs dang mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba/ de ni chos lugs khag tshang mar mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod pa dang / mi rigs mi 'dra ba mang pos chos lugs gcig la dad pa byed mkhan yod pa/ mi rigs gcig gi nang chos lugs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs la dad pa byed mkhan yod pa/ mi rigs kyi gnad don dang chos lugs kyi gnad don mnyam du 'dres nas yod pa bcas la zer/de yang chos lugs khag la mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod pa zer ba ni/ chos lugs de mi rigs kyi rnam pa can du 'gyur ba dper na/ bod rigs sa khul gyi sangs rgyas chos lugs la bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod pa dang /rgya rigs sa khul gyi sangs rgyas chos lugs la rgya mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod pa lta bu dang / mi rigs 'ardus sdod kyi sa gnas de nas thog mar dar 144

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog gi gnad don 'ga' gleng ba/ —spel byung ba'i chos lugs la mi rigs de yi khyad chos yod pa/ dper na/sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar ba'i gnas gzhi rgya gar yin pas sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi byed sgo mang po zhig la rgya gar mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod pa lta bu chos lugs gzhan dag la yang yod/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos zer ba de yang chos lugs kyi lta ba'i ngos nas bshad pa ma yin par/mi rigs so so'i sgyu rtsal dang goms gshis/ chas gos sogs phyi tshul gyi thog nas bshad pa yin pa dang / de yang mi rigs de la yongs khyab tu yod pa'i khyad chos la go dgos pa las/ lung pa re gnyis dang sa khul so so'i khyad chos 'ga' zhig la mi rigs kyi khyad chos zhes btags nas mi rigs gzhan zhig yin pa'i go ba blangs na nor 'khrul red/bcu gsum pa/ chos lugs dang spyi tshogs bar gyi 'brel ba/ de ni chos lugs de spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dus skabs nges can zhig dang 'brel ba yod par brten thog mar byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen dang /bar du 'phel rgyas 'gro ba/ mthar nyams rgud du 'gro ba bcas tshang ma dus skabs de'i mi rnams kyi bsam pa'i 'khyer phyogs dang / dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas/ rig gnas kyi chu tshad bcas dang 'brel ba yod pa der zer/ de yang chos lugs de spyi tshogs nang gnas thub pa'i rgyu rkyen ni/mi rnams kyi bsam pa'i re 'dun dang / dpal 'byor thog gi khe phan bcas dang mthun po byung ba'i ring chos lugs de spyi tshogs nang khyab chen por gnas thub pa dang nam zhig de gnyis dang mi mthun pa'i 'gal ba byung skabs nyams rgud du 'gro ba'i 'go tshugs pa red/ deng rabs tshan /45

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rig lag rtsal dar rgyas chen po yod pa'i rgyal khab kyi nang du yang da dung chos lugs khag sna tshogs la dad pa byed mkhan mi nyung ba yod pa de'i thog nas chos lugs de spyi tshogs kyi nang du gnas pa'i shugs rkyen yun ring yin pa mthong thub cing / de'i rgyu mtshan ni chos lugs kyi bsam blo dang /rig pa'i gzhung lugs mang po zhig gis spyi tshogs kyi sgrig lam bde 'jags dang mi dang mi'i bar gyi mthun sgril bcas la nus pa gang 'tshams thon gyi yod pa'i dbang gis mi mang po zhig gi bsam par gting zab zug thub pa byung bar brten/ chos lugs la mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi rgya chen po yod pa de byung ba red/bcu bzhi pa/ chos lugs dang chab srid bar gyi 'brel ba/ de yang chos lugs ni dus skabs so so'i dpal 'byor rmang gzhi dang / spyi tshogs kyi cha rkyen nges can zhig gi 'og tu byung ba yin stabs/ dus skabs de'i mang tshogs kyi re 'dun dang / srid gzhung gi khrims lugs bcas dang bstun thub na mang tshogs dang srid gzhung gis rgyab skyor thob thub pa dang /gal te srid gzhung gi khrims lugs dang mthun yang mang tshogs kyi re 'dun dang ma mthun na chos lugs de mang tshogs kyi nang du rkang pa brtan por 'dzugs mi thub cing / mang tshogs kyi re 'dun dang mthun yang srid gzhung gi khrims lugs dang ma mthun na chos lugs de la srid gzhung gis drag gnon byed nges yin cing / skabs der chos pa dang chos dad yod pa'i mang tshogs phyogs gcig tu langs nas srid gzhung de gtor ba'am yang na srid gzhung gis chos lugs de la rtsa med rang bzhin ldan pa'i rdung 146

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog giganadadona'aga'aglengab/ ——rdeg gtong nges yin pa ni bod dang rgya gar/ mes rgyal nang khul bcas la chos lugs dang srid gzhung bar 'gal ba byung ste srid gzhung gis chos lugs gtor ba'i lo rgyus thengs kha shas byung myong yod pa lta bu red/phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ rgyal rabs snga ma rgyal rabs rjes mas gtor ba'i srid 'gyur gyi lo rgyus de 'dzam gling thog gi rgyal khab tshang mar byung myong bar brten gsar du btsugs ma thag pa'i rgyal khab de'i srid gzhung gis mang tshogs kyi nang rmang gzhi rgya che ba'i chos lugs kyi shugs rkyen bed spyad nas rang nyid kyi srid dbang de gnas thabs mi byed ka med yong gi yod cing / chos lugs khag gis kyang rang nyid kyi sngar yod dpal 'byor gyi khe phan dang dmigs bsal dbang cha'i thob thang rang 'jags yong ched gsar du btsugs pa'i srid gzhung der rgyab rten mi bcol ka med yin pa red/ de ni srid dbang lag tu bzung med pa'i chos lugs tshogs pa de tsho'i dbang du byas nas bshad pa zhig yin cing / rang nying kyi lag tu srid dbang bzung mkhan gyi chos lugs tshogs pa'i gnas tshul/ ni de dang mi 'dra ba yod/ bod la cha mtshon te bshad na/ chos lugs tshogs pa des lo rgyus thog srid gzhung gi dbang cha gtan nas bzung med pa khag gcig yod pa/ bka' bdams pa dang zhi byed pa/ khro phu bka/'a brgyud/ stag lung bka' brgyud pa lta bu dang / srid gzhung gi dbang cha bzung myong ba ni sa skya ba/ karma bka' brgyud/ phag gru 'bri gung /tshal pa/ dge lugs bcas yod/ de tsho yang rgyal nang gi dus rabs richa/ pa'i srid gzhung gis sprad pa'i dbang char brten nas bod sa gnas kyi 147

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/srid dbang bzung ba zhig las rang btsan rang bdag gis srid dbang bzung ba zhig min cing / yon rgyal rabs dang / ming rgyal rabs/ man ching rgyal rabs bcas kyis kyang dus skabs de'i bod kyi mang tshogs nang shugs rkyen che ba'i chos lugs gang yin pa de'i mtshan snyan dang stobs shugs bed spyad nas bod dang sog po sogs mi rigs grangs nyung sa khul du dbang sgyur byas pa zhig yin pa ma gtogs mchod yon sbyin bdag gi 'brel ba rkyang pa min/ mchod yon sbyin bdag gi 'brel ba ni chos lugs kyi 'brel ba'i go don rkyang pa yin cing / srid kyi dbang cha ni sbyin bdag rgyal po'i lag par bzung yod pa rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang / lo tsā ba be ro tsa na gnyis kyi 'brel ba dang / hu pe li se chen han dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i bar gyi 'brel ba/ karma pa dang ming rgyal rabs bar gyi 'brel ba bcas chos lugs kyi 'brel ba'i thog nas bshad na mchod gnas dang yon bdag bar gyi 'brel ba yin kyang / srid dbang gi thog nas bshad na/ mchod gnas la yod pa'i srid dbang de yang sbyin bdag rgyal pos gnang ba'i srid dbang yin pa ni tham ka bed sbyod byed stangs kyi thog nas gsal por mthong thub/ der brten bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs byung ba dang yon rgyal rabs kyi dus nas bod dang mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur byung ba gnyis bar 'brel ba dam po yod/ de skor zhib phra 〈 bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa 〉zhes pa'i nang gsal bas 'dir zhu rgyu min/bco lnga pa/ chos lugs phan tshun bar gyi 'gal ba/ de ni chos 148

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog giganadadona'aga'aglengab/ da wa— —lugs mi 'dra ba phan tshun bar dang chos lugs tshogs pa gcig gi nang khul bar mi mthun pa'i 'gal ba yod pa la zer/ 'gal ba de'i yong rkyen ni phyogs gnyis yod pa ste/ gcig ni chos lugs khag so so'i stobs shugs khyab khongs dang dpal 'byor rten gzhi 'phrogs res byed pa'i thog nas byung ba dang / gcig shos ni chos lugs thog gi tshul mi mthun pa'i rtsod gleng gi thog nas byung ba zhig yin/ 'gal ba de gnyis gang ltar yang 'phel rgyas kyi tshad gzhi nges can zhig la slebs skabs mi rigs dang mi rigs phan tshun bar dang mi rigs gcig gi nang khul bar gyi 'gal bar 'gyur ldog byung na dus skabs de'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyis bed spyod byas thog phyogs khag gcig la rgyab skyor byas nas phyogs khag gzhan zhis gtor ba'am phyogs gnyis ka re re byas nas gtor ba'i thabs shes la brten nas rang nyid kyi dbang sgyur sra brtan yong ba byed kyi yod pa de ni chos lugs phan tshun dang chos lugs gcig gi nang khul mthun sgril med pa'i rkyen gyis mi rigs gcig gi nang khul mthun sgril med pa chags pa zhig yin cing go skabs de dang bstun nas rgyal khab phyi nang gi dgra bos bed spyod btang ste rang gi mi rigs la gnod 'tshe chen po btang gi yod pa'i lo rgyus kyi bslab bya de nam yang brjed mi rung ba'i thog da lta krung bo gung khran tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus yang dag pa lag len bstar nas chos dad rang mos kyi gnas tshul bzang po shar yod pa'i skabs 'dir chos lugs phan tshun bar dang chos lugs rang rang so so'i nang khul gyi phyogs ris dang 'gal ba sna tshogs kyi 'gos nad rnying /49

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i nad ro bskyar langs gtan nas mi yong ba'i sngon 'gog byed dgos/bcu drug pa/ chos lugs kyi sgrig gzhi/ chos lugs ni rang rang so sor thog ma'i slob dpon yod pa dang / gcig gyur gyi dmigs yul/thun mong gi slob gso/ sgrig 'dzugs dang sgrig khrims/ dpal 'byor lam lugs bcas yod par brten sgrig gzhi dang tshogs pa rgya che tsam yod/des rgyal khab phyi nang gi lo rgyus thog chos lugs tshogs pa khag gis btsan rgyal ring lugs la ngo rgol dang rang gi mes rgyal srung skyob byed rgyu/ 'dzam gling zhi bde srung skyob byed rgyu bcas kyi thad la nus pa chen po 'don thub yod/ srid dbang 'dzin mkhan gyi tang dang rgyal khab srid gzhung bcas kyis chos lugs tshogs pa khag dang chos dad mang tshogs kyi dad mos/chos lugs byed sgo bcas la tshod 'dzin dang bkag 'gog byas na/ kho tsho'i bsam blo'i thog gi brtse gdung la garnad 'tshe phog rgyu nges can la brten tang dang srid gzhung gi dbu khrid rnam pa tshos chos lugs tshogs pa khag gi sgrig gzhi de rgya che chung gang 'dra zhig gi thog la bzhag dgos min thad gzab nan gyis dgongs bzhes gnang dgos pa'i gnad don gsum ste/ (1)sgrig gzhi rgya che ru gtong rgyu/ (2)rgya chung du gtong rgyu/ (3)da yod sgrig gzhi rang 'jags ma gtogs gsar pa mi 'dzugs pa bcas red/dang po sgrig gzhi rgya che ru gtong rgyu ni rgyal khab dang chos lugs tshogs pa khag gnyis kar dka' ngal yod/ gcig nas rgyal khab mi grangs mang ba dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong rgyur 'gal ba yod pa 150

bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug thog gi gnad don 'ga' gleng ba/ —dang / gnyis nas chos lugs tshogs pa khag tshang mas rang kha rang gso'i 'tsho ba skyel rgyu'i zhib phra'i gnad don thag gcod thub med pas/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og sgrig gzhi rgya che ru btang na dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen legs pa'i dgon pa khag gis ma gtogs dgon pa dang tshogs pa mang che bas bsgrub thabs med/gnyis pa/ sgrig gzhi rgya chung du gtong rgyu de la zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs so sor bya thabs mi 'dra ba yod/ (1)dgon pa khag gi grwa grangs tshad nges can zhig tu tshod 'dzin byed rgyu/ (2)da yod dgon pa lha khang ma gtogs gsar pa mi 'dzugs pa/ (3)them tho med pa'i grwa pa dgon pa'i nang mi 'jug pa/ (4)srid gzhung gis chog mchan ma thob par dgon par dpal 'byor thog gi rogs skyor mi byed pa/ (5)grwa pa'i 'bor grangs de shan re'i mi 'bor gyi stong cha gcig las brgal mi chog pa bcas lag len bstar 'go tshugs yod/gsum pa/ da yod sgrig gzhi rang 'jags su bzhag nas gsar pa mi 'dzugs pa de'i thad la yang gnad don mang po yod/ da lta'i gnas tshul ni dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen legs pa'i dgon pa nyung shas ma gtogs mang che ba da yod kyi sgrig gzhi 'thus sgo mi tshang ba sha stag red/(1)dgon pa khag gcig grwa grangs nyung la/ dpe cha slob mkhan dge rgan mi ldeng ba/(2)'ga' re grwa grangs mang tsam yod kyang bdag gnyer byed rgyur dka' ngal che ba/ (3)'ga' re grwa grangs nyung ngu zhig las med pa de yang rang kha rang gso bya rgyur dka' ngal che ba/ (4)'ga' re grwa /51

chas spras pa'i grwa gzugs tsam las shes yon gzhan phar zhog sdom pa yang med pa bcas kyi gnas tshul tshabs chen yin pas dngos 'brel byas na da yod sgrig gzhi rang 'jags su 'jog thabs med cing / gal srid rang babs su bzhag na lo kha shas las ma song bar dgon pa mang che ba rtsa stongs su 'gro rgyu nges can red/

sems gco smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i nabye— —dngos gtso smra ba 'dres nas yod pa/deng skabs rgyal spyi'i thog chos lugs khag gi mtshan nyid rig pa la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byed mkhan mang po yod thog rgyal nang du'ang mes rgyal dbu brnyes pa nas chos lugs spyi dang / lhag par du sangs rgyas chos lugs dang / bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs bcas la zhib 'jug byed 'go tshugs nas lo mang song ba dang / zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi sde tshan dang / mi sger bcas je mang du 'gro bzhin yod pa bcas ni ha cang dga' spro skye dgos pa'i bya ba bzang po zhig red/ krung go khung khran tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus ni dngos thog bden 'tshol dang / lo rgyus dngos gtso smra ba'i srid jus yin stabs de lag len mthar phyin pa bstar dgos na/ lag len bstar mkhan gyi mi tshang mas chos lugs mi sna dang / chos lugs bsam blo'i don gnad thad la 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur yang dag pa zhig dgos pa dang / chos lugs khag gi mtshan nyid rig par go ba gting zab lon pa byas thog de dang mthun pa'i dngos gtso smra ba'i srid jus lag len bstar dgos kyi red/ bya ba dang dngos po rnams kyi 'byung rkyen dang / chos nyid/ gnas tshul bcas zhib phra shes rtogs byed pa ma byung na rang nyid kyi lag len de mun 'thoms kyi lag len du 'gyur 'gro ba de dang 'dra bar lo ngo stong phrag mang por mi'i bsam blor /53

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/shugs rkyen gting zab thebs pa'i chos lugs bsam blo'i don gnad der dngos gtso smra ba'i lta tshul bzung nas srid jus lag len bstar mkhas po zhig yong ba byed dgos na/ dngos su lag len byed mkhan gyi mis chos lugs khag gi mtshan nyid rig pa la go ba gting zab lon pa byed dgos/der brten ngas sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang 'brel ba yod pa'i don gnad kha shas dpyad gzhir bshad rgyu gsham gsal/1 sems gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i nang dngos gtso smra ba'i lta tshul mang po 'dres nas yod pa/ 'jig rten thog gi bya ba dang dngos po tshang mar phyi'i snang tshul dang ngo bo gnyis yod pa'i nang nas ngo bo ngo ma de ngos 'dzin byed skabs rang rang so so'i phyi'i snang tshul brgyud nas ngos 'dzin byed pa ma gtogs phyi'i snang tshul de ma brgyud par ngo bo ngo ma de ngos 'dzin byed mi thub/ phyi'i snang tshul de ni ngo bo mtshon pa'i rtags mtshan yin pas de la mtshan ma zer zhing /snang tshul de la nges can gyi ngo bo dang chos nyid cig yod pas de 'dra'i mtshan ma dang / chos nyid gnyis zung du 'brel nas brtag dpyad bya thabs kyi rigi pa de la mtshan nyid rig pa zhes pa'i ming btags pa red/ de 'dra'i mtshan nyid rig pa la bya dngos so so'i gnas tshul dngos dang mthun pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa zhig dang / gnas tshul dngos dang mi mthun pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa gnyis yod pas dang po de la dngos gtso smra ba zer zhing / rjes ma de la sems gtso smra ba zer/ mtshan nyid rig pa de gnyis yang phyi rol yul gyi snang tshul dngos de gzhir bzung nas rang rang so so'i 154

sems gtso smra ba'i nang dngos gtsosmraba'adresanasayodapa/ da wa—rigs pa'i gzhung lugs shig bton pa yin pa las/ snang tshul dngos dang kha bral nas rang bzos byed mi thub/ dngos gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pas bya dngos de'i snang tshul brgyud nas ngo bo ngo ma yang dag par mtshon thub kyi yod pa dang / sems gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pas snang tshul brgyud nas ngo bo ngo ma yang dag par mtshon mi thub/ mtshan nyid rig pa gong 'phel 'gro ba'i go rim nang dngos gtso smra ba dang / sems gtso smra ba 'dres nas 'phel rgyas 'gro ba dang / phan tshun 'thab rtsod byas pa brgyud rim bzhin gong mthor 'gro ba ma gtogs/ phan tshun ma 'dres pa dang /phan tshun 'thab rtsod ma byas par kher rkyang rang tshugs su gnas pa'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas dang / gong mthor 'gro mi thub/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs dang / 'jig rten thog gi snang tshul sna tshogs pa de tsho'i nang nas 'ga' zhig ni ngo bo ngo ma mtshon pa'i snang tshul yin pa dang /'ga' zhig ni ngo bo ngo ma bsgribs pa'i snang tshul rdzun ma zhig yin cing /snang tshul rdzun ma dang ngo ma gnyis rtag par mnyam du 'dres nas yod pas/sna nga tshul brdzun/ ma gzhir bzung nas bzos pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs de sems gtso smra ba yin pa dang / snang tshul ngo ma gzhir bzung nas bzos pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs de dngos gtso smra ba red/ deng skabs mi 'ga' zhig gis sems gtso smra ba dang dngos gtso smra ba'i khyad par de/sems gtso smra bas sems ang dang po yin pa dang / dngos po ang gnyis pa yin pa khas len gyi yod ces gsal ba de yang dag pa min/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mtha' rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa sus kyang sems /55

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de dang por byung ba dang / dngos po de rjes su byung ba/ dngos po tshang ma sems kyis bzos pa yin zer mkhan rgya gar dang / rgya nag bod gang du'ang med/ rgya gar dang / rgya nag tu byung ba'i sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' la'ang de 'dra med la/ bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung gang du'ang de 'dra med/ sa skya'i chos lugs dang / bka' brgyud chos lugs kyi bla ma gong ma tshos brtsams pa'i mgur dang rtsom yig gi nang snang ba thams cad sems yin gsung ba dang / 'khrul snang tshang ma sems las byung zhes gsal/de ni sems de dang por byung ba dang / dngos po de de'i rjes su byung ba'i go don rtsa ba nas min/ de ni dngos po de 'gyur ba med pa dang / dngos po de rgyu rkyen gang la'ang ma ltos par rang tshugs kher rkyang du gnas pa'i 'char snang zhig yong gi yod pa de rang nyid kyi ngos 'dzin yang ma dag pa la brten nas byung ba ma gtogs/ rang la 'char snang byung ba ltar don dngos su yod pa zhig min/ gal te 'char snang yang ma dag pa de rang gi ngos 'dzin yang ma dag pa la brten nas byung ba ma gtogs don dngos kho rang gi steng du de 'dra yod pa la brten nas byung ba min/ rang la nor 'khrul gyi 'char snang byung ba don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i 'char snang yin par brten 'char snang byung ba ltar don dngos su med/ nor 'khrul gyi 'char snang de rang gi bsam blo'i ngos 'dzin yang ma dag pa la brten nas byung ba yin zhes gsungs pa red/'dir dpe zhig bshad na/ thag pa khra bo zhig 'khyil nas sdod pa'i steng du mun pa cung zad babs pa'i skabs/ de sngon sbrul khra bo mthong myong 156

sems gtso smra ba'i nang dngos gtsosmraba'adresanasayodapa/ —da ———ba'i mi zhig gis glo bar du mthong na/ 'di ni sbrul yin no snyam nas 'jigs snang skye ba de/ sbrul dang 'dra ba'i thag pa khra bo de cha rkyen nges can zhig gi 'og sbrul khra bo dngos yin pa'i 'khrul snang yong thub cing / 'khrul snang de mi des sngar sbrul khra bo mthong myong ba'i myong tshor de la brten nas rang sems kyis bzos pa zhig yin/ de sngon sbrul khya bo dngos su mthong ma myong ba'i mis gong gsal gyi cha rkyen de 'dzoms na yang thag pa khra bo de la 'di sbrul yin no snyam pa'i 'char snang dang bsam tshul yong mi thub/ der brten bya dngos thog gi snang tshul brdzun ma la ngo mar 'khrul ba'i 'char snang gang byung ba tshang ma bya dngos thog gi snang tshul brdzun ma la brten nas byung yang / snang tshul brdzun ma de bsam blo yang ma dag pa'i 'byung rtsa ma yin par/ de'i 'byung rtsa ngo ma ni brdzun ma de ngo mar 'phrul ba'i nor 'khrul gyi bsam blo de yin/ de 'dra'i bsam blo de nor 'khrul yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / bsam blo der byung ba'i 'char snang de don dngos dang mi mthun pa der thug yod/ gal te bsam blo yang ma dag pa'i 'char snang de yang don dngos la brten na sa byung ba yin na/ 'char snang de don dngos dang mthun pa'i 'char snang zhig yin dgos zer/ gong gsal gyi shod stangs der ngas bltas na dngos gtso smra ba yin pa las/ sems gtso smra ba min/2 de dang 'dra bar stong pa nyid zer ba yang / phyi rol yul du dngos su yod pa'i dngos po tshang ma rang rang so so'i rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas byung ba ma gtogs/ kher rkyang rang tshugs su byung ba'i dngos po gcig kyang /57

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/med pa de la stong pa nyid zer ba las/ dngos su yod pa'i dngos po tshang ma gang yang med pa'i stong pa yin par khas len pa'i sangs rgyas chos lugs pa rgya gar dang / rgya nag bod gang du'ang med/ sangs rgyas chos lugs pas rang bzhin gyis byung ba med zer ba'i go don dang / deng sang rang bzhin gyis byung ba yod zer ba'i go don gnyis rtsa ba nas mi 'dra/sangs rgyas chos lugs pas rang bzhin gyis byung ba med zer ba'i go don/bya dngos tshang ma rgyu dang rkyen la brten nas byung ba ma gtogs/ rgyu dang rkyen la ma ltos par rang bzhin gyis byung ba med zer ba'i don yin pas/de yang dngos gtso smra ba'i lta ba yin cing / deng sang rang bzhin gyis byung ba yod zer ba'i go don ni mis bzos pa la ltos mi dgos par rang bzhin gyis byung ba yod pa'i don yin pas de yang dngos gtso smra ba'i lta ba red/lta ba de gnyis tshig gi thog nas 'gal ba yod kyang don gyi thog nas 'gal ba med par ma zad/ don dngos dang mthun gyi yod pa red/3 sangs rgyas chos lugs pas/ mthar thug pa'i bden don yod zer ba yang dngos gtso smra ba yin/ kho tshos bden don ngo ma zhig yin phyin/lung pa gang 'dra zhig dang / dus tshod gang 'dra zhig gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig gi 'og tu yang spyi tshogs thog gi mi ches mang che bas khas len pa de ni mthar thug gi bden don yin/ dper na/ nyes pa med par zhwa mo g.yogs pa dang / nyes pa med par mi gsod pa/ mi gzhan gyi rgyu nor phrogs pa sogs ni bya spyod ngan pa yin pa dang / rang don dor nas gzhan don sgrub pa/ skad cha drang po shod pa/ las ka drang po byed pa/ bden pa yod pa'i mi 158

sems gtso smra ba'i nang dngos gtsosmraba'adresanasayodapa/ da wa da la rgyab skyor byed pa sogs bya spyod bzang po yin pa bcas ni dus skabs gang 'dra zhig dang / gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig gi 'og tu yang spyi tshogs thog gi mi ches mang che bas khas len pa'i bden don zhig yin cing /bden don de la 'gyur ba nam yang yong mi srid pas/ mthar thug pa'i bden don yin zer gyi yod/ de yang dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun pa'i dngos gtso smra ba yin/4 mi zhig tshad ldan yin dang min gyi tshad gzhi de mi de la rgyab skyor byed mkhan mang nyung thog nas blta rgyu min par/ mi des bshad pa'i skad cha de dang bsam blo de dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun na mi de tshad ldan yin pa dang / de min na tshad ldan min/ der brten skabs re mi mang che bas bshad pa de dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun pa dang / skabs re mi nyung shas kyis bshad pa de dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun pa yong gi yod pas/ sus bshad pa'i skad cha de dang bsam blo de dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun na mi de tshad ldan red zer/ shod stangs de yang don dngos dang mthun pa zhig red/ 5 yang / sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nang nas theg pa chen po'i chos lugs kyi nang / bya spyod ngan pa tshang ma.oṃ rang rang so so'i sger sems la brten nas byung ba red/ sger sems pa'i mi la bya spyod ngan pa gtan nas med zer ba de yang dngos gtso skyab red/ gang yin zer na/ kho tshos 'di 'dra shod kyi yod pa ste/ 'jig rten thog gi bya spyod ngan pa tshang ma sger sems la brten nas byung ba yin/ dper na/ rkun ma rku ba dang / mi gsod 159

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa/ brdzun shod pa/ dbyen sbyor dkrugs shing byed pa/ 'dzing res byed pa/rgyu nor 'phrog pa/ mgo skor bslu khrid byed pa sogs tshang ma rang gi khe phan blos ma btang ba la brten nas byung ba sha stag yin pas de dag yong sa'i rtsa ba rang nyid la yod pa'i sger sems de gtor thub na bya spyod ngan pa de tsho yong don med/ sger sems de med pa bzo ba ha cang gis khag po yod pas thog mar gom pa dang por mi rnams kyi bya spyod ngan pa bkag 'gog byed rgyu dang / mi rnams rang rtogs yod pa'i sgo nas bya spyod bzang po ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur ldog yong ched/ btsan shed kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i spyi tshogs kyi sgrig khrims dang / slob grwa'i sgrig khrims/ chosartsolugs kyi sgrig khrims bcas sgrig khrims khag gsum la brten nas mi rnams gcun te bya spyod ngan pa bkag 'gog byed dgos/ de nas go rim gnyis pa la bsam blo'i thog nas slob gso byed rgyu ste/ bya spyod ngan pa de tsho'i gnod skyon dang /bya spyod bzang po'i dge mtshan bshad de dngos yod kyi mig dpe bstan na/mi rnams rang rtogs dang rang 'gul thog nas sgrig khrims srung mkhan zhig tu 'gyur ldog yong thub/ go rim gsum po kla bya spyod ngan pa de tsho'i 'byung rtsa sger sems yin pas de med pa bzo ba'i slob gso byed rgyu yin/ de la dus yun ha cang ring po dgos shing de la tshad yod pa'i sger gyi khe phan la blta rtog dang / srung skyob/ tshad med pa'i sger gyi khe phan bkag 'gog byas te rim bzhin mi rnams sger sems chung du song nas mthar sger sems med pa'i mi zhig tu 'gyur thub pa dang / mi tshang ma sger sems med pa'i mi zhig tu gyur mtshams spyi tshogs de chese bde skyid ldan pa dang / dpal 160

sems gtso smra ba'i nang dngos gtsosmraba'adresanasayodapa/ —— da ———'byor phun sum tshogs shing dmag 'khrugs med pa zhig tu 'gyur thub ces bshad kyi yod/ de yang don dngos dang mthun pa'i dngos gtso ba smra ba red/der brten sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs nang sems gtso smra ba dang dngos gtso smra ba gnyis ka 'dres nas yod pa'i dpe mang po bshad rgyu yod pas sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa la zhib 'jug dang brtag dpyad byed rin yod pa zhig yin pa dang / zhib 'jug byed pa brgyud nas sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bsam blo de lo ngo stong phrag gnyis lhag tsam ring mi rnams kyi bsam blor bag chag gting zab yong ba'i rgyu rkyen gang yin dang deng sang tshan rig dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab nang du yang da dung mu mthud nas gnas thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin gsal por shes thub pa ma zad/ mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i don gnad yin pa'i chos lugs kyi bya spyod dang bsam blor lta stangs yang dag pa dang /srid jus yang dag pa ga 'dra 'dzin dgos min yang gsal por shes thub rgyu red/ 'dir ngas lo ngo sum cu lhag tsam ring sangs rgyas chos lugs la zhib 'jug byas pa'i lta tshul khag gcig thengs dang por dpyad gzhi'i tshul du bris pa yin pas/ gzigs pa po rnams kyis skyon brjod dang / legs bcos kyi dgongs 'char lhug por gnang rogs zhu rgyu bcas/
