bod gna' rabs kyi rig gnas dang /chos lugs/ mi rigs bcas kyi 'byung khungs skor gleng ba/mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i tang krung dbyang gi dbu khrid yang dag pa'i 'og dang tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i lam ston 'og mi rigs khag gi rig gnas dang / chos/ lugs/lo rgyus bcas la zhib 'jug brtag dpyad byed pa'i tshan pa dang tshogs/ pa mang po char shul gyi smyug rtsa rgyas pa ltar gong 'phel 'gro ba dang dus mtshungs bod kyi lo rgyus rig pa'i ched las mkhas pa mang pos rang rang so so'i dgongs tshul gsal por mtshon pa'i rtsom yig gcig mjug gnyis mthud du spel gnang mdzad pa dang / ched don gros bsdur tshogs 'du skong tshogs gnang ba sogs brgyud nas rgya che'i klog pa po dang zhib 'jug pa rnams la mthong rgya che ba'i mig gsar pa rnyed pa dang blo skyed gsar pa thob yod pa 'di ni rang ljongs kyi deng rabs can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun dang bod mi rigs kyi ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam thad la don snying chen po yod pa'i bya ba zhig red/ der brten rang nyid kyis lo shas ring slob khrid kyi las 'gan 'khur ba'i zhor la 'brel yod bod kyi rig gnas dang /chos lugs/ mi rigs bcas kyi 'byung khungs skor la zhib 'jug brtag dpyad phran bu byas pa'i shes tshor 'ga' zhig dpyad gzhi'i tshul du zhu rgyu 162

bod kyi rig gnas dang / chos lugs/ mi rigs bcasakyi'abyungakhungasaskor/ da yin pas gzigs pa po tshos skyon brjod dang legs bcos kyi dgongs 'char gnang rogs zhu rgyu/dang po/ bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas kyi 'go ga dus tshugs pa dang rig gnas dang chos lugs gnyis bar 'brel ba gang 'dra yod pa'i skor/da yod bod kyi lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs khag dang gna' rabs bon gyi lo rgyus yig rigs 'ga' zhig kho bos mthong myong ba de tshor zhib tu brtags skabs bod pa la sangs rgyas chos lugs ma byung gong ste spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo brgya phrag kha shas kyi dus nas bod la rig gnas yod pa ma zad/ 'ga' zhig ni rig gnas kyi tshad cung zad mtho zhing tshan rig dang ha cang nye po yod pa de 'dra zhig red/ dper na/ spyi lo'i gong gi lo brgya phrag gnyis yas mas kyi dus su (rang rgyal gyi han nub ma'i rgyal rabs kyi gong ma han u rdis dang dus mtshungs)bod kyi rgyal po dang po gnya' khri btsan po byung zhing / khong gis srid dbang bzung skabs bon shes pa can bcu gnyis zor ba zhig yod pa dang / de'i nang gses skor shes rtsis mkhan zer ba de ni gnam gyi nyi zla skar gsum gyi bgrod tshul nges pa can la brten nas sa steng du dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog gang 'dra yod pa dang / de'i chos nyid dang bstun nas zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi las ka bkod sgrig byed pa la 163

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin lasarmya gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ mkhas pa'i bon po yin pa dang / khong tshos skar ma'i gzugs dbyibs mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos gzhir bzung nas rgyu skar nyer bdun so sor ming re btags yod pa ste skar ma bra nye zer ba ni gna' rabs bon gyi skar ma'i ming rang sor gnas pa dang / smin drug la nya drug snar ma la bi rdzi/mgo la smal po/ lag ni gna' rabs kyi ming / nabs so la rgyal stod/rgyal la rgya' smad/ skag la wa/ mchu la rta chen/ gre la rta chung / dbo la phra/ me bzhi la bya ma/ nag pa la bya'u/ sa ri la gong / sa ga la nam 'ogalha mtshams la lag sor/ snon la lde'u/ snubs la sog pa/ chu stod la bre/chu smad la phul/ gro bzhin la bya spo/ byi bzhin la bya gzhug mon gre la sgrog stod/ mon gru la sgrog smad/ khrums stod la bya mchu/ khrums smad la ze'u/ nam gru la she sa/ tha skar la dbyug pa bcas zer zhing / deng sang yang zhing 'brog khul du rgan rabs rnams kyis skar ma'i ming de ltar 'bod srol yod pa ma zad/ smal po'i char brtag pa zhes pa bod zla lnga pa'i nang skar ma smal po(mgo)shar ba'i rjes kyi zhag nyi shu'i nang char babs dang ma babs la brten nas sad ser dang / zhod skyon yod med brtag pa/ skyor kha brtag pa zhes bod zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer bdun dang / bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga/ bod zla dang po'i tshes nyi shu gsusdu bcas la dgong mo'i zla ba dang mnyam du shar lho'i phyogs nas skar ma lag sor (lha mtshams)zhes pa mi'i lag pa'i bzo dbyibs dang 'dra ba zhig shar yong ba de'i gnas gang du zla ba yod med bltas te lo rjes ma'i char chu mang nyung dang / than zhod/ sad ser/ 'bu gnod bcas yod med 164

bod kyi rig gnas dang / chos lugs/ mi rigasabacasakyi'abyungakhungasaspyor/ da brtag pa/ nya drug brtag pa zhes bod zla bcu pa'i nang skar ma smin drug dang zla ba mnyam du 'grogs nas nam tshod 'dzin gyi yod pas tshes bco lnga'i dgong mo skar ma smin drug de zla ba'i rgyab mdun g.yas g.yon gang du yod med bltas te lo rjes ma'i lo tog legs nyes brtag pa sogs gna' rabs bon dang / zhing 'brog rgan po'i nyams myong kha rgyun mang po zhig ni bod sa gnas rang gi dmigs bsal rang bzhin ldan pa'i nyams myong sha stag yin/ gzhan yang skar rtsis rig pa'i thad spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo brgya phrag gcig yas mas su btsan po spu de gung rgyal gyi dus zhing 'brog thon skyed gong 'phel chen po byung ba dang dus mtshungs lho kha yar klungs khul du thags mkhan rgan mo bal ma zer ba zhig byung ba des zla ba'i gzugs dbyibs 'gyur ldog la brten nas zla zhag dang / dus bzhi brtsi ba'i zla rtsisakyi srol gtod pa dang / rjes su zla rtsis kyi dus bzhi dang / dngos yod kyi dus bzhi tag tag ma 'phrod pa'i 'gal ba byung rjes nyi ma'i grib gzugs la brten nas nyi ma lho bgrod dang byang bgrod/ dpyid mnyam dang / ston mnyam/ dbyar nyi ldog dang / dgun nyi ldog bcas kyi chos nyid shes rtogs byung ste nyin rtsis dang zla rtsis zung 'brel gyi skar rtsis byung ba sogs ni bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs ma byung gong gi lo rgyus sha stag red la bon po'i chos lugs dang 'brel ba yod med sna tshogs pa zhig yod/gso ba rigachapa'i thog nas bshad na/ bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs ma byung gong gi lo brgya phrag kha shas kyi dus nas rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis sa gnas rang bzhin ldan pa'i nad rigs sna tshogs la 'thab rtsod byas pa /65

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsungartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wabargyud bod kyi yul thon skye dngos dang / rtsi shing / gter rdzas/ srog chags sogs kyi sman la brten nas nad gso ba'i chos nyid ngos 'dzin thub ste de'i mjug bsdoms la dug yod na sman yod ces pa'i rtsod sgrub rig pa dang mthun pa'i bshad tshul bkod yod pa der dug kyang sman du bsgyur thub pa'i rdzas sbyor rig pa yang 'dus yod/ gzhan yang mar la brten nas khrag gcod pa dang / chang la brten nas rma bcos pa sogs rdzas sbyor rig pa la brten nas nad bcos thabs gna' snga mo nas shes yod/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo brgya phrag kha shas gong gi bod kyi rgyal po dang po gnya' khri btsan pos srid dbang bzung skabs su byung ba'i bon shes pa can bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan phan shes sman dpyad zer ba ni gna' rabs bon gyi sman pa mkhas pa zhig yin pa da yod yig cha khag gi nang gsal ba dang / lhag par du tun hong nas thon pa'i gna' rabs bod kyi sman gzhung mdor bsdus shig gi nang spang rgyan dang / gur gum/ lcum rtsa sogs skye dngos rigs kyi sman sna kha nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gla rtsi dang dom mkhris sogs srog chags las byung ba'i sman sna kha nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gser g.yu dngul chu/ rgya tshwa sogs gter kha'i rigs las byung ba'i sman sna kha bdun bcas la brten nas sman bcos bya tshul 'khod yod pa ma zad/ sman bcos bya tshul de dag nang nas mang po zhig deng sang yang lag len bstar mus su yod pa dang / da dung sman gzhung de'i nang 'khod don du/ dpyad 'di ni zhang zhung gi dpyad phug pa dang sbyar te bgyid pa lags so zhes gna' rabs zhang zhung sman bcos nas 'byung ba bzhin du sman bcos bya tshul 166

bod kyi rig gnas dang / chos lugs/ mi rigs bcas kyi 'byung khungs skor/ —zhig yin par gsal por bshad yod pas gna' rabs zhang zhung gi yul ni bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs ma byung gong gi lo stong phrag yas mas kyi skabs nas bon chos ha cang dar rgyas che ba'i yul zhig yin pa'i thog bong mi rigs kyi gna' rabs rig gnas khag gcig zhang zhung gi rig gnas nas byung ba dang / khag gcig zhang zhung gi rig gnas dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa zhig yin/lo rgyus rig pa'i thad nas mtshon na/ gna' rabs bod kyi bon chos nang du 'byung ba sna lnga'i snying po las sgo nga chen po gcig byung ba/ phyi'i sgong shun dkar po las lha brag dkar po chags/ nang gi sgong chu las dung mtsho dkar mer 'khyil/ bar gyi sgo nga'i ngar cha las rigs drug sems can kun tu grol/ zhes 'jig rten chags tshul dang srog chags byung tshul bshad yod pa 'dir brtags na/ deng sang lta bu'i tshan rig dar rgyas ma byung gong gi spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo brgya phrag kha shas kyi skabs nas gna' rabs bod kyi mis rang cag 'tsho gnas byed pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'byung ba sna lnga'i snying po 'dus nas grub pa dang / de'i bzo dbyibs kyang cung zad 'jong mo yin pa'i zlum gzugs sgo nga'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba/sgo nga de'i grub cha phyi nang rim pa gsum yod pa'i phyi pags las brag ri sogs skam sa chags pa dang / nang gi sgong chu las rgya mtsho chen po chags pa/ bar gyi sgo nga'i dar cha'am snying bcud las mi dang dud 'gro sogs srog chags kyi rigs byung ba sogs bshad thub yod pa de ni snga rabs shis la rgyal khab kyi tshan rig mkhas pa h+pha tā ko la si dang dus mnyam pa dang 67

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtshan nyid rig pa'i mkhas pa ya li tri to te las lo sum brgya lhag tsam gyi snga ba yod/ de dang 'dra bar bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs ma byung gong du dmangs khrod du khyab che ba'i bshad rgyun 'di 'dra zhig yod/ bod kyi mi rigs ni thog mar lho kha rtsed thang du byung ba dang / de yang pha spre'u dang ma brag srin mo ste spra mo (de sngon lo nyis brgya tsam gyi gong rol du sde dger par bskrun byas pa'i 〈 ma ṇi bka' 'bum 〉par rnying zhig gi nang / brag srin mo zhes pa'i thad du spra mo zhes 'khod yod )gnyis 'dus pa las mi min sprel min gyi phru gu drug byung ba de las rigs brgyud khag mang por gyes te khag gcig mon dang / dwags po/ kong po sogs nags tshal mang ba'i sa char gnas spos byas pa dang / khag gcig lho kha'i sa gnas de rang du gzhis chags nas yun ring song rjes za rung ba'i shing tog dang / 'bras bu'i rigs rnams zad de rim bzhin sa la zags pa'i 'bras bu lo tog rnams lo rjes ma slar yang rang bzhin gyis skye bar mthong nas lo tog sa la 'debs rgyu'i myong tshor byung ba nas zhing las byed 'go tshugs shing / ma rmos lo tog dang 'bru rigs zos pa'i rjes su lus kyi spu rnams byi thog mjug ma yang chad de mi ma sprel zhig tu gyur pa'i mthar mi ngo ma zhig tu 'gyur ba byung ba yin zhes bshad srol yod/ bshad srol de la rjes su sangs rgyas chos lugs pas kha snon byas te pha spre'u de ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yin pa dang /ma brag srin mo de ni rje btsun sgrol ma'i sprul pa yin pa sogs kyi bshad tshul snon pa btab pa red/ kha snon de 'dra byas pa de sngar yod bod mi byung tshul gyi lo rgyus de tshan rig dang mi mthun pa'i lha sgrung zhig tu gyur 168

bod kyi rig gnas dang / chos lugs/ mi rigs bcas kyi 'byung khungs skor/ —nas rin thang med par chags pa ma zad/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi gzhung gang dang yang mi mthun pa zhig chags pa red/ sangs rgyas chos lugs payokha snon byas pa'i bshod tshul de dor nas sngon yod lo rgyus de rang ma bcos rang babs su bzhag na sangs rgyas chos lugs dang / bon chos gang gi yang dri mas ma gos pa'i lo rgyus tshan rig gi don snying ldan pa zhig dang / bod sa gnas rang du bod mi rang nyid kyis mes po'i 'byung khungs bshad pa'i gtam rgyud ngo mtshar che ba zhig byung yod pa red/ sngon yod bod kyi mi'i 'byung khungs bshad pa'i gtam rgyud de la bzo bcos dang kha snon ma byas par rang babs su bzhag na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi gzhung gang du'ang de 'dra med pas khas len thabs bral ba dang /sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du dar spel gtong dgos na sangs rgyas chos lugs de bod mi rigs kyi rnam pa can du 'gyur ba zhig bya rgyu ni ha cang bi gal chen po yin par mthong nas sngar yod lo rgyus de la kha snon de 'dra zhig bya dgos byung ba mngon gsal red/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas sngar gyi bod kyi mi'i 'byung khungs bshad pa'i gtam rgyud gong gsal de bon gyi chos lugs nas bshad pa min nam snyam pa'i dogs pa zhig de snga nga rang la byung myong yang rjes su bon gyi lo rgyus chos 'byung 'ga' zhig mthong ba'i nang du de la dgag pa rgyag pa gsal por mthong byung bas gong gsal gna' rabs kyi gtam rgyud de ni sangasangargyas chos lugs dang bon chos gang gi yang dri mas ma gos pa'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar can zhig yin pa shes rtogs thub pa byung / gnas tshul de'i thog3sa gna' rabs bod mi'i 69

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'byung khungs bshad pa'i gtam rgyud de la sangs rgyas chos lugs pas kha snon byas pa'i phyogs gcig yod la sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon chos gnyis gang gi yang bshad tshul gtan nas ma 'dres pa dang tshan rig dang ma thun pa'i phyogs gcig kyang yod stabs bod kyi gna' rabs rig gnas yod tshad chos lugs rmongs dad sha stag yin bsam pa'i mthong phyogs nor 'khrul can 'dzin mi rung bar nges par du dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi sgo nas snyigs 'dor bcud len bya dgos pa gal chen po red/ spyi lo'i gong gi lo brgya phrag kha shas nas nye rabs kyi lo brgya phrag yas mas bar gyi mes rgyal nang khul du mi'i rigs kyi thog ma'i 'byung khungs 'chad tshul ni bskal pa ya thog gi dus su gnam dang sa gnyis gcig tu 'brel nas yod pa sgo nga chen po gcig dang 'dra zhing / de'i nang du h+phan ku'u zhes pa'i mi zhig bsdad yod pa des sta re khyer nas sgo nga chen po de gshag pa red ces dang / yang nyus wa hre zer ba'i lha mo zhig byung ba des sa dang chu bsres pa'i 'jim pa las mi gzugs shig bzos te phu btab nas bzhag pa rnams gson por gnas thub pa byung ba nas 'jig rten thog mi thog mar byung ba yin zhes bshad kyi yod pa dang / skabs der phyi rgyal gyi gtam rgyud nang thog mar lha yi dbang pos gnam sa dang nyi zla skar gsum gsar bskrun byas pa dang / de rjes rtsi shing dang srog chags rnams gsar bskrun byas te mthar 'jim pa las mi gzugs skyes pa zhig bzos pa de'i ming la ya teng zer zhing / de nas mi gzugs de'i rtsibs rus shig blangs te bud med gcig bzos pa de'i ming la zhwa wa zer ba de gnyis bza' tshang byed du 170

bod kyi rig gnas dang / chos lugs/ mi rigs bcas kyi 'byung khungs skor/bcug pa las bu tsha mang po skyes pa de nas 'jig rten thog mi thog mar byung ba yin zer ba sogs kyi sgrung gtam yang mang po yod/ deng sang nga tshos rgyun du bshad srol la mi'i rigs kyi thog ma'i mes po spra mi yin pa'i chod gtam thog mar 'don pa gnang mkhan ni dbyin go'i srog chags rig pa mkhas can tar wen yin pa dang / khong gis spyi lo 1859lor 〈 skye dngos rig pa'i 'byung khungs 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb brtsams nas srog chags kyi 'phel 'gyur smra ba thog mar bton pa dang / de rjes spyi lo 1871lor 〈 mi yi rigs kyi 'byung khungs dang pho mo rigs gdam ka rgyag pa 〉zhes pa'i chedasmortsom brtsams nas mi'i rigs la legs skyes chen po 'bul gnang mdzad pa yin zhes bshad kyi yod pa ma red dam/ de 'dra los yin dgos/ 'on kyang mkhas pa chen po khong ma byon gong gi lo chig stong lnga brgya lhag tsam gyi sngon nas rang re bod kyi mis rang gi mi rigs kyi 'byung khungs spre'u dang spra mo 'dus nas byung ba yin zhes bshad thub pa de ni bod mi rigs kyi gzi brjid yin pa ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs yongs kyi gzi brjid kyang yin zhes bshad chog pa 'dugader brten sangs rgyas chos lugs ma byung gong gi bod kyi rig gnas ni bon chos dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa yang mang po zhig bshad rgyu yod la chos lugs dang 'brel ba gtan nas med pa yang mang po bshad rgyu yod/de dang phyogs mtshungs chos lugs dpe deb kyi nang du yod tshad chos kyi nang don sha stag yin par ngos 'dzin byed mi rung / rlabs chen gyi gsar brje'i slob dpon si tā lin gyis 〈 sgra rig pa'i gnad don skor mar khe si /7/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ring lugs ltar lan btab 〉 ces pa'i nang ming tshig khyad par can ni brjod bya khyad par can ltar skad kyi nang du shin tu nyung bas skad kyi rgyu cha'i brgya cha gcig tsam yang yod med gcig yin/ de min gyi ming tshig ches mang ba ni de dag gi go ba dang 'dra bar spyi tshogs kyi gral rim tshang mar thun mong ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs yod pa ltar chos skad ni chos lugs thog gi dmigs bsal go don ldan pa'i ming tshig khyad par can nyung shas shig la zer ba yin pas de rnams phud/ de min gyi skad cha dang tshig sgrub ha cang mang po zhig ni mi'i rigs gnas dang 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang nas byung ba'i tshig sbyor dang tha snyad gson nyams ldan pa sha stag yin pas tshig sbyor de dag med na chos skad rkyang pas skad cha shod mi thub pa yin/gzhan yang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos dpe'i nang du yod tshad tshang ma rmongs dad kyi nang don sha stag ma yin par deng sang gi tshan rig dang mthun pa'i bshad tshul yang mang po yod pa 'dir dpe mtshon 'ga' zhig bshad na/ nga tshos rgyun du bshad srol la gnam la 'brug skad rgyag pa dang /glog 'khyug pa/ thog rgyag pa sogs ni gnam la 'brug zer ba'i srog chags gzugs ring zhing lus yongs la nya khrab kyi pags pa lta bu'i ri mo yod pa/ sprin la brten nas nam mkhar 'gro ba/ ngar ba'i skad sgrogs pa/skabs re rgya mtsho'i nang du 'dzul nas sdod pa/ sprin gseb tu glog 'khyug pa de ni 'brug gi lce brkyang pa yin pa/ skad chen po sgrogs pa ni 'brug gi ngar skad yin pa/ thog rgyag pa ni lha srin sde brgyad khros pa yin zer ba sogs kyi bshad tshul rnams sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rmongs dad bshad 172

bod kyi rig gnas dang / chos lugs/ mi rigs bcasakyi'abyungakhungasaskor/ da wa tshul zhig red ces zer gyi yod pa ma red dam/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung ngo ma gang gi nang du de 'dra'i bshad tshul gtan nas med pa ma zad/de sngon dus rabagadagu pa'i 'gor bod kyi rgyal po khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon gyi dus skabs bod kyi lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sde dang / rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra gnyis kyis bod skad du bsgyur ba'i 〈 'jig rten gdags pa 〉zhes pa'i nang gsal bar/ ci'i phyir 'brug ces bya zhe na/ smras pa/ phyogs gnyis nas rlung chen po dag ldang ste brdabs pa las sgra 'byung ste/ rgyu des na 'brug zer ro/ /zhes dang / ci'i phyir glog 'byung zhe na/ smras pa/ phyogs gnyis nas rlung shin tu che ba dag ldang /de dag phan tshun thug pa las glog 'argyung ste rgyu des na glog 'byung ngo/ /zhes gsal zhing / de dang mthun par gong gsal chos dpe de bod du ma bsgyur gong bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs brtsams pa'i 〈 rgyal po bka' thang 〉gi nang du yang 'di ltar 'khod yod de/ mtsho yi rlangs pas mkha' la sprin du chags/ /'byung ba tsha grang phrad pas glog tu 'khyug /de nyid 'thab pas mkha' la 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /drag cing ngar na gnam lcags thog tu babs/ /dper na me lcags rdo la brdabs pa bzhin/ /bar nas me dang rin chen 'od zer 'phro/ /zhes dbyar dus su sa ngos kyi drod tshad ha cang mtho ba'i rkyen gyis mtsho rlangs par 'gyur sla bas mtsho chu'i rlangs pa nam mkhar chags pa rnams la brten nas sprin byung zhing / sprin gyi nang du yod pa'i mkha' rlung tsha grang gnyis phan tshun 'thab pa la brten nas 'od 'phro ba de la glog zer ba dang / de'i rkyen gyis skad sgrogs pa de /73

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la mi rnams kyis 'brug ces brjod pa yin tshul gsal por bshad yod pas de dang deng sang gi tshan rig thog nas bshad tshul gnyis khyad par gtan nas med pa red/ de dang 'dra ba'i dpe mtshon ha cang mang po bshad rgyu yod pas 'dir re re bzhin 'bri bar ma nus shing / nga tshos sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos dpe khag la zhib 'jug nan tan gnang na de'i nang du mi yi rigs kyi rig gnas dang tshan rig gi snying bcud phun sum tshogs pa mang po zhig 'dus yod pas zhib bajug bya rin yod pa dang byas na don snying yod pa/ zhib 'jug byas pa'i go rim nang nas mi mang po zhig mthong thos kyi shes yon rgya je che dang gting je zab tu song ste dngos gtso smra ba'i 'jig rten lta tshul gong 'phel gtong par phan thogs chen po yod pa zhig red/ der brten nga tshos gna' bzang deng spyod dang snyigs 'dor bcud len gyi bya thabs bzung nas gna' rabs kyi rig gnas khag rgyun 'dzin srung skyob byed dgos pa'i gnad 'gag der thug yod pa dang / de sngon bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar rjes bon po'i chos la dad pa yod pa tshos rang nyid kyi lag tu yod pa'i srid dbang la brten nas sangs rgyas chos lugs med par bzo ba dang sangs rgyas chos lugs pas kyang srid dbang bzung ba'i go skabs bed spyad nas bon po'i chos lugs bsnubs pa sogs byas pa'i zhor la chos dpe de dag gi nang du 'dres nas yod pa'i gna' rabs rig gnas kyi snying bcud phun sum tshogs pa rnams rtsa brlag tu song ba'i rang gzhan gnyis phung gi bya ba nor 'khrul can de'i thog nas bslab bya len rgyu gal chen po red/ /74

bod kyi rig gnas dang / chos lugs/ mi rigasabacasakyi'abyungakhungasaskorngi/da —gnyis pa/ bod kyi mi rigs thog mar byung ba'i dus mtshams skor/sngar yod bod kyi lo rgyus dpe deb mang po'i nang sangs rgyas shākya mu ne sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs bodakyi sa cha rnams chus gang nas yod pa dang /yang 'ga' zhig gis ni pha dam pa sangs rgyas dgung lo lnga brgya lhag bzhugs pa dang khong thengs dang por bod du phebs skabs bod kyi sa cha rnams chus gang ba dang / thengs gnyis par bod du phebs dus yul lung chags zin kyang nags tshal nang ri dwags thar thor las med pa/ thengs bdun pa bod du phebs skabs mi la ras pa dang mjal ba sokas bshad pa ltar na/ bod mi byung nas da bar lo nyis stong tsam las ma song dgos pas bshad tshul de 'dra ni tshan rig dang gtan nas mi mthun pa red/ lo rgyas smra ba'i mkhas dbang 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis bod kyi yul 'di yang rgya gar dang 'dra bar yul dang mi la sogs pa gnas pa'i bskal pa nas 'go tshugs te byung bar byas na yang lung dang rigs pa'i gnod pa med ces gsungs pa ltar byas na sangs rgyas chos lugs pas rang cag gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di chags pa nas med par gyur te 'jig rten rjes ma chags pa'i bar la mi lo dkrigs chen po gsum/dkrigs chung ba gsum/ gtams 4 dgu/ gtams chung ba bdun/rab bkram chen po bdun/ rab bkramalged/ khrag khrig chen po drus//75

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/khrag khrig gnyis/ ther 'bum chen po bzhi bcas yod pa rnams ang rtags su bkod na 3397706240000000000yod pa ste deng sang gi dung phyur brtsi gzhir byas pa ltar na mi lo dung phyur de 'dra dung phyur sum brgya sum cu so dgu dang / bye ba bdun/ sa ya bdun/ 'bum med/ drug khri nyis stong / bzhi brgya tham pa yin/ de nyid dum bu bzhir byas pa'i dum bu dang po 'jig rten chags dus dang / gnyis pa 'jig rten gnas pa'i dus/ gsum pa 'jig pa'i dus/ bzhi pa 'jig rten snga ma stong nas rjes ma da dung ma chags pa'i bar stong gi dus bcas re re la bar bskal nyi shu re dang / bar bskal re re la mi lo bye ba brgyad dang sa ya drug 'bum bzhi yod pa de nyi shus bsgyur na mi lo (1728000000)dung phyur bcu bdun dang bye ba gnyis sa ya brgyad yod pas 'jig rten 'di chags pa'i mjug rdzogs nas gnas pa'i 'go tshugs pa ste mi'i rigs thog mar byung ba nas da bar ma mthar yang mi lo sa ya kha shas tsam song zin par brtsi dargo/sa/ bod mi rigs ni mi rigs gzhan dag dang 'dra bar spra mi nas rim bzhin gna' rabs kyi mi dang / mi gsar pa/ kla klo'i dus rabs dang / shes rmongs kyi dus rabs/ shes rig ldan pa'i dus rabs bcas brgyud myong yod pa dang / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dbang du byas na gdod ma'i khyu tshogs/ rus rgyud kung hre/ bran g.yog spyi tshogs/ phyed bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin gyi spyi tshogs bcas brgyud zin pa'i nang nas rus rgyud tsho pa'i spyi tshogs nas gcig gyur gyi mi rigs shig tu 'gyur ba'i 'go ga dus tshugs pa yin min skor la rang gi bsam tshul 176

bod kyi rig gnas dang / chos lugs/ mi rigs bcas kyi 'byung khungs slor/'ga' zhig gleng rgyu yin/ mar khe si dang in ke si gnyis kyis mi rigs ga dus byung ba yin min skor gsal por gsungs med na yang / khong rnam pa tshos khyim tshang dang / sger dbang lam lugs/ rgyal khab bcas kyi 'byung khungs skor gsung skabs bsam pa'i ngal rtsol dang lus kyi ngal rtsol gnyis kyi las bgos dang / grong khyer dang grong gseb kyi khyad par byung tshul skor gsung ba brgyud nas mi rigs byung ba'i cha rkyen skor gsungs yod pa red/ gsung tshul 'di yi nang dngos po'i ngal rtsol dang bsam pa'i ngal rtsol gnyis kyi las bgos chen po ni grong khyer dang grong gseb kyi khyad par byung ba nas 'go tshugs pa dang / grong khyer dang grong gseb kyi khyad par byung ba de ni mi yi rigs kyi spyi tshogs de kla klo'idus rabs nas shes rig ldan pa'i phyogs su bar brgal byed pa/ rus rgyud tsho pa nas rgyal khab kyi phyogs su bar brgal byed pa/ sa gnas kyi bkag rgya'i rang bzhin nas mi rigs kyi phyogs su bar brgal byed pa de nas 'go tshugs pa yin zhes gsung 'dug pa de bod kyi dngos yod lo rgyus dang sbyar na/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po'i dus kyi bon shes pa can mi bcu gnyis ni dngos po'i ngal rtsol pa min par bsam pa'i ngal rtsol pa'i gras yin pa dang / mi mang che ba ni rus rgyud tsho pa'i gras su bsdad yod pa/rgyal rabs dgu pa spu de gung rgyal gyi dus su lag shes bzo las (lcags bzhu bzo las )dar rgyas byung ba dang chabs cig tshong las gong 'phel byung nas ri khyim rnams klung thang du spos pa'i 'go tshugs pa sogs ni grong khyer dang grong gseb kyi khyad par 'go tshugs pa'i rtags dang / rus rgyud tsho pa nas /77

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal khab dang / sa gnas kyi bkag rgya'i rang bzhin nas mi rigs kyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i bar brgal dus rabs su slebs pa'i rtags red snyam gyi 'dug de rjes rgyal rabs so gcig pa rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan gyi dus su tsho pa khag gcig gyur byas nas mi rigs su 'gyur ba'i cha rkyen 'dzoms par brten sngar yod tsho pa khag mang po mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa'i 'go tshugs te/ mthar rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su rus rgyud tsho pa khag rnams gcig gyur gyi las ka yongs su grub ste mi rigs kyi rnam pa ldan pa'i srid gzhung thog mar btsugs pa ma zad/ thun mong gi skad yig dang / thun mong gi sa khongs/ thun mong gi dpal 'byor sgrig gzhi/thun mong gi rig gnas bcas khyad chos bzhi tshang ba'i bod kyi btsan po'i rgyal rabs dngos 'brel zhig byung ba red/ der brten kho bo'i bsam par bod kyi rus rgyud tsho pa gcig gyur byung nas mi rigs su 'gyur ba'i dus mtshams ni rgyal po srong btsan sgam po nas 'go tshugs par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/de sngon gcig gyur gyi mi rigs shig gi khongs su gtogs pa'i rus rgyud tsho pa 'ga' zhig slar yang mi rigs gsar pa zhig yin par khas len dang mi len skor la si ta lin gyis gsung pa ltar/ mi rigs ze ra ba ni thun mong gi skad yig dang / sa khongs/ dpal 'byor/ rib/ gan sa ba4ze sa thun mong gi bsam pa'i ngo bo mtshon pa'i thun mong gi tshogarnga/ pa sazan 'jags shigre/ la zer 'icho / khyad chos de 'dra tshang ba'i tshogs pa zhi/ gi nang slar yang mi rirges gsar pa gzhan zhig gi ming 'dogs don 178

bod kyi rig gnas dang / chos lugs/ mi rigs bcasakyi'abyungakhungasaskor/ —da wamed/ skad yig gi thog nas bshad na/ rang rgyal la mi rigs lnga bcu lhag tsam yod kyang de yi grangs dang mnyam pa'i skad yig re yod dgos pa'i nges pa med la/ mi rigs gcig pa min na yang thun mong gi skad yig gcig bed spyod byas na chog pa de 'dra yang mang po yod/ skad yig gcig pa yin min ni skad zur phran bu mi 'dra ba tsam la zer rgyu min par rtsa ba'i tha snyad dang / rtsa ba'i brda sprod tshul mi 'dra ba la zer ba yin gyi de min rgya mi rigs la ma na yang hran zhi dang / hu'u nan/ hran tung / kong dung sogs kyi skad mi 'dra bas de tsho yang mi rigs gsar pa zhig tu 'gyur srid/ thun mong gi sa khongs zer ba ni/ thun mong gi skad rigs dang /dpal 'byor 'tsho ba/ bsam pa'i ngo bo bcas chags pa'i cha rkyen gtso bo zhig yin zhing / sa khongs khag gcig tu bsdad nas thun mong gi 'tsho ba gaskyal te phan tshunari bar 'brel ba byed skabs spyod pa'i yul skad logs su yod kyang— de rgyu mtshan du byas nas mi rigs gsar pa zhig tu brtsi dgos don med la/ gtso bo ni sa gnas de dang gzhan dag bar 'brel ba byed skabs thun cho/nga du spyod pa'i skad yig yod med la lta dgos pa yin/ sa khongs so sor kha gram nas sdod pa'i mi rnams rgyun du rang rang gi yul skad bed sbyod pa'i dus tshod ring zhing / sa gnas khag phan tshun 'brel ba byed skabs spyod pa'i thun mong gi skad rgyun du bed spyod pa'i dus tshod thung ba yod pas nga tshos yul skad khag so so dang / tsho thun mong gi phal skad tshaḥ mar rtog zhib cha tshang ba zhig ma byung gongu 'de yang mi rigs gzhan zhishā / 179

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yin pa dang / de yang mi rigs gzhan zhig yin pa sogs kyi sdoms tshig bzhag na mthar rus rgyud tsho pa mang po zhig mi rigs gsar par gyur nas de yi dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas/ 'tsho ba/ sems khams/ skad yig bcas kyi khyad chos cha tshang ba'i thog nas mi rigs gzhan dag dang 'dra mnyam dngos 'brel yong bcazhig chags rgyur dka' ngal gsar pa dang /'gal ba gsar pa mang po 'phrad srid pa dang / de lajibarten nas mi rigs gsar pa de dnge sngar yod mi rigs gzhan dag bar gyi 'brel ba dang / 'phel rgyas bcas gnas skabs dang phugs su dge skyon ji yong dgongs bzhes gzab nan gnang dgos pa zhig yin pa dang / lhag par mi rigs skor la zhib 'jug brtag dpyad byed rgyu ni sa khams rig pa dang /srog chags rig pa/ mi rigs rig pa/ skad yig rig pa sogs tshan rig gi sde tshan khag mang po zhig dang 'brel ba yod stabs de tsho'i thad la shes yon dma' ba bdag lta bu mi nyung shas kyis dus tshod thung thung nang rta rgyug zhor me tog la lta ba dang 'dra ba'i zhib bajug brtag dpyad phran bu bgyis tsam gyis tshan rig dang mthun pa'i mjug bsdoms ga la bzhag thub/'on kyang slob khrid kyi las 'gan khur ba'i zhor la zhib 'jug brtag dpyad phran bu bgyis pa'i bsam tshul 'ga' zhig rgya che'i gzigs pa po tshor dpyad gzhi'i tshul du zhus pa la 'gal ba med snyam nas skabs 'dir rang gi bsam tshul mdor bsdus tsam du gleng ba lags/ gong gsal rang blos dpog tshod kyi dpyad gtam cung zad zhus pa 'dir skyon cha dang / nor 'khrul nges par du yong srid pas tshan rig dang 180
bas pa'i dbang po rnams kyis skyon

bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug cung zad byas pa'i myong tshor/rang re'i mes rgyal ni mi rigs lnga bcu lhag tsam yod pa'i rgyal khab chen po zhig yin pa dang de'i nang bod rigs ni spun zla mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar gzi brjid ldan pa'i lo rgyus yun ring yod pa dang / rang nyid 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i brgyud rim ring po'i nang 'od stong 'phro ba'i rig gnas kyi shul rgyun phun sum tshogs po yod pa'i dbang gis 'dzam gling thog gi rig gnas gral star nang gal che'i go gnas bzung yod pa ma zad/ bod kyi rig pa zhes mthong ha cang chen po byed kyi yod pa red/ da lta bod kyi rig pa'i zhib 'jug skor la rang nyid kyi myong tshor 'ga' zhig gleng gzhi'i tshul du bshad rjes de'i skor la rang nyid kyis zhib 'jug byas pa'i gnad don khag 'ga' zhig gi lta tshul rnams dpyad gzhi'i tshul du rim bzhin ngo sprod zhu rgyu yin/dang po/ bod kyi rig par zhib 'jug byed pa'i 'go gang nas 'dzugs dgos pa'i skor/bod kyi rig par zhib 'jug byed pa'i khyab khongs ni ha cang rgya chen po dang rnam grangs mang po yod pa ste mi rigs/ skad yig spyi tshogs/182

bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug cungazadabyasapa'imyongatshor/ — da —chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ khrims lugs/ dmag don/ rig pa /nas/rtsom rig chos lugs/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ sems khams/ slob gso/gso rig gzugs khams/ srog chags/ skye dngos/ gter kha/ rdzas 'gyur/ skar rtsis/ bzo rig mdzes rtsal/ zlos gar sogs yod cing /de tsho rang rang la yang dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos yod par brten zhib 'jug bya yul gyi tshan pa mi 'dra ba re chags pa yin/ de'i nang nas tshan pa 'ga' zhig gi thad la bod yig gi nang don cha tshang zhing rgya che la gting zab tsam yod pas zhib 'jug gi rin thang thad 'dzam gling thog gal che'i go gnas bzung yod pa dang / yang tshan sa 'ga' zhig la sa bcad ma stong tsam las med stabs kha snon byed dgos pa dang / yang tshan pa 'ga' zhig ni stong char lus pas gsar rtsom byed dgos pa bcas yin/ rnam grangs de dag tshang mar 'dzam gling gi thun mong khyad chos ldan pa yang yod la/ bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa yang yod pa'i dbang gis mi'i rigs spyi'i khyad rbos ldan pe'am spun zla mi rigs gzhan dag dang 'dra ba'i khyad chos ldan pa'i rigs 'ga' zhig ni mi rigs gzhan gyi khyad chos la brten nas phan tshun shugs rkyen thebs pa yang srid la/ 'ga' zhig ni rang nyid gnas pa'i khor yug gi rang byung khams dang / de la ngos 'dzin byed pa'i chu tshad mtho dman 'dra ba'i dbang gis shod tshul gcig mthun byub ba ma gtogs phun tshun shugs rkyen thebs pa'i dbang gis byung ba min pa dang /— mi rigs rang nyid la yod pa'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos de tsho la yang rang nyid kyi lo rgyus 'phel /83

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyas dang / rang byung gi cha rkyen/ dus skabs kyi 'gyur ldog sogs phyi rkyen nang rkyen mang po zhig phrad pa la brten nas byung ba yin pas/ de tshor zhib 'jug byed skabs tshan rig gi thabs shes dang / dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi bya thabs la brten nas 'os shing 'tshams pa'i sdoms tshig 'jog dgos pa ma gtogs 'ol tshod kyis sgro 'dogs dang 'khyog bshad/ mi bden brdzun bsgrigs byed pa'i spyod tshul gtan nas 'dzin mi rung ba yin/de ni bod kyi rig pa tshud pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs gang 'dra zhig la zhib 'jug brtag dpyad byas kyang thog mar gal che ba'i 'aso/ 'dzugs sa de yin pas de nor na rtsa ba gang las skyes pa'i yal ga dang lo ma 'bras bu tshang ma de dang gcig mtshungs shig las mi yong ba ltar tshan rig gi spyod tshul dor nas dmigs yul zur bcangs byas pa'i zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras ni long bas mig ldan la mgo bskor btang ba dang 'dra bar dgongs pa gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas dbang dgyes pa bskyed pa dang /blo gsal las dang po ba rnams blo skyed 'phel thub pa'i legs bshad gtan nas yong thabs med/gong gsal gyi khyab khongs rnam grangs mang po'i nang nas thog mar gang 'dra zhig la zhib 'jug byed dgos zer na/ gong du bkod pa'i rnam grangs de dag sde tshan mi 'dra ba'i khyab khongs che gras yin cing / de dag re re la yang nang gses kyi yan lag mi 'dra ba mang po yod pas thog ma nas/ ham pa chen pos khyab khongs che shos bdams na khyed kyis mi tshe gcig ring grub 'bras thob pa'i zhib 'jug gang yang byed mi thub ste/ dper na/ 184

bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug cungazadabyasapa'imyongatshor/ —da ——khyed kyis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs la zhib 'jug cig byed bsams nas zhib 'jug bya yul 'dems skabs sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nang tshan gzhung bka' pod lnga yongs rdzogs bdams na khyed rang mi tshe gcig ring bka' pod lnga'i nang nas sna kha gcig la yang cha tshang ba'i zhib 'jug byed mi byub cing / dpe de bzhin du bod kyi gso ba rig pa la zhib 'jug byed ba sams nas zhib 'jug bya yul 'dems skobs bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung yongs rdzogs bdams na de yongs rdzogs lta zhog/ de'i nang gi sna kha gcig la yang cha tshang ba dang gting zab pa'i zhib 'jug byed mi thub/ dper na/ khyed kyis sder ma'i nang du yod pa'i shing tog tshang ma za bsams nas za thengs gcig la shing to go tshang ma kha nang du bcug na mi 'grigs par shing tog de dag re re byas nas rim gyis bzas na sder ma'i nang gi shing tog yod tshad za thub pa dang 'dra bar bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs dang / yang na bod kyi gso ba rige pa lta bu'i khyab khongs chen po gcig la zhib 'jug byed bsams na zhib 'jug byed thengs gcig la de'i nang gses kyi yan lag tshang mar zhib 'jug byedajirgyu ma yin par thog mar sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nang gses phar phyin lta bu 'am/ bod kyi gso ba rig par mtshon na de'i nang gses mi'i lus khams chags tshul gyi skor lta bu gtso gnad gal che ba gcig zhib 'jug bya yul du bdams nas de mthar ma thon bar du blo gcig sems gcig gis zhib 'jug byed dgos/zhib 'jug bya yul gtso gnad gal che ba gcig yod na de nyid brgyud nas de dang 'brel ba yod pa'i don gnad mang po zhig shes rtogs byed rgyur /85

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skul ma gtong thub pa ni/ dper na/ mgo'i skra rkang gcig nas 'then na gzugs po yongs rdzogs 'gul thub pa dang 'dra/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang zhib 'jug bya yul gyi gtso gnad de la/ dngos dang brgyud nas 'brel ba yod pa'i khyab khongs gzhan dag mang po yod pa'i dbang gis skud sne bzung nas mdud pa bkrol ba dang / shing sdong gi yal ga brgyud nas sdong po ngo mar gtugs pa lta bu'i shes yon mang po zhor la shes thub pa yin/der brten khyab khongs che ba gcig la zhib 'jug byed skabs thog mar de'i khongs gtogs kyi cha shas re rer dam 'dzin byas te zhib 'jug byed rgyu nas 'go 'dzugs dgos pa dang / gtso gnad yod pa'i sgo nas zhib 'jug byed dgos pa'i gnad 'gag de ma shes par thog ma nas khyab khongs che ba gcig yongs rdzogs 'dems pa dang / de ring 'di bdams pa dang sang nyin gzhan zhig 'dems pa bcas spo len mang po dang / dus skabs gcig nang zhib 'jug bya yul mang po 'dems pa bcas byas na zhib 'jug byed thub pa'i nus rtsal les/sa po yod pa zhig yin na'ang grub 'bras thob pa'i zhib 'jug byed mi thub na gzhan dag gis lta ci smos/mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ zhib 'jug byed 'go 'dzugs skabs dngos thog bden 'tshol byed pa nas 'go 'dzugs dgos pa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul 'dems skabs khyab khongs che ba'i nang gi cha shas re re nas 'go 'dzugs dgos pa de yin/ 186

bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug cungazadabyasapa'imyongatshor/———da — —gnyis pa/ zhib 'jug bya yul gyi sde khag rnams phan tshun 'brel ba yod pa'i skor/gong du bkod pa'i zhib 'jug bya yul gyi rnam grangs khyab khongs che ba rnams rang rang la dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos yod pa'i dbang gis tshan pa mi 'dra ba so sor phye ba yin kyang / phan tshun bar 'brel ba gtan nas med pa'i kher rkyang rang tshugs shig ma yin par gcig la gcig brten gyi 'brel ba dam po yod pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ bod kyi skad yig rig pa ni sgra rig pa dang / tshad ma rig pa/ sems khams rig pa sogs rig pa'i tshan khag mang po zhig dang 'brel ba yod pa dang / de dang 'dra bar bod kyi slob gso'i rig par mtshon na brda sprod rig pa dang / sems khams rig pa/ gtan tshig rig pa bcas phan tshun 'brel ba yod pa/bod kyi gso ba rig par mtshon na gzugs khams rig pa dang / skar rtsis rig pa/ srog chags rig pa/ skye dngos rig pa/ rdzas 'gyur rig pa/gter rdzas rig pa/ sems khams rig pa bcas tshan khag mang po zhig dang 'brel ba yod pa/ bod kyi lo rgyus rig par cha mtshon na sa khams rig pa dang / chab srid dpal 'byor rig pa/ srog chags rig pa/gna' rdzas rtog zhib rig pa/ gter rdzas rig pa sogs sde khag mang po zhig dang phan tshun 'brel yod pa lta bu bcas tshan rig zhib 'jug bya yul gyi sde tshan rnams phan tshun 'brel nas yod pa'i dbang gis rgyal khab phyi nang du sngon byon dang da lta 'tsho bzhugs gnang bzhin pa'itshomakhas ngabang /87

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mang po zhig sna gcig mkhas la sna mang mkhyen pa 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de la thug pa dang / gal te khyed kyis rig pa'i gnas lnga yongs rdzogs la mkhas pa'i nga ṇa ḍi ta zhig byed bsams nas rang nyid kyi zhib 'jug bya yul la gtso gnad gang yang med par rig gnas yod tshad dus gcig tu dam 'dzin byas na 'di ya nga legs par mi shes la de yang legs par mi shes pa ni phan med dngos zog gcig bsdus byas pa'i sna 'dzoms rdzab tshal dang 'dra ba yin/zhib 'jug tshan pa khag gi nang don phan tshun 'brel ba yod pa'i rkyen gyis gna' rabs kyi rig gnas de rgyun mthud nas deng rabs can gyi rig gnas gsar par— 'phel rgyas byung ba dang / tshan rig dang mi mthun pa'i rig gnas nas rim bzhin tshan rig dang cung zad thag nye ba dang /tshan rig dang yongs su mthun pa'i rig gnas bar chu tshad je mtho je mthor 'gro ba de byung zhing / zhib 'jug bya yul gyi dzhan pa khag kyang 'brel thag je nyer 'gro yi yod pa de la brten nas rgyal khab phan tshun dang /las khungs phan tshun/ tshogs pa phan tshun bcas sgo bkag rang srung dang /rang phan gzhan gnod gang thub byed pa'i bkag rgya btsan po de mthar phyin parngo gtor nges red/ gnas tshul de ni tshan rig zhib 'jug gi nang don phan tshun 'brel nas gnas pa'i chos nyid kyi stobs shugs de las byung ba yin stabs de ni rgyal khab chen po dang / las khungs chen po/mkhas pa dbang grags can sus kyang gtor mi thub pa'i stobs shugs shig red/ 188

bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug cungazadabyasapa'imyongatshor/ da da da lta'i char tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las khungs dang / sde khagatshogs pa bcas phan tshun bar sgo bkag rang srung dang / rang phan gzhan gnod gang thub byas te rang nyid kyi sde tshan de gzhan dag su la yang stos mi dgos par kher rkyangari rang tshugs kyi thog nas zhib 'jug las don mthar phyin pa sgrub thub pa'i rang btsan rgyal khab lta bu zhig yin khul byed kyi yod pa de ni rang rang so sos gtso bor brtag dpyad byas pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi chu tshad de rang nyid kyi 'khor rgya chung ngu de'i nang du bskor ba brgyab ste sdod pa ma gtogs 'khor rgya de nas thon te 'brel yod tshan rig gi sde khag gzhan dag la zhib 'jug byed thub kyi med pa'i rjes lus kyi rnam pa zhig yin pa dang / zhib 'jug gi chu tshad je mthor phyin nas tshad nges can zhig tu slebs skabs rang nyid kyi 'khor rgya de nas thon te 'brel yod tshan rig gi khyab khongs gzhan dag la zhib 'jug mi byed ka med yong zhing / de skabs zhib 'jug las khungs dang / sde khag tshogs pa bcas phan tshun bar 'brel med kher rkyang du sdod pa'i bkag rgya btsan po de thabs shes ji ltar byas kyang rang srung bya thabs bral te phan tshun mnyam 'brel thog nas tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las don mi sgrub ka med yong gi red/ deng skabs rang rgyal tshud pa'i 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag dang /rgyal khab so so'i nang gi ched las tshan rig gi zhib 'jug las khungs mang po zhig phan tshun bar mnyam 'brel yod la las bgos yod pa'i thog nas las don sgrub pa'i 'gro lam der skyod 'go tshugs zin pa de ni chan rig zhib 'jug gi chu tshad mthon por slebs pa'i rtags mtshan zhig yin par /8)

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brten 'gro lam der gom stabs spo mus su yod pa rnams phyir bshol bya thabs med pa dang / da lta gom pa spo rgyur bsdad pa rnams de'i thog tu ma bskyod thabs med kyi dus su slebs yod pa red/ der brten rang ljongs kyi ched las zhib 'jug tshan pa dang / de min ched las gzhan dag gi las 'gan yod pa'i zhib 'jug sde tshan khag rnams rang rang gi 'khor rgya chung ngu'i nang nas thon te blo rgya cher bskyed kyi sgo nas mnyam 'brel las bgos zung du 'brel ba'i 'gro lam thog nges par du gom pa spo thub pa mdzad rgyu gal chen po 'dug snyam/gsum pa/ zhib 'jug mi sna gso skyong bya thabs skor/deng skabs rang re'i ljongs su tang gi dbu 'khrid yang dag pa dang /rgan rabs ched las mkhas can da lta ‘ratsho bzhugs gnang bzhin pa rnams kyis thugs 'khur dang gso skyong 'og shes spyod gnyis ldan gyi rang rigs zhib 'jug mi sna gzhon nu mang po zhig dwangs bsil chu dang phrad pa'i pad mo bzhin du 'tshar longs yong bzhin yod pa mthong skabs dga' tshor dpag med skye ba dang chabs cig tshan pa 'ga' shas nang rang khongs su yod pa'i gzhon nu las byed pa gso skyong gi thad do 'khur med pa dang /yod kyang bed spyod mi byed par da dung las byed mi sna mi ldang ba'i zhu 'bod byed pa mthong dus blo pham chen po yong gi 'dug lhag par du rang ljongs su bod kyi spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi mtshan snyan che yang zhib 190

bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug cungazadabyasapa'imyongatshor/ —da —'jug byed mkhan mi sna nyung ba'i stabs kyis gzhon nu zhib 'jug sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa ched mngags btsugs te mes rgyal nang khul du slob sbyong byed par btang ba ma zad/ skyon bral ngang 'tshar long yong bzhin yod/der brten da lta 'tshar long yong bzhin pa'i zhib 'jug mi rabs rjes ma 'di dag gi sne ji ltar khrid rgyu dang / ga 'dra byas nas gso skyong bya rgyu'i rgyang ring dang / dus thung gi 'char gzhi go rim yod pa zhig dgos pa ma zad/ zhib 'jug gi las ka dngos kyi nang kho tsho sbyong brdar dang / slob khrid zung 'brel byas te zhib 'jug gi chu tshad gong mthor gtong rgyu bcas ldum ra'i nang gi me tog gsar pa gso skyong byed pa lta bu'i bya thabs brgyud rim ldan pa zhig med na skyed tshal nang gi me tog gzhon nur 'tshar longs kyi nus pa yod kyang gso skyong mkhan gyi bya thabs ma ldang na skye 'phel gyi nus pa zhan pa dang / tha na rang bskams su 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pa dang 'dra bas 'dir de'i thad kyi bya thabs 'ga' zhig dpyad gzhi'i tshul du ma bshad thabs med byung /1 ched las zhib 'jug mi sna gsar par zhib 'jug gi las 'gan sprod stangs skor/ zhib 'jug byed mkhan gyi slob ma so sor zhib 'jug gi don tshan 'ga' shas kyi ming byang sprad de rang mos kyi sgo nas ched las zhib 'jug bya yul dga' 'dems byed du bcug kyang chog la/ yang na 'go khrid dang mdzub ston gnang mkhan gyi slob dpon gros mol gnang ste slob ma rnams la ched las zhib 'jug gi las 'gan gnang yang chog yang na slob ma khag gcig la rang mos kyi dga' 'dems byed du 'jug pa dang / /91

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de ma thub na khag gcig la 'os 'tshams kyi sgo nas ched las las 'gan gnang yang chog gang ltar thog mar tshod lta'i ched las layo'agan de nang don ha cang rgya chen po min pa dang gting zab po min pa zhig gi ched las las 'gan gnang ste thog mar ched las de'i rtsa ba'i shes yon gyi slob khrid gnang dgos shing / de nas zhib 'jug gi las ka dngos la zhugs su bcug ste dngos sbyong dang slob khrid zung 'brel gnang rgyu gal che/ gso skyong bya rgyu'i slob mar ched las kyi las 'gan ma sprad na ched las de'i rtsa ba'i shes yon slob sbyong yag po byed thub thabs med pa ma zad/ ched las zhib 'jug gi nus rtsal sbyong brdar byed thub thabs med/ ched las zhib 'jug bya yul so sor rang rang gi dmigs bsal khyad chos yod par brten ched las zhib 'jug gi slob mar las 'gan sprad rjes thog mar ched las de'i rtsa ba'i shes yon gyi slob khrid gnang dgos/ de ni zhib 'jug dngos su byed rgyur blo sgo phye ba'i lde mig rtsis sprod gnang ba dang 'dra/de nas slob ma rang nyid dngos su zhib 'jug gi lag len ngo ma'i nang zhugs su bcug ste sbyong brdar byed rgyu gtso bo dang / dka' gnad la thug pa rnams slob khrid dang / mdzub ston gnang rgyu phal par bzung ste zhib 'jug gi nus rtsal khong du chud pa gnang dgos / ched las zhib 'jug gi slob ma'i rig gnas chu tshad gcig mtshungs rang yong mi srid stabs chu tshad mtho ba rnams la ched las zhib 'jug gi don tshan sna ba/cig mi gcig kher rkyang gis zhib 'jug byed du 'jug rgyu dang / chu tshad dma' ba rnams la mi gnyis sam gsum mnyam sbrel gyi sgo nas zhib 'jug byed du 'jug 192

bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug cungazadabyasapa'imyongatshor/ — —— dzedagos/2 ched las zhib 'jug byed mkhan slob mar mdzub ston gnang mkhan slob dpon ma ldeng ba'i dbang gis byung ba'i gnad don skor/ched las zhib 'jug gi slob ma mang por dus gcig tu mdzub ston gnang thub mkhan gyi slob dpon ha cang dkon pa'i thog 'ga' zhig da lta 'tsho bzhugs gnang ba rnams kyang dgung lo mthon por phebs zin pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gcig gis ched zhib slob ma gsum lhag mdzub khrid dang gso skyong gnang thub pa ha cang dka' ba'i gnas su gyur yod/ ched las zhib 'jug gi slob mar mdzub ston gnang thub pa'i slob dpon gyi chu tshad ni spyir btang gi slob deb thog nas slob khrid gnang thub pa de tsam gyis mi 'grigs par ched las sde tshan de rang dang / 'brel yod rig gnas khag gi rtsa ba'i shes yon ldan pa dang / ched las de'i khongs su gtogs pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rnams la thugs rgyus zhib phra che tsam yod pa/ dpyad gzhi'i yig char gsal ba'i gal che'i gnad don khag la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i dbye zhib gnang thub mkhan zhig dgos pas/ slob dpon de 'dra zhig gis ched las zhib 'jug slob ma gsum lhag gso skyong dang mdzub ston gnang thub pa ni bod ljongs tsam ma zad/ rgyal yongs su ha cang dkon po red/ deng skabs bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gis gso skyong gnang ba'i slob ma slob grwa nas thon ran pa sum cu tsam yod cing /khong tsho tshang mar ched las zhib 'jug gi las 'gan gnang ste mi gsum re slob dpon rer cha bgos byas par cha bzhag na gong gsal gyi chu tshad ldan /93

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i slob dpon bcu tsam dgos kyi yod rung de 'dra yang ldang gi med pa red/ gal srid slob thon slob ma phyed kar ched las zhib 'jug gi las 'gan sprad nas de byings las ka gzhan dag 'os 'tshams shig byed du bcug pa'i dbang du btang na mdzub ston gnang mkhan gyi slob dpon rang khongs yod pa dang / gdan zhu bsdoms lnga ldang bar cha bzhag chog kyang /ched las zhib 'jug gi las 'gan ma sprad pa'i slob ma gzhan dag la 'os shing 'tshams pa'i las ka gang 'dra sprod dgos rgyur thugs bsam nan tan ma bzhes na/ phyis 'byung lo shas song mtsha mas kho tshos lo mang ring dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis sbyang brtson byas pa'i shes yon rnams bed spyod gtong ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis tshang ma chud zos 'phro brlag tu song nyen shin tu che bas de 'dra byung na ha cang phangs po red/ der brten slob thon slob ma khag gcig la gnas skabs ring dge rgan ma ldang ba'i dbang gis las ka gzhan dag byed du bcug tshe kho tshor 'os shing 'tshams pa dang / phyis 'byung rim bzhin ched las zhib 'jug gi mi sna yag po zhig tu 'tshar longs yong rgyur phan thogs yod pa'i las ka gang 'dra zhig byed du 'jug dgos rgyu ni mig sngar thag gcod byed dgos pa'i gnad don chen po zhig yin/ de'i thad kho bo'i bsam tshul ltar na/ slob thon slob ma'i nang nas chu tshad mtho ba khag gcig ched las zhib 'jug si/ mi snar gso skyong byed rgyu dang / khag gcig phyis 'byung ched zhib mi snar 'tshar longs yong ched dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'tshol bsdu ngang sngon yod dpe deb khag gi dkar chag sgrig tu bcug na de ni tshan rig zhib 'jug byed rgyur gom pa dang po 194

da bodakyirigaganas la 'ib 'jug cungazadabyasapa'imyongatshor/ da spos pa zhig yin/ gang yin zer na/ 'dzam gling thog gi tshan rig zhib 'jug gi mkhas pa sngon byon mang po zhig thog mar dpe mdzod khang gi nang lo mang ring phyag las de 'dra gnang ste rim bzhin tshan rig zhib 'jus ched las mkhas can zhig tu 'gyur thub pa byung ba'i nyams myong rtsa chen de kho tshor lag len bstar du 'jug dgos shing / de 'dra byas na bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gis nges par du gnang dgos pa'i las ka chen po khag gnyis po (dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'tshol bsdu dang de'i dkar chag 'argod rgyu dang gcig ched zhib mi sna gso skyong byed rgyu dang gnyis)de go rim ldan pa'i ngang nas bsgrub thub pa yong rgyu red snyam/bzhi ba/ tshan rig zhib 'jug dang slob gso'i las don gnyis phan tshun gzhogs 'degs byed dgos pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin skor/tshan rig zhib 'jug byed rgyu dang slob gso 'i las ka dam 'dzin byed rgyu gnyis phan tshun 'brel ba dam zab yod pa zhig red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ri /phyogs bsdus rang bzhin ldan pa'i slob grwa dang / ched las rang bzhin ldan pa'i slob grwa gang yin kyang de'i nang du slob khrid kyi 'gan 'khur ba'i dge rgan rnams kyis slob ma tshor slob khrid legs po zhig byed dgos na/thog mar khrid bya'i slob tshan de'i nang don la 'ol tshod tsam ma yin pa'i go ba gnad la khel zhing gting zab zhig lon par byed dgos pa ma zad/slob khrid kyi go rim dang / rgyas bsdus/ thabs shes/ dogs pa yod pa'i /95

da wa dungadakarablo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsungartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa gnad don thag gcod bya rgyu sogs kyi bya rim mang po zhig yod pa tshang ma slob khrid kyi nang don zhib 'jug dang slob tshan gra sgrig byed pa brgyud nas yong dgos pa dang / ga/la te zhib 'jug dang gra sgrig gang yang med par slob khrid byas na chu khar g.yengs ba'i rtswa sngon ltar gting zab mi yong ba dang / dogs pa yod pa'i gnad don khag la dri ba 'don mkhan byung na thag chod pa'i lan 'debs byed mi thub par brten/ slob tshan gra sgrig byed pa ni don du tshan rig zhib 'jug byed pa dang kha bral thabs med pa zhig red// deng rabs slob grwa chen mo khag gis slob khrid dang tshan rig zhib 'jug zung 'brel byed kyi yod pa dang / slob khrid gtso bor byed pa'i zhor la tshan rig zhib 'jug byed kyi yod pa/ slob khrid las don des tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las kar skul 'ded byed thub pa/ slob grwa'i dge rgan zhig yin phyin tshan rig zhib 'jug mi byeng/ ka med yong gi yod pa/ ched las zhib 'jug gi slob ma yang zhor la gso skyong byed thub pa bcas red/tshan rig zhib 'jug khang ni slob grwa khag dang mi 'dra bar rang rang so sos ched gnyer zhib 'jug bya rgyu'i las 'gan dang / nang don sna mang yod pa'i thog zhib 'jug gtso bor byed pa'i zhor la ched las zhib 'jug slob ma nyung shas shig gso skyong byed pa tsam las slob grwa khag lta bu'i slob ma mang po gso skyong byed mi thub pa'i thog bskong bsdu bya rgyu'i slob ma'i chu tshad kyang slob grwa chen mo khag gis skong 'gugs byed thub pa'i slob ma'i chu tshad las mtho ba dang / gso skyong byed thabs kyang 'dra gi med pa red/tshan rig zhib 'jug khang gis slob gso'i las kar gzhogs 'degs kyi /96

bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug cungazadabyasapa'imyongatshor/ —da ——nus pa thon thub dang mi thub rigs gnyis yong gi yod pa de'i gnad 'gag thug sa ni zhib 'jug khang du yod pa'i dge rgan chen mo dang mkhyen yon ldan pa'i zhib 'jug mkhas can rnams kyis dus tshod 'os 'tshams shig zur 'then gnang ste slob grwa chen mo khag gi slob ma tshor slob khrid gnang dang mi gnang la thug yod pas slob khrid de rigs gnang thub pa yin na rang nyid kyi ched las zhib 'jug gnang rgyu dang / slob grwa'i nang slob khrid gnang rgyu gnyis phan tshun zung 'brel legs po byung ste gsham gsal ltar gyi phan thogs mang po yod pa ste / 1 rang nyid kyi mkhyen yon rnams mi rabs rjes ma mang po zhig la thad kar brgyud sprod gnang thub stabs kho tsho'i mthong rgya dang shes yon phun sum tshogs su gtong thub pa/ 2 zhib 'jug gnang ba'i go rim nang thugs snang de tsam ma byung ba'i dogs 'dri mang po zhig slob ma tshos bton par brten zhib 'jug gi spus tshad sngar las yag tu gtong thub pa/ 3 da yod slob grwa che 'bring khag la dge rgan mi ldang ba'i dka' ngal sel thub pa/ 4 da lta slob gso'i las 'gan 'khur mus yin pa'i lo na gzhon pa'i dge rgan mang po zhig gi slob khrid nus rtsal mtho ru gtong thub pa/ 5 zhib 'jug khang de rang gi nang zhib 'jug slob ma nyung shas zhig gso skyong byas pa de las khyab che ba'i shes ldan mi sna mang po gso skyong byed thub pa/ 6 slob ma dang lo na gzhon pa'i dge rgan mang por shes yon zab sbyong gi nus pa 'don thub pa/ 7 rgyal khab dang / slob gso'i las khungs/ rang ljongs bcas kyis slob gso'i thog gtong ba'i mi shugs dang dngos shugs kyi 'gro gron /97

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mang po bsri tshags byung ste de'i lhag 'phro rnams slob gso'i gron dngul gzhan dag thog kha gsab dang 'phar snon byed thub pa bcas yin/ ga/la te tshan rig zhib 'jug khang gis zhib 'jug bya rgyu kho na ma gtogs/ slob grwa khag gi slob gso'i las don la do 'khur ma byas na rang nyid kyi ched las zhib 'jug mi sna'i yong khungs la sems 'khur ma byas pa zhig yim/ pas de ni rang rang so so'i zhing kha'i 'gram gyi yur bur bltas nas chu la hab thob rgyab pa ma gtogs chu de gang nas yong ba'i chu 'go dang chu rdzing la bdag gces ma byas pa dang khyad par med/ zhib 'jug gi spus tshad ni grangs 'bor gtso bo ma yin par gnad don la zhib 'jug byed pa'i gting zab tshad dang bsdoms tshig gnad la khel ba byung yod med de gtso bo yin pas de ni slob khrid byed pa'i go rim nang slob ma chu tshad mtho dman mi 'dra ba mang po zhig dang 'brel 'dris byung ba brgyud de sngon rang gis do snang ma byung ba'am do snang chen po rang ma byung ba'i gnad don la dogs 'dri mang po yong ba dang / de'i rkyen gyis slar yang zhib 'jug gting zab tu 'gro rgyur phan thogs chen po yod/zhib 'jug khang gi las khungs nang slob ma nyung shas gso skyong byed pa'i spus tshad de dang / slob grwa khag gi nang slob ma mang po gso skyong byed pa'i grangs tshad gnyis phan tshun ltos bcas yin pas re 'dun mtho ba'i spus tshad de shes ldan mi sna gso skyong byed pa'i thog nas bshad na bzo grwa khang gis thon rdzas thon skyed byed pa dang mi 'dra/ bzo grwa khang gi thon rdzas ni spus tshad nges can yod pa'i grangs 'bor de yin pas spus tshad ma 198

bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug cungazadabyasapa'imyongatshor/ ——da ——lon na grangs 'bor ji tsam mang yang don dngos su grangs 'bor ma byung ba dang khyad par med/ shes ldan mi sna gso skyong byed pa'i thad kyi spus tshad dang grangs 'bor ni de dang mi 'dra bar ched las mi 'dra ba dang spyi tshogs hril po'i dgos mkhor gzhigs pa'i shes ldan mi sna sna tshosas dgos pa dang / shes ldan mi sna gso skyong dang 'tshar lo ngas byed pa/ra dus/ tshong ni ji tsam mgyogs kyang nyung mthar lo bco lnga yas mas dgos pa/ 'tshar longs byed pa'i chu tshad kyang cha snyoms po med pa/ 'dzin grwa gcig gi nang slob ma sum cu tsam yod na de yi nang re 'dun dang 'tshams pa'i shes ldan mi sna lnga nas bdun bar tsam las thon mi thub pa/ tshan rig dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi myur tshad mgyogs pa bcas la bsam gzhigs byas te/'char gzhi yod pa'i sgo nas shes ldan mi sna grangs tshad nges can zhig gso skyong ma byas na/ spus tshad long ba'i shes ldan mi sna ha cang nyung nyung zhig las yong mi thub pa'i dbang gis dus tshod gang 'tshams song rjes spyi tshogs hril po'i dgos mkho dang 'tshams mi thub pa'i 'gal ba chen po yong gi red/ der brten tshan rig zhib 'jug khang gis spus tshad gtso bor byas pa'i slob ma gso skyong byed rgyu dang / tshan rig zhib 'jug khang dang slob grwa chen mos phan tshan mnyam 'brel byas te grangs tshad nges can yod pa'i slob ma gso skyong byas pa gnyis zung 'brel byung na grangs 'bor de'i nang nas spus tshad long ba'i slob ma mi nyung ba zhig thon thab pa yong ༄rgyu red/ /9()

bod ljongs su tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las don thog la bob pa'i grub 'bras rags tsam gleng ba/bod rang skyong ljongs dngos su dbu brnyes nas lo sum cu 'khor bar dga' ston rten 'brel zhu ba'i skabs 'dir/ rgya che'i mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs tshang mas spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas bkra shis bde legs zhu ba dang chabs cig 'das zin pa'i lo sum cu'i ring la krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid 'og rang re'i ljongs kyi 'thab phyogs khag la rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha thob par dran gso zhu bzhin yod pa ltar/go skabs 'di dang bstun nas ngas kyang bod kyi tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las don thad la 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba'i myong tshor rags bsdus tsam gleng rgyur/gcig bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol ma thob gong dang / lo sum cu'i gong gi tshan rig zhib 'jug gi gnas tshul dran gso/bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol ma thob gong du rgyun srol rig gnas rgyun 200

bod ljongs su tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las don thogalathobapa'igruba'abras/———— ——'dzin dang dar spel gtong rgyu gtso bor bzung ba ma gtogs deng rabs rig gnas gsar pa'i slob gso dang / tshan rig zhib 'jug byed rgyu'i phyogs la mthong chen byed rgyu lta zhog gom pa gang tsam yang spos ma thub stabs rgyun srol rig gnas la yod pa'i nus pa sngar las lhag par 'don ma thub par 'phel med rang sor lus pa dang / rgyun srol rig gnas kyi slob gso de dus rabs kyi 'phel rgyas dang / spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gong 'phel gyi dgos mkho dngos dang rgyang thag ring por chod de mthun sbyor byed thub med pa'i thog deng rabs rig gnas gsar pa'i slob gso ni nang bstan chos lugs dang mnyam du gnas thabs med pa'i ngos 'dzin gyi bag chags gting zab yod pa bcas la brten nas mi khag gcig gis rig gnas gsar pa dang tshan rig gi skor ming tsam thos ma thag tu de rigs bod du dar spel gtong rgyur ngo rgol shugs chen byed kyi yod pa dang /yang mi khag gcig gis chos lugs kyi nang don rna bar thos pa tsam gyis tshan rig gi dgra bo yin par ngos 'dzin gyis rig gnas gsar pa dang tshan rig dar spel gtong dgos na chos lugs dang chos dad med par bzo dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod par brten/ mi grangs mang che bas chos dad byed kyi yod pa'i bod ljongs su rig gnas gsar pa'i slob gso dang tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las don 'phel rgyas 'gro ma thub pa'i rgyu rkyen de gnyis la thug yod/bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob rjes dang / bod rang skyong ljongs dngos su dbu brnyes rjes phyogs gcig nas rgya che'i chos dad mang tshogs 2(//

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyi chos lugs byed sgo dang chos dad la khrims lugs thog nas rang dbang yod pa'i 'gan srung gnang ba dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas deng rabs rig gnas sa/sar pa'i slob gso dar spel btang ste tshan rig zhib 'jug dang slob gso'i ched las kyi shes yon ldan pa'i dpung khag gso skyong gnang bar brten/ rang rigs kyi tshan ris/ zhib 'jug pa'i mi rabs ga/sar pa 'tshar longs mgyogs po byung nas khong rnam/ pas 'thab phyogs khag gi thad la rkang 'dzin stobs shugs kyi nus pa 'don spel byed bzhin yod pa ma zad/ rgyun srol rig gnas la yod pa'i legs cha khas len byed pa dang chabs cig ma tshang ba'i cha rnams kha skong dang / yang ma dag pa dang nor 'khrul gyi rigs legs bcos bcas tshan rig dang mthun pa'i bya thabs la brten nas zhib 'jug byas par grub 'bras bzang po thob pa des mi rnams la go bskon blo 'gugs kyi phan nus chen po thon bzhin yod/gnyis/ tshan rig zhib 'jug gi ched las rnam grangs gsar pa gong 'phel byung ba'i skor/de sngon bod du gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus shes rtogs byed rgyu dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu/ rig gnas slob gso dang sman bcos 'phrod bsten gong 'phel gtong rgyu sogs la gal che ba'i tshan rig gi shes yon rnam grangs mang po zhig gi thad mthong chen dang do snang byed rgyu lta ci/ming tsam yang go thos med rung da phan dus thung lo sum cu'i ring rgya yig 202

bod ljongs su tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las don thogalathobapa'igruba'abras/ da nas bod yig thog cha tshang bsgyur thub pa'i ched las tshan pa khag so sos rang nyid kyi khyad chos dang bstun nas cha tshang bar bsgyur ba dang / khag gcig gi ming dang tshig rnams rgya bod shan sbyar dang / bod rgya dbyin gsum shan sbyar gyi tshig mdzod phyogs bsgrigs byas te/ rim bzhin bod yig thog cha tshang bsgyur thub pa'i gom pa dang po'i las ka legs sgrub byung yod pa ste/ gna' shul brtag dpyad rig pa dang / spyi tshogs tshan rigagrangs rtsis rig pa/ dngos lugs rig pa/ rdzas 'gyur rig pa/ skye dngos rig pa/ sa khams rig pa/ sa gshis brtag dpyad rig pa/ chu bed rig pa/ glog rdul rtsis rgyag rig pa/ slob gso sems khams rig pa sogs stong char lus pa'i tshan rig rnam grangs khag rnams kha gsab dang 'thus sgo je tshang du 'gro dang 'gro mus kyi skabs yin/gsum/ zhib 'jug mi sna'i dpung khag gso skyong dang 'tshar longs byung ba'i skor/tshan rig zhib 'jug gi ched las mi sna'i dpung khag ni zhib 'jug gi las don legs grub yong min gyi 'gag rtsar thug pa'i gnad don zhig red la/ de yang zhib 'jug mi sna'i mi rabs rgan dar gzhon gsum gyis rang so so'i dmigs bsal khyad chos dang nus pa mnyam 'don byed thub na gzhi nas phul du byung ba'i grub 'bras thob thub pa zhig red/ da lta'i char rang re'i ljongs su mi rigs rang nyid kyi tshan rig zhib 'jug pa mi 20 3

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rabs rgan dar gzhon gsum las grub pa'i dpung khag cig chags zin pa ma zad/ rgan rabs rnams kyis dpyad gzhi'i khungs sne 'don pa dang /rang nyid kyi myong tshor dngos la brten nas dar ma dang gzhon nu'i mi rabs rnams la sne khrid rogs ram bya rgyu tsam ma gtogs/ gzhi rtsa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las ka rnams dar ma dang gzhon nu'i mi rabs rnams kyis rang rkya 'pher ba'i sgo nas byed thub kyi yod pa ma zad/ khong tshos bris pa'i ched rtsom rin thang mtho tsam yod pa rnams krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dang / bod ljongs zhib 'jug bod ljongs sgyu rtsal zhib 'jug krung go'i bod ljongs/ gangs ljongs rig gnas/ bdag po sogs kyi dus deb khag nang 'grems spel byas pa der rgyal khab phyi nang gi tshan rig mkhas can rnams kyis bsngags brjod dang gdeng 'jog chen po byed pa ma zad/'brel yod phyogs la yi ge btang nas dus deb mngags nyo byed mkhan ha cang mang po yod/bzhi/ da lta'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi cha rkyen dang ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam skor/bod kyi gna' rabs spyi tshogs dang / rig gnas/ chab srid bcas kyi dngos yod lo rgyus dang / bod dang mes rgyal bar gyi 'brel ba/ rang byung tshan rig dang / gso ba rig pa/ skar rtsis/ chos lugs sogs phyogs mang po zhig gi zhib 'jug la mkho ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs 204

bod ljongs su tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las don thogalathobapa'igruba'abrasad/ wa da 'bor chen bsdad yod pa'i nang khag gcig dpar skrun 'grems spel byas zin pa'am yang na 'grems spel byed grabs yod pa dang / da lta 'grems spel bya rgyur bsdad pa'ang ha cang mang po yod pa'i thog zhib 'jug bi ched rtsom bod yig thog 'bri ba dang / zhus dag gtong ba/ dpar skrun bcas kyi ma lag cha tshang yod pa'i 'phrul 'khor jus gzhi mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'char 'god byas te/ 'ga' zhig da lta dngos su bed spyod byed 'go tshugs zin pa dang / rgyal khab tshan rig u yon lhan khang dang / mi rigs don gcod lhan khang / glog rdul bzo las pu'u/ bod rang skyong ljongs bod skad yig mdzub ston lhan khang / bod ljongs tshan rig lag rtsal u yon lhan khang bcas kyi 'go khrid dang rgyab skyor 'og lo shas song du bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i glog can slob gso bdag gnyer khang si lag rtsal mi snas glog rdul bod yig 'phrul mdzod kyi jus gzhi gsar pa zhig bton pa der/ rgyal spyi'i glog rdul tshan rig mkhas can rnams kyi tshad mtho'i bsngags brjod dang gdeng 'jog chen po thob nas/ rang re'i ljongs kyi tshan rig zhib 'jug dang / slob deb rtsom 'bri/ dpar skrun bcas glog rdul 'phrul mdzod can du 'gyur rgyu'i rmang gzhi bting zin pa red/ dus thung lo shas nang de dang de 'dra'i grub 'bras mang po zhig thob thub pa des rang ljongs kyi slob gso'i phyag las gnang mkhan dang tshan rig zhib 'jug pa rnams la sngar las phun sum tshogs pa'i las ka'i cha rkyen bzang po zhig bskrun pa gor ma chagagong gsal grub 'bras de dag thog nas 'byung 'gyur la rgyang lta byed 205

dung dkar blo bzanganya'aphrino las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ dus/ krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid dang / spun zla mi rigs khag gi lhag bsam zol med kyi rgyab skyor/ skye stobs ldan pa'i rang rigs tshan zhib las don pa'i 'bad brtson bcas la brten nas rjes lus can gyi bod ljongs 'dir deng rabs can gyi 'dzugs skrun bya 'phur ba ltar gong 'phel 'gro rgyur gdeng tshod dang spro sems kyis khengs so// 206

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phedīrte——— —ltar byung ba'i gtam gleng /tang krung dbyang gi byams brtse ldan pa'i thugs 'khur 'og dang /spun zla mi rigs khag gi lhag bsam rnam dag gi rgyab skyor/ rang rigs kyi slob gso'i mkhyen yon ldan pa'i dge rgan rnam pa'i gso skyong 'og bod ljongs kyi slob gso'i bya gzhag thad dus thung lo ngo sum cu tsam gyi ring la mi rnams dga' spro skye 'os pa'i grub 'bras ha cang chen po thob pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang ljongs kyi slob gso'i las don des dpal yon gnyis 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i thad la sngar las lhag pa'i nus pa 'don dgos pa'i las 'gan gzi brjid can zhig rang cag dge slob rnams kyi phrag par babs yod cing / las 'gan de legs sgrub thub pa byed dgos na/blo mthun teng zha'o phing gis gsungs pa ltar/ slob gso ni deng rabs can la kha phyogs pa dang / 'dzam gling la kha phyogs pa/ 'byung 'gyur la kha phyogs pa bcas kyi mdzad phyogs yang dag pa lag len bstar dgos/gsum la kha phyogs pa'i mdzad phyogs yang dag pa de dang / bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul/ slob gso 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid bcas zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas legs bcos dang / khyab gdal/ gong mthor gtong ba bcas byed dgos shing / de yang thog mar rang re'i ljongs kyi rig gnas slob gso dang / slob gso'i rig pa 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus dang chos 207

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nyid bca sa cha tshang ba'i sgo nas shes rtogs byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gtong dgos pa gang dang gang yod/ legs bcos gtong dgos pa gang dang gang yod/ gsar gtod byas zin pa dang bya dgos pa gang dang gang yod bcas gsal por shes pa bya dgos/ der brten slob gso'i las 'gan 'khur mus yin pa'i dge rgan rnams kyis slob gso'i rig pa cha tshang tsam zhig shes pa byed rgyu de ni ha cang gal 'gangs che ba'i gnas su gyur yod/ gcig slob gso'i rig pa zer ba'i go don/slob gso ni/ dmigs yul nges can zhig gi dgos mkho dang mthun par slob gso bya yul gyi mi rnams kun spyod dang / shes rig gzugs po bcas kyi thad yar rgyas 'gro thub nges kyi 'char gzhi yod pa'i 'gul skyod cig dang / spyi tshogs nges can zhig gi chab srid dang dpal 'byor lam lugs kyis kha lo sgyur gyi yod pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs de'i thon skyed nus shugs dang / thon skyed 'brel ba'i rnam pa mtshon pa dang / slar yang thon skyed nus shugs dang / thon skyed gong du 'phel bar skul 'ded byed kyi yod pa/ rig gnas dang tshan rig lag rtsal gyi tshu tshad yod pa'i mi ni spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor dang / chab srid rig gnas bcas kyi 'tsho ba'i nang gi gtso shugs yin pa/ de 'dra'i nus pa dang 'jon thang yod pa'i mi ni go rim yod pa'i slob gso thob pa brgyud nas yong dgos pa bcas yin/slob gso bya yul gyi mi rnams kun spyod legs pa dang shes yon ldan 208

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamaglengad/ wad wapa zhig mong ba'i slob gso byed dgos na/ slob gso'i bya thabs la mkhas pa'i dge rgon dgos shing / dge rgan de yang dpe thog tu 'khod pa'i tshig don rnams slob mar 'chad shes pa tsam gyis mi 'grig par slob gso'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang zhing go rim yod pa zhig gis mdzub ston dgos pa dang / slob gso'i rig pa'i nang du slob gso'i las ga'i nang gi gal che ba'i gnad don mang po zhig rgyas bshad byas yod pa des dbe rgan gyi mthong rgyu che ru btang ste gna' rabs dang deng rabs/ rang rgyal dang phyi rgyal bcas kyi slob gso'i rig pa rnams phan tshun bsdur ba'i sgo nas dbye zhib byed thub pa dang / gna' bzang deng3spyod/ snyigs 'dor bcud len/ ri sngar dran deng bsdur/ nyams myong phyogs bsdoms bcas byas te tang gi slob gso'i lam phyogs dang bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul zung du 'brel ba'i slob gso'i las don yag po sgrub thub pa yong gi red/slob gso'i rig pa zer ba ni/byu slob gso'i las ka'i nang gi gnas tshul sna tshogs pa ste/ slob gso 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid dang / lo rgyus/slob gso'i ngo bo/ dmigs yul/ las 'gan/ go rim/ thabs shes/ lam lugs/ nang don/ tsho sgrig 'dzugs/ lo rim/ rgyugs len/ slob deb/ yo byad/ tsho dge rgan/ slob ma/ 'go khrid/bdag nyer sogs gna' rabs dang / nye rabs/ deng rabs bcas slob gso'i nang don gal tshe bsnabasdoms na gsham gyi zur lta'i re'u mig thog gsal ba ltar/ rnam grangs brgya dang lnga bcu lhag tsam yod pa'i nang nas rnam grangs drug cuḥlta/narol sngar nas yod mus thog 209

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de 'phros nas brnyan 'phrin slob gso dang / long ba'i slob gso sogs nyung shas rang ljongs su da lta med pa phud/ de min mang che ba bod ljongs zhi bas bcings bkrol thobabyutshun nas da bar gsar du byung ba sha stag yin pa dang nang don rgya che zhing rnam grangs mang ba/ zhib phra yin la rnyog 'dzing che ba bcas yod pa'i dbang gis deng sang 'dzam gling thog slob gso'i rig pa zer ba'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi sde tshan zhig logs su phye nas thon pa dang / slob grwa chen mo khag gi nang zur du slob khrid kyang byed kyi yod/'on kyang rang re'i bod ljongs su snga dus slob gso'i rig pa yod med dang / slob gso'i bya thabs thad la deng sang rgyun 'dzin bya 'os pa gang zhig yod med skor la da phan zhib 'jug gnang mkhan ha lam byung med pa lta bu dang / dus deb khag gi nang bod kyi slob gso'i lo rgyus nyung bsdus tsam ma gtogs/ bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa zer ba'i ched rtsom 'khod pa ni gtan nas ma mthong ba'i dbang gis rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang pos rang re'i bod la slob gso'i rig pa sngon chad byung ma myong ba'i ngos 'dzin gnang gi yod pa red/ der brten bod kyi rig gnas slob gso dang / slob gso'i rig pa ni sngar yod kyi rmang gzhi'i thog bod ljongs zhi bas bcings bgrol thob rjes su dus thung lo ngo sum cu lhag gi ring la sngar las lha ga pa'i yar rgyas dang phun sum tshogs su phyin pa'i lo rgyus kyiglidangos yod gnas tshul la dran gso dang / sngar dran deng bsdur byas te spyi tshogs gsar pa'i nang gi rig gnas slob gso'i dge mtshan shes rtogs byed rgyu 210

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ — da —gal chen po yin par bsams nas bod kyi rig gnas slob gso dang slob gso rig pa'i skor gyi gnas tshul rang gis gang shes rags bsdus tsam zhig rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams la ngo sprod zhu rgyu yin/gnyis/ bod zhi bas bcings bgrol ma thob gong ṅga bod kyi rig gnas slob gso dang slob gso'i rig pa'i lo rgyus skor/rang re'i ljongs su sgrig 'dzugs yod pa'i slob grwa'i slob gso'i lam lugs ni/ thog mar dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil du btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas dgon pa bzhengs rjes bod mis chos khrims srung thub dang mi thub brtag pa'i ched du sad mi bdun rab tu byung nas bsam yas su sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling du yig bsgyur khang btsugs pa ni bod du yig bsgyur gyi ched las 'dzugs pa'i thog ma yin pa dang / slob dpon bcu gsum dang / slob ma nyi shu rtsa lnga las sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i chos kyi slob grwa dngos su btsugs pa ni srid gzhung gis gnyer ba'i ched las slob grwa'i thog ma yin cing / g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos rang nyid sger gyis gnyer ba'i bskor bskyod sman pa'i slob grwa btsugs pa ni sman pa'i slob grwa dang sger btsugs slob grwa'i thog ma yin/ slob grwa de gnyis sgrig 'dzugs yod pa dang / 'go khrid yod pa/ lam lugs yod pa/ tshad gzhi yod pa bcas kyi slob grwa yin pa'i cha nas 'dra yang / yig bsgyur khang dang chos lugs slob grwa gnyis srid gzhung gis thad kar gnyer ba dang tshugs yul 2/ /

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gtan 'jags yod cing / sman pa'i slob grwa ni g.yu thog yon tan mgon po sger gyis gnyer ba dang tshugs yul gtan 'jags med par bskor bskyod sman pa'i slob grwa zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ skabs der sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du dar nas dus yun ring po song med pa'i thogachos bom/ gnyis bar gyi 'thab rtsod kyang dza drag che ba'i stabs kyis yig bsgyur khang dang chos lugs slob grwa gnyis srid gzhung gis thad kar gnyer dgos byung ba ma zad/ slob ma'i mi grangs kyang yig bsgyur khang dang chos lugs slob grwa gnyis bsdoms na yang mi grungs bzhi bcu ma long tsam las med pa red/ sman pa'i slob grwa ni srid gzhung gis gnyer mi dgos par rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis shugs che'i rgyab skyor 'og gnyer thub pa dang / de yang tshugs yul gtan 'jags dang bdag tu bzung ba'i gnas gzhi med par cha rkyen 'dzoms pa'i sa gnas gang yod du bskor bskyod byas te nad thog zhib 'jug dang / sman bcos lag len/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs bcas thad kar zung 'brel byed thub pa bcas kyi khyad chos yod pa'i dbang gis g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos dgung lo sum cu so lngar slob ma thog mar gso skyong gnang 'go tshugs skabs slob ma sum cu lhag tsam las med kyang dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga la phebs dus slob ma sum brgya lhag tsam rgyun du yod pa dang / dgung lo brgya dang bcu bzhes skabs slob ma stong lhag tsam yod par rnam thar las bshad pas rgyud 'dzin sman pa'i slob ma 'phel rgyas ha cang mgyogs po byung / de rjes dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i 'gor mnga' ris lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos mnga' ris mtho lding 212

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungabarigatamaglengad/ —————dgon par chos kyi slob grwa 'dzugs pa gnang zhing / sman pa mkhas pa mi dgu la sogs pa'i rgyud 'dzin sman pa'i slob ma yang ha cang mang po byung /de rjes bod kyi rab byung dang po'i shing stag spyi lo 1074la rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis gsang phu'i dgon pa 'debs pa gnang rjes khong gi dbon po rngog lo blo ldan shes rab kyis rnam 'grel dang / phar phyin/ dbu ma bcas kyi bshad grwa (slob gnyer gyi grwa sa )btsugs shing / khong ni slob khrid gnang ba la mkhas pa'i dbang gis gsung bshad ji tsam mang po gnang yang nyan pa po rnams sun snang med pa dang / gsung shugs che zhing gsung snyan pas tshogs pa khri phrag 'tshogs kyang tshang mas gsal po go thube pa bcas kyi khyad chos yod par brten dgung 'o sum cu so lnga la rgya gar nas bod du phyir phebs gnang (dgung lo bcu bdun nas so bzhi bar lo bcu bdun ring rgya gar dang kha che'i yul du slob gnyer gnang )rjes dgung lo lnga bcu nga gnyis par sku gshegs pas sku tshe ring po ma bzhugs kyang / dus thung de'i ring la zur khrid dge rgan gnang thub mkhan gyi slob ma chig stong brgyad brgya lhag tsam yod ces rnam thar mang po'i nang gsal/ de rjes zhang tshe spong chos kyi bla ma gsang phu'i gdan sa mdzad skabs zur khrid slob dpon bzhi bskos te lo tsā ba chen po'i sku 'bum (sku gdung mchod rten )gyi shar ngos su phya pa chos kyi seng ges tshad ma/ lho phyogs su rgya mching ru bas phar phyin/ nub phyogs su slob dpon rin chen tshul khrims kyis mngon pa gong 'og byang phyogs su yon tan shes rab kyis 'dul ba bcas slob khrid gnang zhing / lha ga par du phya pa chos kyi seng ges tshad ma slob khrid 2/ 3

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnang ba gcig pu tsam ma yin par rigs lung gi rtsod gleng bya thabs gsar pa zhig 'don pa gnang ba ni/ tshad ma rig pa'i nang don gal che ba rnams bsdus tshan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu phye nas slob tshan so so'i go rim bsgrigs te slob gnyer ba'i chu tshad mtho dman dang bstun nas rigs lam chung ba dang / 'bring ba/ rigs lam che ba/ blo rig rtags rigs/rnam 'grel bcas 'dzin grwa khag lngar bgos shing / 'dzin grwa so so'i nang gi mi tshang ma rang rang so sor kha gtad byas te bgro gleng gtong ba dang /skabs re 'dzin grwa'i nang mi re mos kyis dam bca' bar sdod du bcug ste/de la bgro gleng gtong mkhan gyis thog mar gzan skyor 'bebs pa'i gus 'dud dang bcas zhwa mo gyon te dhi skad gsangs mthon por btang nas skabs su babs pa'i slob sbyong gi gzhung de'i khas len dri ba dang / de nas gzan sked par dkris te dam bca' ba'i lan 'debs la dgag pa rgyag pa'i thal 'gyur 'phangs pa dang chabs cig lag pa rdeb pa/ khyab mtha' 'god pa/ rgyu mtshan 'dri ba/ 'khor gsum bskor ba/ khas len shor na tsha phul ba(ngo tsha zer ba'i don yin)sogs kyi bgro gleng gtong thabs gsar gtod gnang zhing / da dung skabs re 'dzin grwa yas mas gtugs res byed rgyu dang / 'dzin grwa gong ma'i gras nas slob gnyer legs pa rnams 'dzin grwa 'og mar gral skor la gtong ba dang / 'dzin grwa 'og ma'i nang nas slob gnyer legs gras rnams 'dzin grwa gong mar spor ba/ slob gnyer zhan pa rnams slob grogs gzhan dag dang mnyam du 'dzin grwa 'phar du mi 'jug par rang gnas su 'jog pa/ 'dzin grwa so so'i nang gi slob 214

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da — —gnyer legs gras khag gcig 'dzin grwa yongs rdzogs mnyam 'tshogs kyi tshogs chen thog grwa skor dam bca' 'jog tu bcug pa bcas slob gnyer gong du 'phel ba'i thabs shes gsar pa mang po gsar gtod gnang / de nas bzung rje tsong kha pa ma byon bar du tshal gung thang / rwa ba stod/ snar thang / sa skya/ ngam ring / zhwa lu/ khro phu/ gnas rnying / skyor mo lung /bo dong / pa rnam dga' gdong / stod lung mtsho smad/ zul bu/ bzang ri/ rtsed thang sogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i bshad grwa nyi shu lhag tsam byung /gsang phu'i lung pa chung chung de 'dra zhig gi nang gsar gtod byung ba'i sa slob gnyer lam lugs des bod ljongs yongs la skul lcag chen po thebs te/dbus gtsang khams gsum/ a mdo/ sog yul bcas su gzhung chen po lnga'i slob gnyer byed stangs der mig dpe bltas nas slob gnyer khyab gdal dang gong 'phel byung / de rjes sa skya pan chen sa skyar bzhugs skabs tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung gi nang nas grags che ba'i tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyan dar rgyas chen po byung ba ma zad/ khong gis 〈 mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo 〉zhes pa'i gzhung brtsams pa gnang ba de'i nang 'chad pa ste slob dpon gyis slob mar slob khrid bya thabs kyi skor dang /rtsod pa ste rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi thog nas phan tshun rtsod gleng bya tshul/rtsom pa ste rtsom yig 'bri tshul gyi skor bcas zhib cing phra ba gsungs par brten bod kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi thad la cung zad cha tshang ba'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs thog mar yod pa byung zhing / rjes su sa skya'i mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyis 〈 mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo'i 2/5

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsungartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa 'grel pa dang / kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos 〈shes bya kun khyab〉 de bzhin mkhas pa mang pos 〈 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi rnam bzhag 〉ces pa'i gzhung mang po brtsams ste nang don sngar las kyang phun sum tshogs su phyin yod/ rje tsong kha pas kyang dgung lo chung dus gong gsal mtshan nyid rig pa'i bshad grwa phal che bar grwa skor du phebs te rjes su gdan sa gsum dang /bkra shis lhun po/ dpal 'khor chos sde sogs su yang gzhung chen po lnga'i slob gnyer 'dzugs srol thad gsang phu'i phyag bzhes de rang rgyun 'dzin thog slar yang slob khrid bya thabs gsar pa gzhan zhig gsar gtod gnang ba ni go rim yod pa'i sgo nas thog mar rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi blo sgo phye ba'i ched du bsdus grwa dang rnam 'grel/ de rjes nang pa sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rtsa ba'i shes yon gyi rmang gzhi 'ding ba'i phar phyin/ de rjes phyi rol yul dang rang gi sems gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba'i thad nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta tshul gang yin shes pa'i ched du dbu ma / de rjes theg pa chung ba'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi lta tshul shes pa'i ched du mngon pa ma dzod/ de rjes nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i 'dul khrims lo rgyus dang /dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi 'dul khrims lag len zhib phra shes pa'i ched du 'dul ba bcas 'dzin grwa khag so sor lo dus grangs cad kyi sgo nas slob gnyer byed pa'i srol gsar gtod gnang bas gdan sa khag dang bshad grwa so so'i slob gnyer la sngar las lhag si 'i yar rgyas mgyogs po byung / dus skabs der lo gcig la slob gnyer bya thabs thad lo gcig ring chos thos 216
