bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng—/ —— — — (deng sang gi slob dus)chen mo thengs bzhi dang / thengs rer dus tshod zla ba gcig dang phyed ka re rtsis zla ba drug chos thog snga phyi'i bar chos mtshams zla ba drug bcas yod cing / chos thog tshugs pa'i ring gtso bor rig lung gi bgro gleng byed rgyu dang / slob khrid skabs bstun zhar byung tsam dang /chos mtshams kyi skabs slob dpon gyis slob khrid gnang rgyu gtso bo dang /rigs lung gi bgro gleng skabs bstun zhar byung tsam gyi thog rang gi 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen gra sgrig byed thub pa bya rgyu bcas yin/slob khrid tshugs stangs thad 'a/ yang / 'dzin grwa yongs rdzogs la slob tshan gcig slob khrid gnang ba'am/ snga dro 'dzin grwa gsum re dang / phyi dro 'dzin grwa gsum re khag so sor bgos te 'dzin grwa so so'i dgos mkho dang bstun pa'i slob khrid gnang ba bcas rigs gnyis yod/slob khrid bya thabs thad/ slob ma'i gnas tshad rab 'bring tha gsum gyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas/ thog mar mdor bsdus shing go bde ba'i bshad pa tshar gcig dang / de nas rgyas bshad tshar gcig de nas dka' gnad la dogs pa gcod ched slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis phan tshun bar rigs lung gi bgro gleng yun ring tsam gnang zhing / de nas don bsdus kyi bskyar bshad tshar gcig bcas bshad pa tshar gsum/ sang nyin slob khrid tshugs skabs thog mar kha sang gi bshad pa mdor bsdus tshar gcig gnang ste/ slob mas dogs gcod dang bka' 'dri zhu rgyu rnams zhus rjes de ring gi slob tshan gzhi nas 'go 'dzugs pa sogs kyi phyag bzhes yod pa der slob ma'i chu tshad rab 'bring tha gsum tshang mar phan 2/7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thogs yod pa sogs zhib par gsham gyi dum bu gnyis pa slob gso'i rig pa'i nang don ngo sprod kyi skabs su gsal/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang skyong gnang skabs dbus gtsang lho kha bcas su dgon pa bcu gsum gsar du 'debs pa gnang ba'i nang shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon pa sogs mtshan nyid rig pa'i bshad grwa chen po brgyad yod/ da dung gzhung chen po lnga'i rtsa ba dang 'grel pa/ gso rig sman gzhung / sgra rig pa'i gzhung sogs blo thog nas rgyugs sprod byed mkhan ‘pa shog grangs mang nyung la gzhigs nas bya dga' sprod pa'i lam lugs gsar gtod gnang zhing / paṇa chen er ti ni sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis dbus gtsang dmag 'khrug gi lo shas ring dga' ldan khri pa'i tshab gnang skabs se 'bras dga' gsum gyi dge bshes mkhas pa'i nang nas phyag dpe yag gras rnams lha sa smon lam chen mor grwa skor dam bca' bzhag ste dge bshes lha rams pa'i mtshan gnas 'bul rgyu dang / ang rim bsgrigs te bya dga' 'bul ba'i srol gsar gtod gnang yod/ de dus kyi dge bshes lha rams pa'i ang dang po len mkhan gnyis yod pa'i gcig ni blo gsal gling dge bshes 'brug ltag pa ngag dbang dpal bzang dang / gcig ni sgo mang dge bshes dom nyag pa bsod nams chos bzang yin pas skabs der dbus gtsang khams gsum du khong gnyis la 'bras spungs dge bshes dom 'brug gnyis zhes mtshan snyan che ba ma zad/ khong rnam pa gnyis ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa tsam ma yin par mdo sngags rig 218

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wabheganas kun la mkhas pa'i slob dpon chen po zhig yin stabs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas kyang gus bkur che thog/ skabs der par skrun gnang ba'i par yig mang che ba'i zhus dag pa yang khong gnyis la gnang du bcug pa yin tshul rang rnam du gsal/ de rjes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po gsar du bsko bzhag gnang skabs dang / dge bshes lha rams pa dang / tshogs rams pa/ rgyud grwa stod smad kyi dge bshes sngags rams pa bcas nor bu gling khar bcar nas rtsod rgyugs bzhes (bgro gleng gi rgyugs sprod )te rgyugs ma 'phrod pa rnams phyir 'then dang / rgyugs 'phrod pa rnams la ang rim bdun gyi bar bzos te bya dga' rim pa dang por grwa chas spus legs cha tshang gcig dang /zhwa ser/ chos gos/ ja sgam phyed/ kha btags nang mdzod gcig bcas nas/ ang bdun par chos gos gcig dang / zhwa ser gcig ja sbag gcig kha btags a she gcig bcas kyi bar gtan 'bebs bzos pa ma zad/ dge bshes lha rams pa'i ang grangs su tshud pa rnams rtse yig tshang las khungs brgyud nas dgongs zhu ma zhus par rang mtshams kyis pha yul dang / gnas skor bcas la phyin mi chog pa'i rgyas bcad bzos pa gnang ba des gdan sa gsum gyi slob gnyer la skulasmolcag chen po thebs pa ma zad/dgon pa gzhan dag gi slob gnyer yar rgyas 'gro rgyu la yang phan thogs chen po byung yod/rig gnas slob sbyong gi skor/ bod ljongs su rig gnas slob sbyong thad la thog mar gso ba rig pa dang / sgra rigapha gnyis la slob sbyong byed 2/9

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa nas 'go tshugs shing / srong btsan sgam po'i dus nas dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i mjug bar lo drug brgya tsam gyi ring la gso ba rig pa'i slob sbyong thad srid gzhung gis btsugs pa'i slob spu mi dgos par cha rkyen 'dzoms pa'i sa gnas gang yod du slob khrid dang dngos sbyong zung 'brel gyi sgo nas byed pa bcas de dag slob dpon so so sger gyis btsugs pa'i slob grwa yin/ de'i khyad chos ni sa gnas gang du btsugs kyang de ga'i mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor shugs chen yod pas dpal 'byor thog dka' ngal chung ba dang / sman gyi rgyu cha'i 'byung khungs 'tshol bde zhing / nad thog zhib 'jug gi lag len byed sla ba/ sdod gnas gtan 'khel med pas 'tsho ba'i thad la— rgyas spros kyi bsam blo mi 'byung ba/ slob ma'i sman bcos lag len gyi chu tshad yar rgyas 'gro mgyogs pa bcas yin pas de ni g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos btsugs pa gnang ba'i sger btsugs sman pa'i slob grwa'i khyad chos dang nyams myong rtsa chen zhig yirne/ de nas bzung ste gtsang pa rgyal pos bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang ma bzung bar du gso ba rig pa'i thad la sger btsugs slob grwa ma gtogs srid gzhung gis btsugs pa'i slob grwa med/ gtsang pa rgyal po phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung skabs gzhis ka rtser gso rig slob grwa zhig btsugs pa de ni bod sa gnas su srid gzhung gis btsugs pa'i gso ba rig pa'i slob grwa thog ma de yin cing / rjes su gu shri han gyis gtsang pa rgyal po'i srid gzhung rtsa gtor btang ba dang chabs cig gzhis ka rtse'i gso rig slob grwa de yang kha 'thor nas gnas ma thub/ de rjes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas 220

bod kyi spob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da —bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang skyong gnang skabs 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang nang du gso rig grwa tshang drang srong 'dus pa'i gling zhes pa zhig btsugs gnang ba de yang yun ring ma song bar 'thor zhing / slar yang rtse po ta la'i lha dbang lcog tu gso rig 'dus pa'i gling btsugs pa gnang ba de yang yun ring por gnas ma thub par 'thor rkyen sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos lcags po rir gso rig grwa tshang ngo mtshar lta na rig byed gling gsar du btsugs nas mchod gzhis sogs 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen phun sum tshogs pa gnang thog sman pa gso skyong dang / rgyugs len/ sman rams pa'i ming btags bya dga' sprod pa sogs kyi lugs srol gtan 'bebs/ slob khrid kyi yo byad dang / dpe ris bris thang sogs gsar skrun gnang ba nas da lta'i bar rgyud 'dzin sman pa mkhas pa rgyun mi chad pa byung / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas srid dbang skyong gnang skabs sman bcos dang skar rtsis zhib 'jug zung du 'brel ba'i bya thabs gsar par brten nas sman rtsis khang thog mar 'dzugs pa gnang ste bod ljongs sa gnas khag nas bsdus pa'i slob ma rnams slob gnyer thon rjes sbyangs 'bras mtho ba re zung rgyud 'dzin slob dpon du nyar ba phud/ de byings thog mar gang nas yong ba'i sa gnas so sor btang ste sman pa mu mthud byed du bcug par brten rang ljongs su sman pa dkon pa'i gnas tshul la phan thogs che tsam byung yod/de min rig gnas gzhan dag gi slob sbyong skor/ sgra rig pa dang /snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/ sum rtags bcas kyi slob sbyong thad gdan sa chen 22

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/po gsum gyi nang mngon gsal dod pos slob sbyong byed mi chog cing / dge bshes thon rjes gzhi nas slob dpon zur du bsten te slob chog pa dang /tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs rig gnas chung ba lnga ni smin gling du slob par 'gro dgos pa dang / de nas slob sbyong thon rjes sku drag yin na zhabs sdod zhus chog pa red/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa'i skabs btsugs pa'i rtse rig gnas slobalke grwa ni srid gzhung gi las byed rtse drung byed dgos pa'i rigs rnams slob grwa der 'gro chog pa dang / slob grwa der snga dro bod yig gi yig gzugs ka kha nas rim bzhin dbyangs ldan/ mgo 'dogs/ tshugs ring thung / tshugs ma 'khyug 'khyug yig bcas shes rjes rgya gar gyi yi ge lan tsha/ wa rtu sogs yig ris mi 'dra ba kha shas slob kyi yod/ phyi dro ni gnas tshad cung zad mtho ba rnams la dag yig ngag sgron dang / sum rtags/ snyan ngag bshes spring sogs slob srol 'dugalha sa grong khyer nang grags che ba'i na rong shag gi slob grwa ni sger btsugs slob grwa yin pa'i thog slob grwa ba'i nang mtho 'bring sku drag dang 'byor ldan pa khag gi bu dang bu mo/ sger pa khag gi g.yog rigs bcas la bod yig gi yig gzugs gtso bor slob kyi yod la/ yig gzugs 'khyug yig 'bri shes pa byung mtshams gtong yig dang / srid gzhung gi bka' rgya/ snyan zhu/ chod yig dpyad mtshams khra ma/ gan rgya sogs 'bri stangs kyi shes yon dang srid gzhung gi las khungs nang gi las ka'i lugs srol slob khrid dang dngos sbyong zung 'brel thog nas slob kyi yod pa red/bod kyi sgra rig pa dang / sum rtags/ snyan ngag skar rtsis/ sdeb 222

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da sbyor bcas ni slob khrid dang dngos sbyong lag len zung 'brel byas te slob dgos pa sha stag yin stabs sgra rig pa slob khrid zin rjes sgra gzhung de cha tshang ba'i ri mo blo thog nas 'bri shes pa dgos shing / sum rtags dang snyan ngag la ni gzhung cha tshang gi dper brjod gsar pa 'bri dgos pa/sdeb sbyor slob sbyong zin rjes gzhung cha tshang gi dper brjod rgya gar skad dang bod skad shan sbyar gyi rtsom yig gsar pa 'bri dgos pa/ skar rtsis slob sbyong zin rjes lo gcis/ gi lo tho cha tshang gsar rtsom byed dgos pa bcas kyi lugs srol bzang po rgyun ma chad par yod pa ma zad/ rig gnas chung ba lnga la slob sbyong byed skabs slob sbyong dang lag len zung 'brel bya dgos pa'i dbang gis slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis kas yi ge 'bri ma shes na slob khrid bya thabs bral ba de 'dra red/gdan sa chen po 'ga' zhig nang slob ma rnams yi ge klog shes pa tsam gyis 'gris pa dang / gzhung chen po lnga slob khrid gnang skabs sngon gyi mkhas pas brtsams pa'i khrid gzhung de ga rang gi thog nas slob khrid gnang ba las logs su slob dpon rang nyid kyis slob khrid zin bris gnang srol med pa dang / 'dzin grwa gcig gi nang mi bzhi bcu nas lnga bcu'i bar yod kyang / de'i nang yi ge 'bri shes mkhan gnyis gsum tsam las med thog sum rtags dang dag yig sbyong myong mkhan ni ha cang dkon pa bcas red/ de'i dbang gis snga dusabod du mkhas pa chen po ha cang mang po byon pa rnams 'chad rtsod gsum ka la byang chub pa sha stag yin kyang /bar skabs gdan sa chen po'i nang du gzhung chesko por slob sbyong byed ring 223

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rig gnas chung ba lnga la slob sbyong byed rgyur tshod 'dzin nan po yod pa'i rkyen gyis 'chad rtsod gnyis la mkhas pa mang po yod kyang gsung rtsom gnang thub mkhan dkon po yin pa de byung zhing / de ni rang re'i slob dpon bka' drin can thon mi sam bho ṭas sum cu pa'i rtsa ba'i mjug tu/‘‘bslab pa'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /gang zhig 'bad pa chung ngus kyang / /shes rab myur du grol bar 'gyur/ /de phyir dang po de nyid bslab/ /de nas rgyas pa'ang mnyan byas te/ /bslab pa gang la dad pa yis/ /gzhung nyid bla ma dag las mnyan/’’zhes rig gnas slob pa'i thog mar yi ge 'bri klog legs par shes dgos pa dang / de nas sum rtags gnyis slob dgos pa/ de rjes gzhi nas so sos gang slob par 'dod pa'i rig gnas dang gzhung chen po gzhan dag slob dgos pa bcas kyi go rim nan tan du gsungs pa de las go ldog pa'i rkyen gyis slob sbyong gi grub 'bras thog shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs pa yin pas rig gnas slob sbyong ma byas gong du thog mar yi ge 'bri klog dang sum rtags dag gsum la sbyong dgos pa ha cang gal che bar 'dug lags/gsum/ bod kyi gna' rabs slob gso'i khyad chos skor/ bod kyi gna' rabs slob gso'i rig par khyad chos gang dang gang yod rags bsdus tsam zhig ngo sprod byas na 'di ltar mchis te/1 slob gso'i lam lugs/ slob gso'i lam lugs zhes pa ni 224

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da sneslob grwa gang 'dra zhig yin kyang de'i ngo bo dang / las 'gan/ slob grwar zhugs skabs dgos pa'i cha rkyen/ slob sbyong gi yun tshan/ rgyugs len/slob grwa thon skabs kyi chu tshad sogs kyi lam lugs yod pa la zer de yang spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs mi 'dra bar gzhigs pa'i slob gso'i dmigs tshad dang las 'gan sogs mi 'dra ba yod pa dang / bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol ma thob gong ste de snga'i bod kyi slob gso'i lam lugs thad gso skyong byed pa'i dmigs tshad dang las 'gan mi 'dra ba yin stabs slob grwa'i ngo bo mi 'dra ba yod/ dper na/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil du btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas gtsug lag khang du thog mar btsugs pa'i chos kyi slob grwa ni chos lugs slob sbyong byed rgyu yin cing / nang don ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos skyabs 'gro dang / las rgyu 'bras/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos khrims bcas slob rgyu yin/ slob ma de dag gi nang nas chos gang mkhas pa/ spyod tshul gang bzang ba rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs par (mkhan po dang slob dpon)bsko bzhag byed kyi yod pa dang / skabs der slob dpon bcu gsum dang / slob ma nyi shu rtsa gsum yod pa de dag gi 'tsho ba'i 'gro gron ni rgyal po'i mdzod nas sbyar ste slob dpon rer lo rer phogs 'bru khal lnga bcu nga lnga/(zla rer khal bzhi dang bre bcu gnyis phul gang ) mar srang brgyad brgya/(zla rer mar nyag drug dang srang do) na bza' cha tshang re/ slob ma mi grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga yod par slob ma re la lo re phogs nas khal nyi shu rtsa lnga re/(zla rer 'bru khal gnyis lhag tsam) snam bu3bubs gsum re bcas rgyun du d+ku 225

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sprod kyi yod pa dang / slob ma de dag gi nang nas chos mkhas shos dang kun spyod bzang ba rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ste mkhan por bsko bzhag byas thog lo rer phogs 'bru khal bdun cu don lnga/(zla ba rer 'bru khal drug dang bre lnga) mar srang chig stong brgya tham pa/(zla ba rer mar khal gcig dang nyag gsum lhag tsam) na bza' snam bu bubs dgu chibs rta gcig shog bu bcu ldebs bzhi/ snag tsha yug gsum/ tshwa nam dgos dus su len chog pa bcas kyi lta skyong yod pa dang / go gnas ni gser yig chung ba'i byang bu dang / tshogs 'du'i skabs dgung blon chen po'i 'og zhang blon chen po'i gral gyi gong du bsdad chog pa bcas kyi gus bkur mthong chen gnang gi yod tshul 〈 rba bzhed 〉nang du gsal/sangs rgyas chos lugs phyi dar 'go tshugs pa nas bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol ma thob bar du chos lugs dang rig gnas slob sbyong byed pa'i lte gnas ni dgon pa khag yin cing / de la yang nang gses kyis phye na rigs gsum yod/ rigs dang po ni chos lugs slob sbyong gtso bor byas te mthar thon rjes rang mos kyi thog nas rig gnas gzhan dag slob sbyong byed pa ma gtogs chos lugs slob sbyong byed pa'i ring der rig gnas gzhan dag slob sbyong byed mi chog pa'i lam srol dam po yod pa zhig ste de ni dbus gtsang gdan sa chen po bzhi sogs mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa phal che ba de ltar yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni slob sbyong gi skabs gtso gnad yod pa'i sgo nas sna gcig la dam 'dzin ma byas par sna mang por bzung na shes rig 'chal te sems pa lhod g.yeng du 'gro ba dang sna mang bslabs kyang 226

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da walegs par shes pa sna gcig kyang ston rgyu med par 'bad brtson byas pa thams cad don med du 'gro ba sngon 'gog byed ched dmigs yul yongs rdzogs la dmigs thog gom pa re re byas nas mthar thon yong ba'i bya thabs bzung ba zhig yin pa ma gtogs chos lugs slob sbyong byed mkhan gyis rig gnas gzhan dag gtan nas slob mi chog pa min la/ gdan sa chen po'i nang du dge bshes ming btags thon rjes rig gnas gzhan dag slob sbyong gnang rgyur bkag 'gog gtan nas med/ rigs gnyis pa ni chos lugs slob sbyong gtso bo ra byed pa'i zhor la chos mtshams kyi ngal gso'i go skabs dang bstun nas rig gnas gzhan slob sbyong byed pa de yin cing / grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas dbang mang po zhi ga ni slob gnyer gnang thabs de la brten nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa dus thung lo bcu yas mas la slob gnyer mthar son te 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ka'i thog nas ming don mtshungs pa'i mkhas dbang chen por gyur pa sha stag yin/ rigs gsum pa ni dgon pa de'i nang du gzhung chen po lngar slob sbyong gtso bor byed mkhan gyi grwa tshang sngon yod thog bod kyi sman rtsis gnyis la gtso bor slob sbyong byed pa'i ched las grwa tshang zur du phye ste gzhung chen po slob gnyer byed mi thub pa'i grwa pa khag gcig sman rtsis gnyis dang rig gnas gzhan dag slob sbyong byed du 'jug pa de yin/ de ni bod kyi slob gso'i thog gi bsgyur bcos chen po zhig dang 'phel rgyas gsar pa zhig ste lam srol de thog mar 'dzugs pa gnang mkhan ni 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang po yin cing / khong bis 227

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ mdo smad phyogs su bod kyi skar rtsis rig pa'i srol rgyun sngar yod mi nyams ched rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu lug lor (spyi lo 1763)rgyud stod sngags rams pa blo bzang rdo rje dang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bshes rab brtan rgya mtsho gnyis slob dpon du bskos te mtshan nyid grwa tshang dang rgyud pa grwa tshang gnyis kyi grwa pa khag gcig bsdus nas gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil rang du dus 'khor grwa tshang e wam chos 'khor gling zur du 'dzugs gnang thogagrwa tshang der gtso bor bod kyi skar rtsis rig pa slob sbyong dang / zhor la sgra rig pa dang / sdeb sbyor/ sum rtags/ snyan ngag gzhan yang chos lugs kyi byed sgo khag gcig bcas slob sbyong byed dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i skar rtsis kyi ched las slob grwa zhig byung ba dang dus mtshungs rig gnas gzhan dag gi zhor sbyong slob grwa'i rmang gzhi yang 'ding thub pa byung / de rjes sde dge phyogs su gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa ḍi ta 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse mchog nas ka thog gdan sar gzhung chen bcu gsum dang rig gnas chung ba lnga'i slob grwa ched 'dzugs gnang yod pa go thos byung yang lo rgyus zhib cha bdag gis ma mthong / gong gas/la dgon pa chen po'i nang du rig gnas slob sbyong gi ched las grwa tshang zur du btsugs pa des rig gnas slob sbyong byed 'dod yod pa'i blo gsal don gnyer can rnams la cha rkyen bzang po zhig bskrun pa ma zad/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bod kyi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dang gong 'phel gtong ba'i gnas gzhi brtan po 'dzugs thub pa byung yod/ 2 slob gso'i mtshan nyid rig pa/ de ni bsam blo'i slob gso 228

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da —dang / shes yon gyi slob gso/ sgrig khrims kyi slob gso bcas phyogs gsum dang 'brel ba zhig yin/ bsam blo kun spyod legs pa ni rang shugs su mi yong bas thog mar sgrig khrims la brten nas rang nyid gcun dgos pa dang / sgrig khrims ni btsan shed dang gzhan dbang gi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin pas des rang nyid gcun te goms gshis su 'jags pa zhig byung mtshams gzhi nas rang rtogs yod pa'i bsam blo kun spyod bzang po de byung zhing / de gnyis med na shes yon legs po thob mi thub pa ma zad/ gal srid shes yon phran bu zhig thob pa'i dbang du byas kyang des rang gzhan tshang mar gnod pa zhig las phan pa gang yang mi yong /sgrig khrims rang rtogs kyis srung ba dang kun spyod legs po zhig yod na shes yon yang gong nas gong 'phel du 'gro bas de gsum phan tshun gcig phan gcig grogs su gnas pa yin zhes bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma tsho'i gsung rgyun du yod/ 'di skor bshad gzhi che bas dpyad brjod zur du 'bri rgyu yin/3 slob khrid/ slob khrid ces pa ni dge rgan gyis slob tshan khrid pa dang slob mas slob tshan nyan pa'i thun mong gi 'gul skyod cig ste slob sbyong byed pa brgyud nas shes yon shes pa dang ngos 'dzin byed pa'i nus rtsal mtho ru gtong rgyu dang chabs cig kho tsho 'i bsam blo dang kun spyod legs po gso skyong byed pa zhig la zer/ de la nang gses kyis phye na bshad khrid dang / dmar khrid/ myong khrid bcas rigs gsum yod/ (1)bshad khrid zer ba ni slob dpon gyis slob mar bslab bya'i gzhung de'i tshig dang 229

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/don rnams yig 'bru gcig kyang ma lus par gsal bshad byas pa la zer/(2)dmar khrid zer ba ni dngos yod kyi dpe mtshon nam/ yang na ri mor bris pa lta bu'i steng nas gsal bshad byas pa ste deng sang gzugs snang can gyi slob khrid zer ba de yin/ (3)myong khrid zer ba ni slob dpon gyis rang nyid kyi nyams myong thog nas slob mar slob khrid byas te slob ma la nyams myong dngos su ma thon bar du bsam blo gtong du bcug pa de la zer/khrid stangs rigs gsum po de yang phan tshun 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ slob ma'i chu tshad mtho dman gyi khyad par gzhir bzung nas khrid stangs rigs gsum ka'am/ yang na de gsum gyi nang nas gang gtso bor bya dgos pa slob ma'i gnas tshul la bstun pa dang / slob ma shes tshad dma' ba rnams la dmar khrid dang myong khrid thog nas go sla zhing don bsdus pa'i slob khrid gnang srol yod pa red/4 slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin/ slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin zhes pa ni slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi gzhir bzung nas slob tshan rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum gyi khrid tshul gtan 'khel yod pa zhig te/ de'i nang las 'gan dang /dngos sbyong / tshod lta/ bskyar sbyong slob khrid kyi dus tshod cha bgos byas pa'i rtsa 'dzin yod pa la zer/ de sngon gdan sa chen po khag la sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa slob khrid gnang skabs kyi go rim dang rgyas bsdus kyi rtsa 'dzin ni thog mar rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang mtshan nyid rig pa'i 'gro lugs shes pa'i ched du bsdus grwa dang / de rjes blo rigs te dbang po lnga dang / dbang shes lnga sogs mngon sum dang /230

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamaglengad+ngha/da ge — gtan tshigs rig pa la brten nas phyi rol yul ngos 'dzin byed pa'i rjes dpag gi shes rig bcas skye tshul dang / mngon sum dang rjes dpag bar gyi 'brel ba/ 'khrul shes te nor 'khrul can gyi shes pa dang / log shes te bsam blo yang ma dag pa'i rigs/ dad pa brtson 'grus sogs sems pa bzang ba'i rigs/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang sogs bsam pa ngan pa'i rigs/ 'gyodatrepa dang gnyid sogs gzhan 'gyur gyi rigs/ gzhan yang de dag dang 'brel yod kyi bsam blo rigs mi 'dra ba so so'i khyad chos dang 'brel ba bcas shes pa'i ched du blo rigs/ gtan tshigs rigs pa yang dag pa gsum dang / yang ma dag bzhi bcas so so'i khyad chos dang /'brel ba/ nang gses kyi dbye ba/ gtan tshigs rigs pa khag dang bsam blo rigs mi 'dra ba khag bar 'brel ba gang yod pa bcas shes pa'i ched du rtags rigs te gtan tshigs rigs pa/ de yi rmang gzhi'i thog rgya gar du yod pa'i gna' rabs kyi chos lugs te mu stegs pa'i lta ba rigs bcu gcig so so'i lta tshul dang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba khag gi bar gyi khyad par dang 'gal ba dang / 'thab rtsod bcas kyi gnas tshul shes pa'i ched du tshad ma rig pa ste tshad ma rnam 'grel/ de rjes nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa po'i spyod tshul shes pa'i ched du phar phyin / de rjes nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa chen po'i lta ba shes pa'i ched du dbu ma/de rjes theg pa chung ngu'i spyod pa dang lta ba shes pa'i ched du mngon pa mdzod/de rjes theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i thun mong gi spyod pa shes pa'i ched du 'dul ba bcas go rim bzhin du slob dgos pa ma zad/ de rnams so so 23/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la yang slob sbyong byas pa'i lo tshad dang / lo rer slob sbyong gi mtshams gang nas gang gi bar du slebs dgos pa'i tshad gzhi bcas gtan 'bebs yod pa red/ gzhung chen po lnga'i slob sbyong gi lo tshad skor gsham du slob sbyong gi yun tshad dang lo re'i slob dus skor gleng skabs su bkod yod/5 slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi/ slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi zhes pa ni slob khrid kyi go rim dang dus tshod sogs 'khod pa'i yig cha zhig ste slob grwa dang ched las kyi ngo bo ldan pa'i las 'gan khag slob ma'i lo tshad khyad chos/ slob tshan khag gi slob khrid dus tshod dang / rgyugs len/ slob grwa thon pa'i yig tshad sogs slob grwa de'i bya rim cha tshang ba rnams dus dang khag bgos nas gtan 'khel byas pa de yin/ 'char gzhi de ni slob grwa'i 'go khrid las khungs la dgos pa ma zad/ dge rgan so sor yang slob dus re dang / lo re slob grwa 'go tshugs nas ma thon bar bcas dus thung dang dus ring gi slob khrid 'char gzhi yod dgos shing / 'char gzhi med par slob khrid byas na slob dus gcig la slob khrid zin dgos pa rnams kyang ma grub par lhag ma lus pa'am/ yang na gal che'i slob tshan zhig kyang dus tshod thung ngu zhig la slob khrid zin pa byas te slob khrid kyi spus tshad ma lon pa'i khral sel sla bcos yong nyen chen po yod/ de sngon gdan sa chen po khag dang gzhung btsugs dang sger btsugs kyi slob grwa rnying pa khag la slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi rags bsdus tsam las zhib phra med pa ma zad/ dge rgan rnams pa tshos kyang rang rang gi mkhyen rgya che chung la gzhigs pa'i slob khrid rgyas bsdus thugs 'dod ltar gnang ba ma gtogs yig cha'i thog 232

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da ——gcig gyur gyis gtan 'khel byas pa'i 'char gzhi gtan nas med stabs dge rgan mkhyen yon ha cang rgyas pa tshos slob tshan gcig la dus tshod ha cang ring po 'gor 'gro zhing / dge rgan mkhyen rgya chung ba tshos slob tshan gal che'i rigs kyang dus tshod thung thung zhig nang grub pa mdzad de slob khrid gnad la 'khel po zhig yong gi med pa red/ de ni gna' rabs bod kyi slob gso'i lam lugs thog ma 'dang ba'i skyon cha zhig yin pas deng dus dang mthun par 'char gzhi ldan pa'i slob khrid lam lugs gcig gyur zhig 'dzugs dgos pa red/6 slob khrid zin bris/ de ni slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin gzhir bzung nas dge rgan so sos bris pa'i slob khrid zin bris zhig ste de sngon gdan sa chen po khag gi grwa tshang so sor mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung chen po lnga'i spyi don dang mtha' dpyod sogs rgyas bsdus sna tshogs yod cing / mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis ni gzhung chen po lnga ka cha tshang ba'i spyi don dang mtha' dpyod bcas mdzad yod pa dang 'ga' zhig gis ni gzhung gcig gam gnyis gsum lta bu'i spyi don dang mtha' dpyod mdzad pa bcas ni mkha sa pa so sos rang nyid kyi slob ma rnams la slob khrid gnang skabs slob dpon rang nyid dang / yang na slob ma rnams kyis zin bris byas pa zhig yin/ dbus gtsang gdan sa chen po bzhi dang / mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil/ sku 'bum byams pa gling / dwags po bshad sgrub gling /dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang / co ne dgon chen bcas la rang rang so so'i gzhung chen po lnga'i spyi don dang mtha' dpyod rgyas bsdus sna tshogs 233

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod pa'i skor zhib par sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈 baiḍūr+ya gsa' sel 〉rig gnas lnga'i bshad pa'i skabs dang / klong rdol bla ma 0 ṭ+wāṃn po che ngag dbang blo bzang gis mdzad pa'i 〈 bka' gdams pa dang dge lugs pa'i bla ma rags rim gyi gsung 'bum mtshan tho 〉zhes pa'i nang gsal/ gna' rabs bod kyi slob gso'i lam lugs thog gdan sa khag dang grwa tshang khag so sor gtan 'khel byas pa'i slob khrid zin bris gong du bkod pa de rnams ma gtogs slob khrid mdzad po dge rgan dang slob dpon rang rang so sos zur du slob khrid zin bris 'god pa gnang srol med/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni dge rgan res slob khrid zin bris re bkod pa gnang na zin bris gcig gyur zhig yong dka' ba dang / dge rgan rnams thugs thog nas slob khrid gnang rgyur byang goms thon po yod pa'i rkyen gyis slob khrid zin bris zur du 'god dgos pa'i dka' ngal med pa red/deng skabs ni 'char gzhi zhib phra ldan pa'i slob khrid lam lugs lag bstar byed kyi yod pa ma zad/ dus thung lo gsum bzhi'i nang gal che'i ched las slob tshan mang po zhig slob khrid byas zin pa dgos stabs dge rgan so sos rang rang gi gsung bshad rgyas bsdus 'tshams shing gnad la khel ba'i slob khrid zin bris re nges par du 'god gnang mdzad dgos shing / ma mthar yang gsung bshad gnang rgyu'i don tshan khag gi sa bcad rkang grangs tsam gyi brjed tho zhig las ma byung yang nges par du 'god gnang mdzad rgyu gnad chen po yod/7 slob khrid bya thabs/ de sngon bod du gdan sa chen po khag la 234

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa —slob khrid bya thabs kyi nyams myong mang po yod pa rnams sa skya paṇa chen gyis phyogs bsdoms mdzad de 〈mkhas pa khri/ 'jug pa'i sgo 〉las gsal bshad rgyas par gnang yod pas 'dir gnad bsdus tsam bkod na/ thog mar gzhung don dngos gzhi ma 'chad gong du sngon 'gro la gzhung de'i dgos don dang dmigs yul bshad nas nyan pa po slob ma rnams spro ba skyed du 'jug pa dang / de rjes bshad bya'i gzhung de'i nang don gtso bo gang dang gang yod pa bcas bshad nas nyan pa po rnams gzhung don rags rim tsam khong du chud thabs byed dgos pa/ de rjes gzhung don dngos gzhi 'chad skabs bshad tshul ma legs pa'i skyon bcu gsum yod pa de dag spangs nas bshad tshul legs pa'i phyogs la 'bad brtson byed dgos pa ste/ de yang / (1)ma bshad pa'i skyon ni/ skabs der bshad dgos nges kyi don ma bshad par bzhag pa ste/ de ni slob khrid byed mkhan gyis rang gis bshad bya'i gzhung don de la dogs pa chod med pa dang /gsal por 'chad thub pa'i gdeng tshod med pa'i dbang gis g.yol thabs byas te bzhag pa yin pas des nyan mkhan rnams la phan thogs yod pa'i blo bskyed gang yang thon mi thub pas slob khrid spus legs yong dka' ba red/ (2)legs par ma bshad pa'i skyon ni/ bshad bya'i gzhung don rnams gsal la mi gsal tsam bshad nas nyan pa pos gzhung don la dogs pa gang yang chod ma thub par lus pa zhig ste/ de ni dge rgan gyis rang nyid mkhas rlos dang nga rgyal byas te rang nyid kyis ma shes pa rnams slob sbyong nan tan ma byas pa'i dbang gigobyung ba yin/ (3)phyin ci log 235

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tu bshad pa ni/ dge rgan gyis gzhung don go ba log sgrub byas te bshad pa zhig ste/ dge rgan gyis 'khrid bya'i gzhung don de la go ba yang dag par lon ma thub par go nor thebs pa'am/ yang na dmigs yul zur bcangs kyi sgo nas shes bzhin du go ba log sgrub byas te bshad pa gang rung zhig yin pas nyan pa po rnams la phan thogs yod pa'i blo bskyed mi 'byung ba ma zad/ mthong thos kyi shes rgya chung ba'i mi mang po zhig mgo bskor thebs te ma dag rgyun 'byams dang rang gzhan tshang mar gnod skyon chen po yong ba'i gzhi yin/ (4)the tshom dang bcas te bshad pa ni/ dge rgan gyis bshad bya'i gzhung don la dogs pa ma chod bzhin du 'ol tshod byas nas bshad pa zhig ste/ de ni dge rgan gyis bshad bya'i nang don de la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba mang po zhig rnam grangs tsam du bshad pa las rang nyid kyi lta tshul gang yang gsal bshad bya rgyu med pa ste/ lo rgyus thog gi bshad tshul mi mthun pa rnams dpang rtags 'pher ba'i dpyad gzhi'i dngos por tshad 'dzin bya rgyu ma gtogs rigs pas sgrub mi thub pa phud/ de min bshad bya'i gzhung don gang yin gdeng tshod yod pa'i sgo nas gsal bshad bya dgos pa yin/ (5)dka' sar g.yol nas sla sar spros bshad byed pa ni/ dge rgan gyis 'khrid bya'i gzhung de'i dka' gnad che sar gsal bshad byed mi thub par g.yol nas dka' gnad min pa'i sar bshad pa mang po byas pa zhig ste/ de ni mi rgan so med kyis zas za ba dang 'dra bar gal che ba'i dka' gnad rnams rab rib tsam du lus na sa gzhung don la dogs pa chod pa'i blo bskyed gang yang thob mi thub pa yin/236

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa(6)go rim med par bshad pa ni/ dge rgan gyis gzhung don snga phyi'i go rim dkrugs nas bshad pa zhig ste/ de ni dge rgan gyis gzhung don so so'i snga phyi'i go rim rnams nyan pa po'i bsam blos phyi rol yul la ngos 'dzin byed pa'i go rim dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad don gal chen po der do snang ma byas par rang nyid kyi 'dod pa ltar go ri ma med par gang bsam gang dran du bshad pa yin pas bshad tshul des slob ma'i shes yon khong du chud pa'i go rim mkhrugs nas slob sbyong thog grub 'bras chen po thob rgyur shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs nges yin/ (7)skabs su ma babs par bshad pa ni/ slob dpon gyis gzhung don 'chad skabs de dang 'brel ba med pa dang / skabs su ma babs bzhin du go skabs btsal nas bshad pa zhig ste/ bshad tshul des skabs su babs pa'i bshad bya gtso bo brlags nas nyan mkhan gyi bsam blo 'khrugs te gnad don gtso bo ngos zin ma thub pa'i skyon chen po yod/ (8)'brel ma chags par bshad pa ni/dge rgan gyis bshad bya'i gzhung don rnams snga phyi'i go rim gyi 'brel ba yod pa rnams 'brel mthud byed ma thub par dum bur chad nas bshad pa zhig ste/ bshad tshul des slob ma rnams gzhung don snga phyi'i bar gyi 'brel ba gang yin pa dang / gzhung don snga ma bshad rjes phyi ma de dang de bshad pa'i dgos pa gang yin shes mi thub pa'i skyon chen po yod/ (9)rang tshig snga phyi 'gal ba'i skyon ni/ slob dpon gyis slob khrid byed skabs rang nyid kyis 'grel bshad byas pa'i tshig snga phyi'i bar mi mthun pa'i 'gal ba yod pa zhig ste/ bshad tshul des slob ma rnams la rang lugs gang yin gzhi 237

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dzin sa med pa'i dogs pa mang po skyes nas slob dpon la yid ches chung du 'gro ba dang / mtha' ma 'phya smod byed pa'i gzhir 'gro nyen chen po yod/(10)tshig dang don la ldab skyor mang ba ni/ slob dpon gyis slob khrid byed skabs dgos pa gang yang med par bshad zin pa'i tshig don la yang nas yang du ldab skyor byas pa ste/ de ni slob dpon gyis sngar bshad zin pa'i tshig don la sngar las lhag pa'i gsal bshad bya rgyu yod pa'am/ yang na mdor bstan dang / rgyas bshad/ dogs gcod bcas kyi dgos pa lhag po gang yang med bzhin du yang nas yang du bskyar zlos mang po byas na slob ma'i sems la sun snang skye ba dang / yang na go mi bde ba'i shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs kyi red/ 'on kyang slob ma'i gnas tshad mtho dman mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis gnas tshad mtho ba tshor slob dpon gyis lan gcig bshad pa tsam gyis shes thub cing / 'dzin grwa gcig gi nang du yod pa'i slob ma yin kyang gnas tshad cung zad zhan pa rnams la bshad pa rgyas bsdus 'bring tsam bya dgos pa dang / gnas tshad ha cang dma' ba rnams la bshad pa mdor bsdus tsam re byas na chog pa bcas ni dgos pa'i dbang gis yin pas bskyar ldab mang ba'i skyon du mi brtsi ba yin/ (11)gzhung don phan tshun 'dres pa'i skyon ni/ slob dpon gyis slob khrid byed skabs gzhung don gtso bo dang phal pa so sor ma phye bar mnyam du bsres nas bshad pa zhig ste/ bshad tshul des gzhung don gtso bo bshad ma zin gong du yan lag gi don phal pa bshad pa des skabs don gtso bo bsgribs te gtso gnad mngon gsal dod po mi yong ba'i shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs 238

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da da kyi yod/ (12)tshig ha cang myur ba'i skyon ni/ slob dpon gyis slob khrid byed skabs smra brjod ha cang mgyogs drags pa dpe cha ngag skyor byed pa dang 'dra ba zhig ste/ bshad tshul des slob ma zin bris 'debs 'dod yod pa rnams yig 'bri'i rjes zin thub pa lta zhog blo 'dzin bzang ba rnams kyis kyang sems la nges mi thub pa'i dbang gis slob thun grol ba dang slob mas brjed pa dus mtshungs pas slob sbyong gi grub 'bras thog shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs kyi yod/ (13)tshig ha cang dal drags pa'i skyon ni/ slob dpon gyis slob khrid byed skabs ngag gi smra brjod ha cang dal drags pa tshig 'bru re re bzhin du blo 'dzin byas pa lta bu zhig ste/bshad tshul des slob ma rnams kyi sems la sun snang skye ba dang / slob khrid kyi myur tshad dma' ba/ tshig don snga phyir go ba len mi bde ba bcas kyi skyon yod/ gong gsal slob khrid byed tshul yang ma dag pa'i skyon bcu gsum po de spangs nas bya thabs yang dag pa rnams khong du chud pa bya dgos pas bya thabs yang dag pa ni gong du bshad pa'i skyon bcu gsum po de'i ldog phyogs rnams yin/ de la brten nas grub 'bras dang dge mtshan rnams 'byung zhing / da dung de'i thog tshig don nges pa'i sgrub byed/yid ches pa'i gtam rgyud dang lung / go bde ba'i dpe/ blo sgo 'byed byed kyi dogs slong dang / bgro gleng / gnyid rmugs sel ba'i gtam rgyud bcas kyi sgo nas slob khrid byed dgos/ de ni blo sgo 'byed pa'i slob khrid bya thabs yin/ gzhan yang slob khrid bya thabs skor sa skya paṇa chen dang grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pa mang pos rgyas bsdus sna tshogs shig 239

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mdzad yod pas de dag tu gzigs na gsal zhing / 'dir phyogs ston tsam las zhib phra 'god pa'i ngal ba ma byas so/ /8 blo sgo 'byed thabs kyi slob khrid/ de ni dge rgan gyis gtso khrid nus pa 'don pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen 'og slob mas gtso bor bsam gzhigs byed pa'i bya thabs shig yin/ bya thabs 'dis slob ma'i slob sbyong gi hur brtson rang bzhin dang / rang rtogs rang bzhin/ rang 'gul rang bzhin bcas skul spel byed thub pa dang / rang skya 'pher ba'i sgo nas gnad don rtogs thub pa dang / dbye zhib/ yin min brdar sha gcod thub pa'i dmigs yul 'grub thub pa yin/ slob ma'i shes yon ni rgyun pa3 mu mthud nas gnad don shes pa dang / gnad don thag gcod pa/ yin min brdar sha gcod pa bcas kyi go rim nang thon pa yin/ blo sgo 'byed pa'i bya thabs de'i nang slob dpon gyis slob khrid byed pa ni 'gal ba'i phyogs gtso bo yin pa dang / slob mar khrid ston byas te rang rang bsam blo gtong du 'jug pa 'gal ba'i phyogs phal pa yin/ yin na'ang slob ma/'i slob sbyong la mtshon na slob ma ni nang rkyen yin pas de la don gnyer yod dgos pa dang / khrid pa ni slob sbyong byed pa brgyud na gzhi nas slob khrid kyi nus pa thon thub/ der brten slob khang nang du slob ma gtso bo yin zhing / slob khrid byed pa'i go rim nang kho tsho klad pa 'gul ba dang / bsam gzhigs gtong ba/ rig 'ded byed pa/ brdar sha gcod pa/ dogs pa dang dka' gnad 'dri ba bcas byed du 'jug dgos/de sngon gdan sa chen po rnams su gzhung chen po'i slob khrid gnang skabs 240

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/—da da wadage rgan gyis gsung pa tsam ma yin par dge slob phan tshun dri ba dri lan dang / bgro gleng gi thabs shes zung 'brel gnang ba'i rgyu mtshan yang der thug pa yin cing / de la gong du bshad pa ltar gyi khyad chos chen po yod pa dang / de la brten nas gom pa rim bgrod kyis shes tshad dang / ngos 'dzin gyi chu tshad gong mthor gtong thub pa ste rags pa nas zab pa dang /nye ba nas ring ba/ tshor snang nas rjes dpag bye brag nas spyi'i rang ba zhin du gong 'phel 'gro thub pa'i bsam blo'i ngos 'dzin dang sems khams rig pa'i chos nyid dang mthun pa'i bya rim rnams der tshang yod pas snga rabs bod kyi mkhas pa tshos blo sgo 'byed thabs kyi slob khrid de gtso bor 'dzin pa gnang gi yod/9 slob khrid yo byad/ dge rgan gyis slob khrid gnang skabs bed spyod gnyong rgyu'i yo byad dngos po'i rigs te gna' rabs bod du slob khrid yo byadartsoha cang stabs bde zhig las med/ gzhung chen po'i slob khrid gnang skabs gtso bor mtshan nyid rig pa'i thog nas go ba len dgos rgyur brten slob khrid yo byad ri mo dang / dpe ris sogs dgos pa'i skabs ha cang nyung zhing / de min gso ba rig pa dang / skar rtsis/gsang sngags bcas kyi slob khrid skabs yig 'bri'i yo byad sam ṭa dang /sgor thig thig skud/ thig shing / dpe ris/ dmar dpe/ 'bur thon 'dra bzo bcas la brten nas dge rgan gyis slob rim bzhin slob mas rgyugs ma 'phrod bar du dngos su lag bstar gyis dngos sbyong byed dgos pa ha cang mang po yod cing / de dag gi skabs bed spyod gtong rgyu'i yo 24/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byad kyang rjes lus can gyi yo byad stabs bde sha stag red/ deng sang rgyal khab phyi nang du tshan rig rig gnas yar rgyas 'gro mgyogs po yod par brten slob khrid yo byad la yang legs bcos dang gong 'phel chen po byung ste dpe ris la mtshon na tshon khra can gyi dpar ris dang / dpar chas/'gul med glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin/ dngos bshus glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin/ tin rtsi (glog rdul)rtsis rgyag 'phrul 'khor sogs rang 'gul can gyi 'phrul chas mang po yod cing / par 'debs yo byad la mtshon na rang 'gul can gyi par 'debs 'phrul 'khor dang par slog 'phrul 'khor 'dra min sna tshogs yod pa dang / yig 'bri'i yo byad la mtshon na yig 'bru bsgrigs pa'i lcags par 'phrul 'khor dang / ten rtsi'i thabs shes la brten nas dpyad gzhi 'tshol bsdu byed pa'i 'phrul 'khor sogs slob gso'i yo byad ha cang mang po zhig deng rabs can dang 'phrul chas can du gyur zin pas bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i thog de dag bed spyod gtong 'go tshugs pa bcas cha rkyen bzang po yod/ 'on kyang cha rkyen bzang po de dag gis slob gso'i thog nus pa rgya chen po thon thub dang mi thub ni deng rabs can gyi slob khrid yo byad de tsho dge rgan rnams kyis bed spyod gtong thub min la rag lus shing / de tsho bed spyod gtong thub pa byed dgos na slob deb kyi spus tshad mtho zhing / gcig gyur che tsam yin pa dang slob khrid bya thabs gsar pa zhig la brten na ma gtogs gcig gyur med pa dang / spus tshad zhan pa/ bya thabs rnying pa bcas yin pa'i slob deb la brten na deng rabs can gyi slob khrid yo byad 242

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wade dag bed spyod gtong rgyur 'phrod po med pa red/10 slob khang / de sngon dgon pa khag gi nang slob khrid gnang sa'i slob khang zur du med la de yang dmigs 'dzugs byas pa'i slob khang nang dge rgan phar phebs nas slob mar slob khrid gnang srol med cing /dge rgan gyi gzim khang nang slob ma tsho sku bcar zhus te slob khrid nyan pa'am/ yang na sdod khang gi cha rkyen legs pa'i slob ma zhig gi khang pa'i nang dge rgan gdan zhu byas te slob khrid nyan srol yod/ slob ma'i sdod khang nang dge rgan gdan zhu byas pa'i slob khrid ni 'dzin grwa gcig gnyis dang / yang na 'dzin grwa so so'i nang nas slob khrid nyan 'dod yod pa'i slob ma khag gcig la dus tshod rgyun ring tsam gyi bar slob khrid gnang rgyu de red/ de 'dra'i skabs su slob ma su'i sdod khang nang slob khrid gnang kyang gdan zhu byed mkhan gyi slob ma des slob khrid de ma grub bar du dge rgan la gsol chas 'bul rgyu'i 'gan 'khur gyi yod/ deng sang slob khang cha rkyen bzang po yod pa ni 'dzin grwa rer slob khang re re yod la/ 'dzin grwa gsum bzhi shong thub pa'i slob khang po yang yod cing / de tsho tshang ma'i nang du mi rer rkub stegs re dang lcog tse re/ yig 'bri dang dpe ris 'bri sa'i nag pang chen po re/ mtshan mo'i dus su nyin mo ltar gsal ba'i glog bzhu sogs yod pas slob khang gi cha rkyen bzang po 'di 'dra bod ljongs zhi bas bcings 'grol thob rjes gzhi nas byung ba ma gtogs de sngon spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs su mthong rgyu lta zhog sems la dran mkhan yang yod med kyi tshod tsam yin pa ni rgan rabs nyams myong can tshang mas 243

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/shes gsal ltar red/11 slo ba tshan/ de ni nang don dmigs bsal can gyi slob khrid sde tshan zhig ste/ dper na rig gnas chung ba lnga dang / che ba lnga/ deng rabs kyi skye dngos rig pa dang / srog chags rig pa/ rdzas 'gyur rig pa sogs lta bu yin cing / de rnams rang rang so sor thun mong ma yin pa'i nang don dang / ming tshig tha snyad/ slob sbyong gi re 'dun dang tshad gzhi bcas mi 'dra ba yod pas dmigs su bkar nas slob khrid byed dgos pa ma zad/ slob tshan khag re re la yang snga phyi'i go rim dang / nang gses kyi rnam grangs/ zhar byung gi donanotshan nang phan tshun gyi 'brel ba sogs zhib cing phra ba'i don tshan mang po yod/12 zur bkol slob tshan/ rtsa ba'i slob tshan gyi nang nas dka' gnad gal che ba'i rigs zur du bton nas bzos pa'i slob tshan la zur bkol slob tshan zer/ dper na/ phar phyin gyi nang nas drang nges dang / bsam gzugs/ rten 'brel/ dge 'dun nyi shu bcas zur 'don byas pa dang / de bzhin du dbu ma'i nang nas mtha' bzhi'i skye ba 'gog pa/ bdag 'gog pa/ kun gzhi bcas zur 'don byas pa/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi nang nas blo rigs/ rtags rigs/ gzhan sel/ tshad ma grub pa/ mngon sum le'u sogs zur 'don byas pa lta bus mtshon dka' gnad che zhing bshad gzhi mang ba'i rigs zur 'don gyis dmigs su bkar nas slob sbyong rgyun ring tsam byed dgos pa lta bu yin/13 slob deb/ de ni slob ma'i gnas tshad rab 'bring tha gsum 244

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da gyi gnas tshul mi 'dra ba gzhir bzung nas rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum du bzos pa'i slob khrid yig cha zhig ste de la nang gses rigs gsum yod/(byu1)gzhung cha tshang ba'i slob deb/ de ni slob ma gnas tshad mtho ba tshor slob khrid bya rgyu'i slob deb rgyas pa'i rigs te gzhung chen po lnga so so'i rtsa ba dang de'i 'grel pa rgya gar dang bod kyi mkhas pa tshos mdzad pa ha cang mang po yod de/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pas mdzad pa rnams ni bstan 'gyur gyi nang du bzhugs shing / bod kyi snga rabs su byon pa'i rimakhas dbang rngog lo yab sras dang / phya pa chos kyi seng ge khong gi slob ma seng brgyad/sa skya paṇa chen/ 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge/ mtshims 'jam dbyangs/kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba/ rje btsun red mda' ba/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/ 'jam mgon tsong kha chen po/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub/ sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ karma pa sku phreng brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis gzhung pod lnga ka dang / 'ga' zhig gis gzhung re thung bcas kyi 'grel pa rgyas bsdus sna tshogs mdzad yod pa'i skor zhib par 〈 bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag 〉 khag dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈 baiḍūr+ya g.ya' sel 〉gyi rig gnas lnga'i skor dang / a khu rin po che shes rab rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈 dpe rgyun dkon pa 'ga' zhig gi tho yig 〉bcas kyi nang gsal/ (2)'dem sgrig slob deb/ gzhung chen po lnga dang rig gnas skor sogs slob tshan lte ba'i nang nas gnad che ba 245

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'ga' zhig phyogs bsdus kyis 'dem sgrig byas pa zhig ste/ dper na/ de sngon mkhas pa chen po phya pa chos kyi seng ges tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi nang don khag don tshan nyi shu rtsa lngar bsdus pa la bsdus grwa zhes grags pa dang /de yang blo rab 'bring tha gsum gyici gnas tshad dang bstun te bsdus chen/bsdus 'bring / bsdus chung bcas khag gsum du bgos te rim bzhin rigs lam dma' ba nas 'bring dang chen po bcas su gom pa rim bgrod kyis slob sbyong byed thabs 'don pa gnang thog bsdus grwa slob sbyong mthar phyin pa byung na tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi gzhung don cha tshang bar khong du chud thub pa'i dge mtshan chen po yod pa dang / de bzhin du tshad ma dang /phar phyin/ dbu ma/ mdzod bcas kyi nang don khag gnad bsdus byas pa'i gzhung 〈 grub mtha' 〉zhes pa'i rgyas bsdus sna tshogs pa zhig ris med kyi mkhas pa mang pos mdzad yod pa'i nang nas rgyas shos ni 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng dang po ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyis mdzad pa'i 〈 grub mtha' chen mo 〉yin cing / de la khal kha'i dge bshes ngag dbang dpal ldan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈 mchan 'grel 〉legs po zhig kyang yod/grub mtha'i nang nas rgyas bsdus 'tshams shing go bde ba ni lcang skya ho thog thu rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 〈 grub mtha' thub bstan mdzes rgyan 〉zhes pa de yin/ 'dul ba'i gzhung gi nang nas gnad bsdus byas pa ni 〈 'dul ba'i bslab bya 〉khag dang / 〈 'dul ba'i las chog 〉rgyas bsdus/ 〈 'dul ba'i gleng gzhi 〉bcas yin/ de bzhin du rig gnas chung ba khag la yang don tshan gal chen gnad bsdus rgyas bsdus byas pa 246

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa—rgyas bsdus sna tshogs yod pa lta bu red/ deng sang slob grwa che ba 'ga' zhig la gna' rabs kyi rig gnas dang / lo rgyus chos lugs bcas kyi nang nas gnad bsdus byas pa'i 'dem sgrig slob deb bed spyod gtong gi yod/ 'on kyang 'dem sgrig byed mkhas po ma byung na slob deb mgo yod mjug rdum/ mgo med mjug med sogs skyon cha mang po yong gi yod/(3)zur blta'i slob deb/ de ni dngos gzhi'i slob deb dang thad kar 'brel ba yod pa'am/ yang na zhar byung gi don tshan lta bu 'ga' zhig slob deb nang du dngos su ma bkod par slob ma rnams kyis dus tshod yod skabs zur blta byas chog pa zhig ste/ de sngon gdan sa chen po khag la gzhung chen po lnga dang rig gnas slob sbyong skabs gcig gyur gyi yig cha mang po yod pa phud/ dgon pa grwa tshang gzhan dag gi yig cha rnams blta klog byed rgyu'i go skabs yod tshe zur blta byed chog pa lta bu yin/1 4 spob smyong sngon gyi slob gso/ bod kyi slob gso'i lam lugs thog gzhung chen po lnga dang rig gnas slob sbyong ma byas gong du slob gnyer gyi rmang gzhi 'ding ba'i slob gso yod/ de la khyim tshang nang gi slob gso dang / dgon par zhugs nas slob sbyong dngos gzhi ma byas gong gi gra sgrig slob gso bcas rigs gnyis yod/(1)khyim tshang gi slob gso/ de ni bu phrug rnams dgon par chos zhugs ma byas gong pha ma'i sar khyim gyi 'tsho ba skyel dgos pas de skabs pha ma'i slob gso ni gal che ba zhig ste/ pha ma'i 'tsho ba skyel stangs 'dra min gyis bu phrug la shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs kyi yod pas de'i skabs su ya 247

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rabs srol rgyun gyi slob gso dang / kun spyod kyi slob gso/ shes yon gyi rmang gzhi'i yi ge 'bri klog gi slob gso bcas byed dgos/ ya rabs srol rgyun gyi slob gso zer ba ni spyi tshogs thog gi bsngags 'os kyi spyod bzang ste pha ma dang rgan rabs la gus pa/ yon tan can la brtsi bkur/ spyod bzang la mig dpe lta ba bcas yin/ kun spyod kyi slob gso zer ba ni za 'thung dang / 'gro 'dug skad cha shod stangs/ khrims mthun byed stangs bcas yin/ shes yon gyi rmang gzhi'i slob gso zer ba ni yi ge 'bri klog dang / sum rtags dag gsum gyi rtsa ba blo 'dzin byed rgyu sogs yin/(2)slob sbyong sngon gyi gra sgrig slob gso/ de ni dgon par chos zhugs byas rjes nas slob gnyer dngos su ma byas bar gyi slob gso ste byis pa lo bdun yan lon nas dgon par chos zhugs byas rjes rang lo bcu yan ma slebs bar du kun spyod sgrig khrims kyi slob gso dang rmang gzhi'i shes yon gyi slob gso gtong dgos pa la zer/ de sngon bod du gdan sa chen po khag la byis pa dgon pa'i nang chos zhugs byas rjes gzhung chen po'i slob sbyong dngos su 'go ma tshugs bar lo shas ring khag theg dge rgan (shag rogs dge rgan)zer ba zhig yod pa de'i sar bsdad nas yi ge 'bri klog dang / dgon pa'i zhal 'don khag phar phyin 〈 mngon rtogs rgyan 〉dang / 〈 dbu ma 'jug pa 〉bcas blo 'dzin ngag skyor byed rgyu gtso bo dang / zhar la dgon pa'i sgrig khrims dang spyi tshogs thog gi ya rabs kun spyod/ grwa pa'i za 'thung 'gro 'dug sogs kyi lugs srol rnams ngag slob lus khrid thog zhi drag gang la gang 'os kyi sgo nas pha ma bzang pos bu tsha 248

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa—gso skyong byed pa ltar sbyong brdar gnang srol yod cing / lhag par du khag theg dge rgan sku yon bzang ba rnams kyis byis pa chung ngu'i rigs shes rig rgyas shing rtsa khams gsal ba'i dus skabs der gzhung don la go ba len rgyu dang bsam gzhigs byed pa'i nus rtsal zhan yang / dbang po lnga'i yul du 'char snang gang byung sems la ma brjed par thad kar nges thub pa'i khyad chos yod pa de gzhir bzung nas yi ge 'bri klog dang / gzhung chen po lnga'i rtsa tshig rnams blo 'dzin ngag skyor byed du bcug te rjes su rig gnas che chung khag slob sbyong byed thub pa'i rmang gzhi bzang po 'ding gnang mdzad kyi yod pa des gzhon nu'i dus skabs su dge rgan gyis slob khrid gang gnangardzib tshang ma so sos blo 'dzin byas pa'i rtsa tshig de'i thog tu bye ma la chu sim pa ltar hril hril 'jags thub pa ma zad/ lo na mthon por slebs pa'i rjes su yang rang nyid byis pa dang gzhon nu'i dus su blo 'dzin byas pa rnams nam yang ma brjed par brtan por nges thub pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa zhig yod/ phyogs mtshungs byis pa'i dus su kun spyod bzang po dang sgrig khrims bzang po sna tshogs la goms gshis chags su bcug pa de yang btsan shed kyi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin rung / bya rim de brgyud nas rang rtogs yod pa'i kun spyod bzang po dang / sgrig khrims srung rgyur rang 'gul yod pa zhi ga tu 'tsha ra longs 'byung nges pa ni spyod bzang yod pa dang rig gnas yod pa zhig tu 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i chos nyid dang yongs su mthun pa zhig yin/15 slob zhugs kyi 'gro lugs/ thog mar khag theg dge rgan 249

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas dpe cha'i dge rgan dang khang tshan dge rgan la snyan zhu phul te de nas khang tshan dge rgan gyis grwa tshang dge bskos dang / mkhan por snyan zhu 'bul dgos/ mkhan por gsar mjal zhu skabs mjal dar dang dngul phran bu 'bul dgos/ gsar zhugs dngos gzhi'i skabs khang tshan dge rgan gyis sne khrid nas dge bskos la ngo sprod zhus thog ming tho 'god dgos shing / de nyin nas slob gnyer ba'i khongs su tshud pa yin/16 dge rgan/ dge rgan zhes pa'i go don skor sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung nas bshad tshul ni/ rang nyid kyi sgo gsum nyes spyod las ldog cing / ya rabs dge ba'i phyogs la sbyor mkhas pa dang / rang nyid las yon tan gyi sgo nas rgan pa yin pa'i dbang gis dge rgan zhes thogs par gsungs pa 'di la go rgyu gting zab po yod/ dbus gtsang gdan sa chen po khag la dge rgan rigs gsum yod/ 1 khag theg dge rgan/ de ni rang nyid dgon pa der chos sgor zhugs rjes sgrig khrims las mi 'gal ba dang / rgyun ldan gyi 'tsho ba/ slob sbyong / dpe cha'i dge rgan 'tshol rgyu sogs kyi thad la legs spel nyes 'gog gi slob ston dang lta rtog mdzad mkhan yin/ 2 dpe cha'i dge rgan/ de ni sngon dus gdan sa chen po khag la dpe cha slob khrid gnang mkhan gyi dge rgan la zer zhing / gzhung chen por slob sbyong byed pa'i dus la slebs shing slob sbyong byed 'dod yod pa'i slob gnyer pa der 'os shing 'tshams pa'i dpe cha'i dge rgan zhig khag theg dge rgan gyis btsal te/ de la slob gnyer gnyer ba de'i slob khrid mngags bcol zhus yod la/ yang 'dzin grwa gcig gi slob gnyer ba 250

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ ge———tshang mas mos mthun byas te dge rgan gcig 'tshol ba yang yod cing /'dzin grwa mang pos dpe cha'i dge rgan gcig btsal te/ dge rgan gyis bkod sgrig gnang ba'i dus tshod dang mthun par 'dzin grwa khag nyin res mos kyis sku drung du bcar nas slob khrid nyan pa yang yod/ gang ltar dpe cha'i dge rgan ni slob gnyer ba rnams kyis rang mos thog nas 'tshol ba las dgon pa dang srid gzhung gis bka' 'bebs bsko bzhag byed pa'i lugs srol med/ 3 zur khrid dge rgan/ de ni slob ma mang po yod pa'i dge rgan rnams kyis slob ma'i nang nas gnas tshad mtho ba khag gcig bdams te de la slob ma gnas tshad dma' ba tshor zur du slob khrid rogs ram byed du bcug pa la zer/ de ni slob khrid kyi las don dngos kyi nang dge rgan dpung khag gso skyong byed pa dang chabs cig slob ma gnas tshad dma' ba tsho shes tshad gong mthor gtong thub pa'i nyams myong gnad chen zhig red/17 dge rgan gyi 'os tshad/ de ni dge rgan la tshang dgos pa'i yon tan la zer ba ste/ da lta dge rgan byed mus yin pa rnams kyis 'os tshad de rang nyid la tshang ma tshang brtags nas ma tshang ba rnams tshang bar 'bad brtson byed dgos pa dang / tshang ba rnams sngar las lhag par gong 'phel gtong dgos pa/ 'byung 'gyur dge rgan gyi las gnas su slebs rgyu dang / dge rgan byed 'dod yod pa rnams kyis dge rgan gyi 'os gzhir bzung nas rang nyid la blang bya 'don dgos zhes sngon byon bod kyi mkhas pa tshos slob dpon gyi yon tan bshad pa'i skabs su nan tan gyis 25/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsungs yod/ dge rgan la nges par du tshang dgos pa'i yon tan de la bcu gcig yod/ (1)dul ba/ lus ngag gi bya spyod ngan pa rnams spangs nas kun spyod gtsang ma zhig dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni dge rgan zer ba slob ma'i mig dpe lta sa yin pa lugs rgyag sa'i lugs par dang 'dra zhes gsungs srol yod pas de ni rang dpe gzhan ston gyi slob gso'i gzhi rtsa yin/ (2)zhi ba/ de ni bsam pa ngan pa nga rgyal dang phrag dog 'dod chags/ khong khro/ g.yo sgyu/ gnod sems dang / le lo/ rnam g.yeng sogs med pa'am chung ba la zer/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni lus ngag gnyis las byung ba'i bya spyod ngan pa rnams rang sems la nyon mongs de dag shugs chen po yod pa'i dbang gis byung zhes gsungs yod/ (3)nye bar zhi ba/de ni gzhan don sgrub rgyur rang don las lhag par dga' zhen yod pa la zer/ rang don gtso bor 'jog mkhan des slob ma'i don du dka' spyad khur du 'khyer 'dod pa zhig yong mi srid pa'i dbang gis red/ (4)slob ma las yon tan lhag pa/ de ni dge rgan de slob ma las yon tan lhag pa zhig yod na slob ma yar rgyas 'gro mgyogs pa yod cing / 'dra mnyam zhig las med na slob ma'i shes tshad yar rgyas med par rang sor gnas pa dang /slob ma las dge rgan yon tan dma' na slob ma la yon tan phran bu yod pa de yang nyams nas 'gro gi yod par gsungs/ (5)brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ de ni bya ba gang brtsams pa de mtha' 'khyol ba byed pa'i snying stobs yod pa ste/ dge rgan de la slob ma mang po yod zer ba dang / slob khrid 'di dang 'di byas zer ba'i ming skam po don du mi gnyer bar slob 252

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa—khrid kyi las ka 'go mjug mtha' 'khyol ba byed thub pa la zer (6)mang du thos pa/ de ni shes yon sna mang po slob sbyong byed myong ba'i mang du thos pa dang gcig shes yon sna gcig kyang thengs mang po slob sbyong byed myong ba'i mang po thos pa dang gnyis/ shes yon sna kha gcig kyang dge rgan mang po'i sa nas bslabs myong pa'i mang po las thos pa dang gsum/ slob sbyong byed skabs slob grogs mang po dang mnyam du slob khrid nyan myong ba'i mang po dang thos pa ste bzhi bcas ni mang thos phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ldan zer ba de yin cing / de tsho re re la khyad chos mi 'dra ba re yod pa 'dir 'god par ma nus pas 'dul ba dang mngon pa'i gzhung gi 'grel pa tshor gsal ba de lta bu zhig dgos pa yin/ (7)de nyid rtogs pa/ de ni slob mar bslab bya'i yon tan de legs par shes shing dogs pa dang the tshom med pa'i gdeng tshod yod pa la zer/ (8)smra mkhas pa/ de ni dge rgan gyis slob mar slob khrid byed skabs don ma byed kyi dpe dang / don nges pa'i sgrub byed/ yid ches pa'i lung / gnyid smugs sel ba'i gtam rgyud/ blo skyed 'phel ba'i dogs slong / blo sgo 'byed ba'i dri ba dri lan bcas rgyas bsdus 'tshams shing chig gsal la go bde ba/ byams brtse ldan pa'i tshig snyan la 'jam pa/ smra rjod mgyogs tshad ran cing ngal gso'i tshig ma'athibs ldan pa bcas slob ca5ba cingatsam nyan kyang sems la sun snang med par nyan snying 'dod pa de lta bu zhig dgos par gsungs pa de ni deng sang slob gso'i skad cha zer ba de rang red/ (9)byams brtse dang ldan pa/ de ni slob ma'i mdun la kha 'tsher 'cher dang ngo gdong la 253

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byul byas pa lta bu'i byams brtse la mi zer bar skyon brjod dang bstod bsngags gang la gang 'os byas te dka' ngal phrad skabs dus thog tu sel thub pa'i pha ma bzang po lta bu zhig dgos par gsungs/ (10)skyo ngal med pa/ de ni slob mar slob khrid yang yang gnang dgos byung yang sun snang med pa'i thog nas slob mas legs par ma shes kyi bar du ngang rgyud ring pos slob khrid gnang thub pa la zer/ (11)dus su 'doms pa/ de ni slob dpon dang dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la slob gso dang / skyon brjod/ bstod bsngags bcas gang gnang yang dus thog tu gnang ba las dus la ma babs pa'am/ dus las yol na mi gnang ba de la zer/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni dus la ma babs pa dang / dus las yol ba'i slob gso dang /skyon brjod/ bstod bsngags bcas kyi slob mar go bskon blo 'gugs kyi nus pa thon mi thub pas de 'dra byas na phan thogs med pa yin/gong gsal bod kyi sngon byon mkhas pa tshos slob dpon la nges par du tshang dgos pa'i yon tan bcu gcig dang / de tsho re re yang dge skyon gnyis re rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas zhib phra gsungs yod pa rnams deng dus kyi dge rgan tshos kyang slob sbyong gnang 'os pa sha stag red/18 slob ma'i cha rkyen/ de ni slob ma rnams la tshang dgos pa'i cha rkyen la zer/ gzhung chen po'i slob gnyer la zhugs chog pa'i cha rkyen ni gzhung chen po lnga la slob sbyong byed 'dod yod pa/ dgon pa'i rgyun gtan gyi tshogs 'don dang / slob sbyong rmang gzhi'i rtsa tshig rnams blo 'dzin byas yod pa/ chos lugs thog gi rku thabs su gnas pa ma yin pa bcas yin 254

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da ——na slob gnyer la zhugs chog de sngon gdan sa chen po khag nas dga' ldan khri pa dang / grags can gyi dge bshes/ de min gyi mkhas pa chen po grangs las 'das pa byungarnyoba'i nang nas nyung shas shig khyim tshang stobs 'byor can gyi rgyud nas byung ba phud mang che ba ni ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi khyim tshang nas byung ba sha stag yin/ dgon pa'i nang du dge 'dun pa mang po zhig gzhung chen po dang rig gnas slob sbyong mi byed pa de ni brtson 'grus chung ba'am 'tsho ba don gnyer la gtsor 'don byas pa sogs rang rang nyid kyi nang rkyen la brten nas byung ba yin/19 slob gso'i sgrig 'dzugs/ rig gnas slob gso dang /kun spyod slob gso sogs slob gso'i rigs rnams sgrig 'dzugs yod pa'i sgo nas ma byas na slob gso bya yul gyi mi rnams bsam blo gcig gyur dang //bya spyod gcig gyur/ re 'dun dang phugs bsam gcig gyur bcas yong mi thub pas sgrig 'dzugs byed pa ni don snying chen po yod pa'i bya ba zhig red/ sgrig 'dzugs la yang che chung rim pa 'dra ba yod chog pa yin stabs gdan sa chen po'i nang du sgrig 'dzugs che shos ni tshogs chen yin/ de'i 'og tu grwa tshang 'ga' zhig dang / grwa tshang re re'i 'og tu khang tshan bcu lhag tsam yod/ de ni gdan sa chen po'i nang du yod pa'i dge 'dun slob gnyer ba yin min la ma ltos pa'i spyi'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi rnam pa zhig yin pas de skor 'dir gleng ma dgos shing / skabs 'dir bshad pa'i sgrig 'dzugs ni slob sbyong gi sgrig 'dzugasabya tshul la zer/ de ni gzhung chen po lnga la so so'i nang don rgya che chung la gzhigs te 'dzin grwa mang nyung sna 25nga

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshogs su bgos pa ste/ de yang sngar dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i dkyil tsam du gsang phu dgon pa'i mkhan po mkhas pa'i dbang phyug phya pa chos kyi seng ges thog mar gsar gtod gnang ba zhig yin/ de skabs gzhung chen gzhan dag la 'dzin grwa ji tsam yod med dpyad gzhi ma rnyed kyang /tshad ma rnam 'grel la 'dzin grwa lnga yod pa ste/ bsdus chung / bsdus 'bring /bsdus chen/ rtags rigs/ rnam 'grel bcas yin/ rjes su gdan skru chen po khag la 'dzin grwa phye tshul mang nyung sna tshogs byung ste gcig tu ma nges pa dper na/ 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang la bsdus grwa blo rtags bcas la 'dzin grwa lnga/ phar phyin 'dzin grwa bzhi/ dbu ma 'dzin grwa gnyis/'dul ba 'dzin grwa gcig mdzod la 'dzin grwa gcig bcas yod pa dang /gdan sa chen po se ra'i smad grwa tshang la khyon bsdoms 'dzin grwa bcu gsum ste/ bsdus grwa blo rtags bcas bsdoms pa'i 'dzin grwa gcig phar phyin 'dzin grwa drug dbu ma 'dzin grwa gnyis 'dul ba 'dzin grwa gnyis/mdzod la 'dzin grwa gnyis bcas phyed yod/ gong gsal 'dzin grwa der rnam 'grel 'dzin grwa zur du ma phye ba ni bsdus grwa blo rtags bcas la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa byung na rnam 'grel yang de'i zhar la slob sbyong byed thub pa'i dbang gis yin/2༷ slob gso'i sgrig khrims/ de'i nang slob gnyer ba rnams kyi dmigs bsal sgrig khrims dang / dmigs bsal lta rtog lam lugs gnyis ka tshud yod/ slob gso'i sgrig khrims ni slob gnyer ba rnams kyis brtsi srung byed dgos pa'i dmigs bsal gyi khrims lugs te/ deng sang 256

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa—gi slob dus dang 'dra ba'i chos thog zla chos dang zla phyed chos thog gang gi skabs su yang rang la nad gzhi phog pa dang / rang gi dge rgan dang pha ma bsnyun gzhi byung ba sogs phud/ de min dgongs zhu mi chog pa dang / slob gnyer ba min pa'i tshogs pa khag gi nang du zhugs mi chog pa/ skabs su babs pa'i slob sbyong dang 'brel yod kyi yig cha ma gtogs rig gnas gzhan dag dang sgrung dpe sogs bsam blor bslad skyon yong ba'i dpe cha'i rigs blta klog byed mi chog pa dang / zhib 'jug brtag dpyad ma byas par dge rgan dang bla ma gang byung bsten mi chog pa bcas yin/ gzhung chen por slob gnyer byed mkhan gyi gras su zhugs rjes dgon pa'i gzhon khral dang / spyi don ar po/ dos chos dbor skyel/ spyi gnyer/ spyi pa'i rung khang gi ma byan bcas byed mi dgos pa'i dmigs bsal yod/21 slob gnyer sgrig yig gzhung chen po dang rig gnas slob sbyong byed mkhan tshos brtsi srung byed dgos pa'i don tshan rnams yig thog tu 'khod pa'i sgrig yig cig ste de'i nang slob sbyong byed srol dang / rgyugs len/ lo gcig gi slob dus so so dang / dgud gseng skabs kyi byed sgo/bzang por bya dga'/ nyes can dang sgrig 'gal rigs la chad pa gang gcod pa sogs zhib phra 'khod yod cing / lo re chos khrims pa'am dge bskos thengs gnyis brje len dang / dge bskos gsar pas dpyid chos chen mo dang ston chos chen mor sgrig yig gi nang don zhib phra'i sgo nas gtam bshad bya srol yod/ 22 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon/ 'dzin grwa khag so sor gzhung tshig 257

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/blo thog nas ngag skyor byed mkhan gyi sne khrid mkhan zhig ste de'i las 'gan ni 'dzin grwa de'i nang gi slob gnyer ba tshang ma'i ming tho nyar rgyu dang /slob dus rer 'dzin grwa'i nang gi slob gnyer ba mnyam 'dzoms slob sbyong skabs mi su dang su 'byor yod med rtog zhib kyi 'byor tho 'god rgyu dang /zla ba re'i phogs sprod skabs 'byor tho dge bskos la phul rgyu/ rnam kun 'dzin grwa'i nang gi slob gnyer ba nad pa rnams nad dgongs zhu rgyu dang /gnyen 'phrad 'khor zhag gi dgongs zhu bya rgyu/ slob tshan khag gi bgro gleng dus yun ring thung gi tshod 'dzin byed rgyu/ slob tshan khag gi gzhung ngag skyor gtong skabs sne 'khrid byed rgyu bcas yin pas deng sang 'dzin grwa'i kru'u ren zer ba dang 'dra/ skyor dpon gyi 'dems bskos ni 'dzin grwa de'i nang gi slob gnyer ba tshang mas gros/ bsdur thog spyi mos byung ba'i mi zhig 'dems bskos byas pa yin pas 'dzin grwa'i 'thus mi'i go chod pa zhig red/23 'dzin grwa babs pa/ 'dzin grwa gong mar slebs rjes slar yang bskyar sbyong dang zab sbyong gi ched du slob gnyer ba so sos rang mos thog nas 'dzin grwa 'og mar babs pa la zer/ de ni slob sbyong la 'bad brtson ha cang che ba 'ga' shas kyis de ltar byas pa ma gtogs 'dzin grwa gong mar slebs rjes slar yang 'dzin grwa 'og mar rang mos thog nas babs mkhan ha cang nyung /24 'dzin grwa 'bebs pa/ de ni 'dzin grwa so so'i lo dus thim rjes 'dzin grwa gong mar spo skabs slob gnyer la brtson 'grus chung zhing /258

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da wa—sgrig khrims legs par mi srung mkhan rnams 'dzin grwa 'og mar rang 'jags bzhag pa la zer/ lam lugs de yang don dngos thog slob gnyer bar chad pa gcod pa'i bya thabs shig yin pas mkhan po dang dase/ bskos slob gnyer la do dam nan bo gnang mkhan 'ga' zhig gis lag len bstar ba ma gtogs spyir btang de 'dra byed mkhan nyung /25 'dzin grwa 'phar ba/ 'dzin grwa 'og ma nanu/ grong ma/ra 'ang ra ba ste 'di la 'o/rte rkases rigs gnyis yod/ rig/sa dang po ni 'aṣ+ṭhatshon grwa de'i slob gnyer ba yongs rdzogs 'dzin grwa gong mar 'phar ba de yin/ rigs gnyis pa ni 'dzin grwa'i nang nas slob gnyer ba bzang gras dang dmigs bsal gnas tshul gzhan dag gi rkyen gyis 'dzin grwa gong mar spo dgos pa de yin/ spyir btang 'dzin grwa de'i lo tshad ma rdzogs bar du slob gnyer ba'i chu tshad mtho dman la ma ltos par mnyam/ sdod byas pa mang ba yin/ 26 'dzin grwa gtugs pa/ 'dzin grwa phan tshun bar slob gnyer gyi 'gran bsdur bya thabs zhig ste/ de yang 'dzin grwa gong ma dang 'dzin grwa 'og ma gnyis 'gran bsdur byed rgyu de yin// 'dzin grwa gong ma'i slob gnyer ba rnams lan 'debs byed mkhan dang / 'dzin grwa 'og ma'i slob gnyer ba rnams kyis skabs su babs pa'i slob sbyong de'i nang don gal che ba gtso 'don byas te dri ba 'don gyi yod/ 'dzin grwa gang dang gang gtugs res bya dgos thad mkhan pogadage bskos la bka' gnang ste dge bskos kyis thog mar 'dzin grwa gong ma'i slob gnyer ba rnams mkhan po'i 259

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mdun du mnyam tshogs byed du bcug de nas mkhan pos ming 'bod gnang ba'i 'dzin grwa 'og mtsho de dgobaskos kyis 'bod brda gnang ste mkhan po'i mdun du mnyam tshogs byed du bcug pa yin/ 'dzin grwa gtugs rgyu'i dus tshod ni lo re dpyid chos chen mo'i skabs yin cing /dus yun chu tshod bzhi nas lnga'i bar 'gor gyi yod/ 'dzin grwa gtugs skabs 'dzin grwa gong 'og gnyis kas lan 'debs mkhan dang dri ba 'don mkhan gyi rkang 'dzin pa btsugs yod pa de tshos gtso bo byas nas 'gran bsdur dang slob gnyer ba gzhan dag gis ram 'degs pa bya srol yod/27 spob tshan bskyar smyong / de sngon slob sbyong byas zin pa rnams yang bskyar brjed gsos kyi ched du slob sbyong byas pa ste gzhung chen po lnga'i slob gnyer thog nas dge bshes lha rams pa'i ming tho'i gras su slebs rjes lo re'i ston chos chen po grol nas dgun chos chen po ma tshugs par 'dul ba bskyar sbyong dang / dpyid chos chen mo grol nas dbyar chos dang po ma tshugs par der dbu ma'am phar phyin/ dbyar gnas chen mo'i ring mdzod bcas bskyar sbyong byed kyi yod cing / dge bshes lha rams pa rnams bskyar sbyong tshugs skabs bla brang khag dang / 'byor ldan khag nas gsol ja 'bul mkhan rgyun mi chad pa yod/ bskyar sbyong gi nang don gtso bo gang dang gang bya dgos dang / dus yun ring thung / tshogs grol gyi dus tshod bcas lo de'i dge bshes lha rams pa rgan gzhon gnyis nas bkod 'doms dang tshod 'dzin gnang srol yod/ dri ba 'don mkhan dang 260

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltar byung ba'i gtam gleng / —lan 'debs mkhan ni rang rang gi ming tho rgan gzhon ltar res mos gnang dgos/ da dung bskyar sbyong gi rnam pa gzhan zhig ni/ lo re'i dpyid chos chen mo dang / dbyar chos chen mo/ ston chos chen mo/ dgun chos chen mo bcas kyi thog ma'i nyin bzhi'i ring nyin mo ni skabs babs dge bshes ming btags pa su yin gyis bgro gleng gtong mkhan dge bshes bgresatshopa rnams kyis bton pa'i dri bar lan 'debs gnang dgos pa dang /dgong mo'i dam bca' mtshan 'khyongs skabs lo rjes ma dge bshes lha rams mtshan bzhes gnang mkhan gnyis kyis 'dzin grwa bcu gsum yongs rdzogs kyi slob gnyer ba so sos bton pa'i dri bar lan 'debs gnang rgyu de yin/ gong gsal bya thabs gnyis po de ni slob tshan bskyar sbyong gi thabs shes ha cang bzang po zhig red/28 dngos spyong / slob sbyong byed bzhin du lag len bstar ba'i sbyong brdar zhig yin/ gdan sa chen po khag tu nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung chen po lngar slob sbyong skabs ni gtso bor thos bsam gnyis kyi sgo nas gzhung don la go ba len pa dang / sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i thad dmigs su bkar nas dam 'dzin gnang ba yin cing / dge bshes che chung gi ming btags thon nas gzhung don sems rgyud la sbyar ba'i sgom sgrub gtso bor 'don ched ri khrod dang sgrub phug bcas su phebs pa ni lag len dngos sbyong gi 'go tshugs pa yin la/ gsang sngags kyi slob gnyer dang / (gso ba rig pa dang skar rtsis phud)rig gnas chung ba gzhan dag bi slob sbyong ni dngos sbyong dang zung 'brel sha stag las dngos sbyong med na 26/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ dngos gzhi'i lag len thog 'khyol thabs med pa sha stag yin pas/dngos sbyong gi dus skabs yin zer ba'i dus tshod zur du 'don mi dgos pa yin/ bod kyi gso ba rig pa dang skar rtsis gnyis la dngos sbyong gi dus skabs zur du yod pa ma zad/ lhag par du gso ba rig pa'i dngos sbyong gi phyag bzhes bzang po ni rang cag kha ba ri pa'i gso rig bstan pa'i spyi mes chen po g.yu thog yon tan mgon po nas bzung da lta'i bar du sman pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis slob ma rnams sman sna 'dzoms nga/'i ri thang rnams su 'khrid de sman ngo sprod dang / sman 'thu ru 'jug pa/ slob dpon gyi drung du nad bcos byed du 'jug pa sogs mdzad pa de yin/ gnam rig skar rtsis kyi slob sbyong la ni/ slob sbyong thon rjes lo gcig gi lo tho rgyas bsdus gang rigs shig slob ma rang nyid la rtsom 'bri byed du 'jug pa de yin cing / rtse slob grwa dang / na rong shar slob grwa thon nas rtse'i yig tshang slob phrug dang rtsis khang gi rtsis par slebs rjes yig 'bri'i lam lugs dang / nor srid rtsis bsdoms bya rgyu sogs dngos sbyong bya rgyu'i go skabs yun ring tsam yod pa lta bu red/29 zab smyong / slob tshan khag gi nang nas dka' gnad gal che ba'i rigs gtso bor bton nas slob sbyong byas pa zhig ste/ de sngon gdan sa chen po khag tu phar phyin gyi nang nas drang nges dang / bsam gzugs/dge 'dun nyi shu/ rten 'brel bcas la zab sbyong byed ched zur bkol zer ba'i 'dzin grwa zhig zur du phyed yod cing / lo re dgun chos chen mo'i skabs 'dzin grwa so so'i nang nas rang mos kyis re 'dun zhus pa'i 262

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa—slob gnyer ba bzang gras rnams sgrig 'dzugs byas te 'jang dgun chos su zla ba gcig dang phyed ka'i ring tshad ma rnam 'grel zab sbyong byed par thengs gnyis nas gsum bar gtong gi yod pa dang / de'i ring gi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen yang grwa tshang gzhung rkyang nas gang zab gang bzang byas te gtong gi yod la/ der spyi pa'i sdod khang dang / thab tshang / nyer mkho'i gdan chas/ dpe cha sogs gra 'grigs po yod stabs lo ltar 'jang dgun chos su tshad ma rnam 'grel zab sbyong byed par 'gro mkhan grwa tshang so so nas mang mthar nyis brgya yas mas dang nyung mthar bcu bco lnga nas ma chag pa 'gro mkhan yod/30 slob sbyong gi lo tshad/ slob sbyong byed pa'i dus yun ring thung gismolo tshad gtan 'khel yod pa la zer/ de yang gdan sa chen po khag tu gzhung chen po lngar slob sbyong byed rgyu'i lo tshad thad grwa tshang khag so sor phran bu'i mi 'dra ba yod cing / se ra dgon par mtshon na bsdus grwa 'dzin grwa gsum la lo gsum/ phar phyin 'dzin grwa lnga la lo lnga/ dbu ma 'dzin grwa gnyis so sor lo gnyis re ste lo bzhi/ mdzod 'dzin grwa gnyis la lo bzhi bcas khyon bsdoms dge bshes lha rams pa ma thon bar lo nyi shu 'gor gyi yod/ rig gnas chung ba lnga yi nang nas sum rtags la lo phyed/snyan ngag la lo gcig sdeb sbyor la lo phyed bcas ma mthar 'gor zhing /skar rtsis la ni rtsis rab lo dgugazhes gsung srol yod pa ltar lo dgu gso ba rig par nyung mthar lo lnga nas drug bar/ gsang sngags la nyung mthar lo lnga nas drug bar 'gor gyi yod/ 263

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/31 slob gseng dgung gsang / slob sbyong gi dus yin ring tsam song tshe ngal gso'i dus tshod 'os 'tshams shig 'jog pa la zer/gdan sa chen po khag tu chos thog skabs su zla re'i tshes brgyad dang /bco lnga/ sum cu nam yin la nyin phyed ring ngal gso/ bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nas tshes bdun bar ngal gso/ bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug nas bod zla dang po'i tshes gnyis bar ngal gso bcas yin/ngal gso'i ring gnyen 'phrad dang / spro skyid/ chos lugs dang mthun pa'i rtsed mo rtse ba/ rig gnas gzhan dag gi dpe cha lta ba/ thag nye sar gnas mjal du 'gro ba sogs byed chog 'on kyang ge sar sgrung dpe klog pa dang shod pa/ glu gar dang / zhabs bro/ sho sbag rgyag pa/ rdo —skor rtse ba/mchongs rgyag pa/ mig mangs rtse ba bcas byed chog gi med/ mtha' mtshams lung khug gi dgon pa kha shas la dgung gseng gi skabs lha mo 'khrab pa dang / 'bag 'chams/ rma bya/ seng ge/ 'brug sogs 'khrab nas spro skyed byed srol 'dug32 rgyugs len/ slob sbyong byas nas dus yun gang 'tshams song rjes sbyangs 'bras che chung gi gnas tshul rtog zhib byas pa la zer zhing /de la nang gses kyi phye na tshig rgyugs dang / don rgyugs/ rtsom rgyugs/yig rgyugs bcas yod/ (1)tshig rgyugs zhes pa ni blo thog tu bzung ba'i tshig rnams ngag skyor btang ste rgyugs sprod len byas pa ste/ ming gzhan blo tshogs dang / blo rgyugs kyang zer/ sngar gdan sa chen po dang / dgon pa khag rtse slob grwa sman rtsis khang / lcags po ri sogs su gzhung don 264

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa—slob khrid ma byas gong du gzhung de'i rtsa ba dang 'grel pa rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig blo 'dzinad+kubyas te rgyugs sprod dgos shing / de yang slob dpon gyi drung du rgyugs sprod pa dang / tshogs rgyugs zhes grwa mang yongs rdzogs tshogs pa'i tshogs chen thog tu rgyugs sprod pa sogs sna tshogs yod/ de sngon nga rang lo na bcu gsum la slebs skabs bod yig dpe ring mda' tshad ma shog grangs lnga brgya lhag tsam rgyugs phul ba dang / de rjes dge bshes lha rams pa ma btang gong du shog grangs mda' tshad ma chig stong lnga brgya lhag tsam gyi rgyugs phul 3te ang dang po'i bya dga' thengs gsum blangs myong zhing / de rjes lo shas nang dge bshes chen po 'ga' shas kyis shog grangs mda' tshad ma nyis stong lhag tsam rgyugs phul mkhan yang byung song / (2)don rgyugs zer ba3/ gzhung don la go ba blangs pa'i chu tshad mtho dman lta ba'i ched du rgyugs len pa ste/ de ni slob dpon gyis slob mar gnad don gyi dri ba bton pa der slob mas lan 'debs pa'am yang na gzhan dag gis dri ba bton pa der rang rang gis lan 'debs stangs gnad la khel min dang / lan 'debs pa de la slar yang gzhan gyis dri ba 'don pa dang / dgag pa rgyag pa der dgag lan gnad la khel min lta ba'i ched du rtsod rgyugs te bgro gleng gi rgyugs sprod zer ba'i srol yang yod/ de la nang gses kyis phye na bgro gleng gi gnad don gsal por bton nas rtsod gleng byed mkhan ched du bsko bzhag byas pa zhig dang /nang don 'di dang 'di zhes gsal por ma bton par dri ba 'don mkhan gyis bton pa'i don gnad la lan 'debs byed du bcug pa gnyis yod/ 265

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang po ni ched don gsal bsgrags byas pa'i bgro gleng tshogs 'du yin zhing / de yang phar phyin skabs brgyad kyi slob sbyong thon mtshams grwa tshang so sor 'tshogs pa'i rigs chung tshogs langs ni lo re zur bkol 'dzin grwa'i nang gi slob gnyer ba mi bcu drug 'dems sgrugs kyis ched don gzhung tshan brgyad (chos 'khor/ byams gzhung / bka' bstan bcos/ yang dag mtha'/sems bskyed/ sbyor lam/ skyabs gsum/ rigs bcas)la kha gtad gnyis re byas te bgro gleng gtong dgos/ bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes shar la ched don bgro gleng gtong mi rnams grwa tshang dge bskos k+shis ming tho kha byang sprad de bsko bzhag byed kyi yod pa dang / bsko bzhag tshar nas zla ba phyed tsam ring ched don gzhung tshan der bskyar sbyong dang zab sbyong byed dgos shing /bod zla bzhi pa'i zla mjug nas lnga pa'i tshes shar bar du khang tshan brgyad nas bcu yas mas kyi rwa skor nang mun rub nas mtshan phyed ma zin bar bgro gleng byed rgyu dang / bod zla lnga pa'i tshas shar nas drug pa'i tshes shar bar du grwa tshang chos grwa'i nang du dka' rams 'dzin grwa dang / bsdus grwa'i 'dzin grwa phud pa'i 'dzin grwa yongs rdzogs la bgro gleng byed par 'gro dgos/bod zla drug pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga nas nyin bzhi'i ring grwa tshang tshogs khang nang du tshogs thengs rer gzhung tshan gnyis la bgro gleng chu tshod gcig yas mas gtong gi yod/ dbu ma'i slob sbyong phal cher thon rjes gdan sa chen po se rar mtshon na dbyar gnas rigs grwa chen mo zer bar grwa tshang byes smad gnyis nas gzhung chen po lngar bgro gleng gtong mkhan sum cu re 'dem/sa bskos byas pa'i mi drug cu tham pas gzhung tshan sum cu tham pa 266

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wad (sems bskyed/ sbyor lam/ rigs/ byams gzhung / drang nges/ bsam gzugs/ dge 'dun nyi shu/ rten 'brel/ skabs gnyis pa/ skabs sasum pa/skabs bzhi pa/ skabs brgyad pa bcas phar phyin gyi gzhung tshan che ba bcu gnyis dang / ring song / tsemasi bskyed gsum pa/ thal ba zlog bdag 'gog tshad 'gog bden gnyis/ chu 'bab bcas dbu ma'i gzhung tshan che ba bdun/ sngon chog da chog dus tshigs/ gnas bla ma/ spang ltung / las gzhi bcas 'dul ba'i gzhung tshan che ba lnga/ mdzod gnas gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ bdun pa bcas mdzodacakyi gzhung che ba gsum/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gzhung tshan gcig da dung gzhutha jimen gnyis gang yin nged rang gi sems la ma nges pa bcas )la nyin re gzhung tshan gnyis la snga droyi gnyis dang / phyi dro mi gnyis kyis nyin bco lnga'i ring bgro gledze gtong ba'i tshogs chen 'tshogs kyi yod/ rigs chung dang rigs chen gnyis kyi bgro gleng mnyam tshogs de ni deng sang nang don gsal bsgrags byed pa'i yig tshad zer ba de dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba las ngo bo gcig yin/ gnyis pa nang rdon 'di yin gas la bsgrags ma byas pa'i bgro gleng tshogs 'du ni/ — dgedzhabashes lha rams pa gotong mkhan tshos so so'i grwa tshang nang du dgun chosasnachen mo nyin bzhi'i ringardzinyin mo tshogs thengs gsum la dge bshes thon jin ba rnams kyis mngon pa mdzod dang / 'dul ba gnyis kyi gzhung tshan nas so so'ir+shathugs mos ltar bgro gleng gtong zhing /dgong mo ma 'khyodas dang ma ci rtsi'ad res mos kyis dka' rams 'dzin grwa nas bsdus grwa bar 'dzin stoyongs rdzogs kyi slob gnyer ba tshos rang rang so so'i skabs babs slob sbyong gi nang don thog nas bgro gleng 26 7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gosung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gtong gi yod/ dge bshes lha rams dam bca' dngos gzhi ni/ lo re lha sa smon lam chen mo'i skabs gdan sa gsum gyi grwa tshang bdurno ('bras spubs sgo mang dang / blo gsal gling / bde yangs/ se ra byes dang / smad pa/ dga' ldan shar rtse dang byang rtse bcas)nas dge bshes lha rams pa mi gnyis re bsdoms mi grangs bcu bzhi'i thog grwa tshang bdun res 'khor gyis 'phar ma mi re bcas mi grangs bco lnga/ rwa ba stod grwa tshang nas dge bshes re bcas khyon bsdoms lo ltar dge bshes lha rams pa mi bcu drug yod pa de tshos zhogs pa gsung chos rwa bar chu tshod gnyis gsum ring tshad ma rnam 'grel/ nyin dgung khyams grwa'i nang chu tshod gnyis yas mas bar phar phyin dang dbu ma/dgong mo khyams grwa chen mor chu tshod bzhi nas drug bar mdzod dang 'dul ba bcas kyi bgro gleng gtong gi yod/ dge bshes lha rams pa thon nas dge bshes re zung ma gtogs phal che ba rgyud grwa stod smad gnyis gang rigs la so so'i thob khungs ltar sgrig zhugs gnang ste lo shas ring gtso bor gsang sngags kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang lag len rnams slob sbyong thog zhor la dbyangs dang / rol mo/dkyil 'khor bris thig sogs mthong rgyud lag len khag rang mos kyis slob sbyong gnang rjes sngags rams pa'i dge bshes dam bca' nyin mtshan bdun gyi ring 'jog dgos/ de'i ring sngags rams thon zer pa'i dge bshes rnams kyis gsang sngags kyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs thog nas bgro gleng gtong gi yod/ (3)rtsom rgyugs/ snyan ngag dang / sum rtags/ sgra 268
