bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa—da rig pa/ sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis bcas slob sbyong skabs slob sbyong bya rim re re bzhin du rgyugs blangs nas slob tshan 'og ma 'khrid dgos pa dang /slob tshan yongs rdzogs 'khrid tshar nas gzhung yongs rdzogs kyi 'go nas mjug bar cha tshang ba'i rtsom yig gsar pa 'bri dgos pa de ni slob sbyong thon pa'i ched rtsom gyi khongs su gtogs pa yin/ sman pa'i slob sbyong thon nas slob dpon gyi drung du rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang lag len gnyis ka'i rgyugs 'bul dgos kyang rtsom rgyugs med/ (4)yig gzugs/ bod yig gi yig gzugs sbyong mkhan rnams yig gzugs slob pa'i go rim re re bzhin du rgyugs 'phrod rjes go rim rjes ma slob pa yin cing / slob grwa thon mtshams yig gzugs che chung khag mi 'dra ba tshang ma'i yig tshad 'bri dgos pa yin/ gong gsal rgyugs sprod dang yig tshad khag gi tshad gzhi lon pa rnams la ang rim bya dga'i gsol ras dang / ma lon pa rnams la nyes chad ji 'dra gcod pa'i skor gsham du gsal ba der gzigs/33 ang rim/ gong du gsal ba ltar rgyugs sprod dang yig tshad khag gi tshad gzhi lon yod med lta ba'i ang gnas la zer/ de sngon gdan sa chen po khag la tshig rgyugs len skabs kyi tshad gzhi ni/ blo 'dzin byas pa'i dpe cha mda' tshad ma shog grangs (shog bu mda' tshad ma gcig la ngos gnyis dang ngos rer yig phreng bdun re/ yig phreng rer cha snyoms kyi yig 'bru'i grangs tshad mang mthar lnga bcu nas nyung mthar zhe lnga yas mas yod cing / ngos rer yig phreng bdun dang yig phreng rer yig 'bru zhe lnga yod par cha bzhag na thog bu gcig la yig 'bru drug brgya sum cu tham pa yod)blo 'dzin byas pa'i shog grangs mda' tshad ma lnga bcu long na rgyugs 'phrod tsam dang / lnga bcu yan nas 269

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brgya tham pa bar ang bdun pa/ brgya tham pa nas brgya dang lnga bcu'i bar ang drug pa/ brgya dang lnga bcu nas nyis brgya'i bar ang lnga pa/ nyis brgya nas nyis brgya lnga bcu'i bar ang bzhi pa/ nyis brgya lnga bcu nas sum brgya'i bar ang gsum pa/ sum brgya nas sum brgya lnga bcu'i bar ni ang gnyis pa/ sum brgya lnga bcu nas bzhi brgya'i bar ang dang po bcas su brtsis kyi yod stabs tshig rgyugs ang dang po blangs na nyung mthar shog grangs sum brgya lnga bcu ste yig 'bru nyis 'bum nyis khri stong med lnga brgya tham pa (khri nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang stong med lnga brgya)ma lon na ang ki dang po blang mi thub/ don rgyugs kyi ang ki ni/ gdan sa chen po rnams su dge bshes lha rams pa dang / rgyud grwa stod smad rnam gnyis kyi dge bshes sngags rams pa bcas la ang grangs rim pa bdun gyi bar du yod/ de'i tshad gzhi ni dri ba bton par lan yongs rdzogs 'debs thub na ang dang po/mang che ba 'debs thub na ang gnyis pa dang gsum pa/ lan phyed thebs phyed ma thebs pa rnams bzhi pa dang lnga pa/ lan phal che ba 'debs ma thub na drug pa dang bdun pa bcas su gtan 'khel bya srol yod/ de yang 'ga' zhig go rtogs bzang rkyen dri ba'i lan 'debs rgyu legs kyang /rtsod gleng skabs dgag pa rgyag pa'i rtsod rig de tsam mi bzang ba dang /'ga' zhig rtsod gleng skabs gzhan gyis smras pa'i lan la dgag pa rgyag pa'i rtsod rig rno po yod kyang gzhan gyis tshur dri ba bton pa'i lan ha cang yag po rang thebs mi thub pa/ nyung shas ni go rig dang rtsod rig gnyis ka'i thad nas gzhan gyis do mi thub pa de 'dra yod stabs ang rim 270

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —— ——sgrig mkhan rnams gzhung chen po lnga'i gnas tshad mtho po dgos pa de 'dra red/34 bya dga'i gsol ras/ gong du gsal ba'i ang rim yod pa rnams la bya dga'i gsol ras thob cing / ang rim nang ma tshud pa rnams la dran rten dngos po ma stong tsam yod la/ tshad gzhi ma lon pa rnams la nyes chad thob pa yin/ tshig rgyugs kyi ang dang por bya dga'i gsol ras su zhwa mo/ chos gos/ kha btags a she/ dngul srang sum cu/ang gsum par gzhan dag gong mtshungs la dngul srang bco lnga/ ang bzhi par kha btags nang mdzod spus legs gcig las gzhan med/ ang lnga pa'i rigs la kha btags a she/ ang drug pa'i rigs la kha btags zub phyi/ ang bdun pa'i rigs la kha btags zub dkyus/ shog grangs lnga bcu ma lon pa rnams ming tho 'bod skabs langs nas 'gro rgyu las bya dga' gsol ras med/ shog grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga las ma 'o na na rgyugs ma 'phrod pa'i grangs su rtsis nas de'i nyes chad gsham gsal ltar thob kyi yod/ dge bshes lha rams pa ang dang por/ srid gzhung nas kha btags a she/ dngul srang sum cu/ zhwa mo/ chos gos/ ban gzan spus legs/ lham sha gzugs ma/ ja skam phyed bcas/ ang bdun par rnam grangs gong ltar la spus ka zhan pa dang / dngul srang lnga las med/ ang ki ma lon pa rnams la kha btags zub phyi re'i dran rten dngos po stong min tsam sprod srol yod/ dge bshes sngags rams pa'i ang ki yod pa rnams kha btags zub phyi re las bya dga'i dngos po gzhan med/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/35 sgrig 'gal nyes chad/ slob gnyer ba'i gras su tshud nas chos thog gcig chad pa dang / blo 'dzin rgyugs ma 'phrod pa/ dgongs zhu ma byas par rang mtshams kyis gnas gzhan du 'gro ba/ slob gnyer ba min pa'i tshogs pa/ ‘‘rdob rdob skyid sdug ’’nang zhugs pa bcas byung na tshogs khang dang chos grwa'i gral mjug tu phyag brgya phyag nyin grangs 'os 'tshams dang / yang na chos grwa'i rdo gcal gsar pa brje ru 'jug pa/tshogs chen thog bslangs te skyon brjod byed pa bcas kyi nyes chad 'gel gyi yod/ rtse slob grwa dang / na rong shar sogs gzhung btsugs dang /sger btsugs slob grwa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i sgrig srol las 'gal na/ dge rgan dang rgan bdag su 'os nas rta lcag dang / smyug lcag grangs tshad nges can re gtong srol yod 'dug pa de ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi shugs rkyen thebs pa'i nyes chad lugs srol zhig yin/ 36 slob thon ched rtsom/ slob grwa thon khar rang nyid kyis de sngon slob sbyong byas pa'i nang don de'i thog nas ched rtsom bris pa la zer/de sngon gdan sa chen po rnams su gzhung bka' pod lngar slob sbyong thon rjes ched rtsom nges par du 'bri dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs med stabs ched rtsom 'bri mkhan nyung shas kyis rang mos thog nas bris pa ma gtogs ha cang dkon/ snyan ngag dang sum rtags sogs rig gnas chung ba lnga dang rig gnas che ba'i nang gi sgra rig pa bcas la slob sbyong thon rjes gzhung dang mthun pa'i ched rtsom nges par 'bri srol yod/ 'on kyang sngon dus su 272

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltar byung ba'i gtam gleng /bris pa'i slob thon ched rtsom dang / deng skabs kyi zhib 'jug slob ma tshos bris pa'i slob thon ched rtsom gnyis la mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos yod pa ni/ched rtsom sngon ma de ni gzhi rkang rang nyid kyis gsar rtsom byas pa yin kyang gzhung don dang rig gzhung bshad stangs sogs gang ci'i thad sngon byon mkhas pa'i dgongs pa dang rgyab 'gal ma song ba gzhir bzung nas rang nyid kyi lta tshul gsar pa dang dogs gzhi gsar pa 'don pa zhig yin la/deng skabs kyi ched rtsom ni de dang mi 'dra bar sngon yod kyi bshad tshul la tshan rig gi thog nas dbye zhib byas te yang dag pa'i rigs rnams sngar las chu tshad mtho ru gtong ba dang / yang ma dag pa'i rigs rnams yo bsrang byas te lta tshul gsar pa bton pa zhig yin pas sngar yod gzhung don bskyar zlos byas pa'i slob de ba lta bu dang / rtsom 'bri mkhan gzhan dag gi bris pa'i rtsom yig rku bshus ming bsgyur byas pa bcas kyis go mi chod pa yin/37 mtshan gnas/ slob sbyong thon pa'i sbyangs 'bras che chung gi ming btags mtshan gnas te/ deng sang rgya skad thog zho'i wu'i zhes pa de yin/ de sngon gdan sa chen po gsum ma byung gong du rab 'byams pa dang /dka' bzhi ba/ dka' bcu zhes pa'ici mtshan gnas sprad de grwa skor dam bca' 'jog srol yod/rab 'byams pa/ gzhung chen po lnga'i nang nas phar phyin tsam sbyangs myong zhing / dbu ma dang 'dul ba mdzod bcas la sbyangs pa byed ma myong mkhan gyi dge bshes rigs la zer/ 273

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dka' bzhi ba/ dbu ma/ phar phyin/ 'dul ba/ mdzod bcas dka' chen bzhi la slob gnyer thon pa'i dge bshes shig la zer/da ka' bcu/ gzhung chen po lnga kar slob gnyer thon pa'i dge bshes shig ste/ deng sang gdan sartsochen po bkra shis lhun po'i dka' chen dang se 'bras dga' gsum gyi dge bshes lha rams pa lta bu yin/ gdan sa gsum chags rjes gsang phu'i phyag srol ltar gling yongs kyi grwa tshang phan tshun bsres te gzhung chen po lnga'i dam bca' 'jog mkhan gyi dge bshes rnams la gling bsre zer/ paṇa chen er ti ni sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis dga' ldan khri pa sku tshab gnang skabs gdan sa gsum gyi dge bshes slob gnyer bzang gras nang nas lha sa smon lam chen mo'i ring gzhung chen po lnga'i bgro gleng dam bca' 'jog pa'i srol gtod pa nas lha ldan rab 'byams pa ste ming bsdus pas lha rams pa zer/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos srid dbang bzung skabs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sku 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs su tshogs mchod dus ston btsugs pa dang chabs cipo/ tshogs mchod nyin bcu'i ring smon lam chen mo'i skabs dang 'dra bar gdan sa gsum gyi dge bshes khag gcig grwa skor dam bca' 'jog tu bcug pa nas/ tshogs rams pa zer ba byung / gzhan yang rigs rams pa dang rdo rams pa sogs dge bshes chung ba'i rigs 'dir ma bkod/sgra rig pa slob sbyong byas te rgyugs 'phrod pa rnams la slob dpon gyis kun bshad kyi ming 'dogs gnang srol yod la/ skar rtsis la sbyangs pa 274

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/—da wa——thon nas lo re'i lo tho 'don shes pa dang 'das lo spo ba sogs sbyangs pa thon na rtsis rams pa zhes pa'i ming thob pa yin/gso ba rig pa'i thad kyi mtshan gnas ni sngar g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po'i dus nas yod de/ skabs der sman pa'i slob ma'i nang nas slob sbyong gi chu tshad mtho dman rim pa bzhir phye yod/sman pa 'bum rams pa/ sman gyi rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel sogs rgya dkar nag gi gso rig cha lag dang bcas pa blo thog nas thon cing / de dag gi lag len rang skya 'pher ba'i sman pa rnams yin/sman pa rab 'byams pa/ rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel dang / so ma rwa dza /bdud rtsi bum pa rtsa 'grel dang bcas par slob sbyong thon pa rnams yin/sman pa dka' bcu ba/ rgyud gzhi rtsa 'grel kha skong dang bcas pa slob sbyong thon pa rnams yin/sman pa bsdus grwa ba/ rgyud gzhi'i nang tshan rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud/ phyi ma'i rgyud gsum tsam yan lag dang bcas par slob gnyer thon pa rnams yin par g.yu thog yon tan mgon po rnying ma'i rnam thar nang 'khod yod/38 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen/ slob gnyer ba rnams la dgos nges kyi sdod khang dang / zas gos/ dkar gsal zhun mar sogs la zer ba ste/de sngon gdan sa chen po rnams su bla sprul che 'bring dang chos mdzad sogs 'byor ldan rigs nyung shas phud grwa rkyang dbul phongs rnams sdod khang chung zhing dkar gsal mi ldang ba dang / mtshan mor sgron me med par spos long 2 75

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gcig spar ba'i me 'od 'og dpe cha lta klog byed dgos pa/ sha dang tshal rigs zho 'o ma sogs lo gcig nang thengs re gnyis tsam las rgyun du sran tsam rnying pa dang / sran ma chu la sbangs pa'i za 'bru tsam dang / lo gcig la 'bru phogs khal bdun brgyad tsam dang / dad can sbyin bdag khag nas sku 'gyed dang phogs dngul phul ba bsdoms na lo gcig la bod dngul srang sum brgya ma long tsam las med/ gyon gos dang mal chas kyang nam dus bzhi kar rgyun ldan de rang ma gtogs brje len med par sdod dgos pa sogs 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen dka' ngal ha cang che ba yod/ deng sang krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og bod ljongs zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob pa nas slob grwa gsar pa mang po btsugs yod pa de dag gi nang /nyal khang / nyal chas/ glog bzhu/ spyi pa'i za khang / zla rer 'tsho ba'i 'gro gron gyi dngul bcas gang ci'i thad la lo re nas lo re je rgyas je bzang du 'gro ba'i dus skabs bzang po 'di 'dra ni de sngon spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang mig gis mthong rgyu lta zhog rmi lam du yang 'khor mi srid pa zhig red/ rang rgyal mi rigs khag dang phyi rgyal gyi gna' rabs dang nye rabs kyi lo rgyus thog mkhas pa'i dbang po nor bu'i phreng ba bsgrigs pa bzhin du ha cang mang po byon pa'i nang nas 'bad brtson dang snying stobs can gyi 'byor ldan nyung shas phud/ de min mang che ba 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen shin tu zhan pa'i gnas tshul 'og sra mkhregs can gyi brag ri mdzub mos 'bigs nus pa lta bu'i dka' spyad snying stobs la brten nas deng sang nga tsho'i mig dper 'os pa'i mkhas dbang zhig tu gyur pa sha stag las/ sems bde 276

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ — da —lus lhod dga' skyid ldan pa'i 'tsho bar longs su spyod bzhin du byung ba gtan nas min/ don dngos de'i thog nas gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa ṭi ta sa skya kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis/ mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug/ bde bar sdod la mkhas mi srid/ /ces gsungs pa de bden don mi 'gyur ba zhig yin par ra 'phrod gsal por byung yod/39 slob yon/ slob grwa khag gi nang slob khrid gnang mkhan dge rgan la srid gzhung dang sger nas sku yon grangs tshad nges can zhig 'bul ba la zer/ de sngon bod kyi btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su chos lugs dang yig bsgyur slob grwa 'dzugs skabs slob gnyer ba so sos slob dpon la sku yon phul ma dgos par rgyal po'i mdzod nas slob dpon rnam pa tshor zla ba rer gtan 'khel gyi phogs 'bul gyi yod/ bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs phyi dar skabs byung ba'i lo tsā ba mang po zhig rang nyid kyis dang blangs thog bal yul dang / kha che/ rgya gar bcas su slob gnyer gnang bar phebs skabs slob dpon la sku yon 'bul byed gser mang po bsgrubs nas phebs dgos/ sku yon du gser 'bul rgyu med na slob gnyer legs po yong thabs med/ bod kyi mkhas pa rnam pa tsho slob dpon du brten na slob mar 'bul rgyu yod phyin rang nus la gzhigs pa'i ci 'byor gang 'byor gyi sku yon 'bul srol yod cing / 'bul rgyu med pa'i slob ma rnams kyis sku yon gang yang ma phul kyang chog pa las 'bul rgyu med bzhin du nges par du 'bul dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs med/ gdan sa chen po'i nang gi slob gnyer ba mang che ba sa thag ring po nas phebs pa'i 277

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogasardzobasgrigs/dbul phongs sha stag yin par brten slob dpon la slob yon 'bul rgyu lta zhog rang nyid kyi zla re'i 'tsho rten la yang ma ltogs ma 'khyags tsam las gdengs tshod yod pa'i rten gnas gang yang med/ slob gnyer legs po yod pa'i rigs 'ga' zhig la slob ma mang po yod cing slob ma'i gras nas khyim tshang 'byor ldan gyi gras yod na khong tshos rang rang 'byor stobs la gzhigs pa'i slob yon ci 'byor gang 'byor phul gyi yod/ deng sang slob grwa khag gi nang gzhung btsugs slob grwa yin phyin slob dpon gyi slob yon slob grwa gzhung nas sprod kyi yod la dmangs btsugs slob grwa khag gcig gi slob yon ni slob ma'i khyim tshang nas bsdus te sprod kyi yod/ sger btsugs slob grwa khag gi slob dpon gyi slob yon ni slob ma so so nas 'os 'tshams shig bsdus te slob dpon la 'bul gyi yod/ las khungs khag nas rang khongs las byed pa slob grwa khag gi nang zab sbyong byed par btang na slob grwa der slob yon sgor chig stong nas bzhi brgya yas mas sprod dgos pa bcas yin/4༷ slob gso'i 'gro gron/ gzhung btsugs dang sger btsugs slob grwa so sos slob gso'i ched du gtong ba'i gron dngul la zer/ de sngon bod zhi ba'i bcings grol ma thob gong du bod kyi rig gnas slob gso ni dgon pa khag dang sger btsugs slob grwa nyung shas/ rtse yig tshang slob grwa bcas yin pas/ de tsho'i slob gso'i gron dngul ni dgon pa khag la mtshon na rang rang so so'i spyi dngul nas gtong gi yod cing / sger btsugs slob grwa khag 'ga' zhig dang / rtse yig tshang slob grwa bcas la slob 278

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa—grwa ba spyi pa'i dngul nas gtong gi yod/ spyi dngul de tsho spyi gnyer nas nyar te dbyar skyid dang / chab zhugs sogs spyi don gal che'i rigs la gtong gi yod pa dang / dngul de tsho ni slob grwa ba so so nas bsdus pa zhig red/ gdan sa chen po bzhi la slob gnyer ba yin min la ma ltos par grwa pa ngo yod tshang mar phul rgyu'i phogs dang / slob gnyer ba ma gtogs gzhan dag la mi sprod pa'i chos phogs bcas rigs gnyis yod/ zla ba rer chos phogs 'bru khal gcig nas gnyis bar yod/ dge bshes lha rams pa gtong mkhan tshor so so'i grwa tshang dang khang tshan bcas la dge bshes gtong sgo zer ba grwa tshang dang khang tshan thob khongs kyi grwa pa ngo yod tshang mar ja thug gsum dang / sku 'gyed bcas phul dgos pa'i 'gro gron che ba ma zad/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i 'go nas 'bras dang mar sogs nyo bya'i rin gong lo re nas lo re ldab 'phar thog/ dge bshes rnams gtong sgo'i ched du lo gcig tsam gyi ring phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du slong mo zhu bar phebs dgos pa sogs kyi dka' ngal che bar brten dad sbyin khag nas dge bshes gtong sgo'i ma rtsa phon che zhig de snga'i sa gnas srid gzhung la phul te de'i skyed kha'i thoganas dge bshes lha rams pa dpasmu 'byor gyi dka' ngal yod pa rnams la gron dngul kha gsab phon che tsam phul thub pa byung yod/ bod zhi ba'i ba/cings 'grol thob rjes nas da bar bod kyi slob gso'i bya gzhag sngar las lhag pa'i gong 'phel chen po byung ste tang krung dbyang dang rgyal khab nas slob gso'i gron dngul lo re nas lo re bzhin 'phar 279

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/snon gnang gi yod pa dang / lhag par du bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i las don thog gal 'gangasartsiche ba'i srid jus rab dang rim pa 'don gnang mdzad pa'i nang rang ljongs kyi gzhung btsugs slob grwa'i gtso gnad slob grwa chung 'bring khag lacogasum 'gan len lag bstar byed dgos pa dang 'gan len byed yul gyi khyab khongs dang / de'i cha rkyen/ gron dngul gyi tshad gzhi sogs zhib phra'i gtan 'bebs bzos pa ma zad/ da dung rgyal nang du 1985lo nas 'go btsugs te hrang had dang / than cin/le'o nying / ho pe/ ho nan/ hran tung / cang su'u/ cang shis sogs zhing chen dang grong khyer khag bcu drug gi cha rkyen cung legs pa'i slob grwa'i nang bod kyi 'dzin grwa 'dzugs gnyer byed 'go btsugs te bod la mkho ba'i 'bring rim ched las kyi shes ldan mi sna gso skyong gnang gi yod pa red/41 dpe mdzod khang / slob grwa'i nang gi slob sbyong dpyad gzhir mkho ba'i dpe deb 'jog khang la zer/ de sngon gdan sa chen po khag gi grwa tshang so so'i slob gnyer ba rnams nas dngul bsdus te dpe cha re re nas cha tshang lnga re nas bcu re bcas gsog 'jog byas pa'i dpe mdzod khang yod cing / 'dzin grwa so so'i slob sbyong zin mtshams 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon gyis phyir bsdus byas te dpe mdzod khang gi gnyer par rtsis sprod byed kyi yod pa red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni de sngon bod zhi bas bcings 'grol ma thob gong slob sbyong gi dpe deb shog grangs bzhi brgya tsam yod pa zhig la bod dngul srang bzhi bcu nas lnga bcu bar sprod dgos (nga rang lo bcu grangs 280

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel ji ltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da —skabs kyi rin gong yin)pas grwa rkyang dbul phongs tsho'i slob gnyer la dka' ngal chen po yong gi yod/ der brten 'dzin grwa'i nang slob gnyer ba dpal 'byor cha rkyen legs po yod mkhan tshos dpe deb mang tsam nyos te rang khongs slob gnyer ba tshor g.yar gyi yod pa dang / bla brang khag dang shag tshang jiche ba tshor dpe cha mang po yod pas ngo shes rgyud de g.yar thub kyi yod/ deng sang ni slob grwa che 'bring tshang mar dpe mdzod khang che chung sna tshogs btsugs yod pa de gtso bor dge slob tshor dpyad gzhi'i yigaṣ+ṭha lta klog byed bde ba'i ched yin/42 phyicergyal du sdod pa'i slob grwa ba/ phyi rgyal du song nas rgyal khab de dang rgyal khab gzhan dag gi rig gnas slob sbyong byed mkhan gyi slob grwa ba la zer/ da yod kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha gzhir bzung na lo rgyus thog tu rang ljongs nas srid gzhung gis mngags pa'i slob grwa ba dang po ni/ rang rigs yongs kyi mun sel lom ston sgron me chen po slob dpon thon mi sam bho ṭa yin cing / de nas dus rabs bco lnga pa'i 'gor chag lo rin chos rgyal bar bod nas phyi rgyal du slob gnyer la phebs pa'i lo tsā ba nyis brgya bcu med bzhi tsam byung yod/ de yi nang nas nyung shas shig rgyal pos mngags brdzong byas pa phud/ de byings rang nyid kyis dang blangs thog phyi rgyal du phebs pa sha stag yin cing / khong rnams lam bar dgra rkun dang / gcan gzan/ dug sbrul/ g.yang gzar/ la mthon po/'gro lam med pa'i shing nags 'thug po bcas brgyud skabs srog la thug pa'i dka' ngal thengs mang thug kyang zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs brtan 28/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/po'i sgo nas bal yul dang / kha che/ rgya gar bcas su nyung mthar lordzo bdun nas mang mthar lo nyi shu lhag tsam bzhugs te bod du phyir phebs mdzad rjes mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i srol bzang po 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i bka' drin las bod kyi rig gnas zhes rlabs chen mes rgyal gyi rig gnas norā mdzod nang dang 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi gral ltar nang dpal dang gzi brjid ldan pa'i ngang nas ngoms su rung ba 'di byung /gong du bshad pa de dag ni gna' rabs bod kyi slob gso rig pa'i 'phel rgyas dang de'i khyad chos skor rang nyid kyis da phan zhib 'jug byas pa'i shes tshor nyung bsdus shig yin lags/bzhi/ bod kyi slob gso'i bcos bsgyur dang mdun lam skor/ deng skabs tang krung dbyang dang rgyal khab slob gso u yon lhan kha/ nga gis mi rigs khag gi rig gnas slob gso'i kha phyogs skor la mdzub ston gnang don du/ slob gso ni deng rabs la kha phyogs pa dang / 'dzam gling la kha phyogs pa/ 'byung 'gyur la kha phyogs pa bcas kyi rtsa don gzhir bzung nas bcos bsgyur byed dgos par gsungs yod pa de ni rang re bod kyi rig gnas gsar rnying gi slob gso'i bcos bsgyur ga 'dra byed dgos thad la kha phyogs gsal por bstan pa gnang ba zhig red/ngas 'dir bshad pa'i bcos bsgyur zer ba ni rig gnas gsar 282

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wa—rnying gnyis kha bral du gtong ba'i bcos bsgyur de ma yin par sngar yod rig gnas kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i legs cha rnams rgyun 'dzin dang de'i chu tshad gong mthor gtong ba/ skyon cha yod pa rnams yo bsrang dang legs bcos/ ma 'dang ba'i cha rnams kha gsab bcas byas te rang gi mi rigs kyi rig gnas chu tshad de spun zla mi rigs gzhan dag gi rjes zin thub pa bya rgyu'i bcos bsgyur de yin/ bcos bsgyur de 'dra byed par thog mar rang re bod kyi sngar yod slob gso dang da lta'i slob gso'i thog gnas pa'i dge mtshan dang skyon cha gang yod gsal por shes pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog nas bcos bsgyur bya thabs gleng dgos par brten dge mtshan skor gong gi sa bcad gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i nang du bshad zin pa ltar yin cing / legs bcos gtong dgos pa'i skyon cha'i skor skabs 'dir gleng na 'tshams pa 'dug1 legs bcos gtong dgos pa'i skyon cha'i skor la/ bod kyi slob gso'i lam lugs dang rtsa 'dzin thad legs cha mi nyung ba yod kyang /rtsa 'dzin de don thog 'khyol thub pa'irke'achar gzhi gtan 'khel med pa de red/(1)gna' rabs kyi rig gnas phyogs bsdus slob grwa khag la yun ring dang dus thung gi 'char gzhi med pa'i thog slob khrid gnang mkhan dge rgan 'ga' zhig la rang nyid kyis bzos pa'i slob khrid 'char gzhi med pa'i dbang gis slob dus gcig la 'khrid tshar ba dgos pa'i slob tshan mjug ma 'khyol bar skabs 'phral mtshams 'jog byed dgos pa dang / 283

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yang gal che'i slob tshan 'ga' zhig slob dus gcig ring 'khrid dgos pa yang gza' 'khor gcig gnyis la tshar ba byas pa'i khral sel sla bcos kyi gnas tshul mi nyung ba zhig go thos yong gi 'dug pa de ni slob dus so so'i slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi med pa'i skyon red/(2)slob khrid zin bris med pa'i skyon/ 'char gzhi ldan pa'i slob khrid lag bstar byas phyin chad slob khrid gnang mkhan dge rgan rnams kyis slob ma so so'i gnas tshad dang bstun pa'i slob khrid zin bris gnad bsdus shig nges par du dgos kyang / deng sang dge rgan khag gcig gis slob khrid zin bris bkod pa gnang gi med pa ma zad/ tha na slob tshan gra sgrig kyang ma gnang bar 'dzin grwa tshugs ma thag dpe deb thog nas rang nyid kyi mkhyen rgya che chung la gzhigs pa'i slob khrid thugs 'dod ltar gnang bar brten rgyas bshad mi dgos pa'i sar spros bshad dang /gnad bsdus dgos sar gtso gnad 'di yin med pa/ don gnad 'ga' zhig rang la gdeng tshod med stabs skabs don la g.yol thabs bya dgos pa sogs gong du slob khrid bya thabs kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi skyon cha mang po yong gi yod pa red/(3)slob gso'i rig par do snang ma byas pa'i skyon/ deng skabs dge rgan 'ga' zhig gis slob khang nang du dpe thog nas slob khrid gnang thub mkhan zhig yin phyin slob gso mkhan pa yin nges su rtsi chog pa las/ slob gso'i rig pa zer ba'i dpe deb dang slob khrid logs su mi dgos par ngos 'dzin gnang gi yod pa red/ slob gso'i rig pa'i skor la de sngon sa 284

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da —skya paṇa chen sogs bod kyi mkhas pa mang pos 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi rnam gzhag nang slob khrid bya thabs thad gsal bshad zhib phra mdzad pa rnams rang nyid kyis sngon chad slob sbyong gnang ba dang gzhan la slob khrid gnang ba'i go rim nang slob ma rnams kyi shes rig dang shes yon 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i chos nyid dang nyams myong gal chen mang po phyogs bsdoms gnang ba zhig yin par brten slob gso bya yul gyi slob ma'i sems khams rig pa dang zung 'brel gnang ba'i slob gso rig pa zhig red/ dge rgan gyi slob khrid gnang yul slob ma'i sems khams dang shes rig 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i go rim la mtshon na byis pa dang / gzhon nu/dar ma bcas la so sor khyad chos dang nus rtsal mi 'dra ba re yod pa'i dbang gis slob khrid bya thabs kyang mi 'dra ba re yod dgos pa der do snang med pa ni slob gso rig pa dang sems khams rig par snang chung byas pa'i rkyen gyis yin cing / de ltar byas pa'i 'bras bur slob khrid bya thabs thang dma' rim nas mtho rim bar gom pa rim bgrod kyis yar rgyas gtong rgyu med par rang sor lus pa red/(4)dngos gzhi'i slob tshan dang zur blta'i slob tshan bar gyi dbye ba phye med pa'i skyon/ slob khang nang du nges par 'khrid dgos pa'i slob tshan dang / slob khang nang du 'khrid mi dgos par par skrun 'grems spel byas te slob ma tshos zur blta byas na 'grig pa'i slob tshan gang yin gyi dbye ba gtan nas ma phye bar dge rgan so sos gang 'khrid 'dod yod pa tshang ma slob khang nang du khyer nas slob khrid byed kyi yod pa red/ 28 nga

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dper na grub mtha'i slob tshan 'khrid skabs gtso bor slob ma rnams la chos lugs grub mtha' khag gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang lta tshul 'khrid rgyu yin kyang / de gtso bor oṃbyas par slob mas zur blta byas na 'grig pa'i chos lugs khag gi lo rgyus khrid rgyur dus tshod mang po gtong gi yod pa dang / de mtshungs slob khang nang du 'khrid mi dgos pa'i slob tshan dag yig ngag sgron lta bu ni slob mas zur blta bya rgyu'i gras yin kyang /sngon dus slob grwa 'ga' zhig la khrid srol yod pa der legs bcos ma btang bar 'khrid rkyang byas stabs de la dus tshod ha cang mang po gtong dgos pa'i thog slob mas slob khang nang du gnyid cog rgyag pa dang /dpe deb gzhan dag lta ba/ bsam blo gzhan zhig la gtong ba sogs byas te slob khrid thog gi grub 'bras shin tu zhan po zhig las yong gi med pa red/(5)gcig gyur gyi slob deb med pa'i skyon/ sum rtags dang /snyan ngag lo rgyus/ grub mtha'/ tshad ma rig pa sogs sngar yod rig gnas khag gi slob khrid skabs dge rgan re res rang rang so so'i thugs 'dod dang mthun pa'i slob deb re bsnams nas slob khrid gnang ba ma gtogs gcig gyur gyi slob deb gtan 'khel med rkyen slob deb de khrid rjes slob ma tsho'i gnas tshad ga 'dra zhig tu slebs dgos pa'i dmigs tshad gcig gyur yong gi med pa ma zad/ yig tshad gtong rgyu'i nang don kyang rgya che tshad dang gting zab tshad mtho drags pa dang / dma' drags pa sogs kyi skyon cha mang po yong gi yod/ 286

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ da wagong du bshad pa de tsho ni bod kyi rig gnas slob gso bya thabs nang gi skyon cha gtso che ba'i rigs yin pas de tsho nges par du bcos bsgyur ma byas na phun sum tshogs pa'i rig gnas de tsho'i shes yon slob ma rnams la brgyud sprod bya rgyur shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs nges red/ der brten skyon cha de tshor legs bcos ga 'dra gtong dgos min thad rgan dar gzhon gsum gyi dge rgan tshang mas sems shugs gcig sgril gyis thugs bsam zab bzhes gnang ste mkhas brgya 'gran gleng gi gros bsdur lhug po zhig gnang dgos pa'i dus la bab yod/2 bod kyi skad yig thog nas rang ljongs kyi slob gso mi rigs can du 'gyur rgyur mdun lam chen po yod pa'i skor la/bod yig dang bod skad phrothog nas deng rabs rig gnas gsar pa'i slob gso mi rigs can du bsgyur thub pa tsam du ma zad/ de'i mdun lam yangs shing rgya che ba yod/ rang re'i bod kyi sngar yod rig gnas rnams mes rgyal mi rigs khag gi rig gnas nor bu'i bang mdzod nang gi gal che'i grub cha zhig yin pa'i thog 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi gral star nang du'ang bod rig pa zhes gal che'i zhib 'jug bya yul dang mthong chen byed sa zhig tu gyur pa de ni bod kyi yi ge la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos bdun yod par brten nas byung ba yin/(1)bod yig 'di byung nas da bar yun ring gi lo rgyus yod pa ste/slob dpon thon mi sam bho ṭas da lta nga tshosazubed spyod byed pa'i yi ge 'di bzo gnang mdzad nas da bar lo ngo chig stong sum brgya lhag tsam gyi dus 287

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yun ring po song ba dang / de'i ring spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i ming dang tshig gsar pa mang po kha snon dang / legs bcos/ zhun thar chod pa bcas kyi go rim brgyud rim bzhin cha tshang ba dang / phun sum je tshogs su 'gyur ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog deng rabs spyi tshogs gsar pa'i dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i lo rgyus dang dpal 'byor/ chab srid/mtshan nyid/ rtsom rig snyan ngag bcas kyi nang don gsar pa mang po zhig sngar yod bod yig 'di rang gi thog nas kha snon dang yar rgyas gong 'phel byung yod/(2)da lta'i bod yig 'di ni slob dpon thon mis thog mar gsar gtod mdzad skabs dus skabs de'i bod sa gnas spyi'i thun mong gi phal skad gzhir bzung ba nas bzos pa yin pas bod rigs sdod sa'i sa phyogs tshang mar khyab che ba'i yi ge yin/ bod yig ni mtsho sngon dang /kan su'u/ zi khron/ yun nan sogs zhing chen khag dang / 'bras ljongs dang / 'brug yul/ rgya gar sogs phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs bcas bod rigs gang na yod pa tshang ma'i gcig gyur gyi yi ge yin pas lung pa so so'i yul skad thog bris na mi 'dra ba tsam ma gtogs phal skad thog bris na tshang mas go ba len thub pa de 'dra yin/(3)dbyangs dang gsal byed/ ming gzhi/ sngon 'jug rjes 'jugatshig phrad sogs rnam grangs nyung bas slob sbyong byed bde po yod/(4)dus skabs dang mthun pa'i ming dang tshig gsar snon byed skabs ming dang tshig gsar pa bzo rgyu ma gtogs yig gzugs gsar pa 288

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ bhed bzo mi dgos pa yin/ bod yig 'di sgra sbyor yin pas bod mi rang gi skad kyi thog nas chos skad dang 'tsho ba'i nang gi skad cha sogs gang 'dra zhig bshad dgos pa tshang ma yig thog tu bkod thub kyi yod par brten bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po thams cad kyi dang po slob dpon thon mi sam bho ṭa nas bzung / dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dkyil du smin grol gling lo chen dharma shri byon pa'i bar lo grangs chig stong brgya med bdun cu don bdun ring bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa snga rjes bsdoms bdun brgya lhag tsam byung ba de tshos mes rgyal nang khul dang / rgya gar/ bal yul/ kha che/ zhang zhung /li yul bcas kyi skad nas nang pa sangs rgyas kyi gzhung chen po lnga dang /gsang sngags/ gso rig skar rtsis/ snyan ngag sgra rig pa/ gtam rgyud/rtsom yig zlos gar bcas nang don ha cang rgya che zhing rnam grangs mang la gting zab pa bcas 'bor chen po de lta bu zhig bod skad du bsgyur nas bka' 'gyur pod brgya dang bcu gcig bstan 'gyur pod nyis brgya dang brgyad yod pa red/de tsho tshang ma ang dang po'i ma yig gi go don cha tshang ba shes pa mdzad nas bsgyur ba gnang tsang bsgyur stangs thad bod kyi rtsom pa pos bris pa dang khyad med pa'i 'gyur legs shing / go don gnad la khel ba de 'dra byung yod tsang bod kyi rig gnas dang lo rgyus mkhyen mkhan rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang pos bstod bsngags 'di 'dra gnang yod pa ste/bod kyi mkhas pa tshos rgya gar dang mi rigs g.yin dag gi rig gnas la zhib 'jug byed pa'i grub 'bras ni rgya gar rang gi mkhas pa tsho las kyang 289

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lhag pa byung yod pa dang / rgya gar rang gi skad kyi thog nas go ba lon khag po yod pa rnams bod yig gi bsgyur dpe'i thog nas dang po'i ma yig gi go don ji ma ji bzhin shes thub pa yong gi yod pa de'i thog nas/ bod kyi skad yig la nang don phun sum tshogs shing tsha tshang ba'i ming dang tshig sne 'dzoms po yod par brten nas byung ba red ces mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis bsngags brjod gnang gi yod/(5)go rim ldan pa dang cha tshang ba'i brda sprod rig pa khungs btsan yod pa red/rang re'i bod kyi brda sprod rig pa ni dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor slob dpon thon mi sam bho ṭas skabs de'i bod spyi'i phal skad la brtag dpyad nan tan mdzad pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug sogs bod kyi sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos brgyad brtsams pa gnang ba nas da bar lo chig stong sum rgya nyi shu lhag tsam song tshar ba red/(6)lo ngo stong phrag gi dus yun song na yang bod kyi skad yig gi chu tshad nges can yod pa'i mis klog thub pa ma zad/ go ba yang lon thub kyi yod pa red/ dper na de sngon dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil du btsugs pa'i zhol rdo ring phyi ma dang dus rabs dgu pa'i dkyil du btsugs pa'i lha sa gtsug lag khang mdun gyi rdo ring thog gi bod yig rnams lta skabs/brda rnying pa nyung shas ma gtogs de byings mang che ba bod kyi skad yig gi chu tshad nges can yod pa'i mis klog thub pa ma zad/ go ba yang len thub kyi yod pa de red/ 290

bod kyi slob gso'i rig pa gong 'phel jiltarabyungaba'igatamagleng/ —da —(7)bod yig 'di sgra sbyor yi ge yin tsang skad yig gzhan dag gi sgra sbyor byed rgyu dang / ming tshig gsar pa kha snon gang byas kyang da yod yig 'bru bzhi stong lhag tsam de rang gi steng nas byed chog pa yin/mi rigs gzhan dag gi yi ge dang skad sgra sbyor byas na bod yig 'angi rang gi thog nas byed chog pa/ sngar gyi bod yig dpe cha mang po'i nang bod kyi yul skad ngang rgya skad/ rgya gar skad/ zhang zhung skad/ dbyin ji'i skad bcas sgra sbyor byas nga de tsho mi rigs gzhan dag gi yi ge'i thog nas sgra sbyo ra las ha cang gis sgra dag pa dang yag pa yod/gong du gsal ba'i bod yig gi khyad chos de tsho'i thog nas nga tshos mthong thub pa ni/ de sngon bod kyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi ha cang zhan po yin pa dang / zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi lag rtsal rjes lus yin pa/ rang nyid sger gyi dpal 'byor stobs shugs dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen ha cang dka' ngal che ba'i gnas tshul 'og rang rigs kyi mkhas pa sngon byon rnams kyis dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyi snying stobs dang / mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas gong 'phel gtong ba'i lhag bsam thugs la bcangs te nga tshos da lta bed spyod byed bzhin pa'i bod yig 'di yi thog nas bod kyi gso ba rig pa dang / skar rtsis/ rdzas 'gyur rig pa/ mtshan nyid rig pa/sgra rig pa/ snyan ngag rtsom rig lo rgyus/ chos lugs bcas rig gnas che ba lnga dang / chung ba lnga cha tshang ba slob sbyong byed thub pa bzos pa gnang zhing / da lta krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid yod pa dang / spun zla mi rigs khag gi shugs chen rgyab skyor yod pa/ rang 29/

ljongs kyi bzo zhing 'brog gsum gyi thon skyed dang dpal 'byor lo re las lo re gong 'phel 'gro gi yod pa bcas kyi cha rkyen bzang po 'di 'dra'i 'ogang tshos rang nyid kyi 'bad brtson la brten nas bod mi rigs rang gi skad yig thog nas deng rabs kyi tshan rig dang rig gnas gsar pa'i slob gso mi rigs can du 'gyur thub nges yin/

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs—ge —skor gyi thog ma'i bsam tshul/mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i tang krung dbyang gi dbu khrid yang dag pa'i 'og dang tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi 'od stong 'phro ba'i 'og mi bzhi ngan rengs shog khag mthar phyin pa'i gtor pham btang nas rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ 'phrod bsten bcas gang ci'i thad skam la nye ba'i ljon shing chu dang phrad pa lta bu'i skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i rnam pa gsar pa zhig thon bzhin yod pa dang / rgya che'i mi rigs khag gi dge slob tshang mas tshan rig slob sbyong dang / rig gnas slob sbyong / chab srid slob sbyong bcas ma bskul rang mos kyi hur brtson rang bzhin mtho ru phyin te/ rlabs chen mes rgyal 'di nyid deng rabs can bzhi'i rgyal khab stobs ldan zhig tu 'gyur ched 'bad brtson byed bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir/ ngas bod kyi skad yig gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i gnad don dang 'brel ba yod pa'i bsam tshul kha shas dpyad gzhi'i ched du bshad rgyu yin/ 293

da wa dungadakarablo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang po/ spyir yi ge zer ba gang 'dra zhig la ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i skor/sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi tshad ma rig pa dang / mngon pa gong 'ogabod yig gi sgra rig pa'i gzhung sum rtags 'grel pa bcas tshang ma'i nang bshad srol la/①yi ge zer ba ni ming tshig gnyis kyi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi gdangs la ngos 'dzin pa dang / skad kyi sgra gdangs mtshon byed kyi ri mo de la yig gzugs zer ba ma gtogs yi ge ngo ma min zer/ deng sang nga rang tsho'i goms gshis thog yi ge zer ba'i ming de rna bar thos ma thag shog bu'i thog tu bris pa'i skad kyi sgra gdangs mtshon byed kyi ri mo de la go ba len gyi yod pa dang yi ge dang yig gzugs gnyis gcig yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod stabs/ bod kyi gna' rabs dpe deb mang che ba'i nang ming tshig gnyis kyi rtsom gzhi yin pa'i skad kyi sgra gdangs de yi ge yin zhes bshad pa mthong dus gad mo shor mdog kha po red/ de la bsam blo zhib tu btang na rgyu mtshan med pa min te/ gang lags zer na/ ming tshig gnyis kyi rtsom gzhi yin pa'i skad kyi sgra gdangs de mi yi rigs kyi bsam blo mtshon byed kyi brda rtags yin par brten de la yi ge zhes zer chog pa dang / sgra gdangs de ri mor bris pa la yig gzugs zhes zer chog pa la bsams nas de ltar bshad pa red/ mi yi rigs thog mar byung nas gdod ma'i spyi tshogs skabs mi rnams thun mong thog 'tsho ba skyel ba dang thon skyed byas pa bcas kyi go rim nang mi dang mi yi bar la kha bral du 294

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/ —da d+nghami rung ba'i 'brel ba zhig chags pa des/ mi rnams thun mong gi bya spyod gcig gyur zhig yong rgyur skul 'ded byung zhing / mi rnams phan tshun bsam blo mtshon pyed kyi skad brda gcig gyur zhig chags thub pa byung ba dang / thog ma'i skabs kyi brda rtags de ni skad chen po zhig rgyag pa lta bu'i ha cang stabs bde zhig yin stabs/ skad rgyag pa des ma ldeng ba'i cha rnams lag pa'i brda dang lus kyi rnam 'gyur la brten nas go thabs byed kyi yod pa red/⑧ nang don yod pa'i skad kyi sgra gdangs de la skad brda 'am ‘‘skad kyi brda rtags ’’zer ba dang / lag pa'i brda la brten nas nang don go thub pa de la ‘‘lag brda ’’zer kyi yod/ 'tsho ba dngos kyi goms gshis thog yi ge zer ba'i ming de rna bar go ma thag shog bu'i thog tu bris pa'i ri mo de rang lam gyis dran yong ba las/ ri mo de skad kyi sgra gdangs mtshon byed kyi brda rtags yin pa dang / mtho dman mi 'dra zhing nang don yod pa'i sgra gdangs de bsam blo mtshon byed kyi brda rtags yin pa de gnyis bsam blo'i nang 'khor thub kyi med pa red/ gna' rabs bod yig dpe deb nang bshad pa'i yi ge'i ngos 'dzin byed stangs dang nga tsho'i 'tsho ba dngos kyi goms gshis thog yi ge'i ngos 'dzin byed stangs bar la khyad par de 'dra yod kyang / zhib tu bsam blo btang na so sor rgyu mtshan re bshad rgyu yod pas 'gal ba chen po yod pa ma red/(kyi mtshon byed kyi brda rtags zer ba'i skad cha dang bsam blo gnyis ni mtshon par bya rgyu'i don ngo ma de yin pa dang / de gnyis mtshon byed kyi dpe ris dang brda rtags ni yig gzugs yin pa bcas kyi 'brel ba 295

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bshad pa zhig yin pa/ dper na zlos gar gyi skabs mtshon bya don gyi mi sna dang / mtshon byed dpe'i gar mkhan gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba lta bu yin par khas len bya dgos shing / 'brel ba de gzhir bzung nas bsam zhib nan tan byas na ming tshig gnyis kyi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi gdangs de yi ge'i ngo bo yin zhes pa'i bshad tshul der rgyu mtshan dang gnad 'gag chen po yod par mthong thub kyi red/④ gnyis pa/ bod yig gi lo rgyus dang 'phel rgyas skor/bon po'i lo rgyus thog bshad pa ltar na/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i gong du bod la bon po'i chos lugs dar rgyas chen po byung yod stabs yi ge med zer ba dngos yod gnas tshul dang mi mthun zhing / bod yig de yang thog mar stag gzig (rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i gong gi lo rgyus nang gsal ba'i stag gzig ni a la po la ngos 'dzin dgos pa da nga srong btsan sgam pos srid dbang bzung ba tshun chad kyi bod kyi lo rgyus nang gsal ba'i stag gzig ni dbyi lang la ngos 'dzin byed dgos/ zhib cha gzhan du gsal /)⑤gi spungs yig zer ba zhang zhung gi yig rgan du bsgyur zhing / de nas smar brag gi yi ger bsgyur ba dang / de rim bzhin dbu can dang 'bru mar 'gyur ba yin zer/61bod kyi lo rgyus mkhas pa mang pos rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i gong du bod la yi ge med cing / blon po thon mi sam bho ṭas rgya gar kyi nā ga ra'i yi ge la dpe byas nas yig gzugs gsar gtod byas pa yin zhes bshad yod/9 7) 296

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/ da wa —de ni deng skabs nga tshos bed spyod byed mus yin pa'i bod yig gi yig gzugs de rgya gar gyi yi ge la dpe byas pa dang / de'i gong du bod sa gnas yongs la spyi khyab tu spyod pa'i yi ge med pa bcas kyi go don yin pa ma gtogs/ de'i gong du yi ge gtan nas med pa dang / thon mis rgya gar gyi yi ge la dpe byas nas bod yig bzos pa yin zer ba'i go don min/rgyu mtshan ni/ yi ge yod pa'i mi rigs gang 'dra zhig yin rung rang nyid kyi yi ge de rang nyid kyi skad gzhir bzung nas bzos pa yin pa ltar bod yig kyang de 'dra rang red/ der brten ngas bsam par/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i gong du bod yig rnying pa zhig yod pa de ni zhang zhung gi yig rnying yin pa dang / de ni cha mi tshang zhing ha cang stabs bde 'ig yin pa'i dbang gis khyab chung ba dang spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed gong 'phel phyin pa'i dgos mkho dang 'tshams thub kyi med pa red/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i dkyil du rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor yar rgyas chen po byung ba dang / mi rigs gzhan dag dang /khyim mtshes rgyal khab bar mdza' grogs kyi 'gro 'ong byas pa brgyud sngar yod bod yig rnying pa de las cha tshang zhing brda sprod rigs pa'i gzhung lugs yod pa'i bod yig gsar pa zhig dgos mkho byung bar brten/thog mar rang nyid kyi blon po thon mi sam sgo ṭa sogs mi bcu drug rgya gar du mngags shing / thu mi rang nyid kyis rgya gar gyi yi ge mkhas pa bram ze li byin dge rgan du bsten nas yig ris mi 'dra ba mang po slob sbyong gnang ste bod du phyir log phebs rjes skabs de'i bod kyi skad la brtag dpyad zhib 297

da wa dungadakarablo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'jug mdzad pa'i gnas tshul ngo ma gzhir bzung ste sngar yod bod yig rnying pa der cha ma tshang ba rnams kha skong dang legs bcos gnang thog da lta nga tshos bed spyod byed mus kyi bod yig gi yig gzugs gsar gtod dang / cung zad cha tshang zhing go rim yod pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs 〈 sum cu pa 〉dang / 〈 rtags 'jug 〉sogs brda sprod rig pa'i bstan bcos brgyad brtsams pa red/⑧gsum pa/ bod yig 'di la mi rigs gzhan gyi yi ge dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos gang yod skor/1 sgra sbyor yi ge yin pas shes sla ba/ bod yig ni bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi sa gnas khag tshang mas thun mong du go thub pa'i skad kyi sgra gdangs chags tshul la zhib 'jug byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog de dang mthun pa'i sgra sbyor yi ge dang / brda sprod rig pa gtan khel byas pa zhig yin stabs rtsa ba'i yi ge dbyangs bzhi dang / gsal byed sum cu/ mgo can gsum/ 'dogs can bzhi bcas yi ge bzhi bcu zhe gcig las med cing /gal te ya btags can gyi yi ge bdun dang / ra btags can gyi yi ge bcu gcig la btags can gyi yi ge drug wa btags can gyi yi ge bcu gnyis/ ra mgo can gyi yi ge bcu gsum/ la mgo can gyi yi ge bcu/ sa mgo can gyi yi ge bcu gnyis/ mgo tsheg shad gsum bcas bsnan pa'i dbang du byas kyang yi ge ngo grangs brgya dang brgyad las med pas de tsho 'bri 298

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/da wa da klog legs par shes na bod yig gi yig gzugs brgya cha dgu bcu 'bri klog shes pa yong gi yod pa ma zad/ yi ge 'bri klog slob skabs yig gzugs kyi lag rtsal kyang chabs cig slob sbyong byas na dus tshod ji tsam 'gor yang lo gnyis kyi nang bod yig gi yig gzugs yongs rdzogs kyi 'bri klog lag rtsal dang bcas pa byang chub pa zhig yong gi yod/bod yig gi sgra sbyor byed stangs kyang dbyangs bzhi 'am lnga las med pa dang / sgra'i nga ro thon tshul gyi dbang du byas na mtho dman 'bring gsum ste pho mo ma ning gi yi ge'i rnam grangs gsum/ de re re la sgra drag zhan mnyam pa bcas su dbye ba phye nas de dag gi sgra gdangs 'byung ba'i gnas brgyad dang / sgra gdangs thon par byed pa'i rkyen/ dbugs kyi rtsol ba drag zhan gyi khyad par bcas sgra sbyor rig pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba zhig yod pa las 'dir mkhas pa sngon ma'i gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig bkod na/dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i dkyil du sa chen bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa'i 〈 chos la 'jug pa'i sgo 〉dang / dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i 'gor pra sti dge bshes rin chen don grub kyis mdzad pa'i 〈bod kyi yi ge'i rnam bzhag rmad byung don gyi bdud rtsi'i ro 'dzin〉 dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i 'gor dngul chu dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 〈bod yig gi gnas dang byed rtsol ngos 'dzin tshul ngo mtshar gtam gyi myu gu 〉rnams las zhib cing rgyas par gsungs yod pas 'dir ma bris/⑨ 'o na deng sang bod yig klog skabs rjes 'jug dang 'dogs can gyi yi ge'i gras rnams ming gzhi dang mnyam du sgra gdangs gsal por thon gyi 299

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod kyang / sngon 'jug dang mgo can gyi rigs rnams deng skabs yi ge klog skabs gsal por mi thon pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ de ni deng skabs bod dbus gtsang gi skad kyi nang sgra gdangs gsal bar ma thon pa tsam las/ de sngon dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i mgor 'bri gung du skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs dang / deng sang gi 'go log sa khul/ rgyal rong / a mdo bcas kyi sa khul du sngon 'jug yod med dang / mgo can yin min bcas kyi sgra gdangs dbye ba gsal po yod pa'i skor si tu rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i 〈 sum rtags 'grel chen 〉nang gsal por gsungs pa ltar yin/sgra sbyor yi ge ni 'dra gzugs yi ge dang mi 'dra bar skad kyi sgra gdangs chags tshul dang go rim la gzhir bzung nas de dang mthun pa'i yig gzugs dang / brda sprod rig pa gtan khel byas pa zhig yin stabs dus rabs bdun pa'i dkyil du da lta'i bod yig 'di gsar du bzos pa nas da bar lo chig stong sum brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad tsam phyin yod rung /gna' rabs kyi yi ge de tsho deng sang yang bod yig gi chu tshad nges can yod pa'i mi tshang mas brgya cha dgu bcu tshod dpag byas pa tsam ma yin par klog thub pa dang go ba len thub kyi yod pa dper na/ lha sa po tā la'i mdun gyi rdo ring phyi ma dang / lha sa gtsug lag khang mdun gyi dbon zhang mthun 'brel rdo ring sogs rdo ring bod yig 'khod pa tshor bltas na nang don cha tshang go thub pa lta bu red/rkyu nya2 mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad dang mthun pa'i brda sprod rig pa cha 300

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul—/ ——da watshang yod pa red/ bod kyi brda sprod rig pa ni dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor slob dpon thon mi sam bho ṭas skabs der bod mi phal che bas go thub pa'i phal skad gzhir bzung nas deng skabs nga tshos bed spyod byed mus kyi yi ge 'di gsar gtod gnang ba dang chabs cig de'i khyad chos dang mthun pa'i brda sprod rig pa 〈 sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug /〉 sogs sgra yi bstan bcos brgyad rtsom par mdzad pa ma zad/ 〈 sum cu pa 〉〉dang 〈 rtags kyi 'jug pa 〉 gnyis mdzad zin pa'i mjug bsdoms su/ de bzhin yi ge'i 'jug tshul rnams/ /smra ba kun la gnas gyur kyang / /rang tshul de nyid mi shes pas/ /don la sbyor ba ga la shes/ /zhes pa'i gsung 'dis bod kyi brda sprod sum rtags kyi gzhung 'di ni bod mi spyis thun mong du go thub pa'i phal skad kyi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa rnams phyogs bsdoms byas pa zhig yin zhes gsungs pa yin te/ tshigs bcad sho lo ka gcig po 'di'i go don gsal bar bshad na/ brda sprod kyi gzhung 'di nas bshad pa'i bod kyi yi ge'i 'jug tshul de rnams ji lta ba bzhin du bod mi phal skad smra ba kun gyi ngag thog la gnas par gyur pa zhig yin mod kyang / bod skad rang gi brda sprod tshul thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos de nyid gsal por mi shes pa rnams kyis skad dang / yi ge de dag gi go don gang dang gang zhig sbyor nas ston pa'iganas tshul yang ga la shes thub ces gsung rgyu yin pa gsal po red/ 3 bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi sa gnas spyi'i phal skad gzhir bzung nas yi ge bzo gnang mdzad pa yin stabs khyab che ba/ da lta'i bod yig 30/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'di thog mar gsar gtod gnang skabs sa gnas so so'i yul skad gzhir bzung ba ma yin par sa gnas mang che bas thun mong du go thub pa'i phal skad gzhir bzung ba yin par brten dbus gtsang khams gsum dang /mtsho sngon/ kan su'u/ yun nan/ 'bras ljongs/ 'brug yul/ rgya gar sogs rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rigs 'dus sdod sa khul tshang ma'i gcig gyur gyi yi ge yin pas/ lung pa so so'i yul skad thog bris na phan tshun go dka' ba ma gtogs phal skad thog bris na tshang mas go ba len thub pa zhig yin/4 dus skabs dang mthun pa'i ming dang tshig gsar pa kha snon ji 'dra byed dgos kyang yi ge gsar pa bzo mi dgos pas 'jug pa bde ba yin/'dra gzugs yi ge ni ming dang tshig gsar pa re thon skabs yig gzugs gsar pa kha snon byed dgos pa yin kyang / bod yig ni de dang mi 'dra bar bod mi rang gi skad kyi thog nas 'tsho ba'i nang gi skad cha dang /chos skad/ rig gnas gsar rnying sogs tha snyad gang 'dra zhig yin kyang yig thog tu bkod thub par brten/ bod kyi lo tsā ba sngon byon thams cad kyi thog ma'i slob dpon chen po thon mi sam bho ṭa nas bzung dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dkyil du byon pa'i smin grol gling lo chen dha rma shri bar snga rjes su lo tsā ba bdun brgya lhag tsam byung ba de tshos mes rgyal nang sa dang /rgya gar/ bal yul/ kha che/ zhang zhung / li yul bcas kyi skad nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags/ gso 302

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/—da da wab rig pa/ skar rtsis/ snyan ngag sgra rig pa/ gtam rgyud/ rtsom rigazlos gar sogs nang don rgya che zhing rnam grangs shin tu mang ba zhig bod skad du bsgyur nas rig gnas che chung tshang ma'i slob gso mi rigs can du 'gyur thub pa byung yod cing / bod zhi bas bcings grol thob pa nas deng rabs rig gnas gsar pa'i tha snyad dang ming tshig ha cang mang po bod skad du bsgyur ba'i rnam grangs khri nyi shu lhag tsam zhig 'phar snon byung ba tshang ma sngar yod bod yig de rang gzhir bzung nas 'phel rgyas btang ba zhig yin pa las/ ming tshig gsar pa re byung dus yig gzugs gsar pa re snon dgos pa'i dka' ngal med/5 gna' rabs dang deng rabs kyi yig gzugs gnyis bar 'bri gzugs legs nyes kyi khyad par ma gtogs gsar rnying gi khyad par med pas klog pa la dka' ngal med pa yin/ bod yig ni sgra sbyor yi ge yin pa'i rkyen gyis gna' rabs dang deng rabs kyi yig gzugs bar lag rtsal thad la legs nyes kyi khyad par byung ba tsam las/ yig gzugs gsar rnying gi khyad par gtan nas med pa'i dbang gis deng sang yang bod yig shes pa tshang mas klog thub kyi yod/6 yig par 'phrul 'khor dang / la ting yi ge'i thog bed spyod gtong bde ba yod/ bod yig ni yig par 'phrul 'khor thog spyad na ang grangs dang mtshon rtags phud (ang grangs dang mtshon rtags ni mi rigs tshang ma'i yi ger dgos/)mdzub gnon rnam grangs sum cu so gcig las mi dasgos shing de'i thog rgya gar sam skyi ta'i skad kyi dmigs bsal yi ge ring po 303

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsungartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa bdun dang / 'thug po lnga/ log pa lnga bcas bco brgyad bsnan kyang mdzub gnon rnam grangs bzhi bcu zhe dgu las mi dgos pas gza' 'khor gcig gnyis kyi nang 'phrul 'khor bed spyod gtong ba'i lag rtsal slob shes thub kyi yod/7 mi rigs gzhan gyi skad brda sgra sbyor byed skabs bod yig rang gi thog nas byed thub pa/ de yang mi rigs phan tshun bar rig gnas brje res byed skabs ming dang tshig 'ga' zhig mi rigs so so'i skad rang sor bzhag pa ma gtogs go don bod skad du bsgyur na mi 'grig pa dper na/bod rigs sa khul du med cing mi rigs gzhan dag gi sa gnas su yod pa'i srog chags dang / rtsi shing me tog rin po che/ gter kha sogs kyi ming dang / lag rtsal sogs 'ga' zhig mi rigs so so'i skad de nyid rang sor ma bzhag par gang byung don bsgyur byas na phan pa las gnod pa che ba yin pas de 'dra'i rigs rnams bod yig rang gi thog nas sgra sbyor byas tshe/la ting gi skad yig thog nas sgra sbyor byas pa dang khyad par gtan nas med pa ni/ sngar gyi bod yig dpe cha mang po'i nang sgra sbyor yi ge skad gnyis shan sbyar thog nas bris pa rnams mi rigs gzhan dag gi skad kyi thog nas bris pa las kyang sgra dag pa dang legs pa yod pa ni/ skad gnyis shan sbyar dang / skad bzhi shan sbyar gyi dag yig dang / zlos gar gyi gzhung de tshor bltas na shes thub pa yod/tunya 304

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/da wad wabazhi pa/ bod yig gi yig gzugs la 'gyur ba ga 'dra byung ba/thog mar rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus kyi yig gzugs khag gcig lha sa'i shar rgyud 'jan khog snang lha khang gi brag rdo'i thog bskos pa de'i nang don ni thon mis rgyal po srong btsan sgam por bstod bsngags phul ba'i snyan tshig bod yig gi lo rgyus mang po'i nang 'khod pa de yin zhing /1ltade'i yig gzugs ni sbal nag na la bgrad 'dra ’zer/ de'i rjes su rgyal po mang btsan gyi dus su yig mkhan cha ngar rin chen 'bar gyis bris pa'i yig gzugs la so phag gzhibs 'dra zer/ de'i rjes su rgyal po 'dus srong mang po rje'i dus su yig mkhan chab dkar be'u tshe zer bas bris pa'i yig gzugs la bya pho 'jol ba 'dra ba zer/ de rjes rgyal po khri lde gtsug brtan gyi dus su/ yig mkhan dge bsnyen dkon mchog dbang zer bas bris pa'i yig gzugs la/ nas sngon po phying dkar gyi steng du bkram pa 'dra ba ’zer kyi yod/ de rjes rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su yig mkhan be sho khram zer bas bsam yas kyi rdo ring thog bod yig brkos pa'i yig gzugs la mu tig star la brgyus pa 'dra 7zer/ de rjes rgyal po mu ne btsan po'i dus su yig mkhan mkhas pa tshes spong byang chub zer bas bris pa'i yig gzugs la spur nag bgrad pa 'dra ba zer/ de rjes rgyal po mu tig btsan po'i dus su yig mkhan mkhas pa 'bre ba yon tan zer bas bris pa'i yig gzugs la nya mo chu nang nas thon pa 'dra ba zer/ni05

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de rjes rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi dus su yig mkhan mkhas pa gra shod rnam gnyis/ zer bas bris pa'i yig gzugs la ‘‘seng ge gnam du 'phyongs pa 'dra pa ’’zer/ de nas dus rabs bcu pa'i mjus/ tu stod mnga' ris dang zu/tsho sngon brgyud nas bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar gso byung skabs yig mkhan mkhas pa sgro gnya' khri zer bas sngar gyi rdo ring gi yi ge la dpe byas nas yig gzugs legs bcos btang ba de la ‘‘bad gsar ’’zer/ de rjes rim bzhin yig mkhan mkhas pa shakyā rdo rje/ khyung po g.yu khri/sna gnam zhang btsun/ sum pa gnod sbyin sos/sa byung ba ma zad/ lhag par du khyung po g.yu khri la slob ma yig mkhan mkhas pa bcu gnyis byung zhing yang slob mkhas pa chen po rong po sogs byung / khyung po g.yu khris lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyi yig gzugs la dpe byas te bod yig dbu can gyi yig gzugs thig ris thog mar gtan la phab cing / de'i yang slob mkhas pa chen po rong pos 〈 yi ge'i thig ris gsal byed rin chen sgrom bu 〉zhes pa'i gzhung brtsams nas bod yig dbu can gyi yig gzugs tshad gzhi can du 'gyur ba byas pa de la sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos 'grel bshad brtsams yod/ 〈 bai ḍūr+ya g.ya' sel 〉 gyi shog grangs 278ba 6—shog grangs kha shas bar yod/( nyu miyi ge dbu med la ‘‘'bru ma ’’yang zer zhing de la ‘‘li lugs ’’dang /‘‘ldan lugs ’’gnyis yod pa las/ ‘‘li lugs ’’thog mar gsar gtod byed mal/ na su yin skor lo rgyus thog mi gsal ba ma zad/ de'i lag rgyun deng sang chad zin ces lo rgyus 'ga' shas nang gsal/ ‘‘ldan lugs ’’ni 306

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skor gyi thog ma'i bsam tshul/deng sang nga tshos bed spyod gtong ba'i lag rgyun 'di yin zhing / de yang thog mar dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil du rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus lo tsā ba mkhas pa ldan ma rtse mangs zer ba de'i lag rgyun yin/ ju ‘6ldan lugs ’’de yang rjes su yig mkhan so so'i lag rtsal 'dra min gyi dbang gis yig gzugs gtan khel med pa zhig tu gyur par brten/ dus rabs bco lnga pa'i mgor rgyal rtse sde srid rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pas/ gna' rabs ‘‘ldan lugs ’’kyi yig gzugs la mkhas pa'i mi mang po bsags nas de'i nang gi yig gzugs legs shos zhig la dpe byas te dbu med kyi thig ris dang / 〈 thig bshad 〉brtsams shing / de'i 'grel pa yang gong gsal sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i 〈 be ḍū r+ya g.ya' sel 〉 gyi shog grangs 283na 6— shog grangs kha shas bar yod/gong gsal dbu can dang dbu med gnyis kyi thig tshad dang / yig gzugs chabs cig tu 'khod pa'i dpe ris ni dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dkyil du/ mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi sku 'bum dgon par shing par brkos pa de red/ de'i yig gzugs ha cang yag po yod pa ma zad/ yig gzugs kyi sgyu rtsal rang bzhin dang / gtan khel gyi tshad gzhi yod pa'i thig ris gnyis zung 'brel yag po byas pas/ shing par de ni lo brgya phrag kha thas phyin kyang bod yig gi yig gzugs bzo dbyibs mi 'gyur bar gnas thub pa'i dpe ris ha cang yag po zhig yin pa/ deng sang sku 'bum che shos rin po che'i bla brang du bdag gces gnang yod pa red/ gna' rabs bod rigs kyi yig mkhan mkhas pa tshos dga' tshogs che ba'i ngal rtsol rte07

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byas pa brgyud nas thon pa'i yig gzugs de la mi rabs rgan pa mang pos mthong chen byas te thig ris bzo ba dang thig bshad brtsams pa/ de gnyis zung 'brel byas pa'i dpe ris bzos te par skrun byas pa sogs ni nga tshos bstod bsngags byed 'os pa zhig red/ gang yin zer na/ kho tshos yi ge ni skad cha'i tshab byed mkhan yin pa dang skad cha ni bsam blo'i tshab byed mkhan yin pa/ bris pa'i yi ge des skad cha'i tshab byed thub min ni yig gzugs legs nyes la thug yod pa bcas gsal por shes kyi yod pa'i rkyen gyis red/ yi ge zer ba ni skad cha'i tshab byed mkhan yin pa dang / skad cha ni bsam blo'i tshab byed mkhan yin stabs rang gis bris pa'i yi ge des skad cha'i tshab byed thub min ni yi ge de mi gzhan dag gis klog thub min la rag lus yod pa dang / thog mar mi gzhan gyis klog mi shes pa dang zhag gsum song na so so rang nyid kyis kyang klog mi shes pa de 'dra bris pa yin na/ rang nyid kyis bris pa'i yi ge des phan thogs gang yang ma byung ba red/der brten yi ge 'bri ba'i skabs su rang nyid kyis bris pa'i yi ge de gzhan dag gis klog thub pa'i gdeng tshod yod pa byas te yig gzugs gang legs 'bri rgyur do snang byed dgos/lnga pa/ bod yig bcos bsgyur byed dgos min gyi gnad don skor/de la thog mar lo rgyus thog bod yig la bcos bsgyur byung yod med 308

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/—da da dang / bcos bsgyur byed stangs gang 'dra yin pa'i skor bshad na phan thogs chen po yod pas de'i skor cung zad ngo sprod byed rgyu gsham gsal/ dus rabs bdun pa'i dkyil du rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs da lta'i bod yig 'di thog mar gsar gtod byas pa nas rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyis srid dbang ma bzung bar lo brgya lhag tsam ring gi bod yig gi dag cha de ni/ dus skabs de'i ring gi lo tsā ba thon mi sam bho ṭa sogs kyis gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i yi ge'i dag cha yin pas de la bod kyi lo rgyus thog ‘‘bkas bcad dang po ’mizer zhing /yo1 de'i skabs kyi yi ge'i dag cha dang / de dang mthun pa'i dpe cha gang dang gang yod skor/ skyogs ston lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 dag yig li shi'i gur khang 〉gi shog grangs 1na 1 — 2ba 1bar gsal/ de nas dus rabs dgu pa'i mgor rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyi dus su lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang ye shes sde sogs mang du byung ba de dag gis skabs de'i yul skad dang bstun nas bod yig gi dag cha la bcos bsgyur byas nas gtan 'bebs bzos pa de la/ lo rgyus thog ‘‘bkas bcad bar pa ’’zer zhing /⑤(deng sang bod yig bcos bsgyur thengs dang po zer/)skabs der yi ge'i dag cha la bcos bsgyur gang byas pa'i skor gong gsal 〈 dag yig li shi'i gur khang 〉gi shog grangs 3ba 3nas 12na 3bar gsal/ de nas lo nyi shu rtsa bdun tsam song rjes rgyal po glang dar mas srid dbang bzung ste sangs rgyas chos lugs rtsa med bzo skabs/thon mi sam bho ṭas brtsams pa'i brda sprod bstan bcos brgyad kyi nang 309

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas 〈 sum cu pa 〉dang 〈 rtags 'jug 〉gnyis tsam ma gtogs gzhan dag mig gis mthong rgyu med pa chags pa dang /⑩ de rjes dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug tu bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar gso byung skabs mnga' ris lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po sogs byung ba nas/ dus rabs bco lnga pa'i dkyil zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po byung ba'i bar lo bzhi brgya bdun cu lhag tsam zhig ring lo tsā ba mkhas pa brgya dang drug cu re bdun tsam byung ba/⑩ de tshos bod yig gi dag cha'i thad bcos bsgyur rim par byas pa de la lo rgyus thog ‘‘bkas bcad gsum pa ’’zer zhing /⑫(deng sang bod yig gi bcos bsgyur thengs gnyis pa zer chog)dus skabs de'i ring bcos bsgyur gang dang gang byas skor/ gong gsal 〈 dag yig li shi'i gur khang 〉gi shog grangs 3ba 1dpe mtshon 'ga' zhig drangs te mjug tu/skabs der bcos bsgyur de ltar byas kyang lag len dngos kyi thog bkas bcad thengs gnyis pa ltar gnas pa mang zhes gsal/⑨gong gsal gyi bcos bsgyur thengs gsum po de ni sngar yod sum rtags kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs rgyun 'dzin byas thog yi ge'i dag cha'i thad skabs de'i phal skad dang bstun nas bcos bsgyur byas pa zhig yin pa las rtsa ba'i brda sprod rig pa yin pa'i sum rtags kyi gzhung rtsa gtor btang nas/ rig pa'i gzhung lugs gsar gtod zer ba'i bcos bsgyur byas pa de 'dra lo rgyus thog rtsa ba nas byung myong med cing / lhag par du bcos bsgyur thengs gsum pa de dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug nas dus rabs bco lnga'i mgo bar byung ba yin kyang lag len dngos kyi thog bcos 310

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/ da wa bsgyur thengs gnyis pa ltar rang 'jags gnas pa'i gnas tshul de la brtags na blo sgo chen po phye thub kyi red/drug pa/ yul skad dang yig skad gcig gyur byed rgyu'i gnad 'gag thug sa gang yin skor/deng skabs nga tshos rgyun du kha skad dang yig skad zer ba'i tha snyad cig shod srol yod pa yin mod kyang / kha skad zer ba'i tha snyad de ni bar skabs lo shas ring bod kyi rig gnas la cha rgyus med mkhan 'ga' res gsar du bzos pa zhig yin pa las/ gna' rabs bod yig gi dpe cha'i nang sa gnas so so'i skad la yul skad zer ba'i ming btags yod pa dang /sa gnas khag mang por khyab cing mang che bas thun mong du go thub pa'i skad la phal skad zer ba'i ming btags yod/zhu 'on kyang deng skabs kyi bshad srol ltar kha skad dang yig skad zer ba'i tha snyad de rang gzhir bzung nas bshad na/ kha skad dang yig skad zer ba ni ltos bcas zhig yin pa las ltos med kyi kha skad dang yig skad zer ba zhig med/ deng sang kha thog nas bshad rgyun yod pa'i skad la kha skad zer ba dang / kha thog gi bshad rgyun dang mi 'dra bar yig thog tu bris pa'i skad cha de la yig skad zer zhing / de yang sa gnas 'ga' zhig gi yul skad de sa gnas gzhan zhig la yig skad yin pa dang / sa gnas 'ga' zhig gi yig sdeskad de sa gnas gzhan zhig la yul skad yin pa de 'dra red/ der brten 31 /

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kha skad dang yig skad bar gyi 'gal ba ni ltos bcas kyi 'gal ba yin pa dang / 'gal ba'i phyogs gtso bo ni yul skad gcig gyur med pa der thug yod pa ma zad/ gcig gyur med pa'i sa gnas so so'i yul skad dang / sa gnas khag mang por khyab che ba'i thun mong gi skad gnyis mnyam du gnas pa'i phyogs gnyis ka mthong dgos pa bcas red/yul skad dang yig skad bar gcig gyur med pa de ga 'dra byas nas gcig gyur byed dgos pa'i skor la bsam blo zhib phra thengs mang po btang ba brgyud/ rlabs chen slob dpon mar khe sis 〈 sa phyogs dang goms skad 〉 zhes pa'i gsung rtsom nang mi rigs kyi skad rnams gcig gyur chags pa'i 'gro lam skor gsung skabs gsungs don/ sa phyogs kyi skad rnams gcig tu gyur nas mi rigs kyi skad thun mong ba zhig byung ba ni/dpal 'byor dang chab srid gcig tu gyur pa la rag lus yod ces gsungs pa de mthong byung /shu 1 gsung rtsom des mi rigs de'i dpal 'byor dang chab srid gcig gyur ma byung gong mi rigs kyi skad la gcig gyur yong thub kyi med pa gsal por gsungs pa de tshan rig dang mthun pa'i bka' slob rang red/ gang yin zer na/ mi yi rigs kyi skad thog mar byung ba ni thon skyed ngal rtsol gyi go rim nang nas byung ba dang / bar du 'phel rgyas 'gro ba yang thon skyed nus shugs dang thon skyed 'brel ba'i 'phel rgyas dang bstun nas 'phel rgyas 'gro ba/ mthar gcig gyur chags pa yang skabs de'i thon skyed nus shugs dang dpal 'byor thad gcig gyur chags pa dang bstun nas gcig gyur yong dgos pa yin stabs/ mi 312

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/ —da da rigs khag gi skad 'phel rgyas 'gro ba ni mi rigs so so'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa zhig red/ bod ni dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma byung gong phan chad kyi lo stong phrag kha shas ring thon skyed rgyu chas sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs yin pa dang / thon skyed nus shugs dang / thon skyed byed stangs bcas ha cang rjes lus yin pa'i dbang gis/ thon skyed byed mkhan mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba de yang rgya khyon ha cang chung chung zhig las med par brten/ rgyun du sa khul khag so sor kha gram nas sdod pa'i dus yun ring ba'i dbang gis phan tshun 'brel ba byed skabs rang rang so so'i sa gnas dang / yul tsho so so'i skad de bed spyod gtong dgos pa'i dus yun ring zhing / sa khul gzhan dag dang /yul tsho gzhan dag bar phan tshun 'brel ba byed skabs thun mong du go thub pa'i skad de bed sbyod gtong gi yod kyang de'i dus yun thung thung las med pa red/ tsho pa khag rnams gcig tu 'dres nas gcig gyur gyi mi rigs zhig chags thub pa yong dang mi yong de tsho pa khag gi thon skyed nus shugs dang / thon skyed 'brel ba/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas bcas la rag lus yod pa dang / tsho pa khag gi thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel byung ba brgyud/zhing las dang / 'brog las/ lag shes bzo las bcas gong 'phel chen po byung ba dang chabs cig phan tshun dngos zog brje res dang 'gro 'ong gi 'brel ba sngar las rgya che ru phyin te mthar tsho pa khag rnams gcig tu 'dres nas mi rigs khag gcig tu gyur pa dang / skabs der phan tshun thun mong du go thub pa'i skad zhig chags pa de mi rigs kyi skad red/8ga tsho pa khag 3/3

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gcig tu 'dres nas mi rigs gcig gyur zhig chags pa dang chabs cig tshong las kyi 'brel ba gong 'phel phyin pa des/ dus yun ring por bed spyod byed thub pa'i yi ge zhig dgos mkho che ru 'gro ba'i rjes su gzhi nas mi rigs kyi yi ge byung ba red/ tsho pa khag rnams gcig tu 'dres nas gcig gyur gyi mi rigs zhig chags zin pa'i rjes su'ang / da dung mi mang che ba grong gseb dang 'brog khul gyi sa gnas so sor sngar bzhin kha gram nas sdod dgos pa'i dbang gis rgyun du rang rang so so'i yul skad thog nas skad cha shod dgos kyi yod par brten/ nga'i ngos 'dzin du/ bod rigs ni tsho pa khag rnams gcig tu 'dres nas gcig gyur chags zin pa'i mi rigs zhig yin pa ma zad/ sa gnas phan tshun bar 'brel ba byed skabs thun mong du go thub pa'i phal skad yod la/ rgyun du spyod pa'i sa gnas so so'i yul skad kyang yod pa de 'dra zhig yin par rtsi gi yod/ blo mthun 'ga' zhig gis tsho pa khag rnams gcig tu 'dres nas mi rigs zhig tu gyur zin pa'i rjes su thun mong du go thub pa'i skad ma gtogs sa gnas so so'i yul skad med pa chags zin pa red zer ba dang / yang skabs der sa gnas so so'i yul skad yod pa tsam rgyu mtshan du byas nas thun mong du go thub pa'i phal skad med zer ba de gnyis ka mi rigs gzhan dang bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang mi mthun pa red/ lhag par du bod rigs ni gcig gyur gyi mi rigs zhig yin kyang da lta thun mong du go thub pa'i phal skad med zer ba de ni de bas kyang khungs med red/ deng skabs rgyal spyi'i thog sgra rig mkhas pa tshos bod skad la yul skad rigs mi 314

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/ da wa —'dra ba khag lngar phyogs bsdoms byas yod pa dang / rgyal nang du mi rigs kyi skad yig zhib 'jug gnang mkhan sgra rig mkhas can tshos bod skad nang gi yul skad de rigs chen po gsum (dbus gtsang / khams/ a mdo bcas )du phyogs bsdoms gnang yod pa de ni rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i gong du rang rgyal gyi sgra rig mkhas pa tshos lo mang ring grangs nyung mi rigs kyi yul skad la dngos su zhib 'jug byas pa'i grub 'bras gal chen zhig red/ 'on kyang grub 'bras de'i mtha' ma'i mjug bsdoms su lha sa grong khyer gyi skad de yul skad dang yig skad gcig gyur byed rgyur gzhi 'dzin sa'i rmang gzhi'i yul skad du bzhag nas de rang dar spel gtong rgyu'i u tshugs byed tshe cung zad thal drags pa red bsam gyi 'dug gang lags zer na bod skad de yul skad chen po rigs gsum du bsdus pa'i rjes su da dung gna' rabs kyi rtsom yig khag la zhib 'jug byas nas/yul skad chen po rigs gsum gyi nang nas gang zhig nga tshos deng sang ngos 'dzin byas pa'i yig skad dang mthun po yod med zhib 'jug byas te/mthun po yod pa rnams yul skad dang yig skad gcig gyur byed rgyu'i gzhi 'dzin sa byed dgos kyi red/ khyab che chung gi thog nas bshad na/ da dung gtsang pa'i skad dang / lho kha'i skad/ khams skad/ a mdo'i skad sogs kyi nang nas mang po zhig nga tshos deng sang ngos 'dzin byas pa'i yig skad dang tag tag mthun po yod pas lha sa'i yul skad las khyab che ba red/nga tshos gsham gsal gyi bod yig dpe cha de tsho lta tsam byas na dus rabs kha shas ring gi bod yig dang bod skad kyi gnas tshul gang 'dra yin ni15

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/min gsal por shes thub pa yong ste/ dpe cha khag gcig gi ming tho gsham gsal/(1)rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs thon mi sam bho ṭas bsgyur ba'i spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud rnam grangs mi 'dra ba bcu bdun/(2)rgyal po khri srong lde btsan yab sras kyi dus su bsgyur ba'i mngon pa dang / tshad ma/ phar phyin/ dbu ma/ 'dul ba/ 'phrin yig bcas kyi skor/(3)rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi dus 'gos lo tsā ba chos grub kyis bsgyur ba'i 〈 mdo mdzangs blun 〉 tshad ma/ dbu ma/ 'dul ba bcas kyi skor/(4)dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dkyil du a ti sha'i slob ma 'brom ston pas mdzad pa'i 〈 a ti sha'i rnam thar bla ma'i yon tan chos kyi 'byung gnas〉(5)dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i mgor bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes po to bas 'phan po'i skad kyis brtsams pa 〈 be'u bum sngon po〉〈 dpe chos rin chen spungs pa 〉dang 〈 de'i 'grel pa 〉(6)dus rabs bco lnga pa'i mjug tu/ gtsang smyon he ru ka sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis stod mnga' ris ba'i skad du brtsams pa 〈 mi la ras pa'i rnam thar/ 〉(7)dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mgor/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi gung thang rin po che dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes a mdo'i skad kyis brtsams 316

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/ —da —pa'i 〈 go bde ba'i phal skad zab chos 〉dang 〈 zlos gar gyi bstan bcos 〉bcas la gzigs thub tshe/ chos skad dang yul skad khag gcig 'grel bshad ma byas na go thub kyi med pa phud/ de min 'tsho ba'i nang gi skad cha mang che ba go thub kyi yod pa de thog nas bod skad de la sa gnas so so'i yul skad dang / thun mong du go thub pa'i phal skad gnyis ka yod pa gsal por mthong thub rgyu red/ de min da dung gna' rabs kyi bod yig so9khag mang po zhig la zhib 'jug byed skabs yul skad thog gcig gyur med pa ma gtogs rtsa ba'i brda sprod rig pa dang / rtsa ba'i tha snyad mang che ba gcig gyur yin pa dang / lhag par du dus rabs bco lnga pa'i mgor ta ming gong ma yung lo rgyal pos byams chen chos rje shakyā ye shes brgyud rje tsong kha pa dang / karma pa/ sa skya ba bcas la nan cing du par bskrun byas pa'i bod yig gi bka' 'gyur cha tshang re bskur ba des bod kyi mkhas pa mang po'i gzigs rgya che ru phyin nas bod yig gi chos dpe khag rnams shing par thog thog mar brkos pa de nas bzung bod la par bskrun gyi lag rtsal dar 'go tshugs pa dang chabs cig bod yig gi yig gzugs dang dag cha yang sngar las gcig gyur che ru song ba ma zad/ rtsom pa po tsho'i rtsom yig nang gi yul skad kyang gcig gyur che ru phyin yod pa red/thu gong gsal gyi gnas tshul de'i thog nas bod yig par skrun las rigs kyis skad yig gcig gyur byed rgyu'i thad la nus pa ha cang chen po thon gyi yod pa mthong thub kyi red/ gal te kha skad dang yig skad bar gyi 'gal ba gtso bo de yig skad dang / yi ge'i dag cha'i thad la bzhag nas 3/7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sngar yod sum rtags 'gro lugs rnams med pa bzos pa dang / yi ge'i dag cha de lha sa'i kha skad rkyang pa'i thog la bsgyur rgyu'i u tshugs byas pa yin na/ yul skad dang yi ge gcig gyur bzo thub rgyu phar zhog gsar bzos yi ge'i dag cha de dang sa gnas gzhan dag gi yul skad bar kha bral che ru 'gro gi red/ gang lags zer na/ bod rigs ni lha sa grong khyer gcig pu'i bod rigs tsam min par gtsang dang / lho kha/ dwags kong /khams khul/ mtsho sngon/ rgyal mo rong / yun nan bde chen bcas la kha gram nas sdod pa'i bod rigs mang po yod pa dang / de rnams kyis bed spyod gtong rgyu'i bod yig ni gcig ma gtogs sa gnas re re la bod yig re re med pa red/ gal te lha sa'i skad dang mthun pa'i bod yig gcig bzos na sa gnas gzhan dag gis de go mi thub pas kho tshos kyang so so'i skad dang mthun pa'i bod yig gsar pa zhig bzo dgos pa yong zhing / de 'dra byas te bod rigs sa khul tshang mas so so'i yul skad dang mthun pa'i bod yig gsar pa re bzos pa yin na gcig gyur gyi rmang gzhi legs po yod pa'i bod mi rigs kyi yi ge de kha bral du 'gro gi myo/ red dam/ bod rigs ni krung hwa mi dmangs spyi māthun rgyal khab nang gi gcig gyur chags zin pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs zhig yin pa dang / bod yig ni krung go'i mi rigs khag gi yi ge'i nang gi gcig gyur chags zin pa'i mi rigs kyi yi ge zhig yin pas/ gcig gyur gyi yi ge kha bral du gtong ba'i bcos bsgyur de 'dra la sus kyang dga' bsu zhu gi ma red/318

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/ da wa bdun pa/ yul skad gcig gyur byed rgyu'i 'gro lam gang yin skor/si ta lin gyis blo mthun ho lo po h+pho la btang ba'i yig lan zhes pa'i nang du gsung don/⑫ khong gis tang gi 'thus tshogs chen po thengs drug pa'i thog bshad pa'i gtam gyi nang du skad rigs sna tshogs 'dres nas thun mong gi skad gcig tu 'gyur ba'i skor gyi nges tshig gzhan zhig tu bshad pa ni/ gong du bshad pa de dang mi 'dra ba'i dus rabs ga'an zhig ste 'dzam gling yongs su spyi tshogs ring lugs la rgyal kha thob zin pa'i rjes kyi dus rabs de yin/ dus rabs der 'dzam gling gi btsan rgyal ring lugs med par 'gyur rgyu dang bshu bzhog gral rim gtor te mi rigs khag dang bran du bkol yul rnams la gnya' gnon byed pa de med par 'gyur ba/ mi rigs khag grogs med khyer rkyang du lus pa dang phan tshun yid mi ches pa'i gnas tshul med par gyur te phan tshun yid ches ldan pa dang 'brel thag nye ru 'gro ba/ mi rigs kyi dbang cha 'dra mnyam dngos su lag len byed thub pa yo nga rgyu/ skad la gnya' non dang rang rigs su gyur pa'i srid jus med par bzo thub pa/ mi rigs khag gi bar mnyam las kyi 'brel ba btsugs nas phan tshun gong 'phel du gtong thub pa bcas yong /gnas tshul de dag byung ba'i skabs su skad 'ga' zhig la gnya' non byed pa dang pham par 'gyur ba/ yang 'ga' zhig rgyal bar 'gyur ba zhig ci la yod/ de'i tshe byung bar 'gyur ba'i skad gnyis kyi nang nas gcig pham pa 3 9

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang gcig rgyal bar 'gyur ba ma yin gyi/ mi rigs khago rnams dpal 'byor dang / chab srid/ rig gnas gang ci'i thad nas yun ring mnyam las byas te mi rigs kyi skad brgya phrag mang po'i nang nas thog mar sa khul gcig tu khyab pa'i thun mong gi skad 'byung zhing / de nas sa khul gcig tu khyab pa'i skad rnams 'dzam gling yongs su khyab pa'i thun mong gi skad zhig tu 'gyur rgyu/ skad 'di ni 'jar man gyi skad min la/ u ru su'i skad kyang min/ dbyin ji'i skad ni de bas kyang ga la yin/ de ni mi rigs khag rnams kyi skad dang sa khul rnams kyi skad kyi snying bcud thams cad 'dus pa'i skad gsar pa zhig go/ /zhes gsungs yod pa 'di ma gzhi spyi tshogs ring lugs de 'dzam gling yongs la rgyal kha thob pa'i dus skabs su 'dzam gling mi rigs khag gi skad rnams gcig gyur yong ba dang / gang 'dra byas nas gcig gyur chags pa'i skor gsungs pa ma gtogs/ rgyal khab gcig nang la yod pa'i mi rigs khag gcig gi yul skad mi 'dra ba rnams gcig gyur yong stangs skor gsungs pa ma yin kyang / nga rang gis bsam par/ si ta lin gyis gsungs pa ltar/ 'dzam gling yongs su spyi tshogs ring lugs la rgyal kha thob pa'i skabs 'dzam gling mi rigs khag gi skad rnams thun mong gi skad zhig tu 'gyur thub pa'i chos nyid de 'dra zhig yod pa'i dbang du btang na/ rgyal khab gcig gi nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rgyal kha thob zin pa'i rjes su mi rigs khag so so'i yul skad mi 'dra ba rnams thun mong gi skad zhig tu 'gyur ldog yong thub pa'i chos nyid de 'dra zhig nges par du yod dgos pa ni gcig mtshungs rang red 320

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/ —da ——bsams kyi 'dug der brten gcig gyur byung zin pa'i mi rigs khag gcig gi yul skad mi 'dra ba rnams gcig gyur yong ba byed rgyu'i 'gro lam ni/ mi rigs de nyid 'dus sdod sa khul khag phan tshun bar chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas phyogs gang ci'i thad nas rgya khyab che ba'i 'gro 'ong gi 'brel ba chags pa brgyud nas yul skad mi 'dra ba rnams rang shugs kyis gcig gyur chags yong thub pa ma gtogs/ mi rigs gcig yin kyang sa khul mi 'dra ba so sor kha gram nas sdod pa'i rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams phan tshun 'gro 'ong gi 'brel ba byed rgyur tshod 'dzin yod pa'i gnas tshul 'og sa gnas khag gcig gi yul skad de gzhi 'dzin sa'i rmang gzhi'i yul skad byas te/ yi ge 'bri stangs dang dag cha rnams yul skad gcig po de rang gzhir bzung nas 'bri dgos pa'i u tshugs byas pa ni/ gcig gyur yin pa'i mi rigs de'i skad rnams sngar las lhag par kha bral che ru gtong rgyu ma gtogs gzhan 'bras bu bzang po gang yang yong gi ma red/gcig gyur chags zin pa'i mi rigs zhig gi nang sa gnas kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i yul skad dang / sa gnas dang sa gnas bar phan tshun 'brel ba byed skabs thun mong du bed spyod byed pa'i phal skad gnyis mnyam du gnas pa'i gnas tshul 'og skad yig gcig gyur yong ba byed dgos na/ sa gnas rang bzhin ldan pa'i yul skad de dang / thun mong gi phal skad bar thag nye ru 'gro ba'i go rim kha shas brgyud dgos pa ste/thog mar sa khul so so'i thon skyed nus shugs dang / thon skyed 'brel ba ni2/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgya khyon che ru 'gro ba'i go rim nang sa khul gcig gnyis tsam la bed spyod byas pa'i skad de phan tshun shugs rkyen thebs pa brgyud sa khul kha shas la khyab pa'i thun mong gi skad zhig yong rgyu dang / de nas rim bzhin sa khul mang che bar khyab pa'i skad nas mthar sa khul yongs rdzogs la thun mong du khyab pa'i skad zhig tu gcig gyur yong thub gyi red/ gong du gsal ba ltar bod skad kyi yul skad rigs gsum du bsdus pa de rang gi thog nas yul skad dang / yig skad gcig gyur byed rgyu'i gzhi 'dzin sa'i rmang gzhi'i yul skad de lho sa grong khyer gyi yul skad kho nar rtsis na 'grig gi med pa ra sprod gsal po byung yod/ 'grim 'grul dang / slob gso/ rig gnas 'tsho ba bcas gong 'phel ha cang 'gro mgyogs po yod pa dang / rim bzhin grong khyer dang grong gseb bar dang / sa gnas dang sa gnas bar gyi 'brel ba sngar las rgya che ru 'gro rgyu ma zad/ des sa gnas khag bar rig gnas dang dpal 'byor thog gi bar khyad chung du 'gro rgyur skul 'ded yong ba dang / dus mtshungs sa gnas khag gi yul skad kyang phan tshun thag nye ru 'gro gi yod pa bcas ni 'gog thabs med pa zhig red/der ma zad da dung nga tshor ga/zhi rgya che ba'i dpe skrun khang dang / tshags par khang / rgyang bsgrags/ glog brnyan/ zlos gar/ gzugs mthong glog 'phrin bcas gong 'phel 'gro mgyogs po yod pas/ dus rabs rjes ma'i nang bod skad kyi yul skad dang yig skad gcig gyur khyab chen po zhig yong ba byed thub kyi rerde/ de dus kyi bod skad ni/ lha sa'i skad dang /gtsang pa'i skad/ a mdo'i skad sogs gang yang ma yin par skad de tsho 322

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skor gyi thog ma'i bsam tshul/tshang ma'i nang nasaci legs cha 'dus shing khyab che ba'i gcig gyur gyi skad zhig red/ nga tshos bod skad kyi 'phel rgyas 'gro phyogs de dang bstun nas mig sngar sngar yod sum rtags kyi 'gro lugs rnams rgyun 'dzin byas pa dang chabs cig sa gnas khag gi yul skad dang / gna' rabs bod yig gi rtsom yig khag la zhib 'jug byas te 'byung 'gyur yig skad dang yul skad gcig gyur yong ba byed rgyu'i rmang gzhi 'ding thub pa byed dgos kyi red/ der brten nga tshos gna' rabs kyi bod yig la zhib 'jug byas pa der deng skabs chab srid kyi don snying yod pa tsam ma yin par/ 'byung 'gyur bod kyi skad yig gong 'phel gtong rgyur rgyang ring gi don snying ldan yod pa zhig yin/ nimachan 'grel/①rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi dus bod kyi partsi ta rtsi khyi 'brug gis brtsams pa'i 〈gnas brgyad 〉rtsa ba dang / de'i rang 'grel/ bstan 'gyur sde dge par ma'i (co)pa'i nang gsal/②〈ngal rtsol gyis spra nas mir 'gyur ba'i go rim nang thon pa'i nus pa nyi1975lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par skrun byas pa'i deb rkyang pa/①〈sgra rig pa'i skor gyi dogs pa 'ga' zhig la mar khe si'i ring lugs ltar lan btab pa〉 mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1958lor par skrun byas pa'i si ta lin gyi gsung rtsom deb rkyang pa'i bod yig shog grangs 12pa//rjobo dong paṇa chen 'jigs med grags pas brtsams pa'i 〈mkhas pa dga' ba skyed pa'i gtam〉323
