dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/⑥a mdo dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis bsgrigs pa'i 〈deb ther dkar po〉⑦h+phan wen lan gyis brtsams pa'i 〈krung go thung hri 〉rgya yig deb bzhi pa'i grangs 407 mespyi lo 132lor bu ston rin chen grub kyis brtsams pa'i 〈chos 'byung gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod 〉dang / 1328lor sa skya bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉 dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis bsgrigs pa'i 〈deb ther dkar po 〉shing dpar grangs 18ba1/ grangs 30nari(9ste1687lor/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈be ṭur g.ya' sel 〉grangs 278na 4gsal/⑩ 1978lor/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa'i bod yig slob dpyod khang gis bsgrigs pa'i 〈gna' rabs bod yig 'dem bsgrigs 〉deb bzhi pa dum bu gnyis par gsal/tume〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉dang / 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉〈be ṭur+ya g.ya' sel 〉bcas su gsal/⑫〈gnas brgyad rtsa ba 〉dang de'i 'grel pa las gsal/(midus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mgor a lag sha sog rigs dge bshes bstan dar lha rams pas brtsams pa 〈yi ge'i bshad pa mkhas pa'i kha rgyan 〉grangs 8na6nas gsal/ṣā〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉grangs 32ba5nas gsal/skyegong gsal gyi thig bshad sde pa sangs rgyas mtshos brtsams pa 'di/dbyangs bzhi dang gsal byed sum cu re re bzhin du gsal bshad byas stabs shog grangs mi nyung ba zhig 'dug pas rjes su 〈rtsa ba rin chen sgrom bu 〉dang / 'grel bshad mnyam du bltas na gsal po yod/324

bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs skoragyithogama'ibasamatshul/ da wa da ⑩'di thon mi sam bho ṭas gtan 'bebs byas pa dang / de nas lo brgya dang lnga bcu lhag tsam bar gnas thub pa byung /rmyabakas bcad bar pa ste yi ge'i bcos bsgyur thengs dang po 'di lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum sogs bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa mang pos gros bsdur byas te bzos pa ma zad/ gtan 'bebs byas pa'i yig cha 〈sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa 〉dang / 〈bye brag rtogs byed che ba dang chung ba 〉bcas sde dge'i bstan 'gyur (co )pa'i nang du yod pas der gzigs/ yi ge'i bcos bsgyur thengs dang po 'di ni dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug bar lo nyis brgya tsam gnas pa ma zad/ de nas bcos bsgyur thengs gsum pa byung yang mang che ba sngar rgyun ltar gnas pa yin zhes/ skyogs ston rin bkra shis kyis brtsams pa'i 〈dag yig li shi'i gur khang 〉grangs 2ba1por gsal/tu3sum cu pa'i rtsa ba'i mjug tu sgra'i bstan bcos brgyad kyi nang gi dang po'i le'u lnga pa yin pa dang / rtags 'jug gi mjug tu sgra'i bstan bcos drug gi nang gi gnyis pa yin par bshad/ tuyam̐ 1564lor dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas brtsams pa 〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉dum bu bzhi pa/ 〈lo paṇa chos 'byung 〉nang gsal/67 bkas bcad gsum pa 'di la bcos bsgyur gsar pa gang byas kyi gnas tshul zhib phra bkod yod pa'i lo rgyus da phan ma mthong yang / phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba brgya dang drug cu re bdun gyi ming 〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉dum bu bzhi pa/ lo paṇa chos 'byung nang bkod 'dug pa de tshos bsgyur pa'i chos dpe dang rig gnas kyi dpe cha rnams la gzigs na dpyad gzhi ha cang mang po yod pas rjes su zhib 'jug byed dgos/(7snyan ngag 'grel ba mang che ba'i nang zur chag gi skad dang / yul ming rang bzhin pa'i skad/ sam skyi ta'i skad / pi sha tsi ste 'dre'i skad (los skad )325

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kye gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcas bzhi'i dbye ba phye skabs su gsal/⑥si ta lin gyi gsung rtsom 〈sgra rig pa'i skor gyi dogs pa 'ga' zhig la rma ra khe si'i ring lugs ltar lan btab pa 〉1958lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par skrun byas pa'i bod yig gi dpe deb/ grangs 24 5par sa/sal/⑫mi rigs kyi gnad don bshad pa/ mar khe si/ en ke si/ le nyin/ si ta lin bcas kyi gsung btus phyogs sgrigs 1975lor krung dbyang mi ci rigs slob grwas par skrun byas pa'i rgya yig gi dpe deb grangs 2/⑥bod sil bu'i skabs/ bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes tshos brtsams pa'i chos dpe dang / sgrung / yon rgyal rabs kyi skabs su sa skya ba'i bla ma dang /lho kha/ dgas po/ 'bri gung / 'brug pa bcas kyi bla ma tshos brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang / rnam thar/ ming rgyal rabs kyi skabs su dbus gtsang dang /lho kha/ a mdo/ mnga' ris bcas kyi mkhas pa tshos brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang / rig gnas skor/ ching rgyal rabs kyi skabs su sde dge dang / a mdo khul/ dbus gtsang bcas kyi mkhas pa tshos brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dang /sgrung / rnam thar/ chos dpe bcas la zhib 'jug byed rgyu mang ngo/ bsdad yod/dugye〈 deb ther dkar po 〉 grangs 32na2nang gsal/tsosi ta lin gyi gsung rtsom 〈sgra rig pa'i skor gyi dogs pa 'ga' zhig la mar khe si'i ring lugs ltar lan btab pa 〉1958lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par skrun byas pa'i bod yig gi dpe deb/ grangs 101nang gsal/326

bodakyidakarachag rigapa/ da —sngon 'gro'i gleng gzhi/gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i bod yul gyi ljongs 'dir sngon byon lo tsā ba dang parnyi ta rnams kyis mes rgyal nang sa dang / rgya gar/li yul/ kha che sogs kyi skad nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab dang / de'i dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i bstan bcos mang po bod skad du bsgyur pa dang / rang rigs kyi mkhas pa mang pos mdzad pa sogs rig gnas che ba lnga dang / chung ba lnga yi skor la thos bsam slob gnyer dang / zhib 'jug brtag dpyad ci 'dra zhig byed dgos kyang de dang de la nye bar mkho ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha phun sum tshogs pa yod thog mang po zhig ni shing par du bskrun myong ba dang / de 'phros par du bskrun ma myong ba dang /par du skrun ma thub par lus pa yang ha cang mang po yod pa bcas la brten/rang re bod kha ba can gyi bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas ni rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig gnas nor bu'i gter chen gcig tu 'dus pa'i bang mdzod lta bur gyur yod/ 'on kyang rig gnas gsar brje chen po zar ba'i lo bcu'i god chag byung ba dang chabs cig deng sang nga tshos bkol ba'i bod yig 'di thog mar byung ba nas bzung da phan lo ngo chig stong sum brgya lhag tsam gyi ring gsog 'jog byas pa'i bod kyi rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa de 327

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dag la gtor bshig tshabs chen phog yod/ mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i tang krung dbyang gis g.yon thal bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun dang / de'i gnod 'che'i rang bzhin yo bsrang gnang ste mi rigs khag gi rig gnas sngar yod rnams rgyun 'dzin gyi rmang gzhi'i thog gong du spel ba dang gsar gtod bya rgyu'i thad la phan yod kyi mdzad phyogs srid jus rab dang rim pa bton pa des slar yang bod kyi rig gnas nor bu'i bang mdzod nas da lta lhag yod pa 'di dag srung skyob byed thub pa'i go skabs bzang po thob pa dang / tshan pa khag gis de'i thad la legs skyes chen po phul yod pa 'di ni rang rgyal mi rigs khag gi sems kyi gting nas dga' spro skye 'os pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig red/ las don de sgrub pa'i ched du thog mar dkar chag 'god pa nas 'go tshugs te myur skyob kyi rmang gzhi 'ding dgos pa dang / de dang chabs cig rgyun 'dzin dang / spel ba/ gsar gtod bcas kyi go rim yod pa dang / gtso gnad yod pa'i sgo nas dus thung dang rgyang ring gi 'char gzhi 'ding dgos pa bcas las don de dag gang sgrub kyang dkar chag ni ha cang gal che ba'i lhu tshigs shig red/ der brten deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang du dkar chag rig pa zer ba'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi sde khag zhig zur du phye nas thon pa dang / bod la yang snga rabs btsan po khri lde srong btsan gyi dus nas da bar dkar chag 'god pa'i las don rgyun mi chad par byung bar ma zad/ de'i thad la phun sum tshogs pa'i nyams myong mang po bsags yod stabs de tsho phyogs bsdus byas te rgyal khab phyi nang gi tshan rig mkhas pa rnams dang / rang rigs kyi mi 328

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa—rabs rjes ma rnams la ngo sprod zhu rgyu ni ha cang gal chen po yod par bsams nas/ bod kyi dkar chag rig pa zer ba'i ched rtsom 'di bzhin ngo mtshar che ba'i gzigs mo'i sngon 'gro'i 'khrab tshan lta bu dang / dpa' bo g.yul la 'jug pa'i brda ston dung brda lta bu'i phyogs ston tsam du bsgrigs pa yin pas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la mkhyen spyan yangs pa rnams kyis 'di las rgyas shing gsal ba'i legs bshad rgyun mi chad par spro bar mdzad par zhu/dang po/ dkar chag zer ba'i go don dang de'i nus pa/1 dkar chag ces pa ni gsung rab dang dpe deb yig cha sogs sde tshan dang rnam grangs sog sa ma 'dres par 'tshol bde ba'i tho yig gsal bor bkod pa la zer/ de yang dkar zhes pa nyin dkar kyi dus su gzugs brnyan rnams gsal bor mthong thub pa lta bu'i khyad chos ldan pa dang / sde tshan dang rnam grangs khag rnams ma 'dres par so sor phye nas rtswa'i chun po bsdams pa ltar chings rim pa bdun gyis bcings te ming thor bkod pas na chag ces dpe yi sgo nas btags pa yin/ dkar chag gi chings bdun zhes pa ni/ ①sde tshan gang gi khongs yin pa/ mertsom yig gi kha byang dang ming / ③rtsom pa po'i ming / ④le tshan gyi grangs/gyepod grangs/ ⑥shog grangs/ ⑦cha tshang min bcas yin/ bdun po de ni zhib 'jug byed mkhan dang / slob khrid 'chad nyan byed mkhan/ 329

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ dpe mdzod bdag gnyer byed mkhan bcas tshang mas nges par du blo la 'dzin dgos pa'i don tshan gtso bo yin cing / rgyas par bshad na gsham gsal don tshan gsum pa'i skabs su 'byung ba ltar nang don zhib phra 'god rgyu yod par ma zad/ de tsho re re la yang dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos dang / nus pa/ bya thabs bcas mi 'dra ba yod pa red/ der brten dkar chag ni gzhi khyon che zhing rnam grangs mang ba'i dpe cha lta ba la med du mi rung ba'i gsal byed me long lta bu dang / tshan rig zhib 'jug byed par thog ma'i 'jug sgo lta bu/ dpe mdzod khang gi sgo brgya myur du 'byed pa'i lde mig lta bu/ gal che'i dpe deb bdag gnyer srung skyob byed rgyur mkho ba'i nus ldan mtshon cha lta bu bcas yin/dkar chag la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos de 'dra yod pa'i dbang gis rgyal khab phyi nang gi tshan rig mkhas can rnams kyis thog mar dpe mdzod khang gi dkar chag la gzigs te/ ched las zhib 'jug la mkho ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig char thugs zhib dang / dpyad gzhi gsog 'jog legs sgrig bcas gnang ba brgyud tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan pa'i gsung rtsom rin thang bral ba mang po rtsom gnang mdzad pa dang /lhag par du mar khe si dang / in ke si sogs rlabs chen mi sna dang tshan rig mkhas can mang po 'ig ni thog mar dpe mdzod khang du rgyun ring phyag las gnang ba dang chabs cig zhib 'jug gnang ste/ dpe mdzod khang du yod pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha phun sum tshogs pa de dag si/ nus pa 'don spel legs par gnang thub pa byung yod/330

bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/ 2 dkar chag gi nus pa/ dkar chag ni dpe deb kun gyi gzugs brnyan gsal ba'i me long lta bu yin te/ dkar chag gi nang du dpe deb so so'i ming dang / rtsom pa po'i ming / nang don/ sde tshan/shog grangs/ cha tshang min/ bris ma dang par ma gang yin sogs zhib cing phra ba bkod yod stabs dkar chag la yang yang lta klog byed thub na dus tshod ring po mi dgos par de'i nang bkod pa'i don tshan gal che ba rnams blo la 'dzin thub pa yong zhing / rtsom pa po gang dang gang gi rtsom yig nang dpyad gzhi gal che ba gang dang gang yod pa dang / lde tshan gang gi nang du mkhas pa su dang su'i rtsom yig yod pa/ rtsom yig de dus skabs gang gi nang du brtsams pa/ de la khyad chos gang dang gang yod pa sogs kyi dkar chag gson po zhig rang gi bsam blo'i thog chags thub pa yong / yig thog tu 'khod pa'i dkar chag dang / blo thog la 'jags pa'i dkar chag gnyis kyi nus pa 'don tshul mi 'dra ste/ yig thog tu 'khod pa'i dkar chag ni/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi rigs rang rang so so'i rig gnas thog 'brel ba yod pa'i rtsom yig dang dpyad gzhi'i yig cha gang yod yig thog tu bkod pa dang / yang na dpe mdzod khang so sor yod pa'i dpe deb rnams thor bkod pa'i dkar chag yin pas gtso gnad che chung dang / dgos mkho che chung gi khyad par phye med la ma phye yang 'grig pa dang / blo thog tu 'jags pa'i dkar chag ni yig thog tu 'khod pa'i dkar chag lta bu'i dpe deb yod tshad kyi ming dang nang don blo la 'jags thabs byas pa zhig ma yin par/ rang nyid kyi ched las dang 331

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'brel ba yod pa'i rtsom rig dang dpyadagazhi'i yig cha khag gi ming dang /rtsom pa po'i ming / brjod bya'i nang don/ rgyas bsdus/ kha gsal mi gsal/ sde tshan dang le tshan gang gi nang du 'tshol dgos pa bcas blo la nges pa'i bsam blo'i nus rtsal yin pas/ des rtsom yig gi ming de go ma thag tu rtsom yig hril po'i nang don tsam ma zad/ tha na shog grangs kyi rgyab mdun dang yig phreng gang dang gang gi nang du gal che'i dpyad gzhi gang dang gang yod pa bcas kyang sems la 'jog thub/ de ni yig thog tu 'khod pa'i dkar chag gis bsdur thabs med pa'i dkar chag gson po zhig yin pas zhib 'jug mi sna dang / rtsom pa po/ dpe mdzod bdag gnyer mkhan bcas su yin kyang yig thog gi dkar chag gcig pur skyabs bcol nas bsdad na las don gyi sa chod chung zhing / gal che'i dus tshod mang po zhig yig cha 'tshol zhib kyi ring la zad nas mi shugs dang dngos shugs 'bor chen don med chud zos su 'gro rgyu red/3 dkar chas/ ni tshan rig zhib 'jug gi thog ma'i 'jug sgo yin pa/ de yang ched las rig gi zhib 'jug gang byas kyang de'i bya yul ngo ma ni rang byung khams dang / mi/ bya ba/ dngos po sogs la yod pa'i rang rang so so'i khyad chos dang / nus pa/ snang tshul/ ngo bo bcas yin pas de tshor zhib 'jug byed bsam na tshan rig sde khag de dang /'brel yod tshan khag gzhan rnams la sngon gyi mkhas pa tshos zhib dpyad gnang ba'i mjug bsdoms dang / tshod nga /shad/ dogs gnas su 'jog pa bcas gsung tshul 'dra min sna tshogs yod pa rnams rang nyid kyi 332

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa da —dpyad gzhir bya dgos shing / dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rnams kyi nang don rgyus mnga' yod pa zhig byed dgos na thog mar de tsho'i ming dang / rtsom pa po/ de la le tshan mang nyung ci tsam yod pa/ shog grangs dang pod grangs ji tsam yod pa bcas ni ma mthar sems la nges dgos pa'i don tshan yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni dper na dngos po gal che ba zhig rang la dgos na thog mar dngos po de'i ming dang khyad chos nus pa bcas shes dgos/ de ma shes na dngos po de rang la yong thabs med la/ dngos po de rang gzhan su la yod pa zhig yin kyang bed spyod byed stangs shes thabs gtan nas med pa dang 'dra/ tshan rig mkhan rnams kyis thog mar ched las de yi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha khag gi dkar chag la zhib 'jug byed pa nas 'go 'dzugs dgos pa dang / rang nyid la cung zad cha tshang ba'i dkar chag yig thog tu 'khod pa zhig yod dgos pa dang / de nas gom gang mdun spos kyis dkar chag gi nang don sems la nges gang thub byed dgos pa gnad chen po yod/ dkar chag zhib 'jug byed pa ni dkar chag blo la nges pa'i thabs shes ha cang yag po zhig yin pa dang /des dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs mang po lta bar phra mthong che shel lta bu'i nus pa 'don thub pa/ rin thang che ba'i dus tshod mang po gron chung byed thub pa/ gnad don gcig brgyud nas 'brel yod gnad don mang por bsam gzhigs byed rgyur sne 'khrid thub pa bcas phan thogs po yod/dkar chag zhib 'jug byed pa'i las ka'i nang nas thabs shes legs thos ni dkar chag bkod pa'i las don dngos dang zung 'brel byed pa de yin 333

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/cing / de 'dra'i go skabs ni dpe mdzod khang la las ka byas na ma gtogs yong dka' bas dkar chag lta klog byed pa dang chabs cigade'i nang du 'khod pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rnams go rim yod pa dang /'char gzhi yod pa'i sgo nas lta klog byed pa/ gal che'i gnad don rnams bshu ba bcas kyi sbyong brdar byas na dpe deb de'i ming go ba tsam gyis de'i nang don sems la lhang lhang 'char thub pa zhig yong gi red/4 dkar chag ni dpe mdzod khang gi sgo brgya myur du 'byed pa'i lde mig lta bu yin te/ dkar chag med na dpe mdzod khang gzhi rgya ji tsam che ba dang / dpe deb rnam grangs ha cang mang ba/ nang don ci tsam phun sum tshogs po yod kyang sgrig stangs la go rim med pa/ sde tshan phan tshun 'dres pas rnyog 'dzing che ba/ grangs ka med pas cha tshang min mi shes pa/bor brlag dang rku 'khyer byung yang rtsad gcod bya thabs bral ba/ bdag gnyer byed mkhan dang lta klog byed mkhan tshang mas dus thog tu btsal rnyed dka' ba bcas kyi skyon cha mang po yod cing / dkar chag yod na de las ldog pa'i dge mtshan mang po yod pa red/ deng skabs 'dzam gling thog tshan rig dang rig gnas kyi 'phel rgyas ni bya 'phur ba lta bu'i mgyogs tshad kyi sgo nas mdun du skyod bzhin yod pa dang / rgyal khab phyi nang gi tshan rig zhib 'jug sde khag dang / slob grwa khag sogs tshang mas rang rang so so'i ched las zhib 'jug/ dang / 'brel yod dpyad gzhi'i yig cha'i dpe mdzod khang /'dzugs gnyer byas/thog sngar yod dpyad gzhi'i yig cha khag legs sgrig byas te dkar chag bzos zin pa yang mi 334

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ ge—— nyung ba zhig yod la/ 'ga' zhig gis las ka de 'argo tshugs zin pa/'ga' zhig ni da lta gra sgrig byed mus kyi skabs red/ de'i nang nas tshan rig lag rtsal gyi chu tshad mtho ba'i 'jar pan dang dbyin ji sogs/ kyis deng rabs can gyi dpe mdzod khang btsugs te bdag gnyer lam lugs dang / dkar chag lta ba/ dbya da gzhi 'tshol ba/ par glog rgyag pa sos/sa kyi las 7 mang po zhig ten tsi rtsis rgyag 'phrul 'khor dang rang 'gul can du 'gyur ba'i thabs shes mang po gsar gtod byas yod pa red/ rang re'i bod ljongs la cha mtshon na yang gsham du dkar chag bzo ba'i lo rgyus kyi skabs su 'byung ba ltar/ spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug btsan po khri lde srong btsan gyi skabs su dkar chag bzo ba'i las don 'go tshugs pa nas da bar lo grangs chig stong brgya dang brgyad cu gya bzhi song la/ de'i ring la gal che'i nyams myong phun sum tshogs tsam bsags yod pas nyams myong bzang po de dag rmang gzhir byas te tshan rig gi rang bzhin dang / shes rig gi rang bzhin/ phyogs bsdus kyi rang bzhin/ cha tshang ba'i rang bzhin bcas ldan pa'i dkar chag bzo rgyu'i thad la cha rkyen bzang po yod pa zhig yin/gong du gsal ba ltar dpe mdzod khang gi 'dzugs skrun dang /bdag gnyer/ zhib 'jug bya thabs sogs la mkho ba'i cha rkyen dka' ngal che ba rnams deng rabs kyi 'phrul chas can dang rang 'gul can du 'gyur yod na yang da dung rnyog 'dzing che ba'i las ka mang po zhig mis da ngos su byed dgos pas mi'i cha rkyen ni ang dang po dang / da7ra chas 335

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang deng rabs can gyi sgrig chas sogs phyi rol yul gyi cha rkyen ni ang gnyis pa yin te/ phyi rol gyi cha rkyen bzang po de dag mis bed spyod byed dgos pa dang / bsam blo'i 'gul bskyod la brten dgos pa'i las ka ha cang mang po zhig mis dngos su byed dgos pa/ deng rabs can gyi sgrig chas la nus rtsal ci tsam che ba dang / myur khyad ci tsam yod na yang de tsho'i nus pa legs po 'don thub min ni mi la rag las pa red/ der brten zhib 'jug las khungs dang dpe mdzod khang gang yin kyang de'i nang du dpyad gzhi'i yig char zhib phra'i rgyus mnga' yod pa'i rkang 'dzin mi sna med na dpe deb ji tsam mang po yod kyang 'grem ston khang gi dngos rigs lta bu zhig las de tsho'i nus pa 'don spel byed mi thub pas ched las kyi slob khrid dang las don dngos kyi nang sbyong brdar byed pa zung 'brel gyis rkang 'dzin mi sna gso skyong legs po byed dgos pa dang / de'i thad da lta cha rkyen bzang po yod pas go skabs ma shor bar dam 'dzin byed dgos pa yin/5 dkar chag ni dpe mdzod khang gi dpe cha bdag gnyer dang srung skyob byed rgyur mkho ba'i nus ldan mtshon cha zhig yin/zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / rig gnas slob grwa khag dpe mdzod khang bcas la dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs rnam grangs mang zhing / rgya khyon che ba yin pas dkar chag med na lta klog byed mkhan tshor g.yar thabs med la/ gal te g.yar na bor brlag byung tshe rtsad gcod thabs bral ba dang / lta klog byed mkhan dang bdag gnyer byed mkhan tshang 336

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ ————mas yig rigs de 'dra yod med dang cha tshang min bcas mi shes la/yod kyang 'tshol zhib dka' ba/ dpe mdzod khang de sgrig stangs mi legs pa dang / bdag gnyer lam lugs nan po bzo mi thub pa/ 'brel yod tshan pa khag la dpyad gzhi mkho 'don mi thub pa/ de la brtsen nas rgyal khab dang tshan pa khag gi mi shugs dang / dngos shugs/ las ka'i dus tshod bcas mang po chud zos su 'gro ba sogs te gyong gun bsam yul las 'das pa 'byung rgyu red/ dkar chag ni dpyad gzhi'i yig cha bdag gnyer byed mkhan gyis ngos nas bshad na slob sbyong gi slob deb dang / bed spyod lag cha zhig yin pas las ka dngos kyi nang slob spyong dang / dngos su bed spyod pa dang chabs cig bdag gnyer gyi las don 'thus tshang du gtong ba dang gong du spel dgos pas dpe mdzod khang bdag gnyer byed mkhan tshos rgyun du dkar chag lta klog byas te 'brel yod tshan pa khag gis rang rang so sor mkho ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs 'tshol bar yong skabs dkar chag la lta mi dgos par yongs rdzogs bshad rgyu yod pa'am/ mang che ba bshad rgyu yod pa byed dgos/ gal te de 'dra thub mkhan gyi bdag gnyer mkhas pa med na/ dpe mdzod khang gi dkar chag de 'brel gtugs byed mekhan dang / ched las mi sna rnams la lta klog byed du 'jug dgos/ de ni dngos zog sna mang tshong khang du yod pa'i dngos rigs rnams rgyang bsgrags brnyan 'phrin thog nas dril bsgrags byed pa dang 'dra ba'i nus pa thon thub/ deng skabs pe cin mi rigs rig gnas pho brang gi dpe mdzod khang dang / bod ljongs spyi 3pa 37

dudā dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshogs tshan rig khang / mtsho sngon sku 'bum dgon pa/ kan su'u bla brang bkra shis 'khyil/ zi khron rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul/ si khron sde dge dpar khang chen mo bcas kyis rang khongs dpe mdzod khang du yod rma 'i dpe cha'i dkar chag dpar 'debs byas nas 'brel yod tshan pa khag la dpyad gzhir 'bul gyi yod pa de ni bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas srung skyob dang spel rgyu'i thad la rgyab skyor po dang / mig dpe bzang po zhig 'jog gnang mdzad pa red/gnyis pa/ bod du dkar chag ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus/de yang sngon spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug tsam la bod kyi btsan po khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon gyis srid dbang bzung skabs lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs ra khri ta dang / chos kyi snying po/de ban+de(lha'i dbang po)dpal gyi lhun po bcas la bka' gnang nas 'phang thang ka med kyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams la tsheg bar brgyad re la sho lo ka re/ sho lo ka sum brgya la bam po re re'i tshad du byas te grangs des rtsis gzhi byas pa'i them byang (dkar chag)ma nor bar chos tshan 'di dang 'di yod ces bkod pa de la 〈 dkar chag 'phang thang ma 〉zhes zer zhing / de ni bod du bsgyur ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag bkod pa'i thog ma yin no/ /de'i rjes su slar yang lo tsā ba 338

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ — da —dpal brtsegs dang / 'khon klu'i dbang po srung sogs kyis pho brang stong thang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i bka' dang / bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ba zhus chen/ (mtha' ma'i gtan 'beb kyi zhu dag)mdzad zin pa gang yod kyi mtshan byang dkar chag tu btab pa la 〈 dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉zhes grags shing / bstan 'gyur phal che ba'i mjug tu bod kyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsdus gras su yod/de'i rjes su slar yang lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs sogs kyis pho brang mchims phur bzhugs pa'i bka' bstan ci yod kyi dkar chag mdzad pa la 〈 dkar chag mchims phu ma 〉zhes zer/ de rjes bod kyi rab byung lnga ba'i chu byi spyi lo 1312lo nas yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ci tsung a yur par pa ta bu yan thus lo dgu'i ring srid dbang bzung skabs snar thang gi dge bshes mkhas pa 'jam dgag pakhri bla mar gdan drangs/ khong gis rang nyid kyi bla ma bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri la rgya nag gi snag tsha sgam gang dang / shog bu/ sgyu gu/ smyug bri sogs mang du bskur ba la brten nas bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri dang / dbus pa blo gsal byang chub ye shes/lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum rnams kyis skabs der dbus gtsang mnga' ris bcas su bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur kyi ma dpe rnyed tshad phyogs bsdus dang zhus dag gnang nas go rim bsgrigs te bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gris 〈 bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag bstan rgyas pa 〉zhes bya ba zhig dang /de las bsdus pa 〈 bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer 〉zhes pa 339

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhig kyang mdzad/ khong dang 'jam dgag pak+shi gnyis ka'i slob ma dbus pa blo gsal byang chub ye shes kyis kyang bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gnyis ka'i dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad/ slar yang sog yul nas 'jam dgag pak+shis snag tsha dang shog bu sogs kyi cha rkyen gang dgos bskur nas dkar chag bkod pa ltar gyi bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur cha tshang zhig bzhengs te snar thang gtsug lag khang du bzhugs dgos pa'i re 'dun zhus pa ltar/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur cha tshang zhig bzhengs te zhus dag gnang ba'i ma dpe dang chabs cig de sngon snar thang gtsug lag khang du yod/ ('di skor gyi dogs gcod gsham du yod) de rjes kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che dgung lo sum cu so gsum du phebs pa bod kyi rab byung lnga ba'i chu khyi lo spyi lo1322lor 〈 chos 'byung gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod 〉brtsams pa'i mjug tu bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag zhib phra 'god par mdzad/de rjes rab byung lnga ba'i chu phag spyi lo 1323lo nas rab byung drug pa'i sa byi bar tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes srid dbang bzung zhing / de'i ring la gser dngul 'dres ma'i bka' 'gyur cha tshang zhig bzhengs skabs kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che zhus dag tu gdan drangs pa de'i dkar chag ni tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje rang nyid kyis brtsams pa yin la/ dkar chag de'i kha byang du 〈 rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag deb ther dkar po 〉 zhes 'khod yod/ bka' 'gyur 'di la pod grangs nyis brgya drug cu yod ces lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu gsal zhing / 340

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ — da wa— —yongs grags su tshal pa bka' 'gyur zhes zer/de rjes rab byung bdun pa'i lcags stag spyi lo 1410lo tā ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yung los khri lo brgyad par nang blon nyug rum pa ho shin (rgya skad du tha'i kyen ho shin zer)sogs kyis bod nas gdan drangs pa'i bka' bstan ('di la rgya yig gi lo rgyus su/ bka' bstan 'di snar thang nas gdan drangs zhes 'khod pa ltar na gong du gsal ba'i snar thang du phyogs sgrig byas rjes kyi bka' bstan gnyis ka skabs de dus nas nan cin du gdan drangs zin pa lta bu zhig 'dug de ltar yin tshe de'i rjes su rgyal rtse chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pas bka' bstan gnyis ka gsar du bzhengs skabs ma dpe byas pa'i snar thang bka' bstan gnyis po de snar thang gi bka' bstan gang zhig gzhir byas pa'i skor slar yang dpyad dgos)khungs btsan la gzhi byas te bka' 'gyur cha tshang zhig par du bskrun pa de ni bod yig gi bka' 'gyur par skrun gyi thog ma yin cing / de'i zhor la bstan bcos drug gi par yang bzhengs yod skad la bstan bcos drug po gang dang gang yin rjes su rtsad gcod dgos/bod yig gi lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu nan cin gyi bod yig bka' 'gyur par ma 'di zangs par yin zhes bshad pa 'dug kyang de ni yin tshod mi snang /bka' 'gyur par ma 'di'i par phud dang po de ri bo rtse lngar bskyal ba dang /de nas bod du mtshur phu karma pa dang / rje tsong kha pa bcas la 'tshams rten du phul ba de nas bod kyi mkhas pa mang po thugs mnyes shing gzigs rgya che ru song ste dpe cha mang po shing par du bskrun pa'i sgo 'byed thub pa dang / shing par brko ba'i lag rtsal ha cang yar rgyas chen po byung / 'on kyang bka' bstan gnyis ha cang mang ba'i stabs kyis par du brko thub pa 34skyi

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ma byung /de rjes rab byung bdun pa'i lcags phag spyi lo 1431lor rgyal rtse sde srid rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pas snar thang gi bka' 'gyur la ma dpe byas te bka' 'gyur gser bris cha tshang zhig bzhengs pa de la 〈 rgyal rtse them spang ma 〉zer/ de'i dkar chag ni lo chen thugs rje dpal k+ṣas mdzad pa yin par tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sogs mkhas pa mang po zhig gis gsungs shing / sku phreng lnga pas dkar chag 'di dngos su gzigs myong ba yin pas gsung tshul 'di khungs btsan par snang / mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis bka' 'gyur 〈 rgyal rtse them spang ma'i 〉dkar chag ni bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa yin zhes gsungs 'dug kyang / bu ston rin po che ni rab byung drug pa'i shing 'brug spyi lo 1364lor dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das nas rgyal rtse'i bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i lo 1431bar lo ngo bdun cu don drug song zin pas dus mi mtshungs pa red/ bka' 'gyur 'di la pod grangs 111yod/de rjes rab byung bcu pa'i shing rta spyi lo 1594lo/ ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma tā ming dban lis khri lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis par/ pe cin du bka' 'gyur cha tshang dang / bstan 'gyur po ti bzhi bcu zhe gnyis tsam zhig par bskrun byas pa de la pe cin par ma zer zhing / zhus dag ni karma zhwa dmar sku phreng drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa yin/ 'on kyang de'i ma dpe gang la gzhi byas pa dang / dkar chag sus brtsams kyi skor bod yig gi lo rgyus su mi gsal bas rjes su zhib rtsad bya dgos/342

ste bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/bod sa gnas su bka' 'gyur par du bskrun pa'i thog ma ni rab byung bcu ba'i sa bya spyi lo 1609lor zhwa dmar sku phreng drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug tsa ri mtsho dkar du bzhugs skabs 'jang rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan la bka' 'gyur cha tshang par du bskrun dgos pa'i skul ma gnang ba bzhin khas len zhus te bod nas ma dpe khungs dag zhig gsol ras gnang dgos zhus pa ltar de sngon sde srid phag mo gru pa'i dbang grags pa 'byung gnas kyi skabs 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang / karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ zhwa dmar spyan snga chos kyi grags pa sogs kyis zhus dag thengs mang gnang nas bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur zhig 'phyong rgyas phying dbar stag rtser bzhugs pa de gsol ras gnang ba de la ma phyi byas te bka' 'gyur cha tshang par du bskrun pa de yin cing / (par mgo tshugs nas grub pa'i bar lo bco lnga 'gor 'dug)bka' 'gyur 'di'i dkar chag sus mdzad kyi skor zhib 'jug byed skabs 'jar man nub mar tshogs pa'i bod kyi shes rig skor gyi gros tshogs der kho bo dngos su zhugs pa'i go skabs byung thog rgya gar dha ram sa la'i dpe mdzod khang gi 'gan 'khur ba bkra shis tshe ring lags nas rtsom sgrig byas pa'i bka' bstan bris par gyi lo rgyus zhig mthong ba de'i nang 'khod don/ khong rang nyid kyis bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi skor brtag dpyad byed ched ka rdor sgang gsum (ka lon spug rdo rje gling / sgang tog gsum)gyi khul du bskyod skabs 1976lor 'bras ljongs mi rje 'ba' nyag a thing gi sku sger dpe mdzod khang du yod pa'i dpe cha dbu med bris rnying spus legs dpe thung shog grangs 50yod pa zhig gi mtshan byang du 343

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/〈 'jang sa tham rgyal khab tu bzhengs shing li thang dgon chen du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i dkar chag bzhugs so 〉 zhes 'khod yod pa dang / dkar chag 'di zhwa dmar sku phreng drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis 1614lor mdzad pa yin zhes gsal/ bka' 'gyur 'di la pod grangs 108yod/ de sngon lha sa gtsug lag khang gi rtse thog lho ngos bka' 'gyur lha khang du bka' 'gyur li thang mtshal par po ti brgya dang brgyad la pod re re bzhin dar gos kyi dpe sgril dang / pod gnyis re la 'jug snod shing sgam re bcas yod pa 'di ni 'jang rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan gyis lha sa gtsug lag khang du phul ba'i par phud yin zhes bshad srol yod/ 'jang sa tham du bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur gyi par shing 'di la li thang mtshal par zhes 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gu shri han 'das rjes khong gi tsha bo mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong gis 'ba' li rgyal gsum khongs kyi spyi dpon byed skabs de snga'i sa gnas srid gzhung la ngo log gi dmag zing bslangs par brten tā la'i han gyis gtso bo byas pa'i bod sog dmag dpung btang ste cham la phab rjes 'jang gi bka' 'gyur par gzhi de bzhin li thang dgon par gdan drangs pa'i dbang gis yongs grags su li thang mtshal dpar zer/de rjes rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags glang spyi lo 1721lo co ne dpon dmag zor mgon pos spyin bdag byas te bka' 'gyur cha tshang par du bskrun pa de'i ma dpe ni nan cin par ma dang / li thang par ma/dbus bris kyi bka' 'gyur bcas gzhir bzung ba dang de'i zhus dag dang 344

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa—dkar chag ni co ne rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub kyis mdzad cing /dkar chag gi zhal byang ni rjes su ma dpe rnyed na 'bri dgos/ 'di yi pod grangs li thang par ma dang 'dra/ co ne'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gyi par shing yongs rdzogs 1929lor co ne'i nye 'dabs kyi hos rigs dang co ne rgyal 'bangs bar dmag 'khrug byung skabs hos rigs dmag dpung gis mer bsregs shing / go thos la a me ri ka'i mi jo seb rog gis 1925lor a me ri ka'i rgyal yongs dpe mdzod khang gi ched du co ne bka' bstan gnyis ka cha tshang par 'debs blu yon zhus te rgyal sa wa shing kron du bzhag yod skad/ bar lam lo shas gong la a me ri ka'i 'dzam gling chos lugs slob gnyer khang dang / dpe mdzod khang mang che bar khyab spel byung yod cing / co ne'i bka' bstan cha tshang gcig a rir gdan drangs pa'i skor la jo seb rog gis bris pa'i 〈 'dzam gling rgyas bshad 〉brnyan deb ang 54pa'i nang du 〈 co ne'i bla ma tsho'i thun mong gi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul 〉zhes pa der gsal yod skad/ 'jar pan gyi mkhas pa the'i shun mi bu zhu ba khong gis 'jar pan rdo yo sbung gor yod pa'i co ne'i bka' 'gyur la zhib 'jug byas thog 1959lor co ne/ pe cin/ sde dge/ snar thang par ma bcas bka' 'gyur phan tshun go bsdur gyis dkar chag dang / 〈 co ne par ma'i bka' 'gyur sde tshan gyi ngo sprod 〉ces pa'i deb chung zhig bris yod 'dug kyang bdag gis mthong ma byung /'jar pan du yod pa'i co ne'i bka' bstan tshar gcig po de ni paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng dgu ba chos kyi nyi ma mchog nas 'jar pan gyi mi rigs 345

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bod du phebs snga shos gras yin pa dge slong shes rab rgya mtsho'am e kha'i kha ba gu cir 1937lor gsol ras gnang ba yin la/ 1940lor rgyal sa tog khyo'i rdo yo spung go'i dpe mdzod khang du yod skad dang / bka' bstan cha tshang gcig ri bo rtse lnga'i dgon pa'i nang yod zer/ da dung phyi sog dang su'u len la yang cha tshang re gnyis yod skad/ de rjes rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya spyi lo 1729lo dang / de'i lo rjes ma gnyis la rim bzhin sde dge rgyal po bstan pa tshe ring dang / pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas gnyis kyis bal/'a 'gyur cha tshang par du bskrun pa'i nang nas sngon ma de la sde dge bka' 'gyur zer zhing / 1976— 1979lo bar karma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje mchog nas sde dge par ma'i bka' 'gyur cha tshang lnga brgya tham pa mtshal par thog par bskrun gnang nas/ phyi nang mi rigs dang ris med grub mtha' khag gi chos sgar dang dpe mdzod khang bcas la rin med par 'bul gnang mdzad 'dug de rjes 1980lor sde dge dpal yul rnam rgyal byang chub gling gi bu dgon mgo log dar thang dgon pa'i sprul sku kun dga' rin po ches thugs 'khur gnang ba'i 'og a me ri ka'i ca li h+phu nyi ya'i par khang nas sde dge par ma'i bka' bstan gnyis ka deng sang gi dpe deb gzugs su bsgyur thog pod grangs 120par bcos nas cha tshang brgya tham pa par bskrun gnang 'dug de'i ma dpe tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga bas mdo stod lho rdzong du bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur bris ma dang / li thang par ma yin la/ dkar chag ni si tu ri na po che chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa de'i zhal byang du 〈 bde bar gshegs pa'i 346

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ —da wa ——bka' gangs can gyi brdase drangs pa'i phyi mo'i tshogs ji rnyed pa dpar du bsgrubs pa'i tshul las nye bar brtsams pa'i gtam blo ldan mos pa'i kun+da yongs su kha phye ba'i zla 'od gzhon nu'i 'khri shing 〉zhes 'khod yod cing /pho lha bas par du bskrun pa'i bka' 'gyur par shing rnams paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang ye shes la phul nas snar thang dgon par bzhag pa'i dbang gis bka' 'gyur snar thang par ma zer/ de sngon tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos sne srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la dbus ljongs su bka' 'gyur par bskrun byed dgos pa'i bka' gnang bar brten yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gtso bor byas pa'i pod nyi shu rtsa brgyad tsam par bskrun gnang yang las rgyun lo bdun tsam 'gor zhing yun ring ma song bar tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mdzad 'phrin la bar chad byung thog khri las phabs pa dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yang rgyal po lha bzang dang ma mthun par lha bzang gi btsun mos bgrongs shing /par bskrun 'phro can du lus/ de rjes lha bzang dang / stag rtse zhabs drung lha rgyal rab brtan/ da'i ching bā dur bsod nams rgyal po sogs kyis rim par 'phro skyong byas kyang mtha' ma 'khyol bar lus par brten/ pho lha bsode nams stobs rgyas kyis gong 'phros yongs rdzogs kha bskang ste bka' 'gyur cha tshang par bskrun byed thub tsam byung / de'i ma dpe ni tshal pa bka' 'gyur yin la/ dkar chag ni 'ol kha sle lung rin po che blo bzang 'phrin las kyis mdzad pa yin/ de'i kha byang du 〈 rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi gsung par rin po che srid gsum rgyan gcig rdzu 'phrul shing rta'i 347

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dkar chag ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i lde mig 〉ces 'khod yod/ de rjes 1814lor mgo tshugs te smad rwa rgya'i dgon pa'i gdan sa pa shing bza' ho thog thu sku phreng dang po blo bzang dar rgyas kyis thugs khur dang sbyin bdag gnang nas sde dge mtshal par la ma dpe byas te bka' 'gyur cha tshang zhig par bskrun gnang nas rwa rgya'i par khang chen mor bzhugs pa la rwa rgya'i bka' 'gyur zer/ de'ibyokar chag ni paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad pa de'i zhal byang du 〈bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab gangs can gyi skad du 'gyur ro cog gi phyi mo par du bskrun pa'i dkar chag mdo rgyud chos kyi sgo brgya cig car 'byed pa'i lde mig 〉ces 'khod yod/ de nas phyi sog u sga'i chos sde chen po tā khu re 'am/ deng sang u lan pa thur gyi dgon pa dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling du sde dge par ma gzhir bzhag pa'i bka' 'gyur par bskrun gyi mgo brtsams kyang mjug ma rdzogs par lus pa la/ khal kha rje btsun dam pa sku phreng brgyad pa chos kyi nyi ma mchog dang / e rti ni che tshang no yon don grub lha mo rnam gnyis nas par gzhi cha tshang legs sgrub dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba ltar 1908lor mu mthud las 'phro btsugs nas pod brgya dang lnga cha tshang par bskrun byas te chos sde khu re chen mor bzhag pa la sog yul khu re bka' 'gyur zer/ de'i dkar chag sus mdzad kyi skor rjes su ma dpe rnyed na zhib 'jug byed dgos/ de rjes rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags bya spyi lo 1921lor 'bri gung sgo lcog rin po ches tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum par rgyu yon 'bor chen phul te re 'dun zhus pa ltar de snga'i bod sa 348

rngo rngasno kyi tshasdokazopa65tha/:rdogapa/ da waganas srid gzhung gis bka' 'gyur cha tshang zhig par du bskrun te po tā la'i zhol 'bras bu steng gi par khang du bzhugs pa la zhol par gsar zer/de'i ma dpe ni sngar gyi bka' 'gyur bris ma dang par ma khag yin/ dkar chag ni co ne dge bshes rin po che blo bzang rgya mtsho/ bde yangs mtshan zhabs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ mkhas dbang dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho/ pha bong kha rin po che sku phreng gong ma byams pa bltan 'dzin 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ mtshan zhabs rgyal dbang rin po che sogs kyis snga phyir mdzad pa yin la/ de'i kha byang du ṭ+wāṃ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi gsung par 'dzam gling spyi nor gyi dkar chag legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig 〉ces 'khod yod/de rjes yun ring ma song bar chab mdo yab tshang blo bzang dkon mchog dang / sde dge'i sras mo bde sgrol ma gnyis nas sbyin bdag zhus te chab mdor bka' 'gyur cha tshang par du bskrun cing / de'i ma dpe ni go thos la lha sa zhol par ma'i bka' 'gyur la dpar slog byas pa yin zer srol 'dug dkar chag sus mdzad pa yin min ma shes pas ma dpe rnyed na zhib 'jug bya dgos/bstan 'gyur dkar chag skor/ snar thang gi bka' 'gyur phyogs sgrig byas pa yan chad kyi lo rgyus gong dang 'dra zhing / de rjes rab byung drug pa'i shing khyi/ spyi lo 1334lor zhwa lu sku zhang kun dga' don grub kyis sbyin bdag byas te bstan 'gyur bris ma cha tshang zhig bzhengs skabs kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che zhu dag mdzad mkhan du gdan drangs thog 349

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sngar yod snar thang bstan 'gyur du ma tshad pa'i chos tshan stong phrag gcig gsar du bsnan pa dang bcas pa'i dkar chag kyang bu ston rin po che rang nyid kyis mdzad/ de'i zhal byang du 〈 bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng ba 〉zhes 'khod pa gsung 'bum zhol par ma'i pod (la) pa'i nang du yod/ de la zhwa lu'i bstan 'gyur zer zhing pod grangs 124yod/ de nas rab byung drug pa'i chu stag spyi lo 1362lor tā si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis sbyin bdag byas te gong du ma tshud pa'i chos tshan gsar rnyed nyi shu rtsa bdun bsnan pa dang bcas bstan 'gyur cha tshang zhig bzhengs pa la sne gdong bstan 'gyur zer/ de'i ma dpe ni zhwa lu'i bstan 'gyur yin pa dang / dkar chag ni bu ston rin po che'i dngos slob lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i kha byang du 〈 bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i za ma tog 〉ces 'khod pa thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal gyi gsung 'bum pod ( sa) pa'i nang du yod/ sne gdong gi bstan 'gyur 'di la pod grangs 202yod/de rjes rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me yos/ spyi lo 1687lo sde srid cisangs rgyas rgya mtshos tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas tshul lo bcu gnyis ring gsang ba byas te zhabs brtan la kha g.yar nas sngar yod bstan 'gyur khag gi nang ma tshud pa'i chos tshan bdun brgya brgyad cu gsar du bsnan pa dang bcas pa'i bstan 'gyur bris ma cha tshang zhig bzhengs/ de'i ma dpe ni zhwa lu// 'bras spungs/ se ra/ gtsug lag 350

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wakhang / 'phyongs rgyas bcas su yod pa'i bstan 'gyur la gzhir bzung ba yin cing / dkar chag ni sku phreng lnga ba sku ngo ma'i gsung rtsom yin khul gyis don du sde srid rang nyid kyis mdzad pa dang / zhal byang du 〈 bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag 'jig rten gsum gyi bde skyid pad tshal bzhad pa'i nyin byed 〉ces 'khod yod/ bstan 'gyur 'di rtse po tā lar bzhugs yod pa dang pod grangs 225yod/ deng sang 'jar pan du 'dra par brgyab pa'i bstan 'gyur cha tshang de yi ma dpe gcig 'di yin pa dkar chag du gsal/ de nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me sbrul/ spyi lo 1737lor sde dge rgyal po bstan pa tshe ring pha bu gnyis kyis sbyin bdag byas te bstan 'gyur par ma cha tshang zhig bzhengs pa de'i ma dpe ni/ bstan 'gyur sngon yod khag bdun tsam la zhib bsdur dang / gsar du chos tshan gang rnyed bsnan pa dang bcas pa'i dkar chag ni zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad/de'i zhal byang du 〈 kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bka' lung gi dgongs don rnam par 'grel ba'i bstan bcos gangs can pa'i skad du 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi chos sbyin rgyun mi chad pa'i ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi phyi mo rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i bsod nams gyi sprin phung rgyas par dkrigs pa'i tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam ngo mtshar chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba gsar pa 〉zhes 'khod cing / bstan 'gyur 'di la pod grathas 208yod/de rjes rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i.ā+oṃgs rmi/ sbyi lo 1741lor pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis bstan 'gyur cha tshang zhig par du bskrun pa 351

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de'i ma dpe gang yin dkar chag tu mi gsal zhing / tshod dpag byas na sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i bstan 'gyur bris ma dang /yang na rgyal rtse'i bstan 'gyur bris ma gnyis gang rigs gzhir bzung ba yin nam snyam/ bstan 'gyur 'di'i dkar chag ni phur bu lcog sku phreng dang po ngag dbang byams pas mdzad pa yin cing / zhal byang du 〈 bka' yi dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag don ldan tshangs pa'i dbyangs 〉zhes 'khod yod/de nas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu bya/ spyi lo 1753lo co ne dpon bstan srung tshe ring dang / khong gi ma rin chen dpal 'dzoms gnyis kyis sbyin bdag byas te bstan 'gyur cha tshang par du bskrun pa de la co ne bstan 'gyur zer zhing / de'i ma dpe ni sde dge bstan 'gyur yin la/dkar chag ni rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis pa dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang pos mdzad pa de'i zhal byang du 〈 bka' yi dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba 〉zhes 'khod pa gsung 'bum pod (ca) pa'i nang du yod/co ne'i bstan 'gyur de ni da phan bod yig thog bstan 'gyur par du bskrun pa'i mjug ma de yin la pod grangs ni sde dge'i bstan 'gyur dang 'dra/bla ma khag gi gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag skor/ de sngon tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga bas rtse po tā lar bzhugs pa'i phyag dpe yod tshad kyi dkar chag 'god par mdzad pa'i skor rnam thar du 'khod cing / de rjes sku phreng 352

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wabadun pa'i skabs kyang de gzhir bzung nas slar yang phyag dpe gsar du 'byor ba dang / 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang du bzhugs pa'i gzigs dpe ci yod la dkar chag bkod 'dug kyang dkar chag de sku ngo ma'i gzugs dper thugs nyar mdzad pa las dpe rgyun dar spel gnang mi 'dug 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang pos dbus phebs rjes ma'i skabs bkra shis lhun por yod pa'i paṇa chen rin po che'i gzigs dpe yod tshad kyi dkar chag dang / skabs der po tā lar bzhugs pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim pa'i phyag dpe yod tshad kyi dkar chag dang ma dpe bcas 'dra bshus gnang tshul rnam thar du 'khod 'dug kyang dkar chag 'dra bshus de yang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du deng sang yod tshod mi snang / de dang dus mtshungs lta bur klong brdol bla ma rin po ches 〈 bka' gdams pa dang dge lugs pa'i bla ma rags rim gyi gsung 'bum mtshan tho 〉zhes pa zhig brtsams gnang mdzad pa de kun bde gling du par du bskrun cing / 'di'i nang du bla ma bzhi bcu lhag tsam gyi gsung 'bum mtshan tho yod/de rjes rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i mgo spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i dkyil stod tsam du 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gsum pa'i drung yig rje shes rab rgya mtshos 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng rim pa'i gzigs dpe yod tshad dngos su mjal gnang ba'i go skabs bzang po thob pa phyi rabs kyi mi rnams la ngo sprod mdzad ched/ 〈dpe rgyun dkon pa 'ga' zhig gi tho yig don gnyer yid kyi kun+da bzhad pa'i zla 'od 'bum gyi snye ma 〉353

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhes pa'i dpe tho zhig ljags rtsom gnang ba de sde tshan nyi shur phye nas mjug tu grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma dgu bcu lhag tsam gyi gsung 'bum mtshan tho zhig bkod yod cing / dpe tho de bzhin gsung 'bum dang chabs cig bkra shis 'khyil dang / ‘lha sa zhol par khang gnyis su par du bskrun yod/de rjes bod dbus gtsang gnyis kyi par khang khag dang / dgon pa/ mi sger gyi khyim tshang bcas su dpar gang yod kyi par tho mdzad byang med pa zhig 'dug pa de'i kha byang du 〈 gangs can gyi ljongs su bka' dang bstan bcos sogs kyi glegs bam par gzhi ji ltar yod pa rnams nas dkar chag par thor phyogs tsam du bkod pa phan bde'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i nyin byed 〉ces 'khod yod/rgyal yongs bcings 'grol thob rjes 1959lor mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil dgon chen du bzhugs pa'i spyi sger gyi dpe cha pod khri phrag mang po spyi'i dpe mdzod khang chen por bsdus te/ de'i dkar chag rgyas pa deb chen khru gang ma shog grangs chig stong ma zin tsam yod pa zhig gi nang rtsa ba'i sde tshan cho ba bcu bdun du phye nas rtsom pa po dang / le tshan shog grangs/ tshar grangs bcas zhib phra 'khod pa zhig snum par du bskrun pa de ni da phan dkar chag bkod pa rnams kyi nang nas rgyas shos shig yin/'on kyang de'i nang da dung bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur/ grub mtha' gardonan dag gi mkhas pa mang po zhig gi gsung 'bum dkar chag 'khod med/ de sngon sde dge par khang chen mor bzhugs pa'i par ma ci yod kyi par tho rgyas pa bris ma deb chen zhig par khang gi dpar dpon gyis 354

bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/nyar tshags byas pa go thos tsam las dngos su par bskrun 'grem spel byas med kyang / 1981lor ṭ+wāṃ sde dge par khang rig gnas kun 'dus gzhal med khang chos mdzod po bkra shis sgo mang gi dkar chag rdo rje'i chos bdun ldan pa'i lde mig 〉ces kha byang du 'khod pa'i deb 'bring zhig si khron mi rigs dpe skrung khang gis par du bskrun 'dug cing / de yang yongs su cha tshang ba zhig min nam snyam/ de rjes spyi lo 1983lo nas bzung pe cin mi rigs rig gnas pho brang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i bod yig gi dpe cha yod tshad phyogs bsgrigs dang dkar chag sgrig mgo tshugs te thog ma'i ma yig deb dang po snum par du btab pa zhig phran la gnang byung ba de'i kha byang du 〈 bod gangs can gyi grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas dbang brgya dang brgyad cu lhag gi gsung 'bum so so'i dkar chagabhe phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa shes bya'i gter mdzod 〉ces 'khod 'dug pa de ni dkar chag sgrig tshul legs shing / rtsom yig gi kha byang cha tshang bkod pa/ rtsom pa po'i mtshan gyi ming yig dang po'i go rim dang bstun nas katho bsgrigs pas 'tshol bde ba/ zhar la rtsom pa po so so'i lo rgyus gnad bsdus bkod pa bcas khyad chos chen po 'dug pas dpe rgyun don gnyer can dang rgya che'i gzigs pa po tshor rig gnas bang mdzod kyi sgo mo 'byed pa'i lde mig lta bur yod/zhar byung bla ma rnams kyi gsan yig skor/ da bar blo mthun mang po zhig gis/ gsan yig nang dpe tho bkod yod pa de ma shes par dkar chag dang dpe tho zhes pa'i ming yod pa rnams la do snang byed kyi yod pa 355

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/las grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma tsho'i gsan yig la do snang gtan nas byed kyi med pa red/ gsanayig ni dkar chag gi go chod pa'i dpe tho zhig yin/ gang yin zer na grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma tsho'i gsan yig tu bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur gsung 'bum sogs dkar chag tu 'khod pa dang ma 'khod pa phal che ba'i dpe tho kha gsal bkod thog de la lung rgyun yod med dang khrid rgyun yod med/ par ma dang bris ma gang yin/ ma dpe gang du yod med bcas zhib phra bkod yod cing / dkar chag khag gi nang du ma gsal ba'i dpe rgyun dkon pa mang po zhig gi tho bkod yod la dkar chag gi tshab byed thub pa yin/ der brten sa/san yig de tshor chos lugs rmongs dad kyi dpe cha red zer nas snang chung dang gtor brlag btang na rjes su dpe mdzod khang gi dkar chag 'god skabs dpe rgyun dkon pa mang po zhig gi gzhi 'dzin sa'i dpe tho khungs btsan med pas dkar chag zhib phra 'god thabs bral ba red/dpar du 'khod zin pa'i gsan yig gal che'i gras/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga ba'i gsung 'bum (ka)nas (nga)bar 〈gsan yig gaṅga'i chu rgyun 〉pod bzhi yod/ khong gi dngos slob dza ya partsi ta blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung 'bum (ga)nas (cha)bar 〈gsan yig gsal ba'i me long 〉pod bzhi/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa'i gsung 'bum (nya)par 〈 gsan yig 〉pod gcig chu bzang yongs 'dzin ye shes rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum (kha)par 〈 thob yig dga' ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan 〉pod gcig rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dkon mchog 356

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa—'jigs med da bang po'i gsung 'bum (dkye(naste gnyis la 〈 thob yig thub bstan mdzes rgyan gsung rab rin po che'i 'byung gnas ma dros klung chen 〉pod gnyis/ a khu rin po che shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum ( ja) pa'i nang 〈 thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig mdo sngags zab rgyas chos kyi rgya mtsho las skra rtses blangs pa'i chu thigs 〉pod gcig dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum ( ta)pa'i nang 〈 dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul ji ltar mnos pa'i thob yig lung chos bdud rtsi'i ro.oṃ mtsho 〉pod gcig gser tog no min han blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mjo'i gsung rtsom (nyakye( ta) gnyis kyi nang 〈 gsan yig bdud rtsi'i klung rgyun 〉pod gnyis/ sku 'bum che shos rim/ po che blo bzang byang chub bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum (nga)(ca) gnyis la 〈 zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu las rang gi bgo skaX du mnos pa'i dbang khrid lung gsum gyi thob yig nor bu be+e ḍūr+ya'i phreng mdzes dpyod ldan mgrin pa'i do shal 〉pod gnyis/ pha bong kha rin po che byams pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum ( kaste (kha)gnyis la 〈 gsan yig bsam 'phel nor bu'i do shal 〉pod gnyis sogs ni gong du bshad pa lta bu'i khyad chos ldan pa sha stag yin cing / da dung gsan yig ha cang rgyas po yod kyang bris ma tsam las dpar skrun gtan nas ma byas pa yang mi nyung ba zhig yod/ bla ma khag gcig gi gsan yig rnams gsung 'bum gras su bzhugs shing / khag gcig gsung 357

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsungartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ da 'bum gras su bzhag med pas dpe rgyun tshodakon po yin/ dkar chag khag gi nang ma 'khod pa'i gsung rtsom khag gi rtsom pa po dang / kha byang / shos/ grangs/ cha tshang yin min bcas la zhib 'jug byed dgos tshe gsan yig khag la ma bltas na dkar chag gsal por 'god grub thabs med/gsum pa/ gna' rabs kyi dkar chag rig pa/gna' rabs bod kyi dkar chag rig pa ni go rim yod pa dang/ ma lag cha tshang ba/ lta klog dang 'tshol bde ba bcas kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i dkar chag sgrig stangs shig la zer/ de la thog mar sde tshan bgo tshul shes dgos pa dang / de rjes de'i go rim sgrig stangs skor shes dgos/ de gnyis ni dkar chag 'god tshul gyi rtsa ba'i shes yon zhig yin pa dang /dkar chag rig pa'i rmang gzhi yang de nas byung ba red/ de yang sde tshan ni gsung rab dang rtsom yig de dang de'i brjod bya'i nang don gtso bo gang yin pa de gzhir byas te tshan pa mi 'dra ba so sor dbye ba zhig yin cing de yod na rang nyid kyis lta klog dang dpyad gzhi gang 'tshol dgos kyang thog mar sde tshan gang gi khongs nas yin pa shes na rnyed sla bas sde tshan dbye tshul de thog mar bshad pa yin/ de yang dpyad gzhi 'tshol bde ba'i ched du sde tshan dbye ba ni rig gnas che ba lnga dang / chung ba lnga bcas rang rang so sor rtsa ba dang yan lag gi sde tshan mi 'dra bar phye ba de yin cing /rtsom pa po rnams kyi rtsom yig mi 'thor ba'i ched du sde tshan dbye ba ni/ gsung 'bum gyi sde tshan khag rnams yin pas de gnyis ka la nus pa mi 'dra 358

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa——ba re yod/ sde tshan dbye stangs dang / de'i go rim sgrig stangs skor la bu ston rin po che sogs bod kyi sngon byon mkhas pa'i dbang bo rnams kyis bka' bstan gnyis kyi dkar chag sgrig skabs thog mar nang pa sangs/ rgyas pa'i gsung rab spyi la mdzad pa po'i sgo nas bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su phye ba ni spyi'i sde tshan chen po gnyis yin cing / de nas re re la brjod bya'i nang don gyi sgo nas mdo phyogs dang sngags phyogs gnyis su phye ba dang /mdo phyogs la nang gses kyis phye na/ 'dul ba/ mdo sde/ mngon pa gsum/ sngags phyogs la rgyud sde bzhi ste/ bla med rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/spyod rgyud/ bya rgyud/ rgyud sdo spyi'i don dang 'brel ba bcas rtsa ba'i sde tshan chen po brgyad du phye ba ni bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis ka'i thun mong gi sde tshan dbye tshul yin cing / bstan 'gyur dang / bod gzhung bstan bcos la gong gsal rtsa ba'i sde tshan brgyad kyi steng du rig gnas che ba lnga'i nang gi nang rig pa phud pa'i gzhan bzhi ste/ sgra/ tshad ma/ bzo rig pa/gso ba rig pa bcas dang / rig gnas chung ba lnga ste/ snyan ngag mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar/ skar rtsis bcas dang / bod kyi mkhas pa tsho'i gsung 'bum dang / gsung rtsom kha 'thor gyi rigs bcas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs la rtsa ba'i sde tshan chen po bcu dgur dbye ba dang / de nas de'i nang gses tshan pa so sor sde tshan mang nyung sna tshogs su dbye bar mdzad/ a khu rin po che shes rab rgya mtshos bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur phud pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa tsho'i 359

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsung rtsom la rtsa ba'i sde tshan dang yan lag gi sde tshan sogs dbye mi dgos par lo rgyus dang rnam thar skor gyi sde tshan dang por bzhag nang rig pa'i nang nas lam rim dang blo sbyong / grub mtha'/ gsang sngags kyi nang nas sgrub dkyil/ sgra rig pa'i nang nas bod brda bcas zur du phye zhing / snyan ngag sogs rig gnas chung ba lnga ka bsdoms pa'i sde tshan gcig gsung 'bum gyi sde tshan bcas bsdoms pa'i sde tshan che ba nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsdus gnang mdzad yod/ mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dpe cha sbyi'i dkar chag deb gyi nang du/ thog mar rig gnas che ba lnga'i nang gi gso rig nas 'go brtsams ste rig gnas chung ba lnga dang / de nas sum rtags dag gsum zur du sde tshan gcig de rjes lo rgyus skor/ de nas gsung 'bum dang / gzhung chen po lnga/ lam rim blo sbyong / gsang sngags skor/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor te sde tshan che ba bcu bdun du phye ba bcas sde tshan dbye tshul mi 'dra ba'i skor gsham gsal gyi re'u mig la gzigs/ 360
༵ ༵/nga dgon pa'idape cha spyi'i daskerno/ chag gi 'god
—wakadā~Xṅgesgro—stadā~Xṅgesa~Xcosabyargyu'idapematshonadapyadabazhi—/ ——

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa —7 mngon brjod/ rtsa ba dang 'grel ba/ kha 'thor/ ci8 sdeb sbyor/ rtsa ba dang 'grel ba/ dper brjod/9 zlos gar/ 'khrab gasnging / rol mo'i bstan bcos/4 tātrīd+ngha kāṭā rnyi rtsis skor/ kha 'thor sna 10 skar rtsas/ tshogs/ dpe ris/11 lo rgyus skor/ /sdo / trī~X/sa/ rnam thar/ i 'byung / /gdung rabs/ gnas yig lam yig12 dokar chag khyi'i dkar chag dpar khang dkar chag / /ci dpem/rdod dkar chug dzo13 mar+sā nyid rig pa/ ṭāṭ+wāṃ ༵༵la/ / phar phyin/ dbu ma/ ma—da/14 grub mtha'/15 lam rim blo sbyong / lam rim/ blo sbyong / ltakhrid/16 gsang sngags gsar ma/ ṭ+wāṃtā ṭ+wāṃṭī/la/ sa dkyil/ khrid yig17 gsang sngags rnying ma/ mai~X ṣ+ṭṛṭīl/ / sgrub dkyil/ khrid yig /18 gsung 'bum/ grub mtha' so sor phye ba dang ma phye ba/ ///363

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/19 kha 'thor sna tshogs/ cha ma tshang ba sna tshogs phyogs bsdus/gong gsal sde tshan de tshor go rim sgrig stangs rnams la rang rang so /sor rgyu mtshan mi 'dra ba re yod/ dper na bka' 'gyur gyi skabs sangs rgyas kyis thog mar chos gsungs pa'i go rim ni 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor dang / 'khor lo bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ 'khor lo gsum pa legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor/ de nas snod ldan gyi slob ma nyung shas la gsang sngags kyi chos gsung pa yin cing / go rim de ni chos gsung yul gyi gdul bya'i dbang bo'i rim pa gzhir bzung ba yin pas go rim de dang mthun pa yin la/ bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag sgrig skabs go rim de dang mi 'dra bar sde snod gsum gyi brjod bya mchog dman gyi rim pa dang bstun nas thog mar bstod tshogs dang / de nas gsang sngags skor rgyud sde bzhi/ phar phyin/ dbu ma/mdo sde/ sems tsam mngon pa/ 'dul ba/ skyes rabs/ springs yig tshad ma/ sgra rig pa/ mngon brjod/ snyan ngag gso ba rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lugs kyi bstan bcos/ bod rtsom sna tshogs/ smon lam skor bcas su bsgrigs pa de ni/ thog mar sangs rgyas byang sems la gus 'dud dang phyag 'tshal bstod bsngags byed pa sngon du btang nas/ gsung rab rnams kyi nang don mchog dman gyi go rim ltar gsang sngags/ de rjes de'i sngon 'gro phar phyin/ de rjes ma dosngags gnyis ka'i thun mong gi lam ston pa 'khor lo bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor ste dbu ma/ 364

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa—gsung rab kyi drang don dang nges don gsal bor phye ba 'khor lo gsum pa'i skor gyi mdo sde/ de nas gdul bya dbang bo 'bring gi don du gsungs pa'i byams chos phyi ma bzhi ste 〈mdo sde rgyan〉〈 chos nyid rnam 'byed〉〈 rgyud bla ma〉〈dbus mtha'artsornam 'byed 〉bcas dang / de rnams so so'i 'grel ba/ de rnams dang 'brel ba yod pa'i bstan bcos skor/ de nas gdul bya dbang bo dman pa rnams kyi don du gsungs pa'i 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi khongs su gtogs pa mngon pa 'og ma mdzod dang / 'dul ba / de'i yan lag tu gtogs pa skyes rabs dang /bslab bya 'phrin yig bcas de yan chad rang rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs kyi skor yin/ de nas gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs la thog mar rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la blo sgo 'byed pa'i tshad ma/ de nas brda sgrod pa'i rnam gzhag ston pa sgra rig pa/ de'i yan lag mngon brjod/ tshig sbyor mdzes par byed pa snyan ngag debyunas gzhan gyi lus thog gi nad skyob pa gso ba rig pa/ phan byed kyi cha shas sna tshogs su gtogs pa bzo rig pa/ 'jig rten gyi yul chos dang bstun pa'i srid kyi skyong thabs ston pa lugs kyi bstan bcos/ de nas gna' rabs bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig de dag tshang ma'i mjug tu bsngo ba dang smon lam bcas kyi go rim de ltar bsgrigs pa yin pas go rim de la yang rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa chen po yod/ 'o na bka' 'gyur gyi nang du rig gnas che ba gzhan bzhi dang / rig gnas chung ba lnga ka med pa dang / bstan 'gyur gyi nang du de dag yod 365

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ rig gnas chung ba lnga'i nang gi skar rtsis ni 〈 dus 'khor rtsa rgyud 〉kyi nang du gsal bar gsungs pas zur du ma phye ba yin la/ de min gzhan dag ni phyi nang gnyis ka'i thun mong ba yin pas sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab khongs su mi 'du zhing /bstan 'gyur gyi nang du de dag yod pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pas kyang rig gnas de dag slob dgos pa'i dbang gis bstan 'gyur gyi mjug tu bzhag pa yin/ rje shes rab rgya mtshos dkar chag bsgrigs skabs thog mar lo rgyus rnam thar skor bkod pa ni/ sngon byon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems/ mkhas grub rgyal blon rnams kyi lo rgyus shes nas de dag mig dper bltas te rang nyid mi tshe gcig gi mdun lam la rgyang ring gi chod sems 'dzugs thub pa'i ched yin la/ de nas lam rim blo sbyong sogs bkod pa ni/ gzhung rgya chen po la thos bsam byed pa'i blo gros dman pa rnams kyis de dag bltas nas rang nyid kyi sems rgyud 'dul thabs byed dgos pa shes pa'i ched dang / de rjes gzhung chen po lnga dang gsang sngags skor bkod pa ni blo gros che zhing cha rkyen 'dzoms pa rnams kyis theg pa che chung gi lam thun mong ba dbu ma dang / theg chen thun mong ma yin pa phar phyin/ theg pa dman pa'i lam ston pa mdzod/ theg pa che chung gnyis kyi lam gyi rtsa ba 'dul ba/rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi sgo 'byed pa rnam 'grel/ de dag gi don bsdus pa grub mtha'/ theg pa chem/ po'i la ma gyi zab don gsang sngags bcas gtso bor slob sbyong byed dgos pa ngang rgya gar dang / bod skad kyi 366

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da —da —sgra rig pa/ rig gnas chung ba lnga sogs zhar byung du slob thub na legs la/med na yang snying thag pa nas chos byed mkhan la chad pa'i skyon med pa la dgongs pa red/〈 bla brang dgon pa'i dkar chag chen mo 〉 de'i nang gi go rim sgrig stangs 'ga' zhig nor ba dang / par byang smon tshig rtsom pa po la rtsom pa po ngo ma yin par 'khrul ba sogs skyon cha mi nyung ba zhig 'dug rung /khyon yongs kyi phyogs nas legs po yod cing / gsham du gong gsal gyi bka' brnya na gnyis phud pa'i dkar chag sgrig tshul rnams kyi nang nas legs cha'i dpe mtshon dpyad gzhi re'u mig bkod yod pa de'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pā ni/ deng rabs blo gsal don gnyer can rnams kyis slob sbyong byed pa'i go rim dang bstun nas bkod pa yin/ de yang yi ge 'bri klog shes rjes sgra rig pa dang / sum rtags dag gsum la sbyang dgos pa dang / de shes rjes rdzas sbyor dang lag shes bzo las bslabs na shes mgyogs shing / gso ba rig pa bslabs na yang bzo rig pa dang / rdzas sbyor rig pa'i nang nas shes dgos pa mang po yod pas bzo rig pa sngon dang / de'i rjes su gso ba— rig pa bkod pa yin/ bzo rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa ma sbyangs par snyan ngag sbyong mkhan yin tshe snyan ngag dang /de dang 'brel ba'i mngon brjod/ skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi sdebs sbyor/zlos gar/ skar rtsis bcas rig gan4chung ba lnga dang / de nas rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi blo sgo 'byed byed tshad ma rnam 'grel sogs kyi go rim rnams gong bzhin bkod na legs snyam pa'i rnye'u mig gong gsal la 36 7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gzigs/ dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses gnyis pa ka tho dang ang rtags/ sde tshan so so la nang gses mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa dang / de dag la yang nang gses mi 'dra ba mang po yod pas ka tho med na de tsho'i go rim rnams 'khrug 'gro bas go rim gtan khel zin rjes ka tho bkod pa yin/ ka tho zhes pa ni bod yig gi ka mad sum cu tham pa la dbyangs bzhi bo gang yang ma sbyar ba sum cu dang / dbyangs i ldan/ u ldan/ e ldan/ o ldan bcas re re la yang sum cu re yod pa bsnan pas ka mad brgya dang lnga bcu tham pa yod pas ka tho ldang nges yod cing / gal te da dung ma ldang na ka med sum cur dbyangs bzhi bo gang yang ma sbyar ba brgya ste ka dang po nas a brgya tham pa'i bar sum stong yod pas des ldang la/ da dung snon dgos na ki dang po nas o brgya tham pa'i bar i ldan sum stong nas o ldan sum stong bar grangs chig khri lnga stong snon chog pa dang / da dung snon dgos na rgya gar skad kyi dbyangs gsal ka thor sbyar bas chog pa yin/ de 'dra'i ka tho de la sde tshan so so'i ming thog mar sbyar na dpe cha'i ming gi tshab byed thub pa/ blo la nges sla ba/ dpe cha'i ming dngos su ma bkod pas bor brlag sngon 'gog thub pa bcas kyi khyad chos chen po yod/ dper na/ lo rgyus ka pa de la dkar chag thog 〈 rba bzhed 〉ces bkod yod na 〈 rba bzhed 〉ces pa'i ming de blo la ma nges kyang lo rgyus ka pa zhes pa'i ming de blo la yod na des go chod pa lta bu red/ gal te dpe cha'i ming gi tshab dang dpe cha'i grangs 'bor mtshon byed gnyis ka ang rtags kyis go chod par 368

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa da byas na ang rtags des dpe cha'i grangs 'bor mtshon thub pa las/ blo la nges dgos pa'i dpe cha de'i ming gi tshab byed mi thub pas dpe cha de'i ang rtags gang yin dkar chag la ma bltas na ha cang gis 'tshol dka'/der brten bod kyi dpe mdzod khang mang rnge ba'i dpe cha'i gdong dar thog pod de'i nang le tshan ji yod kyi mtshan byeng gsal bor bkod pa des lta klog byed mkhan tshos 'tshol bde bo yod kyang / bdag gnyer byed mkhan gyi rig gnas chu tshad mthon po med na bor brlag song yang gtan nas mi shes pa'i dbang gis dpe mdzod khang mang po'i dpe cha gzhan gyis rku 'khyer dang bor brlag song ba ha cang mang po yod/ der brten bod kyi mkhas pa khag gi dpe mdzod khang mi nyung ba zhig tu dpe cha so so'i ming byang ngo ma dkar chag thog bkod nas gdong dar gyi thog sde tshan gyi ming dang / de'i ang rtags ma gtogs gzhan dag bkod med pa red/ de 'dra byas na do bdag rang nyid ma gtogs phyi nas yong ba'i lta klog byed mkhan tshos bdag gnyer byed mkhan la 'brel gtugs ma byas par lkog tu rku 'khyer byed mi thub pas dpe mdzod kheng gi bdag gnyer la rogs ram gyi nus pa 'don thub/ ang rtags 'god tshul ni gdong yig thog sde tshan gyi ming gi 'og tu sde tshan de rang gi ang rtags bkod pa yin pas zur blta'i dpe ris 'di ltar/ 369
——— — — twe wabye

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ —da wad 〈 tshad ma rnamā 'grel gyi tshig le'ur byas pa 〉zhes bya ba 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas pa chen po dpal chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ zhes pa lta bu yin cing / skabs re rtsom pa po'i mtshan sngon du bkod nas rtsom yig gi mtshan byang rjes su 'god pa yang mi nyung ba yod/ de'i 'god tshul ni dper na/ slob dpon chos mchog gis sbyar ba 〈 tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i ṭik+ka 'thad ldan zhes bya ba 〉zhes bkod yod pa lta bu yin/ gong gsal rtsom yig dang rtsom pa po'i mtshan byang 'god tshul de gnyis kyi nang nas gang legs she na/ spyir btang la rtsom yig gi mtshan byang sngon du bkod na legs te/ lta klog byed mkhan tshos thog mar rtsom yig gi ming la brten nas de'i brjod bya'i nang don 'tshol ba dang / de nas rtsom pa po su yin rtsad gcod pa mang ba'i rkyen gyis yin/ skabs re rtsom pa po'i mtshan sngon du 'god dgos pa yang yod/ de ni rang nyid kyis bris pa'i rtsom yig de'i mgo dang mjug dngos gzhi bcas kyi skabs su mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung rtsom khungs su 'dren dgos tshe sngon du rtsom pa po'i mtshan dang / de'i rjes su gsung rtsom gyi mtshan byang 'god pa yin/ de yang rang gi lta tshul de la tshad ldan gyi mkhas pa sus ji ltar gsungs yod pa dang / gsung tshul de gsung rtsom gang gi nang du yod pa shes rtogs byed pa'i bsam blo'i ngos 'dzin gyi go rim dang bstun pa'i dgos pa yod cing / yang rtsom yig ming gcig pa yin kyang rtsom pa po mi gcig pa dper na/ 〈 deb ther dmar po 〉la tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes mdzad pa zhig dang / paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa zhig bcas tsāganyis yod pa dang / de bzhin 371

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/〈 deb ther dkar po 〉la yang tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes brtsams pa zhig dang / mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa zhig bcas gnyis yod pas so sor mi 'dres pa'i ched du tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes brtsams pa'i 〈 deb ther dmar po 〉dang 〈 debatshother dkar po 〉zhes dang / paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i 〈 deb ther dmar po 〉dang / mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i 〈 deb ther dkar po 〉zhes dang / yang na rtsom pa po'i mtshan gyi mjug tu 'brel sgra sbyar nas de'i mjug tu stabs bde'i ming gis 'bod pa 〈 tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje'i deb ther dkar po〉〈 dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi deb ther dkar po〉〈 si tu'i sum rtags 〉〈 pra snyi'i sum rtags〉〈 dngul chu'i sum rtags 〉zer ba lta bu yod/ rgyun du dkar chag 'bri skabs rtsom yig gi ming sngon du 'bri dgos pa yin/ /rtsom yig gi ming 'bri stangs skor/ bod yig gi rtsom yig la ming ring thung sna tshogs yod cing / dpe cha 'ga' zhig gi mtshan byang ha cang ring bo yod pa dper na gong du drangs pa'i 〈 snar thang bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag 〉dang 〈 sde dge bka' 'gyur dkar chag〉〈 sde dge'i bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag 〉sogs mang po zhig gi mtshan byang la yig phreng gcig dang / gnyis tsam yod pas dkar chag gi nang mtshan byang de cha tshang bar ma bkod na dpe cha mig gis mthong yang ming don ngo mi 'phrod pa'i dka' ngal chen po yong zhing / mtshan byang ring bo de dang chabs cig stabs bde'i mtshan byang zhig logs su ma bkod na mtshan byang blo la nges 372

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da dka' ba'i rkyen gyis dpe cha 'tshol bar dus tshod ring bo 'gor gyi yod/dper na’〈 snar thang dpar ma'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag 〉gi mtshan byang 〈 rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i gsung par srid gsum rgyan gcig rdzu 'phrul shing rta'i dkar chag ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i sde mig 〉 ces 'khod pa ming bsdus na/ bka' 'gyur rin po che'i gsung par dkar chag zer rgyu yin cing / ming de tsam gyis chog par byas na stabs bde bo yod kyang / bka' 'gyur gyi par la sde dge/ li thang / co ne/ pe cin/ lha sa zhol/ chab mdo bcas kyi par ma rigs mi 'dra ba yod pas de tsho gang gi dkar chag yin mi shes pas de tsho dang dbye ba 'byed pa'i ched du sgyu snar thang dpar ma'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag 〉ces sogs bkod na ha cang legs/ skabs 'dir gnad don 'di 'dra zhig yod de/ gong gsal dpe cha'i mtshan byang ring bo de la bsdus ming zhig mi 'god thabs med yin na bsdus ming de dkar chag 'god pa po so sos bsam gzhigs thog nas gsar bzo byed rgyu yin nam/ yang ne rgya che'i gzigs pa po gro'i zhal rgyun du goms byang song ba zhig dgos sam mi dgos zhes pa de yin/ mtshan byang stabs bde zhig dkar chag rtsom pa pos rang dgar gsar bzo byas na phyogs gcig nas mkhas pa'i dbang bo rnams kyi bzhed dgongs dang mjun pā zhig yong dka' zhing / gnyis nas bsdus ming 'dogs tshul thad rgya che'i lkegazigs pa po tshos dgongs pa gcig mthun re zhig yong dka' ba de yin/ gal te rgya che'i gzigs pa po tsho'i zhal rgyun du byang goms song ba zhig dgos zhes nan tan gyis bshad 373

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin los kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyang mkhas pa'i zhal rgyun la 'jags pa'i bsdus ming sna tshogs yod pa/dper na/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga bas mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs deb ther gyi bsdus ming la/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis 〈 deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs 〉zhes gsung rgyun yod la/ 'ga' zhig gis 〈 deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston 〉zhes gsung rgyun yod pa dang / de bzhin du dpa' bo btsug lag phreng bas mdzad pa'i chos 'byung la 'ga' zhig gis 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉zhes dang/ 'ga' zhig gis 〈 lho brag chos 'byung 〉dang 〈 lho brag dpa' bo'i chos 'byung 〉zhes gsung rgyun sna tshogs yod pa lta bu red/ der brten dkar chag par du skrun skabs re'u mig tu bsdus ming 'god sa'i re'u mig stong ba spyi skar bdun tsam yod pa zhig bzhag ste re zhig dngos su ma bkod na legs sam snyam/rtsom pa po'i ming 'bri stangs skor/ bod kyi mkhas pa mang po zhig la mtshan mi 'dra ba mang po yod/ ①rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis rgyun du bkol ba'i mtshan/ ②rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis sgra rig pa sbyangs pa mthar phyin gnang rjes slob dpon gyis mtshan gsar du btags pa'i kun bshad kyi ming / ①rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi grub mtha' mi 'dra ba'i chos lugs so so'i skor gyi gsung rtsom gnang ba'i mdzad byang du 'khod pa/ ④rjes 'brangs slob ma rnams kyis rang rang so so'i 'dod mos gzhir bzung nas che bstod dang gus bkur zhu ba'i mtshan/ ⑤yongs su ma grags pa'i gsang ba'i mtshan bcas lnga yod/374

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa rtsom pa po rangatrenyid kyis rgyun du bkol ba'i mtshanani tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga bas gsungamortsom phal che ba'i nang gi mdzad byang du za hor gyi rigs las chos smra ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho zhes dang / dpa' bo btsug lag phreng bas gsung rtsom mang po'i nang mtshan yongs grags de rang 'god gnang mdzad pa lta bu yin/sgra rig pa gsan sbyong gnang rjes slob dpon gyis btags pa'i kun bshad kyi mtshan ni/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga bas mdzad pa'i snyan ngag dang bla ma'i rnam thar lo rgyus sogs 'ga' zhig gi mdzad byang du/ tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes 'god gnang mdzad yod pa ltar bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang bo sgra rig pa gsan sbyong mdzad myong ba tshang mas rang rang gi kun bshad kyi mtshan bkod yod pas rtsom pa po so so'i rnam thar ma klog na mtshan de rtsom pa po su zhig gi mtshan yin pa shes mi thub/rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis chos lugs spub mtha' so so'i skor gyi gsung rtsom gnang skabs grub mtha' de'i chos skad dang mthun pa'i mtshan rang nyid kyis 'dogs par mdzad pa ste/ dper na tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga bas gsang sngags rnying ma'i rdzogs chen dang yi dam 'ga' zhig gi gsung rtsom mdzad byang du za hor gyi ban+de gang shar rang grol zhes 'god gnang mdzad yod pa lta bu yin/ rjes 'brangs slob ma rnams kyis rang rang so so'i 'dod mos gzhir bzung nas che bstod dang gus bkur zhurnaba'i mtshan ni rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom rtsa'akhod pa'i mtshan ma yin par/ rjes 375

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'brangs slob ma tshos rang rang gi 'dod mos ltar gsar du btags pa'i mtshan zhig ste/ dper na/ deng sang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa zer yang rgyal yongs bcings 'grol ma btang gong du skyabs mgon lnga pa chen po dang / gong sa lnga pa chen po/ rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga pa bcas su 'bod srol yod pa ltar de 'dra'i rigs ha cang mang po yod/yongs su ma grags pa'i gsang mtshan/ de ni rtsom pa po rang gi bla ma'i drung nas gsang sngags kyi dbang zhu skabs bla mas btags pa'i gsang mtshan dang / yang na dgos pa'i dbang gis rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi gsang ming gsar pa gzhan zhig 'god gnang mdzad pa bcas gnyis yod/sngon ma de ni dper na/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga ba'i gsang rnam dang /bka' rgya ma'i gsung 'ga' zhig gi nang za hor gi rigs las mang du thos pa'i ban+de zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal zhes 'god gnang mdzad pa dang /lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ stag phu gar gyi dbang phyug zhes pa sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma mang po'i gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig gi mdzad byang du yongs su ma grags pa'i gsang ming 'god gnang mdzad pa lta bu yin/rjes ma de ni dper na/ mi la'i rnam thar rtsom pa po rgod tshang pas mdzad pa'i mdzad byang du/ rnal 'byor ba rus pa'i rgyan can zhes 'god pa dang / stag phu chos kyi dbang phyug gi gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig gi mjug tu gtad med sprang btsun gar dbang smyon pa zhes 'god gnang mdzad pa lta bu mang po yod/ gong gsal rtsom pa po so so'i mtshan yongs su grags 376

bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/pa dang ma grags pa mang po yod pa'i rigs rnams so so'i rnam thar dang gsan yig khag la ma bltas na dkar chag 'god skabs dpe cha de mdzad pa po su yin shes dka' ba red/dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses bzhi pa/ nang don gnad bsdus 'god tshul skor/ dkar chag nang rtsom yig so so'i brjod bya'i nang don gnad bsdus shig 'god thub na legs/ de yang rtsom yig yod tshad kyi brjod bya'i nang don 'god mi dgos par rtsom yig grags che ba dang /gnad che ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs gras yin tshe de'i nang don gtso che ba rnams gnad bsdus nas 'god gang thub byas na lta klog byed mkhan tshor phan thogs chen po yod cing / de ltar bkod na de'i sa khongs re'u mig gi bar stong che tsam 'jog dgos pas gzhogs ngos gnyis su bris na legs/ de'i dpe mtshon gsham gyi re'u mig la gzigs/dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses lnga pa bam grangs dang pod grangs/gna' rabs bod kyi bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag tu bkod pa'i bam grangs ni/ shog dril chen po zhig gi tshad yin/ bam po ni bod yig gi dbang du byas na tshigs bcad la rkang ba bzhi dang / tshig lhug ma'i tsheg bar te yig 'bru sum cu so gnyis re la sho lo ka gcig sho lo ka sum brgya tham pa ste tsheg bar (yig 'bru)sum stong brgya dang nyi shu tham pa la bam po gcig tu brtsi ba mang zhing / skabs rer sho lo ka sum brgya lnga bcu (yig 'bru sum stong drug brgya bzhi bcu tham pa)dang / bzhi brgya(yig 'bru bzhi stong brgya dang drug cu tham pa)la bam po rer brtsis pa mi nyung ba yod la/377

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag tu le tshan re re bzhin du bam po'am/ yang na sho lo ka grangs ji tsam yod pa yang gsal bor bkod yod/ de ni parnyi ta dang lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i gsung rab rnams la kha snon dang chad skyon sogs mi 'byung ba'i sngon 'gog ched du yin/ rjes su bod kyi mkhas pa tshos mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom khag la bam grangs dang / sho lo ka ji yod kyi grangs bkod med pas/ dkar chag gi nang du dpe cha de'i ldeb ring thung dang / rgyab mdun ngos rer yig phreng ji yod kyi kha grangs gsal bor bkod na bam grangs dang sho lo ka'i grangs bkod pa lta bu'i nus pa thon thub kyi red/ dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses drug pa ma dpe/ de ni rgya gar dang rgya nag sogs kyi skad nas bod skad du bsgyur ba'am/ dpe cha bris ma dang /par ma bcas kyi ma dpe gang nas byung ba gsal bor bkod pa zhig ste/sngar gyi bka' bstan dkar chag tu/ bsgyur yig gi ma dpe gang nas byung ba bkod pa yang mi nyung ba yod cing / bris ma dang par ma yang ma dpe gang nas bshus pa dang gang dang gang nas 'byung ba yang gsal bor bkod yod/ da dung der ma 'dus pa/ bsgyur yig yin na sgyur byed lo tsā ba su yin dang / dri gtugs zhu yul gyi parnyi ta'i mtshan/ sgyur ba'i gnas/sgyur ba'i dus/ rtsod gzhi yod med/ cha tshang min sogs zhib gsal bkod yod pa dper na 〈 bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag 〉nang du 〈 dbu ma la 'jug pa 〉slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ti la ka ka la sha dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis 378

bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/kha che'i dpe dang mthun par bsgyur/ phyis ra sa ra mo cher rgya gar mkhan po ka na ka warma dang / lo tsā ba de nyid kyis nyi 'og shar phyogs kyi dpe dang gtugs shing bcos pa zhes gsal bar bkod pa lta bu dang / rtsod gzhi yod pa'i rigs la mkhas pa so so'i gsung tshul mi 'dra ba gang yod dang /de la dkar chag 'bri ba bos dpyad gtam yang bris yod pa bcas bod gna' rabs kyi dkar chag 'god tshul ha cang zhib phra yod pa zhig yin/dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses bdun pa bris ma dang / par ma'i dkar chag 'god tshul/ dpe cha bris ma'i gras nas bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ gser bris/ dngul bris kyi rigs gsar bzhengs byas pa'i dkar chag 'ga' zhig tu nang don khag bcu bdun bris yod de/①sngon 'gro'i lo rgyus/ ②mthun rkyen sbyor ba bo'i sbyin bdag ①ma dpe gang la gzhi bzung ba/ ④bzo rigs khag ji tsam yod pa/ ⑤las bzo khag gi mi grangs/ rjonyin re'i las ka'i mgyogs tshad/ dulas rigs khag gi las rim/ ⑧gla phogs dang bya dga'i rim pa/ ⑨rgyu cha'i thon khungs/ ⑩gsung rab bzhengs pa'i lag rtsal/ ⑪zhus dag gi rim pa/⑫'go 'dzugs dang mjug sgril ba'i dus tshod/ ⑫'dzugs sgang grol gsum gyi ston mo gnang cha/ ④khyon yongs kyi 'gro gron/ ⑫dad sbyin khag gi zhal 'debs 'bul tho/ ⑩'jog yul gyi sa gnas/ ⑩dkar chag dngos gzhi bcas yin/par du bskrun pa'i rigs kyi dkar chag la yang gong du gsal ba'i don tshan bcu pa ma gtogs tshang ma 'dra ba la/ don tshan bcu par par 379

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brko'i lag rtsal dang / de'i lag cha ci dgos skor bkod yod pas dkar chag 'god tshul ha cang zhib phra yin par ma zad/ de la brten nas rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyis skabs de'i dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs dang / dngos po'i rin thang / lag rtsal gyi chu tshad sogs gnad don mang po zhig shes rtogs dang zhib 'jug bya rgyur phan yod kyi dpyad gzhi gal che sha stag red/dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses brgyad pa/ bris ma dang par ma'i dkar chag 'god skabs do snang byed dgos pa'i gnad don skor/ de ni bod yig gi dpe cha bris ma yin na yig gzugs dbu can dbu med gang yin dang bsdu yig yod med 'bri dgos pa dang / par ma yin na sa gnas gang gi par yin 'bri dgos pa/ bris ma dang par ma dpe cha gcig yin na dkar chag thog mnyam du 'god dgos pa gsum yin/de'i rgyu mtshan ni bod yig gi bris ma mang po zhig zhus dag yag po byung med pa dang / dbu can gyi bris ma khag gcig gi ma dpe dbu med yin stabs dbu med kyi bsdu yig la go ba ma lon par 'ol tshod kyis bris pa dang / dbu med kyi ta dang ra phan tshun nor ba/ pa dang ba phan tshun nor ba/ kha dang pha phan tshun nor ba/ na ro dang 'greng bu phan tshun nor ba sogs byung yod cing / par ma'i rigs kyi zhus dag ni thog mar dmar zhus zer ba ma dpe dang bshus bris phan tshun bsdur nas zhus dag gtong dgos pa dang / de rjes yang zhus zer ba tshig don la zhus dag thengs kha shas gtong dgos pa/ de rjes bskyar zhus zer ba bshu bris 380
