bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/zin pa'i yig gzugs gcig mtshungs byung yod med dang / chad lhag gang yod/ tshig don ma dpe ltar byung yod med bcas zhus dag mkhan mi mang pos yang yang bltas nas gsar brjes dang / chad gsab/'dzugs rgyag bcas dgos rigs 'phral 'phral byed dgos pas bris ma dang bsdur na par ma ni ha cang gis tshad mthun byung yod/ 'on kyang par ma 'ga' zhig gi ma dpe la skyon yod pa'i stabs kyis par ma'i nang du yang ma dag rgyun 'byams byung ba mi nyung ba zhig yod pas bris ma dang /par ma phan tshun bsdur nas lta bde bo yong ched bris par gyi dpe gcig mtshungs ci yod kha ma bral bar mnyam du bzhag na legs/ par ma'i rigs 'ga' zhig dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sa gnas mang por yod pas dkar chag thog par ma de sa gnas gang gi par yin min gsal bor bkod na par ma phan tshun zhib bsdur byas te lta klog byed bde ba'i khyad par yod/ dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses dgu pa ldeb ring thung / bod yig gi bka' 'gyur bris ma dang par ma'i shog ldeb kyi tshad ni/mgo mjug gi shog nye phud pa'i spyi'i ring tshad spyi skar/ 60 da 65zheng tshad spyi skar/ 52 da 54mtha' sne'i thag gi mgo mjug bar gyi ring tshadabyuspyi skar/ 47 da 53sne thig gi zheng tshad spyi skar/ 36 da 34bstan 'gyur shog ldeb ring tshad spyi skar/ 56 da 60zheng tshad spyi skar/ 15 —— 10 38/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sne thig gi ring tshad spyi skar/ 47 da 53zheng tshad spyi skar/ 7 da 6gsung rab mang che ba'i shog ldeb ring tshad spyi skar/ 55 da 60zheng tshad spyi skar/ 10 da 9sne thig gi ring tshad spyi skar/ 53 da 47sne thig gi zheng tshad spyi skar/ 7 da 6ldeb 'bring ni/ dpe cha shog bu'i ring tshad mda' gang ma longs shing dpe thung las ring tsam byas pa rnams la zer/ de ni dpe mdzod dang par khang du 'jog pa'am phyogs gzhan du 'gro skabs khur bo'i steng du bzhag nas khyer stabs bde ba yod cing /de'i ring tshad spyi skar/ 32 da 30zheng tshad spyi skar/ 8 da 9sne thig gi ring tshad spyi skar/ 27 da 25sne thig gi zheng tshad spyi skar/ 6 da 5yod pas de la gzhi bzung nas yig 'bru mang nyung rtsis chogadakar chag rig pa'i nang gses bcu pa yig phreng dang yig 'bru/bod yig gi dpe cha bris ma'i rigs la yig phreng mang nyung nges pa med de/'ga' zhig gis shog ngos rer yig phreng bco lnga nas nyi shu'i bar byas pa yang yod cing / de tsho'i yig gzugs legs shing yig 'bru ha cang chung ba'i thog yig phreng re'i bar gyi stong cha spyi skar phyed tsam las med/ de ni mkhas pa partsi ta tshos rgyun du 'bral spangs mdzad pa'i phyag dpe dang /382

bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/chos pa gnas nges med du 'grul bzhud byed mkhan gyis rgyun khyer nyer mkho'i dpe cha'i rigs/ dpe rgyun ha cang dkon pa'i rigs 'bri bshus byas pa bcas la yig 'bru ji tsam chung na dpe tshogs nyung la khyer stabs bde bo yod/ dper na 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng dang po'i rgyun gzigs phyag dpe bris ma lta bu yin/ spyir btang dpe cha mang che bar yig phreng drug nas bdun bar dang / yig phreng re'i bar gyi stong cha ni spyi skar gang yin pas yig gzugs che chung snyoms pa dang / yig phreng gong 'og gi bar stong la mchan bu'i yig chung bkod na shong thub pa yod/bris ma ni par ma dang mi 'dra bar yig gzugs ha cang chung ba ri bong gi spu dang / zhum bu'i spus bzos pa'i pir gyi sgyu gusabris kyang che shel gyis bltas na gsal bor mthong thub pa ni bris ma'i khyad chos red/ par ma ni de dang mi 'dra bar yig gzugs chung drags na dpar thengs 'ga' zhig brgyab rjes yig gzugs gog skyon yong sla ba 'i dbang gis yig phreng gong 'og gi bar stong spyi skar gang dang / shog ngos rer yig phreng drug nas bdun bar gtan khel byas yod/yig phreng rer yig 'bru ji tsam yod pa ni/ldeb ring yig chen gyi rigs la yig 'bru/ 45 da 53ldeb ring yig chung gi rigs la yig 'bru/ 63 da 73ldeb 'bring yig chen gyi rigs la yig 'bru/ 30 da 37ldeb 'bring yig chung gi rigs la yig 'bru/ 50 da 60ldeb thung yig chen gyi rigs la yig 'bru/ 20 da 25383

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ldeb thung yig chung gi rigs la yig 'bru/ 25 da 30bar bcas yod/ 'di deng sang bod yig dpe skrun khang gi bod yig yig 'bru brtsi tshul dang mi 'dra bar tsheg bar rer yig 'bru re rtsis pa'i bod gna' rabs kyi rtsi tshul gzhir bzung ba yin/dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses bcu gcig pa le tshan kha grangs/bod yig gi dpe cha 'ga' zhig mgo nas mjug bar le tshan kha shas su bgos yod pa dang / 'ga' zhig tshan pa mang por ma bgos par dum bu so so gcig mjug gnyis mthud du sbrel yod pa/ 'ga' zhig dpe cha gcig yin kyang le tshan bgos pa dang ma bgos pa sna tshogs su yod pa ni/dper na thu'u bkan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈 grub mtha' shel dkar me long 〉a mdo par ma dang / dbus par gnyis le tshan mang por bgos yod kyang /sde dge par mar mgo mjug cha tshang dum bu gcig tu sbrel yod pa lta bu yin pas le tshan du bgos yod med/ cha tshang dang ma tshang sogs zhib gsal yong ched dang / dpe cha g.yar mkhan 'ga' zhig gis dpe cha g.yar rjes de'i nang nas so sor dgos mkho yod pa'i le tshan de brkus nas ma tshang ba bzos pa sogs kyi skyon cha sngon 'gog byed ched le tshan ji tsam yod pa gsal bor 'god dgos par ma zad/ rtsom pa po gcig gi rtsom yig cha tshang gcig la le tshan mang po yod pa dang / ya nga na pod gcig gi nang dpe cha le tshan 'ga' zhig yod na/ le tshan so so'i dbu shog gi kha byang thog le tshan gyi ang rtags bkod nas ang rtags de'i thog tu bdag po rang nyid kyi ming 'khod pa'i rtags tham brgyab na gong du 384

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/po ti'am glegs bam de la tshad che chung mi 'dra ba gsum yod cing /de yang shog grangs mang nyung gi thog nas brtsi ba las/ yig 'bru mang nyung dang / ldeb ring thung gi sgo nas brtsi ba min/pod tshad che bar shog grangs/ 500—700pod tshad 'bring bar shog grangs/ 300—400 jipod tshad chung bar shog grangs/ 150 —200shog grangs brgya man chad ni le tshan du brtsi ba las pod tshad du mi brtsi ba bcas kyi khyad par shes dgos/ gal te pod tshad gtan nas ma longs pa'i le tshan gcig la pod gcig tu brtsis na bod kyi lugs srol gtan nas mi shes pa zhig gis do snang gtan nas mi byed kyang / lugs srol cung zad shes shing dpe cha'i rigs la rgyus mnga' med pa'i mi rnams kyis dpe cha de pod tshad longs pa zhig yin dang / pod tshad ma longs pa'i le tshan zhig yin gsal bor mi shes pa'i dbang gis dpe cha de ma tshang ba zhig yin kyang tshang ba'i gras dang / tshang ba'i gras kyang ma tshang ba zhig tu brtsis te bdag gnyer 'thus tshang mi yong zhing / phan tshun rtsis sprod len gyi las ka don dngos dang mthun pa zhig yong mi thub/dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses bcu gsum pa shog grangs/ bod kyi mkhas pa tsho'i gsung rtsom mang che bar shog grangs la bod yig gi yig chen 'bri ba mang zhing / gna' rabs kyi dpe cha 'ga' zhig gi shog grangs/ang ki 'bri ba dang / de yang gcig nas dgu bcu go dgu'i bar yongs grags ltar dang / ang ki ba—dun ni dzo'adi 'dra dang / ang ki dgu la 386

bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/9'di 'dra bris yod stabs bdun dang dgu/ dgu dang gnyis bcas phan tshun 'dra nor yong sla bas yig gzugs la gzab nan gyis lta dgos/ang ki brgya tham pa la 100/ nyis brgya tham pa la1100/ sum brgya la 11100sogs chig stong bar gyi grangs ka rnams la kur rtags gong ltar kha snon byas te chig stong yan chad kyi ang ki rgyun spyod ang ki dang 'dra bar 'bri srolta yang 'dugagana' rabs bod kyi ang ki'i 'byung khungs ni/ thog mar gcig steng gcig bsnan pas gnyis dang / gnyis dang gcig phan tshun bsnan pas gsum/ gnyis dang gnyis phan tshun bsnan pas bzhi/ gnyis dang gsum phan tshun bsnan pas lnga/ gnyis dang bzhi phan tshun bsnan pas drugaganyis dang lnga phan tshun bsnan pas bdun/ gnyis dang drug phan tshun bsnan pas brgyad/ gnyis dang bdun phan tshun bsnan pas dgu lnga dang lnga phan tshun bsnan pas bcu yin pas de la bcu gnas su ang ki gcig dang gcig gnas su thig le bzhag pa ste/ thig le'i grangs ka'i mtshams dang gnas 'dzin pa'i rtsis de gna' rabs nas yod/ (thig les ang ki'i tshab byed pa a rab rgyal khab nas byung zer ba yang yod)de yang lag shes bzo layodar rgyas byung zhing / zhing 'brog gnyis bar dngos zog brje res kyi tshong las gong du 'phel ba dang chabs cig dpal 'byor gyi rin thang brtsi ba'i brjed tho bkod pa'i tshad/ dor dang / thul/ khal/ bre/phul/ srang sogs dang / bre kha/ chag pa/ bcu debs/ pod/ le tshan/shog ngos sogs cha shas rnams hril bo gcig tu bsdoms pa'am/ hril bo 387

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/cha shas su bsil ba/ ldab 'phar du bsgyur ba/ snga ma'i thog tu phyi ma snon pa/ snga ma'i steng nas mar phri ba sogs gang gi skabs su yang grangs ka med mi rung la/ grangs kasmobartsi ba'i tshad gzhi hril bo dang cha shas kyi ming mang po yang med mi rung bas/ mi rigs mang che bar rang rang so so'i lugs kyi grangs kash+tsa thabs yod/ skabs 'di'i grangs ka ni dpe cha'i pod dang / le tshan/ shog ldeb/ yig phreng / yig 'bru sogs hril bo dang / cha shas kyi grangs ka yig chen thog 'bri ba'am/ brda mtshon ang ki bkod pa'i grangs la zer zhing de ni dpyad gzhi lta klog byed mkhan dang /bdag gnyer byed mkhan tshang mas sems la nges dgos pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa'i grangs ka yin/ dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses bcu bzhi pa cha tshang min skor/ bod snga rabs kyi mkhas pa tshos bsgyur ba dang brtsams pa'i gsung rab dang rtsom yig la cha tshang min gyi thad nas bshad na rigs bzhi yod/ ①lo tsā ba dang mkhas pa gcig gis dpe sna cha tshang gcig bsgyur ba dang brtsams pa/ ②lo tsā ba dang mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis dpe sna de'i skor mgo mjug cha tshang bar mdzad pa/ ①lo tsā ba dang mkhas pa des bsgyur ba dang brtsams pa'i dpe sna de bsgyur 'phro dang / rtsom 'phro lus pa/ ④bsgyur ba dang brtsams pa'i dpe sna cha tshang de rang la lo tsā ba so so'i bsgyur stangs mi 'dra ba ('gyur mi 'dra ba)dang / mkhas pa so sos brtsams pa la yang rgyas bsdus mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pas dkar chag gi thog tu gsal bor 'god dgos/ 388

bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/dpe cha 'ga' zhig gi dpe rgyun khyab che bas bris ma rigs mi 'dra ba dang / par ma rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod par ma zad/ dpe mdzod khang gcig gi nang du yang cha tshang mang po yod pas rang nyid kyi dpe mdzod khang de'i nang du yod pa'i dpe cha de dang de cha tshang yin min dang / cha tshang ji tsam yod pa'i bsdoms grangs (tshar grangs)kyang gsal bor 'god dgos/dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses bco lnga pa rtags tham/ bod du dpe cha'i thog rtags tham 'god pa'i lam lugs ni/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa dang / paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng lnga pa'i dus nas phyag dpe'i thog dpe tham gnang srol byung zhing / de yang sku sger gyi sku chas dang phyag dpe'i rigs la dmigs bsal gyis bskyon pa gnang byed mgul tham zhes pa'i rtags tham chung ngu zhig yod pa de phyag dpe'i dbu shog gi kha byang gi steng dang / zhabs shog gi zur du bskyon pa gnang yod/ de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi yig cha gang yin la mgo shog dang / zhabs shogashog grangs re re bzhin gyi grangs ka'i thog dang / zur mchan gyi mgo mjug yi ge med pa'i shog stong gi zur bcas la rtags tham yod/ lhag par du dpe mdzod khang du yod pa'i bod yig gi dpe char rtags tham med na brkus shor bor brlag gi nyen kha che bas dpe mdzod khang so sor ched spyod dpe tham nges par du yod dgos pa ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi dpe cha bdag gnyer thad nas bsags pa'i nyams myong rtsa chen zhig red/dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses bcu drug pa/ gsung 'bum gyi sgru289

da wa dungadakarablo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dkar chag 'god skabs chos lugs grub mtha' so sor phye ba dang ma phye ba'i skor/ chos lugs grub mtha' khag gi bla ma dang mkhas pa tsho'i gsung rtsom gyi dkar chag zur du bkod ma dgos par gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag bkod pa des go chod par byas na mi 'grig pa med cing / de 'dra byed pa'i lugs srol sngar nas yod pas de'i dbang du byas na/ bod la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs grub mtha' khag byung ba'i go rim dang mthun par/ thog mar gsang sngags rnying ma'i gter kha gong 'og de nas bka' gdams pa'i brgyud pa rnam gsum/ de nas sa skya'i ngor gong rdzong gsum/ de nas bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad/ de nas dge lugs/dbus gtsang/ mnga' ris/ mdo smad/ sog yul bcas go rim de ltar sgrig srol yod cing / sgrig stangs de la phyogs bsdus kyi rang bzhin dang /go rim cha tshang ba/ lo rgyus shes rtogs thub pa/ don dngos dang mthun pa bcas kyi khyad chos mang po yod/ 'on kyang bla ma dang mkhas pa 'ga' zhig chos lugs grub mtha' gang gi khongs su gtogs pa mi gsal ba/ khrus khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / 'ol kha sle lung bzhad pa'i rdo rje lta bu dang / chos lugs khag so so'i chos 'byung du bla ma de rang rang gi chos lugs de'i khongs su 'then nas bshad yod par ma zad/ gsung rtsom gyi nang nas rtsom pa po rang nyid chos lugs gtso bo gang la gnang gi yod med kyang gsal bor shes thabs med pa 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang / zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga ba/paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng brgyad pa bstan pa'i dbang phyug lta bu mi nyung 390

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa—ba zhig yod/ gal te gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag 'god skabs chos lugs so sor ma phye bar rtsom pa po so so'i mtshan gyi ming yig dang po gang yin pa ste/gung thang bla ma zhang lta bu'i (gu)dang / 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal lta bu'i ('go)sgrub khang blo bzang tshul khrims lta bu'i (sgrub)bcas ga/zhir bzung nas de dag gi go rim sgrig stangs thad sum cu ba'i skabs nas bshad pa ltar/ thog mar ming gzhi rkyang pa ka mad sum cu tham pa so so'i skabs su bab pa'i go rim ltar bsgrigs te/ de nas rang rang gi ming gzhi de la dbyangs yod pa rnams dang / de nas rjes 'jug yod la sngon 'jug med pa/ de nas smad 'dogs dang sngon 'jug gnyis yod la gzhan dag rnams med pa/ de nas smad 'dogs dang sngon rjes gsum yod la gzhan dag rnams med pa/ de nas sngon rjes mgo gsum yod la smad 'dogs med pa/ de nas sngon rjes mgo 'dogs bzhi yod la dbyangs med pa/ de nas sngon rjes mgo 'dogs dbyangs bcas lnga ka yod pa rnams go rim ma nor bar sgrig dgos/ ('di shes na dag yig tshig mdzod myur du 'tshol thub pa'i lde mig lag tu yod pa dang 'dra)dkar chag rig pa'i nang gses bcu bdun pa/ gsung 'bum khag gi nang du yod pa'i lo rgyus dang rig gnas rnams zur 'don byed 'os dang mi 'os skor/ spyir btang bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas skor gyi dpe cha'i gras la rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis yod/ rigs gcig ni/ dpe cha de rigs lta klog 391

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs byed mkhan mang ba'i stabs kyis zur du par skrun byas pa mang po yod pa'i rigs gcig dang / rigs gnyis pa ni/ dpe cha de rtsom pa po so so'i gsung 'bum khag gi nang du yod pa de ma gtogs zur du bshu 'bri dang nga/ra bskrun byas med stabs dpe rgyun ha cang dkon pa'i rigs yin/rigs dang po de ni rtsom pa po so so'i gsung 'bum cha tshang ba'i gras su yod pa rnams zur 'don ma byas par rang 'jags su bzhag nas/ cha ma tshang ba'i gras nas zur 'don byas chog pas de la stabs mi bde ba med cing / de 'dra'i lugs srol yang sngar nas yod mus yin/rigs gnyis pa de ni/ dkar chag 'god pa dang dpe mdzod khang gsar du 'dzugs skabs thag gcod par dka' ngal che shos gras shig yin/spyir btang bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas skor gyi dpe cha khag gcig ha cang dpe rgyun dkon pa'i thog bla ma tsho'i gsung 'bum nang du yod pa de ma gtogs gzhan dag bris ma dang / par ma'i rigs gtan nas med pas gsung 'bum nang rang 'jags bzhag na dpyad gzhi'i yig cha khag gang du 'tshol dgos min rgyus mnga' med pa rnams kyis gsung 'bum nang du de 'dra yod pa'i dogs pa tsam yang byed mi srid la/ gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig gi nang du yod pa rnams zur 'don byas na gsung 'bum cha tshang ba de yang cha ma tshang bar 'gyur bas ci 'dra byed dgos snyam na/ gsung 'bum nang yod pa de ma gtogs gzhan dag bris ma dang par ma gang yang med pa'i rigs rnams gsung 'bum kha mi 'thor ba'i ched du rang 'jags su bzhag nas dkar chag 'god skabs sde tshan rang rang so so'i mjug tu 392

bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/ —dpe cha de rigs kyi mtshan byang rgyas bsdus gnyis ka bkod nas de bla ma so so'i gsung 'bum pod gang dang gang gi nang du yod pa'i skor gyi dkar chag zur pa kha gsal bris thog rjes su cha rkyen 'dzoms na de rigs par slog dang / dpe skrun byas nas zur 'don byed thub na legs po yod/bzhi ba/ dkar chag rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'god tshul dang de'i lag len gyi re'u migadakar chag rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum zer ba ni/ dkar chag thog dgod bya'i nang don rgyas bsdus kyi sgo nas 'jog pa yin/ de yang dpyad gzhi'i yig cha lta klog byed mkhan dang / bdag gnyer byed mkhan so so'i rig gnas chu tshad mtho dman 'bring gsum gyi dgos mkho dang bstun pa ste/rig gnas chu tshad mtho ba rnams kyis dmigs bsal dgos mkho yod pa dang dus tshod yod skabs dkar chag zhib rgyas blta dgos kyi yod la/las brel che skabs zhib rgyas de 'dra blta long med pas bsdus par bltas kyang chog pa dang / bdag gnyer byed mkhan rnams kyis yig thog tu 'khod pa'i dkar chag zhib rgyas de 'dra sems la nges mi thub pas/ blta klog byed rgyu dang zhib bsher rtsis len bya dgos byung na dkar chag rgyas par lta dgos shing / dkar chag bsdus pa'i nang don rnams blo la nges gang thub byed dgos pa yin/ rig gzhung gi chu tshad dma' zhing dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'tshol zhib byed pa'i nus rtsal zhan pa'i las dang po ba rnams kyis thog mar dkar chag bsdus pa lta klog byas te rim gyis blo kha 393

dung dkar blo ba/zang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtho bar gyur mtshams dkar chag rgyas 'bring gnyis kyang lta klog thub pa yong /dkar chag rgyas pa 'bri tshul ni/ shog ngos chen po gcig gam yang na shog ngos phan tshun gnyis kyi ngos su yig gzugs che chung ji ltar 'dod pa'i yig phreng re'i 'phred thig btab pa de'i ring tshad dum bu bcu dgur bgos shing / zheng tshad yig phreng gnyis shong ba'i tshad du byas pa'i dum bu so sor nang don gang dang gang 'god dgos pa'ihore'u mig gsham gsal ltar kha gsal 'god dgos shing / nang don de dag yig phreng star pa gcig gi ngos su shong ba zhig bris tshe deb ha cang chen po zhig ma byung na shong mi thub pas shog ngos phan tshun gnyis su bgos pa'am/ yang na dpe cha le tshan re la shog ngos re byas te bris na legs pa gsham gyi re'u mig la gzigs/dkar chag 'bring ba 'bri tshul ni/ gong gsal dkar chag rgyas pa'i nang don dum bu bcu bdun gyi nang nas/ dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/lnga ba/ bdun pa/ bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa mnyam du 'bri rgyu/bcu gsum pa/ bcu drug pa/ bcu bdun pa/ bco brgyad pa bcas 'bri dgos shing / gzhan rnams ma bris kyang chog pa gsham gyi re'u mig la gzigs/dkar chag bsdus pa 'bri tshul ni/ gong gsal dkar chag rgyas pa'i nang don bcu bdun gyi nang nas/ dang po/ bzhi ba/ lnga ba/ bdun pa/bcu drug pa/ bcu bdun pa/ bco brgyad pa bcas nges par du 'bri 394

bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/dgos shing / gzhan rnams ma bris kyang chog pa dang de ni shog byang chung ngu'i nang du yang shong bas stabs bde po yod pa gsham gyi re'u mig la gzigs/ chi dkar chag rgyas pa 'god tshul gyi lag len re'u migadum bu'i rnam grangs/ dgod bya'i nang don/dang po/ spyi'i ang rtags/gnyis pa/ sde tshan gyi ming /gsum pa/ ka tho/bzhi ba/ dpe thog gi kha byang /lnga ba/ bsdus ming /drug pa/ ming gzhan/bdun pa rtsom pa po'i ming /brgyad pa/ ming gzhan/dgu ba/ brtsams pa'i dus tshod/bcu ba/ nang don gtso bo/bcu gcig pa/ bris ma/bcu gnyis pa/ par ma/bcu gsumapa/ ldeb ring thung /bcu bzhi ba/ ngos re'i yig phreng /bco lnga ba/ pod grangs/bcu drug pa/ le tshan/ 395

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcu bdun pa/ shog grangs/bco brgyad pa/ cha tshang yin min/bcu dgu ba/ tshar grangs/dkar chag rgyas pa 'god tshul gyi dper brjod/spyi'i ang grangs/ 175sde tshan/ lo rgyus/ka tho/ ka gdape cha'i kha byang / 〈kun gzigs lnga ba chen mo'i phyi'i rnam thar rang gsung du ku la'i gos bzang 〉bsdus ming / 〈rgyal ba lnga ba chen mo'i rang rnam〉ming gzhan/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga ba'i rang rnam/rtsom pa po/ za hor gyi ban+de3 ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ming gzhan/ tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gang shar rang grol/brtsams pa'i dus/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags bya/ spyi lo 1681lo/nang don gtso bo/ rang nyid kyi mes po nas sku gshegs pa'i snga lo'i bar gyi lo rgyus dang / gal che'i gnas tshul mang po yod/par ma/ 'bras spungs pho brang gi par ma/ 396

bod kyi dkar chag rig pa/ldeb ring thung / ldeb ring mda' tshad ma/ngos re'i yig phreng / ngos rer yig phreng drugapod grangs/ (ca)le tshan/ gcigashog grangs/ 364cha tshang yod med/ cha tshang yod/tshar grangs/ tshar gsum/dkar chag 'bring ba 'god tshul gi lag len re'u migare'u mig dang po/ spyi'i ang rtags/gnyis pa/ sde tshan/gsum pa/ ka tho/bzhi ba/ dpe thog gi kha byang /lnga ba/ bsdus ming /drug pa/ rtsom pa po'i ming /bdun pa/ bris ma dang par ma/brgyad pa/ shog ldeb ring thung /dgu ba/ le tshan/bcu ba/ shog grangs/bcu gcig pa/ cha tshang yod med/dkar chag 'bring ba 'god tshul gyi dper brjod/spyi'i ang rtags/ 317397

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ sde tshan/ lo rgyus rnam thar/ka tho/ lo rgyus rnam thar/ka tho/ (ka)nas (tsa)bar/dpe cha'i kha byang / 〈dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉bsdus ming / 〈lho brag chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉rtsom pa po/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/bris ma dang par ma/ lho brag gi par rnying ba/shog ldeb ring thung / dpe ring mda' tshad ma/le tshan/ (ka)—(ca)bar le tshan1(cha)—(tsa)bar le tshan12shog grangs/ 679 cha tshang yod med/ le tshan ja pa mi tshang / gzhan rnams tshang /dkar chag bsdus pa'i lag len re'u migare'u mig dang po/ spyi'i ang rtags/gnyis pa/ dpe thog gi kha byang /gsum pa/ bsdus ming /bzhi ba/ rtsom pa po/lnga ba/ le tshan ang grangs/ 398

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ —da —drug pa/ shog grangs/bdun pa/ cha tshang yod med/dkar chag bsdus pa'i dpe brjod/spyi'i ang rtags/ 357dpe thog gi kha byang / 〈khyab bdag rig 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang bo'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa〉bsdus ming / 〈byang bdag rig 'dzin chen mo'i rnam thar〉rtsom pa po/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga ba(gang shar rang grol)le tshan kha grangs/ 1shog grangs/ 644cha tshang yod med/ bar nas shog grangs 43pa mi tshang /lnga ba/ rgya yig dang bod yig gi bka' bstan dkar chag zhib bsdur dang phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod yig gi dpe cha'i dkar chag skor/bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur du yod pa'i gsung rab dang rig 399

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnas skor 'ga' zhig rgya yig bod yig gnyis kar yod pa dang / 'ga' zhig bod yig tu yod pa las rgya yig tu med pa/ 'ga' zhig rgya yig tu yod kyang bod yig tu med pa/ rgya yig gi glegs bam tshad gzhi ni bod yig gi glegs bam gcig la rgya yig gi glegs bam gnyis brtsi ba sogs mi 'dra ba yod pas/ rgya yig bod yig gnyis kar yod pa'i rigs phan tshun bsdur nas bltas na rgya yig gi gsung rab lta klog byed pa las bod yig gi dpe cha de klog na go bde ba yod tshod 'dugargya yig gi bka' bstan dkar chag ni/ sos rgyal rabs kyi gong ma dang po sos wen rdi rgyal pos srid dbang bzung skabs skya ser gyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa mang po la mngags bcol byas te/ de sngon han shar ma'i rgyal rabs gnyis pa han ming rtis rgyal bo nas sos wen rdi rang nyid kyi srid dbang bzung ba'i bar sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rgya nag gi skad du 'gyur ba yod tshad dag ther byas nas dkar chag 'god dgos par bka' phab pa bzhin/ rgya dkar nag gi skad yig gnyis kar byang chub pa'i hwa shang mkhas pa chen po yan tsung gis gtso mdzad pa'i mkhas pa mang pos sa bcad drug yod pa'i dkar chag thog ma mdzad/de'i sa bcad dang po rkyang 'gyur gyi rigs/ gnyis pa ldab 'gyur gyi rigs/ gsum pa zur bkol byas chog pa'i rigs/ bzhi ba bsgyur 'phro lus pa dang bsgyur zin ma rnyed pa kha skong dgos rigs/ lnga ba brdzus ma phyir bton pa'i rigs/ drug pa dpyad gzhir bzhag pa'i rigs/ bcas khag drug tu bgos pa'i dkar chag gsal bo zhig yin/ de rjes thang rgyal 400

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa rabs kyi gong ma bcu ba thang zhon tsung gi kha'i yon khri lo bco brgyad pa'i skabs/ de sngon han mingardis rgyal bo'i yung phing lo bcu ba nas gong lo'i bar lo drug brgya drug cu re gsum gyi ring la/ lo tsā ba brgya dang don drug byung ba rnams kyis bsgyur ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos khyon bsdoms glegs bam ('di'i glogs bam ni dpe cha chung ba rnams cha tshang re la glegs bam rer brtsis pa yin pas bod kyi glegs bam tshad gzhi dang mi 'dra)chig stong lnga brgya bcu med bdun yod pa rnams dag ther dang dkar chag 'god dgos par bka' phab pa ltar mkhas pa rnams kyis kha'i yu'an lu (lūs)zhes pa'i dkar chag cig mdzod/ de'i sgrig stangs ni gong dang 'dra/ de rjes thang rgyal rabs kyi gong ma bcu gsum pa thang the tsung rgyal bos srid dbang bzung skabs ṭin yu'an khri lo lnga ba'i bar lo drug cu'i ring la lo tsā ba brgyad byung ba rnams kyis snga phyir bsgyur ba'i glegs bam nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe gnyis gsar du bsnan pa'i dkar chag ṭin yu'an lūs zhes pa zhig mdzad/ de rjes su sung byang ma'i rgyal rabs kyi gong ma gnyis pa sung tha'i tsung gi srid dbang bzung ba'i tha'i phing shing go (ṣing kwa)lo bdun pa nas sung rgyal rabs gsum pa sung ṭin tsung gi tā krung shing dru (ṣi'ang)lo bzhi ba'i bar lo nyi shu rtsa drug ring la lo tsā ba drug byung ba rnams kyis gsar 'gyur glegs bam sum brgya brgyad cu gya bzhi byung ba bsnan pa'i dkar chag 〈 shing h+phu lu 〉(ṣi'ang h+phu lus)zhes pa zhig brtsams/ de dus gsar du gdan drangs pa'i rgya dper+sha'aga' zhig bsgyur 'phror bzhag pa rnams gong ma de'i sras sos rin tsung (zhin)rgyal bos lo tsā ba rnams la mu 40/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ mthud nas bsgyur du bcug pa bzhin/ rgyal bo de'i cing yi'u (king)khri lo bzhi bar yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i glegs bam brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe brgyad gsar du bsnan pa'i dkar chag 〈 cing yi'u lu 〉zhes pa zhig brtsams/ de nas yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma hu pi li se chen han gyi kri yu'an khri lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar lo nyis brgya lnga bcu lhag gi ring la lo tsā ba bzhi byung ba rnams kyis gsar 'gyur glegs bam brgya dang bco lnga byung ba rnams kha snon dang / rgya bod kyi bka' 'gyur khag gnyis phan tshun bsdur nas ma tshang ba rnams kha gsab byed dgos par bka' phab pa bzhin/'gro mgon 'phags pa'i sku tsha bdag chen dharma pā la ra k+ṣi tas gtso bo gnang ba'i 'og bod rgya sog gsum gyi lo tsā bdang mkhas pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis zhib bsdur gnang ste gsar 'gyur dang kha skong dgos rigs skabs dang 'tshams par bcug yod/de'i sgrig lugs ni/ mdo sde/ 'dul ba/ mngon pa/ gsum po re la theg pa che chung gnyis re phye zhing / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde la mtshan nyid kyi mdo sde dang / gsang sngags kyi mdo sde gnyis su phye nas/ mgor skad gnyis shan sbyar dang / mjug tu mdzad byang dang 'gyur byang /dogs pa yod pa'i rigs dpyad gzhir bzhag ste glegs bam bdun brgya bcu med bzhir byas pa'i dkar chag 〈tā yon snu bo'u ṣan thung lu 〉zhes pa zhig brtsams/de rjes man ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma mi rabs bzhi ba chen lung gi dus pe cin du btsugs pa'i bod chos slob grwa'i mi bzang gung mgon po 402

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ da wa—skyabs kyis bod yig gis brtsams pa'i 〈 rgya nag chos 'byung 〉zhes grags pa de'i kha byang 〈 rgya nag gi yul du dam pa'i chos dar tshul gtso bor bshad pa blo gsal kun tu dga' ba'i rna rgyan 〉zhes 'khod pa zhig lha sa dang / sde dge gnyis su par du bskrun yod pa dang / deng sang zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas lcags dpar du bskrun yod/ de'i nang bod yig dang rgya yig gi bka' bstan phan tshun bsdur nas bod yig tu med pa rnams la mchan bu'i yig chung btab yod kyang / bod yig tu yod pa las rgya yig tu med pa'i rigs rnams ma bkod pa ni rgya nag tu chos 'byung tshul gtso bor bshad pa'i dbang gis red/ nga tshos bod yig dang rgya yig gi bka' bstan dkar chag khag phan tshun go bsdur byas te/ rgya yig tu yod kyang bod yig tu bsgyur med pa'i rigs gang dang gang yod/ bod yig tu yod kyang rgya yig tu bsgyur med pa'i rigs gang dang gang yod/ rgya bod gnyis ka'i yig thog tu yod pa gang dang gang yod/ rgya yig nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba mang nyung ji tsam yod/ rgya gar yi ge nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba mang nyung ji tsam yod bcas don tshan lnga la zhib 'jug nan tan zhig byas te dkar chag gsal bo lta klog bde ba zhig byung na rgya bod yig bsgyur gnang mkhan dang / zhib 'jug mdzad po rnams la phan thogs chen po yong nges yin kyang / las don 'di 'dra sgrub par dus tshod ring zhing dka' tshegs che tsam yin pa'i thog kho bo ni gal che'i las 'gan sgrub dgos mang zhing dus tshod dang cha rkyen gyis ma ldang ba bcas mkhas pa'i dbang bo rnams kyis zhib dpyad dang ched rtsom gnang rogs zhes re 'bod 403

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhu rgyu tsam yin/phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod yig gi dpe cha'i dkar chag/ skor/dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus mjug dang bcu dgu ba'i dus mjug nas dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas mes rgyal nang logs dang bod sa gnas su btsan 'dzul byed 'go tshugs ste/ kho tshos stod mnga' ris dang gtsang khul gyi dgon rnying khag nas bod gna' rabs kyi dpe cha mang po rku 'phrog byas pa dang / 'ga' zhig tshong ba dang slob gnyer bar brdzus te bod yig gi dpe cha bris ma dang par ma mang po mngon nyo lkog 'khyer byas par ma zad/ 1959lor bod sa gnas su ngo log zing 'khrug langs skabs bod rigs spun zla dang / chos lugs grub mtha' khag gi mi khag cig phyi rgyal du bros pa dang chabs cig sa skya dang / mnga' ris/ gtsang khul bcas kyi dgon pa khag nas gna' rabs kyi dpe rnying mang po phyi rgyal du gyar te 〈 deb dmar gsar ma 〉dang /〈 hor rgyal rabs〉 bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgya'/ gyi gsung 'bum cha tshang sogs phon chen po zhig dbyi ta li dang / 'jar man nub ma bcas nas par du bskrun yod/ da dung dpe rgyun dkon pa mang po zhig dbyin ji chen po'i dngos mang bshams ston khang dang / h+pha ran si'i rgyal sa pā li/ dbyi ta li sogs su nyar tshags byas yod cing / kho tshos bris pa'i bod yig gi dpe cha'i dkar chag tu bkod pa'i dpe cha mang po zhig ni kho tsho'i lag tu med par ma zad/ rgyal nang du yang da phan btsal rnyed ma byung zhing / nyung shas shig kho tsho'i lag tu tshud nas rgyal nang du dpe rgyun 404

bodakyidakarachagarigapa/ —da chad zin pa bcas de tsho'i 'tshol zhib dang myur skyob bya rgyu'i thad phyi dang nang gi 'gog rkyen mang po zhig yod stabs/ lo bcu phrag tsam phyin na las don de sgrub thub pa ha cang dka' ba bcas ni dkar chag 'god rgyu dang /dkar chag zhib 'jug mu mthud du byed thub min la thug pa'i gnad don chen po zhig red/mjug bsdu/ gong du gsal ba'i bod kyi dkar chag rig pa zhes pa 'di ni/ bod kyi btsan po khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon nas da lta'i bar lo grangs chig stong brgya dang brgyad bcu gya bzhi'i ring bka' bstan dang gsung rab rig gnas bcas kyi dkar chag bsgrigs pa'i nyams myong phyogs bsdoms dang / phyogs bsdoms de dag gzhir byas pa'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi gnad bsdus nyung ngu zhig yin zhing / gnad bsdus 'di rnams gang las drangs pa'i dpyad gzhi khag la da dung ched gnyer gyis zhib 'jug byed rgyur dka' ngal mang po phrad stabs 'di'i nang du bshad ma thub pa dang zur tsam zhig las gsal bo byung med pa/ cha ma tshang ba sogs kyi skyon cha mang po yod nges kyang / rang mnyam blo dman rnams kyi blo sgo 'byed pa'i brjed tho dang / rang rigs blo gsar gzhon nu rnams la mdzub mo ri ston gyi ngo sprod bya rgyur cung zad phan nus thon srid snyam nas bris pa yin pas/ rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi dge mtshan ldan pa'i dgongs 'char dang skyon brjod mdzub ston yod pa zhu rgyu yin/405

bod yig dpe rnying par slun dang 'brel ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhig skor gleng ba/rang re'i ljongs su bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i brgyud rim nang bod yig gi par skrun las rigs kyis ha cang gal che ba'i go gnas bzung yod cing / spyi lo'i gong gi lo brgya phrag kha shas nang thog mar shing la srog chags dang me tog sogs kyi mdzes ris dang / mu 'brel sgrung gtam ri mo sna tshogs rko dkrol byed pa'i lag rtsal byung ba nas bod yig gi par skrun lag rtsal ma byung bar nyung mthar lo grangs chig stong bzhi brgya lhag tsam song yod pa dang / dus rabs bco lnga pa'i 'gor bod yig gi par skrun lag rtsal dar 'go tshugs pa nas da bar lo grangs lnga brgya bdun cu don brgyad tsam song yod/ bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob rjes bod yig par skrun gyi las don khag 'phrul chas can dang rang 'gul can du 'gyur ba'i 'go tshugs shing / lhag par skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs pa nas bzung bod yig gi par skrun lag rtsal de glog las can dang / glog rdul 'phrul chas can du gong 'phel mgyogs por 'gro ba'i dus rabs gsar pa zhig tu slebs yod pa red/bod yig dpe rnying par skrun gyi las don legs po bsgrubs na bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i las don gong 'phel gtong thub pa dang / bod kyi 406

bod yig dbe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig da wa—rig gnas che chung bcu'i slob gso mi rigs can du 'gyur zin pa'i lo rgyus dang nyams myong la phyi mig bltas te rig gnas gsar pa'i slob gso de mi rigs can du 'gyur rgyur rmang gzhi 'ding thub pa/ lhag don rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi nyung shas kyis gung khran tang gis bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas shul med du btang zin pa red ces skyon 'dzugs byas par bya spyod ngo ma'i thog nas lan btab ste mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur srung skyong bya rgyur phan thogs yod pa sogs kyi gal che'i don snying ldan yod pas/ nga tshos bod gna' rabs kyi par skrun las don dang 'brel ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhig la phyogs yongs nas sngar dran deng bsdur gyis skyon spangs dge 'tshol bya rgyu ni dgos nges shig red/ bod kyi par skrun las don 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus skor la de sngon bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gi blo mthun tshe ring phun tshogs lags nas 〈snga rabs bod kyi par skrun dang dpar khang skor gleng ba 〉zhes pa'i ched rtsom zhig bris gnang yod pa der gsal bas skyar zlos kyi ngal ba spangs shing / thengs 'dir ched rtsom de'i kha skong zhabs 'degs kyi tshul du bod yig dpe rnying par skrun gyi dge mtshan dang nyams myong / las yun/ las rigs/ las rim/ lag rtsal/gla phogs dang bya dga'/ 'gro gron/ par khang gi sgrig srol lam lugs/par shing bed spyod kyi dus yun/ dpe skrun sde tshan gyi las ka'i phan nus sogs kyi gnad don skor la lo shas ring zhib 'jug thengs mang bgyis pa'i myong tshor dang mjug sdom gnad bsdus shig zhu rgyur/ 407

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang po/ dpe rnying par skrun byed pa'i dge mtshan dang nyams myong /1 yig nor mi 'byung ba/ de sngon bod la par skrun lag rtsal ma dar gong ste 1425lo phan chad ni dpe rnying tshang ma bris ma yin pa dang /de yang gcig la gcig brgyud kyis bshu 'bri byas rjes zhus dag nan po ma byung bas yig nor mang ba/ gser dngul gyis bris pa rnams yig gzugs dang lag rtsal thad nas bshad na rtsa che'i rig dngos dang dpyad gzhi yin yang / mang che bar zhus dag nan po byung med stabs chad lhag dang yig nor mang zhing dpe rnying mang po zhig ni yig gzugs dbu med yin thog bsdus yig mang ba dang / yi ge'i brda dag dang yig gzugs gcig gyur med pa/ dpe 'grems khyab chung bar brten bod kyi skad yig dang brda dag gcig gyur byed rgyur nus pa 'don thub kyi med/ par skrun byas na zhus dag rim pa bzhi (smar zhus/ bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas )ma brgyud par par skrun byed kyi med pas yig nor mi 'byung ba'i khyad chos yod/2 ma dpe bshu 'bri'i dka' ngal sel thub pa/ dpe cha ba/la che'i rigs lta klog byed mkhan mang yang bshu 'bri byed dgos na dus tshod ring po 'gor ba dang / ma dpe sna 'dzoms shig 'tshol bsdu bya rgyur dka' ngal che ba/ dpe rgyun dkon pa'i gnad don thag gcod mi thub pa'i dbang gis ma dpe brlag thor yong sla ba bcas kyi skyon cha yod/ par skrun byas 408

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig ——da wa —na klog pa po rnams kyis bshu 'bri bya dgos pa'i dka' ngal sel thub pa dang / gal te par shing zad gron che ba'i dbang gis slar yang shing par gsar pa brko dgos byung na de sngon par skrun byas pa'i par thengs dang po gnyis pa'i gras kyi par ma de gzhir bzung nas par yig bskyar ma bris pa'am yang na par skrun byas rjes kyi par thengs dang po'i skabs shog srab ngos gnyis la par brgyab pa zhig par brko thengs rjes ma'i skabs kyi par yig byed rgyur nyar tshags thub kyi yod stabs/ par yig yang bskyar 'bri ma dgos pa yong gi yod/3 dpe 'grems khyab che bas rgya che'i klog pa po'i dgos mkho skong thub pa/ shing par thog par skrun byas rjes bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/gsung 'bum pod grangs mang po yod pa'i rigs lo re par grangs mang shos brgya dang lnga bcu lhag par rgyag mi thub kyang / pod grangs re gnyis las med pa rnams cha tshang nyis brgya lnga bcu tsam par thub kyi yod pas bris ma dang bsdur na dpe 'grems khyab che ba'i khyad par yod/ deng sang bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gnyis ka lo gcig la cha tshang bdun cu lhag par 'debs mi thub cing / mkho 'don rkyang pa'i rigs de las ldab gcig tsam mang ba par 'debs thub kyi yod/4 ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang / legs sgrig srung skyob bcas thub pa/par skrun byas na dpe 'grems kyi rgya khyon bris ma las che ba yod stabs ma dpe khungs btsan zhig 'tshol bsdu bya rgyu'i 'gan khur rang shugs su yong gi yod pa dang / ma dpe khag mang phan tshun bsdur nas legs sgrig byed 409

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thub pa/ ma dpe dkon pa'i rkyen gyis gal che'i ma dpe brlag thor mi 'byung ba'i srung skyob thub pa yong gi yod/ ma dpe gcig las med pa'i rigs par skrun ma byas na gcig pu de yang srung skyob byed rgyu ha cang dka'/da phan dpe rnying gal che'i rigs mang po zhig dpe mdzod khang nas brlag thor song ba'i rgyu mtshan sna tshogs yod srid kyang mang po zhig ni dpe skrun byed mi thub pa'i dbang gis byung ba yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ blo mthun 'ga' zhig gis ma dpe gcig las med pa'i rigs par skrun byas na ma dpe de'i rin thang med pa chags rgyu yin pas par skrun byed rgyu med pa'i ngos 'dzin gnang gi 'dug nga rang gi bsam par dngos po de'i rin thang che chung mi tshang mas shes pa byed dgos na tshang mar mthong du 'jug dgos pa dang / dngos po de'i 'dra par dang 'grel bshad cha tshang ba dpe skrun byas nas rgyal khab phyi nang du 'grems spel byas na/ da gzod bod sa gnas su yod pa'i rig gnas dngos rdzas khag 'dzam gling thog mthong dkon pa'i rtsa che'i rin thang can yin par mi tshang mas shes rtogs thub pa yong gi red/ rig gnas dngos rdzas de tsho khungs skyel ra 'phrod byed thub pa'i tshad ldan yig cha mang po zhig dpe cha ring po de tsho'i nang nas btsal rnyed thub kyi yod pas ma dpe gcig las med pa de tsho yang par skrun 'grems spel byas na ma dpe de'i rtsa che'i rin thang lta klog byed mkhan tshos shes thub pa dang / rtsi mthong che ru 'gro rgyur phan thogs yod/5 bod skad kyi brda dag dang tha snyad yul skad bcas gcig gyur byed rgyur phan thogs chen po yod/ deng skabs 'dzam gling thog gi sgra rig 410

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhigamakhas pa rna nga po zhig gis bod la yul skad rigs mi 'dra ba lngar phye yod pa dang / rgyal nang gi bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug mkhas dbang rnams kyis bod skad la yul skad rigs gsum (dbus gtsang / khams/ a mdo/)du bsdus nas 'byung 'gyur bod kyi skad yig gcig gyur bya rgyu'i gzhi 'dzin sa'i rmang gzhi'i yul skad ni lha sa'i skad kyi thog gcig gyur byed dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin gnang ste de'i skor la rgyu mtshan mang po gsungs yod/gnad don de'i thad rang rigs kyi mkhas dbang rnam pa tsho'i dgongs tshul 'dra min yod par brten nga tshos slar yang gom gang mdun spos kyis bod kyi yul skad dang phal skad gang yin la zhib 'jug bya dgos pa los yin/'on kyang dus rabs bco lnga pa ste/ 1410(ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yung lo'i khri lo brgyad pa lcags stag )lor nan cing du bod yig gi bka' 'gyur par skrun byas pa'i par thengs dang po de ri bo rtse lnga'i dgon par phul zhing /par thengs gnyis pa'i gras karma pa dang / phag gru/ rje tsong kha pa bcas la par phud re 'bul gnang mdzad pa de nas bzung bod du par skrun lag rtsal dar 'go tshugs te/ grub mtha' khag gi bla ma mang po'i gsung 'bum par skrun byas pa des dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi yul skad gcig gyur med pa mang po zhig thag nye ru song ba ma zad/ de sngon gcig gyur du gnas mus yin pa'i rtsa ba'i tha snyad dang brda sprod rig pa rnams kyang mu mthud rang 'jagasasu gnas thub pa byung yod/de yang bod du dus rabs bdun ba'ilokha dang / bstan pa snga dar/bod sil bu dang bstan pa phyi dar/ par skrun dar 'go tshugs pa'i dus 411

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skabs bcas bzhi ni gna' rabs dpe rnying 'phel rgyas kyi dus rim bzhi yin zhing / skabs de'i ring gi bod yig dpe rnying ni mdo dbus khams gsum dang bcas pa'i bod rigs bar phan tshun thun mong du go thub pa'i phal skad dang rnam kun zhing 'brog sa khul so sor kha gram nas sdod skabs bed spyod gtong ba'i yul skad gnyis la zhib 'jug byed rgyur med du mi rung ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha zhig yin pas/ yig cha de dag gi nang nas dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / 'grim 'grul gyi dka' ngal/ skad yig gi gcig gyur khyad chos/ yul skad mi 'dra ba'i bar gyi 'gal ba bcas 'tshol bsdu dang legs sgrig bya rgyu mang po yod la/ 'byung 'gyur bod rigs 'dus sdod sa gnas khag gi yul skad 'tshol zhib bya rgyur phan thogs chen po yod pa zhig yin pa lo rgyus kyi nyams myong thog nas ra 'phrod byung yod/ gnyis pa/ bod yig dpe cha par skrun byed pa'i las rgyun ring thung /rang gis mthong myong ba'i da yod dpyad gzhi'i yig cha gzhir bzung na/ pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis snar thang gi bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur par skrun byas pa dang / sde dge rgyal po bstan pa tshe ring pha bu gnyis ring sde dge'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur par skrun byas pa gnyis kyi bar lo kha shas ma gtogs dus skabs gcig mtshungs lta bu yin/snar thang bka' 'gyur gyi par ni/ spyi lo 1730lo'i ston khar 'go 4/2

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig da wa—tshugs te spyi lo 1732lo'i bod zla dang po'i nang mjug sgril ba'i bar lo gcig dang zla ba drug las 'gor med/ sde dge bka' 'gyur ni snar thang bka' 'gyur par skrun ma byas gong gi lo gcig gi sngon la 'go tshugs zin kyang mjug sgriX dus lo gcig gi rjes su ma gtogs grub ma thub/ phyogs mtshungs snar thang gi bstan 'gyur ni spyi lo 1741lo'i bod zla gsum pa'i nang las 'go tshugs nas spyi lo 1742lo'i bod zla bcu pa'i dga' ldan lnga mchod nyin mjug sgril ba'i bar las rgyun lo gcig dang zla ba bdun zhag nyi shu rtsa lnga las 'gor med cing / sde dge bstan 'gyur ni snar thang bstan 'gyur las 'go ma tshugs gong gi lo gsum dang zla ba bcu gcig gi gong la 'go tshugs zin kyang mjug sgril dus snar thang bstan 'gyur las lo gcig rdang zla ba drugatregi rjes te khyon sdom las rgyun lo lnga dang zla ba drug song rjes gzhi nas mjug sgril ba red/ snar thang gi bka' bstan 'gyur dang sde dge'i bka' bstan 'gyur gnyis par skrun byed pa po'i sems shugs kyi ngos nas bshad na khyad par gtan nas med kyang / dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs thad nas bshad na pho lha ba ni bod sa gnas yongs kyi srid 'dzin rgyal po yin pa dang / sde dge rgyal po ni bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mnga' 'og tu gnas pa'i sa khul gcig gi sa spyod rgyal phran gyi stobs shugs tsam red/ las mi dang lag rtsal stobs shugs sgrig 'dzugs byed pa'i dbang cha'i ngos nas bshad na yang srid skyong rgyal po dang sa spyod rgyal phran bar gyi khyad par chen po yod pas mi shugs mang po dus gcig tu sgrig 'dzugs dang bkod 'doms byed thub min gyi dbye ba yod/ de'i 4/3

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skor la gsham du gsal ba'i snar thang dang sde dge'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur khag gnyis kyi las mi'i grangs dang / gla phogs/ khyon yongs kyi 'gro song sdom 'bor bcas kyi thog nas gsal bshad byed thub/de sngon tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos bka' 'gyur par rko'i dbu btsugs te yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i pod nyi shu rtsa brgyad tsam las spub ma thub par lus shing / skabs der lag rtsal byang chub pa tshos zla ba rer par shing lnga nas drug yas mas dang / 'bring gras kyis zla ba rer par shing gsum nas bzhi/ mang che bas gcig nas gnyis bar las grub mi thub cing / tha gras tshos zla ba rer par shing re re yang grub ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis po ti nyi shu rtsa brgyad la lo bdun 'gor ba'i lo rgyus yod/ snar thang bka' 'gyur par rko byed skabs lag rtsal byang chub pa tshos zla ba rer par shing bcu drug nas nyi shu rtsa gsum bar dang / 'bring gras kyis bcu nas bco lnga bar/ 'ga' zhig gis brgyad nas bcu gnyis bar/ mang che bas lnga nas bdun bar/ lag rtsal zhan shos tshos kyang par shing gsum re grub thub pa'i lo rgyus de tshor brtag na skabs der par rko'i lag rtsal gyi myur tshad ldab gnyis nas lnga bar mgyogs su phyin yod/ de nas snar thang bstan 'gyur par rko 'go tshugs skabs bka' 'gyur par rko'i las mjug sgril nas lo dgu las song med stabs lag rtsal mi sna'i rmang gzhi sngar yod thog lag rtsal gyi byang tshad sngar las mtho ru song yod pa ni snar thang bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gnyis la pod grangs mang nyung gi khyad par ldab gcig lhag tsam yod rung / 414

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig da wa—par rko mkhan sogs las mi'i grangs phal cher 'dra mtshungs yin pa'i gnas tshul 'og par rko'i las rgyun thad zla ba gcig dang zhag po nyi shu rtsa lnga'i khyad par tsam las med pa de'i thog nas gsal bshad byed thub/gsum pa/ par skrun gyi las rigs rnam grangs/par shing thog par rko'i las grwa tshugs skabs 'go byed pa dang bdag gnyer mi snar phud pa'i las rigs rnam grangs bcu gnyis yod de/①zhus dag pa/ ⑧shog bzo/ ①yig 'bri ba/ dushing bzo ba/dhipar rko ba/ dhilha bris pa/ rjolcags bzo ba/ rjolag rtsal dge rgan/rjoslob phrug ⑩sman pa/ ⑨'che'i5 bzo ba/ ⑫lag g.yog bcas yin zhing / las rigs tshang mar las bgos yod la phan tshun 'brel ba yod pa dang / go rim ldan pa bcas yin stabs 'brel mthud legs po ma byung ba dang go rim 'khrugs na las rim de'i khongs kyi las rigs gzhan rnams las med du sdod dgos pas par rko'i las kar shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs te rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi dpal 'byor thog gyong gun po phog gi yod/ der brten par rko'i las grwa tshugs skabs thog mar gra sgrig gi las don ji tsam legs pa byung na las grwa dngos gzhi'i las chod kyang de tsam gyis che ba yong gi yod pas gra sgrig gi las ka ni ha cang zhib tshags che zhing go rim ldan pa zhig yin dgos/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur par skrun gyi las grwa ni las rigs rnam grangs mang zhing gzhi khyon che bas thog ma'i dus skabs su lag rtsal mi 415

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sna ma ldang ba'i dka' ngal yod la las sgrub myur tshad kyang 'gor po yin pas lag rtsal mi sna gsar pa kha gsab ma byas na las rgyun ring zhing dpal 'byor gyi zad gron chen po yong gi yod stabs/ par skrun las grwa tshugs ring lag rtsal mi sna gsar pa skong 'gugs byas thog las ka dngos kyi nang sbyong brdar byas te tshad gzhi lon pa byung mtshams las grwa dngos gzhir zhugs chog pa'i lam lugs bzos yod cing / las grwa tshugs nas zla ba kha shas song rjes lag rtsal mi sna gsar pa 'tshar longs yong gi yod par brten dus skabs de'i ring par rko ba tsam ma zad/ yig 'bri/lcags bzo/ shing bzo/ zhus dag pa bcas kyi ched las mi sna gsar pa gso skyong byed pa'i go skabs bzang po de dam 'dzin yag po byed thub pa byung yod/ de ni deng skabs kyang dang len byed 'os pa'i mig dpe dang nyams myong rtsa chen zhig red/ gong gsal las rigs khag gi las 'gan ni/1 zhus dag pa/ rig gnas spyi dang ched las shes yon gyi chu tshad mtho zhing par yig dang par shing gnyis kar zhus dag gtong ba'i nyams myong yod pa zhig ste/ de la nang gses phye na rim pa bzhi yod/(1)smar zhus pa/ dpar yig 'bri skabs ma dpe dang par yig gnyis bar yig 'bru dang / shog grangs/ le tshan bcas phan tshun bsdur nas zhus dag gtong mkhan yin/ (2)bskyar zhus pa/ ma yig dang par yig phan tshun bsdur nas zhus dag song zin pa'i gras la yig gzugs legs nyes dang che chung gcig mtshungs byung yod med dang / brkos pa'i yi ge 416

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig da wa—gting zab po byung yod med bcas la zhib bsher byed mkhan yin/ (3)yang zhus pa/ gong gsal gyi zhus dag rim pa gnyis la yang bskyar zhib bsher dang / chad lhag dang spus tshad ma lon pa rnams chad gsab dang /nor bcos/ 'dzugs rgyag bcas kyi 'gan khur mkhan yin/ (4)zhus chen pa/ par yig gi ma yig khag mi 'dra ba rnams phan tshun bsdur nas par yig 'bri gzhi'i ma dpe gtan 'khel byed rgyu dang / par yig bris zin pa rnams yang bskyar ma dpe dang zhib bsdur thengs gcig bya dgos pa/gong gsal zhus dag rim pa gsum la zhib bsher nan tan byung yod med bltas nas tshad gzhi lon pa la 'thus mchan dang / ma lon pa rnams la zhib mchan bkod de legs nyes kyi mjug sdom thag gcod byed mkhan yin/2 shog bzo ba/ par yig 'bri gzhi'i shog bu legs gras dang /lag gdan shog bu bzo rgyu dang / mtha' dras rgyag rgyu bcas kyi 'gan khur dgos/ 3 yig 'bri ba/ par shing thog sbyar rgyu'i par yig gi tshad gzhi gtan 'khel ltar yi ge 'bri mkhan yin/4 shing bzo ba/ par shing las snon byed rgyu dang / par shing 'dul sbyong byed rgyu/ par shing 'jog sa'i kun dga' ra ba bzo rgyu bcas yin/ 5 par rko ba/ par yig gzhir bzung shing par brko rgyu dang /chad pa'i rigs gsab snon/ nor ba'i rigs 'dzugs rgyag byed rgyu/6 lha bris pa/ par yig gi mgo shog dang mjug shog khag la brko 4/7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyu'i lha sku khag gi ma dpe 'bri rtsa 7 lcags bzo ba/ par rko'i lag cha'i gras gsar bzo dang las snon byed rgyu ste/ bzhar gri/ mig gzong / sbo gzong / gseg gcod che chung gnyis/ 'dzugs gzong bzo dbyibs mi 'dra ba lnga gtsabs ste/gzhog sog bcas gtan 'khel tshad gzhi ltar bzo rgyu/8 lag rtsal dge rgan/ gsar 'byor slob phrug rnams la par rko dang yig 'bru sogs ched las khag so so'i lag rtsal slob khrid dang /dngos sbyong / rgyug len bcas byas te tshad gzhi lon pa rnams so so 'i las gnas kyi las grwar 'jug rgyu'i 'gan khur dgos// 9 slob phrug las grwar slebs rjes zla ba kha shas ring lag rtsal dge rgan gyi mdzub ston ltar sbyangs goms thon pa'i slob sbyong byed rgyu dang /lag rtsal dge rgan gyi gzhogs 'degs las ka byed rgyu/10 sman pa/ par skrun las grwa 'go tshugs pa nas mjug ma sgril bar nad par sman ster rgyu dang / nad dgongs 'khrol 'dzin ster rgyu/1sna1 'tshem bzo ba/ snam bu dang phying pa gang rigs las bzos pa'i par shing gi shugs 'tshem rgyu dang / las rigs khag gi gyon chas ral rdol rigs la lhan pa rgyag rgyu/ bya dga' sprod byed kyi gyon chas dang zhwa lham sogs bzo rgyu/12 lag g.yog ched las lag rtsal mi sna khag dang / spyi pa'i thab tshang bcas la ngag bkod ltar gzhogs 'degs las ka byed rgyu bcas red/ 418

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhigabazhi pa/ par skrun las ka'i nang gi las rim/par skrun las grwa 'go tshugs pa nas mjug ma sgril bar du gra sgrig dang / dngos gzhi/ mjug sgril bcas las rim che ba gsum brgyud dgos kyi yod/ ca de'ang thog mar gra sgrig gi skabs/ ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang / zhus dag gtong rgyu/ par yig 'bri byed shog bu dang snag tsha gsog 'jog las snon byed rgyu/ par shing gsog 'jog dang las snon byed rgyu/ par shing 'jog khri bzo rgyu/ par shing gi shubs 'tshem rgyu/ par rko ba'i lag cha khag gsar bzo byed rgyu/ dpal 'byor thog gi 'char gzhi bzo rgyu/ las rigs khag gi lag rtsal mi sna dang mi grangs gtan 'khel byed rgyu sogs yod/dngos gzhi'i las rim ni/ par yig 'bri rgyu dang zhus dag gtong rgyu legs grub zin mtshamasartsopar rko 'go tshugs te le tshan re re dang dum bu re re par brkos zin skabs par shing gnyis phan tshun zhib bsdur byed pa'i zhus dag smar zhus nas zhus chen bar tshar bzhi re ma yig zhus dag gi skabs ltar bya dgos shing / smar zhus grubarjes zhus mtshan bkod nas yang zhus par 'bul rgyu dgos shing / yang zhus grub rjes zhus mchan bkod nas bskyar zhus par 'bul rgyu dang / bskyar zhus grub rjes zhus mchan bkod nas zhus chen par 'bul dgos pa dang / zhus chen pas zhus dag grub rjes par tho'i nang bkod nas par shing do dam par rtsis 4/9

— dungadakarablo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sprad/ des rtsis blangs rjes de sngon gra sgrig zin pa'i par shubs nang bcug nas par shing 'jog sgrom thog go rim ltar bsgrigs te par tho'i nang bkod pa ltar 'tshol bde ba'i kha byang 'god dgos pa bcas yin/par skrun las ka'i nang gi gal che shos kyi lhu tshigs ni zhus dag gi las rim de yin zhing / thog mar gra sgrig skabs ma yig la zhus dag nan tan byed dgos pas ma yig cig lag son byung ma thag zhus dag nan tan ma byas par par skrun byas na ma dag rgyun 'byams chen po yong gi red la/par rko 'go tshugs nas kyang zhus dag nan tan byed dgos pa smos med red/ gong du bshad pa ltar gna' rabs bod kyi dpe skrun las kar las rim zhib tshags che la go rim ldan pa zhig yod pa dang / las don mi sna'i rang rtogs kyi tshad mtho'i 'gan 'khur gyi hur sems che ba bcas kyis dpe skrun gyi las ka'i spus tshad ha cang yag po yod pa red/deng skabs dpe skrun gyi cha rkyen phun sum tshogs shing las ka'i las chod spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs las ldab kha shas kyis mgyogs pa yod/ de yang de sngon ma yig zhus dag grub rjes gtsang bshu thengs gcig rgyag dgos pa tshang ma lag bris la brten dgos pa'i dbang gis dus tshod ha cang ring po 'gor 'gro ba yin/ 'on kyang deng skabs ma yig bshu 'bri byed rgyur glog rdul yig par 'phrul 'khor la brten nas bshu 'bri dang nor bcos skabs 'phral byed chog pas ma yig bshu 'bri'i las ka dka' ngal chen po de rang 'gul can dang 'phrul chas can du bsgyur zin stabs las chod ldab kha shas che ru song yod la/ phyogs mtshungs yi ge sgrig pa'i 420

bod yig dpe rnying par sgrun dang 'brel ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhig —par 'debs 'phrul 'khor la brten nas par yig sgrig chog pas par shing thog lo zla mang por par rko'i las kapyibyed dgos pa'i dka' ngal bsal te par yig gcig gis nang don mi 'dra ba'i dpe cha mang por bed spyod btang nas par 'debs chog pa'i rang 'gul can gyi 'phrul chayoyod par brten/ de sngon par shing thog par 'debs byas pa'i sdom 'bor de lo nyis brgya'i nang gzhi nas ngo grangs khri gsum lon thub tsam zhig yin pa nas deng sang lo gcig nang khri gsum par 'debs byed dgos kyang byed thub par gyur yod/ lhag par du nye ba'i lo shas nang tshan rig lag rtsal bya 'phur ba ltar 'phel rgyas 'gro mgyogs pas glog rdul rtsis rgyag 'phrul 'khor la brten nas ma yig bshu ba dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun bcas tshang ma rang 'gul can dang 'phrul chas can du gyur zin pa red/lnga pa/ par skrun las ka'i lag rtsal skor/bod du par shing rko ba'i lag rtsal thog mar dar nas yun ring ma song bar rje tsong kha pa sku 'das shing / de nas lo bcu bdun song ba'i me rta/ spyi lo 1426lor gong dkar dang sne'u rdzong dpon nam mkha' bzang po bcas la rgyal tshab rin po che dang / rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sogs kyis bka' gnang ba ltar rje tsong kha pa'i gsung 'bum cha tshang par skrun byas pa de'i gras de sngon rtse po tā la dang / se 'bras/ 'on rgyal sras bla brang / kun bde gling bcas kyi dpe mdzod khang du cha tshang yod/ par shing de la dga' ldan par rnying zer zhing de sngon rig gnas gsar brje'i 42/

dung dkar blobazang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gong tsam bar dga' ldan zung ju khang tshan du bzhag yod pa de'i yig gzugs dpe cha lag bris ma dang nor 'gro ba lta bu'i par rko'i lag rtsal ha las pa zhig 'dug par shing de'i dbu lha rnams dbu dang sku gzugs cha snyoms shing / sku gzugs kyi dpung zheng che la sku sked phra ba zhal ras kyang de tsam legs po med pa zhig yod/ de'i rjes su rim bzhin byung ba'i par rko'i lag rtsal rnams dga' ldan par rnying gi yig gzugs la do thub pa zhig byung med/ lha sku dang rnam thar sogs kyi par rko'i lag rtsal thad/snar thang bka' bstan 'gyurarme dang / sde dge'i bka' bstan 'gyur par skrun byas rjes/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khrungs rabs rnam thar dpag bsam 'khri shing cha tshang gi lo rgyus ri mo'i par shing ngo grangs sum cu so gcig dang / rje tsong kha pa'i rnam thar cha tshang gi lo rgyus ri mo'i par shing ngo grangs bco lnga bcas brkos pa snar thang par khang du yod cing /deng skabs par shing de bzhugs med kyang / par shing la ras bkab nas par brgyab thog slar yang tshon btang ba'i thang ka cha tshang deng sang se 'bras kyi grwa tshang khag dang / dgon pa che khag phal che bar mthong rgyu yod/sde dge'i bka' 'gyur par rko 'go tshugs nas lo gcig song ba na ka thog si tu rin po che dgung lo so gnyis su phebs pa lcags phag spyi lo 1731lor sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khrungs rabs rnam thar dpag bsam 'khri shing gi lo rgyus cha tshang mu 'brel ri mor babod pa'i thang ka'i ma dpe 'bri gnang mdzad/ (si tu rin po che dgung lo bdun brgyad skabs nas ri mo la phyag rtsal shin tu mkhas pas sde dge par khang gi ldebs bris ma dpe dang /ka thog 'du khang chen mo'i ldebs bris kyi ma dpe bcas 'bri gnang mdzad yod ) 422

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig da wad 'di'i lha sku rnams bod bris thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs srol gzhir bzung nas legs cha gsar gtod thog yul ljongs kyi bkod pa rnams rgya mi rigs kyi lag rtsal nas legs cha bzhes te 'bri gnang mdzad pa yin/ma dpe de gzhir bzung nas shing par thog brkos pa de sngon sde dge par khang chen mor yod kyang deng skabs bzhugs yod med ma shes shing / par shing de la ras bkab nas par brgyab rjes tshon btang ba'i thang ka mi nyung ba zhig dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dgon pa mang por deng sang yang mthong rgyu 'dug pa rnams bod kyi par rko'i lag rtsal rtse mor son pa'i dpe mtshon zhig yin/par rko ba'i skabs kyi lag rtsal nyams myong ha cang mang po zhig yod kyang / lag rtsal yo byad rigs mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis tsam gyi ming dang /par shing snum gyis 'dul sbyong byas tshul sogs zur tsam zhig 〈 snar thang bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag 〉nang 'khod pa las zhib cha mi gsal zhing /de skor yi ger 'khod pa da phan ma mthong ba ma zad/ par rko ba rgan gras mang po zhig ni 'das grongs song zin pas/ rgan gras re zung zhig da lta 'tsho bzhugs kyi skabs 'dir nga tshos khong rnam par bka' slob zhus nas yig thog tu 'khod thub pa zhig yong ba'i re ba yod/drug pa/ par skrun lasartsorigs khag gi gla phogs dang bya dga'i skor/rang re'i ljongs 'dir gna' rabs nas bzung rang rigs dang mi 423

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rigs gzhan dag gi lag shes bzo rtsal gong 'phel 'gro ba'i brgyud rim nang ched las lag rtsal gyi bzo rigs mkhas can mang du thon nas dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dus dkyil du slebs dus par rko'i lag rtsal mkhas pa mang po byung ba de tshos grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas dbang rnams kyi gsung 'bum shing par thog rko 'go tshugs shing / khong tsho'i phul du byung ba'i lag rtsal la bod sa gnas kyi dus rabs rim pa'i srid gzhung dang sger pa khag nas mthong chen byas te srid gzhung sngon ma las kyang rjes ma'i skabs gla phogs dang bya dga' sogs ldab 'phar byas te sprad par brten/ched las lag rtsal pa tsho'i bzo rtsal chu tshad kyang mi rabs sngon ma las rjes ma mtho ru song nas bod kyi lag shes bzo rtsal las thon pa'i rig gnas dngos rdzas rnams la deng skabs 'dzam gling gi mkhas dbang tshos mthong chen byed mus red/de'i skor gyi dpyad gzhi khungs btsan ni/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈 gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi dkar chag 〉dang / sle lung bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 〈 snang thang bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag〉 si tu rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i 〈sde dge'i bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag〉 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 〈 rang rnam du ku la'i gos bzang 〉bcas su zhib phra gsal zhing / gzhan yang gna' rabs bod yig gi dpe rnying mi nyung ba zhig gi nang dus rabs so so'i 'bru mar sha gsum dang / tshwa/ bul togaja/ rta/ phyugs rigs pho mo/ dkar yol/ gser/ dngul/ g.yu/ mu 424

bod yig dpe rnying par sbunartsodang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig da wa—tig bcas kyi rin thang skor 'khod pa tshang ma dus skabs de ga rang gi mis bris pa sha stag yin stabs yid ches blos 'gel chog pa'i dpyad gzhi rtsa chen sha stag yin/ der brten nga tshos dus rabs thoso'i dngos zog gi rin thang dang / lag shes bzo las pa'i gla phogs kyi gnas tshul bcas phan tshun zung 'brel byas nas zhib 'jug mang po bya rgyu yod pa zhig yin pas/ 'dir par skrun gyi 'brel yod lag rtsal bzo pa'i gla phogs dang bya dga'i skor tsam gleng rgyu yin/rang ljongs su rdo shing lcags gsum gyi bzo pa'i gla phogs thad srid gzhung sngon ma'i skabs las rjes ma'i dus ldab 'phar byung yod pa dper na/sa skya dang phag grus srid dbang bzung skabs rdo shing lcags gsum gyi bzo pa'i gla cha ni nyin gla 'bru khal med bre do ste (khal rer bre nyi shu dang 'bru khal gcig la deng sang ltar na rgya ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ bre gang la deng sang ltar na rgya ma gang dang srang bzhi yin/)deng sang ltar na rgya ma do dang srang brgyad yin /gtsang pa rgyal pos bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung skabs rdo shing lcags gsum gyi bzo pa'i gla cha mtho shos la nyin rer 'bru khal med bre gsum phul do ste/ deng sang ltar na rgya ma bzhi dang srang lnga tsam dang /dma' shos la nyin rer 'bru khal med bre do ste deng sang ltar na rgya ma do dang srang brgyad yin/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung skabs rdotshoshing lcags gsum gyi ba7ga 'i nyin gla mtho dman rim pa drug tu phye ba'i mtho shos la nyin gla 'bru khal med bre drug phul bzhi ste/ deng sang 425

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ltar na rgya ma dgu dang srang gsum zho do tsam yin zhing / dma' shos la nyin gla gtsang pa rgyal po'i skabs kyi mtho shos dang 'dra ba yod/ snar thang bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur par skrun skabs sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skabs las ldab gcig min tsam 'phar yod pa gsham du bkod pa'i re'u mig las gsal /sa skya dang / phag spu/ gtsang pa rgyal po bcas kyi skabs dngos zog gi rin thang skor da phan dpyad gzhi lag tu ma son zhing / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skabs 'bru rigs kyi rin thang ni 'bru khal gcig la bod dngul srang med zho med skar phyed bdun yin pa 〈 gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi dkar chag 〉nang gsal/de nas lo brgyad cu lhag tsam song ba dus rabs bco brgyad pa ste 1730lor snar thang gi bka' 'gyur par rko 'go tshugs shing / skabs der bod dbus gtsang khul du 'bru khal rer rin thang bod dngul srang med zho gang skar lnga yin paga'abru'i rin gong ldab gcig 'phar ba red/snar thang gi bka' 'gyur dngatshubastan 'gyur par brkos zin pa nas lo bdun cu ma zin tsam la tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pas lha sa gtsug lag khang la nyams gso dang / rin chen sna bdun gyi bstan 'gyur bzhengs gnang mdzad skabs bod dbus gtsang khul du 'bru khal rer bod dngul srang med zho gsumartere byas pa de sngon las ldab gcig 'phar yod/de nas lo bdun cu lhag tsam song rjes rta tshag rje drung ngag dbang dpal ldan mchog gis bod sa gnas kyi srid skyong gnang skabs bod dbus 426

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhigagatsang khul la 'bru khal rer rin gong srang med zho drug re byas te ldab gcig 'phar yod/ (tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa sku na phra mo'i skabs yin/)de rjes sku phreng cibacu gsum pa dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das nas rwa sgreng rin po ches srid skyong gnang skabs gtsang khul du 'bru khal rer bod dngul srang lnga ('iramangs shog sgor 0 25)dang / lha sa khul du 'bru khal rer bod dngul srang bcu (midamangs shog sgor 0 50)yan las 'phar med pas skya nam rgyas po byung zhes shod srolayod pa der brtag na/ sku phreng bcu gsum pas srid dbang skyong ba gnang skabs lha sa khul du 'bru khal rer rin gong ji tsam mtho yang bod dngul srang gang zho lnga yan las 'phar med tshod red/ de rjes stag brag gis srid dbang 'dzin skabs 'bru khal rer bod dngul srang bco lnga nas nyi shu rtsa lnga yas mas bar byas te de gong las ldab gsum nas lnga bar 'phar yod/ gong gsal dus skabs so so'i 'bru gong 'phar tshad de 'bru rigs dang dngos po gzhan dag brje tshong byed skabs kyi rin gong 'phar tshad de red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni dus skabs so so'i 'bru rigs dang dngos po gzhan dag gi rin mnyam sdur tshad de zhing 'brog khul du rang byung gnod 'tshe dang / dmag 'khrugamu ge bcas byung na gnas skabs ring 'gyur ldog yong ba ma gtogs spyir btang rang 'jags su gnas thub cing / gtan 'jags su gnas pa'i dus yun yang ring mthar lo brgyad cu yas mas nas thung mthar lo drug cu tsam gyi bar gnas thub pa'i dbang gis srid gzhung dang / dgon sde khagasger pa 'byor ldan bcas tshang mas bang mdzod du 'bru rigs bkar 'jug 427
dbus khul/

bod yig dpe rnying par sgrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig da wa—du bed spyod byed pa'i ldan rgya ma la zer zhing / bod kyi shong tshad rgya ma gang la deng sakhu gi shong tshad rgya grangs ltar rtsis nas rgya ma do dang srang lnga yod/ mar dang ja sogs ljid tshad kyis 'degs dgos rigs rnams srang brgyad cu tham par khal gcig tu rtsi srol yod pa bcas zhib par bod gna' rabs kyi 'jal bshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi'i skor zur du bkod pa las gsal bas 'dir ma smros/gong du bshad pa ltar bod sa gnas su 'bru rigs kyi rin gong 'phar ba'i rkyen gyis sha mar tshwa bul sogs zas rigs dang / yul thon dngos zog gi rin gong yang mnyam du 'phar bar brten/ las bzo khag gi gla phogs kyang de dang bstun nas 'phar snon mi byed ka med yong gi yod/de sngon rdo shing lcags gsum sogs lag rtsal las rigs khag gi mi rnams gzhung sger chos gsum gyi las kar skong 'gugs byed skabs/ nyin gla dang las gla phud pa'i da dung lag rtsal gyi chu tshad mtho dman la gzhigs te zhus dag pa dang / 'go byed pa/ lag rtsal dge rgan/ slob phrugapar yig 'bri mkhan/ par rko ba/ sman pa bcas la zla ba rer za 'bru rtsam pa khal lnga re dang / de byings shog bzo ba/ shing bzo ba/ lcags bzo ba/ lha bris pa/ 'tshem bzo ba bcas la zla ba rer za 'bru rtsam pa khal bzhi re/ chang 'thung mkhan /gyi las bzor zla ba rer chang rgyu nas khal gcig dang bre bcu ste deng sang ltar na rgya ma bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ chang mi 'thung mkhan la zla ba rer ja rgya med nyag lnga ste deng sang ltar na rgya ma gang dang srang bdun zho lnga/ mar khal med nyag bco lnga la deng sang ltar na rgya 429

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ma lnga dang srang do zho lnga/ 'go byed dang —/ zhus dag pa/ sman pa bcas la zla ba rer za sha lug khog gsum re yod pa phud/ de byings kyi las bzor zla ba rer za sha khog med bzhi ling gcig re/ 'go byed par zla ba rer snum khal med bre do ste deng sang ltar na rgya ma gang dang srang bdun zho lnga tsam dang / de byings kyi las bzo tshor zla ba rer snum khal med bre med phul gang la deng sang ltar na srang gadza lhag tsam/ 'go byed dang sman par zla ba rer tshwa khal med bre do la deng sang ltar na rgya ma gang dang srang bdun zho lnga tsam bcas sprod kyi yod/ skabs der las bzo tsho'i gla thob rnams 'bru rigs dngos mdog sprod pa ma zad/ da dung zla ba re'i za 'bru rtsam pa dang / chang rgyu/ za sha/thug rdor/ ja/ mar/ tshwa/ snum bcas ldang nges sprod pa des las bzo dang nang mi bu phrug bcas kyi 'tsho ba'i thog phan pa chen po byung bar brten/las bzo tsho'i lag rtsal gyi khyad nus dang hur brtson gyi rang bzhin 'don spel yong rgyur skul lcag chen po thebs thub pa byung yod/gzhan yang bod du rten bzhengs dang / 'dzugs skrun/ par skrun sogs spyi sger gyi las grwa che gras gang yin la thog mar 'go 'dzugs skabs 'dzugs ston dang / las grwa phyed tsam zin skabs bar ston/ mjug sgril skabs grol ston bcas thog mtha' bar gsum gyi sne len ston mo nyin gang thog las bzo 'go byed lag g.yog bcas par lag rtsal dang las ka'i mgyogs tshad dang spus tshad bcas rim pa bdun du phye nas bya dga'i gsol ras sprod srol yod/ de yang rim pa dang por/ gyon chas sked 430
— 1 tresdurna
—shā— wawa ṭ+wāṃbru— spuṭ+wāṃ/
swāpy-i kā dhiṭ+wāṃ sbyin pa rgya
las rigs —

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bdun pa/ snar thang bka' bstan 'gyur dang sde dge bka' bstan 'gyur par skrun byed skabs kyi dgos cha'i 'gro song skor/snar thang bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur par skrun byed skabs rgyu cha'i 'gro song gi gnas tshul mi 'dra ba yod de/ bka' 'gyur par skrun byed skabs kyi rgyu cha dang gla phogs ni pho lha'i 'dzin khongs shel dkar rdzong gi lo gnyis kyi yong 'bab thog de 'phros rnams pho lha ba rang nyid kyi dpal 'byor thog nas gang dgos btang ba dang / sa gnas gzhan dag nas blang dgos rigs rnams yul thang gi rin 'bab sprad nas nyos pa ma gtogs dpya khral gtan nas bsdus med/ snar thang bstan 'gyur par skrun byed skabs par shing mang che ba 'brug pa rgyal pos phul ba dang / ma ldang ba rnams pho lha ba rang nyid sger gyis kha gsab byas yod/ bod dbus gtsang gnyis su par shing gi rgyu cha ni gas skyon dang / 'chus pa/ 'dzer pa yod pa sogs gang byung gis mi chog par/ shing rgyu mnyen po dang 'drongs po yod pa'i stag pa shing sha stag dgos la/ par shing 'dul sbyong byed skabs par shing rer par snum phul do tshod tsam re byugs nas snum 'dul byed pa de ni gas skyon mi 'byung zhing lo mang song yang rul skyon mi yong ba'i phan thogs yod/par shing gi thon khungs ni/ shel dkar/ rdzong dga'/ skyid grong /gnya' nang / rong shar/ mkhar rta/ gting skyes/ phag ri/ lho brag do bo/ 436

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig da wa—seng ge/ lha khang / dar ma/ mtsho sna/ dwags po/ kong po bcas rdzong khag bcu gsum dang sa khul gnyis nas thon gyi yod/par yig 'bri gzhi'i shog bu'i thon khungs ni/ mtsho sna/ dwags po/kong po/ snye mo/ gnya' nang / mon bcas nas thon gyi yod cing / de la yang dug shog dang shing shog rigs gnyis yod pa'i nang nas dug shog la yi ge bris na mig la gnod par brten/ par yig 'bri gzhi'i shog bu ni dug shog ma 'dres pa'i shing shog gtsang ma srab mthug snyoms la 'jam po yod pa zhig dgos shing de ltar byung na par yig 'bri mkhan gyi mig la mi gnod pa dang / snag tsha rgyugs bde ba/ snag tsha mi 'byil ba/ chu la sbangs kyang chud zos su mi 'gro ba bcas kyi dge mtshan yod/par yig 'bri byed snag tsha ni/ sgron me shing mer bsregs pa'i dud dreg legs shos yin zhing / de nyid thog mar spyin chu dang shel ka ra 'os 'tsham btab pa'i chu'i nang sbangs te snag kyog nang dbur shing gis yun ring bar dbur 'dul byas rjes/ rang nyid kyi lag pa'i drod la brten nas mnyed 'phur 'dul sbyong byas na/ mes rgyal nang sa nas thon pa'i snag tsha gser yig can las legs pa yod/snag tsha'i rgyu sgron dreg gi thon khungs ni/ dwags po dang / kong po/mtsho sna/ mon/ sbyar bcas yin/ gzhan yang snag tsha'i rgyu dang par shing gas sdom la dgos pa'i ko spyin/ par shing 'dul sbyong skabs par shing la byugs rgyu'i snum/ shog bu sbyor byed gro zhib gtsags ma/ rko gzong rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bzo rgyur mkho ba'i lcags rdzogs dang / bal lcags/4 )7
parno tshe'i rmerge cha ṅgek+ṣe sgyeske— lcags/——

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhigasong skor la/ dacikar chag nang zhib phra gsal ba'i las bzo'i gla phogs sha mar/ snum/ tsha/ phyur ba sogs phud/ chang rgyu'i nas dang / sha dod kyi 'bru/ nyin gla dang las glar sprod pa'i 'bru/ bza' bya'i rtsam pa (rtsam pa khal gnyis rer 'bru khal gsum re rtsis )bcas khag bzhi la 'bru kha75 lnga 'bum drug khri bzhi stong nyis brgya bdun cu don gsum dang bre bcu gcig phul bzhi khyor ba gnyis lhag tsam song ba deng sang gi rgya mar phab na rgya ma bye ba gcig dang sa ya lnga bdun 'bum dgu khri dgu stong drug brgya drug cu tham pa dang srang bzhirtsozho drug yin pas/ deng sang lha sar 'bru khal rer mi dmangs shog sgor bcu bzhi re byed pa'i yul thang du brtsis na sgor sa ya bdun dang brgyad 'bum dgu khri dgu stong brgyad brgya sum cu tham pa dang sgor zur gnyis skar drug tsam thob/mar khal nyis stong dgu brgya drug cu re gnyis song ba deng sang mar khal rer rgya ma bdun re brtsis pa ltar na/ mar rgya ma nyis khri stong med bdun brgya sum cu so bzhi la deng skabs lha sar mar rgya ma rer mi dmangs shog sgor bdun re byed pa'i yul thang ltar brtsis pas sgor chig 'bum bzhi khri lnga stong brgya dang sum cu so brgyad thob/ gong gsal 'bru mar gnyis kyi rin thang khyon bsdoms sgor sa ya brgyad dang 'bum med bzhi khri bzhi stong dgu brgya drug cu re brgyad dang sgor zur gnyis skar drug thob pa de snar thang bka' 'gyur pod brgya dang bcu med gsum yod par bgos na pod rer ma gnas sgor bdun khri brgyad stong brgya dang bcu med drug dang sgor zur bzhi skar dgu thob/cho 439

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig —da wa gong gsal gyi 'bru rigs bsdoms 'bor de deng sang gi rgya mar phab na rgya ma bye ba gcig dang sa ya gnyis bzhi 'bum chig khri sum stong nyis brgya dgu bcu go drug yod pa dang / de'i rin thang thad deng sang lha sar 'bru khal rer sgor bcu bzhi re byed pa'i thang gzhir brtsis na sgor sa ya drug dang nyis 'bum khri med drug stong drug brgya bzhi bcu zhe brgyad yin zhing / sdo dge bstan 'gyur la pod nyis brgya bcu gsum yod par pod re'i ma gnas 'bru la phab na 'bru khal nyis stong brgya med brgyad cu gya gcig dang bre bdun phul gnyis bya sgong gsum star phul med kham phul gcig nas drug re thob cing / mi dmangs shog sgor la brtsis na pod rer ma gnas sgor nyisu khri dgu stong brgya dang sum cu so dgu dang sgor zur gcig skar dgu yin/ jibargyad pa/ par khang gi sgrig srol lam lugs skor/de sngon spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs dang / deng sang gi dus skabs gang yin rung par gzhi gsar skrun gyi ma gnas ni ha cang mtho po yin pas//par gzhi gsar skrun byas rjes tshong las byed rgyu'i bsam blo btang tshe/par skrun byed skabs kyi ma gnas las mtho ba'i rin gong ma blangs na khe bzang yong thabaso med cing / ma gnas las mtho ba'i rin gong chen po blangs na par skrun byayopa'i dpe cha de dag nyo mkhan mi yong bas spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho skong mi thub/ de snga bod sa gnas su dpe cha par skrun byeng 4 43

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i ma gnas mthon po yod kyang / par gzhi gsar skrun gyi sbyin bdag mang che ba ni sger pa 'byor ldan khag yin pas/ kho tshos dpe cha par skrun 'grem spel bya rgyu de ni chos kyi sbyin pa dang / bsod nams stobs chen po bsags pa'i ched du yin pa las/ khe bzang thob ched du tshong rgyag pa zhig min pa ma zad/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gsung rab nang du yang dpe 'tshong byas te byung ba'i blu yon dang / brngan pa sogs rang nyid dang nye 'brel spun mched bu phrug bcas kyi lto gos sdod gnas sogs kyi ched du bed spyod btang na nyes dmigs shin tu che bar gsungs yod par brten/dpe skrun byas rjes par 'debs kyi gla yon dang rin 'bab rnams par skrun bya gzhag gong 'phel gyi ched du gtong ba ma gtogs tshong zog tu brtsis nas khe tshong rgyag mkhan ha cang nyung nyung yin zhing / 'byor ldan sbyin bdag khag nas par skrun byas pa'i par shing rnams 'brel yod dgon sde khag la 'bul ba ma gtogs/ rang sger gyi khyim tshang nang nyar tshags byed mkhan ha cang nyung bas/ bod sa gnas kyi dgon pa lha khang khag gi nang par shing mang po yod pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/dgon sde khag dang spyi pa'i par khang nas par 'debs byas pa'i dpe cha rnams kyi shog bu dang snag tsha'i rin 'bab/ par shing zad gron song ba'i gun gsab/ las bzo'i gla thob bcas yul dus so so'i bza' bca' dang dngos po'i rin gong 'phar tshad dang bstun nas sprod len byed pa'i nang nas las bzo'i gla thob phud pa'i gzhan dag rnams dgon pa so so'i par khang gi yong 'bab yin zhing / yong 'bab de rnams par shing 444

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig da wa —dang / par khang nyams gso bcas kyi 'gro gron du gtong ba ma gtogs sger don du bed spyod gtong mkhan med la btang yang mi chog pa ma zad/dgon pa'i grwa pa la yang bgo 'grems byed srol med/ par 'debs las bzo tsho'i gla 'bab ji thob par khang de'i las byed mtho dman tshang mar cha snyoms kyis bgo ba las/ par khang do dam par gla mang ba sprod len gyi rigs byed mi chog 'on kyang do dam par lo gcig gi 'tsho ba ldang nges kyi 'bru dngul sha mar sogaso phogs thob zur du sprod kyi yod/ par pa las bzo tshos las grwa tshugs ring rgyags rang 'khur byas te yong rgyu yin stabs par gla len skabs gla lto chabs sgril gyis rtsis rgyag sprod len byed pa de tsho ni par pa tsho'i yong 'bab yin/ bka' bstan 'gyur dang bla ma khag gi gsung 'bum sogs pod grangs mang ba'i rigs la rin 'bab dang gla thob sne sel tsam las med pa'i gyong gun kha gsab yong ched/ spyi tshogs thog 'gro rgyug che ba'i dpe cha'i rigs mang tsam par 'debs byas te 'tshong gi yod/ bka' bstan 'gyur sogs pod grangs mang ba'i rigs lo rer par 'debs bya rgyu'i grangs ka mang shos brgya dang lnga bcu yas mas yin zhing /de yang lo de rang gi mjug tu gang yod rdzogs 'gro ba ma gtogs par khang nang du phung gsog thebs te 'tshong mi thub pa'i gnas tshul yong gi med pa de ni par shing thog dpe cha par brkos byas pa'i dge mtshan zhig red/deng skabs kyi rang 'gul 'phrul par ni par gzhi sgrig sbyor thengs gcig gis dpe deb cha tshang khri kha shas par 'debs byed chog gi yod pas par grangs ji tsam mang ba de tsam gyis ma gnas chung zhing / par grangs ji 445

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tsam nyung ba de tsam gyis ma gnas mtho la gyong gun che ba yod stabs/par 'debs ma byas gong sngon tshud nas 'brel yod tshan pa dang sger khag la dril bsgrags byas te gdeng tshod yod pa'i grangs ka nges can zhig byung mtshams gzhi nas par 'debs byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ —skabs 'dir par khang che ba khag gi sgrig srol lam lugs ngo sprod zhu thub na bsam rung / dpyad gzhi yod rigs lag tu ma son stabs sa bcad ma stong tsam du si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i 〈 sde dge bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag 〉gi mjug tu sde dge dpar khang gi sgrig khrims skor 'khod 'dug pa de'i nang don gnad bsdus byas te bkod na/ bka' 'gyur cha tshang gcig gi dgos char/ shog bu bre kha dgu stong sum brgya tham pa/ gro zhib khal brgyad/ mtshal spus legs khal med srang bdun cu tham pa/ (bod kyi ljid tshad srang gang la deng sang gi snyid tshad srang med cha shas brgyad dang yang cha bdun cu don lnga yod/)rgya skyegs rgya ma gsum (bod kyi shong tshad rgya ma gang 'a/ deng sang gi shong tshad rgya ma do dang srang lnga yod )bcas yin/bka' 'gyur cha tshang gcig la shog bu dang snag tsha'i rin 'bab ja 'khor drug/ brgya dang lnga bcu/ dpar gla ja 'khor drug dgu dang sbag chen gnyis sbag chung gsum bcas dgos pas snag shog gi rin dang par gla bcas bsdoms/ na ja 'khor drug brgya dang lnga bcu nga dgu dang sbag chen gnyis sbag chung gsum thob kyi yod/ de sde dge'i nas 'dong la bsgyur na nas 'dong chig 'bum nyis khri bdun stong brgyad brgya bdun cu yin zhing / 446

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'iganadadona'aga'azhig ——da wakhal la brtsis na nas khal sum stong brgya dang dgu bcu go drug dang zho gsum yin pa deng sang gi rgya mar phab na rgya ma brgya da khri dgu stong lnga brgya bcu med dgu thob pa dang / deng skabs lha sar 'bru khal rer sgor bcu bzhi re byed pa'i yul thang ltar brtsis na sgor bzhi khri bzhi stong bdun brgya lnga bcu nga bzhi dang sgor zur lnga yin pas/ sde dge bka' 'gyur gyi par gzhi thog mar skrun skabs kyi ma gnas bsdoms 'bor dang bsdur na drug cha gcig ma zin tsam gyi rin gong ma gtogs med/ sde dge dpar khang gi sgrig srol lam lugs nang 'khod pa ltar na/ las bzo'i gla 'bab phud pa'i de byings kyi yong 'bab gang yod ho bag med par sde dge rgyal po'i srid gzhung la rtsis 'bul zhu dgos kyi yod 'dugapar khang der de snga sde dge rgyal pos bsko bzhag byas pa'i par dpon (par khang do dam pa )zer ba zhig yod pa de sde dge dgon chen gyi grwa pa'i khongs nas ming 'don byas pa zhig yin pa de la sde dge'i srid gzhung gis lo rer phogs dod ja sgam re sprod kyi yod cing / sde dge dgon par par khang gi yong 'bab khongs nas thob cha ci yod dpyad gzhi'i nang mi gsal/de sngon zhol par khang du yod pa'i bka' 'gyur gyi par shing de 'o shas gong du ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung nas krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs bod yan lag mthun tshogs la gnang ba nas bzung dgon pa khag dang / spyi tshogs thog nas bka' 'gyur cha tshang gdan 'dren zhu mkhan mang stabs ming tho bkod nas lo gsum song rjes gzhi nas lag son yo/nga gi yod pa de ni phyogs gcig nas par 'debs lag rtsal gyi mi sna nyung ba 4 /7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang / gnyis nas shog bu dang / snag tsha/ bza' tshas dngos zog bcas kyi rin thang lo re bzhin ldab 'phar 'gro ba dang / las yul khang pa gu dog pa sogs cha rkyen ha cang zhan pa'i gnas tshul 'og lo re bka' 'gyur cha tshang bdun cu yas mas las par 'debs byed thub kyi med pa'i rkyen gyis yin zhing / par 'debs 'grem tshong byas pa'i rin 'bab deng sang sgor brgyad stong lhag tsam zin gyi yod pa de rnams kyang las bzo'i gla phogs dang / snag shog gi rin bcas lachi sha khu rang thim ltar gtsang dag gis gtong yong 'go thug tsam las khe bzang gang yang med tshod red/gzhan yang de snga shog ngos rgyab mdun gnyis kar shog ro med cing 'jam sha dod pa'i par shog bed spyod gtong dgos pa las/ shog ro mang po 'byar ba'i bod shog dkyus mas par 'debs byas na par shing zad gron che stabs/ dang dod che ba tshos bod shog nyis sbyar ma'am yang na 'brug yul dang stod khul nas thon pa'i shog bu'am rgya gar nas thon pa'i shog bu bed spyod byed kyi yod/ deng sang ni mes rgyal nang khul nas thon pa'i ko shog spus legs de bed spyod gtong mus red/par 'debs snag tsha ni bod nas thon pa'i sgron dreg btul ma'i snag tsha dang / mes rgyal nang khul nas thon pa'i snag tsha gru bzhi gser yig can mnyam bsres byed pa'am yang na sgron dreg btul ma'i snag tsha spus legs de 'dra ma gtogs phyi rgyal nas thon pa'i rdzas 'gyur gyi snag tshas par 'debs byed mi chog me dang / par 'debs byed pa'i dus tshod kyang bod zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad nas dgu pa'i tshes brgyad bar zla ba drug gi 448
