bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhigadus tshod nang par 'debs byed pa ma gtogs de min gang byung du par 'debs mi chog pa'i thog par khang nang du chang 'thung ba dang / tha mag 'then pa/ sgog pa dang btsong yod pa'i zas rigs za 'khyer mi chog pa bcas kyi lam lugs nan po bzos 'dugadagu pa/ par shing bed spyod gtong ba'i dus yun ring thung skor/snar thang bka' 'gyur gyi par shing de bod kyi rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu byi (spyi lo 1732)lo'i bod zla dang po'i nang par skrun las mjug/ nibasgril nas bod zla gsum pa'i tshes shar la par 'debs byed pa'i 'go tshugs pa nas/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing khyi (spyi lo 1934)lor zhol par khang gi bka' 'gyur las mjug bsgril ba'i bar lo nyis brgya bcu med gnyis ring par 'debs byas shing / lo re cha snyoms bka' 'gyur ngo grangs brgya dang lnga bcu par 'debs byas pa'i dbang du btang na ngo grangs sum khri stong med sum brgya tham pa zin/sde dge bka' 'gyur ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu glang (spyi lo 1733)lor par 'debs byed 'go tshugs pa nas lo bcu gnyis ring bka' 'gyur cha tshang ngo grangs chig stong lnga brgya par 'debs byas tshul 〈 bka' 'gyur dkar chag 〉nang gsal ba ltar na/ spyi lo 1955lo bar lo nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis ring lo rer cha snyoms ngo grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga par 'debs byas pa'i dbang du btang na bka' 'gyur cha tshang 449

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ngo grangs nyis khri bdun stong ba dun brgya lnga bcu par 'debs byas yod pa ma zad/ da phan lo ngo bcu'i ring la yang mu mthud par 'debs byas yod pa dang / 'byung 'gyur da dung lo ngo bcu lhag par 'debs mu mthud byed thub pa'i gdeng tshod tsha/da pa der brtag na/ snar thang bka' 'gyur gyi par shing de lo nyis brgya bcu med gnyis ring de 'dra'i zad gron chen po byung ba ni snar thang bka' 'gyur par 'debs byas pa'i grangs tshad gong du bkod pa de las ldab gcig tsam mang ba yod nges snyam/gong gsal gyi gnas tshul de'i thog nas par shing thog par rko byed pa'i dpe skrun bya gzhag der rjes lus kyi phyogs dang skyon cha mi nyung ba zhig ldan pa smos med kyang de ni las don dngos kyi nang legs bcos gtong thub pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ deng skabs dpe skrun lag rtsal 'phrul chas can du 'gyur ba'i 'og tu yang mu mthud nas nus pa 'don thub pa'i dge mtshan 'ga' zhig yod pa mthong thub ste/(11spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho yod pa'i gnas tshul nam byung gi skabs dus thog tu par 'debs byed thub pa/21lo rer par 'debs bya rgyu'i grangs tshad de lo re'i dgos mkho dang bstun nas tshod 'dzin byed bde ba/ 31par shing thog par 'debs byed thub pa'i nus pa de lo nyis brgya lhag tsam bar rgyun 'khyodas byed thub pa/(7par 'debs byed pa'i kha grangs nyung mthar khri gsum lon thub pa bcas yin/ der brten par skrun gyi las ka de 'phrul 'khor la brten 450

bod yig dpe rnying par skrun dang 'brel ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhiganas par 'debs bya rgyu gtso bo dang / par shing thog par 'debs bya rgyu gozhogs 'degs kyi tshul du byas na dpe cha deb gzugs la dga' ba rnams kyis deb gzugs dang / dpe gzugs la dga' ba rnams kyis/ dpe gzugs gang 'dod ltar nyos tshag pas par khang phan tshun bar du gzhogs 'degs kyi mnyam las yag po yong thub pa ma zad/ deng skabs bod yig gi debra gzugs dpe skrun gyi mgyogs tshad legs po de dang /dpe gzugs dpe skrun gyi spus tshad legs po gnyis phan tshun 'gran sdur byas pa brgyud/ deb gzugs dpe skrun gyi spus tshad zhan pa'i gnas tshul legs bcos yong rgyur skul ma gtong thub kyi red /

tun hong nas thon pa'i bod yig gi lo rgyus yig cha dpe slun byas pa'i gleng gzhi/rang rgyal tun hong gi sa gnas nas thon pa'i gna' rabs bod yig gi lo rgyus yig cha ha cang mang po yod pa'i nang nas khag gcig nga tshos zhib 'jug byas pa brgyud gsham gsal myong tshor 'di 'dra zhig byung ba ste/(1)yig cha 'di rnams lo chig stong lhag tsam gong bod kyi btsan po'i dus skabs de rang la bod mi rang gis bris pa zhig yin pa las/ phyi rabs kyi lo rgyus rtsom bris byed mkhan tshos rang nyid kyi rig stobs la brten nas gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus la tshod dpag dang bcos bzo byas pa'i bsre bslad phran bu tsam yang ma zhugs par lo stong phrag lhag tsam ring brag rdo dang bye ma'i 'og tu lus pa'i yig rnying sha stag yin pa/ (2)spyir btang gi lo rgyus yig rigs lta bu'i tshig ring po med rung / gnad don gal che ba rnams tshig nyung ngu'i thog nas gsal bshad byas pa dang / gzhi 'dzin sa brtan po yod pas lhad med gser gyi thigs pa lta bu yin pa/ (3)dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mgo nas da bar bod kyi lo rgyus smra ba'i mkhas pa tshos rtsom bris gnang ba'i lo rgyus yig cha'i nang gsal ba dang ma gsal ba'i gnad don mang po zhig yig cha 'di dag gi thog nas sngar las lhag par ra sprod byed thub pa/ (4)thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs su rgya yi lo rgyus mkhas pa tshos dus skabs de rang la bris pa'i rgya yig gi lo rgyus nang gsal 452

tun hung gi bod yig lo rgyus yig cha dpesgrunabyasapa'iglengagazhi/ ——ba'i bod kyi lo rgyus dang phan tshun lta bsdur byas chog pa ma zad/ gnad don mang po zhig gcig la bltas tshe cig shos gsal du 'gro ba'i ngo mtshar chen po skyed thub pa/ (5)yig cha 'di dag gi nang lo chig stong lhag tsam gong gi bod kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs dang / srid 'dzin/ khrims lugs/dmag don/ dpal 'byor bcas kyi gnas tshul dang / de bzhin rgya bod mi rigs dang / mi rigs gzhan dag bcas bar gyi 'brel ba sogs gal che'i lo rgyus kyi gnad don mang po zhig zhib 'jug byed rgyur mkho ba'i dpang rtags yod par brten/ yig 'bru gcig brlag kyang ha cang phangs sems byed dgos pa'i rin thang chen po yod pa/ (6)bod yig thog mar gsar du byung ba nas bzung da bar lo ngo chig stong lhag tsam phyin zin rung nga tshos yig cha de dag bltas nas zhib 'jug byed skabs brgya cha brgyad cu lhag tsam klog thub pa ma zad/ tshod dpag byas pa tsam ma yin par go ba gsal po lon thub pa 'di'i thog nas bod yig 'di sgra sbyor yi ge yin pa dang sa gnas so so'i yul skad phud gzhi rtsa'i thog gcig gyur yin pa'i khyad chos gsal por mthong thub pa/ (7)yig cha 'di dag gi brgya cha bcu tsam ni thengs bcu phrag kha shas bltas kyang da dung tshod dpag byas pa tsam las gdeng tshod yod pa'i go ba lon thub kyi med pa dang / 'ga' zhig ni tshod dpag tsam yang byed thub kyi med pa/ de'i thog nas skabs de'i bod kyi skad yig dang / deng skabs kyi bod kyi skad yig bar la khyad par mi nyung ba zhig gnas yod pa dang / khyad par de 'dra 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin skor nga tshos slar yang gom gang mdun spos kyis zhib 'jug byed 453

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dgos pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin gsal por mthong thub pa bcas yin/der brten gna' rabs bod kyi lo rgyus dang / skad yig la zhib 'jug brtag dpyad gnang mkhan rgya che'i blo mthun tshor gzigs bde'i dpyad gzhi'i ched du/ nga tshos zhib 'jug byas pa'i thog ma'i yig cha khag gcig da res par skrun byas thog rjes su da dung zhib 'jug byed rgyur lus pa rnams rim bzhin zhib 'jug dang par skrun byed rtsis la/ rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyis nga tsho'i nor 'khrul gyi rigs la skyo na brjod dang slad kyi las don thad rin thang brapa ba'i ngagongs 'char thad kaljo5/ / de min yig thog gang rung bis lhug por gnang kye+ong yod pa zhu rgyu/

bod kyi rdo ring yibyuge dang dril bu'i kha byang gabyeshā— bsdus dpe spun byas pa'i gleng gzhi/〈 bod kyi rdo ring yig ge dang dril bu'i kha byang gces bsdus 〉zhes pa 'di ni/ bod kyi lo rgyus dang / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas/ sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du thog mar dar rgyas chen po byung skabs kyi gnas tshu'/ bcas la zhib 'jug byed rgyur gal che'i rin thang ldan pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha zhig yin pa ma zad/ lo rgyus yig cha ga'an dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ldan pa zhig yin/1 yis/ cha 'di dag rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang / khri lde srong btsan/ khri ral pa can bcas bod kyi rgyal po mi thog gsum gyi gal che'i lo rgyus yig cha khag gcig dus skabs de rang la rdo ring thog brkos pa zhig/ yin pas/ lo rgyusari smra ba su zhig gis bcos bslad byas pa'i dri mas ma gos pa/2 rjod byed kyi tshig nyung ngu zhig las med rung brjod bya'i gnad don gsal zhing gtsang ba'i sgo nas bstan yod pas sngar yod bod kyi lo rgyus thog bshad srol mi 'dra ba rnams nas gang zhig yang dag pa yin min ra sprod byed thub pa'i dpang rtags lta bu yin pa/3 rdo ring 'di dag btsugs pa nas bzung da bar lo chig stong nyis brgya lhag tsam song yod kyang deng sang bod yig gi chu tshad nges can yod 45 )

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i mis klog skabs tshod dpag byas pa tsam min par go ba lon thub kyi yod pa des dus skabs de'i bod kyi skad yig dang rtsom yig gi khyad chos dang / thon mi sam bho ṭas gsar gtod gnang ba'i bod yig gi khyad chos bcas gsal por mtshon thub pa bcas yin/4 rdo ring yi ge 'di dag gi thog nas gsham gsal gyi gnad don khag mang po zhig gsal bshad byas yod/ gcig rdo ring yi ge'i nang gi gnyis pa dang / skad grags che ba'i dbang gis dang por bzhag pa'i khrang ching mthun 'brel rdo ring 'dis gsal bshad byas pa'i don gnad dgu ste/po1sna/ thang bod gnyis bar dmag 'khrug thengs mang byung yang des thang bod gnyis kyi mthun sgril rtsa ba nas gtor thub med pa/laskabs de'i bod kyi rgyal blon tsho'i mna' bzhag byed stangs/snyirgya bza' 'un khrin kong jo dang cin khrin kong jo bod du rgyal po'i btsun mor brdzangs pa'i lo gsal por 'khod pa/khyorgyal po khri lde srong btsan (sad na legs )gyi sras rgyal po khri gtsug lde btsan (ral pa can )yin pa/⑤rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyis srid dbang bzung ba'i ring la thang rgyal rabs kyi gong ma mi rabs gsum byung ba dang / phan tshun mthun 'brel legs po byung ba'i dbang gis bka' gcigs bzhag ma thub par lus pa/(7thang rgyal rabs kyi khri lo dang / rgyal po khri gtsug lde btsan gyi srid 456

rdo ring yi ge dang dril bu'i kha byang gces bsdus dpe skrun byas pa'i gleng gzhi/lo shan sbyar khag gsum bkod yod pa/⑦skabs de'i thang rgyal rabs dang bod kyi rgyal po'i bar gyi 'brel ba ngo ma de gang yin gsal bshad byas yod pa/⑧mthun 'brel chings yig 'jog skabs su zhugs pa'i thang bod rgyal rabs gnyis ka'i zhi drag blon chen so so'i go gnas kyi rim pa dang ming bcas rgya bod shan sbyar du bkod pa/⑨bod yig thog bkod pa'i bka' gcigs kyi nang don rnams rgya yig thog tu yang cha tshang bar bkod yod pa bcas/gnyis/ bod sa gnas su yod pa'i rdo ring gi yi ge snga shos rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis blon po stag sgra klu gong la gnang ba'i bka' gcigs yi ge 'dis gsham gsal gyi don gnad khag bzhi gsal bshad byas yod pa ste/hubyas rjes yod pa'i blon po la sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / phyugs rigs/ bran g.yog bcas mi rabs nas mi rabs bar brgyud 'dzin byas chog pa'i bya dga' sprod pa dang / rabs chad na mu mthud nas gnyen 'brel gzhan dag la gnang ba/②byas rjes yod pa'i blon po'i mi brgyud kyi nang nas btsan po la ngo log byed mkhan byung na nyes can de rang la khrims gcod byed pa las khyim tshang gi bu tsha dang spun mched gzha na dag la zhor 'drud mi byed pa/②blon po 'bal ldong tshab dang lang mes gzigs gnyis kyis rgyal po khri lde gtsug btsan bkrongs pa dang / rgyal po khri srong lde btsan yang bkrong 457

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rtsis byas pa'i gnas tshul blon po stag sgra klu gong gis shes nas rgyal po la zhus rjes blon po gnyis srog thog tu btang ba/ 4‘blom po sta ga sgra klu gong gis dmag dpon byas te thang rgyal rabs kyi mnga' khongs su dmag drangs pa dang / rgyal sa khrang an blangs pa/ gong ma hran gro'u la bros pa'i skor bcas gsal bar bshad pa/gsum/ 'bri gung zhwa lha khang gi rdo ring dang po'i nang gsham gsal gnad don khag bzhi bshad yod pa ste/ 1 rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyi ya ba ni rgyal po khri srong lde btsan yin pa dang / khong gi gcen po ni mu rug btsan po yin pa dang / skabs der bka' gcig/sa bcas par mnyam du yod pa/(27khri lde srong btsan gyi yab khri srong lde btsan dang / gcen po gnyis rgyun ring po'i bar ma mthun pa byung ba blon po myang ting 'dzin bzang pos zhi 'jags mthun 'grigs byas pa/gisna blon po myang ting 'dzin bzang po ni blon chen gyi go gnas bzung ba'i dge slong zhig dang / rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyis srid dbang bzung skabs gal che'i dbang cha yod pa'i chab srid kyi blon chen zhig yin pa/d+nghablon po myang ting 'dzin bzang po'i mi rabs gong ma rnams la bya dgar sprad pa'i zhing 'brog bran g.yog rnams mu mthud brgyud 'dzin byas chog pa dang / rabs chad pa'am/ nyes chad phog pa gang yin kyang mu mthud bdag dbang byas chog pa las btsan pos phyir len mi byed pa bcas bshad yod/ 458

rdo ring yi ge dang dril bu'i kha byang gces bsdus dpe sgrun byas pa'i gleng gzhi/bzhi/ 'bri gung zhwa lha khang gi rdo ring gnyis pa der gsham gsal gyi gal che'i gnad don khag gsum gsal bshad byas yod pa ste/②rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyis srid dbang bzung ba'i ring 'brug lo snga rjes gnyis byung ba dang / 'brug lo rjes ma'i skabs der pho brang 'on cang do na bzhugs yod pa gsal bar 'khod yod pa des de sngon bod kyi lo rgyus yongs grags su rgyal po khri ral pa can sgyu dus su bod yig gi bkas bcad bar pa byas pa bshad pa der yang bskyar gom gang mdun spos kyis brtag dpyad byed dgos pa/2 bka' gcigs thengs gnyis pa 'di bcas skabs rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyi gcen po mu rug btsan po'i ming 'khod med pa/sriblon po myang ting 'dzin bzang po'i mes po blon snang bzang 'dus kong gi mi brgyud gtsang dang stod khul du yod pa rnams la zhang blon bka' yig can gyi thob thang gnang ba dang / kho tsho'i rgyu nor zhing 'brog bran g.yog rnams la gzhan gyis btsan 'phrog byed mi chog pa bcas gsal bshad byas yod pa/lnga/ dkar chung lha khang gi rdo ring yi ge 'dir gsham gsal gnad don khag lnga gsal bshad byas pa ste/(nyu1rgyal po khri lde srong btsan gyis sangs rgyas chos lugs mu mthud du srung skyob byas pa/5khong gi yab khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su brag dmar gyi bsam yas gtsug lag/ khang bzhengs pa/ 459

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/④rgyal po khri lde srong btsan rang nyid kyis rgyal sde dkar chung lha khang bzhengs pa/ ④rab byung gi nang nas chos la mkhas shing nus pa yod pa zhig 'dams nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku tshab mkhan por bsko dgos pa dang / khong la chos lugs kyi las don thad dbang cha tshang ma yod pa/⑤yab dang mes po'i dus su dkon mchog gsum gyi mchod rgyun du gnang ba'i lha 'bangs dang rgyu nor rnams mu mthud nas srung skyob 'gan len byed rgyu bcas 'khod yod/gong gsal gyi rdo ring nang 'khod pa'i gnad don de dag ni nga tshos bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug byed par med du mi rung ba'i gal che'i gnad don sha stag yin pas lo rgyus yig cha'i thog gi rtsod gleng thag gcod byed rgyur nus pa ldan pa'i dpang rtags zhig red/ der brten 1975lo nas bzung rgya bod lo rgyus la gzigs pa yangs pa'i dge rgan wang ya'o mchog nas gna' rabs bod kyi rdo ring yi ge dang / bka' gcigs gal chen rnams phyogs bsdus kyis snum dpar dusabatab 'dug pa de dang deng skabs slar yang blo mthun khren can can gyis 〈bod kyi rdo ring yi ge dang dril bu'i kha byang gces bsdus 〉bsgrigs pa 'di ni/ snga rabs kyi lo rgyus yig cha rnams la rdzun rkub brtol ba'i ched du ma yin par/ sngon yod bod yig gi lo rgyus thog mkhas pa rnams kyi bshad srol 'dra min sna tshogs yod pa'i nang nas yang dag pa rnams sngar bzhin rgyum/ rakhyongs byed rgyu dang / yang 460

ma dag pa rnams yo bsrang byas te sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas bod kyi gna' rabs lo rgyus gsal bshad byed bde yong ba'i dgos mkho dang 'tshams par gnang ba der ngas khong rnam gnyis la dga' gus chen pos thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang chabs cig bka' gcigs rdo ring 'di dag gi nang 'khod pa'i gal che'i gnad don rnams la rgya che'i gzigs pa po tshos do snang gnang bde yong ched dpyad gzhi'i sa bon tsam gyi mtshams sbyor gleng gzhir/

ge〈 deb ther sngon po'i 〉 mdzad pa po'i lo rgyus dang nang don ngo sprod gnad bsdus/deb ther 'di nyid kyi rtsom pa po ni mkhas pa'i dbang po 'gos lo sa/zhon nu dpal zhes bod sa gnas yongs dang rgya gar bal yul bcas su mtshan snyan shin tu che ba zhig yin/ bod kyi rab byung bdun pa'i chu spre/spyi lo 1392— nas rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags glang / spyi lo 1481lo'i bar dgung lo dgu bcur bzhugs/ 'khrungs yul ni lho kha 'phyongs rgyas khul rgyas sman lha khang gi mda' 'am pa ra'i grong nag me dgu zer ba'i sa char 'khrungs/ yab 'gos ston 'byung gnas rdo rje dang /yum srid thar skyid gnyis la sras lnga dang / (sras che bas khyim bzung yang ring min 'das shing / de'i 'og ma yang chung ngu nas 'das/ gsum pa 'angos lo rang nyid/ bzhi pa nam mkha' dpal ldan/ lnga pa mgon po rdo rje bcas yin/) sras mo gsum yod (rdo rje skyid/ bu 'dren/ rin chen skyid bcas yin/)pa'i nang gi gsum pa yin/ dgung lo dgu la phebs skabs spyan g.yas ma/khas ngo/ sangs rgyas dpal ba'i drung du rab byung myoshaṃdzad/ slo3bo dpon shes rab dar rgyas kyi drung nas spyod 'jug sogs gsan1/ dgung 'o bcu gnyis nas nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi bar du rtsed thang khi rngo ri 9 /na po bsam bzang pa la sa/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ ston pa shakyāpa la/sari nga5 hwa ri drun skor dang byams chonu/ sde lnga/ 'phan po thang sag gi mkhas pa ye ༷ ri rgyal mtshan las dbu ma rigs 462

〈deb sngon 〉mdzad pa po'i lo rgyus dang nangadonangosprodaganadabasdus/——da ——tshogs drug gi skor/ skyor mo lung du dge bshes bstan 'dzin don 'grub las 'dul ba dang mngon pa gong 'og rgyal ba karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa las sems bskyed dang na ro chos drug gung snang chos rje mdzes pa dpal las bde mchog gi skor gsan/ dgung lo nyer ba'i/ sa lus sgage snyegro ‘tāci/ 'on bkra shis do khar rje tsong kha pa mjal bar byon te bka' gdamaru/ 'a/myo/ rim dang / dbu ma/ na ro chos drug bcas gsan/ gzhan yang skyang che na ri ༈ sha kyā shi/ dang / spyan snga ri na chen 'phel/ shangs nga/ kun mkhyen/ 'a/kha na che na grub pa shes rab/ grub chen bso/da nams blo gros/ mkhan che na rgyal bzang pa/ rngog gi gdung rgyud thub pa dpal ba/ bzad pa blo gros /nye ma/tsho/lha pa rin po che rdo rje bla ma/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer sokra/sa ska/bas der bod du yongs su grags pa'i mkhas pa rme/nga po bsten nashā5 ma/ngo sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ gzhan yang chos lugs grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma mang po bsten par mdzad de/ rta nag gi chos rje sgrol ma ba dang / rgod phrug ras pa gnyis kyi drung nas rnying ma'i chos skor zung ngo//rong ston shakyā rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas sa skya'i chos skor/ rgyal ba /rma pa (nā nag dang zhwa dmar sku phreng rim pa'i drung nas dwags po bka' brgyud kyi chos skor sogs gsan par mdzad/ rig gnas kyi skor la shangs pa kun mkhyen dang / skyang chen pa shakyā shri'i drung nas dus 'khor rgyud 'gre/la skar rtsis dang bcas pa/ snar thang lo tsā ba saṅga shi'i drung nas sgra rig pa'i skor gsan nga sogs mdor na yongs su grags pa dang ma grags nga/stu/sku bla ma drug cu lhag tsam bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa klo/ 4( 2

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad cing / sku gzhon nu'i dus skabs nas sku na mthon por ma phebs bar nyin ltar shog bu mda' tshad ma bco lnga re chag med blo 'dzin gnang thub pa dang / chos gang gsan pa dang gzigs pa rnams thengs re re la khong du chud thub pa'i mkhyen rab kyi rtsal chen po yod pas/ rab byung bdun par rgya gar gyi partsi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen bod du phebs thengs dang por lo ngo bcu gnyis tsam bzhugs skabs 'gos lo dgung lo zhe gnyis pa/ rab byung bdun pa'i chu glang / spyi lo 1438lor thog mar mjal ba nas lo lnga tsam ring mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan zhing / parnyi tas chos nam gsungs na yang de'i skad bsgyur thogs med du mdzad pas thugs mnyes po byung ste/ deng sang 'dzam gling na ku ma ra shri (gzhon nu dpal )las mkhas pa ngas ma mthong zhes bsngags brjod tshad med pa mdzad/ rgya gar dang bal yul sogs su phebs ma myong yang / bod sa gnas rang du bzhugs te bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa'i drung du sgra rig pa la slob gnyer mdzad de rgya bal yongs su grags pa'i parnyi ta chen po de lta bu'i chos gsungs pa'i skad bsgyur thogs med du mdzad thub pa de'i thog nas bod yig du bsgyur ba'i rgya gar skad kyi sgra rig pa'i gzhung rnams dang / de'i slob khrid kyi chu tshad ha cang mthon por byin yod pa mngon par gsal thub bo//gsung rtsom khyon pod bcu tsam yod pa las grags che ba ni/ 〈 dus 'khor rgyud 'grel chen mo 〉dgung lo nga gcig pa chu khyi lor brtsams/〈rtsis kyi bstan bcos 'khrul sel 〉dang / 〈 dus 'khor dka' 'grel 〉 464

〈deb sngon 〉mdzad pa po'i lo rgyus dang nangadonangosprodaganadabasdus/ da wa——〈 'phrul 'khor bcu gcig gi nang don rnam par bshad pa 〉dgung lo don gsum pa shing sprel lor brtsams/ 〈rgyud bla ma'i 'grel bshad chen mo 〉dgung lo don bdun pa sa byi lor brtsams/ 〈 phar phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel bshad 〉dgung lo gya bzhi pa me spre lo 'gor brtsams/〈deb ther sngon po 〉'di ni dgung lo gya bzhi pa rab byung brgyad pa'i me spre/spyi lo 1476lor mgo brtsams te sa khyi spyi lo 1478lo'i lo mjug tu mjug rdzogs par mdzad/ gzhan yang dgung lo ji tsam la mdzad pa gsal bar ma 'khod pa'i gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig 'dug kyang 'dir ma bkod/ deb ther 'di mdzad nas lo ngo bzhi song ba rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags glang / spyi lo 1481lor sku gshegs shing / lo der lo chen bsod nams rgya mtshos bya pa khri dpon bkra shis dar rgyas la bskul ma gnang ba ltar khong gis rgyu yon sbyar te/ dol lhun grub lha rtser par bsgrun gyi ma yig bris thog gnyal chos rgyal lhun por dngos su dpar bskrun byas nas yangs pa can gyi dgon par bzhugs su gsol ba las rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu glang / spyi lo 1793lor karma zhwa dmar ba chos grub rgya mtshos sne khrid byas pa'i gor kha btsan 'dzul dmag gis bod ljongs su btsan 'dzul byas pa'i dmag dpung gtor pham btang nas yangs pa can gyi dgon—pa dge lugs dgon par bsgyur rjes deb ther 'di'i par shing rnams yangs pa can nas kun bde gling du spos shing / deng skabs par shing nang khag gcig ma tshang ba phud/ mang che ba ma nyams par bsdad yod pa red/ gong gsal gyi lo rgyus rnams 'gos lo rang nyid kyi dngos slob 465

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/skyes mchog pas brtsams pa'i rnam thar 〈 thams cad mkhyen pa gzhon nu'i zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa 〉grangs 73yod pa mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs pa de dang / chag lo rin chen chos rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 dus 'khor chos 'byung dpag bsam snye ma 〉sa skya lha khang chen mo'i nang bzhugs pa de gnyis nas gnad bsdus byas te bkod pa yin/mkhas pa'i dbang po 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis mdzad pa'i 〈 deb ther sngon po 〉'di bzhin slar yang par bskrun byas pa'i rgyu mtshan dang gleng gzhi mdo tsam zhig ngo sprod zhu rgyur/1 〈 deb ther sngon po 〉'di ni bod gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus yig cha grags can mang po'i nang nas khungs btsan pa dang / dpyad gzhi'i rnam grangs mang ba/ lo grangs kha gsal ba/ sde tshan so so nas 'tshol bde ba bcas kyidage mtshan mang po ldan yod pa ma zad/ rtsom pa po 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal yang mdo sngags rig gnas chos lugs grub mtha' thams cad la mkhas shing byang chub pas dus skabs de'i bod kyi mkhas pa mang che bas thams cad mkhyen pa 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal zhes 'grin gcig gis bstod bsngags byed kyi yod pa dang / chos lugs grub mtha' khab/ gi lo rgyus yig cha thams cad la gzigs rgya che thog/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gsum la phebs rjes lo ngo gsum gyi ring rang nyid kyi phyag tu yod pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha mang po zhig la zhib gzigs brtag dpyad gnang ste brtsams par mdzad pa zhig yin stabs sngon dang deng rabs kyi lo rgyus smra ba'i mkhas dbang mang che bas tshad mar 'dzin cing gdeng 'jog mtho ba'i 466

(deb sngon 〉mdzad pa po'i lorgyus dang nangadonangosprodaganadabasdus/ da ——dpyad gzhi'i yig cha ha cang legs po zhig yin/2 〈 deb ther sngon po 〉'di la snga rabs kyi lo rgyus yig cha gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos bzhi yod/ 1)skabs der khong gis gzigs myong ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha'i rigs la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba yod pa rnams skabs su gang babs kyi thad kar bkod pa las/ de dag la dgag sgrub kyi spros pa mdzad med pa/ (nyadapyad gzhi'i yig cha khungs btsan med pa'i thog rigs pas kyang bsgrub par dka' ba rnams gzhan gyi zer sgros shod rgyun tsam las med kyang btang snyoms su 'jog par ma mdzad par phyi rabs mkhas pa rnams kyis slar yang brtag dpyad bya rgyu'i dpyad gzhir bkod pa gnang yod pa/ (7chos lugs grub mtha' khag sga lo rgyus thad rang rangarteso so'i chos 'byung dang rnam thar nang 'khod pa gzhir bzung nas bris gnang mādzad thog tshang mar gdeng 'jog mthon po'i bstod bsngags gnang ba ma gtogs rang nyid kyi grub mtha'i phyogs bzung nas gzhan la zur za dang dma' 'bebs kyi tshig gtan nas bkod med pa'i dbang gis klog pa po tshos bltas na 'gos lo rang nyid kyi rtsa ba'i grub mtha' gang yin gsal por shes mi thub pa/ (4rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i deb ther 'di la rang nyid kyis gdeng 'jog mdzad pa ha cang drang po yin pa ste/ deb ther 'di'i le tshan (bste grangs 10ba5——ba 2bar du gsal bar/ rang nyid kyis 'bri gnang mdzad pa'i lo rgyus mang che ba ni snga rabs kyi yi ge rnying pa gzhir bzung nas bris pa yin pas yid ches byed chog pa'i khungs btsan yin pa dang / dpyad gzhi khungs 467

da wa dungadakarablo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/btsan med pa'i rigs rnams gzhan gyi zer tshod tsam bris pa ma gtogs rigs pas bsgrub thub pa mi snang zhes gsal bar gsung yod pa bcas red/ gong du gsal ba'i khyad chos de dag ni lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'bri ba la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi spyod tshul gzab nan can zhig yin pas phyi rabs kyi mi rnams kyis nges par du slob sbyong byed 'os pa'i mig dpe bzang po zhig red/3 skyon sel dang dogs gcod bya rgyu'i gsal bshad/ nga tshos nges par du shes dgos pa ni/ deb ther 'di'i nang du 〈 deb ther dmar po'i 〉lung drangs pa'i bar du mchan bu khag brgyad tsam 'dug pa de ni/skabs der 'gos lo rang nyid kyis gzigs myong ba'i deb ther dmar po dpe ma dag pa zhig gi mchan bu yin pa las/ 'gos lo rang nyid kyis bcug pa gnang ba'i mchan bu ni gtan nas min te/ mchan bu der shog ngos gnyis gsum tsam gyi mgo mjug la rang tshig snga phyi 'gal ba'i skyon dang / skar rtsis la sbyangs pa gtan nas byas ma myong ba'i dpang rtags gsal po 'dug cing / 'gos lo ni mdo sngags rig gnas kun dang skar rtsis la mkhas shing byang chub pa zhig yin pas nor 'khrul mang pos khengs pa'i mchan bu de 'dra gtan nas bcugo par mdzad mi srid la/ mchan bu de 'dra de sngon mthong myong ba'i deb ther dmar po dpe mi 'dra ba khag bcu gcig tsam gyi nang du'ang gtan nas mi snang bas tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes bkod pa'i mchan bu yang min no/ /de dang phyogs mtshungs srong btsan dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis bzhugs par 〈 'jam dpal rtsa 468

deb sngon mdzad pa po'i lo rgyus dang nangadonangosprodaganadabasdus/ da wa gebargyud 〉kyi lung bstan la 'grel bshad gnang skabs gsungs shing /deb 'di'i shog grangs 7014yod/ 'gos lo rang nyid kyis bzhed pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i 'khrungs lo'i sa glang de/ thang rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thang ka'o tsu'u yis srid dbang bzung rjes kyi sa glang (spyi lo 629)lo de yin pa las/ de'i drug cu skor sngon ma'i sa glang de min pa ni 'gos lo rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 〈deb sngon 〉gsham gsal gyi dum bu khag de rnams nas gsal por ra sprod byed thub pa yod de/ 'dir dum bu 'ga' shas dper drangs na/ 〈deb ther sngon po 〉lha sa par ma'i le kha grangs 30na/ gzhan yang bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo tshigs gsungs pa'i mjug tu chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sa glang lo la 'khrungs pa nas deb ther 'di bgyis pa'i me spre lo yan chad du lo brgyad brgya bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad 'das so/ /zhes dang / yang le tshan de rang gi grangs 5na 2de la spyir srong btsan sgam po sa glang la 'khrungs nas lo nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gnyis 'das pa lcags glang (881)lo la ral pa can gyis rgya dang 'dums mdzad/ chu pho stag lo (882)la lha sa'i rdo ring btsugs/ chu stag de nas lo bco lnga pa me 'brug la (896)ral pa can gshegs/ lo de nyid nas lcags bya'i (901)bar dar mas rgyal po byas/ rab tu byung ba'i bstan pa bsnubs/ zhes dang / bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcags bya (901)nas lo bdun cu rtsa bdun pa 'di me mo glang gi lo (977)yin/ de'i rjes kyi sa stag (978)nas jo bo rje bod du byon pa'i chu rta (1042)bar lo drug cu rtsa bzhi yod/ lo de dag gi khongs su dbus gtsang mi drug gis rab tu 469

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ byung ba'i bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ jo bo rje bod du byonaspyodus mi drug po'i slob ma khu rngog la sogs pa mang du bzhugs so/ /zhes dang / yang le tshan ( ba) grangs 6na 7chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs nas lo bdun brgya dang nyi shu lhag 'das pa tsam na/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ zhes pa nas/grangs 8ba 5bar rje tsong kha pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus dang / rgyal tshab rje nas dga' ldan khri thog lnga pa rje blo gros chos skyong bar gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus gsal zhing / deb ther 'di rtsom par mdzad skabs dga' ldan khri thog bdun pa dwags po blo gros brtan pa dga' ldan khri thog tu bzhugs pa'i skabs yin par gsal bar gsungs/ yang deb ther 'di'i mdzad byang du/ chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs nas lo brgyad brgya dang lnga bcu pa la babs pa sa khyi (1478)lor dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags 'dabs rang byung bdud rtsi'i rgyun can mngon par dga' ba'i chos rdzong du chos smra ba'i btsun pa gzhon nu dpal gyis nye bar sbyar ba'o/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa rnams zhib bsdur gyis yar slog gi rtsis byas tshe rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i 'khrungs lo'i thad 'gos lo rang nyid kyi bzhed par rang tshig snga phyi 'gal ba'i skyon nam yang mi 'jug pas/ deb sngon nang gzhan gyi 'dod pa bkod pa'i tshig dang / rtsom pa po'i bzhed pa gnyis gcig tu 'khrul mi rigs so/ / 'a deb ther 'di brtsams par mdzad skabs kyi lo rgyus cha rkyen ni skabs der sde srid phag mo gru pa'i khri rabs dgu pa spyan snga ngag gi dbang 47’0

〈deb sngon 〉mdzad pa po'i lo rgyus dang nangadonangosprodaganadabasdus/ —da wa posartesrid dbang bzung steci phag mo gru pa nang khul mi mthun pa'i 'gal ba'i dbang gis nang 'khrug yang yang byung ba dang / go skabs de dang bstun nas sde pa rin spungs pa nor bu bzang pos gtsang khul gyi rdzong gzhis mang po blangs ste phag mo gru pa'i srid dbang nyams rgud du 'gro ba'i 'go tshugs nas ring poro ma lon pa'i skabs su khel zhing / 'gos lo rang nyid dang sne gdong sdortsesrid ngo ma'i bar la yang 'brel ba legs po med pa'i rkyen gyis lo rgyus deb ther 'bri ba gnang rgyur mkho ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha ha cang mang po zhig sne gdong pho brang du yod kyang 'gos lo rang nyid kyi phyag tu 'byor rgyur 'gog rkyen mang po zhig phrad de dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'dzoms po zhig ma byung ba red/ de sngon sne gdong sde srid khri rabs drug pa dbang grags pa 'byung gnas kyis srid dbang bzung skabs 'gos lo rang nyid sde srid ngo ma'i dbu blar gyur pa dang / sne gdong pho brang dang / gdan sa mthil/ rtsed thang dgon pa bcas la gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i yig cha ha cang sne 'dzoms po yod pas dus skabs der khong gis deb ther 'di rtsom 'bri gnang thub na da riyod kyi deb ther 'di las rgyas tsam zhig yong rgyu yin yang / de skabs chos 'chad spel dang / gsung rtsom gal chen mang po zhig gnang rgyu yod pa des go skabs 'phrog nas dgung lo mthon po ma phebs bar du rtsom 'bri gnang ma thub par lus shing / 'on kyang rang nyid sku na mthon po dgung lo brgyad cu gya lngar phebs yod kyang da dung sku ngal la ma 'dzems par dpyad gzhi'i yig cha thabs shes gang yod kyis 'tshol bsdu dang zhib 47/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gzigs thog lo ngo gsum gyi ring 'bad brtson chen pos deb ther 'di rtsom 'bri mdzad de rang cag phyi rabs kyi mi rnams la lo rgyus lta ba'i nor bu'i bang mdzod lta bur 'jog gnang mdzad pa der nga tshos sems kyi gting nas bka' drin dran pa'i gus 'dud dang rjes dran zhu ba'i bsam tshul mtshon byed du deb ther 'di nyid par bskrun byas pa yin pas gzigs pa po rnams kyis rin thang bral ba'i dgongs 'char thad ka'am yig thog gang rigs nas 'dzems zol med par gnang skyong yod pa zhu rgyu'i gsal bshad du/ 472

〈 deb ther dmar po gsar ma 〉 maljad pa po'i lo rgyus dang nang don ngo sprod gnad bsdus/〈 deb ther dmar po gsar ma 〉'am yang na ming gzhan 〈 rgyal rabs 'phrul gyi lde mig 〉ces pa 'di'i mdzad po ni/ dga' ldan khri thog bco lnga pa paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa yin/ bod kyi rab byung brgyad pa'i sa khyi spyi lo 1478nas rab byung dgu pa'i shing stag spyi lo 1554lo bar dgung lo bdun cu don bdun bzhugs/ khong ni lho kha rtsed thang dgon pa'i nye 'dabs kyi grong1tsho zhig nang 'byor pa dang ldan pa'i khyim tshang zhig gi bur 'ikhrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas rtsed thang dgon par chos zhugs kyis yi ge 'bri klog sogs la sbyangs pa mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug gi skabs su lha sar phebs te dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun bar lo bcu gnyis ring se ra theg chen gling du bzhugs/ kun mkhyen don yod dpal ldan dang / gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ thon pa mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho bcas bla mar bsten nas phar phyin/ tshad ma/ dbu ma/'dul ba/ mdzod bcas gzhung chen po lnga slob gnyer mthar phyin pa gnang zhing / zha zhor gsang sngags kyi chos kyang mi nyung ba zhig gsan/dgung lo nyi shu la 'od sna'i bla ma sangs rgyas bzang po dang rin chen chos bzang gnyis kyi drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes pa dang / mdo phyogs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i slob gnyer thon nas dge bshes mkhas pa'i 473

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrig/yang rtser son/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun nas lo gsum ring rgyud stod grwa tshang du zhugs te rgyud pa'i slob dpon chos ldan blo gros bla mar bsten nas gsang sngags kyi dbang lung khrid sogs ha cang mang po gsan nas gsang sngags kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa mdzad cing 〈 rgyud sde spyi'i rnam bshad 〉kyang brtsams/ dgung lo so bzhi pa lcags lug lor rgyud stod grwa tshang gi slob dpon gyi khrir phebs nas lo bcu bzhi'i ring rgyud kyi 'chad nyan gnang / dgung lo so drug par 〈 gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid yig 〉gnyis kyang brtsams/ dgung lo zhe bdun par tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bka' ltar lo drug gi ring 'bras spungs blo gsal gling grwa tshang gi mkhan po mdzad/ de'i ring la 〈 phar phyin gyi spyi don yum don gsal ba'i sgron me 〉 〈 dbu ma'i spyi don zab don gsal ba'i sgron me 〉sogs brtsams/ dgung lo nga gnyis pa sa glang spyi lo 1529lor dga' ldan gyi khrir phebs te lo bdun gyi ring la mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan rgyun mi chad par mdzad/ de'i ring 〈 bka' gdams gsar rnying gi chos 'byung yid kyi mdzes rgyan〉 〈 'dul ba'i spyi don lung rigs nyi ma〉 〈 dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod zab don yang gsal sgron me〉〈mdzod kyi spyi don shes bya rab gsal〉 〈tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi spyi don dgongs pa rab gsal 〉bcas brtsams/ dgung lo nga brgyad pa shing lug lor dga' ldan khri pa'i lo dus gtsang nas dgongs zhu mdzad de lo ngo brgyad ring dga' ldan dgon du zur bzhugs thos/ nye 'alo/ ra gyi dgon pa 'ga' zhig gi 'dod mos ltar mkhan po mdzad/ de'i ring la 〈 'dul 474

sgyudeb dmar gsar ma 〉mdzadapa po'i lo rgyus dang nang don gnad bsdus/ba'i chos 'byung〉 〈bstan rtsis rin chen phreng ba〉 〈 dge ldan legs bshad pad+ma dkar po'i chun po 〉sogs brtsams/〈 deb ther dmar po gsar ma 〉'di yang dgung lo drug cu re gcig pa sa khyi spyi lo 1538lor brtsams/ dgung lo re drug pa chu yos lo nas lo ngo bzhi'i ring 'bras spungs kyi mkhan po mdzad/ dgung lo re dgu pa me rta lo nas sku ma gshegs kyi bar se ra'i mkhan po mdzad cing / de'i ring la gzhung chen po'i 'grel bshad dang dogs‘gcod sogs mang po brtsams pa gnang yod/ gong gsal gyi lo rgyus rnams paṇa chen nyid kyi dngos slob bya bral lha dbang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈 paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i dpal rnam dpyod mchog gi sde'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung rol rtsed 〉las gnad bsdus byas te bsgrigs pa yin pas zhib pa rnam thar ngo mar gzigs/deng sang gi lo rgyus smra ba 'ga' zhig gis paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa ni gtsang pa rgyal po'i bka' blon bkra shis rtse pas do dam btson 'jug byas te bkrongs pa yin tshul bshad pa ni nor 'khrul yin te/gtsang pa rgyal po'i bka' blon bkra shis rtse pas btson 'jug byas te ljags bcad nas bgrongs pa'i rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pa rmi 'khrungs yul stod lung lam pa nas yin pas lam pa rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pa zer zhing / khong ni paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dngos slob yin la/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa ni 'khrungs yul lho kha rtsed thang nas yin pa dang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sku na phra ba'i dus kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma 475

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrig/mdzad myong zhing / skabs der sde pa rin spungs pa'i srid dbang gi stobs shugs rgyas skabs yin pas gtsang pa rgyal po dang dus mi mtshungs pa yin pas so/ /〈 deb ther dmar po gsar ma 〉'di'i nang don thad/ tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes brtsams pa'i 〈 deb ther dmar po 〉las ma gsal ba'i khri skor bcu gsum gyi khri dpon phal che ba'i lo rgyus dang / lhag par du phag gru sde srid kyi khri rabs bcu gcig pa bar gyi gal che'i lo rgyus mang po zhig kha snon gnang yod pa'i ming la 〈 deb ther dmar po gsar ma 〉zhes zer zhing bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug byed rgyur gal che ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha zhig red/ 'on kyang de sngon dpe cha bris bshus byas pa sha stag las par du ma 'khod pa'i dbang gis dpe rgyun shin tu dkon/ da lam bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas sngon gyi bris ma rnying pa zhig la ma phyi byas te mngon che'i yig nor re 'ga' dag bcos byas (gzigs bde ba'i phyir le'u khag lngar dbye ba'i kha byang chung ba ni rtsom sgrig pas gsab 'bri byas pa yin )yod pa bcas de don dgongs 'jags 'tshal/ 476

〈 sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad mkhas pa'i legs bshad gartses badril 〉〉 kyi rtsom pa po'i lo rgyas gnad bsdus/sum rtags 'grel pa 'di'i mdzad pa po ni shar chen ngag dbang tshul khrims yin/ (dbyangs can ngag gi dbang phyug )khong gi 'khrungs yul dang 'khrungs lo 'das lo gsal bar 'khod pa'i lo rgyus shig da phan lag tu ma son cing / khong sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs bshad sgra sde srid dbang phyug rgyal po'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa dang / rnam kun bzhugs gnas bshad sgra gzim shag tu mdzad pa/ sku phreng gsum pa thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan yang bdag nyid lo na chung dus phar phyin dang dbu ma'i dge gon mdzad myong ba'i thog sku 'khrungs sa bshad sgra rang du yin pas rgyun bzhugs gnang yul sngar bzhin bshad sgrar bzhugs kyi yod stabs/ da lta zhal bzhugs pa sras sku zhabs dga' ldan dpal 'byor mchog la shar chen ngag dbang tshul khrims kyi lo rgyus skor bka' 'dri zhus par yang zhib gsal gsung rgyu med lugs bcas la brten/ khong dang 'brel yod kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa gnyis kyi rnam thar dang / bshad sgra sde srid kyi lo rgyus bcas nas rang gis gang shes mdor bcis su bkod na/ khong gi rtsa ba'i bla ma ni dngul 477

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chu dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje dang / kong po rgyal dbang 'phrin las rnam rgyal gnyis yin pa der brtags na khong rnam pa gnyis las dgung lo nyi shu yas mas kyis chung ba yod pas/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i dkyil tsam du 'khrungs par nges/ sku na gzhon dus ser smad grwa tshang du chos bzhugs gnang ba'i khang tshan ni kong po yin/ dgung lo sum cu lhag tsam ma phebs bar lo nyi shu tsam gyi ring grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs ltar gzhung chen bka' pod lngar slob gnyer mthar phyin pa gnang ste dge bshes lha rams pa'i grwa skor mtshan bzhes gnang / lha rams grwa skor thon 'phral rgyud stod grwa tshang du chos zhugs thog lo mang ring gsang sngags kyi gzhung chen por slob gnyer dang rgyud pa grwa tshang gi phyag bzhes tsha ga'i gdangs dbyangs dang /dkyil 'khor sogs kyi thig rngul tshon/ blos bslangs sogs la sbyangs pa mthar phyin thon pa mdzad cing / bar gseng nas yin la dngul chu dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje dang / dge ldan khri chen byang chub chos 'phel/khri chen ngag dbang chos 'phel sogs kyi drung nas sum rtags dang snyan ngagasgra rig pa/ skar rtsis sogs slob sbyong mdzad skabs kun bshad kyi mtshan la dbyangs can ngag gi dbang phyug zhes gsol/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang po'i bshad pa dang / dbang lung nyams khrid sogs grangs las 'das pa ga/san zhing / gang gsan pa de dag kyang tshig tsam du ma song bar lag len thog 'khyol ba'i gdeng tshod yod par mdzad/ rim bzhin rgyud stod sngags rams pa'i grwa skor mtshan bzhes dang rgyud pa'i dge bskos/bla ma dbu mdzad/ mkhan po/ shar pa chos rje bcas kyi mtshan gnas 478

(sum rtags 'grel bshad mkhas pa'i legs bshad gces bsdus 〉mdzad po'i lo rgyus/bzhes shing / dga' ldan khri thog tu phebs nye'i mtshams su dgongs pa rdzogs stabs dgung lo drug cu yas mas shig 'tsho bzhugs gnang yod pa tshod dpag thub/ gsung rtsom skor/ par du 'khod pa dang ma 'khod pa bsdoms pa'i pod gnyis brtsam yod cing / grags che ba ni 〈 'dul ba'i sdoms tshigs blo gsal mgu ba bskyed pa'i ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi me long 〉zhes pa shog grangs dgu bcu go bdun tsam yod pa de yin cing /de ni gdan sa chen po gsum sogs dbus gtsang mdo smad bcas su khyab che ba'i sdoms tshigs shig yin stabs blo 'dzin gnang mkhan ha cang mang po yod/khong gi gsung rtsom gras 〈 sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad mkhas pa'i legs bshad gces bsdus 〉zhes pa 'di ni khong nyid dge bshes lha rams thon nas rgyud stod grwa tshang du lo mang bzhugs ring dngul chu dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i drung nas sum rtags kyi mdzub khrid zhib rgyas gsan skabs zin bris 'god gnang mdzad rjes slar yang 〈 si tu'i 'grel chen 〉dang 〈 pra sti'i sum rtags 〉 gzhan yang sum rtags kyi 'grel bshad mang por zhib 'jug brtag dpyad gnang ba'i mjug bsdoms su rang nyid kyi dpyad brjod 'god par gnang ba'i ched rtsom legs po zhig yin par brten/ de sngon gdan sa chen po khag dang sger gyi dpe mdzod khang che gras mang po'i nang du yi ge dbu can dang /dbu med thog nas bris bshus byas pa mang po mthong yang par du 'khod pa gtan nas byung mi 'dug pa ma zad/ dpe rgyun dkon pa'i gras shig yin/ 479

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/der brten rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs phran rang nas lo mang srung skyob nyar tshag byas pa'i lta dpe bris ma 'di nyid par bskrun thub pa zhig byung na bsams nas zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang la re bskul zhus pa bzhin ha cang thugs khur chen pos par bskrun gyi 'gan bzhes gnang ba dang chabs cig rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus gnad bsdus shig yi ger 'god dgos zhes gsung nan phebs pa'i zhal ngo ma ldog tsam du/ 480

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/gleng gzhi/de sngon 1977lor/ krung gung bod rang skyong ljongs tang u dang /rang skyong ljongs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u nas/ gus rang la bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs de gang 'dra byas nas byung ba'i skor gyi lo rgyus zhig 'bri dgos pa'i las 'gan gnang byung zhing / de ni lo rgyus kyi ched du lo rgyus 'bri rgyu zhig ma yin par/ rtsod sgrub dngos gtso smra ba dang lo rgyus dngos gtso smra ba'i lta tshul spyad nas/ bod kyi lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi dus skabs rim pa'i dpal 'byor lam lugs dang / chab srid/chos lugs bcas la zhib 'jug byas te/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs de thog mar ga 'dra byas nas byung ba dang / rjes su 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i go rim/ mthar rgyu rkyen ga 'dra zhig la brten nas rtsa med song ba bcas kyi lo rgyus la dbye zhib byed dgos stabs nang don ha cang rgya che zhing gting zab pa zhig red/ nga rang gis cung zad go rim ldan pa'i lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rtsom 'bri byas pa de da res thengs dang po yin pa'i thog rtsod sgrub dngos gtso smra ba'i lo rgyus lta tshul gyi chu tshad ha cang dma' ba'i khar/ dgos nges kyi dpya da gzhi'i yig cha khag gcig phyi rol gyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas lag tu son dgang ba dang / rtsom 'bri 48/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bya rgyur dgos nges kyi cha rkyen yang ha cang zhan pa bcas la brten/ thog mar tshod lta'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha gnad bsdus nyung ngu zhig rtsom 'bri byas pa'i zin bris thengs dang po de gzigs pa po rnams kyis dgongs pa tshim thub pa lta zhog so so rang nyid kyang 'dod pa khengs pa zhig byung ma song / de rjes dus tshod ring po ma phyin par rim pa gong mas bkod sgrigs gnang don ltar/ nga rang pe cin krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mor slob gso'i las gnas su rang 'jags bskyod rgyu'i go skabs bzang po thob pa dang chabs cig 'brel yod las khungs khag nas dgos nges kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha khag gcig lta klog byed rgyu byung ba ma zad/ mi rigs khag gi lo rgyus la gzigs pa yangs pa'i rgya bod blo mthun khag gcig gis rin thang bral ba'i dgongs 'char gnang ba yang bsdu len byas te/ slar yang sngon yod rtsom yig gi rmang gzhi'i thog kha snon dang bcos bsgrigs byas shing / snga rjes su legs bcos thengs bzhi byas pa yin/rtsom yig 'di'i sgrigs stangs thad/ lo rgyus kyi dus skabs so so'i gnas tshul rnams go rim bzhin du bsgrigs te dus de'i bod sa gnas dang mes rgyal bar gyi 'brel ba'i gnas tshul dang / de'i gzhi 'dzin sa'i yig cha'i ming rnams so so'i thad kar bkod thog skabs re las ka'i dgos mkho'i dbang gis nang don kha shas zur 'don byed dgos tshe stabs bde yong ba dang / gzigs pa po rnams kyis gzigs bde ba'i ched du dkar chag kyang bkod cing / da dung rgya yig gzigs ma thub pa'i blo mthun tshor cung zad thugs phan gsos pa yong res rgya bod 'brel ba'i lo 482

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/rgyus gnad bsdus skabs dang sbyar nas bkod yod/rtsom yig 'di dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad don khag gcig lo rgyus rtsom 'bri gnang mkhan gzhan dag tshos rtsom 'bri gnang grub pa rnams 'dir bskyar bzlos byas med/ 'on kyang rang nyid lo rgyus dngos gtso smra ba'i chu tshad kyis ma ldeng ba dang da dung dgos nges kyi yig cha khag gcig lag tu ma son pa bcas la brten nas cha ma tshang ba dang nor 'khrul nges par du yong srid pas/ rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi rin thang bral ba'i dgongs char thad ka'am yang na yig thog gang rung nas lhug por gnang skyong yod pa zhu rgyu/ dang po/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs ma byung gong chos srid tha dad du gnas pa'i dus 4 jiskabs kyi gnas tshul dang chos lugs phan tshun bar gyi 'thab rtsod skor/(1)bod la sangs rgyasacichos l+yags ma byung gong gi bon dzo'i chos lugs 'kha skabs de'i : tshogs rganas tshul skor/'jig rten thog gi bya dngos tshang ma'i 'gyur ldog de yang thog mar cha shas dang grangs 'bor thog gi 'gyur ldog byung ba brgyud nas mthar ngo bo'i 'gyur ldog yong gi yod pa ltar/ bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam 483

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lugs de yang thog mar chos srid thatshodad du gnas pa'i rnam pa'i thog nas rim bzhin 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldog byung ba zhig dang / lam lugs de dus skabs gcig nang glo bur du byung ba'i snang tshul zhig min par/ chos lugs dar ba nas bzung chos srid tha dad du gnas pa'i go rim brgyud chos lugs mi sna khag gcig gi gral rim gyi ngo bo rim bzhin 'gyur ldog phyin pa'i yong nges kyi 'bras bu zhig rang red/ der brten nga tshos lo rgyus kyi dus skabs nges can de gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba dang / 'gyur ldog gi gnas tshul la thog mare lta tsam zhig byed do/ /de sngon bod kyi lo rgyus tshor/ bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs dhi ma byung gong rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal po lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi bar rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun ring bod kyi chab srid de sgrung / lde'u/bon/ gsum gyis bskyangs zhes gsol ba der gzhi bzung na/ bod kyi chab srid dang bon po'i chos lugs gnyis zung 'brel byas pa'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs shig sangs rgyas chos lugs bod la ma dar gong nas byung zin yod pa lta bu zhig 'dug rung zhib tu brtags skabs/ de dus/ rgyal po tshor sku bon zer ba'i rgyal po'i bla ma zhig yod pa de rnams rgyal po'i sku rim byed mkhan tsam yin pa las srid dbang bzung mkhan zhig yin tshod mi 'dug 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉sogs bod kyi lo rgyus mang po zhig gi nang rgyal po srong btsan sgam po ma byung gong gi lo bdun brgya sum cu so gcig gi sngon la bod kyi rgyal po dang po gnya' ① 'di skor 〈bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs 〉zer ba zhig zur du bris pa der gsal/ 484

bod kyi chos srid zunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wa—khri btsan po byung ba bshad pa ltar na/ bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 429shing byi (han nub ma'i rgyal rabs kyi gong ma han u dhi'i yon sngo'o'i khri lo drug pa)dhi spyi lo'i gong gi 117lo yas mas kyi dus su srid dbang bzung zhing / rgyal po 'di'i dus tshe mi gshen gyi rtsargyal zer bas bon bsgyur ba dang / de ni bod sa gnas rang du thog mar byung ba'i bon po yin par 〈sabon po'i lo rgyus 〉dang / 〈 tā la'i lnga pa'i deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉 paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas brtsams pa'i dz+nyo deb ther dmar po gsar ma rgyal rabs 'phrul gyi lde mig 〉bcas su gsal zhing / rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su byung ba'i bon chos de ni bod sa gnas rang du thog mar byung ba'i bon chos yin pas ming la brdolobonasgroze ra/ chos lugs de ni sngar yod gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi bsam blo'i rmang gzhi'i thog 'byung ba lnga'i lha dang / yul lha/khyim lha/ dgra lha/ zhang lha sogs lha rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa de tshor/ sems can ba phyugs dngaka ra lug shwa ba sogs bsad nas mchod pa 'bul ba dang / mi shi tshar nas 'dre la skyes pa dang lha la skyes pa yod pa ma zad/ lha 'dre shi nas mi la skyes pa'ang yod pas skye ba snga phyi yod par khas len gyi yod/ de la lo rgyus thog bon dkar po zer zhing dmigs bsal gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs gang yang med/ nang pa sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lo rgyus yig cha'i bshad srol ltar na/ rgyal rabs brgyad pa rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i dus su mnga' ris zhang zhung gi yul du gshen dhi 'di'i shākya'i 'das lo ni kha che paṇa shāspya sgori'isagasagazhir bathung ba yin/ 485

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rabs mi bo che (yongs grags su bon ston pa gshen rabs zer)zer ba de byung zhing / de rgya gar nub phyogs kyitā sig① brgyud nas bod du 'khyar ba'i mu stegs dbang phyug pa'i lta ba de dang sngar yod bon po'i chos gnyis bsres te rigs pa'i gzhung lugs shig gsar gtod byas pa de ni 'khyar bon zer ba de yin pa las brdol bon min/bon chos gsar pa der snang gshen zer zhing / des skye ba snga phyi zer ba gtan nas khas len gyi med rung / lha 'dre yod par khas len gyi yod/kho tshos khas len pa'i lha ni mi de gson por sdod dus mi de'i tshe srog la srung skyob byed mkhan zhig yin pa dang / 'dre ni mi de gson por sdod skabs srog gi bdag po byed pa ma zad/ mi de shi rjes bla srog de 'dre des khyer nas 'gro ba dang / da dung mi de'i khyim tshang dang mi rgyud rjes mar yang mu mthud nas gnod pa skyel gyi yod pas/ skyob pa'i lha de mchod dgos pa dang / gnod pa'i 'dre de med pa bzo dgos zhes zer gyi yod pa red/ chos lugs 'dis lo re'i ston ka'i dus su shā pho ru rkyang zhes shwa ba pho stong phrag gcig dus gcig tu ske bcad nas bsad pa'i sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul ba dang / dgun ka'i dus su bon lha dmar mchod ces g.yag lug ra sogs pho phyugs stong phrag gsum re longs pa'i ske dus gcig tu bcad nas bsad pa dang / 'bri lug ra sogs mo phyugs stong ① bod kyi lo rgyus thog bkod pa'i tā sig ni dbyi lang la go dgos/ de'i rgyu ma ni/ thang tha'i tsung gi khrin kon khri lo bcu drug spyi lo 642lor rgya gar nub phyogs kyi tā sig a la pos dbyi lang la dmag drangs te dbyi lang a la po'i 'og tu shor zhing de nas yon rgyal rabs kyis dbyi lang la dmag ma drangs bar dbyi lang de tā sig a la po'i rgyal khab kyi mnga' 'og tu bsdad pa red/ 486

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/phrag gcig re longs pa'i yan lag rnams gson por lhu lag phral nas bsad pa'i sha khrag gi dmar mchod/ dpyid ka'i dus su yu mo'i byin 'breg zer ba shwa ba yu mo bzhi'i rkang las/ lhu lag phral nas bsad pa'i sha khrag gi dmar mchod/ dbyar kha'i dus su bon ston bsangs mchod zer ba shing sna dang 'bru sna'i bsangs gtong ba bcas byed kyi yod pa ma zad/mi la na tsha byung ba'i skabs su srog blus spus 'gyed zer ba/ gong bzhin mi so so'i dpal 'byor che chung la gzhigs pa'i sems can pho phyugs dang /mo phyugs stong phrag gsum nas ma tha re re las ma byung yang bsad nas dmar mchod 'bul gyi yod pa dang / mi shi rjes 'dre 'dul zer ba byed skabs kyang gong ltar sems can bsad nas dmar mchod 'bul dgos kyi yod pa/ da dung g.yang sgrub byed pa dang / mdos rgyab pa/ glud gtong ba/mo/ rgyab pa/ pra phab pa/ gson po dang gshin po'i rtsis rgyab pa sogs byed kyi yod par brten/ sems can bsad pa'i dmar mchod gzhi rgya chen po des bod kyi 'brog las thon skyed thog la gnod skyon tshabs yong gi yod pa mthong nas/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bon po'i chos lugs bkag 'gog byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin zhes 〈 mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi rnam thar 〉nang gsal por 'khod 'dug 〈 bon gyi chos 'byung legs bshad mdzod 〉las bon gyiston pa gshen rabs kyis dmar mchod 'bul ba'i srol de 'gog thabs su mi dang phyugs kyi 'dra gzugs la brten nas glud gtong ba'i thabs shes gsar gtod gnang ba yin tshul 'khod 'dug pa de lo rgyus dngos yod yin pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po 'dug 487

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnas tshul de'i thog nas snang gshen dang 'khyar bon zer ba'i bon po'i chos lugs de ni skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs gras shig yin pa dang / mi rigs rang bzhin ldan pa'i bon chos shig yin par gsal bshad byung ba red/(2)bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar skabs kyi dpal 'byor gnas tshul dang chab srid gnas tshul skor/bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1173sa glang (thang tha'i tsung gi drin kon khri lo gsum pa )spyi lo 629lor rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos srid dbang bzung ba nas/ bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1385lcags bya (thang u tsung gi hu'i phrang khri lo dang po )spyi lo 841lo la rgyal po glang dar mas sangs rgyas chos lugs bsnubs pa'i bar gyi lo grangs 213ring ni bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs snga dar gyi dus skabs (bstan pa snga dar)yin zhing / rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs dar 'go tshugs thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ skabs de'i rgyal nang dang bod sa gnas kyi dpal 'byor dang chab srid kyi cha rkyen mang po zhig 'dzoms pa'i rkyen gyis yin pa ma gtogs cha rkyen de ma 'dzoms na bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs dar thub kyi ma red/ skabs de'i mes rgyal nang khul gyi dpal 'byor dang chab srid kyi gnas tshul ni thang rgyal rabs btsugs nas stobs shugs che ba'i dus skabs la khel yod/ 488

bod kyi chos srid zunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wa—bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1162sa stag spyi lo 618lor/ mes rgyal3nga khul du ho nan zhing chen khul to can tes 'go khrid byas pa'i zhing pa'i gyen langs byung te/ sus rgyal rabs 'thor zhig tu 'gro ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ tha'i yon sa khul gyi dpon chen li yan (thang ka'i tsu'u)gyis sus rgyal rabs la ngo rgol byed pa'i rang gi dmag dpung khrid de zhing pa'i gyen langs nang zhugs thog de'i rgyal kha'i 'bras bu phrogs te skabs de'i sus rgyal rabs kyi rgyal sa khrang an (shis an)blangs shing thang rgyal rabs thog mar btsugs/ de rjes kho pa'i bu thang tha'i tsung li hri ming gi skabs su slebs dus thang rgyal rabs de/ chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung / dmag don bcas gang ci'i thad nas skabs de'i 'dzam gling thog snyan grags dang stobs shugs che ba'i go gnas bzung yod par brten/ (thang tha'i tsung gis srid dbang bzung nas lo bcu bdun la slebs pa'i drin kon khri lo brgyad pa)bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1178shing rta spyi lo 634lor/ bod sa gnas kyi rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan (srong btsan sgam po'i pha)gyis thang rgyal rabs dang thog ma'i 'brel ba btsugs pa dang / de nas bzung mes rgyal nang khul gyi gso rig dang / skar rtsis sogs rig gnas dang sngon thon zhing las dang bzo las kyi lag rtsal (lag shes bzo las)sogs bod du dar 'go tshugs shing / bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas kyi thad la sngar las lhag par 'phel rgyas dang 'gyurasnyeldog chen po yong ba'i skul ma thebs pa red/ 489

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de dang phyogs mtshungs bod kyi chab srid gnas tshul thad la yang skabs der gzhi rgya che ba'i zhing pa'i gyen langs byung ba'i skor/ tun hong nas thon pa'i bod yig gi lo rgyus shog dril nang du 'khod don slobatsan po srong btsan sgam po'i ring la/ yab 'bangs kyis ni 'khus/ yum 'bangs ni ngo log gnyen zhang zhung / mdzo sum pa/ nya gnyi dwags po/ kong po/nyang po kun ngo log yab gnam ri slon btsan la dug bor nas bkrongs so ’’zhes gtsang dang / mnga' ris/ byang rgyud/ gnyal/ dwags po/kong po/ nyang po bcas nas gzhi rgya che ba'i ngo log byung ste/ srong btsan sgam po'i pha gnam ri srong btsan la dug btang nas bkrongs pa bshad pa der brtags na skabs der byung ba'i bran g.yog gi gyen langs des bod kyi bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs la rdung deg tshabs chen phog pa dang chabs cig spyi tshogs thon skyed kyi 'brel ba gsar pa 'phel rgyas yong rgyur skul 'ded btang ba red/ gzhan yang da dung / de sngon bod kyi rus rgyud tsho pa khag gis bod sa gnas dum bu mang por bcad nas dbang sgyur byas pa'i lam lugs des rus rgyud tsho pa khag gi mthun sgril la gnod 'tshe gtong ba ma zad/ spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed gong 'phel 'gro rgyur yang gnod 'tshe chen po yong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul de rus rgyud tsho pa khag gi mi tshang mas rim bzhin shes rtogs byung ste/ rus rgyud tsho pa khag gcig gyur gyi srid dbang zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i re 'dun dang dgos mkho chen po yod pa'i go skabs de dang bstun nas/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sa gnas khag gi rus rgyud tsho pa 490

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da ——khag gcig gyur byas pa'i srid dbang dang po btsugs thub pa byung zhing /de ni bod kyi rus rgyud tsho pa khag gcig gyur byung nas mi rigs su 'gyur ba'i thog ma'i snang tshul zhig kyang red/ skabs de'i bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi dus rim de ni gzhi rtsa'i thog bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs yin pa la/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dpal 'byor 'brel ba'i myu gu'ang thon yod pa'i bar brgal gyi dus rim zhig tu slebs yod pa dang /sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bsam blo khag gcig ni bran g.yog lam lugs spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor 'brel ba'i rnam pa mtshon pa dang / 'ga' zhig ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor 'brel ba'i bsam blo mtshon pa zhig yin par brten/ bsam blo de dang mthun pa'i spyi tshogs kyi nang la sangs rgyas chos lugs de dar ba dang / gnas pa/ 'phel rgyas bcas yong thub pa ma gtogs/ de min gyi spyi tshogs gzhan dag gi nang dar ba dang / gnas pa/ 'phel rgyas bcas yong thub kyi ma red/rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs/ bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar 'go tshugs pa de ni/ skabs de'i bod kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi 'gyur ldog gsar pa'i 'og dbang bsgyur gral rim gyi chab srid lam lugs thad la chos lugs kyi bsam blo gsar pa'i dgos mkho byung ba dang bstun nas dar spel gtong thub pa byung ba zhig yin pa ma gtogs/ sangs rgyas chos lhags rang nyid kyi rang tshugs stobs shugs la brten nas glo bur du dar spel byung ba zhig min/ rlabs chen gyi gsar brje'i slob dpon en ke sis gsungs don/ dngos gtso'i lo rgyus lta 49

da wa dungadakarablo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshul ni/ lo rgyus kyi dus skabs nges can zhig gi dngos po'i 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen gyi thog nas lo rgyus kyi 'gyur ldog dang go don yongs rdzogs dang /chab srid yongs rdzogs/ mtshan nyid rig pa dang chos lugs yongs rdzogs bcas la gsal bshad byed rgyu de red ces gsungs yod pa ltar/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos gtan 'bebs byas pa'i khrims yig gi nang don dang /lo rgyus thog nas skabs de'i bod kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor la dbang ba'i lam lugs de ga 'dra yin min lam tsam shes thub pa'i thog skabs der sangs rgyas chos lugs bod la dar ba'i phyi rol yul gyi cha rkyen 'dzoms yod pa yang ra sprod byed thub kyi red/rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos thog mar lo tsā ba thon mi sam bho ṭa la deng skabs nga tshos bed spyod byas pa'i bod yig 'di gsar gtod byed du bcug rjes/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos dpe sna kha nyi shu rtsa gcig dhisogs bod skad du bsgyur ba dang / sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nang don gtso bo dge ba bcu zer ba bcas bca' khrims kyi nang bkod nas bod 'bangs rnams chos byed dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs bzos pa ma zad/khrims chen po drug la nang gses kyis phye ba'i khod sum cu so drug zer ba de'i nang srid 'dzin do dam lam lugs kyi sgrigs gzhi dang / dmag don sgrigs gzhi/ srid 'dzin sa khul gyi dbye mtshams/ 'bangs rab 'bring tha gsum gyi 'gro lugs dang rim pa sogs zhib tshags tsam bkod yod cing /bca' khrims kyi nang bkod pa'i srog khrims dang / rkun khrims/ 'bangs dhi 'di'i ming tshang ma 〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dzha ra ston 〉172la gsal/ 492

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da khrims sogs tshang mar khrims 'gal gyi nag nyes che chung nyes can so so'i gral rim gyi go gnas mtho dman la gzhigs nas thag gcod byed dgos pa dang/ khrims dpon gyis khrims thag gcod skabs rim pa dma' ba la nyes pa chung ba dang / rim pa mtho ba la nyes pa che ba yod skabs kyang rim pa mtho ba ngo mi tsha ba dang / rim pa dma' ba blo mi pham pa'i thag gcod byed dgos pa sogs gral rim gyi dbye ba ha cang gsal po yod pa red/lhag par du bca' khrims kyi nang bka' gros chen po drug zer ba zhig gtan 'bebs byas don du rje'i sku 'tsho zhing zho sha slar 'bul zhes pa/'bangs rnams kyis rgyal po'i sku srung zhing bsam pa rnam dag gis stobs shugs yod tshad 'bul dgos pa dang/ kheng rgod du mi gtong zhing / mo btsun bka' la mi gdags zer ba/ bran g.yog rnams 'bangs rab gras dmag mi'i gras su bcug mi chog pa dang / bud med rnams gros tshogs kyi tshogs mi'i gras su zhugs mi chog pa bcas gsal por 'khod yod pa dang / de bzhin du rgyal khrims bco lnga zer ba'i nang kheng po rjer mi dbyung zhes bran g.yog rnams dpon du bskos mi chog par bshad yod la/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug zer ba'i nang rigs mtho ba dang rgan rabs la phu dud bya ba zhes rigs brgyud mtho po yin pa'i mi dang / mi rgan rabs la brtsi bkur byed dgos pa/ bud med kyi ngag la mi nyan pa zhes spyi tshogs dang khyim tshang gi las don nang bud med kyis bshad par nyan rgyu med pa bcas gsal por bkod yod pa des rgyal po'i dbang cha dang / khyo'i dbang cha/rus rgyud kyi dbang cha gsum khrims kyi thog na sagatan 'bebs byas pa 493

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/des skabs de'i spyi tshogs thog gi mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba'i nang bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba'i myu gu thon yod pa gsal por mtshon pa red/ lhag par du gsal por mthong thub pa zhig la/rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos gtan 'bebs byas pa'i bka' gros po drug gi nang 'bangs kyi tshal zhing rta dkyus kyis mi bcad zhes 'bangs kyi sa zhing thog rta rgyugs nas dum bur gcod mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs bzos pa de'i thog nas 'bangs la sger dbang gi sa zhing yod pa dang /sa zhing de'i thog rang nyid sger la dbang ba'i thon skyed yo byad bed spyad nas sa zhing 'debs kyi yod pa'ang ra sprod byed thub cing / thon skyed byed stangs de 'dra ni bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs nang la ma gtogs/bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang yong thub thabs med/ da dung tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus shog dril khag gcig gi nang 'khod don/ btsan po yab khri slon btsan dgung du gshegs nas sras khri srong btsan gyi ring / myang mang po rjes zhang snang gis sum khams thams cad mdzangs kyi sgo nas mi rta gnyis la tshegagam byung bar 'bangs rnal mar bkug te dpya phab/ zhes rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su blon po myang mang po rje zhang snang gis mi rta gnyis la zad grom ma byung ba'i thog nas/sum pa'i yul tshang ma mnga' 'og tu bcug ste dpya khral bsdus par gsal zhing / yang shog dril gzhan zhig bi/ nang 'alod don btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i ring la de'i 'og tu ba tsan ngo/ zhabs kyis btsugs te byang lam du byon par/ dmag ma byung ma drang sa/ par rgya (gru gu)dang 'a zha dpya 494

bodakyi chos azunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da ——bcald lo/ zhes rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sum pa'i yul mnga' 'os tu bcug pa'i rjes su btsan po ngo ma byang phyogs brgyud du song nas/ tshur dmag ma byung zhing phar dmag drangs ma dgos par rgya gru gu dang 'a zha nas dpya khral bsdus pa bcas gsal pa la zhib tu brtags skabs/ lha dbang dang / rus dbang / khyo dbang rnams ni krung go'i bkasardzobakod brgyud 'dzin gyi spyi tshogs kyi mtshon rtags gal che ba'i gras shig yin par ma'o kru'u zhis 〈 hu'u nan zhing pa'i las 'gul la rtog zhib gnang ba'i snyan zhu 〉zhes pa'i gsung rtsom nang gsal por gsungs shing / rgyal pos rang gi mnga' 'og mi ser gyi sa nas dpya khral bsdus pa de ni/ skabs de'i rgyal po de bran g.yog bdag po min par zhing bdag yin par mtshon pa dang / skabs de'i spyi tshogs de bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin gyi spyi tshogs su slebs pa'i rtags mtshan yin pas/ bran g.yog spyi tshogs dang bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs bar gyi dbye mtshams ni/ skabs de'i rgyal po de dpya khral bsdu mkhan gyi zhing bdag gin min la lta dgos par ma'o kru'u zhi dang / de skabs kyi tshan rig mkhas pa mang po zhig dgongs pa gcig mthun byung yod pa red/ der brten ngas rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs kyi bod kyi spyi tshogs de gzhi —rtsa'i thog bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs yin pa la/ bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin gyi dpal 'byor 'brel ba'i myu gu'ang thon yod pa red ces bshad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas de 'asazhig gi nang bon po'i chos lugs kyis mi rnams kyi bsam blor dbang sgyur byed pa'i nus pa shor 'bo tshugs 495

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa dang chabs cig spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gyi 'brel ba gsar pa dang mthun pa'i chos lugs gsar pa zhig dbang sgyur gral rim la dgos mkho byung zhing / de nyid dar spel gtong ba'i cha rkyen yang 'dzoms yod pa red/rlabs chen gyis slob dpon mar khe sis 〈 yi'u tha'i mi rigs kyi gnad don skor 〉zhes pa'i gsung rtsom nang gsungs don/ mi tshos snga phyi bar gsum du rmongs dad kyi thog nas lo rgyus la 'grel bshad byed kyi yod pa dang / nga tshos da lta lo rgyus kyi thog nas rmongs dad la 'grel bshad byed kyi yod pa red ces dang / le nyin gyis 〈 mi gzhan gyi dar cha khyer ba 〉zhes pa'i gsung rtsom nang gsungs don/ mar khe si'i thabs shes ni thog mar dus tshod nges can dang / khor yug nges can nang gi lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi phyi rol yul gyi nang don la dgongs pa bzhes kyi yod pa dang /de nas khor yug nges can de'i nang gral rim gang zhig gi 'gul bskyod de spyi tshogs mdun du skyod par skul 'ded byed mkhan gyi gtso bo'i sgul shugs yin pa shes rtogs gnang gi yod pa red ces gsungs yod pa red/sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar gsar gtod mdzad mkhan ni shākya mu rne yin zhing /dhi des gsar gtod mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas chos lugs ni rang nyid 'tsho bzhugs kyi dus skabs de'i hin rdu'i spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor 'brel ba dang bstun thabs gnang ba zhig dang / spyi tshogs gnas ① deng skabs dpar skrun byas pa'i rgya yig gi krung go'i lo rgyus nang / kra'o shar ma'i rgyal rabs kyi kra'o ling wang rgyal po'i khri lo bcu drug shing sbrul spyi lo sngon gyi lo 556par 'khrungs nas/ kra'o shar ma'i rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po kra'o yon wang gi khri lo dang po me stag spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 475lor gshegs shing / khung tsi las lo drug gis rgan par bshad 'dug 496

bod kyi chos srid zunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ —— —— ——pa nas bsam blor 'gyur ba'i go rim nang thon pa'i 'jig rten lta tshul zhig yin pa ma zad/ 'jig rten lta tshul de sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rnam pa'i thog nas mi rnams kyi bsam blor bag chags gting zab byung ba zhig dang / dus skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas pa dang / skabs de'i dpal 'byor rmang gzhi mtshon pa'i steng gi bkod pa zhig bcas red/ dper na sangs rgyas chos lugs nang / rigs mtho shos dang bzang shos ni rgyal rigs dang / de 'og rje bo'i rigs yin pas de gnyis kyi rigs brgyud nas byung ba'i mi la rigs bzang zer ba dang / mgar ba dang / bshan pa/nya pa bcas la rigs ngan gdol pa'i rigs zer gyi yod pa des rus rgyud dbang cha gsal3por mtshon pa dang / de bzhin bran g.yog rnams kyis bran g.yog bdag por gyen ldog ma byas par ngag la nyan nas dka' ngal bzod jithub pa de bran g.yog yon tan bzang shos yin pa/ bran g.yog rnams bran g.yog bdag pos gnang ba ma thob par grwa pa byed par yong mi chog pa/ rang gi khyo bo'i ngag la nyan nas bran g.yog ltar brtsi bkur byed pa de bud med mdzangs ma'i yon tan brgyad kyi gras su rtsi ba des khyo bo'i dbang cha gsal por mtshon pa sogs bran g.yog spyi tshogs dang / bkas balko/da brgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor 'brel ba'i mtshon rtags gsal po yod pa zhig rang red/ der brten sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bsam blo de skabs de'i bod kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'brel ba dang mthun po yod pa de'i rkyen gyis rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad mos byas pa dang dar spel gtong thub pa byung ba red/ 4sdo)7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yin na'ang rgyal po srongasgrobatsan sgam pos sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nang don khrims yig gi nang bkod nas bod 'bangs rnams chos byed dgos par gtan 'bebs bzos pa de ni/ chos lugs chab srid du 'gyur ba'i thog ma'i snang tshul zhig dang / chos lugs bed spyad nas rang nyid kyi dbang sgyur srung skyob byed pa'i bya thabs tsam zhig yin pa ma gtogs skabs der chos byed mkhan gyi grwa pa zur du med la/ chos byed mkhan rnams la sdod sa'i dgon pa zur du med pa dang / kho tshor dmigs bsal gyi thob thang dang dbang cha gang yang med cing / rgyal po srong btsan sgam po ni srid dbang 'dzin mkhan gyi rgyal po yin pa tsam las chos bdag min pas de dus chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs byung med/de rjes bod kyi rab byung gong gi shā kya'i 'das lo 1249shing sbrul (thang krung tsung li shi'an gyi hreng lung khri lo dang po)spyi lo 705lor rgyal po khri lde gtsug brtan gyis srid dbang bzung zhing /dhi khri lde gtsug brtan lo na son nas blon po bran ka mu le ko ṣa dang / gnyags dzha na ku ma ra gnyis hin rdur sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos dpe len par btang bas/ kho gnyis gangs ri ti sir slebs skabs ri der sgom byas nas bzhugs pa'i rgya gar gyi parnyita sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis dang phrad nas khong gnyis kyi blo la yod pa'i 〈 mdo sde las rnam par 'byed pa 〉dang 〈 gser 'od dam pa 〉〈 rnal 'byor rgyud〉〈 bya rgyud 〉bcas blo la bzung nas 'ongs pa rgyal po la phul/ rgyal pos chos dpe rnams 'jog zho) 'di rgyal po srong btsan sgam po lo sum cu so bzhi la 'das pa'i dbang du byas shing / gsham du yang rtsi stangs de bzhin yin/ 498

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/sa'i lha khang / lha sa mkhar brag dang / brag dmar mgrin bzang / brag dmar ke ru/ mchims phu sna ral/ ma sa gong gi lha khang bcas lnga bzhengs/bod kyi rab byung gong gi shā kya'i 'das lo 1298shing rta (thang zhon tsung li long cis kyi thi'an pa'o khri lo bcu gsum pa)spyi lo 75'byu1 la/ rgyal po khri lde gtsug brtan gyis/ thang gi blon chen 'ba' de'u'i bu sang shis gtsos pa'i mi bzhi gong ma thang zhon tsung gi sar sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos dpe gsol ras zhu bar btang / thang zhon tsung gis kyang mthing shog la gser gyis brisanepa'i chos dpe le tshan stong sprad/ hra'an shis zhing chen gyi ri bo rtse lnga'i nye 'dab sa su sdod pa'i ha shang nyi ma la chos zhus shing ha shang des kyang 〈 dge ba bcu'i mdo 〉dang / 〈 rdo rje gcod pa 〉〈 sa lu ljang pa'i mdo 〉 bcas dpe gsum bskur nas dpe de rnams go rim gong gsal ltar rgyal po la bstan na rgyal pos chos byed par 'gyur zhes sogs bshad de/ sang shis gong gsal gyi dpe rnams khur nas bod du log yong kyang sang shi bod du ma 'byor gong / rgyal po khri lde gtsug brtan rgyal ma yar snon sgra tshal du (rgya ma khrisgang)rtas g.yugs te grongs/('di skor rba bzhed che ba 〉dang / yar lung chos 'byung 〉 lho brag chos 'byung 〉bcas tshang mar gong ltar bshad 'dug kyang / lha sa po tā la'i mdun gyi rdo ring phyi ma'i sto ngos kyi yi ge de'i mgor/ rgyal po khri lde gtsug brtan ni blon po 'bal ldong tshab dang lang mes gzigs gnyis kyis bkrongs zhes gsal/) 499

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/(3)sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs bar gyi 'thab rtsod skor/sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs bar gyi 'thab rtsod thengs dang po ni/ bon gyi lo rgyus byams ma 〉zer ba'i nang rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bon po'i chos lugs la sdang ba'i rkyen gyis lo sum cu so bzhi las ma thub ces 'khod pa dang / 〈mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi rnam thar 〉nang bon po'i chos lugs des lo ltar sems can mang po dmar mchod 'bul dgos pa de'i rkyen gyis rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bon po'i chos bsnubs pa'i gnas tshul bkod pa der bltas na/ skabs der sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs bar 'thab rtsod byung yod pa zur tsam bstan na yang / de min gyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha da phan mthong ma byung /sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs bar gyi 'thab rtsod thengs gnyis pa ni/ rgyal po khri lde gtsug brtan 'das rjes khri srong lde btsan gyis rang lo bco lnga pa me spre (thang sud tsung li shi'ang gi kri te khri lo dang po)spyi lo 756lo nas lo bzhi bcu zhe gnyis ring srid dbang bzung /①skabs der thog mar khri srong lde btsan lo na phra ba'i stabs kyis pha dus kyi zhang blon ma zhang grom pa skyes kyis dbang cha yongs rdzogs bzung gi yod cing / blon po ma zhang ni bon po'i chos lugs la dad pa byed pa ma rdzu1 thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs bris pa'i rgya yig gi bod kyi lo rgyus gzhir bzung /500

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/gtogs/ sangasalhas chos lugs la gtan nas mi dga' ba'i rkyen gyis bka' phab don du skye ba phyi ma la skye ba len rgyu yod zer ba rdzun yin/ tshe 'dir lha 'dre'i gnod 'tshe bzlog thabs la bon po'i chos bgyis/ sus sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos byas na de'i rgyu nor gzhung bzhes btang nas mtha' mtshams su phud rgyu yin/ da phyin chad bon chos ma gtogs sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos byed mi chog mi shi ba'i rjes su mchod 'bul byed mi chog rwa mo che la yod pa'i rgya lha rgya nag tu phyir skyol dgos zer ba sogs khrims bcas/ lha sa mkhar brag gi lha khang dang brag dmar mgrin bzang gi lha khang gnyis bshig rwa mo che'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje mi sum brgyas drud nas sgul ma thub par bye ma'i 'og tu sbas/ slar yang gtsug lag khang dang rwa mo che'i jo bo gnyis mnga' ris skyid grong bar du bskyal/ lha sa ra yod pa'i hwa shang thams cad rgya nag tu phyir slog byas/ rwa mo che dang gtsug lag khang gnyis su bzo grwa dang bshas ra byas te/ sems can bsad pa'i rgyu ma dang nang khrol rnams lha sku'i mgo bo dang lag pa'i steng du bkal/ lha sku'i steng du pags pa dmar po bskams/chos la dad pa'i blon po lang mes gzigs dang 'bal ldong tshab gnyis khrims la sbyar nas srog thog btang /('di la ṭ+wāṃrba bzhed 〉nang gong gsal blon po gnyis chos la dga' ba'i rkyen gyis srog thog btang bar bshad kyang /lha sa po tā la'i mdun gyi rdo ring phyi ma'i lho phyogs kyi yi ge yig phreng dang po nas nyi shu tham pa'i mjug bar 'khod don du/ gong rgesal blon po gnyis kyis rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi pha khri lde gtsug btsan bkrongs pa dang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan yang bkrongs rgyu'i gra sgrigs byas pa'i gnas tshulakhyiblon po stag sgra klu gong gis shes nas rgyal 501

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/po khri srong lde btsan la zhus te/ blon po gnyis srog thog tu btang bar bshad/ yang ṭ+wāṃrba bzhed che ba 〉nang blon po stag sgra klu gong bon la dga' zhing chos la mi dga' bas bsam yas gtsug lag khang brtsig rgyur ngo rgol byas pa'i rkyen gyis 'dzin bzung byas te byang la rgyang 'bud btang bar bshad pa bcas khag gsum po de bsdur na dpyad gzhi chen po 'dug) sang shis mes rgyal nang khul nas lha sar 'byor dus rgyal po khri lde gtsug brtan 'das nas khri srong lde btsan lo na chung ba'i stabs kyis dbang cha yongs rdzogs blon po ma zhang gis bzung ste chos byed mi chog pa'i khrims bcas pa dang lha khang bshig pa sogs byas pa'i skabs dang khel nas/ mes rgyal nang khul nas khyer yong ba'i chos dpe rnams bsam yas mchims phu'i brag gseb tu sbas dgos pa byung zhing / chos la dga' ba'i blon po gsal snang mnga' ris mang yul du bros/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan lo na son nas rang nyid kyis dngos su srid dbang bzung rjes/ blon po sang shi la khyed kyis de sngon mes rgyal nang khul nas khyer yong ba'i chos dpe rnams bsgyur shig ces bshad pa dang / thog mar hwa shang gis bskur ba'i chos dpe khag gsum po de rgya yi lo tsā ba me mgo dang /sang shi/ bod kyi lo tsā ba kha che a n+dan gsum gyis gas nga ba byas nas bod skad du bsgyur skabs/ blon po ma zhang dang blon po stag ra klu gong gnyis kyis shes te bshad don/ khyed tsho gsum gyis bsgyur ba'i dpe cha de sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos dpe red/ de sngon sus sangs rgyas kyi chos byas na mtha' mtshams su rgyang 'bud gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas zin pa khyed tshos da dung ma shes sam/ sdod ma tshugs par khrims dang 'gal ba'i las 'di 'dra byas na nyes chad nan po gtong gi yin zer bas kho tsho gsum skrag 502

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/te chos dpe rnams slar yang rdza gseb tu sbas/de nas rgyal pos blon po sang shi blon po gsal snang gi grogs byed par mnga' ris mang yul du btang / de'i shul du rgyal po dang blon po chos la dga' ba rnams gsang gros byas thog bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel gtong dgos na sngon la bon la dga' ba'i blon po dbang che shos ma zhang kho ma bsad na bya ba de sgrub mi thub zer nas blon po ma zhang grom pa skyes gsod rgyur thag bcad/de nas blon po 'gos khri bzang dang / zhang nya bzang sogs chos la dga' ba'i blon po rnams rikyis rgyal po'i bang phyin pa dang / mo rgyag mkhan/rtsis byed mkhan sogs la lkog tu brngan pa mang po sprad nas/ da lo rgyal po'i chab srid la gegs dbang chen po 'dug zer ba dang / gegs dbang de bzlog thabs la blon po gtso che ba zhig dur gyi nang du gson por sbas dgos zer ba sogs shod du bcug skad cha de rim bzhin mi tshang mas go ba dang mthar blon po ma zhang gis kyang go ba red/ go skabs de dang bstun nas rgyal blon tshogs 'du'i thog blon po 'gos khri bzang gis thog mar gleng don du da lo rgyal po'i sku srog dang chab srid la gegs dbang chen po yod pa de bzlog ched/ rgyal po'i blon po'i gtso che ba gcig dur gyi nang du gson por 'gro dgos 'dug blon po'i nang nas gtso che ba nga rang yin pas nga gson por dur nang du 'gro gi yin zer nas ngar slong ba'i skad cha bshad pa dang / blon po ma zhang phrag dog gis ngar langs nas rgyal po'i blon po'i nang gtso che ba nga rang yin pas nga yang dur nang 503

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/du gson por 'gro gi yin zer nas khas len byed dgos byung ba red/ de nas nyin gcig blon po ma zhang dang 'gos khri bzang stod lung nang du dur dong yod sar song nas dong nang du gson por 'dzul te dong gi kha bkag ran pa dang / blon po 'gos khri bzang gis brdzus chas spras nas g.yo sgyur byas te dong nang nas bros/ de ma thag blon po chos la dga' ba gzhan dag tshos dong gi kha bkag nas blon po ma zhang gson sbas btang ba red/de ni sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs bar dza drag che ba'i 'thab rtsod thengs gnyis pa yin/sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs gnyis bar gyi 'thab rtsod thengs gsum pa/ de nas rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel gtong ched/ bal yul na bzhugs yod pa'i mkhan po bo rnyi swa to du bod du gdan drangs nas bsam yas kyi pho brang rlung 'tshubs du su dge ba bcu dang rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi chos bshad du bcug zla ba gnyis tsam song dus chu log chen po byung nas bsam yas kyi pho brang 'phang thang chus khyer/ lha sa dmar po ciri pho brang la thog brgyab/mi la nad yams dang / nor phyugs la zog nad byung / lo thog la sad dang ser ba/ than pa sogs byung bas/ bod 'bangs yongs kyis gnod 'tshe de tsho ni chos byas pas lan/ rgyal pos skad btang ba'i rgya gar gyi a tsa r+ya bal yul la phyir skyod dgos zer nas sangs rgyas chos lugs la ngo dhi bham ga la za hor rgyal po'i sras yin zhing / ma ti sha dang rus rgyud gcig red/rjo lo rgyus smra /ba 'ga' zhig gis pho brang rlung 'tshubs ni pha bong kha yin zhes bshad pa'ang mthong byung bas dpyad par zhu/ 504

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/rgol shugs chen byas par brten rgyal po khri srong lde btsan bya thabs zad de mkhan po bo dhi su to b.layul la phyir slog mi byed ka med byung zhing /skabs der mkhan pos rgyal po la gros 'go bton pa ltar rjes su slar yang mkhan po rang nyid bod du gdan drangs rgyu dang / de dus slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas 0 mnyam du gdan drangs rgyu byas/ de nas slar yang rgyal po dang blon po chos la dga' ba rnams gros byas nas/ chos dang bon gnyis su khungs btsan pa yod med mi tshang ma yid ches yong ba byed / rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis slar yang blon po gsal snang dang / sang shi sogs mi grangs sum cu tham par dngos po mang po'i 'bul skyes dang bcas gong ma thang su'i tsung gi sar btang nas 'tshams 'dri zhu rgyu dang chabs cig sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos dpe khag gcig gsol ras yong ba'i re 'dun yi gophul ba ltar/ gong ma thang su'i tsung gis kyang mthing shog rjo la gser gyis bris pa'i chos dpe khag mang po dang / rgyal po la 'bul skyes su phra men gyi zhwa gcig ⑦ dar gos yug khri gcig bla gor gyi gzhong pa chen po 'dom gang tsam yod pa gcig bcas bskur zhing /blon po gsal snang la gsol ras su/ rgya byi'u ri mo yod pa'i gser shog srang brgya tham pa/ dar gos yug lnga brgya/ phra men las bzos pa'i bum pa gcig phra men las bzos pa'i gzhong pa srang brgya yod pa gcig mu tig che chung sran ma tsam gyi phreng ba 'dom pa gang tsam yod pa bcu bcas 'bul dhi au rgyan gyi rgyal po'i sras yin zhing / ṣ+pergyan ni deng sang gi a spru han red/② shog bu sngon po/② gser dngul 'dres mas bzos pa'i zhwa mo/505
