dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyu skur zhing/ de mtshungs mi gzhan dag la yang bya dga'i dngos po phun sum tshogs pa sprad de bod du 'byor nas gong mas bskur ba'i bka' shog gi sgrom bu du dang / 'bul skyes/ chos dpe bcas rgyal po khri srong lde btsan la phul/ de nas slar yang rgyal pos blon po gsal snang bal yul nas mkhan po bo dhi swa to gdan 'dren par btang te slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyang mkhan po bo rnyi swa tos mnyam du gdan drangs nas tshur phebs pa dang mnga' ris mang yul du phrad/ mnga' ris mang yul narme shangs kyi 'u yug bar du chu thog la gru gzings bcas te 'ong / mkhan po dang slob dpon gnyis bsam yas su 'byor rjes mkhan po bo dhi su tos chos bshad pa dang slob dpon pad+mas rdzu 'phrul bstan pa sogs byas/lhag par du slob dpon pad+ma sa pha ma gnyis 'dzoms kyi bu dang bu mo khag gcig la pra 'bebs pa zer ba mi la lha 'dre khog zhugs byas pa'i lugs srol thog mar btsugs shing / deng sang lha phebs zer ba de skabs thog mar byung ba red/ de nas bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang rtsigs rgyu'i gra sgrigs byas skabs blon po stag sgra klu gong sogs bon la dga' ba'i blon po khag gcig gis ngo rgol byas par ma zad/ rgyal po'i btsun mo cog ro bza' sogs dang / bon po rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas chos lugs la bon po las lhag pa'i nus pa gang yang med pas chos byas na phan thogs med zer/ blon po chos la dga' ba dang / rgya nag gi hwa shang / rgya gar gyi slob dpon sogs kyis chos dang bon gnyis ni me chu ltar mnyam du ① bka' yig spugs pa'i sgam chung / 506

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/gnas thub thabs med pas lung pa gcig gi nang chos lugs gnyis byung na bkra mi shis/ chos dang bon gnyis gang khungs btsan pa yod med 'gran bsdur dang rtsod gleng byas thog bon po la rgyal kha thob na nged tsho rdzoso'i yul la phyir log byed rgyu dang / chos la rgyal kha thob na bon bsnubs te bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel gtong gi yin zer nas ma 'a'athebs pas/ rgyal pos sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs gnyis phan tshun rtsod gleng byas nas su rgyal ba de dar spel gtong rgyu dang /surtsopham pa de med pa bzo rgyur thag bcad/ de nas rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1303sa phag (thang sud tsung li shi'ang gi chen yon khri lo gnyis pa)spyi lo 759lor/ mal dro zur phud rkyang bu tshal gyi pho brang mdun/ du chos dang bon gnyis rtsod gleng byas skabs bon rnams pham/ rgyal po bon po rnams stod mnga' ris zhang zhung gi yul du mthar skrod btang zhing /bon po'i chos dpe yongs rdzogs bsdus nas khag gcig chu la g.yugs/khag gcig bsam yas su mchod rten nag po gcig bzhengs pa de'i 'og tu mnan/ mi gson po dang gshin po'i rim gror sems can gsod pa'i dmar mchod 'bul mi chog pa dang / sangs rgyas chos lugs ma gtogs bon po'i chos byed mi chog pa'i khrims bcas/ skabs 'dir 〈 rba bzhed 〉kyi nang 'khod don du/ rgyal pos chos ma gtogs bon byed mi chog pa'i khrims bcas skabs blon po stag sgra klu gong gis nga bon po ma gtogs chos byed mi thub zer nas ngo rgol byas par brten/ blon po stag sgra klu gong 'dzin bzung byas thog srung skyel byed mkhan mi gnyis dang 507

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcas te byang la rgyang 'bud btang bar bshad 'dug kyang / lha sa po tā la mdun gyi rdo ring phyi ma'i lho ngos kyi yi ge'i mgo brjod nang / blon po stag sgra klu gong snga phyi bar gsum du byas rjes yod pa'i mi yin pas de'i dran gso'i ched du rdo ring 'di btsugs pa yin lugs gsal ba ma zad/rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi bka' gcigs dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis ka 〈 lho brag chos 'byung 〉le tshan ja pa'i shog grangs 109na nas grangs 111na dkyil bar cha tshang bkod 'dug pa de'i bka' gcigs dang po'i mjug tu sangs rgyas chos lugs srung skyob byed rgyu'i mna' skyekha mkhan gyi gras su yod pa'i blon po tshang ma'i ming bkorde pa de'i nang / blon stag sgra klu gong zhes gsal por bris 'dug cing / bka' gcigs dang po dang gnyis pa tshang ma bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs tshar ba'i rjes kyi lug gi lo bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin bkod pa dang /bka' gcigs 'di'i ma dpe phud pa'i 'dra bshus khag bcu gsum yod pa dge 'dun gyi sde gang yod sar bkram pa bcas gsal por bkod pa bcas la brtags na blon po stag sgra klu gong snga rjes gnyis byung ba yin nam/gang ltar 〈 rba bzhed 〉kyi nang / bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i gra sgrig byed dus blon po stag sgra klung gong gis ngo rgol byas pa'i rkyen gyis blon po stag sgra klu gong byang la rgyang 'bud btang zhes 'khod pa der dogs gzhi chen po zhig 'dug rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis bon po'i chos lugs bsnubs skabs g.yang sgrub pa dang / mdos glud gtong ba/ro bsreg pa/ lha bsangs gtong ba/ hom bsreg pa sogs khag gcig 508

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad med par ma bzos par bzhag cing / rjes su sangs rgyas chos lugs pas nang don bsgyur nas rnam pa rang sor bzhag ste bed spyod byas yod pa dang /de mtshungasu bod sil bu'i dus skabs su gsar du dar ba'i ‘‘bsgyur bon ’’gyis kyang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nang don yongs rdzogs bon po'i chos lugs kyi nang don du bsgyur nas rigs pa'i gzhung lugs yod pa'i bon gzhung zhig gsar du bzos pa bcas byas pa de ni/ sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs gnyis phan tshun 'thab rtsod byas pa brgyud/'thab rtsod kyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas rjes su gnyis kas kha gtad phyogs nas dgos mkho yod pa rnams blangs te nang don bsgyur nas rnam pa rang sor bzhag pa zhig red/ (4)bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grwa pa thog mar byung ba dang dus mtshungs rnying ma'i chos lugs byung tshul skor/bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1306chu stag (thang ta'i tsung li yu'u gi pa'o dbying khri lo dang po )spyi lo 762lor bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs 'go tshugs te lo bzhi la grub/ de'i phyi lo me lug (thang ta'i tsung li yu'u gi ta glis khri lo gnyis pa )spyi lo 767lor/ bod la grwa pa byed thub mkhan yong dang mi yong tshod lta byed ched/ rgya gar nas thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa yin paṅge dge slong btsu gnyis gdan drangs nas mkhan po bo snyi su tos mkhan po (rab byung gi mkhan po )dang / dbe slong 509

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcu gnyis kyis kha skong byas te/ rba gsal snang / sang shi/ rma rin chen mchog 'khon klu'i dbang po srung / pa gor be+e ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ la gsum rgyal ba'i byang chub bcas mi bdun rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs byas/ de ni bod la grwa pa byed mkhan gyi thog ma yin pas sad mi mi bdun zer/ de nas rgyal pos da dung blon po dang btsun mo 'bangs bcas kyi nang nas chos byed 'dod yod pa rnams grwa pa byed dgos zer ba'i bka' phab skabs kho tshos bshad don/ grwa pa byas na phyogs gcig nas 'tsho ba'i bsten sa med pa dang / gnyis nas rgyal po'i khral dang dmag khral rgyugs ma thub na khrims dang 'gal bas grwa pa byed mi thub zer ba la/ rgyal pos bshad don mi sus grwa pa byas na khral rgyugs mi dgos pa'i thog tshang ma'i 'tsho rba rgyal po'i mdzod nas blangs chog pa'i dbang cha sprod rgyu yin zhes bshad pa red/ skad cha de'i thog nas gnas tshul gnyis mthong thub pa ste/ gcig ni chos la zhugs nas grwa pa byed mkhan tshang mas 'tsho ba gzhan brten ma byas na rang kha rang gso mi thub pa'i ngo bo de gsal bshad byas yod pa dang / gzhan gcig ni skabs der rgyal pos grwa pa phud pa'i 'bangs mi ser gyi sa nas khral bsdu gi yod pa de mthong thub kyi red/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis mi sus grwa pa byas na mi des khral dang dmag khral 'khur mi dgos pa'i dmigs bsal dbang cha sprad par brten lo gcig lhag tsam gyi nang la snga rjes bsdoms pa'i grwa pa'i 'bor grangs sum brgya dang lnga bar 'phel rgyas byung ba red/ grwa pa de tsho tshang mar chos bshad mkhan gyi slob dpon zur du bskos pa'i nang nas 510

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad dbang cha che shos ni mkhan po yin pa dang / thog ma'i mkhan po ni bo dhi swa to yinadu / skabs der mkhan po bo dhi swa to dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gnyis chos kyi bdag po yin pa tsam las/ srid kyi thog dbang cha med pa ma zad/ srid don tshogs 'dur zhugs pa'i dbang cha'ang med/ gnad don bshad rgyu yod na mkhan po dang slob dpon gnyis kas rgyal po la thad kar bshad chog kyang / rgyal pos blon po gtso che ba rnams zhugs pa'i tshogs 'du mdun sa che chung dhi rim pa brgyud nas blon po tsho dang gros bsdur byas te thag gcod pa ma gtogs srid don tshogs 'du che chung gnyis ma brgyud par rgyal po gcig pus bka' btang nas thag gcod byed mi chog gal te gnad don 'ga' zhig rgyal po'i 'dod pa dang mthun na'ang / gros la dbang ba'i blon po tshos mos mthun ma byas na/ rgyal pos blon po'i gros mol la bstun nas bka' gtong ba ma gtogs rgyal pos rang shed byed mi chog pa'i lam lugs dam po yod pa bcas kyi gnas tshul skor 〈 rba bzhed 〉kyi nang / mkhan po bo dhi swa to thengs gcig phyir 'bud byas pa dang / slob dpon pad+ma phyir 'bud byas pa/ sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar spel gtong ba/ bsam yas sa/tsug lag khang rtsigs rgyu'i gros mol byas pa'i skor bcas kyi thad la gsal por 'khod yod pa red/du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bod du ① zhi ba'atsho/ ② tshogs 'du che chung /du rgyal blon mnyam tshogs kyi rgyalogasum blon dgu'i tshogs 'du che chung gi lam lugs de ni thang rgyal rabs kyi srid 'dzin lam lugs kyi shugs rkyen thebs pa zhig yin pa dang / lam lusas de bod la thog mar 'dzugs mkhan ni rgyal po srong btsan sgam po red/5/ /

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin 955 kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phebs nas lo shas bzhugs ring rgyal po dang blon po sogs khag gcig la gsang sngags kyi chos mang po gsungs nas thog mar dar spel btang ba der gsang sngags rnying ma zer zhing / chos lugs der gsang sngags rnying ma zer dgos non ni dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug tu bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar gso byung skabs/ mnga' ris lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos rgya gar nas gsang sngags kyi chos gsar pa mang po bod skad thog bsgyur te dar spel btang ba de nas bzung bod kyi lo rgyus thog de'i gong gi gsang sngags kyi chos rnams la gsang sngags rnying ma zer ba'i ming de gzhi nas btags pa dang / gsar du bsgyur ba'i gsang sngags kyi chos rnams la gsang sngags gsar ma zer gyi yod pa red/ mkhan po bo dhi swa to sku ma gshegs phan chad bod kyi rab byung rnams rgyal po'i mdzod nas phogs blangs pa tsam ma gtogs/ gtan khel byas pa'i 'tsho ba'i rten gang yang med pa'i phogs gzan pa sha stag red/(5)sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos byed mi sna rnams bran g.yog bdag po nas mthar mchod gzhis yod pa'i zhing bdag gral rim du 'gyur ba'i skor/rgyal po khri srong lde btsan skabs bris pa yin zer ba'i lo rgyus yig cha 〈 rba bzhed 〉de la che ba dang / 'bring ba/ chung ba gsum yod pa'i nang gi 〈 rba bzhed che ba 〉de dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas brtsams pa 〈lho brag chos 'byung 〉gi nang cha tshang bkod 'dug pa ltar nang don gnad 5 2

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ ged da bsdus byas te bkod na/ mkhan po bo dhi su to sku gshegs rjes rgyal pos rba ye shes dbang po ① mkhan por bskos/ chos lugs kyi chogs 'du de srid 'dzin tshogs 'du chung ba'i gong du bzhag chos lugs kyi chos bdag mkhan po du la gser yig chen po'i go gnas sprad nas sdod gnas blon che tshang ma'i gral mgor sdod rgyu dang / blon chen tshogs 'du chung ba tshogs skabs mkhan po tshogs 'dur zhugs dgos pa'i bka' phab/ de sngon grwa pa gang yod tshang ma'i 'tsho ba rnams rgyal po'i mdzod nas phogs sprod mus yin kyang / mang nyung ji tsam sprod dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gang yang bzos med par brten/ rgyal po'i dgongs par/ da lta nga rang 'tsho sdod skabs bsam yas sogs lha khang khag gi mchod rgyun dang / mkhan po grwa pa bcas kyi 'tsho ba'i rten mang nyung ji tsam sprod dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs shig bzos ma thub na/ nga rang shi rjes de tshor lta rtog byed mkhan med par lus srid pas/ lha khang dang mchod rgyun la lha ris phya mi khyim sum brgya tham pa dang / grwa pa sger so so la lha 'bangs mi khyim bdun re sprod rgyu'i bsam 'char yod lugs rba ye shes dbang po khy-i) la gsungs pas/ ye shes dbang pos rgyal po la bshad don/ de snga rgyal pos blon po byas rjes yod pa gcig la 'bangs mi khyim dgu brgya gnang ba de dang bsdur na/gtsug lag khang dang grwa pa'i 'tsho rten gong gsal ltar gnang pa chung skyon ① rba gsal snang rab byung byas rjes mkhan pos btags pa'i ming /② skabs der bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa zer/() lha 'bangs bran g.yog() mkhan po gsar pa/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ma gtogs che skyon mi 'dug kyang / rjes su rgyal po'i khyim tshang nang mi mthun pa byung ba'am/ yang na mi phyugs la nad yams chen po byung ba dang /de bzhin phyi'i dgra bos dmag byung ba/ yang na mu ge chen po byung ba sogs dang thug dus rgyal pos gtan 'bebs gnang ba der gnas mi thub pas phugs brtan po yong ched/ gtsug lag khang gi mchod rgyun la 'bangs mi khyim nyis brgya dang / grwa pa sger so sor 'bangs mi khyim gsum re gnang ste/ lha 'bangs rnams kyi dbang cha grwa pa tsho'i lag tu sprad pa yin na 'tshams po yong zhes zhus pa ltar/ rgyal pos lha khang dang gtsug lag khang gi mchod rgyun la 'bangs mi khyim brgya dang lnga bcu/dhi grwa pa sger so sor 'bangs mi khyim gsum re ② gong gsal lha khang dang gtsug lag khang gi mchod rgyun mi ser dang / grwa grangs sum brgya dang lnga'i bran g.yog bcas bsdoms pa'i lha 'bangs bran g.yog them dud chig stong brgya med drug cu re lnga dang / der cha snyoms kyi mi grangs bzhi re brtsis khyon bsdomasatshomi grangs bzhi stong nyis brgya drug cu yod pa de tsho tshang mas rgyal po la dpya khral dang dmag khral 'jal mi dgos pa red/chos bdag mkhan po dang grwa pa sger so sor 'tsho rten thad rgyal pos 'bangs kyi sa nar+sā dpya khral bsdus pa'i 'bab kyi steng nas chos bdag rjo 'bangs mi khyim rer pha ma gnyis dang bu bu mo gnyis bcas bzhi re rtsis pa'i dbang du btang na cha snyoms kyi mi grangs drug brgya yod/dhi skabs der dngos yod grwa pa sum brgya dang lnga la bran g.yog tshan pa dgu brgya dang bco lnga dang /der cha snyoms kyi mi grangs sum stong drug brgya drug cu yod/ 514

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad wamakhan por zla ba re la nas khal bdun cu don lnga dang /dhi lo gcig la khal dgu brgya red/ lo re la mar srang chig stong brgya tham pa/② zla ba re la mar khal gcig dang nyag phyed dang gsum/ lo re gos cha tshang re/ rta gcig shog bu bcu debs bzhi/ snag tsha yug gsum/ tshwa zad len/bsam yas mchims phur yod pa'i sgom nyi shu rtsa lnga la lo rer nas khal lnga bcu nga lnga/du lo rer mar srang brgyad brgya/dhi rta re/ gos sne kha drug re/ chos slob mkhan gyi dbe/ rgan bcu gsum la lo re'i phogs sgom chen dang gcig mtshungs/ chos slob mkhan gyi slob phrug nyi shu rtsa lnga la lo re 'bru khal nyi shu rtsa lnga re dang /rjo gos sne kha gsum re/ de 'phros grwa pa byings la lo rer phogs nas khal brgyad/ zla ba re la bre bcu gsum dang phul lnga/ shog bu bcu debs gnyis bcas sprod rgyu'i gtan 'bebs bzos pa'i gnas tshul 'khod 'dug pa der bltas na/ skabs de'i grwa pa'i 'bor grangs ha cang nyung nyung yin kyang / grwa pa dang chos bdag tshos phogs blangs pa'i grangs 'bor ni ha cang mang po red/ skabs der grwa pa dang chos bdag bsdoms pa'i mi grangs sum brgya lhag tsam yod pa des () 'di'i khal jis stangs ya khyor gsum dang byed ka la phul gang / gul drug la bre gang / bre nyi shu la khal gcig brtsis pa skabs de'i 'jal gshor gi yin/() 'di'i srang rtsis stangs/ nas 'bru drug gi sdid tshad la se ba gang / se ba nyi shu tham pa la zho gang / zho bcu la srang gang / srang bzhi 'am spor bzhi la nyag ka gang / nyag ka nyi shu ste srang brgyad cu tham pa la khal gcig tu rtsis pa skabs de'i 'degs tshad yin/dhi zla ba rer nas khal bzhi dang bre bcu gnyis phul gang /rjo zla ba rer mar nyag drug dang srang do/() zla ba rer khal gnyis lhag tsam/6 15

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/— bod yongs kyi mi 'bor gyi thad nas bshad na ha cang nyung nyung yin kyang kho tshor dbang ba'i bran g.yog gi 'bor grangs them dud chig stong brgya med drug cu tsam yod pa der them dud rer cha snyoms kyi mi grangs bzhi re rtsis pa'i mi grangs bzhi stong nyis brgya drug cu tsam yod pa red/ kho tshor rang bdag gi sa zhing dang / 'brog ra/ nor phyu gas sogs med kyang kho tshos lo gcig la rgyal po'i mdzod nas phogs blangs pa'i 'bru rigs bsdoms 'bor nas khal lnga stong bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad zin pa des// zhing pa mi grangs lnga brgya bzhi bcu zhe gnyis kyis lo gcig ldang ba'i za 'bru'i 'bor grangs dang mnyam gyi yod pa red/ de dang 'dra bar chos bdag dang /sgom chen/ slob grwa'i dge rgan bcas bsdoms pa'i mi grangs sum cu so dgu yod pa de tshos lo gcig la mar phogs blangs pa'i bsdoms 'bor des mar srang sum khri nyis stong nyis brgya tham pa du zin pa des zhing pa mi rer lo rer rgya ma bco brgyad re thob par cha bzhag na zhing pa mi grangs brgya dang brgyad cu gya gcig gis lo gcig ldang ba'i mar 'bab dang mnyam gyi yod pa dzad/ gong gi gnas tshul de'i thog nas skabs der grwa pa'i mi grangs ha cang nyung nyung zhig las med kyang / tshang ma bran g.yog gi bdag po sha stag yin pa dang / kho tsho ni khral dang 'u lag rgyugs mi dgos pa'i dmigs bsal dbang cha chen po yod pa'i rim gras shig tu gyur zin par ra 'phrod gsal po byung ba red/rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis bzos rtari/'i gtan 'bebs de tsho rgyal po du rgya ma suzlo stong nyis brgya nyi shu/ 516

bod kyi chos srid zunga'abrelasmo/rabashadapa/ da wad mu ne btsan po dang khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon ① gnyis kyi dus su'ang mu mthud rgyun 'khyongs byas shing 'gyur ldog gsar pa gang yang byung mi 'dugabod kyi tsorab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1359shing lug (thang shan tsung li khrun gyi yon ha'o khri lo bcu pa)815nas bzung lo ngo nyi shu rtsa bdun ring rgyal po khri ral pa can gyis srid dbang bzung zhing / khong ni chos lugs la ha cang gis dad pa chen po yod pa zhig yin par brten/ slar yang grwa pa mi re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun re sprad pa dang / sus grwa pa la mig ngan bltas na de'i mig 'don pa dang / sus grwa pa la mdzub brda sprad na de'i mdzub mo gcod pa sogs grwa pa rnams spyi tshogs yongs kyi rim pa dang po'i gras su bzhag yod pa red/ da dung dgon pa dang lha khang 'ga' zhig la sa zhing dang / sems can/ bran g.yog bcas sprad nas de tsho dgon pa dang lha khang gi chos rgyun du gtan 'jags sprad yod pa/dper na/ rgyal po'i blon po zhang tshe spong sto re zer bas stod lung lcang phur dhi dge slong bzhi yod pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs pa de'i mdun gyi rdo ring yi ge'i nang 'khod don/ btsan po lha sras khri gtsug lde btsan 'phrul gyi bka' drin stod lung gi lcang phur gtsug lag khang brtsigs te dkon mchog gsum gyi rten btsugs/ dge slong bzhi gnas par sbyar nas/ rkyen gyi bran dang / zhing 'brog dang / lha cha dang / nor rdzas dang /dhi khri lde srong btsan dang sadan legs mjing yon gcig pa yin pa dang khri lde srong btsan ni khri srong lde btsan gyi bu yin par rgyal sde dkar chung lha khang gi rdo ring yi ge'i nang gsal po 'dug⑦ 'di'i stod lcang lcang phu zer ba ni mtshur phu yin cing / rdo rings kyang da lta yod mus/5/7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rkang 'gros la sogs pa tshang bar bcad de/ btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan gyi sku yon rgyun mi chad par byed do zhes gsal zhing / rgyal po khri gtsug lde btsan ni rgyal po ral pa can yin par bod kyi lo rgyus smra ba tshang ma zhal gcig mthun yin pa dang / dgon pa dang lha khang sogs la mchod gzhis sprod pa'i lugs srol de ni rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi dus su thog mar 'go tshugs pa ha cang gsal po red/ der brten ngas bsams par/ rgyal po khri ral pa can phan chad kyi chos lugs mi sna rnams bran g.yog yod kyang sa zhing dang 'brog thang / sems can sogs med pa'i bran g.yog bdag po'i gral rim yin pa dang / rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi dus dgon pa dang lha khang 'ga' zhig la sa 'ing dang / 'brog thang / sems can bcas sprad pa de nas bzung chos lugs mi sna'i nang gi mi khag gcig chos gzhis yod pa'i zhing bdag gral rim zhig tu 'gyur 'go tshugs pa yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/(6)rgyal po glang dar mas sangs rgyas chos lugs bsnubs pa dang de'i 'byung rkyen gang yin skor/〈 rba bzhed chen mo'i 〉mjug gi lo rgyus ltar gnad bsdus bkod na/rgyal po khri ral can gyis srid dbang bzung skabs grwa pa mi rer 'bangs mi khyim bdun re sprad pa dang / grwa par mig ngan bltas na mig 'don pa/mdzub brda byas na mdzub mo gcod pa/ kha ngan bshad na mchu to bregs pa/lha khang dang grwa pa'i rgyu nor brkus na de'i ldab brgyad cu tshab 'jal du 518

bod kyi chos srid zunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wa——bcug pa sogs byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ blon po chos la mi dga' ba dang mang tshogs mang po zhig gi blo la ma babs pa chen po byung ste/ rgyal pos gtan 'bebs byas pa'i chos khrims ma gtor na nga tshor rang dbang gtan nas yong gi ma red ces shod kyi yod pa red/skabs de'adi blon po chos la mi dga' ba tshos sangs rgyas chos lugs med pa bzo thabs skor la gros mol byed skabs/ thog mar rgyal po ral pa can dang / blon po bran ka dpal gyi yon tan/ btsun mo ngang tshul ma bcas med pa ma bzos na chos lugs med pa bzo mi thub cing / rgyal po ral pa can la sras med kyang spun rgan pa gtsang mas srid dbang bzung rgyu'i nyen kha yod pas rgyal po ral pa can med pa ma bzos gong de sngon la med pa bzo dgos/ de nas rgyal po'i btsun mo ngang tshul ma dang / blon po bran ka dpal yon gnyis med pa ma bzos na rgyal po bkrongs mi thub pas de gnyis sngon la med pa bzos rjes rgyal po ral pa can grogs med kher rkyang du lus skabs med pa bzo rgyu las sla zer nas gros 'chams/ de nas blon po sbas stag sna can gyis mnga' 'og tu yod pa'i mo rgyag mkhan dang / rtsis byed mkhan tshor lkog tu brngan pa mang po sprad de/ sras rgan pa gtsang ma mtha' mtshams su ma phud na rgyal khrims 'jig pa'i nyen ka 'dug zer ba shod du bcug skad cha de mi tshang mas go thos byung rjes rgyal por zhus nas gcen po gtsang ma mon gyi yul du rgyang 'bud btang ste lho brag kho mthing du slebs pa dang / sna nam bza' mang rjes dug btang ste bsad/ de rjes rgyal po'i btsun mongang tshul ma dang / blon po bran ka 5/9

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dpal yon gnyis lkog tu lus 'brel byas song zer ba'i phra ma rgyal por zhus pa ltar rgyal pos kho gnyis gsod dgos par bka' phabs te/btsun mo ngang tshul ma rang srog bcad de shi/ blon po bran ka dpal yon gyis rang nyid bsad na rgyal po bgrongs pa'i nyen kha yod bsams nas byang du bros te sa 'og tu gab nas bsdad pa thog mar ma shes kyang phyogs thams cad la rtog zhib byed mkhan btang bas sprang po long bas shes te gsang brtol ba ltar blon po bran ka 'dzin bzung byas thog snye thang du dmar gsod btang ste pags pa spubs bshus byas pa gsob tu brgyangs nas bzhag de nas rgyal po rang lo sum cu so drug la slebs pa lcags bya (thang u tsung li yan gyi hu'i khrang khri lo dang po)spyi lo 841lor rgyal po khri ral pa can mal dro'i 'od zer dam pa'i pho brang du 'bras chang btung nas ra bzi ba'i skabs dang bstun te blon po sbas stag sna dang / cog ro lha long /legs sdug btsan gsum gyis ske gcus te bgrongs thog glang dar ma 'u dum btsan la srid dbang bzung du bcug cing / sbas stag snas blon po byas pa red/ skabs der chos lugs dang chos khrims med pa bzo rgyu'i gleng phyogs gra sgrig byed pa nga/nga dus mtshungs/ bod kyi zhing 'brog sa khul du sngar byung ma myong ba'i nad yams dang / sad dang ser ba/ than pa/chu log sogs gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung bar brten/ rgyal po'i blon po chos la mi dga' ba tsho dang / de bzhin mang tshogs ha cang mang po zhig gis rang byung gnod 'tshe de dag chos byas pa la brten nas byung ba yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ de ni tshan rig 'phel rgyas byung 520

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wa—— med pa'i dus skabs nang rang byung gi gnod 'tshe g.yol thabs ma byung ba'i gnas tshul 'og rang byung khams kyi gnod 'tshe de tsho rang byung khams las 'das pa'i stobs shugs gzhan zhig la brten nas byung bar ngos 'dzin byed pa zhig yin pas tshan rig dang mthun pa'i bsam tshul zhig min rung / sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis rang byung khams kyi gnod 'tshe bkag 'gog byed ma thub pa'i gnas tshul mthong nas sangs rgyas chos lugs la ngos 'dzin dang shes rtogs byed pa'i 'go tshugs skabs bsam tshul de 'dra yong ba ni rgyu mtshan yod pa zhig dang go ba lon thub pa zhig red/ skabs der da dung mi khag gcig gis rang byung khams kyi gnod 'tshe de tsho chos byas nas bkag 'gog byed thub kyi yod pa'i ngos 'dzin/ byed kyi yod/ rgya/la po glang dar mas rang nyid kyi chab srid thog gi dbang sgyur go gnas srung skyong byed ched skabs der spyi tshogs thog yod pa'i mang tshogs khag gcig gis sangs rgyas chos lugs la dga' po med pa dang /dogs pa za ba'i bsam tshul yod pa de bed spyad nas de dang mthun pa'i gleng phyogs shugs chen bzo ba sogs byas mthar/ sangs rgyas chos lugs rtsa med bzo ba'i las don de shugs drag che zhing myur ba'i sgo nas sgrub thub pa byung ba ma gtogs/ skabs der bed spyod bya rgyu'i mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i rmang gzhi med na/ chab srid thog dang khrims lugs thog nas bka' phabs pa tsam gyis lag len thog 'khyol thub kyi ma red/rgyal po glang dar mas skabs der spyi tshogs thog gi mang tshobs khag gcig gi bsam tshul de tsho bed spyad nas bka' phab don du/ rgya bza' kha2/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kong jos khyer yong ba'i shākya mu ne'i sku 'dra de ni rgya 'dre'i lha sku yin zhing /sku de dang po lha yul du yod skabs lha'i dmag pham pa dang / de nas rgya nag tu khyer bas rgya nag tu bkra mi shis pa mang po byung / rgya bza' kong jos sku de bod du khyer yong rjes bod la yang bkra mi shis pa byung zhing /kong jo de ni 'dre mo yin pas bod kyi sa cha'i sa dbyibs brtag dpyad byed khul byas nas bod kyi sa dbyibs bzang po yod pa tshang ma ngan pa red zer nas med pa bzos te/ bod kyi chab srid rgya nag gis 'phrog 'dod pa red/nga tshos sangs rgyas chos lugs dang gtsug lag khang sogs med pa bzo dgos pa dang / grwa pa tsho khyim la babs su 'jug dgos zhes bshad nas/thog mar lha sa gtsug lag khang nas bzung lha khang rnams bshig pa'i 'go tshugs te/ jo bo gnyis chu la bskyur dgos par bka' phab kyang / blon po chos la dga' ba tshos sku 'dra rnams ha cang ljid po yod par kha g.yar te bye stong nang du sbas/ byams pa chos 'khor yin khul byas nas rdo po chu la bskyur/ lha khang rnams kyi sgo bkag ste 'dag zhal btang / dpe cha rnams 'ga' zhig mer bsregs/ 'ga' zhig chu la bskyur/ mang po zhig ni chos la dga' ba'i khyim pa rnams kyis sbas te gnod pa ma byung bar lus/grwa pa rnams grwa chas phud nas khyim la babs su bcug de'i nang nas chos pa rab kyi gras rnams bsad/ 'bring gras rnams mtha' mtshams su phud/mang che ba khral dang 'u lag rgyugs su bcug cing / bka' la ma nyan pa rnams ri dwags brngon par gtong ba sogs byas te/ skabs der bros thub pa rnams mnga' ris brgyud nas mtsho sngon dang / kan su'u zhing chen 522

bod kyi chos sridazungawelaskorabashadapa/ da da rgyud du bros/ rgyal po glang dar ma rang nyid kyang rang lo zhe bzhi pa me stag (thang u tsung gi hu'i khrang khri lo drug pa)spyi lo 846lor lha sa gtsug lag khang gi mdun ngos su yod pa'i rdo ring gi yi ge klog nas bsdad pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal po la phyag 'tshal ba'i khul gyis mda' brgyab ste bsad thog lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje kho rang yang 'jigs te sdod ma nus par 〈 'dul ba 'od ldan 〉dang / 〈 mdo karma sha tam〉〈 mngon pasadzod 〉bcas dpe gsum khur nas mtsho sngon du bros shing / dbus gtsang gnyis dang mnga' ris bcas bod sa gnas yongs la lo rgyus thog grwa pa byung myong ba'i ming tsam ma gtogs ma lus pa chags pa red/ gnas tshul der bod kyi lo rgyus thog chos bsnubs pa zer ba'i ming btags pa ma gtogs/ grwa chas ma gon par lkog tu gsang sngags kyi chos byed mkhan mang po yod pa de tshos lhag lus kyi lha khang dang / dpe cha/ lha sku sogs thabs shes gang yod kyis srung skyob byas te/ rjes su sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar dar byung skabs gzhi nas nyams gso dang sngar las lhag par dar spel gtong thub pa byung/ yod/ gnas tshul de'i thog nas mthong thub pa zhig la/ mi mang po'i bsam blo'i thog gi dad pa'i don gnad der chab srid dang khrims lugs thog nas bka' phabs te chos lugs bsnubs pa der tha ma'i grub 'bras ni de las ldog pa zhig byung bar gsal bshad byas yod pa red/ 523

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/(7)bod sa gnas su bran g.yog gi gyen langs byung ste sil bur 'thor ba dang / skabs de'i rgyal nang dang bod kyi chab srid gnas tshul skor/thang rgyal rabs kyi dus mjug la dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul gyi 'gal ba ha cang dza drag che ru phyin te/ bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1299shing lug (thang zhun tsung gi thi'an pa'o khri lo bcu bzhi pa)spyi lo 755lor/ thang gi dmag dpon an lu'u hran dang / hri si ming gnyis kyis thang rgyal rabs la ngo log byas pa'i zing 'khrug bslangs te lo brgyad ring dmag 'khrug byas pa de nas bzung byang phyogs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor la gtor bshig tshabs chen byung ba dang dus mtshungs thang rgyal rabs de chab srid dang / dmag don/ dpal 'byor bcas phyogs gang ci'i thad nas nyams rgud du song ba'i 'go tshugs shing / de nas bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya 'das lo 1403sa yos (thang zhun tsung li khren gyi ta krung khri lo bcu gsum pa)spyi lo 859lor/ wang zhan gyis 'go khrid byas pa'i zhing pa'i gyen langs byung 'go tshugs te/ der mu mthud nas sa gnas mang po nas zhing pa'i gyen langs gcig rjes gnyis mthud byung ba'i go rim nang / thang rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung dang / sa gnas khag gi sger tshugs srid gzhung bar dang / dpon ribag/sa nang phan tshun bar bcas srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i dmag 'khrug rgyun mi chad pa byung ba des thang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bkod 'doms byed pa'i sa cha'i rgya khyon 524

bod kyi chos sridazungawelaskorabashadapa/ da wad je chung je chung du song bar brten/ bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1404lcags 'brug spyi lo 860lo nas bzung thang rgyal rabs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas bar gyi 'brel ba chad rjes/ bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1451me yos (thang e rdis li kru'u gi thi'an yo'u khri lo bzhi pa)spyi lo 907lor/ thang rgyal rabs rtsa 'thor du song zhing / de nas bzung lo grangs bdun cu don gnyis kyi ring der mes rgyal nang khul du snga rjes su rgyal rabs lnga zer ba byung ste/ 6)ho nan gyi kha'i h+pheng la rgyal sa byas pa'i li'ang rjes ma/ de la rgyal rabs gsum/ ②ho nan gyi lo'i yang la rgyal sa byas pa'i thang rjes ma/ de la rgyal rabs bzhi/ kyeho nan gyi kha'i h+pheng la rgyal sa byas pa'i cin rjes ma/ de la rgyal rabs gnyis/ ③ ho nan gyi kha'i h+pheng la rgyal sa byas pa'i han rjes ma/ de la rgyal rabs gnyis/ ⑤ho nan gyi kha'i h+pheng la rgyal sa byas pa'i kra'o rjes ma/ de la rgyal rabs gsum bcas byung / de tsho yang snga rjes su khag bcur gyes te/①si khron zhing chen gyi khreng tur rgyal sa byas pa'i hri'u sngon ma/ de la rgyal rabs gnyis/ ②ho pe zhing gyi ci'ang hran la rgyal sa byas pa'i cing nan/ de la rgyal rabs lnga/ ③si khron zhing gyi khreng tur rgyal sa byas pa'i hri'u rjes ma/ de la rgyal rabs gnyis/ ④kong tung zhing chen gyi kong kre'u la rgyal sa byas pa'i han lho ma/ de la rgyal rabs bzhi/ ⑤cang su'u zhing chen gyi nan cing la rgyal sa byas pa'i thang lho ma/ de la rgyal rabs gsum/ ducang su'u zhing gyi dbyang kro'u la rgyal sa byas pa'i wu rgyal khab/ de la rgyal rabs bzhi/ ⑦hu'u nan zhing chen gyi khrang hra la 525

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogasabasgrigs/rgyal sa byas pa'i khru'u rgyal rabs/ de la rgyal rabs drug ⑨h+phu can zhing chen gyi h+phu kre'u la rgyal sa byas pa'i min rgyal rabs/ de la rgyal rabs lnga/⑩kre cang zhing chen gyi hang kre'u la rgyal sa byas pa'i wu g.yod/ de la rgyal rabs lnga/ ⑪hra'an shis zhing chen gyi tha'i yon la rgyal sa byas pa'i han byang ma/ de la rgyal rabs bzhi bcas kha 'thor mang po byung ba de la lo rgyus thog rgyal rabs lnga dang rgyal khab bcu zer zhing / de tsho tshang ma krung go'i rgyal khab chen po gcig gi nang rgyal khab chung chung mang po gcig 'og tu gcig ma 'dus par kha 'thor nas bsdad pa'i gnas tshul zhig yin pa las/ krung go'i rgyal khab khongs nas kha bral te pharang btsan rgyal khab ’ chags pa de 'dra min/thang rgyal rabs kyi chab srid stobs shugs nyams rgud du song ba dang dus mtshungs bod sa gnas su yang rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po'i rus rgyud kyis bod sa gnas su dbang bsgyur byed pa'i stobs shugs nyams 'go tshugs pa red/ rgyal po glang dar ma lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bkrongs pa'i phyi lo der bu 'od srung dang / yum brtan gnyis skyes rjes/ btsun mo che chung gi bu gnyis srid dbang bzung rgyur ma 'chams par 'od srung phyogs khag gis g.yo ru dang / yum brtan phyogs khag gis dbus ru bzung ste de la che srid dang chung srid/ mang tshan dang nyung tshan/ gser pa dang g.yu pa/sha zan dang rtsam zan zer ba'i phyogs khas gnyis su gyes pa rnams phan tshun lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad ring nang 'khrug burkurke shing nang 'khrug thag ma chod gong / bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i da das lo 1413sa glang (thang dbyi 526

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/tsung gi zhan thung khri lo bcu ba)spyi lo 869lor/ bod yongs su lo rgyus thog gzhi rgya che shos kyi 'bangs gyen langs dhi byung ste/ de yang thog mar —dbas kho gzher legs stong gis sne khrid 'go pa byas pa'i mdo khams kyi gyen log byung / de rjes dbu rur 'bro dang spas gnyis 'khrugs pa byas par brten nas dbas lo pho lo chung gis 'go khrid de gyen log byas/ de nas lho kha dang / dwags po/ kong po bcas su mtshims kong mi drug dang / shud pu stag rtse gnyags kyis 'go khrid de 'bangs gyen log byung ba bcas ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi gzhi rgya che shos kyi gyen langs yin/ des bod kyi bran g.yog bdag po dang zhing bdag gral rim la shugs drag che ba'i rdung deg btang bar brten/ rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po dang / srong btsan sgam po'i gdung rgyud kyis bod la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i dus rabs mjug sgril ba zhig bzos pa ma zad/ lo grangs brgya lhag tsam ring rjo sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos khrimus lam lugs dang / grwa chas gyon pa'i grwa pa mig gis mthong rgyu med pa zhig bzos pa red/gyen log de'i rjes su bod sa gnas su rje dpon tshan pa bcu gcig gis dum bur bcad nas dbang bsgyur ba'i bcad bzung sa khul chags te/(1)gtsang stod sa khul du grom pa lha rtse la btsan mkhar byas shing / 'bro dang cog ro'i rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig(2)gzhu snye mor 'brang mkhar bye btsan la btsan mkhar byas shing / myang dang snang gi rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig (3)dhi 'bangs gyen log kyang zer/② 'di srong btsan sgam po lo sum cu so bzhi la grongs pa'i dbang du byas pa'i rtsi tshul yin/527

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'phan po za dam du btsan mkhar byas shing / sgro dang rma yi rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig (piyar lung stod du sna mo yar rtse dang mar rtse gnyis la btsan mkhar byas shing / mchims dang gnyags kyi rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig (5)lho brag gtam shul du bya tshang gung snang la btsan mkhar byas shing / snyi ba dang shud pu gnyis kyi rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig(6)'phyongs rgyas phyogs su khu gud co mkhar la btsan mkhar byas shing /khu dang gnyags kyi rus rgyud kyis dpon byas pa'i rje dpon tshan pa gcig sogs chags/ gzhan yang dol po dang / kong po/ gnyal/ lha sa bcas su rje dpon tshan pa re chags nas bod sa gnas yongs rdzogs sil bur 'thor te/ bod kyi rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags phag spyi lo 1231lor yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yon shan tsung mong gol han gyis bod sa gnas yongs rdzogs mes rgyal dang gcig gyur byas pa'i bar lo grangs 362yod pa de la lo rgyus thog bod sil bu'i dus skabs zer/ gyen langs byung nas lo dgu pa bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1421me bya spyi lo 877lo la blon po shud pu stag rtse gnyags sogs gros byas te rgyal po'i bang so rnams gnyags dang / shud pu/ khu/ snyi ba/ 'bro/ cog ro bcas rus rgyud tsho pa drug gis bgo bsha' byas te/ srong btsan gyi bang so 'phyongs rgyas su yod pa de dang / de min lha tho tho ri nas 'od srung bar gyi bang so don mkhar mda' rjo la yod pa'i nang nas/ mang srong gi bang so du deng sang 'phyongs rgyas rdzong khongs 'phyongs po chus don mkhar shang yin/528

bodakyichosasridazunga'abrelaskon+d+rabashadapa/ ge—— —sngo gzher hral po de gnyis ma gtogs bang so gzhan dag tshang ma brus nas bshig rgyal po 'od srung gi bu mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyis lo bcu gcig ring lho kha khul du srid dbang bzung yang rang lo so bcig pa shing yos (thang kra'o tsung gi chen nying khri lo gnyis pa)spyi lo 985lor/'bangs gyen langs kyi 'go khrid pa blon po shud pu stag rtse gnyags kyis myang ro sham po mkhar ① du bgrongs/ de'i bu che ba skyid lde nyi ma mgon dang / chung ba khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gnyis bros te chung ba khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal la stod khul du bsdad/ che ba skyid lde nyi ma mgon stod mnga' ris su song nas bu gsum ② byung ba'i che ba dpal lde rig pa mgon gyis mar yul bzung ste/ de nas la dwags kyi rgyal brgyud rnams byung /me 'bring po bkra shis mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung ste de nas gu ge'i rgyal rgyud rnams byung / mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi bu chung ba khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal la bu gsum dhi byung ba'i 'bring po 'od lde la bu bzhi dhi yod pa'i nang gi bu dang po pha ba de se dang chung ba nyag pa gnyis kyi mi brgyud la gtsang gi rong khuljo dang / nyang stod/ g.yas ru byang rgyud bcas kyi rje dpon tshan pa khag byung / bu gnyis pa khri lde mdo smad du song nas mtsho sngon sa khul du bldad pa las rgyal sras tsho pa zer ① 'di rgyal rtse rdzong gi mkhar de yin zhes skyango chos 'byung 〉gi nang gsal/② dpal lde rig pa mgon dang / bkra shis lde mgon/ lde gtsug mgon gsum yin/⑪ 'bring po bkra shis lde mgon gyis spu greng bzung yang rgyal brgyud byung min lo rgyus mi gsal/① dpal lde dang / 'od lde/ skyid lde gsumarkun/( nya pha ba de se/ khri lde/ khri chung / nyag pa bcas yin/ 5 ṭ+wāṃ9

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i mi brgyud dang dpon rgyud byung zhing /du bu gsum pa khri chung gis yar klungs su bsdad pa las yar lung jo bo zer ba'i dpon rgyud byung /②gong gsal bod sa gnas su kha 'thor gyi rje dpon tshan pa mang pos bod sa gnas su sa khul dum bur bgos nas dbang bsgyur byas ring tshan pa khag bar gcig 'og gcig la mi 'dus pa'i dmag 'khrug yun ring byas pa des bod sa gnas kyi zhing 'brog thon skyed la lo mang po ring gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa dang chabs cig rang byung gi gnod 'tshe dang / mu ge bcas gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung nas dbus gtsang gnyis kyi mi mang po mdo smad sa khul dang / de bzhin zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi gnas tshul cung yag po yod pa'i sa gnas su yul byol du 'gro dgos pa byung ba bcas/ bod sil bu'i dus 'gor dbus gtsang gnyis kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams dmag 'khrug dang mu ge'i sdug bsngal rgyun mi chad pa'i me mtsho'i nang lhung ba red/ bod sil bu'i dus mjug bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1460me byi spyi lo 916lor rang rgyal gyi byang shar sa khul du sdod pa'i chis tan mi rigs kyi 'go gtso ye lu'i a po cis kyis chis tan rus rgyud tsho pa khag gcig gyur byas thog chis tan bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi srid dbang btsugs shing / le'o nying zhing chen gyi pā ling tso chis la rgyal sa byas pa'i le'o rgyal rabs zer ba byung / de la rgyal du 'di'i mi rgyud rjes ma rnams dpon po byed skabs/ rang rgyal gyi sung rgyal rabs dang 'brel ba dam po byung /dhi zhib cha lho brag chos 'byung 〉le tshan ja pa'i mjug dang / la dwags rgyal rabs〉〈gu ge rgyal rabs〉〈mdo smad chos 'byung〉mtsho sngon zhing chen dpe sgrun khang nas dpar sgrun byas pa'iṭ+wāṃmatsho sngon lo rgyus 〉bcas su gsal/530

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da rabs snga rjes gnyis la rgyal po bcu bzhi byung / de rjes kra'o rjes ma'i rgyal rabs kyi rgyal po gsum pa kra'o kong dis kyis srid dbang bzung nas zla ba gsum tsam song dus/ rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1504sa lug spyi lo 960lor/ dmag dpon kra'o khung yon gyis dmag don srid 'gyur byas te ho nan zhing chen gyi kha'i h+pheng sa khul du rgyal sa byas pa'i sung byang ma'i rgyal khab btsugs thog rma chu byang rgyud kyi le'o rgyal khab dang /shis zhwa (mi nyag)gnyis tsam ma gtogs de min gyi rgyal yongs sa gnas mang che ba gcig gyur byed thub pa byung / de rjes 'di'i rgyal rabs bzhi pa sung ren tsung gi pa'o yo'u khri lo dang po sa stag spyi lo 1038lor/blon chen li yon ha'u zer bas ngo log byas te nying zhwa gi ying kre'u la rgyal sa byas pa'i shis thā rgyal rabs dhi de la snga rjes bsdoms pa'i rgyal po bcu byung / de rjes bod kyi rab byung gong shi shākya'i 'das lo 1956shing lug (sung hu'i tsung gi kreng ha'o khri lo lnga pa)spyi lo 1115lor/ rang rgyal gyi byang shar sa khul sung hā ci'ang gtsang po dang 'brug nag gtsang po du dkyil smad khul du gnas pa'i nyu'i kren mi rigs kyi 'go gtso wang yan a ku'i rta nyu'i kren rus rgyud tsho pa khag gcig gyur byas te he lung cang zhing chen gyi a khreng la rgyal sa byas pa'i cin rgyal khab rjo btsugs shing / rjes su rgyal sa ho nan zhing chen gyi kha'i h+pheng la spos/ de la rgyal po dgu byung / de rjes bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1169shing sbrul (sung hu'i dhi 'di bod kyi lo rgyus thog slomi nyag rgyal rabs7 zer ba de yin/rjo he'i lung cang gtsang po yin/() man ju rgyal rabs/ 5 31

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsungartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ da watsung gi zhon ha'o khri lo bdun pa)spyi lo 1125lor/ cin rgyal rabs dang sung rgyal rabs mnyam 'brel byas te le'o rgyal rabs gtor rjeg de'i phyi lor sung byang ma dmag don thog la dogs zon dang gra sgrig med pa'i skabs dang bstun nas cin rgyal khab kyis sung rgyal khab la 'jab rgol byas thog sung byang ma gtor zhing / sung ka'o tsung khang go'u kre cang zhing chen du bros te hang kre'u la rgyal sa byas pa'i sung lho ma'i rgyal khab btsugs pa de la rgyal rabs dgu byung ste sung lho ma'i rgyal khab de yang rjes su yon khra'o rgyal rabs kyi gong ma hu pe li se chen han gyis gtor nas rgyal yongs gcig gyur byas pa red/(8)bod sil bu'i dus mjug tu bod sa gnas su slar yang sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar dar byung ba dang de'i 'byung rkyen skor/bod kyi rab byung gong gi shākya'i 'das lo 1522sa stag (sung byang ma'i sung tha'i tsung kra'o kus/ tha'i phing shin go khri lo gsum pa)spyi lo 978lor/de sngon dbus gtsang gnyis nas mtsho sngon du bros byol song ba'i dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcu du mdo smad du phyin nas bla chen dgongs pa () dbus nas glag pa lam pa klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ gnyal pa 'bring ye shes yon tan/rba tshul khrims blo gros/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes blo gros bcas lnga dang / gtsang nas mgur mo rab kha ba lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug stod kyi shab sgo lnga'i tshong btsun shes rab seng ge mnga' ris pa 'o brgyad spun gnyis/ bo dong pa u pa de dkar ba bcas lnga/532

bod kyi chos srid zunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ — da —rab gsal gyi slob ma grum ye shes rgyal mtshan la dge slong zhus/① kho tsho rim bzhin dbus gtsang du log yong kyang lha sar bsdad ma nus par bsam yas su song nas klu mes tshul khrims shes rab kyis ka chung lha khang bdag po byas/ rag shi spun mched gnyis kyis dge rgyas bye ma gling gi bdag po byas/ 'bring ye shes yon tan gyis khams gsum zangs khang gling bdag po byas/ rba tshul khrims blo gros spun mched gnyis kyis bsam yas dbu rtse'i lha khang rnams bdag po byas/ rjes su kho tsho rim bzhin lha sar yong nas/ klu mes kyis dbus stod la mor chag de'u zer ba'i lha khang btab nas gnas gzhi bzung / klu mes la slob ma ka ba bzhi zer ba byung ba'i nang nas zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis 'phan po rgyal lug glas lha khang btab nas gnas gzhi bzung ba las zhang skor byung / klu mes kyi slob ma sdog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis yer pa ba rang gi lha khang btab nas gnas gzhi bzung ba las rngog skor byung / klu mes kyi slob ma glan ye shes shes rab kyis rgya gsar sgang gi lha khang btab nas gnas gzhi bzung ba las glan skor byung / klu mes kyi slob ma gru mer tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis thang po che'i dgon pa btab nas gnas gzhi bzung zhing de nas gyes pa la thang skor byung / gong gsal gyi skor tsho bzhi po de la spyi ming du klu mes tsho pa zer/dbus pa mi lnga'i nang gi rba tshul khrims blo gros kyis 'phan por lan pa spyil bu'i dgon pa btab nas gnas gzhi bzung zhing / de nas gyes pa dhi lo rgyus kyi dpe cha khag gcig nang mi bcus bla ngo ma la gtugs par bshad/ 5rte3

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la rba tsho zer/dbus pa mi lnga'i nang gi rag shi tshul khrimasna 'byung gnas kyis mal dror 'phreng 'og lha khang brtsigs nas gnas gzhi bzupre zhing / de nas gyes pa la rag tsho zer/dbus pa mi lnga'i nang gi 'bring ye shes yon tan gyis 'phan por ngan lam spyi mo dgon pa btab nas gnas gzhi bzung zhing / de nas gyes pa la 'bring tsho zer/gong du bshad pa'i klu mes/ rba/ rag 'bring bcas kyi tsho pa bzhi po de rim bzhin lha sar 'phel rgyas byung ste dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dkyil dang / bcu gnyis pa'i mgor tsho pa sde bzhi phan tshun bar dmag 'khrug thengs mang po byung ba dang / bod kyi rab byung gnyis pa'i me khyi (sung byang ma'i sung hu'i tsung kra'o chis kyi khrong nying khri lo lnga pa)spyi lo 1106lor bsam yas su klu mes tshogs pa dang / rba rag tshogs pa bar nang 'khrug byung ste bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi 'khor sa'i lha khang mang che ba mer bsregs/ lcags ri dang rtsig pa'i gyang rnams kyang 'gyel nas bsdad yod skabs/ rwa lo tsu ba rdo rje grags kyis nyams gso byas shing / skabs der shing cha rnams 'ol kha nas dbor 'dren byas pa dang / bzo pa las mi bsdoms pa'i mi grangs lnga brgya tham pas las rgyun lo gnyis lhag tsam 'gor thog nyams gso'i 'gro song 'bru khal chig 'bum lhag tsam phyin pa bcas kyi gnas tshul skor rwa lo'i slob ma rwa chos rab kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 rwa lo rdo rje grags kyi rnam thar 〉nang gsal po 'khod 'dug yang rab 534

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wa da byung gsum pa'i lcags 'brug (sung lho ma'i sung ka'o tsung kra'o ku'o gi hra'o shin khri lo sum cu pa)spyi lo 1160lor/ lha sa dang / yar lung / 'phan po bcas la yod pa'i gong gsal gyi tsho pa sde bzhi phan tshun bar dmag 'khrug yun ring byung skabs lha sa gtsug lag khang dang rwa mo che khra 'brug bcas la me skyon dang gtor bshig tshabs chen byung ba dang / skabs der dwags po lha rje'i slob ma dwags sgom tshul khrims snying pos tsho pa phan tshun bar gyi dmag 'khrug 'dum sgrigs byas thog lha sa gtsug lag khang che chung gnyis kar zhig gso byas rjes/ skabs der lha sa khul du dpal 'byor dang / dmag rdon thog stobs shugs che ba'i chos lugs mi sna gung thang bla ma zhang ⑦ la rtsis sprod byas pa'i gnas tshul skor 〈 lho brag chos 'byung 〉gi le tshan ja pa'i mjug dang / na pa'i mgo dang / de bzhin 〈 deb ther sngon po 〉le tshan nya pa/ 〈 lho rong chos 'byung 〉bcas su gsal/ gong du bshad pa ltar skabs der gsar du dar rgyas byung ba'i tsho pa sde bzhi ni chos lugs thog grub mtha' mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gang yang med rung dgon pa so so'i dpal 'byor gyi rten gzhi lha khang khag gi yong 'bab 'phrog rgyu kho na'i ched du dmag 'khrug rgyun mi chad pa rgyab pa des bod sa gnas kyi zhing 'brog thon skyed dang / rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi tshe srog rgyu nor la tshabs che ba'i gnod 'tshe phog pa ma zad/ dmag 'khrug gi nang gna' rabs bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi blo gros dang lag rtsal la brten nas gsar skrun byas pa'i lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gnyis dang / bsam yas/ khra 'brug sogs du tshal pa bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs thog mar gsar gartod byed mkhan/ 54rte5

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la gtor bshig tshabs chen byung ba de ni/ chos lugs mi sna rnams gzhan brten bshu gzhog gi 'tsho ba dang kha bral thabs med pa'i rul sungs kyi rang bzhin de'i rkyen gyis phan tshun bar dpal 'byor rten gzhi 'phrog res byas pa'i ngan 'bras shig yin pa gsal po red/ tsho pa sde bzhi byung nas lo sum cu tsam phyin pa/ bod kyi rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug (sung byang ma'i sung ren tsung kra'o kron gyi pa'o yon khri lo gsum pa)spyi lo 1040lor mnga' ris gu ge'i rgyal po lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis rgya gar nas a ti sha bod du gdan drangs te lo ngo bcu bdun ring mnga' ris/ lha sa snye thang / brag yer pa/ 'phan po bcas su phebs nas sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel btang zhing / a ti sha sku 'das rjes lo gsum song ba bod kyi rab byung dang po'i me bya (sung byang ma'i sung ren tsung kra'o kren gyi cwa yo'u khri lo gnyis pa)spyi lo 1057lor/ a ti sha'i slob ma 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rwa sgreng dgon pa btab nas gnas gzhi bzung ste/ de nas bka' gdams kyi chos lugs byung / dgon pa 'debs mkhan gyi sbyin bdag ni yon bdag shakā mgon dang zhang 'phrang kha ber chung gis byas/de nas lo bcu drug song ba/ bod kyi rab byung dang po'i chu glang (sung byang ma'i sung hren tsung kra'o hu'i gi shis nying khri lo drug pa)spyi lo 1073lor/'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos sa skya'i dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas sa skya'i chos lugs byung /de nas lo zhe dgu song ba rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags glang (sung byang ma'i sung hu'i tsung kra'o hu'i cis kyi zhon ha'o khri lo gnyis pa)spyi lo 1121lor/536

bod kyi chos sridazungawelaskorabashadapa/ da wa—mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyis shangs gzhong dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung /gong gsal gyi lo de rang la/ mi la ras pa'i slob ma dwags po lha rjes dwags lha sgam po'i dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas dwags po bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung /de nas lo bcu dgu song ba/ bod kyi rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag (sung lho ma'i sung ka'o tsung kra'o ka'o yi hra'o shin khri lo nyer brgyad pa)spyi lo 1158lor/ dwags po lha rje'i slob ma phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal pos phag mo gru'i dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas phag grub bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung /de nas lo gnyis song ba/ rab byung gsum pa'i lcags 'brug (sung lho ma'i sung ka'o tsung kra'o ka'o yi hra'o shin khri lo sum cu pa)spyi lo 1160phag mo gru pa'i slob ma 'bab rom pa dar ma dbang phyug gis nag chu khul du 'bab rom ri bo che'i dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas 'bab rom bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung /de nas lo ngo bdun songardzib/ bod kyi rab byung gsum pa'i me phag (sung lho ma'i sung sha'o tsung kra'o mu'u yi to'o khri lo gsum pa)spyi lo 1167lor/ phag mo gru pa'i slob ma 'gro mgon smar ba shes rab ye shes kyis bar khams su sho dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas smar ba bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung /de nas lo lnga song ba/ rab byung gsum pa'i lcags yos (sung lho ma'i 537

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sung sha'o tsung kra'o mu'u gi cen ta'o khri lo bdun pa)spyi lo 1171lor/ phag mo gru pa'i slob ma sangs rgyas yel pa ye shes brtsegs kyis khams su yel phug dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas yel phug bka' brgyud byung /gong gi lo de rang la/ phag mo gru pa'i slob ma rgyal tsha rin chen mgon gyis gtsang khul du khro phu dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas khro phu bka' brgyud byung /de nas lo bzhi song bam̐/ rab byung rgesum pa'i shing lug (sung lho ma'i sung sha'o tsung kra'o yu'u gi hren zhis khri lo gnyis pa)spyi lo 1175lor/ dwags po lha rje'i slob ma dwags sgom tshul khrims snying po'i yang slob gung thang bla ma zhang brtson 'grus grags pas tshal gyi dgon pa btab gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas tshal pa bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung /de nas lo lnga song ba/ bod kyi rab byung gsum pa'i sa phag (sung lho ma'i sung sha'o tsung kra'o mu'u gi khrun shis khri lo drug pa)spyi lo 1179lor/ phag mo gru pa'i slob ma skyob pa 'jig rten mgon pos 'bri gung mthil gyi dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung /de'i phyi lor/ phag mo gru pa'i slob ma stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal gyis stag lung dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas stag lung bka' brgyud byung /de nas lo dgu song ba rab byung gsum pa'i sa bya (sung lho ma'i sung sha'o 538

— bodakyichosasridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wa da tsung kra'o mu'u gi khrun zhis khri lo bcu drug pa)spyi lo 1189lor/ dwags po lha rje'i slob ma karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas stod lung nang du mtshur phu'i dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas karma bka' brgyud byung /de nas lo bcu song ba/ rab byung gsum pa'i me stag (sung lho ma'i sung nying tsung kra'o kho'u gi kha'i shing khri lo gnyis pa)spyi lo 1206lor/ phag mo gru pa'i slob ma za ra ba skal ldan ye shes seng ge'i yang slob g.ya' bzang pa chos smon lam gyis g.ya' bzang dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung /gong du bshad pa'i chos lugs de tsho'i nang nas bka' gdams pa dang sa skya pa/ shangs pa bka' brgyud bcas phud pa'i chos lugs gzhan dag de tsho'i spyi ming la bka' brgyud pa zer zhing / de la nang gses kyi che bzhi dang chung brgyad du phye ba ste/ ①dwags po bka' brgyud/ (nyaphag gru bka' brgyud/ ①'bab rom bka' brgyud/ ④mtshur phu bka' brgyud bcas bzhi ni dwags po lha rje rang nas thad kar brgyud pa'i chos lugs yin par brten che bzhi zer ba dang / ①'bri gung bka' brgyud/ (sne)stag lung bka' brgyud/ ②khro phu bka' brgyud/ sti'abrug pa bka' brgyud/ 5smar ba bka' brgyud/ (khyeyel pa bka' brgyud/ megaya' bzang bka' brgyud/ ⑧shug gseb bka' brgyud bcas bergya/da ni dwags po lha rje'i slob ma phag mo gru pa nas gyes pa yin pas de rnams la chung brgyad zer/ chos lugs de dag nidar spel byed mkhan gyis rang rang so sos gnas gzhi re bzung nas dgon pa 'debs pa dang / lha khang bzhengs pa sogs byas te 539

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnas gzhi'i sa khul de la brten nas rang rang so so'i stobs shugs khyab khongs rgya skyed byas pa sha stag yin pas sa khul rang bzhin ldan pa'i chos lugs stobs shugs shig yin pa dang / thog ma'i gnas gzhi'i dgon pa de la ma dgon zer zhing / de'i rjes su gnas gzhan la rgya skyed byas pa'i dgon pa de la bu dgon zer gyi yod pa red/rab byung dang po'i me bya (sung byang ma'i sung ren tsung kra'o kren gyi cwa yo'u khri lo gnyis pa)spyi lo 1057lo nas rab byung gsum pa'i me stag (sung lho ma'i sung nying tsung kra'o kho'u gi kha'i shing khri lo gnyis pa)spyi lo 1206lo bar gyi lo brgya dang lnga bcu'i ring gi dus skabs de'i nang bod sa gnas su chos lugs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs gcig mthud gnyis rjes su byung ba der spyi tshogs kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo gnyis yod pa red/gcig ni/ bod sil bu'i dus dkyil du slebs skabs bod sa gnas su bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin gyi dpal 'byor lam lugs rtsa ba'i cha nas chags zin pa ma zad/ zhing 'brog thon skyed la gong 'phel che tsam byung ba dang chabs cig sa gnas kyi lag shes bzo las dang tshong las kyang 'phel rgyas byung ste/ stod mnga' ris kyi ding ri dang / gnya' nang /gtsang gi lha rtse tshong 'dus mgur mo bcas su tshong rwa chags 'go tshugs shing / stod mnga' ris gu ge dang byang gi lo deng zer ba'i sa cha gnyis nas gser gyi gter kha thon pa/ lho kha dang ngam ring gnyis su dkar yol bzo ba'i lag rtsal dar ba/ de dus rta gcig la rin thang 'bru khal bzhi re rtsi gi yod pa sogs lo rgyus khag gcig nang gsal/ skabs de dus kyi 540

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad gser dngul gnyis kyi ljid tshad thang gzhi ni/ bal sran dhi gcig gi ljid tshad la se ba gang / se ba brgyad la zho gang / zho brgyad la srang gang //gser srang gang la dngul srang do/ gser srang bzhi la bod dngul srang brgyad/ de la dngul bre gang zer/ gser srang bcu drug la gser bre gang /de la dngul bre do/ dngul bre chen gcig la dngul srang lnga bcu tham pa dang / —gser srang nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa'i thog 'degs byed kyi srang de yang shing srang zer ba shing las bzos pa'i srang zhig yod pa red/ skabs de'i bod sman dang 'bru rigs kyi 'jal tshad ni/ nas 'bru che ba gnyis/'bring ba gnyis/ chung ba gnyis bcas drug shong ba'i tshad la kham tshig gang / kham tshig drug gi shong tshad la star phul gang / star phul drug la bya sgong gang / bya sgong drug la mkhar phul gang / mkhar phul drug la mkhar bre gang / mkhar bre nyi shu la mkhar khal gang du rtsi gi yod par skabs der brtsams pa'i 'dul ba'i 'grel pa dang / sman gzhung gi nang 'khod 'dug pa de ni/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan skabs lag pa'i khyor ba la 'jal tshad byas pa de las yar thon che ba zhig red/skabs de'i bod sman dang mar gyi ljid tshad thang gzhi ni/ nas 'bru che ba gnyis/ 'bring ba gnyis/ chung ba gnyis bcas bsdoms pa'i drug gi ljid tshad la se ba gang / se ba nyi shu tham pa la zho gang / zho bcu la srang gang ste spor gang / srang bzhi'am spor bzhi la nyag gang / nyag lnga la khyor ba gang / nyag nyi shu tham pa la khal gcig tu brtsi gi yod par skabs dhi deng sang dmar ru mgo nag zer/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/der brtsams pa'i sman gzhung 'ga' zhig nang gsal/de dus bod sa khul nas gser phon chen po thon gyi yod pa yin na'ang / skabs der bod nas rgya gar du slob sbyong byed par 'gro mkhan lo tsā ba snga rjes bsdoms pa'i mi grangs brgya dang lnga bcu lhag tsam byung ba de tshos rang nyid kyi slob yon dang / sger gyi 'gro song bcas lo gsum ldang ba khyer na ma tha yang gser srang brgyad cu nas brgya lhag tsam bar khyer dgos pa dang / bod sil bu'i dus skabs su bod nas rgya gar du sangs rgyas chos lugs slob sbyong byed par 'gro mkhan gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po nas shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan bar snga rjes bsdoms pa'i mi grangs brgya dang lnga bcu lhag tsam zin pa des sangs rgyas chos lugs snga dar dus las ldab gnyis kyis mang ba yod/dhi de bzhin hin rdu dang / pa ci si than/a h+phu han/ kasmir bcas nas bod du phebs pa'i paṇ+ḍita yang bod sil bu'i dus dkyil dang dus mjug der snga rjes bsdoms pa'i mi grangs bdun cu don gsum byung yod pa de yang sangs rgyas chos lugs snga dar dus las ldab gnyis kyis mang ba red/dhi skabs der bod sa gnas nas rgya gar dang / ne pā la/ kasmir bcas la slob sbyong byed par 'gro mkhan gyi lo tsā ba tshos ma tha yang lo bdun sdod dgos pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis lo nyi shu tsam sdod mkhan byung yod pa de tsho tshang mas slob yon dang / 'gro song bcas lo gcig gam yang na lo gsum ldang ba khyer nas de rdzogs mtshams da dhi snga dar dus lo tsā ba lnga bcu nga drug las med/ dhi snga dar dus phyi rgyal nas bod du phebs pa'i paṇ+ḍita snga rjes bsdoms pa'i mi grangs nyi shu rtsa gnyis las med/542

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ —da ——su slar yang bod du yong ste gser gang mang thabs shes byas nas bskyar du slob sbyong byed par 'gro gi yod pa red/ gong gsal phyi dar skabs kyi lo tsā ba mi grangs brgya dang lnga bcu nga gsum gyis phyi rgyal du slob sbyong byas pa'i lo grangs cha snyoms kyis lo dgu dang lo re'i 'gro song gser srang brgyad cu btang bar cha bzhag na/ mi grangs brgya dang lnga bcu nga gsum gyis lo dgu'i ring gser srang chig 'bum chig khri stong med brgya dang drug cu tham pa phyi rgyal du 'khyar ba red/de thog da dung phyi rol gyi cha rkyen ni/ bod kyi rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug (sung byang ma'i sung ren tsung kra'o kren gyi sba'o yon khri lo gsum pa)spyi lo 1040lor a ti sha bod la phebs pa'i rjes nas bzung dzukye hin rdu'i sa khul dkyil rgyud la yang tā sig a la po'i dmag dpung gis btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug bslangs de rgya gar gyi shar dang lho rgyud sa khul phud de min sa khul mang che ba btsan bzung byas par brten rgya gar gyi dkyil rgyud la yang tā sig gi chos lugs dar nas sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi stobs shugs nyams 'go tshugs nyu/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi 'bar ma dang / can h+phu kre/ g.yod nan/ la'o wo/ tha'i go bcas kyi sa gnas tsam ma gtogs de min rgya gar gyi sa gnas gzhan dag la sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nus pa shor ba red/de nas lo grangs brgya dang drug cu tsam song ba/ rab byung gsum pa'i lcags bya (sung byang ma'i sung nying tsung kra'o khu'o gi cin tha'i khri lo dang po)spyi dhi de'i gong la hin rdu'i sa khul dkyil rgyud la tā sig gi chos lugs dar med/ 54 rte

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lo 1201lor/ tā sig gi dmag dpung gis hin rdu'i rgyal khab dkyil rgyud dang lho rgyud/ nub rgyud bcas tshang ma btsan bzung byas te sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mkhas pa dang / grwa pa mang che ba rgya gar shar phyogs kyi 'bar ma dang / g.yod nan/ la'o wo/ can h+phu kre/ tha'i go bcis su bros pa dang / nyung shas shigazu.a sam dang / bal yul brgyud nas bod du bros phebs pa red/ dper na/ de sngon bod kyi lo rgyus thog skad grags che ba'i kha che paṇa chen shākya shri zhu ba (sa skya paṇa chen gyi bla ma)de yang skabs der a sam dang / gro mo brgyud nas bod du bros phebs pa'i gras shig yin zhing / khong bod kyi khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bod sa gnas su gdan drangs te lo bcu tsam bod du bzhugs thog sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel btang ba dang / de dus sa skya paṇa chen dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum la phebs yod pas khong gis kha che paṇa chen la bsnyen rdzogs zhus te dge slong gi sdom rgyun spel ba nas kha che paṇa chen gyi brgyud pa zer ba'i dge slong gi sdom rgyun gsar pa 'phel rgyas byung ste tshogs pa sde bzhi zer ba rjobacas byung ba red/ rgya gar du sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nus pa shor ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas bod sa gnas su sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar gso byung ba der/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya gar nas byang du dar ba zer zhing / de rjes kan su'u dang mtsho sngon brgyud nas nang sog dang / khal khar dar ba'i 'go tshugs pa der bod kyi lo rgyus thog bstan pa byang nas byang du dar ba zer gyi yod pa red/ gong gi ① tshogs pa bye rdzing pa/ tshogs chen pa/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa/ tshogs pa tshal mig pa bcas yin/ 544

bod kyi chos srid zunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wa——gnas tshul de dag gi thog nas rgyal po glang dar mas sangs rgyas chos lugs bsnubs rjes bod khams sil bur gyur pa nas yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma mong gol han gyis bod sa gnas gcig gyur byas pa'i bar (spyi lo 858—1251bar)gyi lo grangs sum brgya dgu bcu go gsum ring gi dus skabs der mes rgyal nang khul dang bod sa gnas kyi chab srid stobs shugs kha 'thor yin pa'i gnas tshul 'og rgya gar du sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi stobs shugs nyams 'go tshugs pa dang chabs cig bod sa gnas su sangs rgyas chos lugs 'dra min sna tshogs bskyar gso byung ba dang /chos lugs de tsho yang sa khul rang bzhin ldan pa'i chos lugs stobs shugs shig yin pa'i thog de tsho'i brten sa chab srid kyi stobs shugs mi 'dra ba re yod pa'i dbang gis slar yang chab srid stobs shugs kha 'thor ba'i gnas tshul gsar pa zhig 'phar snon byung ba bcas ni bod sil bu'i dus skabs der sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar gso byung ba dang / yun ring bar bod sa gnas gcig gyur byed ma thub pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen red/de dang dus mtshungs gong du bshad pa ltar rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus grwa pa tshor bran g.yog yod kyang / kho tsho'i 'tsho ba rnams rgyal po'i mdzod nas phogs blangs kyi yod pa de dang / rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi dus grwa pa tshor mchod gzhis sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can bcasu sprad pa'i lam lugs de gnyis bar khyad mistatshochen po yod pas/ grwa pa tshor sger bdag bran g.yog tsam ma gtogs/ mchod gzhis sogs ma sprad par 'tsho ba'i brten sa rgyal po'i mdzod dang srid gzhung nas phogs blangs rgyu'i lam 5/5

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lugs de mu mthud nas rgyun 'khyongs byed thub na/ chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi sna rnams bran g.yog/ gi bdag po tsam zhig ma gtogs/ sa zhing dang 'brog thang / sems can bcas sger bzung byed mkhan gyi zhing bdag gral rim zhig tu 'gyur mi thub cing / chos lugs mi sna tshor sger la dbang ba'i sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can bcas med na kho tshor thon skyed rgyu chas sger la dbang ba'i dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi med pa yin stabs/ dpal 'byor rmang gzhi de srung skyob byed ched srid dbang bzung rgyur brtson len byed pa'i dmigs yul de yong mi srid/ dmigs yul de med na bod la chos lugs mi snas srid dbang lag tu bzung ba'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs yong mi thub pa bcas red/ 'on kyang skabs der bod sa gnas kyi thon skyed lag rtsal ha cang rjes lus yin stabs/ rgyal po'i mdzod dang srid gzhung gi dpal 'byor stobs shugs des grwa pa nyung nyung las med skabs kho tsho gso skyong thub kyang / grwa pa mang du phyin nas rgyal po'i mdzod dang srid gzhung gis gso thub pa'i tshad las brgal na rgyal po'i khyim tshang dang / srid gzhung gi dpon rigs/ mang tshogs bcas kyis khas len byed mi thub pas gnad don de thag gcod byed ched thon skyed rgyu chas sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can bcas grwa pa tshor sprad nas khe gyong gang byung yang srid gzhung dang rgyal po'i mdzod nas 'gan khur mi dgos pa zhig mi byed ka med byung ba red/ thag gcod de 'dra byas nga/ des grwa pa tshor 'tsho ba'i brten sa nges can zhig byung thog chos lugs mi sna tsho'i dpa'/ 'byor stobs shugs che ru song ba ma zad/ 546

rim bzhin je rgyas je 'phel du phyin nas mthar chos lugs mi sna'i nang gi mi khag gcig sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can bcas phon po bzung ba'i zhing bdag gral rim stobs che ba'i gras shig tu gyur pa de ni/bod la chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs chags pa'i gral rim gyi rmang gzhi red/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsungartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa gnyis pa/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs dngos su 'go tshugs pa dang / chos lugs grub mtha' khag gi mtho rim mi snas chos lugs bed spyad nas phan tshun srid dbang 'phrog res byas pa'i 'thab rtsod skor/(1)sa skya bas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung ba dang / sa skya ba dang 'bri gung pa gnyis bar gyi dmag 'khrug skor/bod kyi rab byung gsum pa'i sa bya spyi lo 1189lor/ mong gol mi rigs kyi rgyal po jing gir han gyis mong gol tsho pa khag gcig gyur byas rjes/ rim bzhin yā gling dkyil ma dang nub ma/ o gling shar rgyud bcas la rgyang bskyod dmag 'khrug byas te thog mar phyi nas yong ba'i btsan 'dzul stobs shugs zil gyis mnan mthar/ gzhi nas krung go'i rgyal nang du gcig gyur byed pa'i dmag 'khrug rgyab pa brgyud/ shis khā dang / sung lho ma/ cin rgyal rabs gsum phud pa'i rgyal nang gi sa khul mang che ba dbang bsgyur byas shing / skabs der bod sa gnas nang khul du chos lugs tshogs pa khag dang / chab srid stobs shugs phyogs khag rnams gcig gyur med pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ bod kyi rab byung gsum 548

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad pa'i me stag spyi lo 1206lor bod dbus gtsang du dmag dpung btang bas/ skabs de'i bod dbus gtsang mnga' ris bcas kyi 'go pa tshang mas rgol lan slog ma nus par mgo btagasasmozhus thog sa skya'i bla ma dang thog ma'i 'brel ba byung /dhibod dbus gtsang nas sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lha sku dang / chos dpe mang po sog yul du khyer te sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel gtong ba'i 'go tshugs/ bod kyi rab byung bzhi pa'i me phag spyi lo 1227lor/ jing ger han gyis shis khā rgyal rabs mnga' 'og tu bsdus rjes shis khā rgyal po'i bla ma gtsang pa dung khur ba dbang phyug bkra shis la ② chos zhus te bod sa gnas kyi grwa pa rnams khral dang dmag khral rgyugs mi () 'di skabs sum pa mkhan chen gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 chos 'byung dpag bsam ljon bzang 〉dang / dga' ldan khri thog bco lnga pa paṇa chen bsodanams grags pas brtsams pa'i ṭ+wāṃ desge ther dmar po gsar ma 〉sogs bod yig gi lo rgyus mang po zhig gi nang / jing ger han gyis bod du dmag dpung gtong skabs sde srid jo dga' dang / tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje sogs kyis mgo btags zhus par bshad pa dang /yang de'i skabs sa skya'i bla ma kun dga' snying po dang 'brel ba byas pa bshad pa ni nor 'khrul yin te/ gang lags zhe na/ ṭ+wāṃ deb ther dmar po 〉rtsom mkhan tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje ni bod kyi rab byung lnga pa'i sa bya spyi lo 1309lor skyes nas/ rab byung drug pa'i chu sbrul spyi lo 1353lor 'das pa dang / des 'bri gung pa dang mnyam 'brel byas te tā si byang chub rgyal mtshan la dmag drangs pa'i mthar pham nyes byung nas tshal pa'i srid dbang tā si'i lag tu thob pa'i gnas tshul skor/ tā si byang chub rgyal mtshan rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 bka' chems deb ther 〉nang gsal ba ma zad/ tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 deb ther dmar po'i 〉nang du 'ang zur tsam 'khod 'dug cing / jing ger han ni bod kyi rab byung gsum pa'i chu rta spyi lo 1162da rab byung bzhi pa'i me phag spyi lo 1227bar gyi mi yin pas tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje dang jing ger han gnyis rtsa ba nas dus mi mtshungs ga de datha phyogs mtshungs jing ger han gyis bod du dmag dpung btang ba'i lo/ rab byung gsum pa'i me stag spyi lo 1206lor sa chen kun dga' snying po 'das nas lo zhe brgyad dang / sa chen bsod nams rtse mo 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa lnga/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal ma gyi rang lo drug cur slebs pa'i skabs yin pas jing ger han gyis 'asbol ba byed sa'i sa skya'i bla ma ni ā+oṃ kun dga' snying po min par rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan yin dgos par 'dug() tshal pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma zhig 5 /9

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ dgos pa'i bka' shog rjo zer ba yongs bsgrags byas nas chos lugs mi sna rnams la dmigs bsal dbang cha chen po sprad/ yin na'ang skabs der bod du yod pa'i chos lugs tshogs pa khag rnams la so so'i stobs shugs khyab khongs mi 'dra ba yod thog rang rang so sos sger bzung byas pa'i sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can/ bran g.yog bcas mang tsam yod rung / tshogs pa khag so so'i rgyab rten bcol sa'i chab srid kyi stobs shugs khag ni gcig 'og gcig la mi 'dus pa'i kha 'thor dgu 'thor yin par brten/ chos lugs tshogs pa khag gis so so'i chos lugs stobs shugs gong 'phel dang sra brtan gtong dgos na/ nges par du rang nyid kyi rgyab rten bcol sa'i chab srid kyi stobs shugs de yang chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ dmag don bcas gang ci'i thad nas stobs shugs che zhing gcig gyur che tsam yin pa zhig la brten dgos rgyu de kha tsha dgos gtugs yin par mthong nas/ bod kyi rab byung bzhi pa'i sa phag (yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma go dan rgyal po'i khri lo drug pa)spyi lo 1239lor/sa skya ba dang / phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung pa/ tshal pa/ stag lung pa/g.ya' bzang pa bcas kyis sog yul du mi sna mngags gtong byas te sa skya bas o go da'i rgyal po la mgo btags zhus shing / de dang 'dra bar phag mo gru pa dang g.ya' bzang pa gnyis kyis rgyal sras hu la'i hu la mgo btags zhus pa dang / 'bri gung pa dang / gtsang mgur mo bas rgyal sras se chen han la mgo btags zhus pa/ stag lung pas rgyal sras a ri bo ga dhi ban rde shed bskyed kyi 'ja' sa/550

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ —da da la mgo btags zhus rjes kho tshor rgyal po dang rgyal sras so so'i mnga' khongs bod kyi sa gnas khag nas rgya khyon ha lam 'dra ba'i mchod gzhis sprad pa red/ phag mo gru pa la hu la'i hus sprad pa'i mchod gzhis mi ser them grangs nyis stong bzhi brgya sum cu so brgyad/ 'bri gung pa la mong gol han gyis sprad pa'i mchod gzhis mi ser them grangs sum stong drug brgya sum cu/ tshal pa la se chen han gyis sprad pa'i mchod gzhis mi ser them grangs sum stong bdun brgya/ g.ya' bzang pa la hu la hus sprad pa'i mchod gzhis mi ser them grangs sum stong / stag lung pa la a ri bo gas sprad pa'i mchod gzhis mi ser them grangs lnga brgya/ sa skya ba la go dan rgyal pos mnga' ris skor gsum phud pa'i la stod lho byang gnyis dang /gur mo chu mig shangs/ zhwa lu/ yar 'brog bcas khri skor bdun gyi sa cha dang / mi ser them grangs chig khri stong med brgyad brgya brgyad cu gya lnga sprad yod pa red/ lo de'i phyi lo bod kyi rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags byi spyi lo 1240lor go dan rgyal pos blon po dor rta nag pos sne khrid pa'i dmag dpung bod du btang / bod du chos lugs thog mkhas shos su yin zhib 'jug byas te/ rab byung bzhi pa'i shing 'brug spyi lo 1244lor yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma go dan rgyal pos sa skya paṇa chen mes rgyal nang khul du gdan drangs/bod kyi rab byung bzhi pa'i chu byi spyi lo 1252lor yon shan tsung mong gol han gyis srid dbang bzung rjes kyi phyi lo chu glang spyi lo 1253lor bod du dmag dpung btang nas bod yongs rdzogs gong bu gcig gyur byas 55/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa dang / dus mtshungs mnga' khongs su dud tshang zhib bsher byas/ rab byung bzhi pa'i shing yos/ spyi lo 1255lor karma pak+shi dhi chos kyi bla ma mes rgyal nang khul du gdan drangs nas karma pa dang yon rgyal rabs bar thog ma'i 'brel ba byung / bod kyi rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags spre spyi lo 1260lor hu pi li se chen han srid khrir 'khod pa dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa slar yang mes rgyal nang khul du gdan drangs shing / se chen han gyis karma pak+shi dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa gnyis ka bla mar bsten/ rab byung bzhi pa'i shing glang /spyi lo 1265lor hu pi li se chen han gyis 'gro mgon 'phags pa la gsang sngags kyi dbang thengs dang po zhus pa'i dbang yon du/ mnga' ris dang mdo smad gnyis phud pa'i bod khri skor bcu gsum phul/ 〈 sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen bang mdzod 〉nang / mi bza' tshang gnyis/bu bu mo gnyis/ bran g.yog pho mo gnyis/ phyugs rta bong / ra/ lug ba/mdzo bcas re re/ khang pa ka ba drug gi sa/ sa zhing hor son khal bcu gnyis bcas yod par dud chung gcig dud chung nyi shu rtsa lnga la dud chen gcig dud chen gnyis la rta mgo gcig rta mgo gnyis la brgya skor gcis/ brgya skor bcu la stong skor gcig stong skor bcu la khri skor gcig bcas rtsis par bshad pa ltar gzhir bzung na/ dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum la mi ser them dud chig 'bum sum khri dang / mi grangs bsdoms 'bor bdun 'bum brgyad khri/ sems can khag so so nas chig ① karma pa sku phreng gnyis pa/552

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad 'bum sum khri re yong dgos kyi 'dug kyang / skabs der dbus gtsang du mi grangs nyung bas khri skor bcu gsum gyi dngos yod them dud ni/(1)la stod lho'i khri skor la them dud nyis stong nyis brgya lnga bcu/(2)la stod byang gi khri skor la them dud nyis stong nyis brgya lnga bcu/(3)tshu mig khri skor la them dud sum stong brgya med bcu med gsum/(4)gur mo khri skor la them dud phyed dang brgyad brgya/(5)zha lu khri skor la them dud sum stong brgyad brgya dgu bcu go ba/nyis/ (6)shangs khri skor la them dud chig stong bzhi brgya/(7)rgyalam khri skor la them dud lnga stong dgu brgya lnga bcu/(8)phag gru khri skor la them dud nyis stong bzhi brgya sum cu so brgyad/(9)'bri gung khri skor la them dud sum stong drug brgya sum cu/ (10)tshal pa khri skor la them dud sum stong bdun brgya/(11)bya yul khri skor la them dud lnga stong dgu brgya lnga bcu/(12)yar 'brog khri skor la bdun brgya lnga bcu/(13)g.ya' bzang khri skor la sum stong /gong gsal dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum la dngos yod them dud bzhi khri nyis stong drug brgya bco lnga yod par bshad pa der them dud rer mi drug re brtsis pa'i mi grangs nyis 'bum lnga khri lnga stong drug brgya dang dgu bcu go brgyad yod pa red/du gsang sngags kyi dbang thengs gnyis pa zhu dhi bshad tshul 'dir da dung rjes su brtag dpyad bya dgos/55ni

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dus bod chol kha gsum phul ba dhi der zhing chen gcig dhi ma long tsam gyi mi grangs dang rgya khyon yod par 〈 sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen bang ma dzod 〉 kyi nang bshad/bod kyi rab byung lnga pa'i chu spre (hu pi li se chen han gyi kri yon khri lo dgu pa)spyi lo 1272lor yon rgyal rabs kyis bod sa gnas su thu po shon wu'i si tu yon hra'o h+phu'u zer ba'i srid 'dzin do dam las khungs btsugs shing /sa tshigs dang dmag don do dam babs tshugs btsugs te bod sa gnas nas khral gang 'tshams shig bsdu gi yod pa red/'gro mgon 'phags pa nas bzung tā dben blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi bar sa skya'i khri thog dgu dang / dpon chen shākya bzang po nas dbang brtson gyi bar bskyar ldabs dang bcas pa'i dpon rabs nyi shu tham pa'i ring (bod kyi rab byung bzhi pa'i shing glang spyi lo 1264lo nas bod kyi rab byung drug pa'i shing rta spyi lo 1354lo bar lo grangs 91)yon krung dbyang srid gzhung gi thad ka'i bkod 'doms 'og bod sa gnas kyi chos srid gnyis ka'i bdag po byas te bod yongs la dbang sgyur byas pa red/ de ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi sna rnams dpal 'byor thog gi zhing bdag gral rim zhig nas chab srid thog gi dbang sgyur gral rim gyi go gnas su thog mar slebs pa'i mtshon rtags shig yin pa ma zad/ sangs rgyas chos bu mnga' ris gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ sog la skya bo nas rma chu khug pa yan mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ rma chu khug pa nas mchod rten dkar po yan mdo smad rta'i chol kha/dhi khri sgor bcu la glus gcig glus bcu la zhing chem gcig tu brtsi ba yon rgyal rabs kyi lugs srol yin zhes 〈sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen bang mdzod 〉nang bshad/ 554

bod kyi chos srid zunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad lugs de chab srid dang kha bral nas rang tshugs su gnas mi thub pa'i gzhan dbang gi rang bzhin sngar las mngon gsal dod du phyin pa'i mtshon rtags shig kyang red/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa ni dus skabs de'i bod kyi mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyi spyi'i gtso bdag yin pa dang / gsham 'og la mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyi khe phan mtshon byed kyi srid 'dzin spyi khyab dpon chen zhig dang / khri dpon/ stong dpon/ rdzong dpon/ gzhis gnyer sogs rim pa mi 'dra ba'i dpon rigs dang srid 'dzin las khungs yod pa'i thog da dung de sngon chos lugs mi sna tshor med pa'i gsol dpon dang / gzims dpon/ mchod dpon/ mgron gnyer/ drung yigaphyag mdzod/ ma chen/ sgar dpon/ gdan gnyer/ khang gnyer/ chibs dpon/ 'gag pa/ a drung bcas sger gyi g.yog rigs mtho ba'i gras kyi las tshan bcu gsum yang thog mar btsugs te chos srid gnyis ka'i thog nas dbang sgyur byed thabs kyi sgrig gzhi dang ma lag cha tshang tsam zhig byung ba red/ yin na'ang bod sa gnas kyi srid 'dzin las don dbang cha chung ba'i rigs sa skya'i khri pa dang spyi khyab dpon chen nas thag gcod byed kyi yod kyang / gal che'i don gnad che rigs dang / spyi khyab dpon chen gyi go gnas bsko 'then sogs yon krung dbyang srid gzhung la snyan 'bul chog mchan zhus nas lag len bstar gyi yod pa ma zad/ dpon chen nyung shas phud mang po zhig ni yon krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bsko bzhag byas pa zhig kyang red/ gong gsal gnas tshul de'i thog nas gnad don bzhi gsal bshad byas yod pa ste/ 555

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ (1)sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi snas bod sa garnas kyi chos srid gnyis ka'i bdag po byed pa'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs de 'gro mgon 'phags pas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung ba de nas 'go tshug pa zhig yin pa/ (2)sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi sna rnams dpal 'byor thog zhing bdag gral rim gyi go gnas nas chab srid thog dbang sgyur gral rim gyi go gnas su slebs pa'i 'go tshugs pa/(3)sa skya bas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung skabs yon krung dbyang srid gzhung gi thad ka'i bkod 'doms 'og bod sa gnas kyi dbang cha bzung ba zhig yin pa ma gtogs/ rang tshugs sger btsan gyi thog nas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung ba zhig min pa/(4)sa skya ba'i chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi snas rang nyid kyi stobs shugs khyab khongs sra brtan dang gong 'phel gtong ched/ yon rgyal rabs kyi chab srid stobs shugs la rgyab rten bcol ba dang / yon rgyal rabs kyis kyang bod sa gnas la dbang sgyur byed pa'i chab srid kyi stobs shugs sra brtan gtong ched/ skabs der bod kyi spyi tshogs thog snyan grags che ba'i sa skya'i chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi sna bed spyod gtong dgos pa bcas phyogs gnyis ka'i khe phan gcig gyur gyi gnas tshul 'og sa skya bas bod kyi chos srid gnyis ka'i bdag po byed thub pa byung ba bcas red/'gro mgon 'phags pas bod kyi rab byung bzhi pa'i shing glang (hu pi li se chen han gyi kri yon khri lo dang po)spyi lo 1265lo nas lo gsum ring srid 556

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/dbang bzung zhing / de nas dpon chen shākya bzang po dpon du bskos/ gcung po rin chen rgyal mtshan rang nyid kyi tshab tu bskos te slar yang mes rgyal nang khul du phebs/ bod kyi rab byung lnga pa'i lcags rta spyi lo 1270lor/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas bod yig dbu can gyi yig gzugs la dpe byas nas 'khor yig cig gsar du bzos dhi rjes su gong ma hu pi lis 'gro mgon 'phags pa la‘‘gnam gyi 'og sa yi steng / sprul —pa'i sangs rgyas/ rgyal khams 'jags su 'jug mi/ yi ge rtsom mi/ snyan ngag gi rgyu/ 'phags pa tī shri ’’zer ba'i go gnas dang / shel dam phul/skabs der hu pi li se chen han gyis bod sa gnas yongs la sa skya ba'i chos ma gtogs chos lugs gzhan dag byed mi chog pa'i bka' phab rtsis byed skabs 'gro mgon 'phags pas gong mar zhus don/ bod sa gnas su chos lugs 'dra min sna tshogs yod pa tshang ma so so'i dad pa byed yul mi 'dra ba dang / bon po'i chos lugs phud pa'i de byings tshang ma sangs rgyas chos lugs gcig gi khongs su gtogs pa la khyad par med cing / so so'i dad mos la rang dbang ma byung na gong ma khyed rang gi chab srid dang snyan grags gnyis kar gnod pa ma zad/ nged sa skya ba'i chos lugs la yang phan thogs mi 'dug pas/ chos lugs grub mtha' mi 'dra ba rnams rang rang so so'i dad mos la rang dbang yod pa byed dgos zhes bsam 'char bton pa de gong ma hu pi li'i sems la ha cang babs po byung ste/bod sa gnas kyi chos lugs khagatshang ma so so'i chos lugs dar spel dhi deng sang gi sog yig ni thog mar sa skya paṇa gyis gsar bzos gnang rjes/ ngase bshes chos kyi 'od zer gyis cha tshang bar byas pa zhigayen zer srol yod/pa557
