dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/btang nas gong ma sku tshe ring po yong ba'i smon lam 'debs dgos zer ba'i bka' phab pa red/ chos lugs grub mtha' mi 'dra ba khag gi dad mos rang dbang yod pa ni/ chos lugs grub mtha' mi 'dra ba khag mthun sgril yong ba'i rmang gzhi yin pa ma zad// mi rigs khag gi phyi nang gnyis kar phan tshun mthun sgril yong ba'i rmang gzhi'ang yin par brten/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gzigs rgyang ring ba'i dgongs 'char des yon rgyal rabs kyi chab srid dang snyan grags/ bod sog mi rigs bar dang bod sa gnas kyi mi rigs nang khul bar gyi mthun sgril dang bod sa gnas bde 'jags su gnas pa bcas la phan thogs chen po byung yod ces bod kyi lo rgyus mkhas pa mang pos 'gro mgon 'phags par bstod bsngags byas yod pa red/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa mes rgyal nang khul du thengs gnyis phebs rjes/ khong dang yum mi gcig pa'i gcung po rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung lnga pa'i me yos (yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma hu pi li se chen han gyi kri yon khri lo bzhi pa)spyi lo 1267lo nas lo bcu gsum ring 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i khri tshab byas shing / de nas 'gro mgon 'phags pa sku 'das tshab tu hu pi li se chen han gyi mchod gnas su gdan drangs pa ltar mes rgyal nang khul du song /de nas 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gcung po phyag na'i bu dharma pā la ra k+shi ta zer bas/ rab byung lnga pa'i lcags 'brug (yon hri tsu'u hu pi li se chen han gyi kri yon khri lo bcu bdun pa)spyi lo 1280lo nas lo brgyad ring srid dbang bzung / 'dis srid dbang bzung nas lo gcig song rjes 'bri 558

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad gung du spyan snga bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo rje 'das nas de'i tshab tu rin po che grags pa ye shes bskos shing / khong gis rang nyid kyi dbon po snag tsha grags sle pa sa skya'i bla ma ye shes rin chen la phul/ de la sa skya bas 'bri gung gi gdan sar bsko rtsis byas skabs bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo rje'i gcung rgya bo grags pa rin chen gyis bgrongs/ de'i don du sa skya bas 'bri gung par kha mchu bslangs rtsis byas kyang / gcung rgya bo grags pa rin chen gyi rgyab tu 'bri gung pa yongs rdzogs langs par brten sa skya ba dang 'bri gung pa gnyis 'khrugs pa'i 'go de nas tshugs te/ sa skya bdag chen dharma pā la ra k+shi tas srid dbang bzung nas lo lnga la slebs pa/ rab byung lnga pa'i shing bya (yon hri tsu'u hu pi li se chen han gyi kri yon khri lo nyer gnyis pa)spyi lo 1285lor 'bri gung sgom pa kun rdor rin chen du gyis stod hor gyi rgyal po hu la'idzohu'i sog dmag khri dgu lhag tsam bod du khrid yong ste sa skyar dmag drangs/du de nas sa skya'i gdung rgyud khongs min pa'i 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung lnga pa'i me phag (yon hri tsu'u hu pi li se chen han gyi kri yon khri lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa)spyi lo 1287lo nas bzung lo brgyad ring srid dbang bzung / 'dis srid dbang bzung nas lo bzhi la slebs skabs sa skya'i dpon chen ang len gyis hu pi li se chen han gyi bu thi mu bho khas kyi dmag dpung bod du khrid yong ste gtsang dmag dang mnyam du 'bri gung par dmag drangs/ 'bri gung mthil gyi lha khang chen mo mer ① bod kyi lo rgyus thog stod hor gyi dmag zer ba de yin/() 'ga' zhig gis 'bri gung pas sa skyar dmag drangs skabs rogs ram byed mkhan gyi sos dmag de hu la'i hu'i dmag dpung yin mi srid zer ba'ang 'dug pas brtag 559

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsregs btang / grwa pa dang mi skya bsdoms pa'i mi grangs chig khri lhag tsam bsad/ de sngon 'bri gung pa'i mchod gzhis khongs yin pa'i du sbyar/dgas po/ kong po/ e/ gnyal/ lo ro/ lho kha/ brag dkar/ yar rgyab/ mon bcas sa skya bas phrogs/ de la bod kyi lo rgyus thog 'bri gung gling log zer/ de nas bzung dbus gtsang gnyis kyi bod rigs nang khul bar 'gal zla chen po chags pa'i 'go tshugs/ de'i rtsa ba thug sa ni/chos lugs thog sa skya ba dang / 'bri gung pa gnyis chos brgyud tha dad yin pa'i thog gtsang dang stod khul ni sa skya ba'i chos lugs kyi stobs shugs khyab khongs dang mchod gzhis yin pa dang / dbus dang dgas po/kong po sogs gong du 'khod pa'i sa gnas rnams 'bri gung pa'i chos lugs kyi stobs shugs khyab khongs dang mchod gzhis yin cing / sa skya bas bsten sa'i sbyin bdag ni hu pi li se chen han yin pa dang / 'bri gung pa'i bsten sa'i sbyin bdag ni rgyal po go dan gyi bu hu la'i hu yin pa bcas la brten/ sa 'bri gnyis mchod gzhis mi ser 'phrog res kyi 'thab rtsod byung skabs phyogs gnyis kas so so'i chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi dar cha brdzun ma khyer nas so so'i sbyin bdag sog po'i dmag dpung bod du khrid yong ste dbus gtsang gnyis bar dmag 'khrug bslangs nas mi rigs nang khul bar mi mthun pa'i 'gal zla bzos pa ma zad/ bod dbus gtsang gnyis kyi bod rigs nang khul dang / sog po'i mi rigs bar du yang 'gal zla bzos pa red/ bod kyi lo rgyus kyi yig cha mang po'i dhi rgyal po go dan gyi bu hu la'i hus 'bri gung par sprad pa/ 560

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/nang sa 'bri gnyis bar dmag 'khrug byung ba de nas bzung dbus gtsang gnyis bya rog dang 'ug pa'i spyod tshul bzung zhes 'khod yod pa de ni/ sa 'bri gnyis kyi dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul dmag brgyab pa des dbus gtsang gnyis kyi bod rigs nang khul 'gal zla bzos pa red ces skad cha gnad 'dus po'i sgo nas chod sdom bzhag pa zhig red/ chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi sna tshos so so'i chos lugs kyi stobs shugs khyab khongs la brten nas dpal 'byor dang dbang sgyur gyi stobs shugs khyab khongs rgya skyed byas pa yin stabs nang khul dpal 'byor dang dbang sgyur gyi stobs shugs khyab khongasatsha'aphrog res byed skabs chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi dar cha khyer ba'i bya thabs bzung nas mi rigs nang khul du 'gal zla bzo thabs dang dmag 'khrug slong thabs byed kyi yod pa red/ 'og tu bshad rgyu yin pa'i dus skabs so so'i chos lugs khag bar gyi dmag 'khrugartede tsho yang 'gal ba'i gtso bo mi 'dra ba dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba tsam ma gtogs ngo bo ni gong du bshad ba ltar so so'i dpal 'byor khe phan dang srid dbang 'phrog pa'i ched du chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi dar cha bed spyod byas pa gcig mtshungs red/ der brten dus skabs so so'i 'gal ba'i gtso bo bzhir bzung nas skabs 'dir chos lugs de dang de'i bar gyi dmag 'khrug zer ba'i ming btags pa yin/de nas bdag chen bzang po dpal gyis rab byung lnga pa'i me rta (yon khreng tsung thi'i mur kren gyi yon kron khri lo bcu pa)spyi lo 1306lo nas lo bcu dgu'i ring srid dbang bzung zhing / yon khreng tsung thi'i mur kren gyis 561

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rang gi gcung mo mun rda gan mna' mar sprad/ de la bu bsod nams bzang po zer ba zhig byung zhing / bu der pa'i len dbang zer ba'i go gnas sprad/ bdag chen bzang po dpal la btsun mo bdun dang / de tshor bu phrug mang po yod rkyen bzang po dpal 'das rjes/ de'i btsun mo gnyis pa ma gcig ngang mo'i bu ti shri kun dga' blo gros kyis rang gi spun mched gcung po tshor bla brang bzhi so sor bgos te sprad/ yo3mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa spun mched la shel gyi dam kha dang gzhi thog bla brang /phyiti shri kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas spun mched la gser gyi dam kha dang lha khang bla brang / ①'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan spun mched la shel gyi dam kha dang rin chen sgang bla brang / rgyadabang kun dga' legs pa ming sring gnyis la gser gyi dam kha dang dus mchod bla brang sprad pa rnams mi ring bar phan tshun mthun po ma byung ba'i 'go tshugs/de nas mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pas/ rab byung lnga pa'i shing glang (yon tha'i ting ye sun the'i mur gyi tha'i ting khri lo gnyis pa)spyi lo 1325lo nas lo bco brgyad ring srid dbang bzung / 'di la yon ye sun the'i mur gyis bkwan ting gi shri zer ba'i go gnas dang shel dam sprad/de nas 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung drug pa'i chu lug (yon hu'i tsung thug the'i mur gyi kri kreng khri lo gsum pa)spyi lo 1343lo nas lo gsum ring srid dbang bzung / 'di la yon gong ma thug the'i mur gyis tā dben gau shri zer ba'i go gnas dang shel gyi dam kha sprad/de nas bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung drug pa'i 562

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wagred shing bya (yon hu'i tsung thug the'i mur gyi kri kreng khri lo gsum pa)spyi lo 1345lo nas lo gsum ring srid dbang bzung / 'di la yon gong ma thug the'i mur gyis gdan 'dren snga rjes thengs bzhi tsam btang yang dgongs zhu byas te ma phebs/de nas tā dben blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung drug pa'i me phag (yon hu'i tsung thug the'i mur gyi kri kreng khri lo bdun pa)spyi lo 1347lo nas lo gsum ring srid dbang bzung zhing / srid dbang bzung ba'i lo dang por yon gong ma tho bkan the'i mur gyis tho ling ta'i dru tā dben gau shri zer ba'i go gnas dang shel dam bcas sprad/(2)phag mo gru pas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung ba dang / dge lugs pa'i chos lugs gsar du dar spel byung ba'i skor/ bod kyi rab byung drug pa'i sa glang spyi lo 1349lor/ sa skya'i bla brang khag bzhi po nang khul mi mthun pa'i 'gal ba cher song ste/ dpon chen dbang phyug brtson 'grus kyis 'go gtso byas pa'i lha khang bla brang gi phyogs khag gcig dang / dpon chen rgyal ba bzang pos 'go gtso byas pa'i bla brang gzhan gsum gyi phyogs khag bcas khag gnyis su gyes nas dpon chen rgyal ba bzang pos 'go gtso byas pa'i phyogs khag pham nas sa skya'i gdung brgyud spun mched phan tshun gsod res dang btson 'jug byas sogs byung rkyen/ skabs der phag gru'i khri dpon gyi las 'gan 'dzin 363

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mkhan tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis thog mar g.ya' bzang pa dang tshal pa phyogs gtogs nang nas stobs shugs che shos 'bri gung pa gtor zhing / de nas rim bzhin g.ya' bzang pa dang tshal pa tshar bcad/ de nas dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po'i phyogs su langs nas/ skabs der sa skyar dbang shugs che ba'i dpon chen dbang phyug brtson 'grus kyi phyogs khag la dmag drangs te sa skya'i srid dbang phag mo gru pa'i lag tu shor/dhide nas tā si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung drug pa'i sa glang (yon hu'i tsung thug the'i mur gyi kri kreng khri lo dgu pa)spyi lo 1349lo nas lo bcu drug ring srid dbang bzung / 'dis srid dbang bzung nas lo lnga la slebs pa/ rab byung drug pa'i shing rta (yon hu'i tsung thug tho kan the'i mur gyi kri kreng khri lo bcu gsum pa)spyi lo 1353lor brag dkar ba shes rab bkra shis la seng ge'i pags pa sder mo bzhi cha tshang yod pa sogs kyi 'bul ba bskur te pe cin la yon gong ma tho bkan the'i mur sar 'tshams 'dri zhu bar btang zhing / gong mas ta'i si tu'i go gnas dang mi rabs nas mi rabs bar bod sa gnas kyi dbang cha yongs rdzogs brgyud 'dzin byed chog pa'i bka' shog tham ka bcas sprad/ de nas rim bzhin gzhis ka rtse'i rdzong dang / sne'u rdzong / gong dkar rdzong / brag dkar rdzong / 'phyongs rgyas stag rtse rdzong / gnyal lhun rtse rdzong / rong rin spungs rdzong / lcags rtse gri gu rdzong / 'ol kha stag rtse rdzong sogs rdzong chen bcu gsum brtsigs nas lo gsum re'i mtshams brje len byas te rdzong dpon 'gro ba'i lam dhi 'di skor zhib cha ṭ+wāṃtā si'i bka' chems 〉nang gsal/ 564

bod kyi chos srid zunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad lugs btsugs/ khrims yig zhal lce bco lnga zer ba gtan 'bebs byas/dhiphag gru bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs mi snas bod sa gnas yongs la dbang sgyur byas pa dang dus mtshungs/ bod kyi rab byung drug pa'i sa spre spyi lo 1368lor/ ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma tha'i tsu'u kru'u yon krang gis zhing pa'i gyen langs kyi rgyal kha'i 'bras bu phrogs te ming rgyal rabs btsugs rjes/ rab byung drug pa'i chu byi (ming tha'i tsu'u kru'u yon krang gi hung wu khri lo lnga pa)spyi lo 1372lor bod sa gnas su dbu/ sa gtsang kri ho'i si zer ba'i bkod 'doms pu'u btsugs shing / phag gru'i srid 'dzin mi thog rim par go gnas dang dbang cha sprad de phag gru bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs mi snas dbang sgyur byas pa'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs la shugs snon rgyab pa ma zad/ chos lugs tshogs pa gzhan dag la yang 'dra mnyam mthun sgril gyi srid jus bzung / ming gong ma srid gzhung gis dbus gtsang kri ho'i si btsugs pa'i lo der karma zhwa nag gi skye phreng gsum pa rol pa'i rdo rjes thengs dang po nan cin la 'tshams 'dri'i mi sna btang nas ming tha'i tsu'u kru'u yon krang la ming rgyal rabs gsar du btsugs pa'i rten 'brel zhus pa dang / ming rgyal rabs rim pas karma pa skye phreng rim byung dang 'brel ba dam zab byas te/ gu shri dang / hran hā wang / tā hu) 1 ci dpal bo stag gi zhal rtse/ 2 chi ldar ma wa yi zhal lce/ 3 ri sne mo las 'dzin gyi zhal lce/ 4d+ku zhu bzhes bden rdzun gyi zhal rtse/ 5 ci bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal lce/ (‘ nag can khrag sbyor gyi zhal lce/ 7 ci dran 'dzin chad las kyi zhal rtse/ 8 ༄ hor 'dra za rkang gi zhal lce/9 ༄ bsad pa stong gi zhal lce/ 10 ci rmas pa khrag gi zhal rtse/ 11 bsnyon ham mna' dag bi zhal lce/ 12 d+ku brkus pa 'jal gyi zhal lce/ 13 nye 'brel 'bral bsdums kyi zhal lce/ 14 ༄ byi byas byi rin kyi zhal lce/ 15 chi nam phar tshur gyi zhal rtse bcas red/ 565

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/h+pho h+pha wang sogs kyi go gnas sprad pa nas bzung bod sa gnas su karma bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs mi sna'i stobs shugs rim bzhin che ru phyin pa red/de nas 'jam dbyangs gu shri shākya rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung drug pa'i shing sbrul (yon hu'i tsung thug the'i mur gyi kri kreng khri lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa)spyi lo 1365lo nas lo dgu'i bar srid dbang bzung / 'dis srid dbang bzung ba'i lo dgu pa rab byung drug pa'i chu byi spyi lo 1373lor ming dzo'i tsu'u kru'u yon krang gis ta'i si tu/ ching gu'i gung / bkan ting gu shri zer ba'i go gnas dang / bod kyi dbang cha yongs rdzogs shes su bcug pa'i 'ja' sa/ g.yang kri'i dam ka bcas sprad/de nas spyan snga grags pa byang chub kyis rab byung drug pa'i chu glang (ming tha'i tsu'u kru'u yon krang gi hong wu khri lo drug pa)spyi lo 1372lo nas lo ngo brgyad ring srid dbang bzung /de nas spyan snga bsod nams grags pas rab byung drug pa'i lcags bya (ming tha'i tsu'u kru'u yon krang gi hong wu khri lo bcu bzhi pa)spyi lo 1381lo nas lo lnga'i ring srid dbang bzung / de nas dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung drug pa'i shing glang (ming tha'i tsu'u kru'u yon krang gi hong wu khri lo bco brgyad pa)spyi lo 1385lo nas lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun ring srid dbang bzung / 'dis srid dbang bzung nas lo bzhi la slebs pa rab byung bdun pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo 1388lor dbang gi go gnas dang gser tham sprad/ lo nyi shu rtsa lngar 566

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad slebs pa rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang spyi lo 1409lor tā ming gong ma (hre tsu'u kru'u tis)yung los kyis hran h+pha wang zer ba'i go gnas dang shel tham sprad/ lo der rje tsong kha pas dga' ldan dgon pa btab nas gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas dge lugs pa'i chos lugs byung / skabs der dgon pa 'debs pa'i 'gro song gtong mkhan dang / mchod gzhis 'bul mkhan gyi spyin bdag ni sne gdong dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dang /gzhis ka brag dkar ba'i nang so rin chen lhun po dang nang so rgya bo spun mched gnyis/ rgya ma khri dpon zla ba bcas yin zhing / khong tshos mal dro klung shod khul nas mchod gzhis mi nyung ba phul/ rje tsong kha par dbus gtsang mnga' ris khams khul mtsho sngon bcas nas slob ma mang du byung ba de tshos rang rang so so'i pha yul du log rjes dgon pa mang du btab/ de dag gi nang nas dar rgyas che shos ni gdan sa gsum ste se ra/ 'bras spungs/ dga' ldan gsum dang / bkra shis lhun po bcas yin/dga' ldan dgon pa btab nas lo brgyad song ba/ rab byung bdun pa'i me spre (tā ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ming greng tsu'u kru'u tis kyi yung lo bcu bzhi pa)spyi lo 1416lor tsong kha pa'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan gyis 'bras spungs dgon pa btab/ de'i 'gro song gtong mkhan dang mchod gzhis mi ser 'bul mkhan gyi sbyin bdag ni skabs de'i sne'u rdzong dpon nam mkha' bzang po yin/ 'bras spungs dgon pa btab nas lo ngo bzhi la slebs pa rab byung bdun pa'i sa phag (tā ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ming hreng tsu'u kru'u tis kyi yung 567

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/los khri lo bcu bdun pa)spyi lo 1419lor/ rje tsong kha pa'i slob ma byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes kyis se ra dgon pa btab/ de'i 'gro song gtong mkhan dang mchod gzhis 'bul mkhan gyi sbyin bdag ni sne'u rdzong dpon nam mkha' bzang po dang de'i bu nam mkha' dpal 'byor gnyis yin/se ra dgon pa btab nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad song ba rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos (ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ming dbyi tsung kru'u chis kren gyi kreng thung khri lo bcu gnyis pa)spyi lo 1447lor rje tsong kha pa'i slob ma dge 'dun grub (tā la'i bla ma sku phreng dang po)kyis bkra shis lhun po'i dgon pa btab/ de'i 'gro song gtong mkhan dang mchod gzhis 'bul mkhan gyi sbyin bdag ni skabs de'i gzhis ka rtse'i rdzong dpon 'phyongs rgyas pa hor dpal 'byor bzang po yin/ de nas bzung dge lugs pa'i chos lugs de sngar las lhag pa'i gong 'phel dang stobs shugs che ru song ste/ karma bka' brgyud sogs bka' brgyud chos lugs mang che ba dang 'gran zlar langs pa'i go gnas bzung thub pa byung ba red/(3)phag mo gru pa'i dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul gyi dmag 'khrug skor/phag gru sde srid dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan 'das pa'i rjes su dbang grags pa 'byung gnas kyis rab byung bdun pa'i chu byi (ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ming zhon tsung zhon te khri lo bdun pa)spyi lo 1432lo nas lo bcu gsum 568

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad ring srid dbang bzung / 'dis srid dbang bzung nas lo gnyis song mtshams spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'das rjes rang nyid kyi pha che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis sne gdong gi srid dbang 'phrog rgyu'i thabs ngan mang po brtsams par brten/ pha bu gnyis bar zing 'khrug byung ste yun ring bar thag ma chod pa 'di la bod kyi lo rgyus thog stag lo'i sde gzar chen mo zer zhing / phag mo gru pa nang zhig gi lo zhes kyang zer/ skabs 'di'i nang 'khrug byung ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ blon po'i gras yin pa'i rin spungs pa nor bu bzang pos gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse sogs gtsang khul gyi rdzong gzhis 'ga' zhig blangs shing / de nas bzung phag mo gru pa'i srid dbang nyams rgud du 'gro ba'i 'go tshugs/da'adis srid dbang bzung nas lo dgu song ba rab byung bdun pa'i lcags spre spyi lo 1440lor ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma kreng thung gis gser yig pa mang po mngags te dbang gi go gnas dang 'ja' sa sprad/ de nas bzung dbang grags pa 'byung gnas zer/de nas dbang kun dga' legs pas rab byung bdun pa'i sa 'brug (ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ming dbying cung kru'u cis kren gyi kreng thung khri lo bcu dhi skabs 'dir 〈 rgyal rabs 'phrul gyi lde mig 〉las phag gru'i srid dbang bzung mkhan med par lo gsum bar stong lus par bshad cing / losgyus 'ga' zhig nang bar stong 'dir che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis srid dbang bzung bar bshad pa'i bshad tshul gnyis 'dug kyang / bar khams ri bo che chos rje mi g.yo mgon po'i slob ma dpon tshang tshe dbang rgyal gyis rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos spyi lo 1447lor brtsams pa'i 〈lho rong chos 'byung thub bstan gsal byed 〉kyi nang bshad don/ dbang grags pa 'byung gnas dang che sa sangs rgyas mtshan ma mthun pa byung rjes che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gnas skabs lo shas ring yar rgyab tu zur 'bud dang / de nas rtsed thang gi nang sor bskos pa tsam las srid dbang bzung med par bshad pa de khungs dag pa 'dug 569

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsum pa)spyi lo 1448lo nas lo bzhi'i ring srid dbang bzung / tā ming gong ma dbying tsung kreng thung gis hran h+pha wang gi go gnas sprad/ 'dis srid dbang skyong stangs legs po ma byung ba'i dbang gis khyim tshang nang mthun po ma byung ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas rin spungs rdzong dpon nor bu bzang po pha bu rnams kyis gtsang khul gyi dbang cha phal che ba phag mo gru pa'i lag nas blangs/'di skabs rin spungs nor bu bzang po'i bu gnyis pa kun bzang pa dang de'i bu chung ba don yod rdo rje/ bu gsum pa don grub rdo rje/ bu bzhi pa mtsho skyes rdo rje bcas kyis rim bzhin gtsang khul gyi rdzong gzhis mang rme blangs par brten/ rin spungs pa dang / phag mo gru pa'i srid dbang 'dzin mkhan bar dmag 'khrug yang yang byung ba red/(4)rin spungs pa dang dge lugs pa'i bar gyi dmag 'khrug skor/de nas spyan snga ngag gi dbang pos rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags glang (tā ming gong ma shan tsung kru'u can hring gi khreng h+pha khri lo bcu bdun pa)spyi lo 1481lo nas lo ngo bcu gcig ring srid dbang bzung zhing / yun ring ma song bar gsham 'og gi dpon rigs phan tshun mi mthun pa'i nang 'khrug thengs 'ga' zhig byung ba'i thog spyan snga ngag gi dbang po yang rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags phag spyi lo 1401lor 'das nas lo ngo gnyis song ba chu glang (tā ming gong ma sha'o tsung kru'u yo'u thang gi hung kri khri lo lnga pa )spyi 570

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabathadapa/ —da wa—lo 1493lor spyan snga ngag gi dbang po la wang gi go gnas dang dngos skyes gnang ba rnams gzhi nas bod du 'byor/ spyan snga ngag gi dbang po gshegs skabs gdung rgyud sras ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa dgung lo bzhi las phebs med pa'i sku na phra bar brten sku na ma son bar gnas skabs ring srid 'dzin dpon tshab tu zhwa dmar sku phreng bzhi pa chos grags ye shes dang / rin spungs nor bu bzang po'i bu mtsho skyes rdo rje gnyis bskos/ de nas lo brgyad la slebs pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa rta spyi lo 1498lor zhwa dmar rin po ches bka' bkod gnang ba ltar/ rin spungs nor bu bzang po'i bu kun bzang pa dang don yod rdo rje gnyis kyis mi grangs khri gcig lhag tsam yod pa'i gtsang dmag dbus phyogs su drangs te dge lugs pa'i sbyin bdag sne'u rdzong dpon ngag dbang bsod nams lhun po dang ngag dbang bsod nams rnam rgyal gnyis skyor mo lung du phud/lha sa smon lam chen mor se 'bras dge gsum gyi dge 'dun rnams yong mi chog pa bzos nas lo nyi shu ring de mur gnas/de nas dbang ngag dbang bkra shis grags pas rab byung brgyad pa'i sa lug (ming sha'o tsung kru'u yo'u thang hung kri khri lo bcu gnyis pa)spyi lo 1499lo nas srid dbang bzung zhing rab byung brgyad pa'i chu phag (ming sha'o tsung kru'u yo'u thang gi hung kri khri lo bcu drug pa)spyi lo 1503lor slar yang karma zhwa nag pa chos grags rgya mtshos bkod pa byas pa ltar rin spungs don yod rdo rjes se 'bras dge gsum gyi kha gnon du lha sa'i shar phyogs sa nag zer bar

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dgon gsar thub bstan chos 'khor btab/①dbang ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa 'dis srid dbang bzung nas lo bcu song ba chu spre spyi lo 1512lor tā ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ming u tsung kru'u ha'o kren gyis dbang gi go gnas sprad pa de nas bzung dbang shugs che ru song ste rab byung dgu pa'i me byi spyi lo 1516lo nas rin spungs pa'i dbang shugs nyams shing gtsang phyogs kyi sa cha tsam la dbang bsgyur/ rab byung dgu pa'i sa stag spyi lo 1518lo nas slar yang se 'bras dge gsum gyis lha sar smon lam tshogs par yong rgyu bskyar gso byas/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos lo ltar smon lam gyi tshogs dbu gnang zhing / 'bras spungs su yod pa'i sne gdong pa'i 'tsher shag rdo khang sngon mo zer ba de tā la'i sam dge 'dun rgya mtshor phul rjes khang pa der ming dga' ldan pho brang zhesu btags pa'i rjes su tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung rjes khang pa de'i ming srid gzhung gi ming du bsgyur ba yin/de nas rab byung dgu pa'i me khyi (ming hri tsung kru'u ha'o tshung cwa ching khri lo lnga pa)spyi lo 1526lor 'bri gung sgom pa dhi kun dga' rin chen gyis kong po dang zho kha'i dmag dpung bskul nas 'bri gung khul du yod pa'i dga' ldan dgon pa'i mchod gzhis rnams phrogs par brten/ 'bri gung pa dang dge lugs pa'i bar dmag 'khrug byung / dge lugs pa'i rgyab rten ni sde pa skyid shod pa red/du yongs grags su karma dgon gsar zer/② 'bri gung gi dpon chen gyi spyi ming /572

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad rab byung dgu pa'i me bya (ming hri tsung kru'u ha'o tshung tsā ching khri lo bcu drug pa)spyi lo 1537lor/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho chos 'khor rgyal du bzhugs skabs 'bri gung pa'i dmag gis 'ol kha rgyud du zing 'khrug bslangs thog 'bri gung dang mal dro rgyud du yod pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa che chung bsdoms bco brgyad tsam chos lugs dang zhwa stabs bsgyur/ skabs der lo mang ring bka' brgyud chos lugs dar rgyas che ba'i sa gnas su dge lugs pa'i grwa pa rnams zhwa mo phyi nang gnyis byas pa gyon dgos pa byung / (5〉gtsang pa the srid dang dge lugs gnyis bar gyi dmag 'khrug skor/ rab byung dgu pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1564lor/ dbang bkra shis grags par tā ming gong ma hri tsung cwa ching gis hran h+pha wang dang bkan ting tā gi shri h+pha wang gi go gnas sprad/ skabs der bod sa gnas su yar skur gtsang gsum zhes pa lho kha stod rgyud du sde pa yar rgyab pa stobs shugs che/lho kha smad dang / dgas po/ kong po/ gnyal/ lo ro/ sbyar bcas kyi sa khul du sde pa sku rab pa stobs shugs che/ gtsang khul du gtsang pa sde srid dbang shugs che ba bcas tshang ma bka' brgyud pa'i sbyin bdag yin/ de min gyi sa khul nas cung zad stobs che ba sde pa lha rgya ri ba dang lha sa chu shul nas mal dro bar gyi sa khul der stobs shugs che ba sde pa skyid shod pa gnyis yin cing / de gnyis ni dge lugs pa'i sbyin bdag yin pa bcas 573

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la brten sde pa zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rje dang 'bri gung pa gnyis mnyam 'brel byas te dge lugs pa'i stobs shugs med pa bzo ched/ sngon la dge lugs par dpal 'byor thog nas rgyab skyor byed mkhan sde pa skyid shod pa gtor dgos bsams nas rab byung dgu pa'i shing sbrul (ming hron tsung kru'u yi cun dban glis khri lo so gsum pa)spyi lo 1605lor gtsang dmag dang zho dkar nag gnyis kyi dmag bskul nas skabs de'i dge lugs pa'i sbyin bdag sde pa skyid shod pa gtor te dpon dmag mang po bsad/ de'i rjes su sde pa yar rgyab pa bdud 'dul grags pa dang gtsang pa sde srid gnyis gnyen tshan yin kyang ⑦ nang khul ma mthun par gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis rab byung bcu pa'i lcags khyi (ming hren tsung kru'u yi cun dban glis khri lo so brgyad pa)spyi lo 1610lor yar rgyab par dmag drangs te bcom/ sde pa yar rgyab pa bdud 'dul grags pa dbang cha shor nas lto skal phran bu sprad de zur 'jog byas/ slar yang rab byung bcu pa'i chu byi spyi lo 1612lo dang / de'i phyi lo gnyis kar gtsang pa rgyal po phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi dmag gis 'phan po dang gzhis ka sne'u sogs blangs te bod yongs la dbang sgyur byas/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid ngos 'dzin mi chog pa bzos/ de'i lan du dge lugs pa'i sbyin bdag skyid shod sde pa bsod nams rnam rgyal gyis khal kha cho khur dpon po spun mched gnyis la rtse po tā lar yod pa'i 'phags pa lo kai sha re'i sku de brngan par sprad nas dge lugs pa'i don du gtsang par dmag dhi gtsang phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi chung ma ni yar rgyab pa'i bu mo yin pa dang / gcung po phun tshogs rig 'dzin gyi mna' ma yang yar rgyab pa'i bu mo red/574

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/rgyab dgos smras par brten/ rab byung bcu pa'i me sbrul (ming hren tsung kru'u yi cun dban glis khri lo zhe lnga pa)spyi lo 1617lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa 'khrungs pa'i lo der khal kha cho khur dpon po'i dmag dpung mi grangs sum stong lhag tsam dbus su 'byor nas dbus dmag dang mnyam du gtsang pa rgyal por phar rgol byas/ de'i phyi lo bod zla bdun pa'i nang gtsang pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi dmag dpung chig khri lhag tsam stod lung brgyud dbus su yong nas rgol lan sprad de/ se 'bras gnyis dmag gis gtor zhing / rgyab ri gnyis la skya ser bsdoms pa'i mi grangs lnga stong lhag tsam bsad/ paṇa chen er te ni sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan yang stod mnga' ris su yul byol du phebs dgos pa byung zhing / se 'bras gnyis kyi grwa pa tshang ma yul thon nas mtsho sngon du bros 'gro rtsis kyis stag lung du 'byor mtshams stag lung khri pa zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis se 'bras grwa pa rnams zla ba bzhi lhag tsam ring 'tsho ba'i rogs ram byas te mtsho sngon du bro sa su ma bcug par gtsang pa rgyal por se 'bras grwa pa rnams so so'i dgon par rang 'jags bsdad chog pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa ltar gtsang pas khas len byas/ de'i drin lan du se 'bras nga/ge gsum gyis lha sa smon lam gi ja ro tshang ma stag lung par sprod rgyu dang / stag lung dgon pa'i grwa grangs yod tshad la lha sa smon lam gyi 'gyed skal sprod rgyu byas/dbus sog gnyis kyi dmag pham par brten/ sog dmag rang yul du log cing / se 'bras gnyis nas gtsang pa rgyal por chings dngul 'bor chen sprod dgos stabs/ slar yang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i phyab mdzod 5 75

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsod nams rab brtan gyis gtsang par rgol lan sprod ched gtsang pa sde srid sar song nas/ nga tshos 'khor rgyal gyi dgon par tā la'i bla ma sku gong ma'i sku chas rnams len par 'gro gi yin pas zla ba kha shas ring dgongs pa gnang rogs zhus pa ltar dgongs khrol byung ba dang stabs bstun/ mal dro brgyud chos 'khor rgyal gyi dgon par 'gro ba'i khul byas te kong po dang / nags shod la lam byas nas mtsho sngon du song zhing /skabs der mtsho sngon gyi dpon po gu ru hong tha'i ji dang / blo bzang bstan 'dzin spun mched gnyis dmag shugs chen po yod pas kho gnyis la dge lugs pa'i don du dmag rogs zhus/ de'i shul du rab byung bcu pa'i lcags spre spyi lo 1620lor gtsang pa rgyal po phun tshogs rnam rgyal 'brum nad kyis grongs shing / de'i bu karma bstan skyong dbang pos rab byung bcu pa'i lcags bya (ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma ming khro)spyi lo 1621lor srid dbang bzung / gzhis ka bsam grub rtse sogs gnad 'gag che ba'i rdzong chen bcu gsum tsam ma gtogs/ de min sa btsan po yod pa'i rdzong phran chung ba rnams rjes su dus zing langs pa'i cha rkyen du gyur dogs nas mi dgos pa byas te shul med bzos/ sngar yod phag mo gru pa dang tshal pa sde srid sogs kyi khrims yig la gzhir bzung nas khrims yig zhal lce bco lnga thog kla klo mtha' 'khob kyi zhal lce bsnan pas bcu drug tu gtan 'bebs byas shing / yongs grags su gtan tshigs mkhar ru zer ba'i mkhar 'bo'i tshad gzhi gcig gyur bzos/ lo der phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan dang / sog po lha btsun chung ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin 576

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/gnyis kyis sog po'i rta dmag mi grangs nyis stong lhag tsam khrid nas bod dbus gtsang du yong ste dbus kyi sde pa skyid shod pa'i dmag dpung dang mnyam 'brel gyis gtsang pa rgyal por rgol lan sprad rjes gtsang dmag pham nas gtsang dmag yongs rdzogs rkyang thang sgang dang / lcags po rir bros pa rnams chu bkag btang / de mtshams sog po'i rta dmag gtsang dmag gi steng du rgyugs nas mi stong phrag mang po bsad/ slar yang sos po'i rta dmag thengs gnyis pa rgyug grabs yod pa'i skabs der/ paṇa sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / dga' ldan khri pa dkon mchog chos 'phel/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal bcas nas gtsang sog gnyis bar chings 'grigs gnang thog dga' ldan pho brang gi bla brang la lha sa dngo rags man chad kyi mchod gzhis bdag dbang yod pa dang / phyag mdzod bso da nams rab brtan 'bras spungs pho brang du sdod chog pa/ se 'bras dge gsum gyi mchod gzhis sngar gtsang pas phrogs pa rnams rang 'jags/ bde chen gsang sngags mkhar sogs dbus gtsang gnyis kyi dge lugs dgon pa chos lugs bsgyur ba rnams bskyar gso/sde pa skyid shod par 'phan po mkhar rtse rdzong sprod rgyu/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bzhi pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin byed chog pa bcas kyi don tshan bkod pa rnams kyi nang nas don tshan gzhan dag tshang ma gtsang pas khas len byas kyang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bzhi pa'i yang srid rtsad gcod byed rgyu skabs der khas len ma byas pa red/dhi de dus gtsang pa rgyal pos tā la'i bla ma sku 9kye skabs der tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa dgung lo lnga la slebs yod/577

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i skye srid ngos 'dzin byed rgyu khas ma blangs pa de ni/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i skye srid ngos 'dzin byed du bcug na 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi dpal 'obyor stobs shugs rgyas te/ karma pa zhwa dmar nag gi chos lugs stobs shugs la gnod skyon yong rgyu dang / mthar sde pa dga' ldan pho brang pa de chab srid thad nas dbang shugs che ru song ste gtsang pa rgyal po kho rang gi mgo thog tu bzhon yong snyam pa'i dogs 'char yod pa'i dbang gis red/(6)gu thi han gyis gtsang pa sde srid kyi srid dbang rtsa gtor btang nas de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung btsugs pa'i skor dang karma bka' brgyud chos lugs kyis tshur rgol byung ba lhing 'jags btang ba'i skor/skabs der gtsang pa rgyal po pham nyes byung bar brten/ rang nyid la chab srid thog stobs shugs che ba'i rgyab rten zhig btsal te dge lugs par rgol lan slog rgyu'i re ba byed bzhin yod pa red/ 'on kyang de skabs mes rgyal nang khul du de sngon rab byung dgu pa'i sa sbrul (ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma u tsung kru'u ha'o zhis kreng tes khri lo bzhi pa)spyi lo 1509lo nas li lis dang / li chis gnyis kyis 'go khrid byas pa'i zhing pa'i gyen langs rgyun chad med par byung ba des ming rgyal rabs kyi bkas bkong brgyud 'dzin srid dbang la shugs drag che ba'i rdung rdeg btang bar brten sa gas ri 578

bod kyi chos sizunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad nyil ltar 'thor la nye ba'i dus skabs su gnas yod pas stobs shugs med pa chags zin pa dang / sog po tsho chen zhe dgu'i nang tshan cha har tsho pa brgyad kyi 'go gtso len tan rgyal po ① zer bas srid dbang bzung nas lo ngo bco brgyad song mtshams rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu sbrul (ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma dbyi tsung kru'u yo'u jan khru'u kreng khri lo lnga pa)spyi lo 1632lor mtsho sngon yang dbang 'og tu bsdus te stobs shugs che ba'i skabs dang / dus mtshungs bar khams khul be ri rgyal po don yod zer ba des sde dge dang / ldan khog nag shod tsho drug chab mdo/ ri bo che sogs/ la dmag drangs te dbang 'og tu bcug nas stobs shugs che ba'i skabs yin cing / rgyal po de gnyis ka bon po'i chos la dga' zhing sa ngas rgyas chos lugs la sdang po yod pa dang lhag par du dge lugs par shin tu nas mi dga' ba zhig yin stabs/ gtsang pa rgyal po karma bstan skyong da bang pos kho gnyis dang 'brel ba btsugs thog se 'bras dge gsum gtor te dge lugs pa ming med du gtor rgyu'i mna' bzhag byas/ rab byung bcu gcigadzopa'i shing khyi (ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma dbyi tsung khrung kren khri lo bdun pa)spyi lo 1634lor cha har len tan rgyal pos mtsho sngon nas ngamag dpung khrid de gcang pa rgyal por dpung rogs byed par 'ong yang sha ra tha la zer ba'i sa char slebs skabs glo bur grongs/ lo der hal ha tsho pa bdun gyi dpon po chog thu zer bas nang 'khrug bslangs te mang da — ————/tsho yon rgyal rabs rtsa 'thor phyin rjes sog yul tsam la dbang sgyur byed mkhan rgyal brgyud so bdun nga//tā7sngu)

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshogs kyis kho pa hal ha yul na sa phyir 'bud byas/ pa de mtsho sngon du du 'ongs/ mtsho sngon gyi sde yongs rdzogs blangs te mtsho sngon rgyud du yod pa'i dge lugs pa'i bla chen dang grwa pa mang po srog thog tu btang zhing / 'ga' zhig btson du bcug de dang dus mtshungs bar khams khul gyi be ri rgyal po don yod kyis kyang khams su yod pa'i sa skya dang / dge lugs/ rnying ma gsum gyi dgon pa mang che ba gtor zhing bla ma rnams bzung nas btson khang du bcug da dung hal ha dpon po chog thu'i dmag dpung bod du yong rgyu'i gra sgrigs yod pa bcas lha sar go thos byung mtshams/ phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel dang skyid shod sde pa mtsho skyes rdo rje gnyis kyis 'bras spungs dgon pa'i bsam blo khang tshan gyi grwa pa 'ga' ru lo tsa ba sna chen dang sems nyid kha chen zer ba gnyis la gsang ba'i yi ge bskur te brdzun chas spras nas mtsho sngon brgyud jun gar du gu shri han gyi sar dmag rogs zhu bar btang / de'i phyi lo rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag spyi lo 1635lor/ hal ha chog thus rang gi bu ar sa lang zer ba dmag dpung stong phrag kha shas dang bcas gtsang pa rgyal po'i dpung rogs byed par btang ba 'bri chu'i stod rgyud du slebs skabs/ gu shri han gyis ba thur hong tha'i ji sogs dpon g.yog nyung bsdus tshong pa'i chas spras nas dbus gtsang gi gnas tshul rtog zhib byed par 'ong ba dang thug 'phrad byung ste lha sa bar mnyam du 'ongs/ gu shri han gyis ar sa lang la dge lugs par gnod 'tshe btang mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa ltar ar sa lang gis lha ① bon po'i chos kyi sbyin bdag yin/ 580

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/ —sar slebs rjes gtsang pa rgyal por dpung rogs ma byas pa'i khar/ da du nga yar 'brog rgyud du song nas gtsang pa rgyal po'i dmag dpung la phar rgol byas shing / gtsang pa rgyal pos de'i lan du gtsang dmag phon chen khrid nas byang rgyud nas 'ongs pas sog dmag 'jigs nas phyir 'then byas/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga par mjal kha dang chos zhus pa sogs byas par brten/ karma zhwa dmar bas mtsho sngon du ar sa lang gi pha la yi ge btang nas phas bu la bkod pa btang ba ltar byas ma song zer ba'i lan du/pha chog thus bu ar sa lang mgo skor btang nas gsod thabs gyis zhes lan 'byor ba ltar/ ar sa lang gi blon po tha'i ching gis lkog gsod byas te ar sa lang gis gtsang pa rgyal por dpung rogs byed rgyu don thog tu ma 'khyol/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me byi (ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma dbyi tsung kru'u yo'u can khrung kren khri lo dgu pa)spyi lo 1636lor ston mjug gu shri han gyis tshong pa'i chas spras te bā thur hong tha'i ji sogs dpon g.yog nyung bsdus khrid nas dbus gtsang du gnas tshul rtog zhib byed par 'ong ba lha sar 'byor nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa dang paṇa chen la mjal kha zhus/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas gu shri han la bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po zer ba'i go gnas sprad/ de'i phyi lo gu shri han gyis bā thur hong tha'i ji dpung rogs su khrid de khri dmag gcig gis chog thu rgyal po'i dmag dpung khri gsum dang 'thab nas chog thu rtsa med btang rjes/ lo de'i rjes mar jun gar du yod pa'i gu shri han gyi ru sde tshang ma mtsho sngon du spos/ dpung rogs bā thur hong tha'i ji la rang gi bu mo amin ta ra mna' mar ster )8

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhing / rgyu nor gyi skal ba dang bcas te jun gar du los/ bcug rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa yos (ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma dbyi tsung kru'u yo'u can khrung kren khri lo bcu gnyis pa)spyi lo 1639lor gu shri han gyis gtsang pa'i rgyab rogs be ri rgyal po'i thog dmag drangs te sde dge dang smar khams sogs tshang ma blangs nas be ri rgyal po gtor pham btang / khams khul la dmag 'thab rgyal kha thob pa'i gtam snyan skyel bar mi gnyis lha sar btang skabs tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel gyis bang chen mi gnyis po dga' ldan khang gsar du skad btang nas gu shri han la gsang ba'i yi ge dang kha lan bskur don du/ gu shri'i dmag dpung bod du yong nas gtsang pa rgyal po la yang be ri ltar rgol lan sprod rogs kyis zhes smras/ gu shri han gyis smar khams nas mtsho sngon du phyir log byed rgyu yin khul gis thog mar kha mtsho sngon ngos su gtad nas phyin te gtsang pa rgyal pos gu shri han smar khams nas mtsho sngon du phyir log byas song zer ba'i gtam go ru bcug pas/ gtsang pa rgyal pos gtam de thos rkyen dogs zon med par bsdad pa dang skabs bstun nas gu shri han gyis glo bur du dmag dpung dbus su drangs te gtsang pa rgyal po gtor/ gtsang pa rgyal po karma bstan skyong dbang po thog mar btson 'jug do dam thog mthar ko gtums brgyab ste gzhis ka rtse'i gtsang chur dor/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta (ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma dbyi tsung kru'u yo'u can khrung kren khri lo bco lnga pa)spyi lo 1642lor gu shri han gyis bod yongs la dbang sgyur byas te tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa gzhis ka rtser gdan drangs/ bod 582

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/sa gnas kyi srid dbang yongs rdzogs dang / gtsang pa rgyal po'i bokhrang gzhis ka rtse nas blangs pa'i rgyu nor rin thang can mang po phul te/ de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung thog mar btsugs/ de nas mu mthud de sngon gtsang pa rgyal pos bkra shis lhun po'i 'khris su rgyab pa'i dgon gsar bkra shis zil gnon zer ba bshig nas de'i shing cha yongs rdzogs lha sar drangs te lha sa gtsug lag khang gi khyams ra'i shing cha rnying pa rnams brjes shing / mchod rdzas dang rten mchod mang che ba rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang la sprad/ de sngon gtsang pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa'i dgon pa khag gcig chos lugs bsgyur ba sogs byas/ de'i rkyen gyis karma pa skye phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje lha sa nas bros te lho brag khul du song nas gong lo'i lo mjug la kong po khul gyi phan bde dgon pa sogs bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa dang sde dpon khag dang 'brel ba byas te dga' ldan pho brang gi srid gzhung la ngo rgol byas pa'i zing 'khrug bslangs shing / gtsang dang lho kha rgyud kyi sa gnas mang po bzung ba des gnas skabs srid gzhung 'thor rgyu'i nyen kha byung bar brten/ gu shri han gyi bu bstan 'dzin dā la'i han gyis sne khrid pa'i bod sog mnyam 'brel dmag dpung kong por drangs te drag gnon byas thog sa gnas khag tu yod pa'i karma bka' brgyud kyi dgon khag mang che ba gtor nas chos lugs bsgyur/ karma bka' brgyud pa'i grwa pa tshang ma'i lag par thel rtse brgyab ste/ dge lugs pa'i dgon pa khag la kha gtor nas rtsis sprad pa sogs drag gnon shugs chen byas par brten/ karma pa zhwa nag skye phreng bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje lho brag khul nga83

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas kong po brgyud 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i yul du bros/ gu shri han dang /tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa mnyam 'brel thog nas gtsang pa rgyal po'i srid dbang dang / de'i rjes 'brangs karma bka' brgyud chos lugs kyi dgon pa rna mas la rtsa med rang bzhin ldan pa'i rdung deg btang rjes karma bka' brgyud chos lugs dang dge lugs pa gnyis bar gyi 'thab rtsod mjug sgril/ yin na yang skabs der nyams r+ghad du btang ba'i karma bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs tshogs pa'i khongs gtogs tshang mar drag gnon shugs chen phog pa'i rkyen gyis snga phyir tshur rgol gyen log thengs kha shas byung zhing gsar du btsugs ma thag pa'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi stobs shugs de sra brtan yong bar da dung chab srid kyi stobs shugs nus ldan zhig gi rgyab skyor med na rtsa 'thor 'gro rgyu'i nyen kha chen po bsdad yod pa red/skabs der zhing pa'i 'os langs kyi gnon shugs 'og mes rgyal nang khul du ming rgyal rabs rtsa 'thor phyin nas de'i rgyal kha'i 'bras bu de man ching gong ma hrun kris phrogs te rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing spre spyi lo 1644lo la tung pe hren yang du ching rgyal rabs dang po btsugs pa de stobs shugs chen po yod pa'i rkyen gyis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa dang paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gnyis la se chen chos rjes gros 'go bton pa ltar/ se chen chos rje mes rgyal nang khul du log skabs/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa dang paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gnyis kas 'tshams 'dri'i yi ge dang rten bskur nas hrin yang du man ching srid gzhung gsar pa btsugs par rten 'brel zhus 584

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/pa dang chabs cig gsar du btsugs pa'i srid gzhung la rgyab skyor yong ba'i re 'dun zhus pa red/skabs der man ching srid gzhung yang chab srid thog stobs shugs rgyas 'go tshugs tsam yin par brten/ rang nyid kyi dbang sgyur sra brtan yong ba dang sog po sogs grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul la dbang sgyur byed rgyu sra brtan gtong dgos na dusangaskabs de'i ring chos lugs thog snyan grags dang stobs shugs che ba'i chos lugs bed spyod byed dgos pa dang /de yang tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen gnyis bed spyod byed rgyu gal chen po yin pa mthong nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa dang / paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gnyis la 'tshams 'dri'i 'brel ba byas pa ma zad/ bod kyi rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu 'brug (ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma hrun kri'i khri lo dgu pa)spyi lo 1652lor/ gong ma hrun kris tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa pe cin du gdan drangs nas thug 'phrad byas thog sne len gzab rgyas phun sum tshogs pa dang / gser gyi byang bu bod shog 'thug gras dang snyoms pa zheng sor bzhi dkyus mtho gang tsam yod pa bco lnga 'phrul mig tu sbrel nas ltebs chog pa zhig gi ngos su/ rgya sog bod gsum gyi yi ge shan sbyar thog nub kyi lha gnas ches dge bar bde bar gnas pa'i sangs6rgyas kyi bka' lung / gnam 'og gi skye 'gro thams cad bstan pa gcig turtsogyur pa/ 'gyuromed rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla ma thes 'khod pa'i 'ja' sa dang / gser gyi tham ka skad rigs bzhi 'byar ba'i nang don la nub phyogs kyi phul byung zhi ba sangs rgyas rgya chen khyon la sangs rgyas 585

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bstan pa'i mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma zhes 'khod pa bcas sprad de/ tā la'i bla mas gtso bo byas pa'i bod kyi sa gnas srid dbang la nus ldan gyi shugs snon brgyab pa red/ srid gzhung de ni dge lugs pa'i chos lugs mi snas chos srid gnyis ka'i dbang cha bzung ba'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs shig yin pa'i thog srid 'dzin sgrigs gzhi dang khrims lugs sogs cung zad cha tshang ba'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs shig red/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung btsugs rjes kyi sde srid dang po bsod nams rab brtan nam/ bsod nam chos 'phil yang zer ba 'dis sngar yod gtsang pa rgyal po'i khrims yig zhal lce bcu drug gi nang nas dang po dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce dang / gnyis pa sdar ma wa'i zhal lce/ bcu drug pa kla klo mtha' 'khob kyi zhal lce bcas gsum dor nas zhal lce bcu gsum du gtan 'bebs byas shing 'on kyang 'grel bshad byed stangs mi 'dra ba yod/ phyogs mtshungs sngar sa skya bas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung skabs gsar gtod byas pa'i las tshan bcu gsum skor gong du sa skya bas srid dbang bzung skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra bar rgyun 'dzin thog gsar du bka' blon/ mda' dpon/khrims dpon/ bzo rigs do dam pa/ rtsis dngo na/ gnyer tshang dang mi dpon/ rtswa gnyer dang shing gnyer/ chong dpon dang gser yig pa/yong sdud pa/ bkar 'jug pa/ rdzong dpon/ gzhis sdod bcas gsar du 'dzugs pa dang / srid 'dzin las khungs kyang bka' blon shag/ rtsis ba/ nga / zhol pa las khungs/ zhib khang las khungs/ snang rtse shag la sa 586

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/khungs/ rtse 'phral bde las khungs/ shod bla brang phyag mdzod las khungs/lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs/ rtswa gnyer las khungs/ rtsam bzhes las khungs bcas gsar du btsugs/ bka' shag dang yig tshang sogs mang po zhig ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa dang brgyad pa/ bcu gsum pa/bcu bzhi pa bcas kyi skabs rim bzhin gsar 'dzugs byas pa red/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas rang nyid kyi dbang du bzung ba'i srid dbang gi stobs shugs la brten nas sa gnas khag la bka' brgyud chos lugs phud pa'i chos lugs mi 'dra ba'i dgon pa bcu gsum btab cing / bka' brgyud pa'i chos lugs dgon pa khag gcig dge lugs par bsgyur/ bod du yod pa'i dgon pa khag la grwa pa grangs bcad dang grwa khral bsdus pa'i lam lugs bzos/ se 'bras dge gsum sogs dgon pa khag gcig la mchod gzhis mi ser gyi dbang cha sprad yod pa dang / dgon pa khag gcig la srid gzhung gi yong 'bab thog nas lo ltar 'bru phogs sprod rgyu'i gtan 'bebs bzos pa bcas kyi gnas tshul zhib cha sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i 〈 bai ser 〉 gyi nang gsal ba ltar dpyad gzhi'i re'u mig gsham gsal/ 587
twetram̐/twe/k+ṣiṃ/ //
/ṭ+wāṃraro ri nga /
rdopy-i /༷ /go/ngaX/ 327
tram̐ ṭaṃbyeX/ bye rmerno — —

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mchod gzhis dang mi ser rang bdag gi dbang cha sprad pa ma zad/ de tshor khrims 'go rang btsan gyi dbang cha sprad yod pa dang / dgon pa khag gcig la mchod gzhis dang mi ser med par lo ltar srid gzhung nas 'bru dang ja mar sogs kyi phogs sprad pa'i lam lugs lag len bstar nas kho tshor khrims lugs kyi dbang cha med pa bcas kyi lam lugs rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis lag len bstar ba'i nang / mchod gzhis mi ser dang khrims 'go rang btsan gyi dbang cha yod pa rnams dpal 'byor thog stobs shugs che ba dang chab srid thog dbang shugs che ba yod thog srid gzhung gi khral rigs gang yang 'khur mi dgos pa'i dmigs bsal dbang cha chen po yod rung / dgon pa so so'i khongs su gtogs pa'i mi ser zhing bran rnams rang gi dpon khungs dgon pa so sor srid gzhung gi mi ser dang / sger pa'i zhing bran tsho dang 'dra bar khral rigs sna tshogs rgyun mi chad par rgyug dgos pa gcig mtshungs yin stabs/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs ji tsam tshang du phyin pa de tsam gyis rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs rnams mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyi dbang sgyur 'og gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog gi sdug bsngal sngar las lhag par che ru 'gro gi yod pa red/chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs de'i 'og chos byed dgon pa khag gi khrims lugs la'ang 'gyur ba byung ba ste/ mchod gzhis dang mi ser yod pa'i dgon pa rnams chos srid gnyis ka'i khrims kyi bdag por gyur stabs/ chos lugs rang nyid kyi khrims lugs ltar nyes chad gcod pa'i lam lugs rnams lo rgyus yi ge'i thog 'khod pa'i ming tsam zhig tu 592

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/gyur te/ chos byed dgon pa khag gi nang la'ang bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin srid gzhung gi khrims lugs ltar nyes chad gcod pa'i lam lugs cha tshang ba zhig byung nas dgon pa so so'i khongs gtogs zhing bran lta ci smros/chos byed grwa pa tsho la'ang chos khrims kyi nyes chad gcod lugs ltar mi byed par srid gzhung gi khrims lugs ltar nyes chad gcod kyi yod pa red/khrims 'go rang btsan yin pa'i dgon pa de tshos srid gzhung gis sprad pa'i dmigs bsal dbang char brten nas rang khongs zhing bran rnams la dpal 'byor thog nas khral rigs sna tshogs bsdu brdzodang / chab srid thog bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin srid gzhung dang khyad med kyi khrims lugs lag bstar byed kyi yod pa de ni/ phyogs gcig nas chos lugs kyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i nyes khrims lam lugs des chos lugs mi sna'i dpal 'byor gyi go gnas srung skyob byed mi thub pa'i thog phyogs gzhan zhig nas chos lugs mi sna'i chos khrims srung skyob kyi 'gan len yang byed mi thub par gyur te/ chos byed dgon pa'i bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi srid khrims ltar nyes chad gcod pa'i lam lugs lag len ma bstar ka med byung ba dang / de la brten nas chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi sna rnams chos dad byed mkhan gyi chos pa dang / srid dbang bzung mkhan gyi dpon rigs gnyis ka yin pa'i ser mo ba zhig tu gyur pa der/ rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams kyisabla ma dpon po zhes pa'i zhe sa'i ming gis 'bod pa de ni dngos su che bstod yod la shugs la zur za'ang yod pa'i go don dang rgyu mtshan gting zab ldan pa zhig red/ 593

dung dkur blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsub rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung ba gnang ring de sngon gtor pham btang zin pa'i karma bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs phud pa'i chos lugs gzhan dag la mthun sgril dang bar gnas kyi srid jus bzung ba des rang nyid kyi chos lugs dang chab srid kyikobs shugs gong 'phel gtong bar phan nus chen po byung yod kyang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sku 'das rjes ring por ma lon par srid dbang bzung mkhan tshos chos lugs srid jus thog phyogs ris ring lugs kyi nor 'khrul byung nas chos lugs phyogs khag so so'i bar slar yang 'gal ba gsar pa thon pa red/(7)rnying ma dang dge lugs bar gyi chos lugs 'gal ba dang mtho rim mi snas de bed sngud nas srid dbang 'phrog res byas pa'i dmag 'khrug skor/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i dus dge lugs dgon pa mang po gsar 'debs dang nyams gso byas shing / karma bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa mang che ba dashe/ lugs par bsgyur/ dge lugs pa'i dgon pa dang rnying ma'i dgon pa de tshor mchod gzhi sa dang mi ser phon sprad pa bcas byas te/ dge 'u/ba/sa pa'i dgon pa khag dpal 'byor dang chab srid gang ci'i thad nas stobs shugs che shos kyi go gnas bzung zhing / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ra nga nyid sa skya dang / rnying ma/ dge lugs gsum ka'i chos lugs ris med gnang gi yod pa'i rkyen gyis dge lugs pa'i dgon 594

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/pa dang / chos lugs gzhan dag gi dgon pa tshang mas chab srid thog nas 'jigs snang byed pa dang / chos lugs thog nas mi mang che bas dad pa ha cang chen po byed kyi yod kyang / phyogs ris che ba'i chos lugs mi sna khag gcig gis dad pa de tsam byed kyi med pa dang / paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni dus skabs der bod dbus gtsang dang / mtsho sngon/ sog yul/ 'brug yul/ hin rdu bcas su mkhas pa'i snyan grags che ba'i khar/ chos lugs khag tshang mar mthun sgril gnang mkhas pa dang / lhag par du dge lugs pa'i dgon pa'i grwa pa mtho dman tshang mas rje tsong kha pa sku ngo ma slar yang phebs pa dang khyad par med pa'i dad zhen byed kyi yod pa'i stabs kyis paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa sku 'das rjes kyi paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shel la'ang de dang 'dra ba'i dad zhenakhyed kyi yod pa dang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sku 'das rjes sdergopa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos se 'bras dge gsum la mchod gzhis mi ser mang po sprad pa sogs dpal 'byor thog nas dge lugs par rgyab skyor shugs chen byed kyi yod kyang / kho rang rnying ma'i chos lugs la nga/da pa che ba yod pa'i rkyen gyis se 'bras dge gsum gyi nang nas chos lugs phyogs zhen med pa'i mi khag gcig gis sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshor dga' zhen byed kyi yod kyang / dge lugs pa'i phyogs zhen chen po yod mkhan tshos sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshor 'jigs snang byed pa las dga' zhen byed kyi med cing / gu shri han gyi tsha bo lha bzadz+wahan ① ni dge lugs pa'i chos rjo/ gu shri han gyi bu bcu'i nang gi che shos bstan 'dzin tā la'i han gyi bu yin/ 595

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lugs la dad zhen che ba dang kho rang gi dad pa byed sa'i bla ma yang / paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes dang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng dang po ngag dbang brtson 'grus gnyis yin pa'i stabs kyis/ sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang lha bzang han gnyis srid dbang 'phrog res kyi dmag 'khrug byung ba'i skabs la'ang / se 'bras dge gsum gyis bar chings byas te/ sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos sde pa dgongs pa zhus nas srid dbang lha bzang gi lag tu sprod rgyu byas pa dang / rjes su lha bzang han gyis mtsho sngon du phyir log byas pa'i khul byas nas nag chur slebs rjes dmag gra sgrigs te dga' mo 'phrang brgyud nas lha bzang han rang nyid dang / 'phan po rgo la nas thu gus je'i sang / stod lung nang nas rgyal mo tshe ring bkra shis dhi bcas kyis sne khrid nas dmag khag gsum 'ongs pa/sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag bsdus nas phan tshun 'thab ra sprad skabs sde srid kyi dmag dpung rnams byi'u khras bdas pa ltar gtor/ skabs der sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos lha sa nas ko gru'i thog gong dkar du bros shing / mthar gong dkar nas stod lung phur rgyal mo tshe ring bkra shis la mgo btags zhu bar yong dgos byung skabs/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos bar dpang du se 'bras dge gsum gyi mkhan po tsho yong dgos pa'i lan btang yang /se 'bras dge gsum gyi mkhan po tshos stod lung mda'i zam pa bskor nas 'gro ba'i shul du/ rgyal mo tshe ring bkra shis kyis sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rjo lha bzang gi btsun mo yin/ 596

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/'dzin bzung byas te de ma thag ske bregs nas bkrongs pa red/sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho lha bzang gis bkrongs rjes nas lo ngo bcu gsum ring lha bzang han gyis bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung zhing /lha bzang han gyis srid dbang bzung ba'i phyi lo rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me khyi (ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma khang shis khri lo zhe lnga pa)spyi lo 1705lor/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho chos lugs kyi mdzad spyod tshul mthun med pa dang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i yang srid min pa'i skor gong ma khang shis la snyan zhu phul te/ gong mas mngags pa'i dpon rigs pad+ma sbi cha'i chi sogs bod du 'byor nas tā la'i bla ma tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho khri thog nas phabs te mes rgyal nang khul du gnas dbyung byas shing / gsar du tsha ba dpag shod pa'i sprang po'i bur skyes pa'i sprul sku ye shes rgya mtsho tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin byas nas po tā la'i khri thog tu bkod/de nas ring por ma song bar lha bzang han gyi bu che ba dga' ldan bstan 'dzin gyis rang gi pha lha bzang han gyis bkag 'gog thengs mang byas kyang ma nyan par jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan gyi bu mo mna' mar len rgyu mthar skyel byas rkyen lha bzang han la bya thabs ma byung bar jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan gyi bu mo mna' mar len rgyu gtan khel/ skabs der jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan gyis bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang 'phrog 'dod chen po yod stabs/ da res rang gi bu mo lha bzang han gyi bu che ba'i mna' mar gtong ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas bu mo bod du 597

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/srung skyel byed rgyur kha g.yar te dmag dpung btang thog lha bzang han mgo rting bslogs nas bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang 'phrog thub pa yong ba'i jus ngan bton pa ste/ phyogs gcig nas rang gi bu mo bod du srung skyel byed par kha g.yar te dmag dpung phon che mnyam du btang zhing / gnyis nas stod mnga' ris brgyud nas dmag dpung phon che tsam zhig nyin mo yib cing mtshan mo shar bskyod kyis 'dam gzhung dang thag nye sar dmag dpung khag gnyis dhi dus gcig tu 'dzom thub pa byas rkyen/ lha bzang han la ma gzhi sngon tshud nas dogs zon yod kyang gra sgrigs byed long ma byung bar glo bur du rgol lan slog dgos byung skabs nus pa chen po thon ma thub pa'i thog da dung jun gar bas jus ngan gzhan zhig 'don pa red/ kho tshos phyogs gcig nas lam brgyud khel sa'i bod kyi zhing 'brog mi dmangs la skyob gso'i dngos po phon chen po sprad pa dang / gnyis nas nga tshos bod du dpung bskyod byas pa 'di sger don gyi ched du min par/dge lugs pa'i chos la srung skyob dang / bod mi dmangs kyi sems kyi gting nas dad zhen yod pa'i tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid li thang du sku 'khrungs pa deng sang sku 'bum dgon par bzhugs pa de bzhin bod du gdan 'dren zhu ba'i srung skyel dmag mi yin zhes dril bsgrags shugs chen byas pa rnams gcig nas gcig la brgyud de dmag dpung dang mi dmangs tshang mas go thos byung rkyen mang tshogs dang dmag dpung rnams jun gar gyi dmag dpung la rgol lan slog pa'i sems shugs med pa bzos pa dang /dhi khyon rta dmag drug stong tsam yod pa/ 598

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/ —go skabs de dang bstun nas lha bzang han la dmag drangs te pham par bzos mthar/ lha bzang han rang nyid kyang rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me bya (ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma khang shis khri lo drug pa)spyi lo 1717lor po tā la nas phyir thon te/ rang nyid dpon g.yog gnyis kyis dpa' ngar chen pos jun gar ba'i dmag mi bcu phrag tsam dang lag 'dzings byas te mi bdun brgyad tsam bsad rjes rangaltad srog btang nas 'das/de'i nyin mo nas bzung lo gsum ring jun gar bas bod sa gnas la dbang sgyur byas shing / skabs der sde pa stag rtse ba lha rgyal rab brtan (kyelo na bdun cu lhag tsam la slebs pa zhig phyi tshul tsam du bod kyi sde srid du bskos kyang don dngos thog dbang cha yongs rdzogs jun gar ba'i lag tu bzung zhing / lo rgyus thog snyan grags che ba'i rdo rje brag dgon pa dang /smin grol gling dgon pa sogs rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa mang po rtsa gtor btang thog rdo brag rig 'dzin sprul sku pad+ma 'phrin las dang /smin gling gdung sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho/ smin gling lo chen dha rma shri sogs grags can gyi rnying ma'i bla ma mang po bkrongs/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig ces deng sang 'dzam gling thog rin thang med pa'i khyad nor phun sum tshogs pa de yang bshig nas gtor rtsis byed skabs/ sde pa stag rtse ba lha rgyal rab brtan pa lo na bdun cu lhag tsam slebs pa'i rgad po des 'jam tsub thabs shes sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bkag 'gog byas rkyen bshig ma nus par lus/ skabs du skyid shod dga' ldan pa'i mi brgyud yin/ 599

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/der jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan gyi dmag dpung gis bod sa gnas su btsan 'dzul byed skabs/ bod kyi rgya che'i mang tshogs la dngos pos mgo bskor btang nas bslu brid dang / tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid srung skyel zhu mkhan yin zer ba dang / dge lugs pa'i chos la srung skyob byed mkhan yin zer ba/ bod mi rigs kyi don du yin zer ba sogs chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi dar cha khyer nas bod kyi mtho rim mi sna dang / chos lugs mi sna/ rgya che'i mang tshogs bcas mgo bo rmongs par byas te srid dbang phrogs pa de ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog sems kyi gting nas yid skyo dgos pa'i bslab bya zhig ma red dam/(8)chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs nyams 'go tshugs pa dang dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul srid dbang 'phrog res byas pa'i 'thab rtsod skor/de nas mtsho sngon dpon rigs dga' ldan er rti ni ju nang dang /ching dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs kyis li thang du sku 'khrungs pa'i tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid bskal bzang rgya mtsho sde dge brgyud mtsho sngon du gdan drangs te/ gong ma khang shis la snyan zhu phul ba ltar/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho de bzhin tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug par ngos 'dzin chog pa dang bod du gdan drangs chos/ pa'i bka' phabs/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags glang spyi lo 1721lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho po tā la'i khrir bkod rjes da'i si cang 600

bod kyi chos srid thung 'brel skor bshad pa/ cun dang / gung tshe dbang nor bu/ don grub wang / e bus pa'i li/ching wang blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ pa'i si nga phod rdo rje rgyal po/ gung lum pa ba bkra shis rgyal po bcas rgya bod tshogs 'dus lo gcig ring srid dbang bzung / de rjes slar yang gong ma khang shis a sa khan am ban btang nas bka' blon gyi gtso bo da'i ching ba dur bsod nams rgyal po dang / rogs zlar pa'i si nga phod pa rdo rje rgyal po/ gung lum pa ba bkra shis rgyal po gnyis sngar yod thog gsar du pho lha tha'i ji bsod nams stobs rgyas dang / sbyar ra ba blo gros rgyal po gnyis la tha'i ji go gnas dang bcas bka' blon du bskos/ pa'i si khang chen pa da'i ching ba dur ni dge lugs pa ma gtogs chos lugs gzhan dag la mi dga' ba'i thog lhag par rnyid ma la sdang / nga lum sbyar gsum ni rnying ma ma gtogs chos lugs gzhan dag la mi dga'/ pho lha tha'i ji ni gting rnying ma la dga' yang / phyi tshul dge lugs par dga' khul byed kyi yod pa bcas kyi thogarab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu yos spyi ldo 1723lor gong ma yung ṭing gis ban de rdor khe am ban bod du btang nyisdes bka' phab don du/ tā la'i bla mas chos lugs slob sbyong yag po byed dgos pa dang / rdo rje brag dang smin grol gling sogs rnying ma'i chos lugs rnams rang bzhin gyis med pa chags thabs/ zhwa ser gyi bstan pa sngar las lhag pa dar rgyas su gtong thabs/ bka' blon rnams gong ma mjal bar yong dgos pa/ tā la'i bla ma'i yab kyis srid don la jus gtogs byas na phugs la nyen kha yod pa/bka' blon tshang mas mthun sgril gyis gzhung don sgrub dgos pa bcas 60/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsal bar brten/ da'i ching ba dur gyis de sngon gyi rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi grwa pa tshang ma rnying ma'i chos lugs byed kyi yod pa de rtsed thang o rgyan gling du gnas spos byas thog rgyud grwa stod smad kyi grwa pa'i nang nas khag gcig bsdus te rnam rgyal grwa tshang gsarabyupa btsugs pa dang / de sngon jun gar gyis gtor ba'i rnying ma'e dgon pa rnams bskyar gso byed mi chog pa bcas byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ bka' blon gzhan dag rnams blo la ma babs shing / lhag par du nga lum sbyar gsum mi dga' bar gyur te da'i ching ba dur dang pho lha tha'i ji gnyis gtor pham gtong rgyu'i lkog gros byas pa red/de'i gnas tshul mdo mkhar zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis shes rjes shog bus bzos pa'i phreng thag gi nang du mgyogs po bros thabs ma byas na nyen kha yod pa'i gnas tshul gab tshig thog bris te gsang brda btang ba dang / pho lha tha'i jis gnas tshul de da'i ching ba dur la bshad kyang kho pa dogs zon gtan nas med stabs pho lha tha'i ji'i skad cha der ma nyan pa red/ pho lha tha'i jis gnas skabs gzhis 'khor du dgongs pa zhus te gtsang du thon nas nyin shas song ma—tshams lha sa gtsug lag khang gi tshoms chen khams gsum du nang nga lum sbyar gsum gyis glo bur du 'jab rgol byas te da'i ching ba dur dmar gsod btang / der mu mthud dpal 'byor rab brtan du yod pa'i bza' zla gnyis dang / bu phrug g.yog po bcas gcig kyang ma lus par nyi ma de rang la dmar gsod btang ba dang chabs cig pho lha tha'i ji 'dzin bzung byed par drung 'khor skyid pa thang du gzhung sgo'i thog kha'i tshoms chen yin/ 602

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/pa sogs dmag mi sum brgya tsam gtsang du mngags rung / pho lha tha'i jir snga sa nas dogs zon yod stabs glags ma rnyed cing / pho lha tha'i jis stod mnga' ris su song nas da'i ching ba dur gyi gcen po no mon gung dang mnyam 'brel byas te gtsang dmag khrid nas nga lum sbyar gsum pham par byas pa sogs/ zhib cha 〈 pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi rtogs brjod 〉dhi nang 'khod pa ltar red/ da'i ching ba dur bsod nams rgyal po dang bka' blon nga phod pa/ lum pa ba/ pho lha tha'i ji bsod nams stobs rgyas bcas bar gyi 'gal ba de don dngos thog phan tshun srid dbang 'phrog res kyi 'gal ba yin kyang / 'gal ba de g.yo 'bebs byed ched/ skabs der chos lugs srid jus la mi mthun pa'i 'ab/la ba yod pa de bed spyod byas te dbus gtsang gi mang tshogs khag gnyis bar 'gal ba yong thabs byas pa dang / de'i rkyen gyis dbus gtsang gi mang tshogs nang khul la mthun sgril med par bzos te dmag 'khrug bslangs pa de yang lo rgyus thog gi bslab bya gting zab po thengs gcig red/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sku 'das rjes nas bzung pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi bu 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis srid dbang bzung ba'i bar du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa dgung lo na ma son bar du tā lo'i bla ma la chos lugs kyi dbang cha ma gtogs/ srid kyi thad sde srid rim pas thad kar thag gcod byed kyi yod kyang / pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi bu 'gyur du mi dbang rtogs brjodasprang zer/ 603

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/med rnam rgyal gyis srid dbang bzung ring / phyogs gcig nas lha sar sdod pa'i ching gong ma'i sku tshab am ban la brtsi 'jog ma byas pa dang /gnyis thad nas jun gar gyi 'go pa a kya tshe dbang rnam rgyal rdo rjer ngan 'brel byas shing / gsum thad nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtshor bzhugs bzod mi bde ba'i 'jigs snang tshabs chen bskul ba bcas la brten/ bod kyi rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags rta (ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma chen lung khri lo bco lnga pa)spyi lo 1750lor bod du sdod pa'i sku tshab am ban phu chin dang lab tun gnyis kyis 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi bya spyod yag po med pa'i gnas tshul gong mar snyan gseng zhus rjes gong mas bka' phab don la/ don gnad de'i skor thag gcod byed mkhan sku tshab am ban zhig dang dmag dpung bcas bod du gtong rgyu dang / de ma 'byor bar 'tshab 'tshub ma byed pat+na dogs zon zhib 'jug nan tan byed dgos pa'i bka' phab kyang gnas tshul sngar las tshabs che ru phyin par brten/ don gcod sku tshab am ban dang dmag dpung lha sar ma 'byor gong du/ spyi lo 1750lo(ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma chen lung khri lo bco lnga pa)bod kyi rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags rta lor/ lha sdod sku tshab am ban phu chen dang lab tun gnyis kyis 'gyur med rnam rgyal khrom gzigs sgang du gsol ston la bos nas glo bur du srog thog btang ba red/de rjes 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi shog kha mgron gnyer blo bzang bkra shis sogs mi ngan khag gcig gis am ban gnyis dang / gsham 'og gi dpon rigs dang / g.yog po/ khrom srang du sdod pa'i rgya rigs tshong pa 604

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/dang za khang gi las ka byed mkhan sogs ha lam lha sar yod pa'i rgya rigs tshang ma bsad pa sogs kyi zing cha bslangs pa red/ skabs der tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang rdo ring bka' blon zur pa mgon po dngos grub rab brtan gnyis kyis pe cin du gong mar bod kyi gnas tshul snyan zhu phul ba dang chabs cig da cha bod kyi las don thog la skya ser dpon rigs tshang mar brjid non che ba'i sku tshab cig bod sa gnas su gtong ba gnang na ma gtogs/ de snga phan srid don las ka byed mkhan tshang mas phan tshun mthun sgril mi byed pa'i thog sger don ched du zing cha yang yang bslangs pa bcas kyi gnas tshul rjes su yang bskyar mi yong ba'i nges pa mi 'dug ces zhus/ de 'phral gong mas phyin chad bod kyi srid don las ka yongs rdzogs bod du sdod pa'i sku tshab am ban gnyis nas thag gcod byed rgyu'i gtan 'bebs ma bzos na thabs gzhan mi 'dug bsams nas de don bka' btang ba'i gnas tshul skor lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje ( lung gi dbu bla)la bshad pa red/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes skabs der yar langs te gong mar phyag 'tshal nas zhus don/ gong ma chen po'i bka' la gyen ldog zhu thabs bral yang da res gnang ba'i bka' de gzhir bzung gis bod sa gnas kyi dbang cha yongs rdzogs am ban gnyis kyi lag par bzhag pa yin na/ am ban gnyis srid don thog la 'jon thang chen po yod kyang / chos lugs kyi las don thad la rgyus mnga' med stabs tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen gnyis dang / gdan sa gsum sogs chos lugs kyi las don skor la nyams chag chen po 'gro rgyu ma zad/ 605

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gong ma khyed pe cin du bzhugs/ am ban gnyis ni bod du bsdad nas bod kyi gnas tshul skor am ban gnyis kyis khyed la gang zhus ltar ma gtogs/ gnas tshul dngos yod khyed kyis shes mi thub/ am ban gnyis kyis bod la dbang cha che shos bzung nas 'dod par gang yod byas pa yin na/ bod mi dmangs rnams gong ma chen po khyed la mi dga' ba chen po byed kyi red/ da lta bod mi dmangs kyis tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen/gong ma khyed bcas la ha cang gi dga' zhen chen po byed kyi yod pa 'di la dgongs nas da res kyi don gnad 'di skor phyis 'byung rgya bod gnyis kyi mdun lam dang / bod kyi chab srid/ chos lugs las don bcas la phan slebs che ba'i dgongs bzhes yod pa zhu rgyu ni nga rang gong ma chen po'i lto phogs bza' mkhan bod kyi bla ma chung chung zhig gis gong ma chen po'i chab srid la bsams nas lhag bsam zol med kyis zhus pa yin zhes zhus pa red/ skabs der gong mas yang bskyar bsam blo btang nas bshad don/lcang skya ho thog thus zhus pa'i skad cha de ni dngos 'brel gong ma chen po'i chab srid la bsams pa'i skad cha rang red/ de sngon btang tshar ba'i bka' de phyir 'then thog da cha bod sa gnas kyi dbang cha de tā la'i bla ma la sprad nas/ tā la'i bla ma la rogs ram byed mkhan sku tshab am ban gcig bzhag rgyu dang / don gnad che rigs tā la'i bla ma dang am ban zung 'brel gyis thag gcod rgyu/ tā la'i bla ma'i zhabs phyir bka' blon bzhi bsko rgyu/ bka' blon bzhi'i nang nas gcig tā la'i bla ma'i zhabs zhu'i gras nas bsko gzhag byed rgyu bcas byas na gang 'dra 'dug ces 606

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/bshad par/ lcang skya ho thog thus phyag 'tshal nas gong ma'i bka' der thugs rje che zhus pa red/ de nas gong mas gong gsal gyi bya thabs ltar bka' phab nas/ spyi lo 1751lo (ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma chen lung khri lo bcu drug pa)bod kyi rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags lug lor gong mas btang ba'i sku tshab ban de rdor khe am ban sogs bod du 'byor te bka' shag thog mar btsugs pa dang / bod kyi las don byed phyogs skor gyi rtsa 'dzin don tshan bcu gsum zer ba gtan 'bebs byas te/ ching gong ma'i srid gzhung gis slar yang / tā la'i bla mas gtso bo byas pa'i bod kyi bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs la sngar las lhag pa'i shugs snon dang bkod 'doms byas pa red/ching gong mas bod sa gnas su btsugs ba'i bka' shag gi nang /tā la'i bla ma'i zhabs gras ser mo ba'i khongs nas bka' blon gcig bskos pa de ni phyogs gcig nas bka' shag nang tā la'i tshab byed mi sna'i gras yin pa dang / gnyis thad nas chos lugs dgon pa khag gi tshab byed mi sna'i gras yin pas bka' shag ni chos srid zung 'brel gyi rnam pa ma byed kyi srid 'dzin las khungs mtho shos shig yin cing / dus skabs de nas bzung se 'bras dge gsum gyi sku tshab mkhan po dang / bla spyi'i 'thus mi sogs srid gzhung gi tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms la zhugs pa'i 'alo tshugs pa red/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa sku 'das rjes nas bzung tā la'i bla ma'i tshab byed mkhan srid skyong rgyal tshab zer ba zhig bskos nas/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rjes mas srid don gyi 'gan khur gnang ma thub bar du 607

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ —bod sa gnas kyi dbang cha che shos bzung gi yod kyang / bka' blon sogs las tshan bcu gsum gyi dpon rigs gsar bskos dang / gnas dbyung gtong rgyu/ bod sa gnas kyi sprul sku ho thog thu'i skye phreng gsar pa rdos 'dzin sogs gnad don gal che rigs rnams am ban dang thun mong thog gong mar snyan seng zhus nas chog mchan thob rjes lag len bstar gyi yod pa red/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa sku 'das rjes srid skyong dang po de mo bde legs rgya mtshos lo nyi shu/ tshe smon gling khri chen ngag dbang tshul khrims kyis lo ngo bcu/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtshos kun bde gling rta tshag ho thog thu bstan pa'i mgon po dang mnyam 'brel byas nas lo ngo bcu dgu/ de nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa 'das rjes slar yang kun bde gling rta tshag bstan pa'i mgon pos lo ngo drug de'i 'phros nas de mo ho thog thu 'jigs med rgya mtshos lo dgu/de'i 'phros nas tshe smon gling ho thog thu 'jam dpal tshul khrims kyis lo nyi shu rtsa lnga/ khong srid khri nas gnas dbyung btang rjes paṇa chen er te ni bstan pa'i nyi mas zla ba brgyad lhag tsam/ delta 'phros nas rwa sgreng ho thog thu ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims kyis lo bca brgyad/ de dang 'bras spungs dgon pa dang mi 'grigs pa'i zing cha langs nas mes rgyal nang khul du bros rjes/ bshad sgra ba dbang phyug rgyal pos lo ngo gsum/ de 'phros nas sde drug ho thog thu mkhyen rab dbang phyug gis lo brgyad/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos lo gsum/ de sku 'das nas kun bde gling rta tshag rje drung ngag dbang dpal ldan gyis lo 608

tsho bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ ————bcu gnyis/ de mo ho thog thu 'phrin las rab rgyas kyis lo bcu/ de nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas srid dbang bzung 'go tshugs pa red/(9)btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul stobs shugs bod du sim 'dzul byas pa dang / bod sa gnas kyi mtho rim log spyod pa khag gcig gis mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byas pa'i skor/spyi lo 1894yoching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma kong zhu'i khri lo nyi shu pa)bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing rta lo/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa sku ngo mas srid dbang bzung zhing / de sngon man ching gong ma chen lung gis tā la'i bla mas gtso bor srid dbang bzung ba'i bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang la shugs gyis bkod 'doms byed pa dang chabs cig bod mtha' mtshams kyi gor kha'i btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug la rgol lan bslogs nas mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams brtan srung gi bya gzhag la phan yod kyi bya thabs lag len bstar ba des mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur gyi srung skyob la grub 'bras mi nyung ba thob yod kyang / spyi lo 1796lo bod kyi rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me 'brug lo/ tsā ring gis gong ma'i khri srid 'dzegs pa nas bzung nang khul du rgya che'i mi dmangs la bshu gzhog dang gnya' gnon gyi bya spyod sngar las gdug rtsub che ru btang ba ma gtogs/ phyi nas yong ba'i btsan 'dzul la rang srung gi rgol lan sprod phod kyi med par brten/ rgyal nang gi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ dmag don bcas 6()9

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyi stobs shugs nyams pa dang / dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas rgyal nang dang / mtha' mtshams sa khul la btsan 'dzul dang myul ma gtong ba'i go skabs byung zhing / dus mtshungs bod sa gnas la yang btsan 'dzul gyi bya spyod spel bde ru phyin pa red/ de nas gong ma tā'o kong gis srid dbang bzung nas lo nyi shu phyin pa'i spyi lo 1840lo —bod kyi rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags byi lor nyal tha 'gog pa'i dmag 'khrug langs pa nas bzung krung go 'di mi ser spel yul phyed tsam dang / bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin phyed tsam zhig tu 'gyur 'go tshugs pa dang / bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin gong mas gtsos pa'i zhing bdag dang dpon ngan 'byor ldan gral rim bcas kyis krung go'i mi dmangs la chab srid thog nas gnya' gnon dang dpal 'byor thog nas ya nga snying rje med pa'i bshu gzhog sngar las shugs che ru btang ba ma zad/ da dung btsan rgyal ring lugs pas krung go'i sa char gang 'dod dbang shed kyis 'phrog bcom byed pa sogs dmyal ba mi yul du 'phos pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal gsum brtsegs myong dgos par brten/ sa gnas gang sa gang nas zhing pa'i gyen log gcig rjes gnyis mthud du langs te ching rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung la rdung rdeg tsha nan btang ba'i 'og ching rgyal rabs kyi stobs shugs de 'gram rtsa zad pa'i khang hrul ltar 'thor zhig tu 'gro ba'i 'go tshugs shing /dus mtshungs bod sa gnas su yang rgya che'i zhing 'brog sa khul du bran g.yog rnams kyis yar langs nas gyen log byas pa dang / yul gyar nas bros byol du 'gro ba sogs lo re bzhin je mang du song nas sngar grong sdes 610

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/khengs pa'i yul grong mang po lung stong rtswa yan gyis khengs pa zhig tu gyur te/bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs de bzhin snum zad mar me lta bur rim bzhin nyams rgud du 'gro ba'i 'go tshugs pa red/rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing lug (ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma bkwang zhu'i khri lo nyer gcig pa)spyi lo 1895lor/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa rang nyid kyis dngos su srid dbang bzung zhing / rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu yos (ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma bkwang zhu'i khri lo nyer dgu pa)spyi lo 1903lor/dbyin ji btsan 'dzul dmag gis gam 'bras mtha' mtshams su btsan 'dzul byas shing / de'i phyi lor/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang /hra hong o go gnyis gsang ba'i chings yig bzhag ste/ dbyin gos a h+phu han hra hong o ro su la sprod rgyu dang / hra hong o gos bod de dbyin gor sprod 'i chings yig bzhag cing / lo der dbyin ji btsan 'dzul dmag gis bod sa gnas su btsan 'dzul byed shugs che ru btang rkyen bod sa gnas kyi rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis dpa' ngar zhum pa med pa'i 'gog rgol byas pa dang / rgyal gces mtho rim mi sna khag gcig mang tshogs dang mnyam du btsan 'dzul bkag 'gog byas kyang / ching gong ma'i krung dbyang srid gzhung gis btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi mdun du gnyod chung nus med kyi rnam 'gyur bstan te dbyin go dang bod sa gnas bar 'os med kyi chings yig 'jog tu bcug pa red/ skabs der tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa yang hra hong gong ma'i lkog g.yo ngan jus 'og dbu 'khor nas thog mar hra hong o go la skyabs bcol te bod sa gnas 'di mes rgyal dang 6/1

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kha bral nas hra hong gong ma'i srung skyob 'og bod rang btsan rgyal khab zer ba zhig yong rgyu'i re ba gnang ba red/ skabs der hra hong gong ma'i srid gzhung de ya gling shar ma'i btsan bdag gi don du ri pin dang dmag 'khrug byas nas dmag pham rkyen dmag don dang chab srid thog nus pa chen po thon mi thub pa chags pa'i skabs dang khel te 'char gzhi dang po de ma grub pa red/ rjes su slar yang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i mgo bskor bslu brid 'og de snga bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi bstan dgra dbyin ji zer nas sems kyi gting nas khong khro byed dgos sa'i dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rogs ram la brten nas bod 'di mes rgyal dang kha bral te bod rang btsan rgyal khab cig 'dzugs rgyu'i re ba gnang nas slar yang dbu 'khor chen po thebs pa red/lo rgyus thog gi btsan rgyal ring lugs pa tshang mas mi rigs gzhan dag gi sa cha btsan bzung byed ched mi rigs de'i nang gi mtho rim mi sna dang / shes ldan mi sna bslu brid byas te mi rig sa kyi la rgya zer ba sogs kyi ming snyan po mang po zhig btags nas kho pa tsho'i phyogs su 'then gang thub byed kyi yod pa dang / mthar dpal 'byor thog gi rogs ram dang /dmag don gyi rogs ram/ srung skyob rogs ram zer ba sogs bed spyad nas mi rigs de dang / rgyal khab de'i ske la zhags thag bskon te mi rabs mang po 'i bar thar mi thub pa bzo gi yod pa red/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas snga rjes su hra hong o go dang / dbyin go gnyis la skyabs bcol gnang nas bod rang btsan rgyal khab zer ba zhig yong rgyu'i 612

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/ re ba gnang ba de ni ngan sems 'chang ba'i btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i bslu brid la dbu 'khor ba zhig red/ yin na'ang khong la bslab bya de thob pa'i go skabs ma byung rkyen/ da dung yang mi khag gcig gis btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bskon pa'i zhags thag de'i nang du ma bskul rang mos kyis 'dzul rtsis byas pa de tsho'i gnyid lam skyid po de las gnyid ga dus sad thub kyi red dam/ 'dzam gling thog gi lo rgyus phar zhog bod rang gi lo rgyus thog la'ang gong du bkod pa ltar sog po jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan gyis bod la btsan 'dzul byas nas lo gsum ring bod sa gnas su dbang sgyur byas pa'i lo rgyus de gcig pu'i thog nas bshad na yang chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi dar cha'i 'og mgo bskor thebs nas srid dbang shor ba'i bslab bya tshabs chen gyi gnad don de ha cang gsal po red/(1༷)bod sa gnas kyi mtho rim log spyod pas chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi dar cha khyer nas ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs te chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs rtsa med du song ba'i skor/bod kyi rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa glang / spyi lo 1949lor krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid 'og bod sa gnas dang tha'e wan gnyis tsam ma gtogs rgyal yongs bcings 'grol btang zhing / lo de'i zla 10tshes 1nyin krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su btsugs pa'i khyab bsgrags byas rjes/ krung go'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 613
