dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bod du bskyod nas bod kyi mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul pa'i stobs shugs dang / bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi dbang sgyur 'og nas bcings 'grol gtong rgyur thag bcad pa dang / dus mtshungs krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung la mgyogs myur gros mol byas te bod sa gnas zhi ba'i sgo nas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i gros mthun 'jog ched 'bad brtson rim par byas kyang / me dbyin btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis bkag 'gog dang gtor bshig gi lkog g.yo sna tshogs kyi rkyen ngan dang phrad de zhi ba'i sgo nas gros mol bya rgyu de dus thog tu 'grub ma thub pa'i thog tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa mchog kyang bod sa gnas kyi mtho rim dpon rigs log spyod pa nyung shas shig gis btsan bskul byas te gro mor yul byol du gdan 'dren zhus nas btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rgyab skyor 'og bod rang btsan rgyal khab cig tu 'gyur thub pa yong rgyu'i re stong bcangs pa red/ gong gsal gyi bya spyod der bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs dang / gdan sa gsum sogs dgon sde khag rgyal gces mtho 'bring mi sna bcas kyis shugs drag che ba'i ngo rgol phog pa'i mthar/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang gros mol bya rgyu dang len mi byed ka med byung zhing /tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa rang nyid kyis dngos su srid dbang bzhes rjes/ 1951lo'i zla 2par skabs de'i bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis gtso bo byas pa'i mi lnga dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mir bskos te pe cin du gros mol byed par btang ba dang / de nas dus 614

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/yun zla ba gcig tsam las ma 'gor bar don gnad gal che'i rigs mang por gros 'chams byung ste/ 1951lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin pe cin ching kren teng khang chen nang du krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun la dngos su ming rtags bkod pa ma zad/ de nas yun ring ma song bar tā la'i bla ma mchog kyang gro mo nas lha sar phyir phebs gnang zhing /zla 10tshes 26nyin krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dpung lha sar 'byor skabs bod kyi rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs rnams kyis spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu zhus pa red/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun bzhag pa des bod sa gnas su btsan 'dzul byas nas dbang 'og tu 'jug rgyu'i re ngan 'chang ba'i btsan rgyal ring lugs pa mtha' dag la nus ldan gyis rdung rdeg btang ba dang / rgya bod mi rigs bar gyi mthun sgril dang / mi rigs gzhan dag bar gyi mthun sgril/ bod rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril bcas sngar las lhag par gong 'phel du phyin pa/ bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ mi grangs bcas dpyid kyi dpal yon gsar du bzhad pa ltar 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i 'od zer stong ldan gyi mdun lam yangs po gsar du phye thub pa byung yod/ krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du 'byor rjes/ krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang dang / bod bskyod rgya rigs las byed 6/5

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa dang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dpon dmag bcas tshang mas tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus bcas lag len mthar phyin bstar bar brten/ rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs tshang mas krung go gung khran tang dang / ma'o kru'u zhi'i byams brtse'i thugs khur/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bcas la yid ches dang dga' zhen byas pa ma zad/ mtho rim mi sna'i nang nas khag gcig kyang go rtogs sad nas/krung go gung khran tang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i dbu khrid yang dag pa'i 'og mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang mnyam du dmangs gtso'i gsar brje brgyud spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam thog tu bskyod rgyu ni 'od zer stong ldan gyi mdun lam yin pa ma gtogs/ de las gzhan pa'i 'gro lam med pa gsal por shes pa red/ cha rkyen de lta bu'i 'og thog mar/ spyi lo 1956lor bod rang skyong gra sgrig u yon lhan khang btsugs pa dang dus mtshungs rgya che'i mang tshogs tshos dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed rgyu'i re 'dun bton pa ma zad/ mtho 'bring mi sna khag gcig gis kyang bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam lugs de yongs su bcos bsgyur byed rgyur brtsi bkur dang rgyab skyor zhus pa red/'on kyang mtho 'bring dpon rigs nang gi ngan rengs pa nyung shas shig gis phyi tshul thog dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed rgyur brtsi bkur zhu khul byas te lkog tu gsang ba'i tshogs 'du tshogs nas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' gan bzhag pa dang / bsgrags yig bkrams pa/ mi dmangs 'thus mi zer ba'i tshogs 'du brdzun ma 616

bod kyi chos srid zunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad tshogs pa sogs bya thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bkag 'gog byas te/ bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs de mu mthud nas gnas su 'jug rgyu'i re ngan bcangs pa red/ skabs der kho pa tshos chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ dmag don bcas kyi thad nas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bkag 'gog byed pa gcig pus nus pa thon thub kyi med pa dang /da dung mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs thad kyi 'thab rtsod byed dgos pa mthong nas/ chos lugs dril bsgrags byed pa'i go skabs yod tshad bed spyad de chab srid bsam blo'i 'thab rtsod kyi gleng phyogs mang po bkrams pa red/ de'i nang nas gtso che shos ni chos srid gnyis ni bya 'phur ba la gshog pa gnyis zung 'brel byed dgos pa ltar red zer ba dang / chos srid gnyis ldan gyi dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i bod gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed dgos zer ba/ bod kyi mi dmangs ni sangs rgyas chos lugs dang spyan ras gzigs la dad pa byed mkhan red zer ba/ chab srid thad stobs 'byor bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa yod pa tsam las chos med na skye ba phyi ma'i mdun lam brlag gi red zer ba sogs kyi gleng phyogs de tsho red/ de tsho tshang ma ni chos lugs dang mi rigs kyi dar cha khyer nas gleng phyogs bzos te/ kho pa tshos tshod dpag byed pa'i cha rkyen 'dzoms mtshams gsar brjer ngo rgol dang / mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byed pa'i ngo log zing 'khrug slong rgyu'i chab srid bsam blo'i gra sgrigs rang red/bod kyi mtho rim log spyod pa nyung shas kyis bslangs pa'i zing 'khrug 6/7

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de ni rlabs chen gyi krung go gung khran tang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i dbu khrid 'og gi bod kyi rgya che'i zhing 'brog ngal rtsol mi dmangs dang bod kyi mtho rim log spyod pa nyung shas shig bar rgyal pham thag chod byed pa'i mtha' ma'i dmag 'thab cig yin zhing / de'i nang bod kyi mnga' bdag chen po gsum mdung shugs gcig sgril byed pa de chos srid zung 'brel gyi srid dbang de'i gral rim gyi rang bzhin des thag bcad pa zhig yin pa ma gtogs dus skabs gcig nang glo bur du stes dbang gis byung ba zhig rtsa ba nas ma red/ de ni skabs de'i lo rgyus snang tshul las chos srid zung 'brel gyi gral rim rang bzhin dang / log spyod rang bzhin/ mgo skor gyi rang bzhin bcas gsal po mthong thub pa zhig red/kho pa tshos bslangs pa'i gsar brjer ngo rgol gyi ngo log zing 'khrug lhing 'jags btang nas lo ngo stong phrag ring bod kyi rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi mgo bor gnon pa'i ri bo chen po de gtor te ngan rgu tshang ba'i bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin chos srid zung 'brel gyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi med par bzos pa des de'i steng gi bkod pa'i gras yin pa'i chos lugs thad kyi dmigs bsal dbang cha'i rigs tshang mar rdung rdeg tshabs chen phog rgyu nges can red/ bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs dang dgon pa'i nang gi grwa pa khag gcig bcas rang lus rang dbang byung nas thon skyed nus shugs la bcings 'grol thob pa dang chabs cig lo ngo stong phrag ring rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs mi rabs nas mi rabs bar rta zog dud 'gro lta bu'i 'tsho ba skyel dgos pa'i 'byung rtsa ni/ bkas bkod 618

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/brgyud 'dzin chos srid zung 'brel gyi zhing bran lam lugs yin par ngos 'dzin gsal po thub pa dang / dngos 'brel chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan rnams rang mos kyis chos byas pa dang / rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims la brtsi srung byas na rang nyid kyi 'tsho bar 'gan srung yod pa bcas kyi thog nas blo bde bag phebs su gnas chog pa dang / rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs rnams sdug bsngal gyi 'tsho ba skyes ba'i nyi ma mjug sgril te rang lus rang dbang thob nas rgyal khab kyi bdag por gyur pa dang / de nas bzung bod kyi thon skyed dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung / mi 'bor bcas gang ci'i thad nas lo re las lo re yag tu phyin nas ha cang rjes lus yin pa'i bod rnying pa de dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i bod ljongs gsar pa zhig tu 'gyur ba'i 'go tshugs pa red/ 619

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsum pa/ mjug bsdoms gsal bshad/chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs chags pa'i lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul gong du bshad pa de'i thog nas/ chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs ma byung gong chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po tha dad du gnas pa'i lam lugs der rim bzhin 'gyur ldog byung nas chos srid gnyis ka'i bdag po mi gcig gis byed pa'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs chags pa'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos de yi thog nas/ bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs de glo bur du byung ba'i gnas tshul zhig min par/ de la lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen dang / spyi tshogs kyi rmang bzhi/ gral rim gi 'byung rtsa bcas ha cang gting zab po yod par gsal bshad byas pa red/(1)bod la chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs chags pa'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen ni/ bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar ba dang / gnas pa/ 'phel rgyas bcas kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa zhig ste/spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i 'gor rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod du sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar ba nas/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis bod la rab byung gi sde thog mar tshugs pa'i bar gyi lo grangs brgya lhag tsam ring bod kyi mi dmangs tshos sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs gnyis kar dad pa byed kyi yod kyang mang che ba bon po'i chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan yin nga/ dang / sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan gyi mang tshogs yo da pa las chos byed mkhan gyi 620

bod kyi chos sridazungawelaskorabashadapa/ da grwa pa zur du med cing / chos byed mkhan tshor sdod sa'i dgon pa zur du med la/ de tshor dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha gang yang med stabs/ bon po'i chos lugs dang 'gran zlar langs pa'i stobs shugs med pa bcas kyi thog ma'i dus skabs su gnas yod/ rgyal po khri srong sde btsan gyis srid dbang bzung nas lo na son rjes rgya gar nas slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa dang /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho sogs parnyita mang po gdan drangs nas bsam yas gtsug lag khang sogs lha khang mang po bzhengs shing / rgya gar dang rgya nag nas sangs rgyas chos kyi chos dpe mang po bod skad du bsgyur ba dang /lhag par du sad mi mi bdun zhes bod du rab byung gi sde tshugs thub bam mi thub brtag dpyad tshod lta byed mkhan mi bdun la dge tshul dang dge slong gi sdom pa gnang ste/ rim bzhin rab byung mi grangs sum brgya lhag tsam bar 'phel rgyas byung ba de tshor mkhan po bo dhi swa twa bzhugs ring rgyal po'i mdzod nas zas gos sogs gang dang gang dgos thad kar mkho sprod byed kyi yod rung / rgyal po sger gyi dpal 'byor stobs shugs de tsam brtan po med stabs/ rgyal po 'das rjes sngar bzhin grwa pa'i 'tsho ba rnams rgyal po'i mdzod nas mkho sprod thub min nges pa med par brten/rgyal po khri srong lde btsan ma 'das gong tsam du slob dpon dang / mkhan po/grwa pa/ sgom chen/ chos lhags slob gnyer ba bcas la lo re dang zla re'i za 'bru dang / tshwa/ mar/ gos rgyu/ snag shog sogs mang nyung ji tsam sprod dgos pa dang / grwa pa mi rer 'bangs mi khyim gsum re dbang chog pa bcas kyi gtan 'bebs ma bzos ka med byung ba dang / thog mar rgyal 62/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/po'i mdzod nas lo re zla rer phogs blangs pa'i lam lugs der legs bcos btang nas grwa pa'i 'tsho ba srid gzhung nas 'gan len byas pa de ni/chos byed grwa pa'i 'tsho ba'i chu tshad brtan por gnas thub pa'i bya thabs shig yin pa ma zad/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi chos khrims ltar khrims srung yang dag par byas na grwa pa rnams thon skyed byas te rang kha rang gsos kyi 'tsho ba skyel thub thabs med pa der srid gzhung nas brtsi 'jog dang srung skyob byas pa zhig red/ lam lugs de mu mthud nas rgyun 'khyodas byed thub na chos lugs mi sna rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad de tshad nges can zhig gi steng du tshod 'dzin byed thub kyi yod stabs chos lugs mi sna'i nang gi khag gcig srid dbang bzung mkhan gyi bdag por gyur nas chos srid gnyis ka'i dbang cha de chos lugs mi sna'i lag tu bzung ba'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs tshugs thub kyi ma red/'on kyang chos byed grwa pa rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen srid gzhung gis 'gan len byas pa'i lam lugs de grwa pa'i mi 'bor ha cang nyung ba'i gnas tshul 'og mu mthud nas rgyun 'khyodas byed thub kyang grwa pa'i mi 'bor mang du phyin nas kho tsho'i 'tsho ba srid gzhung gis 'gan srung thub pa'i tshad las brgal tshe lo ltar srid gzhung gi yong sgo las 'gro sgo je mang du song nas srid gzhung la dpal 'byor thog gyong gun chen po phog ste/srid gzhung nang gi las byed dpon rigs rnams kyi blo la ma babs pa je cher 'gro rgyu ma zad/ srid gzhung gi yo nga sgo/ smyo 2 sa 'gro sgo ji tsam mang na dpal 'byor gyi 'byung khungs rgya che'i mang cho /sa kyi thon skyed khur po yang 622

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/de tsam gyis che ru song nas mthar srid gzhung dang mang tshogs gnyis ka dpal 'byor thog nas dbul zhing phongs pa zhig tu 'gyur rgyu dang / srid gzhung gi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi brtan po med na de'i srid dbang yang 'thor zhig tu 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pa red/ ṇa der brten/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang / mu ne btsan po/ mu tig btsan po gsum gyi ring grwa pa ha cang mang po med stabs chos byed grwa pa'i 'tsho ba rnams srid gzhung nas phogs blangs pa'i lam lugs der gnas shing / grwa pa de tshor bran g.yog yod kyang / sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can sogs gang yang med pa'i phogs gzan pa dang / bran g.yog bdag po sha stag yin rung / rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi dus su stod lung mtshur phur yod pa'i dgon pa dang / lha sa'i phyogs bzhir yod pa'i dgon pa chung ba bzhi yi grwa pa rnams la 'tsho rten du sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can/ bran g.yog bcas rang bdag gi dbang cha sprad pa'i 'go btsugs te kho tsho'i 'tsho ba rnams srid gzhung gis thad kar sprod mi dgos pa byas nas srid gzhung gi khur po yang du gtong ba'i bya thabs bzung ba des rjes su srid gzhung la 'gyur ldog ji ltar byung yang chos byed grwa pa rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad sngar bzhin gnas thub pa'i 'gan srung byas pa red/ skabs de'i bcos sgrigs dang 'gyur ldog de ni chos lugs mi sna rnams bran g.yog yod kyang sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can sogs med pa'i bran g.yog bdag po zhig nas/ sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can/ bran g.yog bcas cha tshang yod pa'i zhing bran bdag 62 ni

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/po zhig tu 'gyur 'go tshugs pa dang / mthar lam lugs de je rgyas je 'phel la song nas dus yun lo grangs bzhi brgya lhag tsam ring snga phyir gsar du dar ba'i chos lugs tshogs pa khag gi dgon pa dang / mtho rim mi snas bod sa gnas khag gi sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can/bran g.yog bcas bdag bzung byed pa'i gzhi rgya ma chung tsam yod pa de ni bod la chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs chags pa dang 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen dang dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi yin/(2)chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs byung ba'i spyi tshogs kyi rmang gzhi dang gral rim gyi 'byung rtsa ni bod kyi chos lugs tshogs pa khag gi mtho rim mi sna nyung shas shig thog mar bran g.yog gi bdag po yin pa nas rim bzhin sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / phyugs rigs/ bran g.yog bcas sger bzung byed mkhan gyi zhing bran bdag por gyur pa dang / grwa pa mang che ba rnams mtho rim mi sna de tsho'i gnya' gnon dang / bshu gzhog myong mkhan gyi dbul phongs shig tu gyur zhing / chos lugs mi sna tshang ma/'i 'tsho ba'i brten sa ni chos dad yod pa'i mi gzhan dag gis dad 'bul byas pa'i 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen la brten pa ma gtogs thon skyed byas te rang kha rang gsos thub thabs med pa dang / bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs 'og rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog tshad las 'das pa myong dgos pa'i sdug bsngal ma bzod pa'i dbang gis zhing bran khag gcig sdug bsngal de las g.yol thabs byed ched grwa pa'i nang du sgrigs zhugs byas te zhing bran lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong mi 624

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ —da —da wadagos par gzhan brten gyi 'tsho bas nyi ma 'khyol thub tsam gyi dbul phongs shig yin pa bcas chos lugs mi sna'i nang gral rim khag gnyis su gyes pa ma zad/ mtho rim mi sna de tshor dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi tshad mtho tsam yod stabs sa zhing bogs mar gtong ba dang / len pa/ skyed lci'i bu lon gtong ba/ tshong rgyag pa sogs kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi bya thabs sna tshogs la brten nas bod sa gnas kyi dpal 'byor srog rtsa khag gcig rang nyid kyi lag tu gcig sdud byed thub pa byung ba dang /dpal 'byor gyi go gnas de srung skyob byed ched/ chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi sna khag gcig stegis dus skabs der stobs shugs che ba'i chab srid kyi stobs shugs la rgyab brten bcol ba dang / khag gcig gis rang nyid kyis dngos su srid dbang bzung ba bcas bya thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis la brten nas rang nyid kyi chos lugs stobs shugs dang / dpal 'byor gyi dmigs bsal dbang cha'i go gnas srung thabs mi byed ka med yin pa de ni/ bod la chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs 'byung ba'i gral rim gyi 'byung rtsa red/(3)bod la chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs 'phel rgyas kyi go rim dus rim mtho shos su slebs skabs chos lugs mi sna khag gcig gis srid dbang bzung 'go tshugs pa'i dang po ni sa skya chos lugs kyi phyogs khag yin pa dang / de rjes phag gru bka' brgyud phyogs khag mtha' 'jug dge lugs phyogs khag bcas kyis rim bzhin bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung zhing / dus skabs de dag gi ring la chos lugs tshogs pa khag bar 625

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mchod gzhis mi ser 'phrog res kyi 'thab rtsod ni 'gal ba gtso bo'i go gnas bzung yod pa dang /tsho chos lugs khag bar gyi lta ba mi mthun pa'i 'thab rtsod ni 'gal ba phal pa'i gnas su bsdad yod pa red/ mchod gzhis mi ser 'phrog res kyi 'thab rtsod byed skabs dbang sgyur gral rim pa tshos nam yin yang chos lugs khag gi mi rigs rang bzhin dang / sa khul rang bzhin ldan pa'i mang tshogs kyi dad mos stobs shugs bed spyad nas rang nyid kyi 'thab rtsod la zhabs 'degs zhu gi yod pa dang / lhag par du chos lugs tshogs pa khag gis dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul bar mchod gzhis mi ser 'phrog res dang / srid dbang 'phrog res kyi 'thab rtsod rno ngar che ba'i 'gal zla yod pa de nam yin yang phyi nas yong ba'i btsan rgyal ring lugs pa tshos bed spyad nas mi rigs gcig gi nang khul kha bral che ru btang ste rang nyid kyi stobs shugs bod sa gnas su sim 'dzul bya thabs bzung gi yod pa de ni/ bod sa gnas nang khul du chos lugs stobs shugs tshogs pa khag gis rang nyid la yod pa'i srid dbang gi stobs shugs dang dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs bed spyad de chos lugs tshogs pa gzhan dag la gnya' gnon byed pa'i chab srid thog gi srid jus nor 'khrul can de la brten nas byung ba dang / de'i rtsa ba mthar gtugs na rim byung bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis chos lugs mi sna tshor dus tshod gtan khel gyis phogs sprod pa'i lam lugs lag len bstar ba'i dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs med pa'i dbang gis chos lugs mi sna tshor mchod gzhis sa zhing dang / 'brog thang / sems can/ bran g.yog bcas rang 626

bod kyi chos sridazunga'abrelaskorabashadapa/ da wad wadabang gi dmigs bsal dbang cha sprad pa'i dpal 'byor thog gi srid jus nor 'khrul can de la brten nas byung ba red/ri da cha krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid 'og bod kyi rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs rnams bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs 'og nas dngos su rang dbang ldan pa'i bcings 'grol thob nas bde skyid ldan pa'i 'tsho ba skyel rgyu byung ba ma zad/ dngos 'brel chos la dad pa byed mkhan gyi chos lugs mi sna rnams kyang chos srid mnyam 'brel chos min srid min gyi lam lugs 'og nas bcings 'grol thob ste/ rgyal gces khrims srung gi 'gro lam 'og chos dad rang mos kyi dbang cha longasasnyu spyod pa dang chabs cig chos lugs mi sna tsho'i 'tsho ba'i thad la'ang rgyal khab nas thugs khur lta rtog gnang ste blo bde bag phebs kyi ngang nas chos byed chog pa dang / srid jus lag len bstar ba'i nang g.yon thal gyi nor 'khrul shor ba rnams kyang tang krung dbyang gis dus thog tu yo bsrang gnang dang gnang mus red/bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel lam lugs nang rgyun ring 'tsho ba skyel te bshu gzhog gral rim gyi bag chags gting zab yod pa'i chos lugs mi sna nga rang 'dra ba yang / krung go gung khran tang gi byams brtse'i thugs khur 'og gsar brje'i las don nang zhugs nas/ mar le'i gsung rtsom dang /ma'o tse tung gi gsung rtsom slob sbyong byas pa dang chabs cig zhar dang zhor la spyi tshogs tshan rig dang / rang byung tshan rig snga rabs bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha mang po bltas pa brgyud/ rtsod sgrub dngos gtso smra ba'i lo rgyus 627

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lta tshul la go ba cung zad gting zab tsam lon thub pa dang / mthong rgya che ru song ba 'di la blta dus/ de sngon rang nyid dgon pa'i nang bla ma byas te 'dzam gling spyi tshogs kyi 'gyur ldog dang / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul gang yang shes rtogs ma byung ba de dang bsdur na dga' tshor skye 'os pa'i grub 'bras red bsam gyi 'dug sngar song lo rgyus kyi yig cha rnying pa dang / lo rgyus kyi bya ba rnying pa/ lo rgyus kyi dngos po rnying pa bcas la zhib 'jug dang brtag dpyad byas pa'i go rim brgyud deng rabs kyi bya dngos gsar par ngos 'dzin dang bslab bya len rgyur rang nyid la blo sgo chen po phye thub pa byung bar brten/ bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs gang 'dra byas nas byung ba'i lo rgyus skor la rang gi lta tshul dngos gnas gang yod sbas gsang med par bris pa yin pas gzigs pa po rnams kyis rtsom yig 'di la legs bcos dang skyon cha gang yod dgongs 'char dang / rin thang bral ba'i bka' slob yod pa zhu//rtsom yig 'di'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs skor ngo sprod/bod yig gi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha'i skor/〈 1 〉〈 rba bzhed zhabs btags ma 〉rigs mi 'dra ba gsum/〈 2 〉 tshal pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros sam kun dga' rdo rjes brtsams pa'i 〈 deb ther dmar po 〉mi 'dra ba khag bzhi/〈 3 〉 dga' ldan khri thog bco lnga pa pan chen bsod nams grags pas brtsams pa'i 〈 deb ther dmar po gsar ma'am rgyal rabs 'phrul gyi lde mig 〉 628

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/〈 4〉 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 deb ther sngon po〉〈 5〉 dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas brtsams pa'i 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉〈 6〉 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas brtsams pa'i 〈 bod kyi rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉〈 7〉 thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas brtsams pa'i 〈 grub mtha' thams cad kyi khungs dang 'dod tshul bstan pa legs bshad shel gyi me long〉〈 8 〉 sum pa mkhan chen ye shes dpal 'byor gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 rgya dkar nag bod sog gi yul du dam pa'i chos byung tshul bshad pa dpag bsam ljon bzang〉〈 9 〉 dpal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 rgya bod hor sog gi lo rgyus byis pa 'jug pa'i 'bab stegs〉〈 10 〉 mi bzang mgon po skyabs kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 rgya nag chos 'byung〉〈 11 〉 jo nang tā ra nā thas brtsams pa'i 〈 rgya gar chos 'byung dgos 'dod kun 'byung〉〈 12〉 ri bo che dpon tshang tshe dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 lho rong chos 'byung thub bstan gsal byed〉〈 13 〉 gu ge mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pas brtsams pa'i 〈 mnga' ris chos 'byung〉〈 14〉 sog po dam chos rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i 〈 chen po hor gyi yul du dam chos dar tshul gsal bar ston pa pad ma dkar po 'i phreng ba〉〈 15〉 a mes ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 sa skya'i gdung rabs rin bang mdzod〉〈 16〉 'be lo tsa ba tshe dbang kun khyab kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 karma kam tshang gi chos 'byung〉 629

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/〈 17 〉 brag sgom pa bstan pa rab rgyas kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya mtsho〉〈 18 〉 sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i 〈 dga' ldan chos 'byung be+eḍūr+ya ser po〉 〈 19 〉 sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i 〈 khrims yig dwangs shel me long〉 〈 20 〉 'jog po ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 tshal gub thang gi dkar chag 'gro mgon zhal lung 〉〈 21 〉 mkhas pa dkar shag pas brtsams pa'i 〈 sde pa rin spungs pa'i gdung rabs〉〈 22 〉 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i gleng bzhi phyogs bsdus〉〈 23 〉 tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 bka' chems deb ther〉〈 24〉 rwa ye shes seng ges brtsams pa'i 〈 rwa lo tsā ba'i rnam thar dang de'i lhan thabs〉〈 25 〉〈 mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi rnam thar gter ma〉〈 26 〉 cha har dge bshes blo bzang tshul khrims kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 tsong kha pa'i rnam thar bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas〉〈 27 〉 ser smad mkhan po grags pa mkhas grub kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 dge ldan khri thog rim byon gyi rnam thar〉〈 28 〉 g.yang ba chos rje dkon mchog skyabs kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub kyi rnam thar〉〈 29 〉 pan chen bsod nams grags pas brtsams pa'i 〈 tā la'i bla ma sku 630

bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa/phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar〉〈 30 〉 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas brtsams pa'i 〈 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar〉〈 31 〉 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas brtsams pa'i 〈 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar〉〈 32 〉 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas brtsams pa'i 〈 rang nyid kyi rnam thar du ku la'i gos bzang〉〈 33 〉 sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i 〈 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i rnam thar gyi kha skong 〉〈 34〉 sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i 〈 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi dkar chag〉〈 35 〉 sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i 〈 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rnam thar rgyas pa 〉〈 gsang ba'i rnam thar〉〈 36 〉 lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes brtsams pa'i 〈 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dpag bsam snye ma〉〈 37〉 de mo ho thog thu bde legs rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i 〈 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i rnam thar 'dzam gling tha grur yangs pa'i rgyan 〉〈 38 〉 phur lcog yongs 'dzin byams pa tshul khrims kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar rin chen phreng ba 〉〈 39 〉 pan chen er te ni sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 pan chen er te ni sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar kha skong 〉〈 40 〉 pan chen er te ni sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes kyis brtsams pa'i 〈 rang nyid kyi rnam thar 'od dkar can gyi phreng ba 〉ci 63/

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/〈 41 〉 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang pos brtsams pa'i 〈 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng dang po ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar skal bzang 'jug ngogs〉〈 42 〉 thu'u bstan chos kyi nyi mas brtsams pa'i 〈 lcang skya ho thog thu rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar dge ldan bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan〉〈 43 〉〈 tun hong nas thon pa'i bod yig gi bod kyi lo rgyus shog dril khag bzhi〉〈 44〉〈 lha sa po tā la'i pho brang gi mdun ngos su yod pa'i rdo ring phyi ma'i ngo bshus〉〈 45〉〈 rgyal sde dkar chung lha khang gi rdo ring yi ge ngo bshus〉〈 46〉〈 stod lung mtshur phu dgon par yod pa'i rdo ring gi yi ge ngo bshus〉〈 47〉 mdo mkhar zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 pho lha mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gyi rtogs brjod〉〈 48 〉 rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 rdo ring gung parnyi ta'i mi rabs kyi byung ba brjod pa〉rgya yig gi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha'i skor/〈 1 〉 en ke si'i gsung rtsom 〈 h+phe li ti li zhi we'i lan skye phreng bzhi pa〉〈 2 〉 mar khe si'i gsung rtsom 〈 yi'u tha'i mi rigs kyi gnad don skor〉〈 3 〉 deng skabs par skrun byas pa'i rgya yig gi 〈 krung go'i lo rgyus phyogs bsdus〉〈 4〉 blo mthun ko mo ros brtsams pa'i 〈 krung go'i spyi tshogs kyi dus rim 'pho 'gyur skor bshad pa〉 632

dpe sgrig 'gan khur pa/skal bzang dar rgyas/mdun shog jus 'god pa/pe h+phun/dung dkar ༵ dūzlo d+nghad rnyi rdi shā byisna dañtsā ṭ+wāṃsna r+sha rdosdu ñtshasnas/ bsgrigs/mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dpe tshong khang gis bkramadu/'di ga dpe skrun khang gi glog rdul rtsis 'khor khang gis par gzhi bsgrigs/pe cin zhang dbyang 'gyig par khang gis dpar btab// lo'i zla 12par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs// lo'i zla 12par dpar thengs dang po brgyab/cigs rnoresgo//phrosnu / ba zan ra
